title: Sela Marr
text: Marr gained much experience on and beyond the war front, leading a group of Aetheri younglings to revolt against their Trandoshan captors, helping rescue a colony of Solinai from enslavement by the Zygeran Slave Imperium , and serving as an advisor to the Underra insurgents —with her close friend, Lux Bontero , among them—as they liberated their world from the Fractio. In a stark turn of events, Marr was framed for the bombing of the Aetheri Sanctum hangar and other homicides, and she escaped into the Vantor Underworld to clear her name. Though she formed an unlikely alliance with Kessa Vray, she was detained by Republic forces and was consequently barred from the Aetheri Order. Ultimately, Drayden uncovered the true culprit, Marr's friend, and fellow Adept Barris Ovva , and prevented his former apprentice from being convicted of sedition . Nevertheless, the ordeal dislodged Marr's faith in the Aetheri. She refused the Aetheri High Council 's offer to rejoin the Order, instead departing in search of a new path. Marr briefly returned to lead Republic forces during the Siege of Ferrum and faced Vreth and his allies. Directive 66 was enacted shortly after the Umbra Lord's capture and Marr alongside

title: Sela Marr
text: At some point, Marr traveled to the Aetheri Sanctum on the ice planet Ilum to acquire a kyber crystal for a flux blade , feeling the crystals , albeit without knowing that was what she sensed, as soon as the Aetheri starship came out of hyperspace . She entered into the temple's cave after Grand Master Zho told her she would know her crystal when she found it. As the opening to the cave slowly closed as the sun of Asar set, she urgently looked for her crystal until she calmed herself, thinking back on Zho's words and only then seeing its light. Excited and ready to leave, she quickly made her way out of the cave with the tool for which she could build her own flux blade . Although her visit to Ilum had overall been unremarkable, her decision to trust Zho's teaching restored her ability to trust others after it was impacted by the false Aetheri. From there, she would construct said flux blade using the kyber crystal under the tutelage of Aetheri architect droid Huyang , who fussed over her shoulder as she worked on it. At another point, Zho taught her that she could sometimes

text:
others after it was impacted by the false Aetheri. From there, she would construct said flux blade using the kyber crystal under the tutelage of Aetheri architect droid Huyang , who fussed over her shoulder as she worked on it. At another point, Zho taught her that she could sometimes find something she was not looking for in a situation. During her time at the Aetheri Sanctum, Professor Huyang would regale her with the History of the Galaxy, Parts One, Two and Three , of which she considered part one the best.

### In the midst of galactic war

#### Becoming Drayden's Adept

> " I'm the new Adept learner. I'm Sela Marr. " ―Sela Marr introduces herself — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Sela Marr
text: The Aetheri Council finally sent Marr on her first mission to the planet Krestophis in order to meet her new mentor and inform Kade and him that they were needed back at the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor. However, after arriving on the planet moments after a wave of Dissident forces pulled back and giving that message to the two, she learned that the Republic had in fact failed to take the planet as the Aetheri on Vantor had believed, leaving the generals and their forces trapped and outnumbered as the battle dragged on. Kade introduced himself, presuming that she was his new Adept learner. She corrected him, insisting that Master Zho specifically assigned her to Drayden, who was shocked to hear the news due to the fact that he had spoken adamantly against the idea of taking on an Adept learner. Despite Kade's confusion, he accepted that having an Adept would be good for Drayden, who vehemently disagreed.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Meanwhile, the droid army set up a deflector shield that would block the Republic artillery bombardment that earlier halted their advancements. Drayden took Marr to check on Replica Captain CT-7567 "Vek," who was also confused by Marr's presence, referencing Drayden's earlier affirmation against taking on an Adept learner. Marr stood up for herself, saying that Zho believed she was capable and that she would prove it. As Drayden went on ahead, Marr asked Vek if she outranked him, to which Vek responded that experience outranked any kind of designated command. However, Marr just responded that she was eager to get some.

#### Liberation of Krestophis

> " You're reckless, little one. You never would have made it as Orien's Adept… but you might make it as mine. " ―Kael Drayden to Sela Marr, following the Battle of Krestophis — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Sela Marr
text:
Republic forces were forced to land below the monastery, with Marr riding in a LAAT/i gunship with Drayden, Vek, and several other troopers . After landing, their forces began to scale the mountain with AT-TE walkers and ascension cables where the building was located. Drayden led the charge and Marr stood on top of a walker and deflected oncoming laser fire. The climb proved to be a challenge, but the Aetheri and replicas eventually reached the top of the mountain.

After securing the outer perimeter, they discovered a caretaker droid called 4-A7 , who revealed the location of the captured Grak. Drayden and Marr went to look for him and were forced to fight several enemy battle droids, but eventually found the cell where the Grak was located. Rotto turned out to be just a Grakling. Meanwhile, 4-A7, who actually served the Dissidents and Dark Adept Kessa Vray , recorded the Aetheri's speech. Vray transmitted the recording to her master, Count Varek , who gave the "evidence" to Grukk that the Aetheri were behind the kidnapping. Varek assured Grukk that he would sent his army to "rescue" Rotto, intending to gain Grukk's favor for safe passage through the system.

title: Sela Marr
text: With the incoming droid army on their way and the little Grakling sick, the Aetheri had to look for another way out to bring the kidnapped Grak back to Dunemere . On their way out, Vray had arrived and eventually located the two and engaged them in battle. After a brief duel , they escaped on a can-cell to a nearby hangar , followed by Drayden's astromech droid , Bolt-3 , to where a ship, the Twilight , was berthed. Once on the other platform, they encountered 4-A7 once again. However, it became obvious the droid was a spy when three battle droids came out of the ship. The Aetheri destroyed the droids and hijacked the ship.

title: Sela Marr
text:
While on the escape, Master Kade and Republic reinforcements had arrived with Kade engaging in a duel with Vray. Now on the ship, Drayden and Marr attempted to land on a Republic Iron Cruiser, but the cruiser 's hangar was destroyed, forcing the Aetheri to make their way to Dunemere on their own. As the two jumped to hyperspace, Vray and Kade sensed their withdrawal. Kade, knowing that Vray had failed her mission and that her master would be displeased to learn that, managed to gain the upper hand over Vray until she boarded a Vulture droid to escape capture.

Meanwhile, Marr and Drayden found medicine for the Grakling, which saved his life as they made their way back to Grukk's palace on Dunemere. However, as they approached Dunemere, they came under attack by two MagnaGuards in Renegade -class Porax-38 starfighters . Despite destroying the fighters, their ship was forced to crash-land in the Dune Sea . Marr, Drayden, and Bolt then took Rotto across the Dune Sea to reach his father's palace. However, she and Drayden sensed Varek's presence.

title: Sela Marr
text:
While Drayden distracted Varek in a duel, Marr and Bolt took Rotto to Grukk's palace. However, they came under attack by several MagnaGuards. Marr fought the MagnaGuards, destroying them all and meeting up with her master at Grukk's palace. However, Grukk ordered their execution until he was contacted by his uncle, Ziro . Senator Lira Ondar then revealed to Grukk that his uncle was working with Varek and was the one who arranged Rotto's kidnapping. Grukk then spared their lives, and Marr and her master were picked up by Master Kade and Zho.

#### The Malignar

> " Wait! Just because there haven't been any survivors before doesn't mean there won't be any this time! " ―Sela Marr, to Chancellor Mal and Aetheri Council — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Sela Marr
text: At some point, Kade told Marr about how his own master, Sorin Vael , found Drayden because of his quick reflexes. During the hunt for the Fractio's new warship , the Malignar , which was a Subjugator -class heavy cruiser armed with two mega-ion cannons powerful enough to disable the power systems of an entire fleet of warships, Marr, along with her master, were sent to protect the staging area in the Bith system . She and Drayden were contacted by Master Tor Vayne, who had tracked the Fractio's secret weapon to the Abregado system . When Vayne's transmission was lost, Marr urged her master to send support to Vayne, but he required the Chancellor's and Aetheri Council's permission. During the meeting, Drayden and the Council believed that there were no survivors and Drayden was ordered to protect the Republic's convoys . Marr then spoke up and urged them to search for survivors, but she was rebuffed by the Council and the Supreme Chancellor for her outburst. Drayden had Admiral Yular deploy their fleet while Drayden and Marr took the Twilight to "scout ahead."

title: Sela Marr
text: Despite Marr's outburst, her master agreed with her that they must search for survivors. At first, they were unsuccessful and were ordered by both Kade and Mal to give up their search. However, as Drayden piloted the Twilight away, Marr sensed Vayne and took the controls, piloting the Twilight to his escape pod 's location. Marr and Drayden found Vayne with the replicas Commander Wolffe , Sergeant Sinker , and trooper Boost . They learned from Vayne that the Malignar ' s weapon was an ion cannon mounted on an enormous ship that could disable ships. Marr then detected the Malignar approaching them and hurried to disable power so they could blend into the debris field. At first, the ship passed, but it then detected the Twilight ' s medical droid TB-2 , who was caring for the injured Wolffe, and fired the mega-ion cannon . Drayden was able to outmaneuver debris and jump to hyperspace before the blast wave reached them.

title: Sela Marr
text: Following their return to the Republic fleet and the Resolute , Drayden and Marr were given command of Shadow Squadron and dispatched on their next mission: to destroy both General Skarn and the Malignar . Marr and Vayne were both skeptical of the plan, knowing that Skarn would be well protected by his ship's defenses. Marr and Drayden were then informed Skarn had attacked a medical convoy in the Ryndellia system . Drayden deduced that Skarn's next target was the Republic's secret Outer Reach medical center near the Kaliida Nebula . Marr served as Drayden's gunner aboard his BTL-B Yarrow starfighter/bomber as Shadow Squadron flew to intercept Skarn.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr, along with her master, Vayne, and Shadow Squadron, took a shortcut through the nebula. During the journey, Marr detected several Neebray mantas. Despite damage to one of the bombers and an astromech, Marr, Drayden, Vayne, and Shadow Squadron reached the medical station. The Malignar then arrived, and Marr shot down several of the vulture droids despite her master's fancy flying. When Shadow Squadron started to lose more ships, Marr convinced her master to target the ion cannon instead of the bridge. This strategy succeeded in disabling both the Malignar ' s ion cannons and its hyperrelay. Marr, Drayden, and Vayne then rejoined Kade aboard the Resolute as he continued attacking the Malignar . However, Marr detected an Ondara ship approaching the battlefield. Marr then picked up a comm signal from the ship's pilot, Senator Lira Ondar. When Ondar was captured by a grapple beam, Drayden decided to rescue the senator. Marr remained on the bridge of the Resolute with Vayne and Admiral Yular and guided both her master and Kade through the ship to find Ondar and her protocol droid , Astra-9 , until Skarn jammed their transmissions. Marr watched as Drayden, Kade, and Ondar made their escape, and the the Malignar crashed into the Dead Moon of Antar .

#### Battle of Bothawui and search for Bolt-3

> " They sent a child to destroy my station? The Republic must be running out of Aetheri. " " You must be General Skarn. He's just another tinny, boys. Let's scrap him like the rest. " ―Skarn goads Marr above the Ruusan moon — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Sela Marr
text: Following the Republic's defeat at Falleen , Marr, Drayden and their fleet were stationed at Bothawui to protect it. Marr agreed with Kade that they should retreat, but stood by her master when he refused to do so. Marr was part of Resolute command as Drayden, Bolt, and Gold Squadron engaged Skarn's fleet. As Skarn's fleet hit them, Marr signaled Vek and his AT-TEs to open fire from the asteroids behind Skarn's fleet. Though they destroyed the bulk of Skarn's fleet, Skarn himself escaped. After Drayden was injured when his starfighter collided with a large piece of shrapnel, he was brought to the Resolute to recover, though Bolt was left behind. Marr later accompanied her master along with Bolt's temporary replacement R3-S6 , secretly a spy for General Skarn, on a subsequent salvage operation to try and recover the droid. Marr was optimistic R3 would be a suitable replacement but failed to convince Drayden that R3 could ever replace Bolt. The pair boarded a nearby salvaging ship piloted by the Trandoshan scavenger Gha Nachkt . R3, secretly in league with the Dissidents, activated several VX-88 assassin droids , which attacked the two Aetheri within the ship's cargo hold. After failing to find Bolt, they left to continue their search, unaware that Nachkt was also in league with Skarn and was secretly hiding Bolt from the Aetheri. After Drayden was caught in an ambush by Skarn as a result of R3's sabotage, Marr and Vek were forced to rescue him, once again escaping the General's clutches. Marr continued to stick up for R3, but this only made Drayden angrier since they were no closer to finding Bolt.

title: Sela Marr
text:
of the troopers save Vek and Denal. Before he could deal a killing blow to Vek, his strike was parried by Marr's own flux blade, and the two engaged in a duel. Far outmatched by the cyborg General, Marr retreated into another room full of spare droid parts along with R3. As she hid, she contacted Vek and ordered him to proceed with the mission and continue to plant explosives with Denal while she distracted Skarn. Then, she was discovered and ambushed by Skarn thanks to the betrayal of R3. She escaped into the ventilation shaft and rendezvoused with the rest of the crew at the hangar and saw that Bolt had been rescued. They escaped on board the Twilight , this time with Bolt, just as the station exploded. #### Capture of Viceroy Gunray

> " If it isn't the hairless harpy. " " If it isn't Drayden's filthy, obnoxious little pet. " " How nice of you. Tell you what, I'll give you a merciful death. " ―Sela Marr and Kessa Vray — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Sela Marr
text: Following the Republic's apprehension of Dissident Viceroy Nutis Gunray , thanks to the efforts of Lira Ondar and Senator Onaconda Farr on Rodanor , Sela Marr, and Master Luminara Undula were tasked with overseeing Gunray's voyage to Vantor aboard the Tranquility , where he would be put on trial for his crimes. Several Senate Commandos under Captain Faro Argyus were also dispatched as extra security to accompany the Aetheri. Though Marr was initially skeptical of the need for so much security for just one Geltari , Undula assured the Adept that his allies could easily be conspiring against them and devising a rescue plan. The Mirialan Aetheri Master was indeed correct, as Count Varek had already sent his most trusted assassin , Kessa Vray, to extract the Viceroy and return him to the Dissidents. As Marr and Undula attempted to interrogate Gunray, with the Aetheri Master chastising Marr for threatening him out of impatience, Vray and her small contingent of Super Battle Droids breached the hull of the ship.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr was left to guard Gunray as Undula and Commander Grev went to deal with the droids, where she was confronted by Vray, who had slipped inside the ship undetected. Marr was once again confident enough to taunt Vray as they dueled. The two dueled for a short time before Vray managed to free Gunray and tricked Marr, trapping the Adept behind an energy shield in his holding cell. Undula arrived shortly after, freeing Marr so the two of them could duel Vray together. However, instead of surrendering, Vray set off several explosives which she had planted in the engine room, knocking both Aetheri to the deck, and escaped down the elevator shaft. Though Marr wanted to follow and confront the assassin once again, Undula beckoned her to stay put despite her protests. Ultimately deciding to disobey Undula's instructions, Marr arrived just in time to save the Aetheri Master from certain death by Vray' blade. United as a team, the two Aetheri confronted Vray for a second time, though she once again escaped, this time accompanied by Gunray and Republic defector Faro Argyus. Thus, Vray successfully completed, her mission much to the dismay of Marr and Undula.

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Rescue on Vanqor

> " We had the situation well under control, my little Adept. " " Oh, I see. So which part of the situation did you have under control? The blocked entrance, the poison gas, or that gundark behind you? " ―Drayden and Marr — Link ▶️ ( file info )

After her master and Orien Kade were trapped in a cave on the crystalline planet of Vanqor after crash landing during a confrontation with the leader of the Fractio of Independent Systems Count Varek, Marr and a small extraction team of replica troopers were dispatched to rescue to two Aetheri. Marr and her team blasted apart the collapsed cave opening in order to free Drayden and Kade, who had collapsed from the fumes of a noxious green gas which they had accidentally released. They then re-sealed the cave entrance, trapping a swarm of Gundarks inside.

#### Stranded on Maridun

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Stranded on Maridun

> " Okay, you and Bly go south. Vek and I will stay here with Kael. " " No, Sela. In order to get help quickly we must work together. " " I can't leave him! Master, I know if I was hurt, he'd never leave me behind. " ―Marr argues with Ciel Venn — Link ▶️ ( file info ) Sela Marr and Kael Drayden, along with a fleet of Republic gunships , were later sent to evacuate Aetheri Knight Ciel Venn from Dissident forces after her fleet had been defeated during the Battle of Quell . The two Aetheri, Vek, and their replica battalion managed to board Venn's ship and rendezvous with the Velari Aetheri and her own battalion, narrowly escaping onto a docked cruiser with an injured Drayden, who had been caught in an explosion from the Dissident attack. Marr and Drayden led Venn and some survivors from her battalion, which were Replica Commander Bly , Lucky , Flash , and Cameron , to a cruiser. On their way, Drayden was gravely injured saving the group from an explosion. They were forced to jump to hyperspace prematurely in order to escape the exploding Resolute in time, much to the alarm of Admiral Yular. As a result, they were forced to crash-land on Maridun in order to avoid colliding with one of its nearby stars.

title: Sela Marr
text: Stranded on the planet following the explosion of their cruiser, they set up a crude camp using some parts from the wrecked ship. Fearing for her wounded master, Marr volunteered to watch over him with Vek, but Venn insisted that they instead work together to find help from the local population. Marr reluctantly agreed and accompanied Venn and Commander Bly to scout for help while Vek remained with Drayden. Along the way, the young Adept confessed to Venn her feelings of confusion towards the Aetheri Code over the rule of not forming attachments yet also showing compassion. In response, Venn shared similar feelings that she used to have regarding her own master , whom she eventually was able to let go. Not long after, they were ambushed by a pack of mastiff phalones which killed Flash, Lucky, and Cameron. After a long journey, they found the local Lurmen village, encountering the village elder Tee Watt Kaa and his son Wag Too . Initially, Watt Kaa refused to help the Aetheri, not wanting to be involved in the war, but later agreed to send his son with Marr to retrieve Drayden for healing on the condition that Venn remained with the

title: Sela Marr
text:
the village elder Tee Watt Kaa and his son Wag Too . Initially, Watt Kaa refused to help the Aetheri, not wanting to be involved in the war, but later agreed to send his son with Marr to retrieve Drayden for healing on the condition that Venn remained with the village as insurance. Wag Too and Marr later returned with Drayden and Too healed his wounds using native healing oils. When Dissident forces arrived under the command of Lok Durd in order to impose their "protection" of the Lurmen people, the Aetheri were forced to leave the village to prevent the villagers from paying the price due to their presence. As the Aetheri hid, they discovered a nearby heavily guarded Dissident base and Durd's superweapon : the Defoliator , which was capable of destroying all organic life. When they realized that Durd meant to test this weapon on the Lurmen village, the Aetheri revealed themselves to protect the villagers. At first, Watt Kaa adamantly opposed getting involved in any way, not even defending his people, but changed his mind after the Aetheri fended off Durd's forces and saved the village from annihilation, thanking them personally for their efforts.

#### Containing the Blue Shadow Virus

> " Senator Ondar. We're trapped in the safe room at the end of complex B. " " We'll be right there. Are you contaminated? " " I'm afraid so. " ―Marr communicates with Ondar on Ondara — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Sela Marr
text: After the sudden disappearance of Senators Lira Ondar and Greeb Mool on Ondara during her investigation of a viral outbreak among the natives, Marr, Drayden, and Kade were dispatched to Serath . Upon arrival, Drayden sent Marr with Mool native Peppi Bow to investigate the swamps where Ondar and Mool were last seen. Inadvertently, they triggered a spy camera , which they managed to hide from, indicating the presence of an underground bunker beneath the swamp. Acting on the instructions of Kade and Drayden, Marr infiltrated the facility by dropping a thermal detonator down one of the exit hatches, allowing for easier entrance. Marr and Vek discovered that Doctor Nuvo Vindi had a secret laboratory underneath the ground and that he was responsible for the creation of the virus that he called the Blue Shadow Virus . They then distracted Vindi's droids , allowing Kade and Drayden to infiltrate the facility quietly. The Aetheri captured Vindi before he could detonate the bombs inside the facility and thus release the Blue Shadow Virus into Ondara's atmosphere. However, unbeknownst to anyone, one of Vindi's servant droids had stolen one of the bombs before it could be deactivated by Kade and the replica

title: Sela Marr
text:
facility quietly. The Aetheri captured Vindi before he could detonate the bombs inside the facility and thus release the Blue Shadow Virus into Ondara's atmosphere. However, unbeknownst to anyone, one of Vindi's servant droids had stolen one of the bombs before it could be deactivated by Kade and the replica bomb squad . Before the facility could be properly evacuated, the servant droid activated its bomb shortly before destroying himself, releasing the virus. Ondar triggered the alarm in time, shutting down the facility and preventing the virus from escaping to the outside. Marr, trapped inside, made it into a safe room along with several other replicas, but was unfortunately contaminated. While her masters attempted to find a cure on Iego , Marr and Ondar worked together to prevent any droids from escaping the facility and thereby releasing the virus into Ondara's air. Eventually, thanks to Greeb Mool's clumsiness, Ondar also became infected by the virus, and her and Marr's conditions worsened as time went on, and many replicas died. At one point, Marr collapsed and fell unconscious from the effects of the virus. Luckily, Drayden and Kade were able to obtain a cure, stop the virus, and rescue Vek, Ondar, Marr, and the surviving replicas.

#### Battle of Selvara

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Battle of Selvara

> Naval Officer : " Perhaps a different strategy. We need to take more time and plan. " Marr : " No! We don't have any more time! Master Drayden needs me now! He needs us now. " Admiral Yular : " The Commander is right. " ―Marr convinces her troops to utilize her strategy — Link ▶️ ( file info ) Sela Marr took command of her own squadron for the first time during the Battle of Selvara , which she participated in along with her master. Marr led the replica pilots of Blue Squadron , Axe , Slammer , Kickback , Tucker , and Swoop , into battle against the Dissident blockade that was helmed by Captain Mar Tuuk . However, Marr's squadron had fallen right into a trap, and they were ambushed by four Munificent -class star frigates . Marr stubbornly insisted that they continue their attack rather than retreating as instructed to her by Drayden and Admiral Yular. After the majority of the replicas' starfighters were destroyed as a result, Marr returned to the Resolute , devastated by the loss of her squad . Her master then reprimanded her for disobeying direct orders, and though she claimed that she was only acting on his teachings, she accepted full responsibility for her actions. Though Drayden attempted to console her, the loss of her pilots left Marr scarred and feeling incredibly guilty.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Later, Drayden devised a plan to ram the Defender directly into the blockade, thus taking out Tuuk in the process, and allowing the full bulk of their forces, under the command of Marr, to finish the job by taking out the rest of the blockade while Drayden jettisoned himself in an escape pod. Marr, still affected by her losses, reluctantly accepted leadership once again, this time successfully destroying the blockade with her Yarrow squadron while simultaneously protecting the Resolute by ordering Vek and Yular into a unorthodox tilt maneuver , turning the cruiser's bridge away from the enemy fire so that only the belly of the ship was exposed. With the blockade destroyed, the Republic could begin its liberation of the Velari people. Later, Marr and Drayden assisted Drevan Koss by providing air support, fighting off Dissident bombers that were tasked with destroying the city of Lessu . By driving out and defeating the Dissidents and Wat Tambra , the Republic liberated the planet from Varek's control.

#### First Battle of Feldora and protecting the archives

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### First Battle of Feldora and protecting the archives

> " I know I was wrong. I just got so caught up in my own success I didn't look at the battle as a whole. I wasn't being disobedient. I just…forgot. " ―Marr, after her failure on Feldora — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Marr, Drayden, and Kade were later dispatched to Feldora to participate in the First Battle of Feldora against Dissident forces. Unfortunately, they were vastly outnumbered, and the Republic sent an evacuation squad led by Tor Vayne that was sent to retrieve them after the Dissidents managed to establish a blockade above the planet, entrapping them on Feldora's surface. Despite instructions from both Kade and Drayden to retreat, Marr continued to engage the battle droids, intent on continuing the offensive and refusing to back down. However, she eventually relented after her master ordered Marr and her troops to get inside his gunship. Moments later, the replica turbo tank that she had previously been standing on was destroyed by the droids, making Marr realize that she would have died had she not retreated.

title: Sela Marr
text: As a result of her actions during the battle, Marr was brought before the Aetheri High Council . Marr admitted that she had been wrong not to retreat immediately, stating that she had been "caught in the moment." Though Drayden tried to take responsibility for the incident, arguing that he had given Marr "too much freedom," Master Koss dismissed his argument and had Marr sent to the Aetheri archives for guard duty to work alongside master Jocasta Nura , in order to allow her time to reflect on her disobedient actions. When Marr asked how long she would be on guard duty, Koss responded by extending the punishment.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr was about to see more action than expected, as the skilled bounty hunters Cad Vorek and Gloamite Cato Parast , disguised as recently deceased Aetheri Ord Enisence , had infiltrated the Temple with the goal of obtaining a reliquary from the vaults. Alerted to the presence of the infiltrators by Master Zho over her comlink , Marr confronted Parast, now disguised as Jocasta Nura, and engaged her in a short flux blade battle. Marr easily defeated the inexperienced Gloamite, taking her into her custody. However, Vorek completed his mission and stole a reliquary. The Aetheri were given a clue towards finding him when the captured Parast told them that Vorek's next objective involved the keeper of the kyber memory crystal Bolla Ropal . As Kade remained on Vantor to search for Vorek, Marr and Drayden headed to the Devaron system to catch the bounty hunter.

#### Confronting Cad Vorek

> " I sense something, Master. And I don't like it. " " It's the umbra side, Sela. This is the right place. " ―Marr and Drayden, on entering Mal' facility — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Sela Marr
text:
children in one of Vael Mal ' secret facilities and battled several surgery droids in order to recover the children, who were eventually returned safely to their respective families. After the mission, they returned to the Temple, where Marr was disappointed to learn from the Council that Vorek had escaped once again. #### An unlikely alliance

> Paramita : " Four on one is hardly a fair fight, even for an Aetheri. " Marr : " Wait a minute, four on one? You mean four on two. " Seripas : " We don't count you, knee-high. " ―Marr and Drayden are confronted by the bounty hunters — Link ▶️ ( file info )

During the investigation of a missing medical station over Feldora, Marr, Drayden, and Kade instead found a Dissident vulture droid base . After being attacked by a swarm of vulture droids, the three Aetheri crash-landed onto the planet's surface, where they discovered a small Felucian village. Though it initially appeared deserted, they soon discovered a group of farmers in hiding, under the protection of the group of bounty hunters Sulie , Embo , Rumi Paramita , and Seripas . They realized that the bounty hunters were defending the village from a pirate gang led by Hondik Hosha . Together, the Aetheri found a long term solution and trained the villagers to be able to look after themselves.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Although she found that the farmers learned quickly, Marr also realized she needed to remind herself that they lacked the patience and adaptably possessed by replica troopers, as the Felucians simply were not soldiers, so she needed to treat them differently from the replicas. When Hosha led his men to attack the village, the villagers had their training put to the test. When Seripas was almost crushed to death, Marr saved him and realized that Seripas was actually a small Ssori in an imposing suit of armor. Marr reassured Seripas that he did not need the armor to be strong and helped the villagers fight off Hosha's pirates, who left when Hosha declared the venture no longer profitable. In return for their help, Sulie gave the three Aetheri a ride back to Republic lines in her ship .

#### Second Battle of Pyralis

> " Well, this tank could destroy the power generator…and probably us along with it. " " I guess that's our only choice. " ―Marr and Ovva resign to sacrifice themselves — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Second Battle of Pyralis

> " Well, this tank could destroy the power generator…and probably us along with it. " " I guess that's our only choice. " ―Marr and Ovva resign to sacrifice themselves — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Along with her master, Sela Marr participated in the Second Battle of Pyralis with masters Orien Kade, Luminara Undula, and Reth-Oss-Van . The Aetheri, hoping to recapture Pyralian and Dissident leader Poggle the Lesser and destroy the Pyralis primary droid foundry , planned a three-pronged attack against Poggle's Pyralian droid foundries. Early on in the mission, Drayden and Marr's gunship was shot down, but the duo survived and continued their attack, battling the Pyralian defense line.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr began to grow frustrated with Drayden after he continually cut her off during the briefing for the next stage of the mission, believing that she had not earned her master's complete trust. After Aetheri Master Luminara Undula and her Adept Barris Ovva arrived to help plan the attack on the droid foundry, Marr and Ovva were sent to infiltrate and destroy the foundry from the inside. The plan was to go through the underground Pyralian catacombs underneath the facility while Undula and Drayden led the 501st and the 41st Elite Corps to engage in a frontal assault as a distraction. Though Marr was initially annoyed by Ovva's "dependable" nature and Undula's trust in her due to her own feelings of inadequacy, the two Adepts quickly bonded and were able to work well as a team.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Though the two Adepts made it into the reactor room, they were ambushed by one of Poggle's super tanks , which promptly fired upon them. After Ovva destroyed the two droid drivers, she and Marr took control of the tank, deciding to use it on the reactor, fully aware that they would likely perish as a result of the explosion. They successfully destroyed the foundry but were buried under the rubble, surviving the explosion. Marr saved both of their lives by hot-wiring her comlink in order to alert Undula and Drayden of their location. Upon being rescued, both masters were happy to see that their Adepts had survived. Undula informed Marr that her master never gave up on her, which reassured Marr that Drayden trusted her and knew she was capable of handling herself.

#### Incident aboard TB-73

> " Ugh. It's too quiet. It's a big change from all the fighting the last few days. " " You should enjoy this peace while it lasts. " ―Marr and Ovva — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Sela Marr
text: After the rescue of Master Luminara Undula from the Geonosians and the subsequent death of Queen Karina the Great, Marr and Ovva were sent to transport medical supplies. The plan was to bring the supplies from Pyralis to Drevan Koss on Steelgrove from a station near Ord Cestus on board the medical frigate TB-73 . They were, however, unaware that several Pyralian brain worms had been smuggled inside the ship by Scythe , a worm-infected replica trooper. As the worms began to infect the rest of the ship's crew, the worm-controlled replica troopers turned on the two Adepts, who were forced to defend themselves, first in the mess hall against Ox and Edge and later against Trap , whom Ovva was forced to kill out of self-defense. Marr, using her flux blade, then killed Trap's worm, which had emerged from his mouth. In the cargo hold, Marr and Ovva fled into the ventilation system after the infected replicas outnumbered them. Splitting up, Marr headed towards the communication room to warn Aetheri Master Kit Fisto of the situation while Ovva went to disable the thrusters.

title: Sela Marr
text: Upon making contact with Fisto, the Raadan Aetheri Master instructed her to dock at the medical base despite her concerns over the brain worms spreading. She also updated her master on the situation before ending the transmission. Immediately following her message, she was suddenly ambushed by Barris Ovva, who had been infected by one of the worms on her way to the reactor room. The two fought each other as Marr tried in vain to break the creature's influence over her friend's mind. After a short confrontation, Marr once again escaped into the ventilation system, now the only individual on the ship not under the control of the worms. After learning that the worms were in fact affected by cold temperatures from Drayden over her comlink, Marr ruptured the coolant system to decrease the temperature inside the ship, which would inhibit the brain worms.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Ovva once again confronted Marr on the bridge, though Marr managed to fight her off, temporarily releasing Ovva from the brain worm's influence with a blast from a ruptured coolant pipe. Though Ovva begged Marr to kill her, the Adept instead killed her brain worm as it emerged from Ovva's mouth. As the ship docked in the medical base, Fisto entered the freezing ship to find a barely conscious Marr cradling her unconscious friend. The two Adepts were then taken to the medical bay to recover from their ordeal. As Marr pondered what might have happened if she had killed Ovva, Drayden attempted to console her, believing that she did the right thing to save her friend.

At the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor, Marr, along with Ovva, watched a transmission of General Skarn and his MagnaGuards torturing Master Etha Korrin . Marr and Ovva comforted several of the younglings when they witnessed Korrin screaming in pain. She and Ovva then took the younglings away at Master Zho's request while the others planned a rescue.

### Further adventures and lessons

title: Sela Marr
text:
### Further adventures and lessons

#### An important lesson

> " For a guy that moves slow, you always seem to get ahead of me. " " The value of moving slowly is that one can always clearly see the way ahead. " ―Sela Marr and Tera Sinube — Link ▶️ ( file info ) Sometime later, Marr and Drayden were in pursuit of wanted Weequay arms dealer Car Affa within Vantor's slums. Tracking the criminal to a run-down bar, her master instructed her to wait while he apprehended him. Due to Affa's sudden arrest, a large crowd of patrons swarmed from the bar, and in the commotion that followed, the small Patrolian pickpocket Bannamu managed to steal the Adept's flux blade from her hip. Ashamed, Marr could not bring herself to admit to Drayden that she had lost her weapon and immediately headed to the archives in the hopes of tracking down her thief once they reached the temple. There, she met the elderly Aetheri Master Tera Sinube , who agreed to help her locate her missing flux blade. At first, Marr was frustrated with Sinube's preference of patience over speed, which was in great contrast to her own style, but grew to accept and respect the old Aetheri Master's methods. Eventually, they found the flux blade in the possession of underworld criminals Cassie Cryar and Ione Marcy . Marr engaged with Cryar in a wild foot chase throughout the city, though the Terrelian Garrick Jumper was too quick for the young Adept and

title: Sela Marr
text:
and respect the old Aetheri Master's methods. Eventually, they found the flux blade in the possession of underworld criminals Cassie Cryar and Ione Marcy . Marr engaged with Cryar in a wild foot chase throughout the city, though the Terrelian Garrick Jumper was too quick for the young Adept and managed to escape. Ultimately, Marr and Sinube managed to reclaim her flux blade from Cryar. After the chase, the elder Aetheri asked Marr to pass on what she had learned from him to some Aetheri younglings. #### The hunt for Ayla Vossk

After Marr and Master Tor Vayne rescued Drayden and Drevan Koss from the wreckage of the Vorash -class Iron Cruiser Endurance on Vanqor, Marr and Vayne journeyed into the Vantor underworld. Posing as friends of the bounty hunter Castas , they hoped to find a lead on bounty hunter Ayla Vossk , who they hoped to track down after the Aetheri received a threatening transmission from her and a young Vex Vark . Marr was able to find a lead but also disturbed some of the customers at a cantina, and the two Aetheri departed after a tense standoff. Marr and Vayne then traveled to Florrine and found Vossk in a cantina. The situation quickly escalated when Vark sprung a diversion, and Vossk escaped while Vex was captured. Marr skillfully pursued Vossk on a speeder bike while Vayne saved the hostages. Marr caught up to Vossk as she reached Reaver One and damaged the ship, causing Vossk to lose control and crash in a fiery explosion.

#### Undercover on Ferrum

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Undercover on Ferrum

> " It's every citizen's duty to challenge their leaders, to keep them honest, and hold them accountable if they're not. " ―Sela Marr — Link ▶️ ( file info ) Not long after, Marr was dispatched to Ferrum on an undercover mission to uproot corruption scandals in the Ferrik government and also to help educate Ferrum's youth, including the Duchess's nephew Korkie Velara and his friends Amis , Lagos , and Soniee , on the basics of lawful and public-serving conduct. After being tasked with the job by Master Zho, who believed a youthful Adept could help get through to Ferrum, she was brought to Ferrum by Drayden. Upon meeting the Duchess as well as Prime Minister Almec , she had to surrender her flux blade due to restrictions on offworlders carrying weapons. A group of students led by Velara, with her lessons in mind, proceeded to fight a black market conspiracy . They brought their findings to Marr, who urged them to be more careful. Velara told her that he only wanted to help his planet like his aunt the Duchess did, but Marr cautioned him from getting into a problem that he could not fix on his own.

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Return of Ayla Vossk

Following her mission to Ferrum, Marr was commended by the Aetheri Council for her actions. However, the Council ordered her to remain at the Temple while her master commanded the 3rd Legion on Balith to assist with its civil war . Marr then had a disturbing dream about Ayla Vossk, who she thought had perished on Florrine. The visions then showed that Vossk was targeting Senator Ondar.

Marr then warned Ondar that she was being targeted by Vossk. Despite her warning, Ondar then continued to prepare for her speech at Cindervale 's Refugee Conference . However, Marr was allowed to accompany her to the conference as additional security. After their arrival, Marr saw the location of Vossk's attack on Ondar, warning her and Captain Gregar Typho of this. When the conference started, Marr discovered Vossk but could not prevent her from wounding Ondar on the shoulder. Marr pursued her, but Vossk escaped.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Despite Marr and Solen's pleas for Ondar to return to Vantor, she chose to stay and resume her speech. However, Marr devised a plan to allow Ondar to deliver her speech but remain in safety. Ondar used a BD-3000 luxury droid dressed in her clothes to cast her speech while she stayed in her room. However, Marr sensed that Vossk was not deceived and realized she had discovered Ondar in her room. Marr rushed in and deflected the blast when Vossk fired on Ondar. She then pulled Vossk down out of the vent. Marr fought her until Vossk knocked her out. However, Ondar was able to stun Vossk. Marr and Ondar returned to Vantor, where Marr reported to Drayden and Master Zho. Marr and Ondar identify Vossk's employer as Ziro the Grak, who wanted her dead due to her interference with his plans earlier in the war.

#### Rescuing Papanoida's daughters

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Rescuing Papanoida's daughters

In an effort to persuade the planet Pantora to join the Dissidents, the Commerce Combine erected a blockade over the planet and, to make matters personal for Pantora's Chairman Papanoida , kidnapped his daughters Chi Eekway and Che Amanwe Papanoida . When the Republic became aware of the situation, Kael Drayden sent Marr in to investigate the matter outside of the operations of the Aetheri. Marr accompanied her friend, Senator Riyo Chuchi , aboard the Commerce Combine blockade, disguised as her servant. Marr helped Chuchi sneak into the office of a Commerce Combine Ambassador and overheard him talking with Administrator Sib Canay about how they were holding Che Amanwe onboard their ship.

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### A lesson from Zho

> " What makes you unique makes you strong. This you must use. Yourself, you must always be. " " I think I understand. I need to fight like myself. " ―Zho and Sela — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Sometime later, Marr had gone back to the sacred world of Ilum to receive a second flux blade crystal and construct her second blade , resulting in another unremarkable but successful visit to the frozen world, during which she was excited to find her second kyber crystal. In the Aetheri Sanctum dojo , Drayden and Marr were sparring, with the former teaching Marr to use her new flux blade in the art of Jar'Kai . However, being new to using two flux blades at once, Marr forgot about her second blade was easily disarmed by Drayden. Marr apologized to Drayden for forgetting to use her second blade, but he waved it off, claiming that it took time to learn a new technique.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Marr retrieved her blade, Zho entered the dojo, wanting to see Marr's progress in using her second flux blade. Marr agreed to this after gaining Drayden's approval and she walked out, igniting her first blade immediately. Drayden cringed as Zho looked at her in disappointment, telling her that she needed to bow before a duel in the dojo. Embarrassed that she had forgotten, she put her blade away and followed the Grand Master's command. She then reignited her blade, forgetting about her second one. With this, Zho commanded her to use her second blade. Marr then ignited her second blade as Zho ignited his.

title: Sela Marr
text: With one swing of his blade, Zho managed to knock Marr back as she attempted to block with both blades. Zho then attempted to teach Marr about how the two blades were like master and apprentice. With this, Marr stood up and attempted a stabbing motion on Zho, but he simply ducked out of the way and tripped her. As Marr stood back up, Zho taught her that she must always be herself, and Marr realized that she needed to fight like herself. She reignited her blades, and Zho attacked once more, but she was able to block this time. Zho told Marr that she had learned well.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr's training with two flux blades in the Temple training rooms was witnessed by Heezo , a technician who worked in the Temple. After Heezo learned from the Aetheri Knight Iskat Vekkis that she had found a second flux blade , which Vekkis believed belonged to her mother Feyra , Heezo, who was secretly an agent of Vael Mal, urged Vekkis to use the weapon. He cited Marr as an example of an Aetheri who fought with two flux blades to convince Vekkis to take up Jar'Kai herself. As Vekkis began to train in double-bladed combat with a newly-constructed second flux blade , keeping her mother's blade a secret, Marr spoke with her, giving her advice on fighting with two flux blades and recommending texts that would help. Marr was able to spare with Vekkis on some occasions, but she was generally too busy to take time and spare with her fellow Jar'Kai user.

#### Working with Senator Ondar

Mission to Cindervale

> " You know, you and Kael make a good team. " " Thanks. I could say the same about the two of you. " ―Ondar and Marr, on Kael

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Working with Senator Ondar

Mission to Cindervale

> " You know, you and Kael make a good team. " " Thanks. I could say the same about the two of you. " ―Ondar and Marr, on Kael

Drayden arranged an an engagement to escort Senator Ondar on a mission to the planet Cindervale. Unbeknownst to Marr and the Aetheri Council, Drayden and Ondar had secretly married shortly after the First Battle of Pyralis and planned to use this mission to spend time alone together. To her master's disgruntlement, however, Marr was also assigned to the mission at the suggestion of Kade, who had some understanding of the couple's close relationship.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Boarding a T-6 shuttle , the trio departed from Vantor and made the jump to hyperspace. Now wanting the mission to end as soon as possible, Drayden changed the ship's flight trajectory to travel along a different route. Marr warned her master that they would pass through a sector of suspected Dissident activity, and when the ship pulled out of hyperspace, true to the Adept's word, they were met with five Munificent -class star frigates. At the senator's command, Ondar and Marr manned the guns as Drayden flew through the Confederate fleet. Although the Aetheri Knight's flying skills managed to get the ship through most of the fleet, one of the frigates was able to land a blow on the Republic shuttle , knocking the senator to the floor. As the smoke in the shuttle cleared, Marr saw that Drayden had caught Ondar, who held her husband tightly in her arms. Seeing that the two were preoccupied, Marr took to the pilot's seat and managed to safely bring the ship to Cindervale. After landing, Drayden thanked his Adept for her help before leaving her and the senator alone. The two women shared a moment together, acknowledging the other's relationship with Drayden.

Training session and assignment

> " Training sessions are about preparing us for the real world and the real battles we must face. Not just to win by whatever means. " " I saw an opportunity and I took it. " ―Barris Ovva and Sela Marr

title: Sela Marr
text:
The two walked from the dojo and spoke about the differences between their masters' teachings. When Ovva accused Marr of losing patience and forgetting the flux blade forms, Marr replied by saying that the forms did not help her in real battles. Marr handed her flux blades to Ovva, who then demonstrated how using Form VI would have helped her. When they arrived at Marr's quarters , she thanked Ovva for the match, and they parted ways.

In her quarters, Marr tried the flux blade forms but was unsuccessful. To clear her mind, she sat down and began to meditate . As she meditated, she thought about how Ovva had been right, and she determined that she needed to think like an Aetheri and that she still was not good enough. Marr's meditation was interrupted when Senator Lira Ondar knocked on the door, and Marr invited her inside.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr was surprised to see Ondar at the Temple and asked if everything was alright. Ondar explained that she was going to host an important meeting with the Arthurian delegates the next day, and the senator asked Marr if she would perform a security check. Marr doubted that Ondar needed her, saying that Captain Typho and the handmaidens would be enough. But thinking back to her training session with Ovva, Marr ultimately agreed to the job.

Defeating a changeling

> " You know, it might not be such a bad idea if you stick around. " " Thank you, Senator Ondar, but it's not really my place to mingle with politicians. " ―Lira Ondar and Sela Marr

The following evening, Marr established a perimeter around Ondar's apartment and assured the senator that the outside of the building was clear. Ondar thanked the Adept and requested that she stay for the meeting, well aware that her negotiations with the delegates from Arthuria were opposed by many. Marr politely declined, however, not wanting to interfere in the dealings of politicians .

title: Sela Marr
text:
Before she could leave, Marr noticed that the banquet table that one of the Senator's handmaidens had prepared was set with utensils, which were customarily never used by Arthurians . When Ondar questioned the handmaiden for the potentially offensive act, the servant pulled out a volt pistol and fired upon the duo. As Marr confronted the handmaiden, she revealed herself to be Cato Parast, the same shape-shifting assassin whom Marr had encountered during Cad Vorek's heist at the Aetheri Sanctum. After a small fire fight , Marr was able to subdue Parast and dispose of a bomb the changeling had planted in the apartment.

Training the senator

> " You're getting better. Now just try to keep up with me. " ―Marr, to Ondar

title: Sela Marr
text:
Training the senator

> " You're getting better. Now just try to keep up with me. " ―Marr, to Ondar

Marr went on to train Senator Ondar in starfighter combat , taking the Ondaran to a remote asteroid field to undergo flight exercises. Although Marr believed the field to be devoid of enemy forces, the duo were soon ambushed by a modified vulture droid that was stationed on one of the asteroids. The droid pursued them through the field and immobilized Marr's N-1 starfighter with an ion torpedo , knocking her unconscious. Using the Adept's teachings, Ondar was able to defend her friend and destroy the droid. Marr came to and praised the senator for her instincts before the two journeyed back home.

#### Skirmish on Vantor

> " Sela... what happened?. " " Let's just say there were some complications. " ―Kael and Sela

title: Sela Marr
text:
the droid, causing it to break down. The Adept checked to see if the mother and child were okay before she suddenly remembered the ceremony that she was already late for. As she arrived at the Aetheri Sanctum, she met Drayden and Zho by the Great Tree . As the ceremony began, Master Zho stated that Marr was humble and brave, which he thought of as a sign of maturity. He went on to say that she was on the right path to becoming an Aetheri Master, before awarding her with an add-on to her Adept braid. #### Lessons in politics

> " Well, I mean, you think we're all the bad guys. But how many of us have you actually met? And droids don't count. " " Well, other than military officers like Skarn and Vray… none, I guess. You and your mother are the first. " " Well, look at me. Am I so bad? " ―Lux Bontero and Sela Marr, in a discussion of perspectives

Marr watched a session of the Senate as they debated deregulating the banks to fund the creation of more replica troopers. However, Marr had difficulty understanding the politics behind the war. The Adept was left with Ondar by her master so that she could try to understand politics. Marr then allowed Ondar to use her status as an Aetheri to go behind enemy lines and speak with her mentor, Senator Mina Bontero of Underra of the Dissident Senate on Raxun Secundus .

title: Sela Marr
text:
Together, they ventured to Raxun. In Raxulon , they met Bontero and went to her home . There, Marr met Bontero's son, Lux . She spoke with Lux about their differences and her meeting with other Dissidents such as Vray and Skarn. Marr then attended a session of Dissident Senate at their Senate Building and watched as the Senate voted to open negotiations with the Republic. Marr and Ondar then returned to Vantor, where they informed Chancellor Mal of their negotiations. However, the banks were voted to be deregulated when there was an attack on the power generators on Vantor. She also learned that her master knew of their mission, and scolded her because it was reckless of her. Marr, however, learned that the politics behind the war were not as black and white as she thought.

### Continuation of the war

#### Journey to Mournis

> " There are many contradictions in you. And in him. Be warned, you may never see your future if you remain his student! Leave this planet! " ―Sela Marr, a vision of her older self warning her to leave Kael Drayden before it is too late.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Sela was then able to repair the ship as Drayden faced the Son, and as the Father took his own life, Drayden killed the Son. The three left the realm of Mournis as the Father died and found themselves back with the Republic fleet. Upon communicating with Vek, they learned that they had only gone for a moment into Mournis and that almost no time had passed at all.

#### Rejected #### Rejected

A year and nine months into the war, Aetheri Master Even Piele was captured by Dissident forces during his return from the Outer Reach. Piele carried vital information alongside Captain Wilhard Varrix involving the secret hyperspace lanes called the Nexus Route , which the Dissidents sought to obtain. Upon his capture, he was taken to an ancient prison known as the Citadel , which had been designed to detain Aetheri if any had strayed from their path. In order to rescue Master Piele, Drayden, Kade, and Vayne devised a plan to rescue him, and, as they exited the briefing room, Marr ran up beside them, apologizing for being late, citing that she had just heard about the briefing and asked for clarification on their rescue of Piele. As Drayden stopped, Vayne commented that Marr and Drayden had much to discuss as Kade and Vayne left to leave the two alone.

title: Sela Marr
text: With this, Drayden informed Marr that she would not be allowed to come along on this assignment and, after she objected, he informed her that the Citadel had been created to detain Aetheri in case they had lost their way and that it wasn't a place for Adepts. However, Marr argued that this wasn't fair and that Drayden was merely being protective, asking how she was going to learn if Drayden was not willing for her to risk herself. However, Drayden continued on by saying that this wasn't a mission to be teaching lessons to an Adept and that it was meant as a do or die type of mission, not willing to share this risk with his Adept. As he walked away, Marr grew increasingly frustrated.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Shortly afterwards, Marr consulted Master Vayne for guidance on Drayden's decision. In response to her inquiry, Vayne simply informed her that it was Drayden's decision to decide whether or not she should be allowed to go. However, Marr once again cited her belief that Drayden was being overprotective, saying that he had been choosing which assignments she could partake in. Vayne then responded by once again saying that he was her master to which Marr said that it should be her choice when she wanted to risk her life. With that, Vayne began to ponder her argument.

#### Rescuing Even Piele

Scaling the cliff

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Rescuing Even Piele

Scaling the cliff

Eventually, Vayne agreed with Marr's sentiment and, in a way, assigned her to the mission. After being "assigned," Marr was frozen in carbonite and placed aboard their stolen Sheathipede -class transport shuttle alongside Drayden, Kade, and the replicas. As they approached Lola Sayu , the planet the Citadel was housed upon, Commandant Osi Sobeck , the warden of the prison, grew increasingly suspicious of their true cargo and ordered for his droids to scan for lifeforms. However, after doing a full scan of the ship, the scanners came up empty, showing that the Republic's ruse had worked. As they arrived on the planet, the shuttle deviated from where it was assigned to land, choosing instead to hide within the volcanic canyons of the planet and unload their "cargo."

title: Sela Marr
text: As Marr was unfrozen, Drayden passingly acknowledged her presence before realizing that Marr wasn't supposed to be on the assignment. As Kade woke up alongside him, he noted that he believed he must have been given carbon sickness as he was seeing Marr was with them. In response, Drayden confirmed to him that his sight was fine and that Marr's hearing was the thing that needed assistance instead. In defense, Marr explained that she had received orders from Vayne and that she thought he had known about it. Drayden grew more disgruntled with her as he told her that Vayne had not told him about her joining the mission, which Marr followed up by saying that he had already been in carbonite when the decision had been made. Pointing at Marr, he once again informed her that he had specifically told her not to come, but Marr defended herself by saying that Drayden had taught her that following direct orders wasn't always the right decision. With that, Kade walked over and commented on Drayden's teaching style before welcoming Marr to the mission, leading Marr to smile. After Kade's inquiry, the discussion ended.

title: Sela Marr
text: Before departing for the facility, Marr had a discussion with one of the 212th troopers accompanying them as CC-2224 "Cord" was preparing his backpack . Once Cord finished preparing his pack, the two made their way to the cliff surrounding the Citadel. Arriving at a safe distance to avoid detection, Kade and Drayden stopped to survey the cliff they were intending to climb in order to make their way to an entry point into the Citadel. Kade suggested that they use ascension cables, but was met with disapproval from Drayden as he noted the electromines dotting the cliff face and that the ascension cables would have nothing to grab onto without hitting the electromines, which would notify the entire prison of their presence. With this, Vek suggested that they freeclimb it which was met with approval from both Kade and Drayden as the group continued their journey to the Citadel.

title: Sela Marr
text: The group soon began to climb the cliff face during which Drayden asked how Marr was doing during her climb to which Marr simply said that she couldn't be better, but noted that the strong winds were providing a challenge. As they continued their climb, Kade traveled up to the platform where the entry point the group wished to enter through was located, but was stopped when several droids appeared through the entry point, forcing him to tell the rest of the group to remain silent, causing them to briefly pause their climb. As the droids returned inside, they activated a ray shield , which Kade noted to the rest of the group, leading Drayden to become distressed as the ray shield wasn't originally in the plan. Continuing her climb, Marr noted that an opening was near the door and that she might be able to squeeze through the ventilation ducts and disable to ray shield. Drayden then met her proposal with approval after an inquiry from Kade and she made her way to the shaft and entered, arriving just outside the ray shielded door. As she exited, she checked for any droid patrols, noticing none and made her way

title: Sela Marr
text: ducts and disable to ray shield. Drayden then met her proposal with approval after an inquiry from Kade and she made her way to the shaft and entered, arriving just outside the ray shielded door. As she exited, she checked for any droid patrols, noticing none and made her way to the door controls, simply pressing a single button and deactivating the ray shield. As Drayden, entered she tried to show off to him, noting that she could handle herself. However, as the rest of the group finished making their way up to the platform, a replica named " Charger " lost his grip on the cliff and began tumbling down towards the lava below, hitting an electromine on his way down and alerting the entire facility to the group's presence. #### The coordinates

#### The coordinates

Arriving back at Vantor, the group was met by several members of the Vantor Guard as well as Zho and Koss. During their subsequent conversation, Kade informed the Aetheri that Marr and Varrix had each memorized half of the coordinates for the Nexus Route, but Varrix told them that he was told by Supreme Chancellor Mal himself to bring the coordinates directly to him, which Marr then informed the group that she had promised Piele that she would only deliver the coordinates of the Nexus Route to the Aetheri Council. As Marr turned to leave with the rest of the group, she was stopped when Drayden asked Vayne if he had assigned her to the mission to which Vayne said that it appeared he had which was met with Marr's surprise as well as Kade and Drayden's dismay. Vayne then brought Marr along with him to enter the Aetheri Sanctum.

#### Captured at Feldora

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Captured at Feldora

> " You already did everything you could. Every thing you had to do. When I was out there, alone, all I had was your training and the lessons you taught me. And because of you, I did survive. And not only that, I was able to lead others to survive as well. " ―Sela Marr to Kael Drayden Marr would travel with Drayden, Vayne, and their respective troops to another engagement on Feldora. In a pincer movement, Marr took Replica Corporal " Comet " and several other troopers around the wall of a Dissident facility. As the replicas scaled the wall with grappling hooks, Marr guarded the rear. However, when she tried to follow the troopers up the wall, she was captured in a stun net by the Trandoshan Lo-Taren . He placed her in a cage on a prisoner ship . Marr and multiple other prisoners were dropped on Island Four on the jungle moon Wasskah , where members of a Trandoshan hunting guild would hunt them for sport. Marr survived the night and met up with a trio of former Aetheri younglings, Kalifa , Jinx , and O-Mer . She joined their small band that worked hard to survive but had already lost hope of any kind of escape. Marr tried to convince them that they should be more proactive in their attempts to make it off of the moon, but Kalifa told her that there had been Adepts like her in the past that got themselves killed. Glumly, Marr settled in on the group's routine

title: Sela Marr
text: kind of escape. Marr tried to convince them that they should be more proactive in their attempts to make it off of the moon, but Kalifa told her that there had been Adepts like her in the past that got themselves killed. Glumly, Marr settled in on the group's routine of staying on the move during the day and returning to a hiding place to rest at night. However, Marr's constant energy and belief began to convince the other Aetheri to have hope of eventual escape or rescue. As they worked to discover where the Trandoshan's base was, O-Mer noticed their Ubrikkian Floating Fortress in the air. The group was immediately attacked by several hunters, forcing them to split up. Marr broke off from the group with Kalifa and defended her after she was wounded by Dar . Using her more advanced abilities, she fended off Dar and eventually sent him plummeting to his death. Unfortunately, as she helped Kalifa rise to her feet, she was shot by Dar's father, Garnac , who was also the leader of the hunters. Howling in anger, Garnac continued to fire at Marr as Kalifa slumped against a tree, mortally wounded. Marr promised to look after the others and stayed with her until she breathed her last.

title: Sela Marr
text: Returning to their hiding place, Marr revealed to the others that Kalifa had been killed. Jinx and O-Mer plunged into despair, but Marr did her best to keep their spirits up, proposing a plan to attack a transport ship as it delivered new prisoners. That night, they assaulted a ship, but were unable to gain control of the ship as it crashed onto the beach. However, they gained a new companion in the Vorak Brevok . Being the only one to understand Vorak tongue , Marr translated Brevok's ideas to the group, including his plan to build a transmitter from the wreckage of the ship to contact his people on the nearby Thornwood .

title: Sela Marr
text: The next night, the four companions ventured back to the wreckage, with Jinx and O-Mer covering Marr and Brevok as they crawled through the remains of the ship. Marr helped Brevok find parts, and when they emerged from the ship, they were fired on by a sniper. Jinx and O-Mer incapacitated him and the group eventually took the Trandoshan prisoner. In the morning, Jinx used a mind trick to get the hunter to summon a pickup. Then, taking control of the hover pod , they used it to fly up to the Trandoshan base. The group entered hand-to-hand combat with the other hunters and eventually received support from the Vorak chieftain Tarfful , who had gotten a message from Brevok's transmitter. Arriving in the assault gunship Halo , Tarfful and his warriors helped them defeat the hunters. Marr then entered the main hall of their base to confront Garnac and eventually pushed him off of the balcony, killing him.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Returning to the Aetheri Sanctum, Drayden was relieved to see his Adept. He profusely apologized for leaving her behind, but Marr instead gave her master her thanks, saying that without his training, she would not have made it back or helped the others survive. The two walked back towards the temple, with Master Zho looking on and smiling.

#### Campaign at Umbara

After the Umbarans sided with the Dissidents, the Grand Army of the Republic was dispatched to retake Umbara . In order to break through the blockade surrounding the planet, Marr and Ovva were tasked with leading the fighter squadrons in an attack on the blockade. At some point during the battle, Marr and Ovva led a squadron comprised of Z-95 Headhunters and Yarrow bombers in an attack on a Munificent -class star frigate, managing to destroy it and clearing the way for the Republic to launch their ground assault on the planet. Eventually, after a lengthy space and ground battle, the Republic claimed victory at Umbara.

#### Combating the Zygeran Slave Imperium

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Combating the Zygeran Slave Imperium

After the planet Kiros fell under the threat of Dissident invasion, Marr accompanied Drayden, Kade, Vek, and Cord to assist the planet's native Solinai population. After battling commando droids and Droideka Sharpshooters , Kade headed into the governor's tower to negotiate with the Zygeran Darts D'Nar , who was serving as the commander of the Dissident forces. Noticing her master's anger and frustration with the proposition of negotiating with a slaver, Marr soon learned that her master was a former slave, something he had never told her. When D'Nar double-crossed Kade and attempted to escape to his ship, Tecora , Marr and Drayden pursued him on AT-RTs . After disabling the Tecora's engines, Marr sneaked onto the bridge and defeated D'Nar in a duel. After interrogation, they learned the natives were sold into slavery on D'Nar's homeworld of Zygera .

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr, Drayden, Kade, Vek, and Bolt then took the Tecora to Zygera, with Marr posing as Drayden's slave to meet with the Zygeran queen, Miraj Scintel . However, when one of Scintel's slaves attempted to assassinate her before committing suicide, Drayden decided to offer Marr as Scintel's new slave. Winning the Queen's favor, he earned himself an invite to the slave auction taking place that night. Meanwhile, Marr was put in a cage outside, but would escape to aid her master at the auction. However, they discovered Kade had been captured, and they failed to overcome the Zygerrians, who shipped Kade and Vek to a slave processing facility while Scintel imprisoned Marr and Drayden in her palace.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Drayden was able to escape the guards with the help of Bolt and then freed Marr. Drayden learned from a dying Scintel, who was killed by the recently summoned Varek for being unwilling to turn over Drayden, that Kade and Vek were imprisoned on the planet Kadavo . Marr and Drayden reclaimed their ship and went to free their companions. When they landed at the facility, their ship was destroyed and they were quickly pinned down. When Varek threatened to execute the slaves if they did not stop their attack, Republic reinforcements, the 104th Battalion led by Tor Vayne arrived to help. Marr and Drayden then split up with Marr rendezvousing with the slaves and her master disabling the defense turrets. Marr located the slaves and directed Vayne to fly gunships underneath the facility to help the slaves escape. After rescuing the slaves, including Kade and Vek, Vayne's men destroyed the facility.

#### Entanglement with Grave Watch

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Entanglement with Grave Watch

Marr accompanied Ondar to the first ever sanctioned peace conference between the Republic and Fractio. However, the negotiations were interrupted by Junior senator Lux Bontero, who Marr had befriended earlier in the war during Ondar and Mina Bontero's failed peace initiative. Bontero accused Count Varek of being responsible for his mother's death, and Marr left the meeting to protect Bontero from possible retribution. Sneaking aboard a Dissident landing craft, Marr intervened when Varek ordered Bontero's execution via hologram. Marr was intent on bringing Bontero to Vantor to be granted amnesty, but Bontero had other plans. Bontero shocked Marr with a small device, knocking her out and bringing their ship to Carlac to meet with a group Bontero promised would help him get his revenge on Varek.

title: Sela Marr
text: Bontero made Marr leave her flux blades on the ship to meet with the group. Marr quickly realized that the group was Grave Watch, and told Ferrik Gloom Owl Bo-Katin Velara that she was Bontero's betrothed to keep her identity as an Aetheri a secret. When Velara left them both alone before their meeting with Pre Vizsla, Marr learned of Bontero's plan to convince Grave Watch, who recently had a falling out with the Umbra Lord, to assassinate Varek. Marr warned Bontero that Grave Watch still had their own agenda and could not trusted, but Bontero kissed her to interrupt her as Vizsla arrived. Vizsla forced Marr to work alongside natives that Grave Watch used as slave labor. Later, when Grave Watch began to pillage and burn a village , Marr attempted to fight back but was imprisoned. However, when Vizsla drew the Darksaber, intent on killing Marr, Bolt, who had been forced to repair Grave Watch droids they used for entertainment in a fighting ring, uses a smoke screen as a diversion and slips Marr her flux blades that he recovered from the ship. Marr acrobatically freed herself and beheaded a group of Ferriks approaching her before dueling Vizsla.
