Marr acrobatically freed herself and beheaded a group of Ferriks approaching her before dueling Vizsla. When Bolt set the droids on their masters, the three escaped from Vizsla. When Bontero piloted a speeder back to their ship, Marr defended him from Velara and the other Ferriks. After successfully escaping Carlac, Bontero used an escape pod to avoid being brought to Vantor, leaving Marr behind. #### Training Underra's Insurgents

Marr, along with Masters Drayden, Kade, and Captain Vek was ordered by the Aetheri Council to train and assist the insurgents of Underra in their fight against the newly installed King Sanjay Rash and his Confederate occupation forces. There, she met up with insurgents' leaders, Steela Vess , her brother Torrik , and former junior senator Lux Bontero. Marr, her fellow Aetheri, and Vek were successful in teaching the insurgents how to fight the battle droids.

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Bombing at the Aetheri Sanctum

Towards the end of the war, Sela Marr noticed that Aetheri Master Zho became less happy as the war dragged on; the Solinai observed the Aetheri Master's "deep sorrow" and his burden of seemingly knowing that an ending neared and the ensuing instatement of a new era. At the age of 16, Sela Marr's friend, Barris Ovva, who believed the Aetheri Order had become evil, corrupt and overly belligerent during the war, secretly orchestrated the bombing of the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor. In the aftermath of the incident, which killed six Aetheri as well as several replicas and Aetheri Sanctum workers, Marr and Drayden were called back from the defense of the planet Cato Geltaria to investigate the situation along with crime scene analysis droid Russo-ISC . Before they began, Drevan Koss told them that it was possible an Aetheri was behind the attack. This deeply bothered both Marr and Drayden. When Marr asked her master about the possibility, he told her that there will be Aetheri who disappoint, but they will be far outnumbered by those who do the right thing.

title: Sela Marr
text: Running away from Republic authorities, she defended herself as replicas shot stun blasts to apprehend her. Pursued by Vek, Fox, Sergeant Hound , and others, she fled into the industrial areas outside of the Republic military base . She was pursued by gunships and searchlights, and lost her shoto during the chase. Turning down into the pipes system, she temporarily hid from her pursuers until Drayden caught up as she was preparing to jump down into the Vantor Underworld . Drayden told her that they could help her prove she was innocent, but Marr retorted that she was unwilling to face trial and punishment for something she did not do. Knowing that no one would believe her, Marr decided to go off on her own and jumped onto a ship that was descending into the underworld.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Marr struggled to keep herself hidden from Vantor underworld police and other Republic patrols searching for her, she contacted her friend Ovva, who promised to help her investigate to clear her name. Marr then destroyed her comlink and acquired a cloak for disguise. She boarded a train, but when she attempted to exit before she was asked for a pass by the police, she was surrounded by police forces outside. After fighting them off and fleeing, she was attacked by her longtime nemesis Kessa Vray, who sought the bounty on her head. However, Marr convinced Vray to ally with her, offering a pardon from the Galactic Senate in return for her help.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr used a public holographic system to contact Ovva, the only Aetheri whom she still saw as an ally, unaware that she was responsible for her situation. Ovva informed her of a warehouse she said was where Turmond had obtained the nano-droids. Marr convinced Vray to come with her to the location, but she was spotted by Commander Wolffe and a group of shock troopers. Marr attempted to negotiate with them, but the replicas attempted to detain her and she was forced to combat them, leaving most of the group unconscious before continuing towards the warehouse. Vray departed at that point, reminding her to fulfill her end of the deal. Inside, Marr found the warehouse abandoned before being attacked by a figure in Vray' bounty hunter gear. Unaware she was actually fighting her friend Ovva, whom she thought was her ally, she believed the attacker was Vray. After a short duel, Marr was knocked to the ground next to a crate of nano-droids. When she rose, she was stunned by Commander Wolffe before she could explain herself.

title: Sela Marr
text:
The Aetheri Council attempted to deal with the matter internally, but were convinced by now Admiral Wilhard Varrix that the trial would be a Republic military trial. Despite opposition from Kade, the Council agreed to Varrix's demands and expelled Marr from the Aetheri Order and turned her over to the Republic for a military trial . Marr was prosecuted by Varrix and defended by Lira Ondar. As the trial began, Marr remained confident her master would sort things out and prove her innocence. As Varrix lobbied for a conviction and death sentence, Marr watched with shock as Drayden brought an imprisoned Ovva to the trial. Marr was acquitted as the captive Ovva confessed to her crimes, citing that the Aetheri Order was losing its way for her motive.

### A new path

#### Leaving her old life behind

> " I'm sorry, Master, but I'm not coming back. " ―Sela Marr, to Kael Drayden

title: Sela Marr
text: Drayden chased after her, and, while Kade moved as well, Vayne held the Aetheri Master back. Having caught up with Marr, Drayden asked her why she wanted to leave and begged her to stay. Marr explained that she felt that as the Council lost faith in her, she could no longer find the confidence to trust in herself. Drayden reminded her that he had believed in and fought to prove her innocence, and although Marr accepted this, the situation was not about him. She felt she could not stay anymore and needed to find her own path away from the Aetheri Order. Drayden then told her that he understood the feeling of wanting to leave the Aetheri, but Marr simply responded that she knew, and as Drayden looked at her, his former Adept turned her back and walked away from the Aetheri Order.

title: Sela Marr
text: When Drayden and Kade undertook a mission to Uthara , where they discovered a secret arms deal between the Fractio and Sulie weapons dealers, Drayden briefly forgot Marr had left the Aetheri and suggested contacting her, but he cut himself off after remembering her absence and tried to avoid the subject. Kade questioned if he wanted to discuss what had happened, and, after they had set up camp, Drayden admitted he missed Marr and still could not understand how she left. Drayden still felt that she was an Aetheri and belonged with them. A short time after leaving the Aetheri and close to the end of the Replica Wars, Marr was traveling Vantor's Industrial District aboard a Joben T-85 speeder bike she had purchased, when the craft began to malfunction. Although she ultimately managed to avoid colliding with a Gozanti -class cruiser , she was forced to crash land on the platform of a repair shop on Level 1313 .

title: Sela Marr
text: This caught the attention of the shop's mechanic, a human female named Trayk Martez , who approached Marr as she pulled together the remains of her speeder. After a brief conversation, both girls introduced themselves, with Trayk claiming she owned one of the best repair shops on the level. Although she offered to fix the speeder for payment, Marr noted she could not afford to pay and would fit it herself with the necessary tools. After much negotiating, Martez eventually agreed to let Sela fix her bike for free. Opening the doors to her shop, Marr noticed the mechanic's Nebula -class freighter , which Martez was modifying in the hopes of one day leaving Vantor. After she pointed Marr to a workshop, Sela questioned why the mechanic was helping her, with Martez stating it felt like the right thing to do. Although she offered Marr the option to leave if she wanted, the former Aetheri elected to stay.

title: Sela Marr
text: After Marr had begun to repair her speeder bike, Martez offered to help the former Adept, but Marr rejected any help that would cost her. Although the mechanic was annoyed by this, noting that everything on 1313 had a price, Marr asked if she had any sparkers she could purchase. Though Martez's only sparkers were already used on her freighter and there was no available stock. Stating that was not good and noting she needed to get out, she did not answer Martez after the mechanic asked if she was running from something. Although Martez called after her, stating she could stay as long as desired as long as she could pay, Marr walked out to the platform and looked up towards the sky of Vantor.

title: Sela Marr
text: Afterwards, Marr heard the bike working inside the shop and entered, learning that Martez had helped with it for free. She vaguely admitted to being from Vantor's upper levels, keeping out the fact that she had been an Aetheri, but defended her former order when Martez accused them of starting the Replica Wars. Martez, who felt that the Aetheri had forgotten about common people like her, admitted that the Aetheri were not what she had imagined based on the stories she had heard, revealing that she wanted to get away from the war and Aetheri aboard her starship with her older sister, Ravin . The mechanic's opinion of the Aetheri persuaded Marr to continue to keep her past a secret.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr and Martez were suddenly interrupted when a low-level gangster, Pintu Son-El , and his henchmen entered, looking for money from Ravin that she had promised him. Martez initially told Marr to stay back and tried to fight Son-El's enforcers off, she was eventually overpowered and asked Marr for help. Having been trained as an Aetheri, Marr made short-work of the two enforcers, although Son-El claimed the situation was not over as he fled. Given that she had witnessed Marr's prowess, Martez asked where Marr had learned to fight, so she lied and stated it was her "older brother." The two then made their way to Ravin's Laundry to tell her about Son-El, where she stated she had a job coming up that would make everything better.

title: Sela Marr
text: Ravin also asked who Marr was, and, after being introduced to her, Martez recounted how Marr had fallen onto the platform. After a brief conversation between Ravin and the Velari Lokann , whose " business partner " had arranged a deal with Ravin to build three droids. Marr and Trayk worked on the three binary loadlifters , with Marr reminding the mechanic to put the restraining bolt onto the droid. After Marr activated the droid she had been working on, she and Trayk began a conversation about how people acted, with Martez mentioning her belief that some people were good, others were bad, and some were cross-wired like the loadlifter she had been building. By saying this, however, Marr realized they had been building Type II loadlifter droids and, after her Type II attacked and she shut it down, explained that the "loadlifters" units were actually frauds, being repurposed demolition droid which could cause violence. Unfortunately for the two, Trayk had yet to put a restraining bolt on her droid, allowing it to escape from the shop.

title: Sela Marr
text: Flux-sensitive returned to work on her speeder bike, which Trayk had dubbed " Trash ." After talking about where she would go once the speeder was fixed, Marr accepted Trayk's suggestion to stay a for short time longer, as long as Ravin did not mind. At that moment Ravin entered the shop and was told that Marr would be staying. After asking what skills the former Adept had, Marr stated she only had useful ones. Ravin entered to tell her sister that a crew and starship she had hired had backed out of a job. title: Sela Marr

Trayk then informed her friend and sister that she had in fact found the Angel, but the trio was spotted by the Pykes, who had been helped in their search by the angered Gotal beggar, after Trayk and Ravin had argued about whether to use the Angel to escape. title: Sela Marr

After discretely taking out a guard, the former Adept took control of a construction vehicle, interrupting the planned execution by ramming the repulsorcraft into the Pykes and using its frontal cannons. Although she cleared away most of the Gruv guards in their path, Fife—who had purposely drawn Marr into a trap with the execution—returned with a cannon-equipped landspeeder. #### The last meeting

> " You capture Vreth. I'll take care of Skarn. With any luck, this will all be over soon. " " Master Kade always said there's no such thing as luck. " " Good thing I taught you otherwise. " [Drayden begins to leave] " Kael! Good luck. " ―Kael Drayden and Sela Marr's final words to each other as friends After allying herself with the Ferriks , Marr was given a new outfit made from beskar and set to work trying to find where Vreth was hiding. Marr and Velara also developed a friendship, with Velara becoming a combat mentor to the former Aetheri. After some time, Marr and the Ferrum coalition managed to pinpoint Vreth's location on Ferrum with the help of the information Marr managed to retrieve from the Pykes on Oba Diah. Knowing they did not have the numbers for a siege of Ferrum, Marr and Velara contacted Drayden and Kade, who were finishing up a battle on the planet Yerbana , for their assistance in the siege. Using the subspace frequency " Fulcrum ," Marr and Velara were met by Yular who then contacted Drayden and Kade, calling them back to the ship.

title: Sela Marr
text: Once Drayden and Kade arrived, Marr greeted Drayden and commented on how long it had been since they had last seen each other. There was a brief silence before Drayden asked how Marr had been and where she was. Responding to Drayden's inquiry, Marr said she was alright, but knew that they did not have time to make irrelevant conversation and needed to divulge the important information she and Velara had immediately. After Kade asked what this information was, Marr explained that they had finally managed to locate Vreth and that they might be able to capture him if they moved swiftly.

title: Sela Marr
text: With this information, Drayden and Kade allowed the Ferriks onto their Iron Cruiser. As Marr exited the boarding ramp, Bolt-3 greeted her arrival warmly. After this, she walked towards Drayden who said he was extremely glad to see her, but she interrupted him and told him that they would have to catch up another time as every moment they wasted there gave Vreth more of an opportunity to escape, as noted by Velara. With this, the group ventured to the strategy center to discuss the supposed siege. Arriving there, Marr explained to Kade and Drayden that they had managed to pinpoint Vreth's location using information she had managed to gather on Oba Diah to which Drayden asked why she was on Oba Diah in the first place. However, Marr waved this aside by telling him that that wasn't really relevant at that present moment.

title: Sela Marr
text: After Velara explained that Vreth was on Ferrum, Kade asked what they wanted from the Republic. Velara, embarrassed, explained that she didn't have the numbers that would be needed for a siege of this size and needed the assistance of the Republic's replicas in order for a complete lockdown of Sundari . To gain this, she proposed that she would give them Vreth once he was captured and that she would take the leadership role on Ferrum once the siege concluded. Nevertheless, Kade explained that if they aided them, it would break ancient treaties between the Republic and Ferriks and that the two sides would once again be drawn into a war. To this, Velara asked them what one more war was, but Drayden explained that they didn't want another war when they were already fighting in the Replica Wars. With this, Kade explained that he would ask for the Aetheri Council's guidance in this matter, but Velara, desperate for help, yelled at him that there was no time to speak with them and attempted to incite Kade's feelings for Satinna , whom Vreth had murdered months prior. She scornfully looked at Kade as he walked away to speak with

title: Sela Marr
text: Aetheri Council's guidance in this matter, but Velara, desperate for help, yelled at him that there was no time to speak with them and attempted to incite Kade's feelings for Satinna , whom Vreth had murdered months prior. She scornfully looked at Kade as he walked away to speak with the Council, refusing to allow his feelings to control his actions. Velara then angrily walked away as Marr watched her departure. With Velara gone, Drayden quipped that that meeting had gone well with everything taken into account. Hearing Drayden's witty remark, Marr turned back towards Drayden and said that he and Kade hadn't changed much since the last time she had seen them. Drayden then asked if that was a bad thing to which Marr smiled. He then asked her to follow him as he had a surprise for her waiting in the hangar. As they walked towards the hangar, Marr watched as the replicas saluted her as she passed by, commenting that the replicas shouldn't salute her anymore since she had left the Aetheri Order and therefore no longer commanded them. However, Drayden explained that they were just showing respect for the years she spent with them serving on the front lines in the Replica Wars. As they arrived, the door moved aside to reveal Vek and fellow members of the 501st's 332nd Company with their newly painted helmets bearing her markings. With her now having seen them, Drayden motioned for her to move through the lines of troopers as they had been waiting for her.

title: Sela Marr
text: After seeing the troopers, Marr walked back to Drayden and Vek who said that the paint job on the helmets was a little crude, but it was still good to see her again. Before they parted ways once more, Drayden presented Marr with a box which contained one of her most prized former possessions. However, just as he presented her with the box, the ship's emergency alarm went off, alerting all Republic personnel aboard to get ready for battle. Kade rushed in, informing Drayden and Vek to prepare all forces and that they would be entering hyperspace shortly to help ward off Skarn' surprise attack on Vantor. Kade informed Drayden that the Chancellor was under the protection of Solinai Aetheri Master Shaak Ti , but that Koss had lost contact with her. Growing annoyed by their political games, Marr asked if her former masters were just going to abandon the Ferriks. Somewhat shocked by the accusation, Kade urged Marr to understand that they were needed at Vantor as this was a pivotal moment in the Replica Wars. This only annoyed Marr more as she believed that the Aetheri were still playing politics, and noted that was why the people of

title: Sela Marr
text: Ferriks. Somewhat shocked by the accusation, Kade urged Marr to understand that they were needed at Vantor as this was a pivotal moment in the Replica Wars. This only annoyed Marr more as she believed that the Aetheri were still playing politics, and noted that was why the people of the galaxy had lost faith in them. Kade tried to defend himself that they were needed to defend the people of Vantor, but Marr countered that it was about saving the Supreme Chancellor instead. When Kade protested that what Marr was saying wasn't fair, Marr coldly retorted that she wasn't trying to play fair. However, Drayden offered a compromise where he would divide the 501st into a new division led by Vek who would be promoted to Commander while Marr served as an advisor. Marr accepted her new position and, with Kade's approval, the Siege of Ferrum could begin. Before departing, Kade advised Marr to capture Vreth instead of trying to kill him as he hadn't seemed to stay dead in the past.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr then thanked Drayden for the support as he once again presented her with the box, knowing she'd need its contents if she were going to face Vreth. Realizing what was inside, Marr opened the box, revealing her flux blades as she grabbed them, igniting them and revealing their new blue hue. As she looked at Drayden, he said they were maybe a little better than when she had had them last. She then briefly practiced with them once more. Beginning to depart, Drayden looked at Marr and said that with any luck their missions would be over soon and they would be able to reunite once more after their conclusion. She then offered Drayden good luck as he briefly looked back at her before walking away to prepare to face Skarn. Marr then walked further into the hangar and reunited with Vek.

Arriving at Ferrum, Marr boarded a gunship alongside Velara, Vek, and ARC trooper CT-5597 "Jesse" and joined the assault team in their approach to Sundari. During their approach, Prime Minister Almec contacted them and questioned them on why the Republic was attacking Ferrum, but after Velara announced her presence to Almec, declaring their knowledge of him being a puppet of Vreth, Almec understood. As he informed her that this attack would make her an enemy to the citizens of Sundari, she ended the transmission, noting that she didn't care. Marr turned to address Velara and commented on how much of a difference there was between her and her sister, Satinna. Velara then contacted Ursa Wrenna , another one of the Nite Owls, and asked her if she could confirm where Vreth was located, but Wrenna was only able to confirm that he had not yet left the city and also informed them that Vreth's forces were preparing for combat.

title: Sela Marr
text:
While running across the fighter, Marr noticed a crashing gunship. Landing atop it, she noticed the pilot's ejector seat had failed and needed assistance escaping the gunship. In order to do this, she used her flux blades to cut the top off of the cockpit, allowing the pilot's ejector seat to launch as the pilot thanked her. Before the gunship crashed, she hitched a short ride as the super commandos on the surface prepared to fire at her. Jumping down onto a platform, the gunship exploded behind her as the super commandos began to fire at her, forcing her to deflect their volt pistol bolts, allowing her to kill several of them. As she continued to defend herself, Wrenna and many other Ferriks arrived alongside Vek. With Vek's arrival, Marr mentioned that she had beaten him to the surface, reminding Vek that some things never changed. The two friends then rushed into Sundari.

Shortly afterward, Gar Saxon , one of the leaders of the super commandos, escaped into the Undercity of Sundari, taking several super commandos along with him. Watching the fighting occurring in the city atop a balcony, Marr watched as Vek returned from his scouting mission and confirmed to them that Vreth had not yet been found. With this news, Velara informed them that she and her Ferriks would be heading to the Sundari Royal Palace to capture Almec and ordered her to find Vreth as they would not be able to sustain a long siege. After Velara left, Marr ordered Vek to support Wrenna at Sundari's docks in order to ensure Vreth didn't escape. Before he left, Vek informed Marr that if Vreth wasn't in Sundari then the entire siege would be playing into his plans. Just then, Replica Captain CT-0292 "Vaughn" contacted Vek, informing him that they had a lead on Vreth's location as Marr and Vek rushed off to go investigate the situation.

title: Sela Marr
text: Shortly thereafter, the super commandos rushed in and surrounded Marr who ignited her flux blades to defend herself as Vreth similarly emerged from hiding. Upon his emergence, Vreth explained that he had been hoping for Kade to show up instead of Marr and asked her why she was here instead. Marr then looked around at her opponents and readjusted her stand, turning her head back to Vreth. Vreth proceeded explained that he did not know who Marr was to which she said that she knew who he was. Vreth went on to say that he assumed that they both mutually knew several people.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Vreth spoke, Marr pressed a button on her wrist comm , informing Vek that she needed assistance. While Vek traced her signal, Vreth explained that he was certain Kade would've come instead of sending Marr to which she explained that he was needed at the Battle of Vantor as opposed to fighting Vreth. Vreth then began to wonder if Mal' plan was finally coming to fruition, but did not explain as much to Marr. Vreth then asked why he sent Marr to which she taunted Vreth by asking him to surrender so that they could both go and ask Kade themselves. However, Vreth explained that that would be pointless as he believed the Aetheri and the Republic would soon be toppled by Vael Mal.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Conference with Kade

> " Tell Kael… " " I will. " ―Marr and Kade's last conversation

After Vreth's escape, Marr met with a hologram of Kade along with Vek in the Grand Salon of the Sundari Royal Palace while overlooking a hologram of Sundari itself. During their conference, Velara walked over and informed the group that firefights were still occurring in Sector 11 and congratulated the replicas on how effective they had performed in the siege; however, she also noted that Vreth still needed to be in custody by the end of it or the entire siege would've been for nothing. With this, Marr noted that while she was in the Undercity, Vreth mentioned the name of Vael Mal to which Velara asked Kade who he was, but Kade could share very little information on him, only being able to tell them what the Aetheri Council suspected.

title: Sela Marr
text: After Vek turned off the holo-map for Sundari and motioning the R4 astromech droid away, Kade informed the group that the council suspected that Mal was an Umbra Lord who had orchestrated the Replica Wars and had played both sides throughout the entire conflict. He then went on to note that he learned the name from Count Varek on Pyralis, but any chances of learning more about Mal from him were severed after Drayden beheaded him during the Battle of Vantor, briefly shocking Marr. After this, Kade noted that by capturing Vreth, they may be able to discover the mystery behind Mal and put the final pieces of the puzzle into place. With this, Marr asked for more troops, but Kade informed her that that would not be possible from his front as he was being sent to hunt down General Skarn on Uthara. Marr then asked if Drayden could reinforce them, but, instead, Kade asked for Vek and Velara to leave them while he talked with Marr alone.

title: Sela Marr
text: With their departure, Kade informed Marr that Drayden had been assigned to spy on Supreme Chancellor Mal by the Aetheri Council, which Marr found distasteful. When she asked why, Kade told her that the Galactic Senate had allowed Mal to stay in office far longer than his term allowed, even with the emergency powers granted to Mal shortly before The Replica Wars Begin and that the council was suspicious of Mal's true intentions. Marr then noted that Mal had been a great friend to Drayden for a long time and that she did not believe he would be happy with his current assignment. Kade affirmed her suspicions and said that it was best for her to talk with him. Marr was displeased with this, believing that Kade was asking for her to hold up the Council's judgment in the situation, not believing she was the right person for that role after everything they had put her through. However, Kade relented and admitted that the Council wasn't always right in its decisions, which was why he was asking for her help.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Just then, Vek rushed in, apologizing to both for interrupting them, but telling the two that there had been an attack in the Undercity. Kade allowed Marr to go and, as she ran off, she began to ask the Aetheri Master to tell Kael something. Kade did not let her finish, simply responding that he would. Marr then rushed off to the Undercity as Kade watched.

Interrogating Almec

Arriving back in the Undercity, Marr immediately received news that the replicas there were ambushed on their way to reinforce C-deck leading Marr to order Vek to reinforce the location and him to run off to fulfill his orders. After this, Marr walked over to an injured replica named Sterling who had called her name. He informed her that Vreth tore right through their defenses, asking about Marr the entire time. Eventually, Vreth realized that Jesse was the oldest replica in the unit present by looking into his mind and had most likely served under Marr for longer, so he took him deeper into the Undercity as a prisoner in order to get as much information from him as possible. With this, Marr looked deeper into the Undercity.

title: Sela Marr
text: Soon after, Marr departed the Undercity and went to the royal prison alongside Vek and Velara to interrogate Almec in order to learn more about Vreth's plan. Upon entering his cell, Almec sarcastically mentioned how flattered he was upon the three being able to find the time to meet with him. After this, Velara began the interrogation by asking Almec what Vreth's plan was and how he was planning on escaping. In response, Almec informed them that Vreth was not attempting to escape as he saw no point in it. Velara believed this meant that Vreth believed he could win, but Almec assured her that that was not the reason as he had become filled with a sense of dread in recent days. Marr then asked him if he had mentioned Mal to which Almec said he hadn't yet at that point. Continuing the questions, Velara asked why Almec wanted Kade here to which Almec said that he didn't exclusively want Kade and that there was another individual Vreth wanted as well, however; Almec feigned his forgetting of this person's name.

title: Sela Marr
text:
With this, Marr asked Velara to "help" Almec remember and, with this, he became very defensive, but was immediately shot by Gar Saxon, who had infiltrated to prison to assassinate Almec under Vreth's orders so that he could not tell them anything. While Velara ran after Saxon, Marr ordered Vek to get a medic as Almec informed Marr that Vreth had had a vision in which the name had come to him. As Almec slowly died, Marr cried out for him to tell her the name of the individual. With this, Almec slowly breathed out "Drayden" before dying in Marr's arms. Marr, briefly shocked by this, eventually recovered and rejoined Vek and Velara—who had lost Saxon in her pursuit of him—in returning to the royal palace.

The final confrontation

> " I know Kael. Your vision is flawed. " ―Marr, to Vreth, refusing to believe his accusations

title: Sela Marr
text: Now left alone, Vreth began to note how ignorant all combatants outside were, which led to Marr asking why Vreth was doing this for either her or the Aetheri Council to hear. To this, Vreth noted that he specifically wanted to speak with her. With this, Vreth mentioned Marr's betrayal by the Aetheri Order and asked if this were true to which Marr asserted that she had left voluntarily. Vreth acknowledged this but pointed out that her decision was motivated by the Aetheri Council's hypocrisy. Him noting this caused Marr to briefly pause before Vreth mentioned how he too had been a tool used by another power beyond himself.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr then walked forward and announced that she was there to bring Vreth to justice, to which he claimed that justice was just the construct of the current power structure's morals. He also noted that he believed that the current government would soon be toppled, leading Marr to ask if Vael Mal would be behind what he predicted. Vreth then explained that Mal was behind everything that had recently transpired in the galaxy, always orchestrating events from the shadows, but that would soon reveal himself. Marr then asked for Vreth to join her and help the Aetheri stop Mal before he took control over the galaxy. However, Vreth knew that the Republic had already fallen and that she just couldn't see this. He went on to explain that the Aetheri would not be able to defeat Mal and that their time had already passed, but that he believed that he and Marr might be able to defeat Mal if they worked together.

title: Sela Marr
text: As explosions continued to ring outside, Vreth extended his hand for Marr to join him as she contemplated her decision. As she did this, an explosion shattered the glass around the pair. Eventually, Marr decided that she would help Vreth on the condition that he answer her question on why he wanted Drayden to come to Ferrum. To this, Vreth explained that Drayden was the key to Mal' plan, which led Marr to ask if he was the Seeded One, but Vreth knew that his role was in fact to destroy the Aetheri and that he had long been groomed for his task. Marr then claimed that Vreth was lying, but Vreth remained firm in his beliefs, claiming that he had orchestrated the current war on Ferrum in order to lure Drayden and Kade there in an effort to kill Drayden, depriving Mal of his prized pupil and his main pawn.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Resuming the fight, Marr managed to gain the upper hand but was eventually forced to jump back several times to evade Vreth's attacks. Forced in a blade lock, Vreth grunted, attempting to disorient Marr, but this gave her the opportunity to kick him outside of one of the palace's windows. Marr briefly paused to catch her breath before chasing after Vreth to resume their fight.

As Marr emerged outside, she witnessed Ferrik reinforcements arrive to aid the replicas in warding off the super commandos' attack; however, as she turned her head, she noticed Vreth attempting to escape atop a building leading her to chase him to the support beams of the domed city's ceiling. As she reached the support beams, Marr reignited her flux blades and claimed that Kade had been right in his comment that Vreth would be hard to kill. As Vreth turned to look at her, Marr rushed at him as he reignited his own flux blade to continue their duel.

title: Sela Marr
text: He blocked her oncoming attacks as she lunged at him, briefly forcing her on the defensive before regaining herself and attempting to kick Vreth, but he managed to evade. As the fight continued, Marr jumped back on one of the support beams and almost lost her footing, but managed to regain herself before Vreth exclaimed that if she had joined him they could have destroyed Mal together, but Marr knew that this would have only been for Vreth to take his place, which she commented in response. As Vreth jumped towards her, Marr managed to elbow and kick him to another support beam, causing Vreth to briefly be caught off balance. She then once again lunged at him, but was forced off and kicked back, barely managing to hold onto a support beam.

title: Sela Marr
text:
As gunships arrived to extract him, Vreth wailed in terror of what was to come, claiming they were all going to die before one of the Ferriks used the whipcord within his vambrace and entangled Vreth within it, allowing Vek to stun him. Vek then told Marr that they would take it from there as Marr caught her breath and looked out at the crack in the dome Vreth had created.

#### Aftermath

> " With your help, the Aetheri can stop Mal before it's too late. " " Too late for what? The Republic to fall? It already has, and you just can't see it! There is no justice, no law, no order, except for the one that will replace it! " ―Sela Marr and Vreth

title: Sela Marr
text: As day broke on Ferrum, Marr arrived with the captured Vreth to regroup with Velara. Upon exiting the gunship, Velara exclaimed her disbelief in Marr's ability to capture Vreth, which she noted she was impressed by and handed Marr her flux blades back. In response, Marr noted that it was what the Aetheri Council wanted, with Velara following that by saying that it was still an impressive achievement due to the fact many had failed to capture Vreth in the past. As they continued to walk, Marr noted that this achievement was due to the fact that she had learned from the best the galaxy had, including Velara. However, Velara was not flattered as she expressed that she wished she was proficient in something other than combat. With this, Velara looked out at the ruins the siege had caused, and Marr followed up Velara's previous statement by saying that the people of Ferrum needed a new type of leader. However, Velara continued by saying that her sister had tried and failed to be a new type of leader for Ferrum, wondering if she could be any different.

title: Sela Marr
text: Before they could continue, Vek approached the two and informed Marr that he had managed to contact the Aetheri Council. Leaving Velara, Marr asked if Drayden was with them to which Vek noted that he had been when he had left to inform her about the meeting. Before leaving, Velara turned to Marr and gave her her blessing to leave, telling her that she could handle Vreth. With this, Marr left with Vek. As Marr and Vek walked into the meeting via hologram, the members of the Aetheri Council turned to look at the pair, with Koss noting that her mission had been a success. Marr confirmed this and reaffirmed their belief that she would be escorting Vreth back to Vantor once they departed. With this, Zho thanked Marr for her service to which Marr said that she was just doing her duty as a citizen of the Republic. Zho then asked if she did this act instead as an Aetheri, but Marr followed this up by informing them that she was not yet ready to be called an Aetheri once more. Moving on from this, Marr noted that she wished to speak with Drayden, but was instead informed that Drayden had left to inform Mal that Skarn had been located on Uthara. Having received an earlier report of Kade being sent to Uthara, Marr asked if he was the one who had engaged Skarn to which Zho confirmed that he had indeed engaged the Dissident forces on the planet. With this, Marr noted that the war could be over soon if Kade managed to kill Skarn, but, in response, Koss noted that

title: Sela Marr
text: As they walked out, Velara, Wrenna, and several other Ferriks walked by with the captured Vreth contained within an old Ferrik vault . Velara walked up to Marr and the two acknowledged each other with a bow of their heads with Vek leaving Marr to accompany the Ferriks as they escorted Vreth. As the Ferriks boarded the transport, Marr acknowledged the vault and noted that it was impressive, leading to Velara mentioning that the vault was from an era when the Ferriks were at war with the Aetheri. With this, Marr jokingly remarked that she thought Velara's sister, Satinna, had outlawed such devices as these while she was duchess of Ferrum, which Velara said that she had and that this was the last one the Ferriks possessed. With their conversation finished, Velara and Marr shook hands and the two said their goodbyes as Marr left to board the transport.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Now with Vreth in their custody, the transport took off to board the Iron Cruiser Tribunal . While onboard, Marr and Vek made conversation between one another. Arriving on the Vorash, Marr and Vek exited the transport and made their way to the ship's bridge. As Marr and Vek entered the bridge, the officers present turned and saluted Marr with a smile on their faces. The Iron Cruiser soon entered hyperspace as Vek and Marr watched. As Marr looked into the void of hyperspace, Vek asked if something was on her mind, leading Marr to explain that all she had ever been since she was an Adept had been a soldier, contrary to her training as a peacekeeper. To this, Vek said that all his life he had only been a soldier and that he and his brothers received a mixed feeling about the war because of it, but he knew that without the war, he and his brothers would've never existed. Marr then turned and smiled, telling Vek that the replicas' existence was one of the few good things that had come out of the Replica Wars, nothing that the Republic would never have been able to find better soldiers and that it had allowed her to receive her best friend in Vek. The two then saluted one another as an officer walked in to report that a new briefing had come in and, when asked if she would like to join him to look at it, Marr declined, believing it was more good news. Marr then looked back into streaking blue void of hyperspace.

#### Directive 66

Saving Vek

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Directive 66

Saving Vek

> " How widespread is this? " " Sela, it's all of us. The entire Grand Army of the Republic has been ordered to hunt down and destroy the Aetheri Knights. " ―Vek explains how widespread the betrayal of the Aetheri is — Link ▶️ ( file info )

As Marr stared into hyperspace, she received a vision of Koss dueling Mal within his office and Drayden betraying Koss, but did not fully understand what she was feeling. With this, Marr rushed into the command center and informed Vek that she believed something terrible had happened to Drayden. However, instead, the replicas began to turn their volt pistols towards her in accordance with Directive 66 . Joining them, Vek asked for them to lower their volt pistols so that he could kill her himself and raised his own volt pistols, a tear rolling down his face as he attempted to fight his inhibitor chip , an organic brain implant that compelled each replica trooper to comply with the directive.

title: Sela Marr
text: While his whole body shook and a tear rolled down his face, Vek asked for Marr to find Fivva before firing upon her. Marr, forced to jump out of the way, ran towards Vek and tackled him, igniting her flux blades to defend against the other replicas' incoming volt pistol bolts, managing to kill both attacking her. She then closed the blast door as Vek began to stand up, rubbing his head from being forced into the command console. However, Jesse along with several other replicas arrived, forcing Marr to divert her attention as all of the replicas present began to fire upon her. With this, Marr attempted to direct the volt pistol bolts into the wiring above in an attempt to escape. As she escaped, the replicas believed they had managed to kill her, but soon found that Marr had instead escaped into a vent above.

title: Sela Marr
text: voices crying out in pain and death as Aetheri across the galaxy were killed, including Marr's former mentor Tor Vayne. Marr then explained that her replicas had turned against her and she didn't know why to which Vreth began to laugh and say that he had not known what Mal' had been playing, but that he now did—the Grand Army of the Republic had turned against the Aetheri Order. He then stood up and said that Marr had done the right thing in seeking his help and asked her to follow his lead, but Marr instead held her flux blade up to him once more and made clear that she just wanted to use him as a diversion and not as a partner. With this, Marr ordered Vreth to go cause some chaos as Vreth looked at her with hatred displayed on his face. As the two walked out of the cell, Vreth asked for one of Marr's flux blades so that he might be granted a fighting chance, but Marr declined his offer and commanded him to leave once more. Now having freed Vreth, Marr made her way to the droid storage room to recruit help from the droids located there.

title: Sela Marr
text: As replicas ran by, Marr snuck her way through the Vorash, eventually arriving at her destination. Once Marr arrived in the droid storage room, she reactivated her old astromech droid R7-A7 who was ecstatic to see her, but Marr told him to quiet down as she required his help. R7 began to beep profusely, but Marr continued to attempt to quiet him down as the other two droids CH-33P and RG-G1 activated. As they activated, the droids began to profusely ask Marr questions upon what was happening, but Marr couldn't give them answers as she didn't know herself; however, she asked them for their help in discovering why. With this, the droids pledged their allegiance to her as Marr ordered them to get started.

title: Sela Marr
text: With all of them in agreement, Marr ordered R7 to patch into the central computer and search for any secure file in relation to CT-5555 as asked of her by Vek. As R7 searched, he discovered files in relation to an incident that occurred aboard a space station above Ringo Vindra between CT-5385 "Tupp" and Aetheri Master Tiplee as well as a report from Gelvarian doctor Nalle Seris that said that Fivva had had a malfunction with his inhibitor chip. She went on to mention a grievance report filed by Vek, which Marr asked R7 to open for her, but soon discovered that it was sealed. In order to open it, Marr tried Drayden's passcode of 8108, which managed to open the file. Upon opening the file, Vek said that the inhibitor chips within the replicas' brains could possibly have an alternative purpose they did not yet know. With this new information, Marr took the droids in an attempt to capture Vek and remove his inhibitor chip.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Vek rushed across a hallway, R7 and CH-33P stopped him, sealing the blast doors between him and the other replicas to leave him and Marr alone. With Vek trapped, R7 displayed a hologram of Marr, informing Vek that she believes she knew why he turned against her and that she saw his report on Fivva. On top of this, she informed him that he had been programmed to turn against her and that his mind had been altered by the inhibitor chip, continuing by saying that she could help him. As Vek took aim at R7 and asked where Marr was, she appeared behind him, with R7 electrocuting him in order to bring him to the medical bay. As Vek fell to the ground, Marr asked the droids to be careful as they had not been trying to hurt Vek. As replicas began to yell from outside the blast doors, Marr asked CH-33P if all the doors were sealed between them and the medical bay, which he confirmed. With this, Marr lifted Vek and placed him on top of R7, G-G, and CH-33P, and the combined efforts of the three droids allowed Marr to bring him to the medical

title: Sela Marr
text: doors, Marr asked CH-33P if all the doors were sealed between them and the medical bay, which he confirmed. With this, Marr lifted Vek and placed him on top of R7, G-G, and CH-33P, and the combined efforts of the three droids allowed Marr to bring him to the medical bay. As the replicas broke through the blast doors, Marr sealed even more doors to cover their escape. Reaching the medical bay, Marr placed Vek on the medical bed. With Vek in position, Marr ordered R7 to run a scan for the inhibitor chip within Vek's brain; however, the initial scans came up empty prompting Marr to ask the medical droid to check again. As they scanned once more, CH-33P alerted Marr that the replicas had begun to hack into the door and, with this, Marr ordered G-G to reseal the door as fast as possible if the replicas managed to break through. Marr then asked R7 once more if anything had come up in the scans, but nothing had yet been located.

title: Sela Marr
text:
With Vek awake, Marr asked if he was alright. Vek assured her that he was and apologized for turning against and almost killing her earlier. With that, Marr asked how widespread the inhibitor chips were and how many Aetheri were currently being betrayed across the galaxy, to which Vek responded with the crushing news that the entire Grand Army of the Republic had betrayed their Aetheri and had been ordered to hunt down and kill the remaining ones. However, soon after, the replicas began to cut through the door again as Marr and Vek turned to watch.

Escaping the Tribunal

title: Sela Marr
text: As they fought the oncoming replicas, Marr ordered R7 to find them a path off of the Iron Cruiser. While doing so, R7 managed to close the blast doors around them, sealing off several oncoming troopers, allowing Vek and Marr to mop up the few remaining troopers. Now at a pause in the action, R7 informed Marr that all of the escape pods had been destroyed, leading Marr to conclude that taking a shuttle would be their best bet to escape. With this, Marr began to leave, but while she walked away Vek informed her that Vreth had escaped his imprisonment, but Marr, having let him out herself, informed Vek upon this fact, to his surprise. He began to question her on why she would do such a thing, but she simply said that it was for a diversion as Marr began to rush for the hangar, asking Vek to hurry.

title: Sela Marr
text: to discover what happened, he informed the pair that the hyperrelay had been completely destroyed to Vek's disbelief. The two soon discovered that they had become entrenched in the gravitational field of a moon nearby. With this, Marr asked R7 to open the main hangar doors, and with that, they saw the oncoming moon, causing Marr to exclaim that they needed to get out of there. As the ship continued to jolt profusely, Vek asked about the status of the hangar doors as Marr asked about the shuttle. With that, R7 managed to open one of the hangar doors, revealing a shuttle for them; however, as R7 continued to open the rest of the hangar doors, it revealed an army of replica troopers, led by Jesse, waiting for them.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Fight in the hangar

As the replicas took their positions in the hangar, Vek quickly asked what they were going to do, but Marr admitted that there were too many replicas standing in their path to make a break for the shuttle and that she didn't want to hurt any of them, leading Vek to tell her that the troops did not care about what she wanted. Continuing on, Vek told her that the Iron Cruiser was going down and that all of the replicas aboard were willing to die in order to kill them both. With that, Marr walked over to Vek and removed his helmet, revealing his distraught state. With this, Marr explained that Vek was a good soldier, but that every one of the replicas trying to kill was too. Marr continued to state that they may be willing to die, but she wasn't willing to be the one to kill them, leading Vek to believe that she was admitting defeat.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr declined this, however, to Vek's puzzlement as he didn't see any other way besides killing them in a bid to escape. Marr then walked over to the viewport to see the army of replica troopers standing before them and informed him that she had an idea. As Vek began to look slightly puzzled, Marr handed him back his helmet and assured him that she thought it was a good idea. She then knelt down and asked the droids if she could count on them to which all three of them agreed that she could. With their acknowledgement, she stood up and informed her four allies that she would explain her plan on the way to the hangar. As they approached the hangar, Marr explained that Vek would feign her capture to the replicas as a distraction, while the droids snuck past them and activated the lifts beneath replicas' feet. Before they arrived, Vek took Marr's flux blades to make their ruse seem more plausible.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Vek and Marr reached the hangar, Vek asked for the replicas to hold their fire as he escorted a supposedly captured Marr with her arms on her head. As the replicas prepared to fire on Marr, Vek once again asked them to hold their fire as Jesse told him that he had his orders to execute Marr and asked him to eliminate her or else he would do it himself. As the replicas continued to aim their volt pistols upon Marr, Vek explained that the order had been to eliminate the Aetheri for treason and that since Marr was no longer an Aetheri, she should not be considered a traitor under the directive. This caused Jesse to briefly pause before he informed Vek that he himself had informed the replicas that they were under special orders from Vael Mal to eliminate Marr, even though she was no longer considered an Aetheri, as well as any replica who disobeyed the directive. As Jesse spoke, Marr turned to look at the droids who informed her that they needed a little more time, leading Marr to tell Vek to keep the replicas talking for a little longer.

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Burying the dead

Vek later landed the Yarrow near the Iron Cruiser's crash site and the two erected graves for each of the fallen replicas that they could find, placing their helmets on the graves of their fallen friends. They would also scavenge the remains of R7-A7 to rebuild him. Upon completion of the burial site, Marr stood over the fallen replicas, taking out her flux blades and looking at one of them one final time before dropping them to the ground and leaving them behind. Now fugitives and enemies of the Republic, Marr and Vek were forced to fake their own deaths and go into exile aboard their Yarrow. Marr also received a message from Kade sent to all surviving Aetheri, warning to stay away from the Aetheri Sanctum. She also came to understand that Mal had been an Umbra Lord, and she was forced to stay on the run as Mal transformed the Republic into his Imperium .

title: Sela Marr
text:
### Age of the Imperium

#### Life on Thabeska

> " We all look like each other, everyone in my family. Our long hair and our brown skin. People don't try to tell us apart, and we fool them. It helped us avoid the shadow, and it keeps us safe from the law. I wish you looked like us, too. " ―Hedala Fardi, to Sela Marr Sela Marr fled into the Outer Reach , intent on hiding from the Imperium. Eventually, she found the planet Thabeska , a planet that dealt largely in small-scale water and technology trading, and one with a relatively small and unorganized population located far away from major hyperspace routes . Believing the rural world to be of little interest to the Imperium, and a steady stream of newcomers would allow herself to blend into the quiet world, Marr made landing on Thabeska. However, the refugee did not account for the presence of the local Fardi clan , an influential family that either touched or ran most of Thabeska's businesses, including their own smuggling operations, though the family fronted such with several legal businesses. In time, Marr came to hear rumors that some kind of dark lord who was serving the Emperor and hunting Aetheri, yet she was unable to confirm such reports.

title: Sela Marr
text: On her third day on Raadan, Marr took the opportunity to explore the hills and caves ringing the settlement. She found a cave which she identified as her hiding place. Marr later met with Kaeden, her sister Miara Larte and several local friends including the farmer Tibbola , the work crew leader Vartan , and the twins Hoban and Neera at Selda's cantina , which had the best food in the settlement. The cantina was owned by the Solinai bartender Selda and run by the Garnethexan woman Malat , who reminded Marr of Aetheri Master Tor Vayne. While socializing with her hosts, Marr learned that Kaeden and Miara were orphans who had lost their parents in an accident. Vartan had adopted the two girls. When Kaeden asked "Ashla" about her family, Marr claimed that she was adopted. When Selda asked Marr if she was part of the influx of aliens that had migrated out of the Core Reaches, Marr claimed that she was not running from anything but only longed for quiet. Selda advised her to talk to him or Vartan if she encountered any changes.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr traveled to Selda's cantina and discussed the arrival of the Imperium with Kaeden and her friends. Miara speculated that the Imperium had come to explore the possibility of growing crops on Raadan. The arrival of Imperial rule saw the introduction of new restrictive measures including night curfews, rules forbidding large group meetings, and restricting cantinas' operating hours, food, and alcohol. In response, Marr advised her friends to start stockpiling rations. While several Imperial personnel visited the cantina, Marr and her friends avoided contact with the Imperials by playing a game of crokin . When they inquired about Sela's knowledge regarding their new situation, Marr decided not to reveal her past yet.

Stockpiling supplies

> " Why aren't you at work? " " I am at work. I mean, I'm not a farmer. I fix the equipment when it's broken, see? " ―A shock trooper questions Marr

title: Sela Marr
text:
Stockpiling supplies

> " Why aren't you at work? " " I am at work. I mean, I'm not a farmer. I fix the equipment when it's broken, see? " ―A shock trooper questions Marr

The following morning, Marr was visited by a pair of shock troopers who asked why she was working. Marr informed them that her job was fixing broken machines, and so one of them asked for her information, saying that she may be reassigned to field if they deem it necessary. Wishing to maintain the freedom she had under her job repairing machines, Marr used a mind trick to convince the shock troopers that her work was important for food production and they did not need to reassign her. With the pair in agreement with her, she asked if there was anything else she could help with and one reminded her of the new rules posted around the settlement. Marr closed the door on them and accumulated her rations to take to the caves. Being cautious of any surveillance that could be watching her, she made her way to the caves and hid the rations.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Wishing to move her freighter from the spaceport before the Imperium locked it down, Marr scouted a place to hide it, discovering a gully where the starship could fit. She then headed to the spaceport to retrieve the freighter. There, an Imperial officer took list of the starships in the port. He asked Marr of her purpose there, to which she told him that she wished to move her ship. The officer tried to assure her that the local garrison would keep it safe, but she then began mocking the security, making her way past the haggled officer before he could continue to dispute.

Marr proceeded to the pilot's seat of the freighter and prepared for takeoff. The Imperial officer reattempted to argue but was muffled out by the engines as she flew the ship away. Marr flew her freighter the opposite way to the gully, taking it the long way around Raadan to cover her tracks. Although she briefly considered abandoning the moon forever to run from the Imperium, she chose to continue instead and hid her ship in the gully with its nose positioned upwards towards the sky to ensure a swift take off.

Sowing seeds of insurgency

title: Sela Marr
text:
Sowing seeds of insurgency

> " I've seen them bringing in their own seed. Whatever we're planting, it won't be something we get to keep or sell. " " They'll buy off the overseers. They'll give them enough money to go off-world, and then work the rest of us to the bone. I've seen things like this before. " ―Miara and Marr discuss the Imperium's intentions on Raadan

Later, Marr met up with Kaeden, Miara, and number of other farmers at Selda's cantina. Neera informed Marr that Malat and her husband had already found work on the planet Garnethex . Marr lied that her freighter had been stolen when Kaeden asked why she had not also decided to leave Raadan. She and Miara then discussed the capabilities of the security lock the latter had created for her, with Vartan asking about making bigger charges. As Marr shut this down, Hoban argued that explosives would get rid of the Imperium, to which the Solinai claimed would provoke reinforcements from the Imperium, insisting that surviving with the Imperium was a better strategy.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr then learned from Kaeden and Miara that the overseers were adding two hours to the farmers' shifts, with the Imperium was planning on speeding up the crops and bringing their own seeds in. In this time, a number of uniformed Imperials entered the cantina. Marr then tabled the idea that the Imperium was going to buy off the overseers and overwork the farmers, brushing off Neera's inquiry into her past. Hoban insisted in blowing up Imperials, but as Marr began arguing with him, a drunken Tibbola got into a scuffle with an Imperial officer. The Imperial officer overpowered Tibbola and let a shock trooper shoot the farmer dead.

title: Sela Marr
text:
After Vartan, Hoban and Neera left, Marr watched Kaeden play crokin and suggested that the safest way to hurt the Imperium on Raadan was for the farmers to begin working slower to slow the growth of their crops. Before Kaeden and Miara departed, Marr told them to relay the suggestion to Vartan, who presumably knew how to slow crop growth. Marr briefly spoke to Selda, who deduced that she had seen deaths like Tibbola's before and told her to be careful. The bartender then gave her some leftover food. Marr quickly walked home after.

Building a coalition

> " By the time we harvest, the fields will be useless dirt. Nothing will grow for seasons and it's not like they're going to pay us anything we can use to buy fertilizer with. The whole moon will be ruined. " " Are there other fields? " " No. The whole of Raadan is nearly useless to begin with. " ―Vartan and Marr discuss the Imperium's artificial crop

title: Sela Marr
text:
For the next two weeks, Marr spent her days smuggling food, medical supplies, and water recyclers out to the caves. Marr was aided by the bartender Selda and several local vendors. In response to the slow growth of crops, thanks to the farmers, the new Imperial overseers extended the farmers' work shifts without increasing food rations, water, and breaks. Vartan discovered that the Imperium was growing a new artificial crop on Raadan that leached the planet's soils, preventing the farms from growing more crops. This fueled local resentment against the Imperium since Raadan had little arable land. In a conversation about the artificial crops, Marr convinced Vartan to lend her Miara and Kaeden, whom she recruited for assembling bombs that were to be used to attack Imperial forces. Marr showed Kaeden her caves on a map and later handed the farmer and Miara food at those same caves. The sisters became questioned Marr's intentions in stockpiling at the caves so early on, but Marr dismissed it as habits and directed the conversation towards Kaeden and Miara's parents. Over the next several days, Vartan recruited forty farmers including Hoban into a coalition movement for Marr. He briefed the Solinai on the matter at Selda's cantina, displaying how the recruits were organized into crews. Before leaving, Marr told him that she would brief the farmers the next day and departed the cantina.

Sabotage mission

> " I want to see the patrol a couple times. This might be our only chance to break in here this easily, and we should take advantage of this. " ―Marr, to her colleagues

title: Sela Marr
text:
Sabotage mission

> " I want to see the patrol a couple times. This might be our only chance to break in here this easily, and we should take advantage of this. " ―Marr, to her colleagues

Later, Marr led a mission to plant the corrosive charges on the Imperial walkers stored at the Raadian shipyard. For the mission she chose Miara, Neera and the Rodanori Kolvin to accompany her; Miara to help set the charges, Neera for her swift thinking, and Kolvin for his nimbleness. Due to the weak shock trooper security, Marr and her team infiltrated the spaceport easily. While planting charges, Marr took her time to observe the patrols, feeling that they would not be able to infiltrate the compound as easily after. After observing a couple patrol cycles passed, Neera advised the Solinai that it was time to leave.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr branched from the group with Miara to continue setting charges, and the Solinai was reminded of her time on Underra during the Replica Wars. During their work, she also discovered that Miara had smuggled a real bomb, asking the girl of it. Miara tried to dismiss this as an accident, but the Solinai pressed her inquiry, asking if her companion had been plotting behind her back. The pair were briefly interrupted when another patrol passed, this time scanning the compound for a moment. After they passed, Marr and Miara continued their mission and soon reunited with Neera and Kolvin.

After evading shock trooper sentries, Marr and her team headed back to Selda's cantina. There, she discovered that Vartan had sent Hoban and Kaeden on an unsanctioned mission to attack the Imperial admin building. Since the uprising was premature, Marr urged the farmers to return home and to disavow any knowledge of what had happened that night to evade any arresting that could ensue. However, Miara refused to abandon her older sister. A reluctant Marr agreed to rescue Kaeden and the others but warned Miara to follow her orders and bring the explosives.

An abortive uprising

title: Sela Marr
text:
An abortive uprising

> " What are you going to do Ashla? " " I'm going to the front. The fighting is the thickest there, but I might be able to help out long enough for our people to retreat. " ―Miara Larte and Marr

Marr ran through the streets with Miara and Neera towards the Imperial admin building when the alarms sounded from the Imperial compound, where the damage to the walkers had been discovered. As they continued to the compound, an explosion sounded and Miara denied that it was one of her bombs. When Marr told her two comrades to reveal the real plan, Neera revealed that Hoban had split the coalition fighters into three groups and that they were armed with explosives and volt pistols.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr ordered Miara to hide in the caves and Neera to bring the remaining coalition fighters to the caves. Marr decided to disable the Imperial tanks. When Miara asked "Ashla" what she was going to do, Marr responded that she would head to the thickest part of the fighting and evacuate as many people as she could. Marr also confided that she was a veteran of the Replica Wars when Miara asked again where she had come from. After separating from Miara, Marr and Neera headed to the Imperial compound, where Hoban's ill-equipped fighters had been repelled by the garrison's heavy artillery and the five remaining survivors including Hoban and Kaeden were pinned down by enemy fire.

title: Sela Marr
text: After arriving in the caves, the coalition fighters turned to Marr and Kaeden told her that she had some explaining to do. With Neera being sedated to prevent her from harming herself, the farmers took some time to be quiet before Marr decided to reveal her identity as a former Aetheri apprentice. Kaeden was angry with Marr for not revealing her Aetheri identity since she could have saved Hoban's life and stormed off before the Solinai could continue explaining herself. Having been discovered by the Imperium, Marr considered leaving to avoid drawing further attention from the Imperium. While meditating, Marr was interrupted by Miara, who informed her that her sister Kaeden had left the caves and headed back to town. Marr instructed Miara to stay in the caves with Neera while she went to find Kaeden, knowing that the Imperials would catch her.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr's presence on Raadan drew the attention of both the Imperium and Senator Solen, who was still working against the Imperium in secret. While the Imperium dispatched the Warden Sixth Warden to Raadan to draw the Aetheri out of hiding, Solen took an interest in reports of Aetheri activity on Raadan and contacted Captain Raymus Rask to retrieve Bolt-3 for a secret mission to find Marr. After retrieving Bolt-3, Solen hired the pilots Chardri Tagin and Tamris to find Marr and then contact him to arrange a rendezvous. Solen believed that the former Aetheri would make a worthy ally in the insurgent movement he was building.

title: Sela Marr
text:
While having dinner, Marr chatted with the older Fardi sisters Chenna and Makala about life while taking care not to disclose her adventures on Raadan. "Ashla" claimed that she had seen people suffering in the galaxy, but there was nothing she could do about it, adding that the people had gone into hiding when the sisters asked why she could not help them. Marr also remarked that it was difficult for her to hide since she stood out as a Solinai.

Duties

> " Hedala, I need you to tell me about the shadow. Anything you can remember about it. Can you do that? " " Yes. I never saw it, but I knew that it was here, in the city. " ―Marr and Hedala Fardi

title: Sela Marr
text:
Duties

> " Hedala, I need you to tell me about the shadow. Anything you can remember about it. Can you do that? " " Yes. I never saw it, but I knew that it was here, in the city. " ―Marr and Hedala Fardi

Over the next five days, Marr spent her time working on a large Fardi transport, turning the engine and installing a new compressor. When she managed to find time alone with Hedala, Marr asked the little girl about the "shadow." Hedala explained that she never saw the entity but could sense its presence. Hedala also mentioned that the "shadow" had one day mysteriously disappeared. Marr believed that this individual was a umbra side creature, recalling rumors of a dark lord that served the Emperor. This "shadow" was actually the Sixth Warden, who had been hunting Hedala before redeploying to Raadan. Marr complimented Hedala for staying out of the "shadow"'s way and told her not to mention the individual to her sisters. Marr then took a moment to think about that the "shadow could really be and considered her options once again, deciding to stay with the Fardis since she was safe with them.

title: Sela Marr
text:
A week later, Marr requested a new job from the Fardi patriarch, who was surprised upon this and had her prove her flying skills. Fardi then sent her to ferry supplies to the other branches of the Fardi family in the other cities on Thabeska. During her flights, Marr came to suspect that the Fardis were using her to smuggle goods. Fardi later assigned her offworld transport missions. While on a routine flight, she picked up a distress call from an escape pod. After rescuing the occupants of the pod, Marr was informed that their shuttle had been attacked by pirates, who had taken several hostages. The occupants, all humans, were part of a company that had been targeted by a rival firm competing for a large project. Marr suspected that the rival firm had colluded with the pirates to kidnap hostages in an attempt to bankrupt the company and she agreed to help the humans and rescued their companions from the pirates.

Final departure

title: Sela Marr
text:
Final departure

> " As it is, I think you'll have to leave, and we'll have to go straight for a while to get our reputation back. " " I'm in your debt again. This is the second time you have taken me in when I had nowhere else to go and the second time you have turned me loose instead of turning me in. " " You are a good mechanic. There aren't so many of those that I'm willing to throw one away just because of a few Imperial entanglements. " ―Fardi and Marr Later, Marr returned to the Fardi household and discovered that shock troopers were conducting a routine search of the house. To avoid drawing Imperial attention, Marr claimed that she had repaired the Fardis' ship and taken it for a spin around the system. The Fardi patriarch vouched for "Ashla" and claimed that she was his mechanic. Marr also spoke with Hedala and learned that she had sensed no "shadows" that day. When the shock troopers and their commanding officer asked about the metal pieces they had found in her room, Marr claimed that they were just "bits of junk" that she had picked up from doing various jobs. The Imperials accepted her story but advised Fardi to be careful about associating with criminal elements.

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Entanglements

> " You've cost the Black Sun thousands of credits, and you'll pay them back one way or another. " " This is sounding less and less like a job. " " Your corpse is also acceptable. " ―A Black Sun member and Marr

Marr took the Fardi ship to small, sparsely populated world in the Thabeska system. However, she was followed by a starship flown by a non-binary Black Sun agent , who had come to extort credits from her for the damage her smuggling activities with the Fardis had inflicted on the Black Sun 's operations. In order to pay off these "debts," the Black Sun agent offered her a job, but threatened to kill her if she did not accept her offer. Marr rejected the Black Sun agent's offer and fled back to her ship under fire. The Black Sun agent gave chase in their own ship. During the dogfight, Marr decided to cast her aside her pseudonym as "Ashla" for good and to embrace her identity as Sela Marr.

title: Sela Marr
text: The Black Sun ship managed to damage her freighter's starboard engine, but a larger vessel intervened before Marr's ship could sustain further damage, chasing the syndicate's starship away. Marr managed to take her freighter into space, but burned out her port engine. Before she could engage the hyperrelay, she was caught in the grapple beam of the second ship that she had encountered. This ship belonged to Tagin and Tamris, who had been sent by Solen to find Marr. Believing the second ship to be hostile as well, Marr armed herself with batons. When Tagin and Tamris entered the ship through the hatch, she knocked them out cold.

title: Sela Marr
text:
While navigating her way to the bridge to disable the grapple beam, Marr encountered her old friend Bolt-3 in the engine room. Bolt-3 told her that he now worked for a senator and that Tagin and Tamris had been sent on a mission to take her to meet someone. The droid also confirmed that the senator was the Aetheri sympathizer Bael Solen and that he had indeed sent the pilots to pick her up. Marr convinced Bolt-3 to release the grapple beam on her ship and to tell everyone that he never saw her. However, she instructed him to make sure that she could track his ship. After repairing her ship, Marr left Tagin's ship and hid on one of the small moons that orbited the planet where she had encountered the Black Sun agent. After Bolt-3 had transmitted the coordinates of Tagin's ship, she slept aboard her freighter.

#### A new ally

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### A new ally

> " I keep an eye out for acts of kindness in this new galaxy of our. When there's a concentration of them, I try to find out who is behind them, and then we have a talk. " " What do you talk about? " " The Insurgency, Adept Marr. I look for people who will fight against the Emperor, the Imperium, and everything it stands for. " ―Bael Solen and Marr

After Senator Solen, having spotted Marr's montrals in security footage that Bolt had not erased, arrived in his CR90 corvette Tantiva IV , Marr donned a pressure suit and boarded the Senator's ship through a hatch that Bolt-3 had left open. Marr then surprised Senator Solen in his temporary office. After exchanging pleasantries about Bolt-3, Marr explained that she did not come with Tagin because she distrusted anyone who employed a grapple beam before saying a hello. Solen admitted not telling his pilots who she was in order to protect her true identity. Addressing her as "Adept Marr," Solen then told Marr that he was recruiting people for a insurgency against the Emperor, the Imperium and everything it stood for.

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Planning her return to Raadan

> " The overwhelmingly common descriptor is gray . Not terribly helpful, I think? Even the security footage doesn't reveal too much. " " A shadow? Gray like a shadow? " " I suppose. " ―Bael Solen and Marr discuss the Sixth Warden

Marr agreed to the mission, but requested a meal since she was exhausted from her earlier adventures. Solen then informed her that his contacts in Raadan's sector had reported the presence of a new Imperial agent who had gray skin and was armed with a flux blade ; this agent being the Sixth Warden, who had been stalking Hedala and was now charged with rooting out Marr. The Warden had already attacked the Raadian insurgents who had retreated to the caves, recapturing Kaeden before slaughtering the others, including Kolvin and Neera. Only Miara had survived the massacre.

title: Sela Marr
text:
When Captain Rask entered the office to investigate Marr's intrusion, Solen reassured him that she was a friend. After her conversation with the senator, Marr rested in a room that Solen had provided for her. While sleeping , she experienced a flashback of her acquiring her kyber crystal as a youngling on Ilum. After resting, Marr assembled two flux blade hilts from the scrap metal pieces she had acquired over time. Marr then met with Senator Solen and told him about her plan for their mission to Raadan.

#### Return to Raadan

Voyage

> " Are you sure you don't want backup? I'm sure Chardri and Tamris don't hold a grudge, and they're good in tight spaces. Well, they are when they know what they're up against. " " No, thank you. It'll be easier on my own. " ―Bael Solen and Sela Marr

title: Sela Marr
text: Prior to departing for Raadan, Marr declined Solen's offer to provide a starship as she felt that the models would stand out in the Outer Reach. She also refused backup since she preferred to work alone, which Solen recalled that many of the Aetheri he had encountered preferred as well, although Marr reiterated that she was not an Aetheri. When Solen asked what Marr was, stating that she still sounded and acted like an Aetheri, Marr replied that she would let him know once she figured out who she was. After finishing the modifications to her ship, Marr rested before departing on her mission.

title: Sela Marr
text:
As they approached the settlement, Marr discovered that the Imperial crops had drained the life out of the planet's soil. She told Miara to remind her to burn the dying fields if they got a chance. Miara also informed Marr that the Imperium was having the farmers work shifts for the entire daytime. While Marr headed to the Imperial compound, she instructed Miara to find Selda or Vartan and give them the holo she had recorded in hyperspace.

Duel with the Sixth Warden

> " Aetheri! " " You have something I want. " " Poor little Kaeden Larte. So hopeful that her Aetheri friend would come for her. I had to tell her that Aetheri don't have friends. Aetheri don't have attachments of any kind. " ―The Sixth Warden confronts Marr

title: Sela Marr
text: Some time following the evacuation of Raadan, Marr smuggled herself aboard the Tantiva III in order to arrange a meeting with Senator Bael Solen. She overheard a conversation between the Senator and his young adopted daughter Princess Elira Solen . After exchanging pleasantries, Solen confided that the Imperium hoped to use his image as a family man to ensure his compliance. When Marr asked if he worried about his daughter, Solen replied that she took after her mother. When Marr asked what Solen was doing to fight against the Imperium, he briefed her about Captain Rask' glowing report of the Raadan evacuation. There had been fifteen casualties including fourteen evacuees and one Arrow pilot. However, Rask' medical staff had been able to save Vartan.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr also confided that the Warden she encountered was not the last of his kind. While the Warden had some training, she observed that he mostly relied on brute strength and lacked the skills of an Aetheri. Solen promised to do what he could about possible other Wardens and then asked about Raadan. Marr explained that the farmers could not go back because the Imperium would wipe out the moon's surface.
