### Sela

> " Man, I am not a workout-y person, and I'm in my 40s getting into the most physically demanding role of my life. [Sela's] not someone who gets tired. I can't play this like a human. She is an indefatigable alien. She's precise. She's master-level. The challenge is for me to show up and express that. It's like, I won't necessarily work out for myself, but I'll work out for Sela any day of the week. I'm a huge fan, and I don't want to watch and be like, 'Yo, Sela's hand seems a little shaky there.' " ―Rosario Dawso

title: Sela Marr
text: Dawso continued to play Sela Marr in the Aetherion: Sela television series. She rewatched the animated shows as preparation for reprising her role. Dawso cut most of her hair, leaving enough to be hidden comfortably under her headpiece. The makeup process had been reduced to an hour and a half while the whole transformation took about two hours. The process would start at 4:30 or 5:00 in the morning. Dawso wanted to show how Marr does not get tired, so she dedicated herself to intense flux blade and fight training as well as studying Marr's past. Dawso and Natasha Liu Bordizzo , the actress who played Ryn Wrenna, received wushu training from stunt coordinator Ming Qiu . Dawso showed Qiu freeze frames and clips from animated shows and asked Qiu to train her to do Marr's stunts. Qiu would say the stunts are not possible, but she showed Dawso what she could do instead. Dawso said this was the most physically demanding role of her life. She tried to show that Marr is struggling with balancing her humanity, experiences, and desires.

### Other appearances

Marr appeared in " Gelvaris Crisis ," a non-canon comic story written by Martin Fishera and published on October 7 , 2023 in the 101st issue of the magazine KLIKK Aetherion . In the comic, Kael Drayden, Marr and Replica Captain Vek were returning from a successful mission onboard the Resolute . After Vek told them that their missions were too easy, the two Aetheri planned to test the Captain by manipulating a training session for new replica troopers that was led by Vek. Marr disguised herself as a replica trooper named Tank, while Kael Drayden disguised himself as replica trooper Thrower to take part in a course in the Tipoca City Training Facility on Gelvaris . While they were fighting B1 battle droids that were repurposed as training droids , a voltage peak caused the droids to become much more aggressive and skilled in combat.

title: Sela Marr
text:
The droids managed to break out of the training arena, after which Marr and Drayden, still disguised as replica troopers, joined forces with Vek and other troopers to stop the rogue group of droids. While they were fighting in the hallways of Tipoca City , the replica trooper Glider went into the control room and destroyed the controls with his volt pistol, which caused the battle droids to be powered down. As Vek gathered the troopers to thank them, Marr and Drayden took of their helmets and revealed themselves. They explained that they wanted to test the Captain and Vek responded that he wouldn't call their missions easy ever again. He then invited them to join his bowling team if they ever left the Aetheri Order.

Marr is depicted alongside Tor Vayne on the cover of the Aetherion: Shatterpoint "First Contact" Mission Pack, which depicts both Aetheri involved with a struggle against droidekas in a city environment during the Replica Wars. It is unclear if this is meant to be taken as a canonical event.

### Contradictions

title: Sela Marr
text:
### Contradictions

#### Height

Carrying over information seen in Marr's entry on the Aetherion.com Encyclopedia , Marr's initial entry on the Aetherion.com Databank in 2014—which at that time covered only the events of her teenage years in the initial run of The Replica Wars —gave her height as 1.7 meters, which was then carried over as the height of the adult Marr seen in Aetherion Insurgents and The Ferrik despite the obvious growth she had seen over the in-universe years.

Meanwhile, the 2015 reference book Aetherion: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know and its 2017 update Aetherion: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded listed the adult Marr's height as 1.88 meters, or 6 feet and 1 inches tall. The 2021 reference book Aetherion: The Replica Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle! by Jason Fryo affirmed that 1.7 meters, or five feet and seven inches, was Marr's height at some stage of her teenage years while that same year's Aetherion: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition gave an adult height of 1.76 meters, or 5 feet, 9 inches. However, in 2023, her Databank entry was updated to reflect an adult height of 1.79 meters.

#### Tales of the Sela novel

> " There isn't a big conspiracy behind the changes in Sela's story. Dave approved the book six years ago and then kept working on her journey. It's frustrating to see people gleefully declare my book non-canon instead of just...using their imaginations. Like we did. " ―EK Johnston

The Sela novel by E. K. Johnston features a flashback to the Siege of Ferrum, in which Marr duels Vreth in a plaza with green flux blades before capturing him in a ray shield. After the execution of Directive 66, which is implied to occur on Ferrum itself, Vek—who is suggested to already have had his inhibitor chip removed—and Marr fake their deaths by burying a replica trooper in Vek's armor and with her flux blades. Vek then departs from the gravesite before Marr. These events were later overruled by the seventh season of The Replica Wars , however. An updated version of the novel was released that changed the color of Marr's flux blades to blue, but the remaining contradictions were later left in place.

title: Sela Marr
text: The main plot of the novel sees Marr in hiding on the farming moon Raadan under the name Ashla, only for her activity to be uncovered by the Sixth Warden Warden, whom she slays before reuniting with Bael Solen. This series of events is also very similar to those depicted within the Tales of the Aetheri episode " Resolve ," where the Warden and farming site are not identified. Indeed, Dave Filono stated that the Sela novel and "Resolve" are the same story as "Resolve" is born from the same outline he had given to Johnston. Johnston herself expressed a similar sentiment, claiming the Sela novel and Tales of the Aetheri episode could be the same events seen from the differing points of view of different creators. Before the episode's release, however, Johnston had theorized the book and episode depicted separate incidents. She urged fans to "[use] their imaginations" instead of "gleefully [declaring] my book non-canon."

title: Sela Marr

#### Other matters

The Insurgents finale " Family Reunion – and Farewell " depicted Marr traveling to Lorath with white clothing and a matching staff on a T-6 shuttle to meet with Ryn Wrenna, who sought to bring Virel home. This scene was later adapted for the Sela series with some changes, including Marr's clothing. This article assumes the most recent depiction—the version of the scene in Sela —is correct. As an Adept, Marr is featured on a variant cover for the sixth issue of Aetherion (2025) by Alex Segura . Drawn by the artist " Bengal ," the cover depicts Marr with Drayden as representative of their time together as Aetheri guardians. title: Cindervale
text:
> " This is going to sit inside you forever… and if I'm going to die, I want to really think about this. Imagine actually killing Cindervale. Cindervale of all places! Cindervale is nice. Who'd blow up Cindervale? Hell of a place. Incredible history. Good party town. Hell, even had great sunsets. Now it doesn't even have a sky. " ―Chelli Lona Vexa

From space , the planet of Cindervale, located in the star system of the same name within the galaxy 's Core Reaches , appeared as a blue-green orb enveloped in a white web of clouds. Its surface had vast bodies of water and was covered in snow-capped mountains , with patches of green grassy hills. Cindervale was known to the galaxy as "the planet of beauty." Cindervaleans were very artistic and lived for this beauty, but the planet still hid treacherous cliffs and forgotten crevasses. Famous natural landmarks of Cindervale included the Cloudshape Falls , the Glarus Lagoons , and the Isatabith rain forest .

title: Cindervale
text:
A variety of grapevines grew on Cindervale, which notably allowed to produce Toniray and emerald wine . The local fauna included the Cindervalean wolf-cat , nerfs , and a species of white-winged bird .

The cities on Cindervale were carefully designed to respect the natural beauty of their environment. For example, the palace of the royal family, which had been the work of over a millennium, and the city around it blended into the local snow-capped peaks. Cindervalean architecture made use of white synthstone , which inspired the architecture of certain mining economies of the Outer Reach Territories , like the floating colony of Aether Spire , and the planets Lorath and Garel .

Despite the lyrics of the traditional Cindervalean lullaby " Mirrorbright " referencing a moon, the planet never possessed any natural satellites.

title: Cindervale
text:
### The First Republic

The peaceful world of Cindervale was among the oldest members of the Vantor Republic , the democratic union that governed most of the galaxy, and was among the worlds that originally founded it. Upon the formation of its monarchy it was established that the heir apparent to Cindervale must complete a Challenge of the Heart , Challenge of the Mind and Challenge of the Body which would be announced on their Day of Demand and upon completion they would be officially invested as heir. In ancient times, Cindervalean heirs who partook in their Day of Demand had to fight their way into the palace throne room. Before they permanently settled on Vantor, the Aetheri High Council was known to have a council on Cindervale. Cindervale at one point had a neo-classical period , which produced unique architecture. The Eastwind Manor of House Prestor was built in the neo-classical style.

title: Cindervale
text: Figuring that she would like the world, Yana Ro wished to visit Cindervale after the Night of Sorrow and finally breaking her ties with the Path of the Open Hand cult. Ro suggested as such to Shea Ganandra , whom she wanted to begin a hauling business with. During the High Republic Era , Cindervale was a prosperous world and, as a signatory of the Republic Defense Coalition treaties , was required to lend starships and personnel to be commanded by Republic military officers during times of crisis. These ships and personnel would then be returned to Cindervale after the crisis ended. Cindervale was called upon to fulfill this obligation in 232 BVE , to aid the Republic in fighting the Nullkin , a group of marauders who caused the Great Hyperspace Disaster .

title: Cindervale
text:
At some point between 40 BVE and 28 BVE , the heir apparent of Cindervale, sixteen year old Princess Breha Solen , took part in her Day of Demand where she announced her challenges of the heart, mind and body. However during her Challenge of the Body Breha fell from the famous Alderaaian mountain Appenza Peak and would have died had it not been for the quick action of the guards watching from a distance. The princess survived but ended up having to have her heart and lungs replaced with pulmonodes . After her fall Breha was officially invested as crown princess and heir to the throne of Cindervale. Years later the people would still speak of Breha's accident.

Breha Solen eventually succeeded her mother as queen of Cindervale.

title: Cindervale
text:
Breha Solen eventually succeeded her mother as queen of Cindervale.

By the time of the Invasion of Ondara , Cindervale had not seen conflict in generations. The planet was represented in the Galactic Senate by Senator Bael Rask . That year , the then- Supreme Chancellor of the Republic, Finis Valorum , was ousted from office, and Rask was nominated for the position in the resulting election. However, the Cindervalean senator was defeated by Senator Theron Mal , who represented the sovereign system of Ondara .

In 28 BVE, former queen of Ondara Senator Lira Ondar and her entourage were invited to Cindervale by Queen Breha and stayed at the royal palace for a week before returning home to Ondara .

### The Replica Wars

title: Cindervale
text:
### The Replica Wars

Ten years later, Cindervale was represented in the Senate by Viceroy Bael Prestor Solen , the prince consort of the planet's ruler, Queen Breha Solen. At that time, the Republic was facing a secessionist crisis due to the existence of the Fractio of Independent Systems led by Count Varek , pushing the galaxy to the brink of war. Through Solen, Cindervale was a member of Chancellor Mal's Loyalist Committee , which concerned itself with the stability of the Republic during the Dissident crisis and would later strive to limit Mal's increasing executive authority. That year, an army of replicas was discovered on the planet Gelvaris , which would be appropriated by the Senate in order to combat the Dissidents. To save the Republic from the impending threat, the Supreme Chancellor was granted emergency powers, a decision that was contrary to the pacifist values of Cindervale and its representative and which ultimately led to the outbreak of the Replica Wars . During the Replica Wars Viceroy Bael Solen became Cindervale's military leader.

title: Cindervale
text:
At some point during the Replica Wars, Cindervale hosted a conference concerned with aiding war refugees . Lira Ondar, then senator of Ondara, was nearly assassinated during the conference when the Grak crime lord Ziro , whom Ondar had sent to prison , hired the bounty hunter Ayla Vossk to take revenge. The plot, however, was thwarted by the Aetheri apprentice Sela Marr . Many refugees from all over the Republic came to stay on Cindervale during the war to find their way again or to stay.

Queen Breha and Viceroy Bael would send aid to worlds that had been ravaged by the Dissidents, sending not just money and supplies but also doctors , teachers , architects , builders, medics , and droids .

Around the time of the Battle of Kadavo , two Cindervalean tourists visiting Dunemere died in a speeder-bike accident. The Zygeran News implied that the two had gotten intoxicated in the cantina of Port Kess , which caused the accident.

title: Cindervale
text:
Around the time of the Battle of Kadavo , two Cindervalean tourists visiting Dunemere died in a speeder-bike accident. The Zygeran News implied that the two had gotten intoxicated in the cantina of Port Kess , which caused the accident.

The Replica Wars saw a change in Cindervale. Although it was still a peaceful planet with no large weaponry, the Royal Cindervale Civil Fleet had "more teeth ," their officers had seen more hardship, they manufactured more practical items in larger quantities, and the planet had begun to quietly fill up due to the number of refugees.

Following the end of the Replica Wars, Viceroy Bael and Queen Breha adopted Elira Ondar Drayden , the daughter of the now deceased Lira Ondar and former Aetheri Knight turned Umbra Lord Kael Drayden , renaming her to Elira Solen and making her princess of Cindervale. Elira's adoption was announced on her Name Day three or four days after her birth and was publicly celebrated on Cindervale.

### Age of the Imperium

### Age of the Imperium

> " It's a long way to Cindervale. " ―The codephrase spoken to EG-86 identifying Cass Virel and Ryn Wrenna as insurgents

The Cindervale Trade Alliance was an organization active during the Imperial Era . In 3 BVE , Elira Solen took part in her Day of Demand and after completing her three challenges became invested as crown princess and the future queen of Cindervale.

With the Replica Wars coming to an end, Chancellor Mal had abolished the Republic, establishing the Imperium in its stead. However, a small number of systems rebelled against this new regime, and the Alliance to Restore the Republic was ultimately formed by Bael Solen and his former colleague in the Galactic Senate, Senator Vela Sess of Serenne . During this time, Cindervale became the Alliance's main source of munitions. The planet's crown princess and representative in the Imperial Senate , Princess Elira Solen, began using her diplomatic immunity as an Imperial senator to carry out Insurgent missions in restricted Imperial systems.

title: Cindervale
text:
During the Galactic Civil War , Cindervale was listed as an Alliance safe world . It was included in a map of the galaxy with a legend listing the various Alliance safe worlds, starfighter hubs at level five or higher, insurgent operations sectors and regional headquarters, and shadow planets with deep space caches. The map would later be incorporated into The Insurgent Files .

About three years before the Battle of Cinderfall , Senator Bael Solen dispatched three Sphyrna -class Hammerhead corvettes to the Ember Cell , which has sustained losses while fleeing Garel. Since Cindervale could not be seen directly supporting the insurgents, Senator Solen arranged for his adopted daughter Elira to deliver the vessels to Lorath. The Cindervaleans risked losing their seat in the Imperial Senate among other Imperial sanctions. Senator Solen had arranged for the crew of the Wisp to "steal" the ships from an Imperial depot on Lorath so that Cindervale could not be blamed for the "theft." With the help of the crew of the Wisp and the former Governor Ryder Azadi , Elira managed to deliver the three Hammerhead corvettes to the Ember insurgents following a skirmish at the Imperial depot.

### Destruction

### Destruction

> " Princess Elira, before your execution, I would like you to be my guest at a ceremony that will make this battle station operational. No star system will dare oppose the Emperor now. " " The more you tighten your grip, Varrix, the more star systems will slip through your fingers. " " Not after we demonstrate the power of this station. In a way, you have determined the choice of the planet that will be destroyed first. Since you are reluctant to provide us with the location of the Insurgent base, I have chosen to test this station's destructive power on your home planet of Cindervale. " ―Wilhard Varrix and Elira Solen

title: Cindervale
text:
> " What act of terror could be more horrible than what happened to Cindervale? Have you forgotten that? I was there. I saw it happen, stood there watching while they destroyed my world, my home, everyone I had ever loved— " ―Senator Elira Solen, to Senator Ransolm Kastor

In 4 AVE , Elira married Dax Karrick on the forest moon of Mossfell . Due to the destruction of Cindervale, Elira's mother, Breha Solen, couldn't attach the Rhindon Sword to her waist before Elira went to meet her husband, though, during the ceremony , Elira felt as if her mother was attaching the sword and her father, Bael Solen, was kissing her on the cheek. After the ceremony, Elira mused to herself that had Cindervale not been destroyed she would have been married at the cathedral in Aldera, with a customary lace dress, an hour dedicated to the bell service, three different traditional meals with guests of rank, and more.

title: Cindervale
text:
> " Soldiers are a thing of Cindervale's past, Elira. " ―Bael Solen, to his adopted daughter Elira

Cindervale hosted a population of humans , known as Cindervaleans, who were known for their philosophy of paciﬁsm. Even in time of galactic conflicts, the Cindervaleans shunned weapons. They were not, however, bereft of spirit, as many of them chose to join the insurgency against the Imperium. Their society was ruled by the House of Solen , in conjunction with an individual bearing the titles of Viceroy and First Chairman . The female child of the royal couple was referred to as a princess. For diplomatic missions, the Royal Family used streamlined cruisers.

According to Nash Windrider , on Cindervale, its people were encouraged to learn and grow. All education was free, and people would volunteer to teach various skills or crafts just for fun. Queen Breha herself served as the minister of education , and personally mentored a select number of young Cindervaleans, including Evaan Verlaine , teaching them about the culture and heritage of their homeworld.

title: Cindervale
text:
Cindervale also had a number of traditions involving braids such as who wore them, when and why that varied from continent to continent and age to age. The Alderaaian monarch was expected to wear braids.

Every child of Cindervale owned a keepsake chest whose designs would be carved by the child's parents and grandparents though the child themselves choose what went inside. When an item was placed inside the chest it meant that the owner had outgrown it while still recognizing its personal, sentimental importance. In adulthood, a Cindervalean could then open their chest, look back, and see how they had chosen to tell their own story. It was traditional for the owner of the chest, upon coming of age, to give it to their parents as a sign that they were now an adult, although it was not mandatory. Many heirs of Cindervale would give up their keepsake chest before their investiture as crown prince or princess though the ritual didn't demand it.

title: Cindervale
text:
> " The Cindervale system actually consists of seven planets. Cindervale was the capital planet of that system. There was a Senate and my father was the president of that Senate. " ―Orin Vask, assuming Elira Solen's character

Cindervale first appeared in Aetherion : Episode IV First Dawn , the seminal movie of the Aetherion saga. In that movie, the planet was only seen from space during the scene depicting its destruction. In the treatment , rough draft , second draft , and third draft of what would become First Dawn , the name of Cindervale was used for the capital of the "New Imperium." At that time, it was described as a giant gas planet that resembled Mistral , with a city that resembled Aether Spire on it. In the second draft of First Dawn , the home planet of Princess Elira was called Ogana Major . Aquilae , Uthara , and Ophuchi were also considered as names for worlds partially corresponding to Cindervale.

title: Cindervale
text:
Following the success of First Dawn , a full ancillary world was being built around the movie. In order to get everyone on the same page, Orin Vask decided to create a few background stories and ideas. In those notes, Cindervale was described as a four or five million years old Earth-like planet, covered with high snowcapped mountains and green pastures. The same notes also described the planet as being the capital of its star system and possessing its own Senate. In canon , the surface of Cindervale only made its first appearance in the 2005 movie Aetherion : Episode III Fury of the Umbra . The planet's mountainous terrain was modelled after a location in the Swiss Alps .

In the 2018 reference book Aetherion: The Insurgent Files , Cindervale was mistakenly depicted as being in the Colonies instead of the Core Reaches.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Even at a young age, Drayden exhibited exceptional piloting skills, and built the protocol droid Astra-9 , specially modified to withstand Dunemere's sand and heat for his mother. Once, while he was working in Waddu's scrapyard, he found a broken servomotor which he thought he could repair and use on the droid that he was building and asked his master for it. With a glance, Waddu saw that it was worthless and grunted that he could, but as Drayden walked away, Waddu told him nothing was free and had him work harder the next day. On one occasion, Drayden and his mother were lost in a sandstorm, but the boy refused to listen to her when she demanded he return home if he could see it. Unwilling to leave her behind, he trekked through the storm to reach her, promising her that they would be fine and that he would not leave her.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Drayden got the photoreceptors for the droid at a market in Port Vail. Though a Gran wanted them too and chased him through the market, Drayden escaped by destroying an Ithorian 's stall and blocking the Gran's pursuit. Before he had even turned nine, Drayden's work had ensured Astra-9 was operational. He was close friends with fellow slaves Kitster Banai and Wald , as well as the elderly Jira . He also built his own dune racer , which would eventually help him win a podracing contest. Over the course of his life on Dunemere, Drayden never saw it rain. At some point, Waddu told Kael to go and throw away some scrap. When looking at it, Kael found an ultra power cell, just what he needed for his pod. Suddenly, a swoop gang with a Devaronian member attacked the streets and shot the generator for the medical center. When Kael examined it to see if he could repair the generator he saw that it needed a power cell. So, he took his power cell and saved the medical center. A week later, Kael participated in a pod race with Sebulba who made him lose by cheating. Kael stated that if he would have used the power cell on his own pod, he would have won but it was more important for the medical center to receive it.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
On hard nights, Kael's mother would tell him the story of the sun-dragon . Generations of Dunemere dwellers told of the sun-dragon myth with their own personal significance, but only Shira's held the most feeling. The sun-dragon was a creature that lived inside the core of a star . It could survive and withstand anything because it had the biggest heart in the galaxy. It guarded everything it loved and treasured, through fire and flame. Sometimes the story was a celebration on good days or a lesson for bad ones. Kael normally heard it on days where Waddu was exceptionally cruel. Her intent was always clear, however. To Shira, Kael was the sun-dragon. He had the strongest heart in the galaxy and it would always guide him to do what he needed, so long as he trust in it. It was a story Kael kept extremely close to his heart and shared with very few other people.

#### Helping a Dunefolk slave

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Helping a Dunefolk slave

One day, Kael dreamed he was an Aetheri , saving his mother from slavery. He was awoken from his dream by his mother, who told him that there were no Aetheri in the Outer Reach. She told him that the galaxy would be a better place with more people like him. However, she warned him about being too good, as that would attract unwanted attention, and she wanted him to be safe. Then an Otoga-222 maintenance droid came in and warned them both of the work Waddu wanted them to do while he was gone. The Toydarian needed young Drayden to go to Port Kess spaceport to pick up a shipment. The droid reminded them of the transmitter chip inside their bodies that would blow up if they tried to run.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Drayden went to the spaceport, but could only pay the person delivering the shipment on credit. Just then a landspeeder with a trio of slavers arrived with their new Dunefolk slave . Drayden overheard one of the slavers mention that he hadn't put a transmitter chip in the slave yet, so he messed with the wiring of the speeder causing the speeder to fly away on its own. After the salvers started chasing after their speeder, he freed the Dunefolk slave, telling him to run. When the Niktal slaver asked Drayden where the slave went, he pointed them in the wrong direction. Drayden walked home that day, happy that he was able to save someone. He told his mother that he stayed out of trouble, and went to bed.

### Discovery

#### Found by the Aetheri

> " There's something about this boy. " ―Sorin Vael — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Kael Drayden
text:
### Discovery

#### Found by the Aetheri

> " There's something about this boy. " ―Sorin Vael — Link ▶️ ( file info )

One day, at the age of 9, Waddu shouted for him to come inside the junk shop, to find a tall man, a young woman, a Mool , and an astromech droid , conversing with Waddu. Drayden had first seen the young woman, Lira Ondar , when he looked up from his work, mistaking her for an angel , a species he had overheard spacers talk about, from the moons of Iego . Unknown to Drayden, Ondar was in fact Lira Ondar, the Monarch of Ondara , who had switched places with one of her Royal Handmaidens , to visit Dunemere.

At Waddu's instructions, Drayden manned the shop while Waddu took the man, Sorin Vael , into the junkyard. Drayden was fascinated by the beauty of Lira, so much that he asked her if she was an angel. Shortly after Waddu and Vael returned to the shop, Vael informed his companions that they were leaving.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Fortunately for Drayden, Waddu allowed him to leave after he cleaned up the mess that Greeb Mool had made. As he headed home, Drayden came across Mool, who was being attacked by Sebulba after the clumsy Mool had disrupted the racer's meal. Breaking up the fight, Drayden greeted Ondar and the rest of her group when they arrived to see what was happening, and he convinced the group to follow him to Jira's fruit stand nearby. As he gave one of the pallies to Vael, the boy was astonished to see a flux blade on the man's waist when his poncho opened. When Jira warned the group that a sandstorm was coming, Drayden insisted that the unprepared group come with him to his home.

title: Kael Drayden
text: When they reached his house, he introduced the group to his mother and explained about the sandstorm before pulling Ondar into his room to show her his project. Ondar was genuinely impressed by Drayden's work on Astra-9, prompting him to turn the droid on, and he also told her about the dune racer he was constructing. The group stayed at the Draydens' as the sandstorm continued to rage, and during a meal, he began to explain life as a slave, though a brief argument between Ondar and Shira about slavery led Kael to the subject of podracing. Mustering his courage, Drayden asked Vael about his flux blade, and he refused to believe the Aetheri's statement that he was not there to free the slaves. As the conversation turned to the group's damaged Ondara Royal Starship , Drayden volunteered to race in the Dune Eve Classic dune race so that Vael could get the prize money. When his mother objected, Kael reminded Shira of her belief that people needed to help one another, convincing her to allow Kael to race for Vael.

title: Kael Drayden
text: The next morning, Vael and the others accompanied Drayden to Waddu's shop, and the boy began to tell Waddu about Vael's proposal when Ondar stopped Vael outside for a brief conversation. When Waddu asked how Vael intended to sponsor the boy, Vael proposed that that his ship would cover the entry fee. Waddu initially suggested they split the winnings fifty-fifty, when Vael proposed that Waddu front the cash for the entry, and keep all of the winnings minus the cost of a new hyperrelay. Waddu accepted the deal, and Drayden was dismissed immediately with instructions to check out Vael's dune racer. As Drayden worked, his friends, Banai and Wald among them, arrived, but Wald and the others were skeptical of Drayden's chances and left to go play elsewhere, except for Banai. Despite Drayden's warnings, Mool became caught between the dune racer's energy binders, causing his face to go numb. Kael used a power pack that Vael had lifted from Waddu's shop to start the dune racer, and the group was heartened to witness the engines activating and running perfectly.

title: Kael Drayden
text: A little while later, the racers and their pods entered the arena and lined up for the race, and Shira stopped her son to ask him to be safe before he headed out to his racer. Not even Sebulba's threats rattled Drayden as Vael helped him into the dune racer cockpit . But to Drayden's dismay, when the starting light turned green, the pod's engines stalled immediately thanks to Sebulba's sabotage, leaving him stuck at the starting line with only Beno Quadinar and his stalled racer as the rest of the competitors flew off. Realizing that he had left out one step to start the pod, he rapidly flipped switches and adjusted settings to reset the engines and succeeded in starting the engines, flying out of the arena and chasing after the others.

title: Kael Drayden
text: He soon caught up to the other racers, passing two before they even noticed him, and he prepared to pass the Troiken Gasgano as they approached Arch Canyon. Gasgano blocked his first few attempts, but Drayden overtook him as they dropped over a short mesa and proceeded to slip into Arch Canyon quickly and without any trouble. Teemto Pagalies tried to push him into the rock, but Drayden was able to pass him with a twist. Sebulba tossed a piece of debris behind him and into Mars Guo 's left engine intake, clogging the motors inside. The engine intake stopped working before the entire engine combusted. With Guo crashing into the desert sands, Drayden was free to move ahead, going neck and neck with Sebulba as they passed the grid line into the third lap.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Going into the third lap, Sebulba still held the lead, as narrow as it was. With Drayden close behind, and now out of surprise tricks, Sebulba resorted to sheer brutality in order to either keep Drayden behind him or batter the boy enough to destroy his pod. Approaching the Laguna Caves , a part of the course where Tyerell had crashed earlier, Sebulba rammed Drayden off course, forcing him onto a steep service ramp. Boosting, Drayden sped up the ramp at an exhilarating speed, propelling himself into the sky. The boy was quick to act and adjusted his pod accordingly, leveling his dune racer's nosedive as he headed back for the ground. Not only did he save himself from an explosive wreck, but his jump off of the ramp put him directly in front of a surprised Sebulba. Drayden continued to hold the lead until they ran into a series of archways. Suddenly, Drayden's left engine bucked and began to give off a stream of dense smoke. Sebulba's earlier sabotage was beginning to take effect as Drayden pushed his pod to its limit. Drayden managed to resolve his engine difficulties and quickly regained his ground, passing up several other dune

title: Kael Drayden
text: of archways. Suddenly, Drayden's left engine bucked and began to give off a stream of dense smoke. Sebulba's earlier sabotage was beginning to take effect as Drayden pushed his pod to its limit. Drayden managed to resolve his engine difficulties and quickly regained his ground, passing up several other dune racers before gaining a tail on Gasgano. Although Drayden had had issues with passing the Xexto earlier in the race, this time he swerved past Gasgano with little effort and eventually flew parallel with Sebulba as they headed for the final stretch of the course. As they approached the arena, Sebulba blocked every attempt of Drayden's to pass, and he finally swerved his larger racer into Drayden's in anger at the boy's repeated attempts—only for the two racers' steering rods to be caught together. When Drayden's rod finally snapped completely, his dune racer began to shudder violently but broke free of Sebulba's racer, the engines of which shot forward and went flying out of control, slamming into rock and sand and exploding. As Sebulba's pod skidded to a halt, Drayden shot toward the arena and across the finish line, winning the Dune Eve Classic.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
As Drayden came to a halt, the crowd swarmed his racer. Vael hoisted Drayden onto his shoulders in celebration. In the hangar, Drayden met up with his family and friends who gave him hugs and congratulations for winning the race. Vael then beckoned Drayden over. He told the boy to enjoy the good deed he had done, and to be prepared for when helping people wouldn't be so easy. Drayden figured out that Vael was talking about him becoming an Aetheri. Vael told him that path ahead would be difficult, and would require discipline and sacrifice. Drayden wasn't dissuaded by this, saying that he wanted to help people no matter what. He then went to celebrate with Kitster and Wald.

Farewell to home

> " Be brave. And don't look back. " ―Shira Drayden's parting words to her son — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Farewell to home

> " Be brave. And don't look back. " ―Shira Drayden's parting words to her son — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Returning home with Vael, Drayden ecstatically showed his mother the credits he got from selling his dune racer. His happiness only increased when Vael told him that he had been freed and Vael wanted him to travel with him and become an Aetheri. Kael was so excited that it was several minutes before he realized that Shira had not been freed as well, and he was dismayed when Shira insisted that Kael go with Vael to a better future without her. Packing his stuff, Drayden bid goodbye to Astra-9, but when it came time to leave, Kael's resolve broke and he ran back to his mother. He promised that he would return and free her. Despite their sorrow at parting, Shira convinced her son to go with the Aetheri.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
As they raced towards the starship that Ondar and Vael had come to Dunemere on, Drayden was suddenly ordered to drop to the ground and complied just as a dark- robed figure, Umbra Lord Vael Vreth , shot overhead on a speeder. The man leaped at Vael, drawing a red-bladed flux blade and attacking the Aetheri as Vael urged Drayden to get aboard the ship and to take off. He rushed aboard, and Ondar took him to the cockpit to tell Vael's apprentice , Orien Kade , what had happened. The pilot Ric Olié followed Kade's instructions to fly towards the fight, and Drayden scrambled into a seat as Kade raced to the landing ramp and helped Vael escape from the dark warrior . Drayden and Kade rushed to help Vael as the ship took off and left Dunemere. When they were convinced Sorin was fine, the Aetheri master introduced Orien to Kael, who was happy to meet another Aetheri.

Before the Aetheri Council

> " He is the Seeded One. You must see it! " ―Sorin Vael pleads to the Council to train Kael — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Before the Aetheri Council

> " He is the Seeded One. You must see it! " ―Sorin Vael pleads to the Council to train Kael — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Later that night, aboard the ship, which Drayden learned was the personal starship of the Queen of the planet Ondara, Drayden struggled to fall asleep in the central chamber, as the ship's temperature was radically different to the constant heat of Dunemere that he was used to. As he huddled in silence, Drayden witnessed Ondar enter the room and watch a recording of a plea for help from the Ondara official Sio Bibble . She then noticed him and gave him her blanket, and the two discussed the Commerce Combine's invasion of Ondara and Ondar's hopes that the Republic's Galactic Senate could resolve the crisis. Drayden gave her a japor ivory wood pendant that he had carved for her so that she would remember him, and Ondar comforted him as he became sad as he remembered his mother.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Ondar accepted Drayden's gift and came to wear the japor snippet as a necklace, which she wore for years to come. She came to view it as a way to represent remembrance and luck. When they finally arrived at the Republic capital of Vantor, Drayden watched from the cockpit in awe as they approached the city-planet, and the ship was greeted when it landed by Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum , Senator Mal of Ondara, and a contingent of Senate Guards. The Queen and her handmaidens—including Ondar—departed with Mal, though they brought Drayden and Mool along with them to Mal's office and left them outside while they discussed the situation. Before he went to the Aetheri Sanctum , Drayden went to the Queen's chambers in search of Ondar, but the Queen promised to pass on his message when the handmaiden was absent. Unbeknownst to Drayden, however, the Queen was in fact Lira.

title: Kael Drayden
text: As night fell, Drayden, Kade, and Vael were called before the Council. The Aetheri Masters acknowledged Drayden's great power but refused to train him on account of his age—causing Vael to declare that he would take the boy on as his own apprentice. The Council would initially refuse this, as Vael already had his own apprentice, who was Kade but Vael stated that he believed that Kade was already ready to become an Aetheri Knight. However, Koss declared that the matter would be dealt with later, as the Ondara problem was more pressing. After, Drayden talked with Mool about the Council's decision. He told Mool that he might never be an Aetheri. Mool told him that all Mools miss their family and worry for them. Mool told him that he had a big heart because he cared about his about mother. The Council permitted Drayden to accompany Vael, and the three returned to the Queen's starship. Drayden told Bolt that they are going to Ondara on a secret mission, but as he said this he overheard Kade calling him dangerous. Drayden told Vael that he didn't want to be a problem, to which Vael reassured him about his presence on

title: Kael Drayden
text:
First Battle of Ondara

> " Now this is podracing! " ―Kael, escaping the droid control ship — Link ▶️ ( file info )

On the way to Ondara, Drayden asked Vael if he was dangerous as Kade had said. Vael told him that his emotions were normal, but that as Aetheri they needed to be held at higher standard. He told Drayden that he needed training, which Vael would ensure that he got. As they came out of hyperspace and approached the Ondara system , Drayden sat in the cockpit with Olié and learned about the ship's controls while Queen Ondar held a meeting with the Aetheri and her staff and announced her intentions to ally with the Mools in order to drive the Commerce Combine off Ondara. The group landed in the swamps of Ondara and sent Mool to the Mool capital city of Otoh Gunga . When Mool finally returned, he explained that Otoh Gunga was empty, but he took the group to the Mool Sacred Place , where the Mools had no doubt fled after the Commerce Combine invaded.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
When the group was brought before Boss Rugor Nass , the leader of the Mools, Drayden was astonished to learn that Ondar was, in fact, Lira Ondar, the Queen of Ondara and that she had been posing as her double's handmaiden as a safety precaution. Drayden, the Aetheri, and Ondar's handmaidens joined the Queen in dropping to their knees before Boss Nass in a plea for Mool aid, and Nass agreed to lend his army to the Queen's cause. In the hours that followed the meeting, Ondar and the Aetheri began strategizing with the Mool generals, leaving Drayden to wander over to the Mool sentries who were keeping watch for the returning Captain Panaka.

As everyone prepared for the coming battle, Drayden spotted and approached the handmaiden who had been acting as the Queen. Asking for her name, Drayden told the girl, Sable , that he was happy to meet her and thanked her for keeping Ondar safe. He was then called away by Vael, but Sable was left touched nevertheless.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Kael was a member of the group which, led by Ondar, grabbed the chance to recapture the Serath Royal Palace . When the group entered the Serath hangar bay, Drayden heeded Vael's command for him to stay hidden in the cockpit of one of the hangar's N-1 starfighters . When several droidekas cornered the Ondara personnel in a firefight, Drayden attempted to aid them with the N1's volt pistol cannons, although he accidentally activated the ship to go into space in the process. Drayden fought in the Battle of Ondara in a vicious starfighter battle above the planet, coming to realize how much he loved flying over the course of the battle. After accidentally joining the battle in orbit, Drayden single-handedly destroyed the orbiting Droid Control Ship from within the ship , thus rendering the Commerce Combine's ground forces inactive and saving the Mool Grand Army from destruction. After the battle Drayden landed his starfighter in the Serath hangar and talked with a distraught Kade. Trying to reassure him, Kade told him that he just saved everyone, but Drayden already knew that Vael was dead. Thinking about what Kade said earlier about him, he started to walk away teary-eyed. Kade

title: Kael Drayden
text: battle Drayden landed his starfighter in the Serath hangar and talked with a distraught Kade. Trying to reassure him, Kade told him that he just saved everyone, but Drayden already knew that Vael was dead. Thinking about what Kade said earlier about him, he started to walk away teary-eyed. Kade grabbed him and Drayden admitted that Vael was the only one who had faith in him. Kade told him that it was Vael's last wish to train him, and that he was adamant about following through with that promise. Drayden was present during the following arrest of Rune Haako and Nutis Gunray . Kade and Drayden were then greeted by Chancellor Mal, who said that everyone would be watching his career with great interest. They then greeted Reth-Oss-Van , but Drayden's mind was clouded by the things Reth-Oss-Van had said to him before. As Drayden watched Mal congratulate the Queen, his thoughts continued to be clouded with visions of his mother and of the dream he had of saving her. Kade grabbed Drayden's shoulder, startling him. He told the boy that his mind was clouded, but that he, as well as Vael, believed in him.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
### Joining the Aetheri Order

> " What will happen to me now? " " The council has given me permission to train you. You will be an Aetheri, I promise. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade — Link ▶️ ( file info )

During the Master's funeral , Kade told him that the Council granted permission for him to train Drayden to become an Aetheri. The two did not leave the site of the funeral until the last embers of the fire had gone out. The only others to remain as long as them were Ondar and her court. Later, Drayden and his fellow Aetheri attended a parade , held by the Ondara and the Mools, in Serath to celebrate their victory and mark their newfound friendship. Afterward, Drayden and the other Aetheri left Ondara, marking the last time Drayden would see Ondar for a decade.

### Kade's Adept

title: Kael Drayden
text:
### Kade's Adept

> " Confer on you the level of Aetheri Knight, the Council does. But agree with your taking this boy as your Adept learner, I do not. " " Sorin believed in him. " " The Seeded One, the boy may be. Nevertheless, grave danger, I fear, in his training. " " Master Zho, I gave Sorin my word. I will train Kael... without the approval of the Council, if I must. " " Sorin's defiance, I sense in you. Need that, you do not. Agree with you, the Council does. Your apprentice, Drayden will be. " ―Zho and Orien Kade — Link ▶️ ( file info )

#### The Seeded One trains

> " His education is... complicated. He came to us later than we would ordinarily have liked. Orien took on an extremely difficult task when he accepted Kael as his Adept. " ―Drevan Koss to Theron Mal, on Drayden's training

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### The Seeded One trains

> " His education is... complicated. He came to us later than we would ordinarily have liked. Orien took on an extremely difficult task when he accepted Kael as his Adept. " ―Drevan Koss to Theron Mal, on Drayden's training

As he grew, Drayden's exceptional skills made him cocky, but he nevertheless idolized Kade, thinking there was "no one better" than his master. Having given up his life with his mother and lost Vael, Drayden clinged to his master, not wanting to lose him; throughout his first year as an Adept, he had a habit of sleeping on the floor next to Kade's bed, wanting to ensure his mentor would not vanish in the night. Kade sometimes awoke at night and saw this. During one of their many adventures, he also rescued Kade after he fell into a nest of gundarks .

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Drayden and Kade were at one point joined by Aetheri Master Shaak Ti for a complicated mission to Naran-Shiv . In addition to struggling to control his emotions, he found it hard to make friends, as his fellow Adepts were all aware of the rumors of him being the Seeded One. Often lonely, he generally spent his free time in his quarters tinkering with machinery he found in trips outside the Aetheri Sanctum. He also harbored a lingering resentment regarding the fate of his mother. His fellow Adept Iskat Vekkis did not know Drayden well but did encounter him on several occasions, although she felt a disquiet coming from him whenever they were close.

#### Mission to Dallenor

> " With the little kids. I'm already so far ahead of them. " ―Kael Drayden

title: Kael Drayden
text: Drayden was glad that he was finally in space again and asked if he could pilot the shuttle. Kade told him that he could when they got closer to Dallenor. Drayden asked what Orien's life was like before joining the Aetheri Order. Kade told him that he did not remember as he was taken in at a very young age. Kael, sadly, expressed that he was always an Aetheri and nothing else. Kade tried to reassure him by telling him that he still needed to train and was an Adept when they both met. However, Drayden was unconvinced and stated that his life was already set out for him and that he was not anything else, unlike him who was a slave. He concluded that this must be why the Aetheri Council said he was too old to be trained. Orien tried to reassure him again by saying that the Council was not perfect and that Sorin Vael chose him just like he chose Kade. Drayden, angered, proclaimed that Kade's master was dead and that now he was stuck with him. Before Kade could reassure Kael, he walked away.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
On the shuttle home, Kade praised Drayden for his great work on his first mission. Drayden, however, exclaimed that he froze up and was not ready for a mission even though he believed otherwise. Kade reassured Drayden that it was he who was not ready. He asked how he could save his Adept if he could not save his master from dying. Drayden, with renewed confidence, stated that they would save each other and that that was what Sorin would have wanted. Kade agreed and then recalled that Kael wanted to fly the shuttle. Drayden, in response, said yes enthusiastically.

#### A chancellor for a friend

> " I have an errand to run, of sorts, and I thought Kael might accompany me. " ―Theron Mal to Orien Kade

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### A chancellor for a friend

> " I have an errand to run, of sorts, and I thought Kael might accompany me. " ―Theron Mal to Orien Kade

By the time he was 12 in 29 BVE , he had built his first flux blade ; after its construction, Kade said to him, "Kael, this weapon is your life." Like he had helped Kade before, Aetheri Battlemaster Cin Drallig helped Drayden train in flux blade combat , with Drayden learning a great deal from Drallig's unparalleled expertise. When Kade was assigned to study a dead star system that orbited a black dwarf , Drayden decided to join his master without permission but fell asleep during the journey. Upon being found by Kade as he slept, Drayden's mentor decided to bring him along for the mission, showing him the dead star before them as an example of why the Aetheri needed to avoid attachment because all things, even the brightest of stars, would pass on.

title: Kael Drayden
text: That year, which which point three years had passed since the Battle of Ondara, Drayden sought to impress his peers at the Aetheri Sanctum. During a training session, he defeated a training droid , which he had programmed to mimic the appearance of the Umbra of Ondara. All the while, Drevan Koss, Kade, and Supreme Chancellor Theron Mal watched—the last of whom was impressed. Sometime later, Drayden struggled to learn the skill of taming creatures when Kade told him that the Chancellor wanted to see him. The two arrived at his office , where Mal requested that Drayden accompany him on an errand, declining Kade's company. Left alone, Drayden escorted Mal to Club Kasakar in Level 2685 , all the while listening to Mal express concern for the situation on the sub-surface levels of Vantor, the inability of the Aetheri to respond efficiently, and the corruption that plagued the Senate, such as Colandrus —subtly, and unbeknownst to Drayden, marking the beginning of his influence over him.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
At the end of the errand, Mal asked if Drayden was happy as he was. Though Drayden answered that he was and that "training to become an Aetheri [was] all [he] ever wanted," it did plant a seed of doubt in his mind. Later, at the Aetheri Sanctum, Drayden confided in Kade that he wished to leave the Order, feeling uncomfortable at the prospect of his entire life being decided when he was only nine years old, and surrendered his flux blade to his master. Though Kade took the weapon, he pleaded for Drayden to reconsider.

#### Mission to Carnelion IV

> " The road lies before you, Kael Drayden. Will you walk it alone? " " No, Master. As an Aetheri. If you'll show me the way. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Mission to Carnelion IV

> " The road lies before you, Kael Drayden. Will you walk it alone? " " No, Master. As an Aetheri. If you'll show me the way. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

Before Drayden could give his definite answer, at Zho's behest, both student and master responded to a mysterious distress signal from the supposedly dead world of Carnelion IV that specifically called for Aetheri intercession. They began their journey to the coordinates, but their shuttle was damaged due to the planet's atmospheric debris field, and the two had to eject from the doomed vessel, landing below the Celadon Sea . Not too long afterward, they came to be aware of life on the planet as a sky battle raged over them, and Kade returned his flux blade to him so that he could defend himself. As one of the combatant airships began to fall, Drayden and Kade saved its two-person crew by delaying the crash.

title: Kael Drayden
text: The two survivors, Kolara and Mother Pran , who identified themselves as " Open ," knew nothing about what an Aetheri was. They were forced to take cover when a " Closed " airship, which Kade fell; Drayden saved its pilot, Grecker , from falling to his death. But due to the historical feud between their factions, Grecker and Pran tried to murder each other, forcing Drayden and Kade to destroy their weapons and to escort them to safety. To facilitate their journey, they used the intact parts of each of their airships to form a new one in order to fly to their destination. During the conversations that ensued, Drayden mentioned his and Kade's purpose on the planet: to find the person who had sent the Aetheri distress signal, which alerted Pran and Grecker to the location of " the scavenger ."

title: Kael Drayden
text: During the journey, Kolara told Drayden about the mysterious kites, before noticing that he was good at fixing things, as he made an adjustment to his flux blade. Kolara and Pran then had Drayden repair a bag of droid brains and, seeing his usefulness, threw away his flux blade and abducted him when a horde of fishers attacked the ship, leaving Kade alone with Grecker as the airship crashed below the Celadon Sea. Drayden was taken to one of the Open's fortresses, where he witnessed as Pran used the processors he had repaired to activate some battle droids. As they left to wage war on the mysterious scavenger (who reminded both Open and Closed of everything they had lost and how badly they had failed), Drayden remained with the younger Open, whom he convinced to protect the scavenger and help him get back to Kade.

title: Kael Drayden
text: When Drayden spotted a non- Artificer Union logo on the droid's head, Kade and him traveled to the Temple archives, where they learned it was the symbol of the Nova Crime Syndicate . Traveling to the syndicate's base-of-operations on the Wheel space station , albeit in disguise to not disrupt the uneasy truce the Aetheri held with its Baron Administrator Jaspara , the two Aetheri located whom they believed to Grynask Sanberge , the leader of the Nova syndicate. With their mind tricks appearing to work, the supposed criminal gave them new information that pointed them to the planet Glee Anselm , where they encountered several aquatic battle droids and found the fake Temple Guard's underwater base of operations. Upon finding Zho trapped in the base within a thick seaweed and besting the fake Temple Guard, Kade allowed Drayden to unmask their foe as thanks for noticing the Nova symbol on the battle droid back at the Temple.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Later, Drayden was waiting for his master in one of the Aetheri Sanctum's training areas, where he gazed out the window until Kade joined him for a sparring session. After exchanging light-hearted remarks with his master, whom he had started to think would not be coming, Drayden and Kade began their duel, during which Drayden showed extreme aggression. Kade warned his Adept that the fighting style was antithetical to the Aetheri mission to protect life, but Drayden, certain his aggression would win him the duel, rebutted by claiming mercy was no way to defeat an enemy. He continued his aggressive strikes until Kade was backed into a corner, where he locked blades with his master and demanded he admit defeat. Instead, Kade slipped away when Drayden raised his blade and inadvertently created an opening. The duel carried on as Drayden again continued to beat Kade back until he knocked his master's flux blade away, which Drayden took as a sign that the duel was over.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Ten years after the Battle of Ondara in 22 BVE , as the Dissident Crisis threatened to tear the Vantor Republic apart, the 19 year old Drayden and Kade were involved in an important mission to settle a border dispute on Ansion . Upon their return to Vantor, an assassination attempt on Lira Ondar, now Senator of Ondara, prompted the Aetheri Council—at the behest of Chancellor Mal—to send Drayden and Kade to protect Ondar from future attacks. Kael was delighted to see her after so many years; he had thought about her every day since they parted. In at least her first year in the Senate, Ondar had at times thought about the boy she had met on Dunemere, such as when she passed the Aetheri Sanctum. She also dispatched Sable to free slaves on Dunemere with the particular mission to free Shira, feeling as though she had made an unofficial promise to set her free, but Sable was unable to locate Drayden's mother. When Lira said she wanted to know who wanted her dead, and Orien started to explain that they were only there to protect her life, not to investigate, Kael promised Lira to find who was responsible,

title: Kael Drayden
text: unofficial promise to set her free, but Sable was unable to locate Drayden's mother. When Lira said she wanted to know who wanted her dead, and Orien started to explain that they were only there to protect her life, not to investigate, Kael promised Lira to find who was responsible, annoying Orien. When Lira retreated to her chambers, Kael was disappointed, claiming that Lira hardly even recognized him. However, Greeb, who was a representative in the Senate during this time, said Lira was very happy to see him too. During that night, Kael and Lira agreed on a plan of using her as bait, in order to capture the assassin, much to Orien's dismay. Kael told him that although Lira had covered the cameras in her bedchamber, he was certain he would sense if anything were to happen in the room. Kade had doubts about his Adept's power. Shortly after, when his master noticed that Drayden was tired, he admitted that he had constant nightmares about his mother; he also revealed his powerful affection for Ondar. Orien warned him to control his emotions, saying that Lira was a politician after all, and could not be trusted. This led the two into a debate about whether every politician, including Ondar and Mal, was corrupt. As Drayden expressed his faith in Mal's benevolence, he sensed something in Lira's room. He arrived just in time to cut two venomous kouhuns in half, just a few centimeters from the senator's face. Orien noticed the assassin's droid at the window and threw himself out, grabbing it.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Kael rushed to a row of speeders parked near Lira's apartment. When the bounty hunter Zam Wesell shot her droid down, Drayden arrived upon the scene as his Master was in free fall. Catching Kade, the Adept continued the pursuit of Wesell's airspeeder . Spotting the Aetheri, Wesell took her speeder on a nosedive—plunging several meters toward the lower levels of Vantor. With the Aetheri relentlessly pursuing her, Wesell flew through the exhaust flames of the Kerdos Company recycling plant , hoping that the flames would scorch her adversaries in the open-top speeder. Seeing the pair still chasing her and unharmed by the flames, Wesell fired at the couplings of a nearby electrical plant, causing the Aetheri's speeder to be inundated by electrical shock.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Drayden, an expert pilot himself, quickly caught up to Wesell. The bounty hunter steered her craft into a network of skytunnels, aiming once again to lose the pursuing Aetheri. Drayden did not chase directly into the tunnel but opted to travel an alternate route. Wesell wove through the local network of tunnels. Kael and Orien thought they lost her, but just a few minutes later Kael noticed the bounty hunter's airspeeder below, and jumped out, let his body drop the intervening distance through the air, then latched a firm hand-grip to its rear canopy handle. He ultimately was forced to let go when she shot at him, although not before getting a good look at her, wherein he deduced that Zam was not only a female but also a changeling (he'd briefly glimpsed Wesell's true form when she looked up). The Aetheri ignited his flux blade and sliced at the windscreen, knocking out the guidance systems. Wesell shot the flux blade out of Drayden's hand, but the ensuing struggle caused Wesell to misfire her volt pistol pistol, damaging the control pipes. Meanwhile, Kade, who was behind Wesell at this point, caught Drayden's flux blade. The airspeeder began to plummet toward

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Drayden and Kade took the wounded bounty hunter and dragged her from the club, setting her in an alley behind the club for interrogation. Wesell was initially reluctant to give any information about who had hired her, replying that it had simply been a job. As Drayden pressed her, however, Wesell prepared to divulge the information. Suddenly, a mysterious figure fired a toxic dart into Zam's neck.

#### Return to Dunemere

> " Ani? Is it you? Ani? " " I'm here, Mom, you're safe. " ―Shira Drayden and Kael Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Subsequently, the Council sent the Master and Adept on separate missions—Drayden, on his first solo mission, would protect Ondar on Ondara, whereas Kade continued an investigation into Ondar's aggressors that took him to Gelvaris . Joined by Bolt-3, Drayden and Ondar departed for Ondara aboard the Jendirian Valley , a refugee ship leaving from the western spaceport . On Ondara, the two visited Ondar's family home, and Drayden noticed how much she loved the flower garden maintained by her father, Ruwee Ondar .

title: Kael Drayden
text: While on Ondara, as he experienced inner conflict between his strong desires for her and his duties as an Aetheri, Drayden revealed to Ondar his love for her, but she refused since Drayden was not supposed to form attachments as an Aetheri, even though she felt the same for him. Drayden was also troubled by dreams of his mother suffering, which prompted him to return to Dunemere and rescue her, to which Ondar agreed to accompany him. On Dunemere, the two located Waddu, who revealed that he had sold Shira to a moisture farmer named Cliegg Havel . The couple then visited the Havel farm only to discover that Shira had been abducted by Dunefolk Raiders about a month before their arrival, and was feared to be dead. Determined to save her at all costs, Drayden took the swoop bike of his stepbrother, Owen Havel , and searched for his mother.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### First Battle of Pyralis

> " You call this a diplomatic solution? " " No, I call it aggressive negotiations. " ―Kael Drayden and Lira Ondar — Link ▶️ ( file info )

It was then that Drayden received a message from Kade telling him of Dissident presence on Pyralis , which they retransmitted to Vantor so that the Aetheri Council could see it for themselves. Upon learning he had been captured, Drayden and Ondar departed for the planet, where they entered one of the factories (where his flux blade was destroyed) but were subsequently captured and placed with Kade into the Petranaki Arena to be executed by beasts. However, the trio managed to avoid the creatures (in Drayden's case, a reek ), only to be surrounded by droidekas on Count Varek 's orders. However, an Aetheri assault team , led by Drevan Koss, revealed itself around the arena, having arrived to rescue them. While the team had initially believed they would only find Kade in custody, they adapted their plan to rescue Drayden and Ondar as well, although the presence of both came as a surprise to many involved Aetheri in at least one detachment.

title: Kael Drayden
text: The Aetheri had gotten into position while the three had fought against the arena beasts and revealed themselves on Koss's signal, only for Varek to unleash hordes of battle droids against the Aetheri. Kael was given a green-bladed flux blade lent to him by another Aetheri named Nicanas Tassu . They fought a losing battle against an overwhelming amount of battle droids , including droidekas, B1-series battle droids , and B2-series super battle droids , until Master Zho arrived with the newly established Grand Army of the Republic and safely boarded the survivors of the arena onto LAAT/i gunships . As the battle raged between the replica troopers and the Dissident Droid Army , they caught sight of Varek. When Ondar and a replica trooper were knocked from the troop bay onto the E'Y-Akh Desert by a cannon blast, Drayden argued with Kade about going after her. After he proclaimed he did not care if he would be expelled from the Aetheri Order if it meant saving her, Drayden only agreed to continue when Kade reminded him Ondar would continued on her duties if she had been in a similar crisis. Drayden then looked back at where she had fallen

title: Kael Drayden
text:
he did not care if he would be expelled from the Aetheri Order if it meant saving her, Drayden only agreed to continue when Kade reminded him Ondar would continued on her duties if she had been in a similar crisis. Drayden then looked back at where she had fallen as they continued to race after Varek. Kade and Drayden pursued the Count to a secret hangar , where they engaged him in a duel . Both were defeated, and though Kade suffered minor wounds, Drayden lost his right forearm. It was then that Zho arrived and fought Varek until the Umbra Lord made his escape on his solar sailer . The battle marked the start of the pan-galactic Replica Wars , and Drayden received a cybernetic replacement for his lost arm.

#### Marriage to Lira Ondar

While Kade returned to Vantor, Drayden accompanied Ondar to Ondara, where they were secretly married , their sole attendants being their faithful droids Bolt-3 and Astra-9. As he still needed to recover from the Battle of Pyralis, Drayden was able to remain on Ondara for several days, enjoying his honeymoon and time after it with Ondar.

### The Replica Wars begin

#### Serving as an Aetheri Commander

title: Kael Drayden
text:
### The Replica Wars begin

#### Serving as an Aetheri Commander

> " I was afraid, before I left Gelvaris. We don't really know what happens to unusual replicas. But my brothers never let me doubt. I wasn't sure if the Aetheri would understand. " " The Aetheri are all about transcending things. I don't think we can complain if you've transcended gender. " " Transcended gender. We'll work on it, but I like where it's heading. " ―Sister and Kael Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Following the engagement on Pyralis, Drayden built a new flux blade to replace the one he lost. Early in the war, Drayden quickly came to have encounters with Varek's personal agents. Later, Drayden served with his Aetheri Master as an informal Aetheri Commander , participating in battles on a rocky planet alongside Kade's 7th Sky Corps and Replica Marshal Commander Cord . Afterwards, Drayden encountered the replica trooper known as Sister , who was arranging the helmets of her fallen brothers beneath a tree as a memorial.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Drayden spoke with Sister, and she explained that she was saddened by her brothers' deaths , as well as the origins of her name and the camaraderie her replica brothers had shown for her and her gender identity. Drayden shared that the Aetheri supported such identity and the belief of rising above things, such as Sister's transcendence of the concepts of gender. Sister agreed, and both moved to rendezvous with Kade at his location. A short time later, Drayden was promoted to the rank of Aetheri Knight. This was initially done informally as a result of the increased need for Aetheri in the battlefield. Though the Aetheri were not yet formally integrated within the Grand Army of the Republic, his appointment to Knighthood made Drayden an acting Aetheri General .

#### Business on Cato Geltaria

> " You don't always have to be the sun-dragon. " ―Mill Alibeth to Kael Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Kael Drayden
text: Drayden's knighthood was soon legitimized by a Knighting Ceremony . While Drayden himself had already known that he was a Knight, the public announcement of his knighting caused a ripple of surprise to wash over the gathered crowd. Fellow Adept-turned-Knight Iskat Vekkis rationalized to herself that he had proven himself at the Battle of Pyralis and that, if she was ready to be a Knight, so was Drayden. Drayden spent the night after his Knighting Ceremony with Ondar in which he presented her with an Adept braid pendant he had made for her after his Adept braid was cut. Shortly after his knighting ceremony, the Purse World of Cato Geltaria , the headquarters of the Commerce Combine, was rocked by a destructive explosion that was blamed on the Republic. Kade, now an Aetheri Master and an acting Council member, was selected to travel to Cato Geltaria to investigate the explosion. Wanting to clear any Dissident involvement, Varek sent his own agent to Cato Geltaria as well, which was later revealed to be the Dark Adept Kessa Vray .

title: Kael Drayden
text: Shortly after arriving on Cato Geltaria, Drayden and Alibeth found a series of bombs planted in important Geltari landmarks which they later discovered were planted by Ketar Nor to send a message to the Republic. They came to find that Kade was on trial for conspiracy against Cato Geltaria after Vray found the data that incriminated the Republic. Drayden rescued Kade moments before rifles from Geltari guards fired on him. With the help of Ruug Quarnom and Ondar, the Republic was cleared of any involvement in the bombing. Instead, revealing that an outside actor orchestrated the bombing to point to the Republic and Dissidents in order to play on the fear of both sides of the new war.

title: Kael Drayden
text: When they returned to Vantor, Mal passed the Aetheri Military Integration Act , officially making the Aetheri a part of the Grand Army of the Republic and marking the beginnings of General Drayden and General Kade. Drayden also told Alibeth of a myth from his childhood about the sun-dragon of Dunemere in order to steady her emotions. Becoming apprenticed to Rig Nema to avoid the war and instead provide special medical and spiritual assistance, Alibeth bid farewell to Drayden and Kade, thanking the former for his guidance and letting him know he did not always have to act like the story's sun-dragon, leaving Drayden speechless as he considered her words.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
The time surrounding the Cato Geltaria affair taught Drayden and Kade to become brothers-in-arms, instead of master and apprentice. The mission was also one of several Drayden counted as the times he saved Kade's life, but Kade, however, insisted that "the business on Cato Geltaria" did not count towards the tally. Drayden also believed the operation was the first time he encountered Vray, but he recognized her Ginivex -class fanblade starfighter and she already knew his name. Drayden and Kade also launched a rescue of Ruug Quarnom as she was hunted by battle droids.

#### Rescue at Staggec

> " Good to see you alive. " " Did you have doubts? " " Just for a moment. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Rescue at Staggec

> " Good to see you alive. " " Did you have doubts? " " Just for a moment. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

With the passage of the Military Integration Act, Drayden and Kade, like all Aetheri, were offered body armor, but neither immediately adopted that gear as part of their day-to-day attire. When Senators Ondar and Yarua were ambushed by General Skarn on the Moon of Staggec , Kade volunteered himself and Drayden for the mission . Shortly after they arrived on the moon, Drayden followed a trail of footprints into a nearby forest. There, he and Kade discovered Yarua's daughter, Viiveenn , who gave Drayden a flower and led the Aetheri to the ship where her father had been taken. When Viiveenn headed for the ship, Kade ran after her, causing him to be captured by the surrounding battle droids. Drayden attacked the battle droids and tried to stop Kade and Viiveenn from being captured, but he was too late.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
As the ship left, Drayden lamented not leaving any droids intact for interrogation. Calming his mind, he meditated to think of a solution. Drayden then used the Republic shuttle they'd arrived in to sneak onto the Providence -class Dreadnought Skarn was commanding. Alongside Kade, Drayden cut down the remaining droids and ran off to find Ondar while Kade went to confront Skarn. By the time he reached her however, he found that the senator had already rescued herself and her associates. Drayden then returned with the group to the Republic shuttle. Kade arrived shortly after with Viiveenn, informing the group that Yarua had died saving his daughter. After leaving the ship and escaping into hyperspace, Kade reported to Zho while Drayden checked on Ondar, who comforted Viiveenn over her loss.

#### Lesson on Ondara

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Lesson on Ondara

While on Ondara with Kade, Drayden noticed and hastily attacked Vray, who was amongst the crowd. As she ran Kade told him to wait, but Drayden ignored his master and ran after anyways. When Drayden lost Vray, Kade caught up with him and told him a lesson about patience and trusting others. Listening in, Vray heard Kade tell Drayden that he cares about him staying alive. Vray initially saw this as a sign of weakness, but would go onto intentionally fail her mission because she realized Varek did not care for her like Kade did for Drayden.

#### General of the 501st

> " You fought in the Replica Wars? " " Yes. I was once an Aetheri Knight, the same as your father. […] He was the best star pilot in the galaxy and a cunning warrior. […] And he was a good friend. " ―Joren Drayden and Orien Kade, on Kael Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Kael Drayden
text:
The 501st Legion was under Drayden's command during the war effort, with his "first-in-command" often being Replica Captain CT-7567 , who was also known by his nickname "Vek." At some point before he received a scar over his right eye, Drayden participated in the Battle of Arantara with his troops. During the battle, Vek was wounded and rendered unconscious. After being found by Drayden, Vek was surprised to see that he had come back for him. Drayden responded that it should have been him in his place, telling his captain that a true leader always led from the front.

After that, Drayden and Vek soon developed a mutual respect and even became friends. While at first Vek needed to adapt to his maverick Aetheri General because of the Replica Captain's by-the-book and no-nonsense nature, Vek would come to admire, and even would sometimes emulate, Drayden's willingness to bend the rules and genius for improvisation, and Drayden and Vek would even become friends. Some time after the Battle of Arantara , Drayden received a scar over his right eye, believed to have been created by Kessa Vray in battle.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
With that, Kade informed the replicas that they would need to hold that position while the three went after Varek and Vray. With that, the three Aetheri left to confront Varek and Vray. Meanwhile, Vek told a story about him and Drayden during a mission on Benglor . Eventually, the three managed to find Varek, leading Drayden to enter a duel with him while Vayne contacted trooper Boost requesting immediate aid. As Drayden and his fellow Aetheri chased Varek and Vray, they received a distress call from Vek, leading to the Aetheri breaking off their pursuit to help their soldiers. Upon rescuing their replicas, it was clear the day had been won for the Republic because the soldiers had rescued the Hisseenian parliament from Varek's droids. Drayden and his allies then departed Hisseen to return to Vantor.

#### Battles at Corvair sector and Kudo III

> " …Let's finish this. " ―Kael Drayden

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Battle of Krestophis

> " You're reckless, little one. You never would have made it as Orien's Adept… but you might make it as mine. " ―Kael Drayden to Sela Marr, following the Battle of Krestophis — Link ▶️ ( file info )

A few months into the war, Drayden and his former master, Kade, were tasked by the Aetheri Council to break the Dissident blockade on Krestophis , and assist Cindervalean Senator Bael Solen on his relief effort on the planet's surface. Initially overwhelmed, Kade presented Drayden with a Republic stealth ship prototype with a cloaking device and tasked him with flying it past the blockade, in order to deliver supplies to Solen. Accompanied by Yular, Drayden chose instead to engage Dissident Admiral Trench directly and divert his attention from Solen on the surface.

title: Kael Drayden
text: De-cloaking his stealth ship, Drayden launched torpedoes at the dreadnought Invincible , but his missiles were repelled by the ship's powerful thermal shields . After successfully evading Trench's return fire, Trench sent a message over an open frequency, warning that he had faced this kind of ship before and that they should retreat before they were destroyed. Using the information supplied by Kade, Drayden surmised that Trench would lock onto the ship's magnetic signature to destroy it and so, Drayden de-cloaked once more, firing another volley of missiles at Trench's dreadnought. Trench took the bait and locked onto the stealth ship's magnetic signature, firing several tracking torpedoes . Drayden steered the ship straight at the Invincible , scraping right past its hull before Trench's missiles struck the bridge .
