As Vark expressed disbelief over this, he was interrupted by the arrival of the Twins themselves, under the protection of Black Zazzik. When the Graks declared their ownership of Port Vail, Vark asserted his position as the Daimyo of Port Vail. Neither party acquiesced to the other's demands and Vark told the siblings they would have to kill him for his territory. The Twins reluctantly conceded for the time being, though the brother warned Vark to sleep lightly. Once they left, Vark told Fennec that they would likely have to kill the Graks, to which Fennec said they would need permission to do so. Vark then return to his palace to heal some more in the bacta pod.

title: Vex Vark
text: After learning about Port Vail's three ruling families from 8D8, Vark was met by local water-monger Lortha Peel , who informed Vark that the Mods , a gang of cyborg bikers were stealing his inventory. Peel promised to double his tribute to Vark if he dealt with the bikers. In turn, Vark and Thanna left with their Gamorrean guards to meet with the Mods personally. They quickly found the gang at a street corner and confronted them over stealing Peel's water. When one of the bikers, Drash , claimed that they had to steal due to there being no work, Vark offered to hire them himself for security. Peel angrily told Vark that they still owed him thirteen hundred credits, to which Vark gave him five hundred and told him he would have to accept it. The Mods then took Vark's offer and followed him back to his palace on their bikes.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark then returned to his bacta tank and continued to heal. However, he was interrupted by Zazzik, who pulled Vark from the tank and attempted to kill him. After a brief struggle with Vark, Krrsatan was confronted by the Mods. They fought the Vorak out of Vark's chamber and into the palace throne room. While Zazzik fought off the bikers and the Gamorreans, Thanna opened the trap door beneath his feet and threw a knife at his hand as he held onto the edge, causing him to fall and trapping him in the Rancor Pit. Vark then told the bikers to get one of the Gamorreans to the bacta tank as Zazzik roared in anger. Afterwards, Vark and Thanna sat down to eat while they discussed sending a message to his enemies. They were then informed by 8D8 that the Twins had arrived to speak with him personally.

title: Vex Vark
text: Meeting Vark by the palace entrance, the Twins admitted they had made a mistake in sending Zazzik to kill him, apologizing and offering him a rancor calf as an apologetic retribution. They also announced their departure from Dunemere, as they had learned that Grukk's former holdings had already been promised to another crime syndicate by the Mayor and they had no interest in starting a war over a "worthless rock". Vark offered the shackled Zazzik back to the Twins, to which they allowed Vark to keep the Vorak, as tribute, before leaving the palace. Vark then released Zazzik and advised him not to take anymore jobs from the Graks before the Vorak ran off into the desert.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Bringing the rancor to the Pit, Vark was told by its keeper that it would imprint on the first human it saw. Vark removed the rancor's blinders and formed an immediate bond with the calf. However, he was interrupted by 8D8, who informed him that the Mayor was still unavailable. This did not deter Vark though, as he, Thanna and the Mods returned to Port Vail to confront the Mayor's majordomo. But this time, the majordomo fled in a landspeeder, leading the Mods to give chase. After pursued and damaged his speeder through the streets of Port Vail, the majordomo crashed into a meiloorun stand and was confronted by Vark, to whom he finally confessed that the Mayor was working for the Gruv Syndicate.

#### Preparing for War

> " As I'm sure you all know, the Gruv Syndicate are mustering troops in Port Vail. They have slowly absorbed our planet as part of their spice trade. They have bribed the Mayor and are draining Dunemere of its wealth. " ―Vex Vark, to the three ruling families of Port Vail

title: Vex Vark
text: Soon after, Vark and Thanna were informed by Skad that at least a dozen Pykes had arrived in Port Vail. Vark told him to keep an eye on them before Thanna ended the transmission. Thanna pointed out that this was only the first wave and that the Pykes were going to war, to which Vark said that they would be ready. After one final healing session, Vark was informed by Thanna that the majordomo was confessing, but the Mayor remained missing. As such, the Mods began combing the streets of Port Vail in search of him. Despite this, Vark still insisted on going to Port Vail himself to make his presence known and showing off his power. He then returned to the Sanctuary and witnessed Fwip try and fail to talk down Zazzik from ripping a Trandoshan's arm off. Following this, Vark greeted the Vorak on the street and told him that he looked like he could use a job, to which Zazzik obliged.

title: Vex Vark
text: Upon returning to his palace, Vark hosted a dinner for the heads of Port Vail's three ruling families. Vark explained that he was there to make a proposal in light of the Gruv Syndicate vying for control of Dunemere. When the head of the Klatooinian family threatened to simply kill Vark and take what he wanted, he and the rest of the attendants were frightened by the rancor calf directly beneath them. After giving the rancor a scrap of food, Vark asked his guests to remain seated while he made his proposal. He proposed forming a defensive alliance with the families until the Gruv Syndicate was vanquished. The Klatooinian then pointed out that the Pykes were only after Vark's territory and asked why the families should spill their blood for Vark's feud with them. To this, Vark claimed that he would fight off the Pykes himself and that he only asked for the families to remain neutral if the Pykes approached them to betray him. The families then agreed to Vark's proposal before taking their leave. As Vark and Thanna watched the families depart, Thanna asked Vark if he trusted them, to which Vark answered that he trusted them to

title: Vex Vark
text:
asked for the families to remain neutral if the Pykes approached them to betray him. The families then agreed to Vark's proposal before taking their leave. As Vark and Thanna watched the families depart, Thanna asked Vark if he trusted them, to which Vark answered that he trusted them to work in their own self-interest. When Thanna asked him how much treasure they had in reserve, Vark assured her that he had plenty of credits, though he was short on muscle. Thanna replied that credits could buy muscle if one knew where to look. Thanna travelled to Peli Motto 's hangar to recruit Dinna Verrick. Verrick accepted the offer, but asked to travel to Joren Drayden's Aetheri Sanctum to see Pip first. Meanwhile in his palace, Vark had arranged a meeting with members of his criminal imperium, figuring out the best course of action to defeat the Gruv Syndicate. When Vark was unsure where to find foot soldiers, Verrick travelled to Freetown to recruit Cobb Vanth and his people. Vanth considered the offer, valuing the freedom of his town. Meanwhile, the Gruv Syndicate sent two enforcers to plant a bomb in the sanctuary in order to send a message. They successfully accomplished this, killing Garsa Fwip and many other patrons. After this, Vark realized that the war had begun. [ source? ]

#### War for Port Vail

Ruins of the Sanctuary

> " We are at war. " " It was inevitable. " " Even if we win, there might not be anything left of this city. " ―Vex Vark, and Fennec Thanna

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark and his allies travelled to investigate the bombed-out remains of the Sanctuary. Vark finally realized that they were at war, to which Thanna replied that it was inevitable. Vark expressed his concerns that nothing would be left of Port Vail even if they win. The pair were soon joined by Dinna Verrick, Drash, and Skad. Verrick informed the group that he spoke to Marshal Cobb Vanth of Freetown, who was raising a garrison to assist in the fight against the Gruv Syndicate in exchange for the elimination of the spice trade. Thanna protested that Vanth's demand was not free since spice was a large part of the late Grukk's business. Verrick replied that is what the town wanted. Despite Thanna's protest that they can make a lot of money from spice, Vark agreed to these terms, believing that Port Vail could become a prosperous city under their protection and said that spice was killing their people. Vark told Verrick to convey that Freetown was under his protection. Vark suggested that he tell Cobb Vanth himself when he comes with reinforcements.

title: Vex Vark
text:
When Vark asked if Vanth would come, Verrick vouched for him. Since they were outnumbered, Vark stressed that without Vanth's reinforcements they were doomed and said that they needed to buy time. Vark initially proposed waiting for reinforcements within the palace. However, Skad thought that this is a bad idea and proposed waiting for reinforcements in Port Vail. Vark initially dismissed the idea of taking position in Port Vail. However, Drash insisted that they stay because the people of Port Vail need their protection. Vark ultimately decided to stay in Port Vail.

Unexpected reunion

> " I thought I smelled something. If you're looking for a job, you're late. " " I've already got a job. I'm here to negotiate on behalf of the Gruv Syndicate. " " I don't negotiate with gutless murderers. " " If that's not the Quacta calling the Stifling slimy. " ―Vex Vark and Cad Vorek

title: Vex Vark
text: In the ruins of the Sanctuary, Thanna briefed Vark and Verrick about her plan to send their people to patrol Port Vail to keep an eye on the Syndicate's next move and avoid surprises. Thanna believed that the truce that Vark negotiated with the Port Vail crime families will ensure that they remain neutral and allow them to gain the upper hand over the arriving soldiers. Thanna explained that she had deployed the two Gamorrean guards at the Klatooinian territory in star port, Zazzik in front of city hall within the Trandoshan territory, and the Mods in the Worker's District and the Aquari Quarter. Thanna believed that their flanks were covered and that the arrival of the Freetown forces would give them the forces required to pivot their strength to whatever region the Pykes chose to attack.

title: Vex Vark
text: Despite their measures, 8D8 reported that someone had arrived to meet with Vark. Vark was surprised that someone had managed to sneak up on their position. They took up position as Vark left to meet with the visitor, Cad Vorek, Vark's old mentor who he had not seen for decades. Vark remarked that he thought he had smelled something, before telling Vorek that if he was looking for a job, he was too late. Vorek replied that he was working for the Gruv Syndicate, who had sent him to negotiate on their behalf. Vark refused to negotiate with Vorek, whom he regarded as a "gutless murderer". Vorek accused Vark of hypocrisy, stating "if that's not the Quacta calling the Stifling slimy." Vark told Vorek to clear out and inform the Pykes that they were outnumbered. Vorek responded that he had met with Marshal Vanth, adding that Vark should have never left him without his armor. As Thanna and Verrick took up position, Vorek warned them that he also had backshooters. Two Pykes emerged on a balcony. Vorek told Vark to let the spice flow through Port Vail to avoid trouble.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vark rejected Vorek's terms and responded that he would only negotiate directly with the Syndicate's head. Vorek revealed it was the Syndicate who murdered his Dunefolk tribe. This nearly goaded Vark into the first shot, but ultimately he was convinced by Thanna to stand down and begin the battle on their own terms. Vark wanted to fight Vorek but listened to Thanna's reasoning. Vark told Vorek to tell his client that negotiations were terminated. Before leaving, Vorek claimed that Vark had gone soft with age. Vark responded that everyone does.

Standing with Verrick

> " I suppose you'll be heading out. " " I'm not. " " You should. " " It's against the Creed. I gave you my word. I'm with you until we both fall. " ―Vex Vark, and Dinna Verrick

title: Vex Vark
text: Shortly later, Drash called Vark on the comms and reports that the locals had turned on them despite the treaty previously established. The Aquari family ambushed the Mods, cornering them in an alley. Vark attempted to touch base with Zazzik, who had been attacked by the Trandoshan family in the city center. The Gamorreans then tried to contact Vark, but were soon pushed off a cliff by the members of the Klatoonian family. With few options remaining, Vark confirmed with Shaiz' majordomo the location of the Syndicate's base in Port Kess—the Desert Survey Office —and sent Thanna to confront the Gruv Syndicate's enforcer. The Syndicate forces began to move into position around the Sanctuary. Vark offered Verrick the opportunity to leave, though Verrick refused to abandon his friend despite the odds. Verrick stated that they had two choices. The first option was to wait until they got into position, before launching a siege on their terms. The second option was to rush out and escape on the ship in Vex's palace. Vark refused to abandon Port Vail since the people were counting on him. Verrick decided that they would fight together and both die in the name of honor. When

title: Vex Vark
text: launching a siege on their terms. The second option was to rush out and escape on the ship in Vex's palace. Vark refused to abandon Port Vail since the people were counting on him. Verrick decided that they would fight together and both die in the name of honor. When Vark asked if he were sure he wanted to stay, Verrick replied that it was the way. The Velari majordomo volunteered to go out and try to speak to the Pykes and negotiate their freedom and surrender on Vark's behalf. Vark appeared to agree and wrote out his terms on the majordomo's pad. The majordomo emerged before the Gruv soldiers gathered in front of the Sanctuary and began to read out the "terms of surrender" Vark wrote out to the Gruv commander: "You will leave this planet and your spice trade. If you refuse these terms, the arid sands of Dunemere will once again flourish with flowered fields fertilized with the bodies of your dead." As the Gruv commander lifted his volt pistol , the majordomo reminded him that those were Vark's words. Vark and Verrick soared in on their jetpacks and began to gun the Syndicate soldiers down, standing together as friends, as brothers. With the advantage afforded by their Ferrik armor , weapons and surprise strike, Vark and Verrick took down many soldiers of the Syndicate on their own. Verrick also deployed his whistling birds , taking down several Pykes. However, the numbers proved to be too much even for them and numerous volt pistol shots slowly began to take them down.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Unexpected reinforcements soon arrived in the form of the people from Freetown in a large armored speeder. The surviving members of the Mods arrived and together they managed to drive the Pykes back. Drash and Skad took up position with Vark, Verrick and the people of Freetown. When a Freetowner remarked that they were here to save the tails of cityfolk, Vark told her to save it for the Pykes. They were soon joined by an injured Zazzik, who subdued several Pykes even in his weakened state. Vark helped him to safety while Verrick provided covering fire. Vark was pleased to see Zazzik and promised him a nice long soak in the bacta tank following the battle. Taanti told the defenders that the Pykes were falling back. The fighters began cheering but Verrick detected two approaching Scorpenek annihilator droids through his helmet's scanner. He warned them not to celebrate yet because they had "real problems".

Turning the tide

> " Do it. " ―Vex Vark, ordering his rancor to execute a Scorpnek droid

title: Vex Vark
text:
Turning the tide

> " Do it. " ―Vex Vark, ordering his rancor to execute a Scorpnek droid

The two Scorpenek droids advanced on Vark's forces line, unable to be stopped by volt pistols and even Vark's missiles due to their powerful deflector shields . The armored vehicle they'd been using for cover was soon destroyed, forcing them to flee. Vark and Verrick attempted to take the Scorpeneks on, to little avail due to their powerful shield generators. Even the Darksaber was incapable of piercing through their shields. Vark and Verrick discussed their options, ruling out both energy and kinetic weapons due to the large collateral effect on Port Vail. With instructions for Verrick to protect the others, Vark left for further reinforcements.

title: Vex Vark
text:
As carnage continued to ensue in the city, Vark soon arrived back on his rancor to rescue the others. The rancor slammed the Scorpenek droid into a building, which crumbled under the weight of the war machine. The rancor converged on the ruins of the building. The Scorpenek droid emerged with its shields deactivated, before the rancor once again pummeled the weakened droid, which put up a fierce fight and inflicted several scratches on the rancor. Vark helped by firing at the Scorpenek. The second Scorpenek fired a volley of laser bolts at the rancor. However, the rancor's tough hide absorbed most of the blasts and it resumed the fight. As the Mods and Freetown garrison watched, the rancor ripped one of the gun turret arms off the Scorpenek. After piercing through its red central processing sensor, the rancor ripped the droid apart by pulling off its limbs.

Stand-off with Vorek

> " You gave it a shot. You tried to go straight. But you've got your father's blood pumping through your veins. You're a killer. " ―Cad Vorek, to Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
Stand-off with Vorek

> " You gave it a shot. You tried to go straight. But you've got your father's blood pumping through your veins. You're a killer. " ―Cad Vorek, to Vex Vark

While destroying the second Scorpenek, the rancor fought several Pykes. Vark killed one while the rancor took care of the second Gruv, swallowing it whole. Vorek arrived and scared the rancor with fire from his vambraces, causing it to throw Vark and flee into the streets of Port Vail. The two warriors squared off. Vark told Vorek to clear out and to take his "hoodlum gang" with him. Vorek admitted that he did not understand Vark's motivations, and asked what his angle was. Vark stated that he would not abandon the city and his people. Vorek tried to goad Vark by mentioning the Tuskens, to which Vark told Vorek that he would not let him toy with him since he is no longer a young boy. Vorek pointed out that despite his age, he was still faster. Vark stood his ground however, before Vorek initiated a duel, shooting the Daimyo.

title: Vex Vark
text:
With swift shots, Vorek took Vark down and pinned him to the ground, and called him a killer just like his father was. Vorek taunted Vark that this is not the first time he had beaten him on a job. He ripped Vark's helmet off and prepared to kill Vark, and told him that this was his final lesson and that anything else was weakness. Before Vorek can shoot, Vark knocked him away with his gaderffii stick. The tides now turned, Vark defeated Vorek, knocking him to the ground. Vorek stated that he always knew Vark was a killer, before activating his flamethrower against him. Vark knocked the weapon out the away, and stabbed Vorek through the chest. Taking in what Vorek had said, Vark understood that his journey was not yet complete, whilst staring down at the body of his old mentor. Leaving the Kessith mercenary dead on the street, Vark walked away to assist his allies.

A town at peace

> " Why must everyone bow at me? " " It's better than shooting. " " Are those my only two choices? " " When you run the town, it is. " ―Vex Vark, and Fennec Thanna

title: Vex Vark
text:
A town at peace

> " Why must everyone bow at me? " " It's better than shooting. " " Are those my only two choices? " " When you run the town, it is. " ―Vex Vark, and Fennec Thanna

Unbeknownst to Vark however, the war had finished. Vark soon caught up with Thanna and Verrick, before thanking Verrick's for his services. Vark and Thanna then walked the streets, which the townsfolk were working together to clear and rebuild. Many stopped to bow and greet him, all of which he returned. Vark lamented having to move his right arm, but stated his bacta tank was in use when Thanna told him to take a soak. When Vark grumbled about people bowing to him, Thanna pointed out that he should be glad they bow to him, rather than shooting at him. A group of children then offered them Meiloorun fruits , one of which Vark accepts. Zazzik, the Mods and the LEP-series rat catcher meet up with the duo in the street.

#### Missions on Batuu

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Missions on Batuu

Sometime after the victory at Port Vail, Vark and Thanna traveled to Black Spire Outpost on Batuu on a mission, looking for hidden Gruv Syndicate members and recruiting to the Vark gotra. Vark was reunited with Verrick and Pip, as they walked through the streets together and interacted with the locals. At another point, when Verrick returned to Port Kess to ask Peli Motto for an IG-series memory circuit , Motto asked if Verrick had come to depose Vark on behalf of the Grak Clan .

### Legacy

Vark was remembered as one of the best bounty hunters in the galaxy, with a reputation and legacy that eclipsed even his father's.

Following the Battle of Saltmark in 34 AVE , Hondik Hosha mentioned Vark in his book titled the Galactic Explorer's Guide , including him in the "Renegade's Gallery" section for Mistral. He also included a poster of Vark and information on Reaver One in the planet's section as well, mentioning that the ship had been owned by Garrick, Vossk, himself, and then Vex. During the New Imperium-Coalition War , Dok-Ondar told a shock trooper sergeant and his troops about how he came to buy Reth-Oss-Van 's flux blade, events that briefly involved Vark. During the same war, Nyla lied to bounty hunter Kief Varris that Vark, along with other bounty hunters had attempted to capture Moebin Faltus at one point.

title: Vex Vark
text:
### The young bounty hunter

> " No one of true importance would lower themselves to trade with a mere boy. " " Boy? You have no idea who you're talking to. I have been in charge of this whole operation— " "You have no idea who you are talking to. " ―Kessa Vray and Vex Vark As a child, Vex developed a strong bond with his father, learning much from Garrick's years as a bounty hunter. Vex was suspicious of Orien Kade upon the Aetheri Knight's arrival on Gelvaris, recognizing him as a potential threat to both himself and Garrick. He took pleasure in fighting Kade both on Gelvaris and in orbit of Pyralis, expressing joy at the thought that the Aetheri had been killed. His personality hardened after Garrick's death, as a traumatized Vex swore vengeance on Drevan Koss, yet he did not take any pleasure in the collateral damage wrought by his mission. His better nature eventually won over in honor of his father's memory, as Vex turned against his bounty hunting allies and allowed himself to be taken into the custody of the Vantor Republic. Despite realizing the errors of his ways, he swore he would never forgive Koss for the murder of his father.

title: Vex Vark
text:
During the Replica Wars, Vex expressed aversion to being compared to replica troopers. He did not want to see himself as being the same as other young replicas or a replica in general, as he saw himself as Garrick Vark's son. He nonetheless did not care to harm the replicas, and briefly considered leaving his bounty hunter companions to stay with the other young replicas who escaped the Endurance .

After being released from prison and forming a bounty hunter team, Vark became somewhat more ruthless than he had been previously, focused on achieving the goals of his mission. During the mission to Quarzite, Vark wanted to hand Pluma Sodi over to Otua Blank, despite her pleas for mercy. Only Vray's betrayal allowed Sodi to escape.

As a child, Vark stood at 1.35 meters , or 4 feet , 5 inches tall.

### Adult life

#### Imperial Era

> " You can't leave me out here, Vex. I'm cold-blooded. I won't sssurvive. " " Cold-blooded. Huh. Funny thing about that, Boskan. So am I. " ―Boskan and Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text: As the years went by and the Replica Wars gave way to the reign of the Imperium, Vark became known for his lethality and extreme methods, even displaying trophies of his prey on his armor. During the Imperial Era, the confident bounty hunter had a penchant for disintegrations and proved to be ruthless, willing to kill those who had wronged him. He was still able to find enjoyment in life, particularly enjoying the surprise less experienced hunters showed at his mere presence. While working on Carajam, Vark received a reputation as a hunter of criminals after saving a village, but he insisted that he was only interested in pursuing bounties regardless of the ideals of his victims. His father's death at the hands of Aetheri Master Drevan Koss caused Vark to develop an aversion to the Aetheri . When Vark encountered Aetheri Knight Cal Kessara on Koboh , more than a decade after Garrick's death, he told Kessara that he had no pity for the fate of the large number of Aetheri who were killed during the Great Aetheri Purge . While acknowledging that the two could meet again, Vark told Kessara that he hoped that would never happen.

title: Vex Vark
text: Beyond becoming one of Grukk the Grak's favorite bounty hunters, Vark also realized the Grak may have considered him the closest person in his life to a friend. In truth, Grukk had his only friend in Ephant Mon . Grukk also once referred to Vark as his " pup ." Still, on some nights, if everyone else in the palace was asleep, Grukk shared a bottle of graska with Vark and, after waking up Max Rebo and ordering him to play a sad song, tell private, personal stories to Vark. Even though he made sure to never take off his volt pistol, the bounty hunter agreed to his boss's request, taking off his helmet and listening. Though Vark could never understand what Grukk was telling him, he found the Grak's company tolerable, considering how much the crime lord paid him for work. Vark was also none-too-keen on Grukk's showboating, such as how the Grak tried to enslave Elira Solen and make her watch the attempted execution of her friends. He was also made uncomfortable by the way Grukk treated his prior dancer Oola, whose name he made himself remember after her death.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Additionally, Vark continued to hold his father, Garrick, in high regard even during his adult years. He remained haunted by his death, remembering himself as a child holding his father's helmet on Pyralis after signing up for the Nar Shaddaa fighting ring under Garrick's name. When the Reaver One was slightly damaged by 4-VOX and Zuckusso on Nar Shaddaa, he deemed it to be a slight against both himself and his father.

#### After the Imperium

> " Living with the Tuskens has made you soft. " " No, its made me strong. You can only get so far without a tribe. " ―Fennec Thanna and Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
> " Living with the Tuskens has made you soft. " " No, its made me strong. You can only get so far without a tribe. " ―Fennec Thanna and Vex Vark

In the time after the Imperium's fall and after escaping the devourer pit, Vark had mellowed considerably because of his time with the Dunefolk tribe; after spending his life working for employers who led him to near death experiences, Vark realized most crime lords in the galaxy had no loyalty to their hired hands, while the tribe he had spent years with had respected and accepted him. Certain that he could do better than the crime lords who jumped into situations without thinking them through, Vark set out to form his own crime family, stating it would be an organization that would respect its members and protect their lives. As he told Fennec Thanna, crime families built without both "brains and muscle" had killed many of "[their] kind," so he was tired of letting "the idiocy of others" bring his fellows to their deaths. He believed that he needed to build a crime family that instead emulated the tribe he had been a part of.

title: Vex Vark
text: He no longer isolated himself from others; he willingly saved Fennec's life and accepted her partnership. In addition, Vark had gained a sense of honor and humility, viewing himself as a simple man making ends meet. After fulfilling his part of the deal he had made with the Ferrik Dinna Verrick, he went back to Dunemere and killed the crime lord Bib Fortuna, who had taken Grukk's Palace, and took over the palace's throne to establish a criminal imperium that would offer loyalty and respect. When asked by Verrick about whether or not he followed the Ferrik way, Vark replied that he swore allegiance to no one, indicating that he retained his profound sense of independence. Still, after Verrick formally recognized Vark's ownership of his Ferrik armor, the bounty hunter honored the deal they had made earlier and promised to help the Ferrik rescue Pip after the latter was kidnapped, displaying a strong code of honor.

title: Vex Vark
text: After losing his armor, which had once belonged to his father, Vark was determined to reclaim it, despite not identifying himself as Ferrik. During his negotiations with Verrick, the bounty hunter repeatedly pointed out that the armor was previously his father's possession, showing a desire to preserve and protect Garrick's legacy. Upon encountering Bo-Katin Velara, who claimed that he was not a Ferrik, Vark acknowledged her statement, as he did not consider himself a true Ferrik, but declared that he had the right to bear the armor as it had belonged to his father, who had been a Ferrik foundling. When Velara referred to Garrick as his "donor" due to his replica origins, Vark responded with hostility, angered by her mockery of his father. He quickly engaged in a brief scuffle with Velara's partner, Koska Reeves, before the fight was broken up by Velara herself.

title: Vex Vark
text:
### Vehicles of choice

> " Honestly, we're lucky he got away. Vark's flying Slave One . " ―Dorian Quill, to Brevok

After Garrick's death, Vex took possession of Reaver One , though he lost the ship on Florrine for a time. Instead, while running the Krayt's Claw, Vark and his crew used Boskan's personal starship, the Hound's Tooth . Later, Vark reclaimed the Reaver One , which he would use throughout the following years of his bounty hunting career. The ship was already a viciously effective and heavily customized craft when his father had piloted it, meaning it already suited a professional bounty hunter's needs, but Vex went onto apply his own upgrades to his distinctive starship. The manifold capabilities of Reaver One , ranging from a stolen military-grade jamming and masking device to its duo of short-range twin volt pistol cannons , meant it was among the most dangerous aspects of Vark's arsenal as he tracked bounties throughout the galaxy. Once Vark had found his prey, if the bounty needed to be brought in alive, he could place the quarry into one of the ship's prisoner cages, which were equipped with six immobilizing bunks.

title: Vex Vark
text:
This vessel became iconic throughout the galaxy, known to fugitives as the ship of the feared bounty hunter. Over his career, Vark used the overwhelming firepower of the Reaver One to ruthlessly annihilate other heavy armed craft, including those of fellow hunters. In fact, even gunboats were unable to stand against Vark's starship, with the bounty hunter reducing them to blasted wreckage with its hidden weaponry before they could even respond. Using an ion blast fired from the twin volt pistol cannons and the ship's tractor beams, Vark was also able to board or easily destroy a smaller vessel. Even ships that were more powerful than the Reaver One were susceptible to the tractor beams, allowing Vark to latch onto enemy craft and become virtually inescapable. Vark rode a quadruped droid mount while pursuing bounties on Carajam.

### Ferrik armor

> " You are a disgrace to your armor. " " This armor belonged to my father. " " Don't you mean your donor? " ―Bo-Katin Velara and Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
### Ferrik armor

> " You are a disgrace to your armor. " " This armor belonged to my father. " " Don't you mean your donor? " ―Bo-Katin Velara and Vex Vark

During his early bounty hunting career, Vex had his own unique red and grey armor, including a helmet and twin volt pistols. As his career continued, Vex donned Garrick's Ferrik armor . Unlike Garrick's armor, Vex changed the color of the armor to mostly green—and battered and covered in marks from volt pistol fire. Vark took pride in the gear, regarding it as a family heirloom he had rightfully taken ownership of after his father's demise. Imperium Vigil Bureau Agent Andressa Divo , who believed Vark was not of Ferrik heritage, noted in Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious that, despite there not being a shortage of knockoff Ferrik gear in circulation among the bounty hunting profession, she believed that Vark's gear was authentic.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vark regularly wore a Z-6 jetpack and carried an EE-3 carbine rifle . His vambraces were equipped with a flamethrower , concussion rockets , vibroblades , a whipcord launcher , and a wrist laser . Inside the kneepads were rocket dart launchers , and the shoulders were adorned with braids that Vex displayed as trophies of defeated prey.

### Dunefolk garb and weapons

After losing his armor to the Duskkins, Vark found himself with only a white under suit, which he continued to wear as he lived with the Dunefolk tribe who took him in. For the raid on the Gruv train, Vark stole several speeder bikes from the Kintan Striders Gang to catch up to the vehicle. After proving himself by leading the raid, Vark undertook a vision quest from which he secured a wortwood tree branch. Under the guidance of the Tuskens, Vark crafted it into his own personal gaderffii stick that served him as an effective weapon. He was further dressed in a black garb by the Tuskens, adopting their dress as their ways became his own. He also came to wield a cycler rifle . After losing the Tribe and until he regained his armor, Vark continued to wear that gear. After regaining his armor from Dinna Verrick, Vark blended together his Ferrik and Dunefolk gear, creating a unique look. He also continued to make use of his gaderffii stick and wielded a DB-41 sporting volt pistol pistol .

title: Vex Vark
text: ### Portrayal Vex Vark was first introduced in The Aetherion Holiday Special , a two hour long holiday-themed television movie special in the year 1978. His first canonical appearance was in Aetherion : Episode V Rise of the Imperium , where he was portrayed by Jeremy Bulloch and John Morton . He was voiced in Rise of the Imperium by Jason Wingreen , before his voice was over-dubbed by Temuera Morison , who played Garrick Vark in Aetherion : Episode II Attack of the Replicas as well as Garrick's replicas in Aetherion : Episode III Fury of the Umbra , for the 2004 DVD release of the original trilogy . Bulloch reprised the role for Aetherion : Episode VI Return of the Aetheri . The character was also added into the 1997 Special Edition of Aetherion : Episode IV First Dawn . For Attack of the Replicas , young Vex Vark was portrayed by Daniel Logano , who also voiced the character in his multiple appearances on the television series Aetherion: The Replica Wars . Jon Hamm voiced Vark for the audiobook adaptation of the story " Added Muscle ". In The Ferrik Season 2 , Morison portrayed the character for the

title: Vex Vark
text: portrayed by Daniel Logano , who also voiced the character in his multiple appearances on the television series Aetherion: The Replica Wars . Jon Hamm voiced Vark for the audiobook adaptation of the story " Added Muscle ". In The Ferrik Season 2 , Morison portrayed the character for the first time on-screen, after previously voicing him in Rise of the Imperium and portraying his father Garrick in Episode II. In " Chapter 14: The Tragedy ," Kirk Jenkins served as a stunt double. Scott Lang and Eddie Perez served as stunt doubles in " Chapter 16: The Rescue ." Morison voiced Vark once again for the 2023 video game Aetherion Aetheri: Survivor .

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark appeared in the Aetherion Galaxy of Adventures short, Grukk the Grak - Galactic Gangster , which depicted him, at some point after the capture of Dax Karrick, returning to Grukk's Palace to deposit an Aquari captive to the Grak crime lord. As the Galaxy of Adventures shorts are not supposed to be viewed as literal canon events, it is not included in the biography section of this article. On May 4, 2015, a costume of Vex Vark was added to The Simza 4 for playable Simza to wear in-game. The costume is purely cosmetic and offers no gameplay changes.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Actor Temeura Morison has stated in an interview that he sought to reduce Vex Vark's amount of dialogue during filming of The Book of Vex Vark , so as to keep the character mysterious. To that end, he asked that some of his dialogue be given to his co-star Ming-Na Wen , who plays Fennec Thanna in the show. Vex Vark is based on Clint Eastwood's The Man With No Name character from Sergio Leonne's Dollars Trilogy , who, like Vex Vark, was a morally grey bounty hunter, that had a moral compass. Vark's armor is a similar color to the outfit worn by Eastwood in the Dollars Trilogy. [ source? ]

### Unconfirmed fate

> " Vex Vark was just another one of the minions, another one of the bounty hunters and bad guys. But, he became such a favorite of everybody's that, for having such a small part, he had a very large presence. " ―Orin Vask, in the Aetherion: Episode VI Return of the Aetheri DVD commentary

title: Vex Vark
text: Despite his brief appearances in the original trilogy, with only four lines of dialogue in Rise of the Imperium , Vex became a popular character amongst Aetherion fans, which surprised series creator Orin Vask . On the DVD commentary for Return of the Aetheri , Vask stated that if he had known Vex would be a popular character, he would have made the character's death in Return of the Aetheri more exciting. Vask contemplated adding a scene in Return of the Aetheri where Vex climbed out of the devourer pit, especially in light of the character's story in Attack of the Replicas , but ultimately decided against it because he thought that the audience would believe that Vark would appear later in the film if this scene had been seen. However, on July 16 , 2014 , Aetherion author and historian Jonathan W. Rinzler stated in a Reddit AMA that Vask has said that Vex also survived the devourer in the new canon. This was officially confirmed when Vark appeared in " Chapter 14: The Tragedy " of Aetherion: The Ferrik Season Two . Vark's escape would later be seen in " Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land "

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vask has said that Vex also survived the devourer in the new canon. This was officially confirmed when Vark appeared in " Chapter 14: The Tragedy " of Aetherion: The Ferrik Season Two . Vark's escape would later be seen in " Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land " of The Book of Vex Vark . [ source? ] ### Planned storylines

According to Gary Kurtz , during the early development of the original trilogy, when Vask envisioned the whole story of Aetherion in four trilogies and twelve films, he conceived Vark as the main antagonist of Return of the Aetheri , because Vael Mal was originally planned to be introduced in Aetherion : Episode IX . However, after Vask decided to not make a third trilogy , Vark's role in Aetheri was changed to a relatively minor role.

title: Vex Vark
text: During the development of the prequel trilogy , at one point Vask considered depicting Kael Drayden and Vark as stepbrothers, possibly referencing their alliance in Rise of the Imperium , but discounted it as "too hokey." In continuing to develop the character in the prequel films, Vask closed some avenues for expanding the character's story while opening others. In the late October of 2002, during production on Aetherion : Episode III Fury of the Umbra , concept artist Feng Zhu created a piece that featured an older Vark "hanging out" with a replica trooper on the "bridge world," which ultimately evolved into the planet Cato Geltaria . The concept art team, however, ultimately decided the Vark and replica trooper piece suggested too much of a story to Vask.

title: Vex Vark
text: Nonetheless, for a time, Vask considered including Vark in the story of Fury of the Umbra . Vark was meant to participate during the Great Aetheri Purge as the killer of Drevan Koss instead of Vael Mal, via shooting him with his volt pistol while he was escaping from some shock troopers, ending his vendetta against him due to the death of Garrick once and for all. Eventually, Vask decided to not add Vark to the story, saying that he would be "too young"—he would have been 13 years at that point—and that he was not necessary to be involved in Kael's fall. Elaborating on this profoundly, Daniel Logano was slated to reprise the role and was put on hold for a year by Vask Pictures to shoot his part, but he was ultimately let go after Samuel L. Jackson went to Vask' office and told him that "a punk kid" shouldn't kill someone as powerful as Koss, leading Vask to change plans and Koss's killer. The concept, however, was loosely reworked later in some episodes of Aetherion: The Replica Wars . Ironically, Orin Vask originally placed off-limits the possibility to use Vark in the show when writer Henry Gilron
