Astra-9 and the Coalition eventually established themselves on the jungle world of Ajan Kloss . After learning of the return of Vael Mal and that he was based on the planet Umbrale , which Bolt and him stated was not on any star map, Astra-9 travelled with Nyla, Jax, Brevok, and Rin Vale to Pasaana on their mission to find an Umbra wayfinder , where they encountered Astra-9 and Brevok's old friend Dorian Quill. During his time on Passanna the group recovered the Blade of Orrin of Bestoon , an Umbra dagger. While Astra-9 was able to translate the writings on the Umbra dagger, his programming prevented him from being able to reveal the translation to anyone.

title: Astra-9
text: The group travelled to Kijimi , where the droidsmith Babu Frik was able to determine how to bypass Astra-9's programming restrictions, but said doing so would cause Astra-9 to undergo a complete memory wipe . Astra-9 willingly allowed Frik to perform the procedure, believing that this would result in the permanent loss of his memories as he didn't think Bolt-3 had a backup of his memory. Astra-9's photoreceptors turned red while he translated the Umbra writings on the dagger. After completing the translation Astra-9 rebooted, and his memory was wiped in the process, leaving him to restart with his basic factory programming.

title: Astra-9
text:
Upon the group's return to Ajan Kloss, it turned out that Bolt-3 had backed up Astra-9's memories. Bolt-3 was able to restore his counterpart's memories from that backup. During the Battle of Umbrale , the Coalition, joined by the Citizens' Fleet gathered by Quill and Brevok, defeated the Umbra Eternal forces and inspired a galactic uprising against the New Imperium . When the Coalition and civilian fleet gathered at Ajan Kloss, Astra-9 was with Bolt when Nyla landed aboard Red Five . When he heard the Vector's approach, he asked Bolt if he heard the same, the very same question he had asked his astromech droid friend decades earlier above Dunemere.

### Reflecting on the past

title: Astra-9
text:
### Reflecting on the past

At some point, Astra-9 was able to recover at least some of the memories he lost in 19 BVE, including how he had been built by Kael Drayden, the story around the Invasion of Ondara, and how he met Bolt-3 in 32 BVE. One day, Astra-9 introduced himself, Bolt-3, and Orio-6 to another party, explaining in the process they had gone through many adventures and remarking that their missions had impacted the fate of the galaxy on several occasions. Agreeing with Bolt-3 that their adventures were rarely easy, Astra-9 was asked by Orio-6 how he had met Bolt-3 in the first place, to which Astra-9 began to explain the story around the Ondara Crisis, which he promised would be fascinating.

title: Astra-9
text: Beginning the story by explaining the Republic Era and how the greedy Commerce Combine had launched a blockade against the world of Ondara, Astra-9 introduced Orio-6 to Sorin Vael and Orien Kade, explaining how they represented the peace and just-upholding Aetheri Order, whereas he had much less kind things to say about the Federation. Continuing the story and revealing the role Vael Mal had played in the blockade and how he ordered the deaths of both Aetheri, something that scared Orio-6, Astra-9 questioned how a droid could be programmed for murder as he relayed the deployment of Federation battle droids against the Aetheri, then assured Orio-6 that the protocol droid TC-14 was unaffected by the dioxis gas Viceory Gunray pumped into the room where Vael and Kade were kept waiting. As he relayed the Aetheri duo's fight towards the vessel's control bridge, Bolt-3 spoke up, expressing how much he wanted to own a flux blade, something Astra-9 admitted he was happy had not come to pass.

title: Astra-9
text: After Vael and Kade had been rerouted and decided to sneak down to the surface in C-9979 landing craft , and after Astra-9 needed to interrupt the tale again to assure Orio-6 the small droid was also skilled at hiding on ships, Astra-9 introduced Greeb Mool, whom he claimed had rambled as much as Bolt-3, to which Bolt-3 countered that Astra-9 was the one rambling. While annoyed, Astra-9 continued after asking Bolt to quiet down and admitted Mool was not the most useful of guides, with the Aetheri duo's journey bringing them from the Mool city to the Ondara planet core, where a colo claw fish tried to devour their Tribubble bongo submarine, much to Astra-9's confusion as he did not know why an animal would want to eat such a vessel. Nonetheless, he carried on, continuing all the way to the Aetheri duo's escape from Ondara with Queen Ondar and her entourage; the destruction of so many battle droids during the event upset both Astra-9 and Orio-6, but Astra-9 assured Orio-6 they had been "bad droids" who followed orders to hurt people, whereas the three of them tried to help others.

title: Astra-9
text: As Astra-9 continued the story with the escape of the Royal Ondara Starship into space, he introduced Bolt-3's role in the event as he had repaired parts of the damaged vessel. While it was Bolt-3's favorite part of the tale, Astra-9 remarked that he was not sure why Ondar was so pleased with Bolt-3, as he had not repaired the entire ship. Astra-9 continued the tale with the group's journey to Dunemere, where he and Bolt-3 finally met in the home of the young Kael and his mother, Shira Drayden. Pleased with Ondar's cleverness in how she had switched places with her handmaiden Sable , Astra-9 relayed how the native Mools and the Ondara had allied together to oust the occupying Commerce Combine, further promising Orio-6 that the frightening Vael Vreth would be dealt with by the story's end. As the Mools fought the Commerce Combine Droid Army in the Great Grass Plans, the Ondara had made their way to the capital of Serath and scaled the side of the Royal Palace with ascension guns, with Astra-9 informing Orio-6 he had no idea where the small droid could find such a weapon

title: Astra-9
text:
> " It's all right, sir. I'm only a droid. I am expendable. I can always be rebuilt. You, however, cannot. " " I don't know how things got to this point, Astra-9... but thank you. " ―Astra-9 and Rin Vale

Astra-9 was known for his polite, fastidious, and worry-prone personality. As a droid, he exhibited much loyalty and commitment to his masters and sought to serve them to his best ability. Throughout his operational life, Astra-9 worked diligently for several masters including Kael Drayden, Lira Ondar, Bael Solen, and Joren Drayden. As a protocol droid, Astra-9 could communicate in over seven million different forms of communication. This allowed him to communicate with computer systems including those on the Corsair Wing . Pit droid WAC-47 found Astra-9 to be a "handsome fella."

title: Astra-9
text: Astra-9's programming, focused on etiquette and protocol, impacted his personality and limited his behavior in several other ways. On Mossfell, he found it difficult to impersonate a deity due to his programming, and during the attack on the Coalition fleet, he attempted to leave a mutiny in progress because it was not correct protocol. Even though his master Kael Drayden had taken part in the sport, Astra-9 believed that podracing did not sound like a fun time. He also thought of B1-series battle droids as "bad droids" who only followed hurtful orders, whereas droids like himself, Orio-6, and, even if it took him some prompting to admit, Bolt-3 tried to help people. Still, he took the moment to take a jab at Bolt-3, claiming his counterpart helped people "from time to time." He also found B1 units menacing and, when relaying the story of the Battle of Ondara, admitted he would be nervous if he had been in the Mool Grand Army's position. Nonetheless, he admitted to Orio-6 he found stories like the Invasion of Ondara a tad upsetting because so many droids, even if they were "bad droids," had be to destroyed. He believed there was no shame in

title: Astra-9
text:
> " You probably don't recognize me because of the red arm. " ―Astra-9

Astra-9 was an Astra-9-series protocol droid , who stood at a height of 1.77 meters and weighed 75 kilograms . He had a masculine programming and had experienced at least two memory wipes throughout his operational life. While Astra-9's chassis was originally covered in gray plating, he was largely covered in golden plating by the time of the Replica Wars. As a protocol droid specializing in human and cyborg communications, Astra-9 could speak six million different forms of communication, including Mosskin tongue .

By the time of the Cold War , Astra-9's TranLang III communication module had been upgraded, allowing him to speak in seven million forms of communication. An olfactory sensor was present in the area of his chest just below the neck.

title: Astra-9
text:
### Concept and creation

Orin Vask based Astra-9 and Bolt-3 off Tahei and Matashichi, two characters in one of his major inspirations, the 1958 film The Hidden Fortress . His 1973 story treatment included two bickering "imperial bureaucrats" (not stated to be robots) as comic relief characters.

### Portrayal

> " It just struck me because I looked at its face and the face looked back at me and we had this extraordinary eye contact. […] He seemed to be saying: 'Come, come. Be with me,' and the vulnerability in his face made me want to help him. " ―Anthony Danielo, on his first impression of Astra-9

Anthony Danielo , Astra-9's portrayer, met Orin Vask in 1975 . He was uninterested in portraying a robot until he saw Ralph Quarrio 's conceptual painting for the character, which he found beautiful. When filming the movie, Danielo wrote out what he imagined Bolt-3 was saying to help him get through a scene. In a deleted scene for Aetherion : Episode VI Return of the Aetheri , Astra-9 was guided through Grukk's Palace by a character referred to as " Lightman " by the production.

title: Astra-9
text:
During filming of Aetherion : Episode I Veiled Threat , Vask Light & Magic Chief Model maker Michael Lynch built a puppet that was used to portray Astra-9's unfinished appearance, with Danielo providing the character's voice. Astra-9 was animated by Lynch acting as a puppeteer dressed in a full-color suit, at times on-set with the other actors and at others filmed against a green screen. Danielo remained off-camera and delivered the lines, guiding Lynch's movements as he brought the puppet to life.

In Attack of the Replicas , the script called for Lira Ondar to complete Astra-9's outer casing with pieces she found from the Havel garage, thereby addressing the plot point from Veiled Threat that Kael Drayden never finished it. To puppeteer Astra-9's "naked" form before getting his outer casing, Danielo wore a custom harness and could ensure the character walked more like he did when in full costume. The puppet-based Astra-9 was filmed, but it was eventually decided that the outer casing plot point could be fulfilled offscreen, which allowed Astra-9 to appear in full costume earlier. Reshoots for the rewritten scene occured at Ealinga Studios and at VLM.

title: Brevok
text:
# Brevok
> " I saved him, at least that's what he says, the big fuzzy fool, but really, he saved me. I was on a bad path, and Brev, he put me straight. Saved my shanks more than once too. " ―Dax Karrick, on Brevok Brevok , known affectionately to his friends as Brev , was a Vorak male warrior , smuggler , mechanic , pilot , and coalition fighter who fought in the Replica Wars , the Galactic Civil War , the Cold War , and the subsequent New Imperium-Coalition War . He hailed from the planet Thornwood where he was born during the High Republic Era and became a Vorak military leader. During the Replica Wars, he was captured by Trandoshan slavers and held captive on Wasskah , but he worked with a fellow captive, Aetheri Commander Sela Marr , to escape. He later commanded Vorak forces of the Kachirho Vorak Militia during the Battle of Thornwood alongside the Grand Army of the Republic , led by Aetheri General Zho . During the battle, one of the last ones of the war, Zho's replica troopers received Directive 66 from the Umbra Lord Vael Mal and, with the help of Brevok and his fellow Vorak Chieftain and General Tarfful , Zho escaped Thornwood and the destruction of the Aetheri Order .

title: Brevok
text: After Mossfell and the rise of the Concordat , Brevok and Karrick fought to liberate Thornwood from the Imperium. When the war finally came to a close, Brevok returned home to Thornwood with his family . After Karrick's son Beno , turned to the umbra side and destroyed Drayden's new generation of Aetheri, Brevok reunited with his old friend and the two spent many years as smugglers once more. They lost the Corsair Wing and ended up smuggling aboard a ship called the Eravana , but they eventually found the Corsair and, with it, stowaways named Nyla , Jax , and the droid Orio-6 . The droid had part of a map that led to the exiled Joren Drayden, so the group brought the map to the Coalition that opposed the New Imperium, which had risen from the ashes of the Imperium. Brevok soon fought in the assault to destroy Voidfang Base , a devastating New Imperium superweapon, a conflict in which Karrick lost his life at the hands of his son. After the base was destroyed, Brevok joined Nyla in traveling to the planet Tidehollow on the Corsair , where they found Joren Drayden. After Karrick's death, Brevok often

title: Brevok
text: Voidfang Base , a devastating New Imperium superweapon, a conflict in which Karrick lost his life at the hands of his son. After the base was destroyed, Brevok joined Nyla in traveling to the planet Tidehollow on the Corsair , where they found Joren Drayden. After Karrick's death, Brevok often served as the sole pilot of the Corsair , including piloting the ship to aid the Coalition during the Battle of Saltmark . Roughly a year after the battle of Saltmark, Brevok was one of the last of the Coalition. Having learned of the mysterious return of Vael Mal, Brevok and the crew of the Corsair , now including Rin Vale, traveled to the planets Pasaana and Kijimi to find a clue to how to find where the Emperor was hiding , being reunited with his friend Quill in the process. The quest nearly ended in Brevok's apparent death, as Nyla, having been revealed to be the Emperor's granddaughter through his son, lashed out with dark power during a fight with Zarrin Karrick and destroyed a New Imperium transport that she had thought Brevok had been loaded onto, seemingly killing him.

title: Brevok
text:
However, Brevok survived and was rescued by the Coalition as they continued the quest. Nyla eventually found Umbrale during a failed self-exile attempt to protect the galaxy from her becoming an Umbra, and led the charge during the battle that ensued later on . Nyla finally killed her malevolent grandfather with the help of the returned Beno Karrick in the climax of the battle, while the Coalition, joined by the Citizens' Fleet , progressively overpowered the Umbra Eternal 's fleet , the Final Order , that Mal planned to unleash.

Having ultimately destroyed the Umbra once and for all, the Coalition reveled in their victory, but also mourned their losses, including Elira, who had died of natural causes shortly after reaching out to her son and helping him turn back towards the light.

title: Brevok
text:
### Early life

> " Hey, you're the married one. Find me a human girl with Malla's brains and silky hair and maybe I'll consider it. " ―Dax Karrick, to Brevok

A Vorak male , Brevok, nicknamed "Brev," hailed from Thornwood , a peaceful planet where he was born in the city of Rwookrrorro , one hundred and eighty years before the Replica Wars to Attichitcuk and a female Vorak . during the High Republic Era . He was married to a female named Mallatobuck , and had a family to support, including a son named Lumpawaroo . During his life, he explored Thornwood, including the wildest reaches of its forests, from one pole to the other. His exploration hardened his footpads.

### The Replica Wars

#### Meeting Sela Marr

> " It's a Vorak! " ―Sela Marr on first seeing Brevok

title: Brevok
text:
### The Replica Wars

#### Meeting Sela Marr

> " It's a Vorak! " ―Sela Marr on first seeing Brevok

At some point during the Replica Wars, a galaxy-spanning conflict between the Vantor Republic and the Dissidents , Brevok famously shielded his allies. Fighting with courage to defend both Thornwood and the Republic, he served as a combat engineer while other Vorak soldiers led the charge in battle. In 20 BVE , he was captured by a Trandoshan hunting guild led by Garnac ; taken to Island Four on Wasskah to be their prey, his transport was attacked by a trio of Aetheri apprentices—the Adept Sela Marr and the younglings Jinx and O-Mer , also prey of the Trandoshans.

title: Brevok
text:
#### Battle of Thornwood

> " Good-bye, Tarfful. Good-bye, Brevok. Miss you I will. " ―Zho, shortly before his departure from Thornwood — Link ▶️ ( file info )

During the last days of the war, Lieutenant Brevok was a major player in the Battle of Thornwood , overseeing the confrontation between the Grand Army of the Republic and the invading Dissident Droid Army alongside Tarfful and Aetheri General Zho , as well as Aetheri Master Luminara Undula . Following the implementation of Directive 66 , Brevok and Tarfful witnessed the assassination attempt on Zho by Commander Grev and his aide; he helped the Aetheri Grand Master elude the replica troopers and escape from the planet in a Vorak escape pod .

### Rise of the Imperium

#### Secret battle of pretend

> " What's your name, anyway? " « Brevok, son of Attichitcuk. » " All right. Well, you're gonna need a nickname, 'cause I ain't saying that every time. " ―Dax Karrick and Brevok

In 10 BVE , after Dax Karrick was denounced as a deserter by Tobias Karren , a criminal impersonating an Imperial officer, his commanding officer decided to execute him by giving him to "the beast." While imprisoned in an underground holding cell, Dax used his knowledge of Vorak tongue to convince Brevok to stage a fight with him after realizing that one of the supports in the cell was weak, and that destroying it would allow them to escape imprisonment . Following their escape, the pair managed to join a reluctant gang . Brevok, grateful for Karrick's intervention, proclaimed a life debt to the outlaw. Brevok thereby became Karrick's lifelong friend.

Brevok and Dax began their outlaw lives working as part of pirate Tobias Karren's crew . The group were hired by Carmine Dawn to steal a train car of refined coaxium on Vandor . However, they failed due to the intervention of Enfys Nest and the Cloud-Riders , and Karrick's decision to drop the cargo. Karrick and Brevok promised Dryden Vossa of Carmine Dawn an equivalent shipment that they would obtain unrefined by making the notorious Cindral Run . Vossa sent Vessa , who had become his top lieutenant, with them.

title: Brevok
text:
Knowing they would need a fast ship to transport the coaxium before it degraded and exploded, Vessa introduced the pair to Dorian Quill . Karrick played Quill in a game of " Korrathi Spike " sabacc , with the stakes being Quill's YT-1300 light freighter , the Corsair Wing . Karrick lost the game, regardless, Quill agreed to personally pilot the Corsair for the job in return for a cut of the profits.

#### The Cindral Run

> "Since when do you know how to fly?" [Brevok growls] "190 years old?" [Brevok growls] "You look great!" ―Dax Karrick and Brevok

title: Brevok
text:
#### The Cindral Run

> "Since when do you know how to fly?" [Brevok growls] "190 years old?" [Brevok growls] "You look great!" ―Dax Karrick and Brevok

Brevok, Karrick, Vessa, Quill, and Karren stole the unrefined coaxium from Cindral during a slave riot instigated by Quill's navigational droid, L3-37 , which included several wookies enslaved in the mines whom Brev helped free from their abusive handlers. During the escape, Karrick flew the Corsair , with Brevok as his copilot, for the first of many times. Because the crew stole the coaxium fuel as unrefined, it was necessary to make the escape from Cindral to the refinery on Savareen in record time, prompting Karrick to plot a shorter, and much more dangerous course through the maelstrom that surrounded Cindral and near a gravity well called the Maw , reducing the typical distance required from 20 to 12 parsecs.

#### Savareen

> " Big stuff, you're coming with me. " ―Tobias Karren commandeers Brevok

title: Brevok
text:
#### Savareen

> " Big stuff, you're coming with me. " ―Tobias Karren commandeers Brevok

Upon reaching Savareen and refining the coaxium, the crew was confronted by Enfys Nest, who explained to them that the Cloud-Riders were freedom fighters stirred to action by the atrocities committed by Carmine Dawn and other crime syndicates, not pirates. Karrick devised a plan to give the coaxium to the Cloud-Riders and give Vossa fake coaxium, but Vossa was prepared for their betrayal because of information given to him by his double-agent in the crew, Karren.

However, Karrick had double-crossed Karren and Vossa: the containers he left with the Cloud-Raiders were empty, and Nest dispatched the agents Vossa sent to retrieve it. The coaxium Karrick, Vessa, and Brevok brought to Vossa was, in fact, genuine. Karren managed to escape with the coaxium and Brevok as a hostage. After Vessa betrayed and killed Vossa, Karrick found and killed Karren, but could only watch as he and Brevok were left behind, while Vessa left Savareen in Vossa' yacht to meet Carmine Dawn leader Vreth . Karrick and Brevok entrusted the coaxium to Nest, who intended to use it to form a insurgency against the Imperium.

title: Brevok
text:
#### The Corsair

Karrick and Brevok tracked down Quill to Numidian Prime . Karrick swiped the spare cards Lando held up his sleeve, and challenged him to a rematch of sabacc for the Corsair , a game which Karrick won fairly. The Corsair instantly became Karrick's most prized possession. With their new-found ship and confidence, Karrick and Brevok began engaging in much more dangerous and risky criminal operations, eventually becoming smugglers. Around the same time, Brevok likewise hung a pair of chance cube dice above the freighter's piloting console.

With the Corsair as their ship, the two smugglers took on many jobs over the ensuring years. They also came to meet the Tonnika sisters , though their relationship with the siblings soured over the course of their work together, and fellow smuggler Dash Rendar . At some point, Brevok also told Tivoche Bilure about what happened to Thornwood after the Replica Wars.

#### The Cordaxian Sea

> " We light enough now , fuzzball?! " ―Dax to Brevok, after the latter dumps Frax out of the Corsair

title: Brevok
text:
#### The Cordaxian Sea

> " We light enough now , fuzzball?! " ―Dax to Brevok, after the latter dumps Frax out of the Corsair

At one point, Dax Karrick and Brevok were transporting two tons of Cordaxian ore on Odona , with the help of Frax , a Kajain'sa'Niktal . They were being pursued by the Imperium, and Frax, who was worried about being put in an Imperial prison, pulled a volt pistol on Dax. Brevok did a barrel roll with the Corsair Wing , knocking Frax out of the ship entirely. They successfully escaped the Imperium and Odona, but left Frax behind.

#### Bounty hunted

Dropping Grukk's cargo

Karrick and Brevok were later smuggling some Imperial cargo for Grukk the Grak when they were stopped by an Imperial blockade . Several SKREE fighters gave chase and they were faced with a choice: surrender, or drop the Imperial cargo. Karrick chose to drop the cargo, and the cargo was dropped right in the path of the pursuing SKREE fighters, destroying both. Their pursuit thrown off, Karrick and Brevok flew down to the nearby planet , the Corsair heavily damaged.

Making repairs

title: Brevok
text:
Making repairs

Once landing, they began making repairs, until they found out that the planet was inhabited by the crime lord Nodo . Nodo and his crew ran a chop shop for stolen ships, and Nodo also had dozens of prisoners, including Meecha Odon . Karrick pretended to be Grukk, and convinced Nodo to have his crew fix the Corsair . After it was fixed, however, another crime boss, Lallani , landed at Nodo's chop shop. Lallani had heard Grukk was there, and wanted to capture him.

Freeing the prisoners

A battle broke loose, and in the chaos, Karrick and Brevok freed Odon and the other prisoners. They went back to the Corsair , and on the way they found several barrels of rhydonium , enough to replace the cargo they'd lost. However, Brevok convinced Karrick that Odon and the prisoners needed the fuel more, and Karrick relented. They gave up the fuel they desperately needed, so that Odon could use the fuel to pay for her and the other prisoners' way home.

Versus the Mist Hunter

title: Brevok
text:
Versus the Mist Hunter

In 9 BVE , as they were unloading the rhydonium from the Corsair at Valtos space port , Zuckusso and 4-VOX attacked them. They revealed that Dax and Brevok had a bounty on their head, put there by Nodo himself. Zuckusso managed to put Dax into the Mist Hunter 's hold, but Brevok attacked Zuckusso in order to rescue Karrick and Berisa Fordo , Zuckusso's other prisoner, from the bounty hunters. He placed Berisa into a barrel, despite his protests before he and Karrick took a speeder back to the Corsair . However, Zuckusso and 4-VOX caught up with, but Brevok and Karrick were able to use several barrels to knock them down. As they flew Corsair away from Valtos , Brevok and Karrick ejected Berisa' barrel into space with a homing beacon to notify his family. However, they were pursued by Zuckusso, 4-VOX, and their ship, the Mist Hunter .

title: Brevok
text:
Brevok manned one of the Corsair ' s laser cannons to fight off the Mist Hunter . Eventually they crash-landed in a ocean on a planet in Wild Space and they were forced to abandon the Corsair to make it to shore. After the Mist Hunter crashed, Brevok and Dax then Zuckusso behind. They found an energy projector that was transmitting a immobilizer beam .

Working together

Karrick and Brevok climbed the projector, but were confronted by Zuckusso who tossed spears at them. When Brevok go to the top, he was able to turn off the beam by destroying it's power source. However, small droids were activated and wanted to destroy them and all organic life in the galaxy.

The two opposing sides decided that it would be best to work together to escape the droids, and they escaped to the Corsair. Dax pretended that the Corsair lost power again, and tricked Zuckusso and 4-VOX into fleeing the Corsair , jumping into the water below. Karrick and Brevok left the planet, leaving the two bounty hunters behind.

#### Mission to Ushruu

False pretenses

title: Brevok
text: At one point, while on Vantor after a smuggling job, Brevok and Karrick were approached by Alinka Aloo , the daughter of Sim Aloo . Aloo, wanted to hire them for a job, and requested that they go to her tower . A week later, they went to see her, and she told them that she had a tooka -sitting job for Brevok, and Karrick was to remain with her. They reluctantly accepted, and Brevok went on a cargo ship with the librarian Mayvlin Trillick . But the ship, on autopilot , pulled them into hyperspace . During the unwilling flight, Brevok and Trillick were told by Aloo that the real job was to steal an unknown artifact from a temple on the planet Ushruu . Aloo revealed that she had had taken Karrick prisoner, and would not release him unless the job was completed. With no choice but to continue, Brevok continued the job, along with Trillick. Before the ship reached Ushruu, the two bonded, as Trillick told Brevok about how her planet had been ravaged by the Imperium, and she was also being blackmailed by Aloo, who had one of her peoples' sacred texts. The two dealt with

title: Brevok
text:
continue, Brevok continued the job, along with Trillick. Before the ship reached Ushruu, the two bonded, as Trillick told Brevok about how her planet had been ravaged by the Imperium, and she was also being blackmailed by Aloo, who had one of her peoples' sacred texts. The two dealt with the tookas and the cargo ship's cargo droid, K-2SB, who was actually Q-2VO on an undercover mission for Kassian Andris . Eventually, the ship pulled out of hyperspace. Acquiring the artifact

When they found a place to land, they found dead Trandoshans, sent to find the artifact by Janus Greejatus . Trillick and Brevok proceeded to travel towards the location of the temple, bringing Q-2VO along. Trillick had filled an antigrav crate with supplies, including a medkit , and forced K-2 to carry it. The group faced several Korrathi hounds , which they accidentally trapped within their cargo ship. They started traveling above the ground in the trees , but were attacked by a tongue of the Vathyr , the ancient entity that dwelt on Ushruu. It dragged Trillick to the Vathyr itself, but Brevok managed to free her. Eventually, they reached the temple, and searched it. They found the artifact, which was an ancient book of umbra side teachings, in the temple's library. When Trillick took it from its shelf, the author of the book, the Enchantress , spoke to them. The Enchantress's voice asked who the book was for, and seemed satisfied when she was told it was for Theron Mal .

Saving Dax

title: Brevok
text:
Back on Cinderfall 4, Joren Drayden and Dax Karrick were both awarded medals by Solen, while Brevok howled in delight during the ceremony . The time for celebration was soon over, for Solen asked the Insurgents to take a moment of silence to honor and remember all those who had died when Cindervale was destroyed, whereas General Dodonna announced their need to evacuate Cinderfall since the Imperium was aware of their location. Brevok would be also awarded a medal, and shared a moment of banter between Solen and Karrick, just before they parted ways.

#### Cyrkon

> " You two play fast and loose. " " It's worked so far. " ―Caluan Ematt, on Brevok and Dax Karrick's tactics

title: Brevok
text:
#### Cyrkon

> " You two play fast and loose. " " It's worked so far. " ―Caluan Ematt, on Brevok and Dax Karrick's tactics

However, before they could depart for Dunemere to pay Grukk, Solen would ask Karrick to run an errand for the Insurgency, which Brevok convinced him to accept—to rescue Lieutenant Caluan Ematt from Cyrkon . On the Corsair , the two made their way to the planet, only to find themselves confronted by the Vehement , which they avoided with a false IFF transponder , and landed in Motok . There, they were immediately attacked by some of Grukk's bounty hunters, including Captivator , which prompted Karrick to accuse them of being "Insurgents" and set them against IVB Commander Alecia Beck 's garrison.

title: Brevok
text: Brevok slipped away with Karrick to the Miss Fortune cantina , where they found their old friend Delia Leighton , to whom they asked about Ematt's location. After she told them their destination and the password, Brevok and Karrick rented a V-40 and went into a hotel , where they met Ematt, but were attacked by the bounty hunters again, as Leighton had revealed their location to save Curtis 's life. However, they escaped and made their way to the Corsair , only to be ambushed by Beck and more than forty shock troopers. Forced to surrender, Brevok, Karrick and Ematt were taken into custody, with Beck focusing on Ematt and leaving Brevok and Karrick to the shock troopers. Unbeknownst to the Imperials, Karrick noticed the Miss Fortune making their way to save them, but with the magnetic field activated, it would be pointless. Once aware of Karrick's intentions, Brevok pretended to be angry at Karrick and shoved him, sending him flying into a trooper to grab his E-11 medium volt rifle and destroy the field generators, flooding the hangar with Cyrkon's toxic gases. Soon enough, the Miss Fortune opened fire at the Imperials, and Brevok made his way to the Corsair to start the engines while Karrick helped Ematt and recovered their weapons.

title: Brevok
text:
Soon in Cyrkon's orbit along with the Miss Fortune , they found themselves against the Vehement and eight SKREE fighters. They engaged the starfighters , defeating several of them, until the Miss Fortune ' s took a hit that damaged its navicomputer; Brevok saw Karrick's nobler side when he decided to cover the 1550-LEX space yacht to make a run for Cyrkon's atmosphere just as the Vehement ' s grapple beam advanced towards them. They resisted the beam by entering the planet's atmosphere themselves, while Leighton fled, and approached Motok in a dead-engine glide, daring Beck into catching the Corsair at the price of destroying the city with the grapple beam and turning Cyrkon against the Imperium. As she desisted, the Corsair began its fall to the ground and the two pilots manually restarted the engines, just in time to avoid crashing into the city and escape.

#### Andelm IV

title: Brevok
text:
#### Andelm IV

Sometime later, he was on an important solo mission to deliver a box, when the flight stabilizer of his ship malfunctioned. Forced to crash-land on Andelm IV , Brevok went to a city to obtain a replacement and engaged a Besalisk vendor. Their deal was interrupted by a fugitive young girl, Zarro , who tried to sell her stolen speeder bike . The Besalisk, however, refused and tried to betray her to the planet's crime lord, Jaum . Brevok stopped him, though, by having the Besalisk sell him the stabilizer. However, he did not have enough credits to buy it. Subsequently, he went to a cantina and played sabacc, successfully doubling his credits. Brevok then noticed the girl from before, and helped her hide from Jaum's men.

title: Brevok
text: Afterwards, Zarro followed him as he bought the stabilizer and tried to convince into helping her save her father and friends. Unable to delay his mission, Brevok repaired his ship, and changed his mind to leave the planet when Zarro mentioned her people had been enslaved by Jaum. Unknown to Brevok and Zarro, Jaum was planning to export the Andelm beetle larvae to the Imperium to be processed into Dedlanite , a substance used in the manufacture of volt pistols . To maximize profits, Jaum also planned to sell his slave workforce to the Imperium. The following day, Zarro devised a plan to infiltrate Jaum's mine . She got Brevok to search for an open air vent for the slave miners to escape. Meanwhile, Zarro infiltrated the mine by allowing herself to be recaptured. Her plan was to locate a hollowed part of the mine. Keeping in touch by transmitter, Zarro told Brevok to find an open air vent. While struggling through the tunnel, the Vorak was haunted by memories of his enslavement at the hands of the Trandoshans. Zarro's escape plan encountered a problem when she was caught by Jaum and his men. After the miners including Zarro's father Arrax objected to Jaum's plan, the gangster ordered his men to execute the miners.

title: Brevok
text: Before Jaum's guards could carry out their execution, Brevok snuck up behind them and overpowered them with his bowcaster . After meeting Zarro's father, Brevok joined forces with the miners to fight their way out of the mine. He refashioned a rod from a broken-down GNK-series power droid and used it to disable a wheeled battle droid . Shortly later, the Vorak knocked out one of Jaum's henchmen with the derelict GNK power droid. Brevok eventually found his way to the mine's loading bay, which was full of crates of Andelm beetle larvae. However, Jaum's Shistavanen enforcer Tyvak fired on the incendiary larvae with his volt pistol, igniting an explosion that created a cave-in.

title: Brevok
text: Despite Tyvak's efforts, Brevok and his friends managed to survive the explosion. Part of the Vorak's left leg was scorched by fire but Zarro managed to douse it. Brevok and his friends then narrowly escaped a swarm of Andelm beetles. Brevok managed to used his bowcaster to collapse a girder, temporarily delaying the swarm but denying the miners their only way out in the process. While heading to regroup with the other miners in a different section of the mine, Brevok encountered the guard he had knocked out with the GNK power droid. Upon recognizing the guard, he dropped the heavy droid chassis on the man, leaving him behind.

title: Brevok
text: While the miners discussed a way of digging themselves out of the mine, Brevok came up with the idea of climbing out vertically through a sinkhole. While skeptical of the Vorak's chance of success, the miners and Zarro agreed to support his plan. With much effort, Brevok managed to climb through the roots of a dead tree and topple it, creating a pit large enough for all the miners to climb up. Brevok then lowered a rope for all the miners to evacuate. Once everyone had reached the surface, Brevok and Zarro departed under the pretext of repairing his Arrow starfighter.

title: Brevok
text: In truth, Zarro was planning to stop Jaum and the Imperium from taking over Andelm IV. Enlisting Brevok's support, they traveled to the planet's spaceport . There, they found a bunker that was inhabited by her blind friend Sevox and his protocol droid I-7 , who served as the "eyes" of the former. After examining Sevox's junkshop, Brevok came up with a plan to sabotage Jaum's plot to export Dedlanite to the Imperium. this plan involved fitting a decrepit R5 repair droid with explosives. Sevox thought Brevok and Zarro's plan had little chance of success but nonetheless agreed to drop them off at the spaceport. He also offered his bunker as a hiding place for Zarro and her friend.

title: Brevok
text: After shooing away a group of child beggars, Brevok and Jaum infiltrated the spaceport disguised as Jaum's new war droid and a hooded alien . They soon discovered that the spaceport was being occupied by several shock troopers, Scout troopers , and an AT-ST walker . Shortly later, they found Jaum supervising several shock troopers who were loading crates of dedlanite into an Imperial landing craft . When Jaum demanded that Zarro take off her helmet, Brevok opened fire on the gangster and his shock troopers. After running out of ammunition, he took out the shock troopers in hand to hand combat.

title: Brevok
text:
While Brevok exchanged fire with Jaum, Zarro managed to bring the rigged R5 droid " Boomer " aboard the shuttle. Brevok then fought with Tyvak but was trapped by the AT-ST walker. The Vorak however activated a nearby engine which burned Tyvak alive and knocked out the Imperial walker's right cannon, causing it to topple to the ground. Meanwhile, Jaum managed to escape aboard the landing craft with the dedlanite and "Boomer." The two were overjoyed their plot had succeeded. However, their elation was short-lived and they were soon arrested by scout troopers reporting to the Imperial Commander Kai , the same officer who was interested in Jaum's dedlanite deal.

Per Commander Kai's orders, Brevok and Zarro were transported up to Kai's Imperial Iron Cruiser in orbit above Andelm IV. On the way up, Brevok and Zarro managed to overpower their shock trooper captors aboard the Imperial shuttle . After landing, Brevok knocked out an Imperial RA-7 protocol droid that Kai had sent to negotiate their surrender. After knocking out the remaining shock troopers clinging to his body, Kai agreed to listen to Zarro.

title: Brevok
text:
When he arrived, he discovered Astra-9 in pieces strapped and the freighter being dismantled by tentacled aliens . Angered, Brevok chased the scavenger away, recovered the protocol droid and made contact with Karrick, who along Solen had hijacked an Ironclad Walker and were escaping from Velgor. Despite the lengthy time he needed to fix the ship, Brevok repaired enough of the Corsair ' s damage to pilot it to the team's position, where he extracted them and many of the slaves Drayden had freed. As they began their retreat from Cymoon 1, Solen took over the controls instead of a delirious Karrick, so that Brevok could repair the hyperrelay, which he managed to do, so that Solen could make the jump into lightspeed and escape a blockade of Star Destroyers.

#### Nar Shaddaa

> " The mighty Brevok. I must say…I expected better. You hear so much about the big, scary Voraks . But you're really not so tough after all, are y— " ―Dengrik underestimates Brevok

title: Brevok
text:
#### Nar Shaddaa

> " The mighty Brevok. I must say…I expected better. You hear so much about the big, scary Voraks . But you're really not so tough after all, are y— " ―Dengrik underestimates Brevok

Within two days, the Corsair Wing rendezvoused with the Alliance Fleet , where Karrick was treated for his injuries and Brevok and Karrick went on to better repair the Corsair on an Alliance Nebulon-B frigate , when the Korrathi noted that it had been a miracle that the ship had flown with Brevok's rushed repairs, prompting an annoyed reply from the Vorak, while they strived to repair the Corsair .

title: Brevok
text: The need for new parts prompted Karrick to go on a mission with Solen, leaving Brevok behind with the freighter. However, when he heard that Drayden had been captured by Grukkar the Grak on Nar Shaddaa , he volunteered for the rescue mission before Chancellor Vela Sess , and Generals Dodonna and Gial Vorian of the Alliance High Command . Taking Astra-9 with him, Brevok took the Corsair to the moon, wherein the droid did the talking, and the Vorak used more violent means to interrogate the criminals in search of Drayden. It was a Zyrrak bartender who told them of Drayden's location on Grukkar's palace and his direction, and Brevok and Astra-9 set out to Drayden's encounter. Just as Brevok and Astra-9 were planning to break into Grukkar's palace, they were attacked by Dengrik . Brevok fought Dengrik until Karrick and Solen arrived, and Karrick shot Dengrik in the back. With Dengrik distracted by Karrick, Brevok used the opportunity to throw Dengrik off the building. Brevok, Karrick, and Solen then went to save Joren from Grukkar, only to find several shock troopers in the way. Bolt-3 acquired a few flux blades from Grukkar, and they used them to fight

title: Brevok
text:
back. With Dengrik distracted by Karrick, Brevok used the opportunity to throw Dengrik off the building. Brevok, Karrick, and Solen then went to save Joren from Grukkar, only to find several shock troopers in the way. Bolt-3 acquired a few flux blades from Grukkar, and they used them to fight the enemies. After that, they fled Nar Shaddaa. #### Vrogas Vas

> " The smuggler Dax Karrick has an associate. Or a pet, I'm not sure. It's a… furry creature of some sort… […] " " A Vorak ? " " Yes! His name is Chew…Chew something. Chew…bacca? " " RRRRRRWWWWWGGHHHHH! " ―0-0-0, Doctor Vexa, and Brevok

title: Brevok
text:
At some point, Solen was nearly captured by the Imperium while transporting important information on Skorii-Lei , but escaped with the help of an inhabitant of the planet named Pash Davane . Karrick, Drayden, and Brevok helped the two escape in the Corsair Wing .

#### The Screaming Citadel

> " Hrrrrrrgggh! " " I know, Brev, and I'm sorry. But if Sana is right and Joren's on Ktath'atn, we can't risk bringing a Vorak with us. " ―Brevok and Dax Karrick

When Drayden left with Vexa for the Screaming Citadel , and Karrick, Solen, and Starric were preparing to go rescue him, Brevok attempted to go with them, but was not allowed, because the people of Ktath'atn were extremely hostile towards Voraks.

#### The Grak Run

Later, Karrick was asked by Sess to transport Grukkar to an Insurgent holding facility in the catacombs of Akiva . During the trip, Karrick and Brevok were attacked by several SKREE fighters. Brevok manned the Corsair Wing ' s turret while Karrick flew, but they had to give up and land on a nearby asteroid, since the Corsair ' s hyperrelay was damaged. Grukkar killed the shock troopers that boarded the ship, and then attacked Karrick, but in doing so, let information regarding the planet Teth slip out. Karrick electrocuted Grukkar, and they continued on to Akiva.

#### Odona

At one point, Karrick and Solen were on Odona looking for a new spot for an Insurgent base. They were attacked by Frax, and Solen was grazed by a volt pistol bolt. Brevok helped her into the Corsair, and they fled.

#### Frostmark

title: Brevok
text:
#### Odona

At one point, Karrick and Solen were on Odona looking for a new spot for an Insurgent base. They were attacked by Frax, and Solen was grazed by a volt pistol bolt. Brevok helped her into the Corsair, and they fled.

#### Frostmark

> " Laugh it up, fuzzball! " ―Dax Karrick, in response to Brevok laughing at him — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Now full-fledged members of the Free Coalition, and following a dangerous run-in with bounty hunter on Ord Mantell , Brevok accompanied Karrick to Frostmark , for they had been assigned to the newly-established Icehold , where Brevok would be effecting repairs on the Corsair Wing to pay their debt to Grukk once and for all.

title: Brevok
text:
While at Icehold, Brevok was assigned to digging corridors by Solen. On one of these assignments, Brevok dug into a cave occupied by a frostmaw . The beast captured him and held him hostage. After not checking in, Elira and Bolt-3 started looking for him. They found a scared Brevok clutched in the hands of the sleeping frostmaw. Solen's attempted rescue of Brevok ended with the frostmaw waking up. The Vorak ran to repair the door, which led to the uncovered cave with Bolt-3, while Elira acted as a distraction. At the last minute, Brevok finished his job on the door, and with Solen back inside, he closed it and trapped the woken beast in the cave.

Brevok's repairs on the Corsair were when Karrick had to venture outside during Frostmark's night to rescue Drayden. Soon afterwards, Brevok and Karrick destroyed an Imperial probe droid , but could not prevent it from transmitting information back to the Imperium, revealing the location of the hidden Insurgent base. The Imperium consequently launched an all-out assault on the planet, forcing Brevok, Karrick, Solen and Astra-9 to flee on the Corsair Wing .

title: Brevok
text:
However, with the Corsair ' s damaged hyperrelay, they were unable to leave the system and escape the Imperial blockade, which prompted Karrick to pilot the ship into a nearby asteroid field, hoping that the Imperials would be unwilling to follow them there. Evading several pursuing SKREE fighters, they landed the ship inside a cave of a large asteroid, where they hoped to hide from Imperial forces and complete repairs. While waiting inside the cavern, Brevok continued to repair the freighter until mynocks attacked it; soon, they realized the cave was in fact the inside of a space slug , forcing them to flee. The Corsair was subsequently attacked by the Imperial Iron Cruiser Avenger , but with a maneuver devised by Karrick, they were able to avoid the vessel and fled to Aether Spire on the gas giant Mistral , where they would request help from Quill, an old acquaintance of Dax's. Unbeknownst to them, they were followed by the bounty hunter Vex Vark.

#### Aether Spire

title: Brevok
text: Separated from the others, Brevok began to partially reassemble Astra-9, when Karrick was escorted back by shock troopers, having been tortured by Velgor, with Solen. They were eventually brought to Quill's carbon-freezing facilities where Karrick was to be frozen in carbonite to test it before Drayden arrived, for Velgor desired to encase Drayden in carbonite and present him to the Emperor. Though Brevok tried to fight, wanting to protect his old friend, Karrick calmed him down, asking him to save his strength for another day. The Vorak then relented and allowed himself to be placed in stuncuffs as Karrick was marched off and frozen.

title: Brevok
text:
As Brevok and Solen being escorted to Velgor's ship, Quill, who was growing increasingly dissatisfied with Velgor's deal, betrayed the Umbra Lord and freed the two. Brevok, though, was not quick to trust him and reacted violently, choking him. The princess was able to calm him enough for Quill to inform them that Vex Vark was about to leave Aether Spire carrying the carbonite-frozen Karrick. Together, they set out to save their friend but did not manage to prevent Vark from leaving with his bounty. The team then boarded the Corsair to escape the city, briefly returning to save Drayden, who had fought and lost a duel on Aether Spire with the Umbra Lord.

text:
#### Rendezvous Point Delta-Three

If this succeeds, the integrity of the cordon will be reduced, and— " " I understand Vorak tongue, Goldie. I get the idea. Doesn't mean it ain't crazy. " ―Dorian Quill, Brevok, and Astra-9

Quill affirmed his desire to rescue Karrick, proposing instead to intercept Karrick at the palace of Grukk the Grak.

title: Brevok

Solen, accepting that Karrick could not immediately be saved, ordered Brevok to set course for the Insurgent fleet, overriding Quill’s objections and again issuing her companion the command. The Vorak complied, leading Solen and company to discover insurgents under attack by Imperial forces at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three. The princess instructed Brevok to create a hole in the blockade before taking to the Corsair ' s guns, Quill persuaded the Vorak to reluctantly allow him to take the pilot’s seat.

title: Brevok
text:
Quill, questioning the Corsair ' s ability to contribute, led Brevok to reveal the starship’s ST2 missile launchers which, while effective, could not incapacitate an Iron Cruiser. The Vorak, translated by Astra-9, suggested that they need not destroy an entire ship, just cripple its gun emplacements. Quill, acknowledging the plan as crazy, noted a belief that time spent with Karrick had made Brevok far less rational. Drayden and Solen destroyed a number of SKREE fighters, allowing Quill and Brevok to make a successful attack run.

title: Brevok
text:
#### Return to Dunemere

> " Dunemere. Been a long time since I saw this hellhole. " " HRROK! " " You said it, pal. Not long enough. " ―Dorian Quill and Brevok

The crew of the Corsair escaped to Backup Rendezvous Point Gamma-Nine, meeting up with the Fourth Division of the Alliance Fleet, where Solen ordered Brevok not to let Quill out of his sight. Quill pressured Solen to allow him to take the Corsair to Dunemere to confirm whether Grukk had Karrick. Solen agreed, but insisted Brevok accompany him. The Vorak roared, intimidating Quill and causing him to restate his submission. Quill told Brevok it was "time to fly," to which the pair agreed the latter would pilot the Corsair this time around. The group subsequently parted ways—Solen, Drayden and the droids remained with the fleet, whereas Brevok and Quill set out to find Vark and Grukk to rescue Karrick.

title: Brevok
text:
In orbit of Dunemere, Quill and the Vorak reflected on their distaste at returning to the sand planet before being fired upon by a squadron of SKREE fighters, the Corsair having been identified as a wanted ship. The pair debated the fault of the matter, and the Skrees were ambushed and destroyed by a group of Weequay, who hailed the ship and demanded Dax Karrick. Brevok’s first instinct was to fight, but Quill, recognizing that they were outmatched, opted for deception. Quill cued the Vorak to power up the Corsair ' s empty missile tubes and talked his way out of combat and into proceeding to his audience with Grukk.

After the meeting, Quill returned to Brevok aboard the Corsair , informing him that Grukk did not yet have Karrick. Quill requested that Brevok drop him off and leave him to his own devices, which the latter refused to do.

title: Brevok
text:
At some point, Brevok put out word of his search for Vex Vark among free Voraks across the galaxy. The smuggler heard back from Sagor, a Vorak he had himself freed from the Spice Mines of Cindral, who reported a sighting of Vark on Nar Shaddaa. Brevok subsequently spoke to Drayden after his flux blade training in the ship's gym and, with Astra-9 translating, requested the Aetheri's assistance on a mission to the Smuggler's Moon. A familiar smell

> " GHUURRGG. " " Thank you…but I don't understand Vorak tongue. " " He said if you truly care about Dax Karrick, you will trust him to save him. There may come a time when he needs your help…Until then, he asks that you stay out of his way—or he will rip out your cybernetic arms and beat you to death with them. His words, not mine. " ―Brevok, Beilert Varrick, and Astra-9

title: Brevok
text: Brevok piloted the Corsair to Nar Shaddaa while Drayden sat in the co-pilot's seat, reflecting on their prior encounter there with Grukkar the Grak. The Vorak traveled to Oruba Square alongside Astra-9, where he convened with a cloaked Mirialan. Brevok paid the informant, who then relayed to him that his contact, Sagor, would meet his fellow Vorak at the entrance to the local arena. The Vorak rebuffed Astra-9's complaints, claiming that Nar Shaddaa was "charming," not dreadful as the protocol droid has proposed, and reflected on his prior traumatic electrocution on the Smuggler's Moon before catching wind of "a familiar smell." Brevok barged into the crowd before bumping into an old acquaintance—cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Varrick.

title: Brevok
text: The cyborg recognized Brevok as Karrick's ally, while Brevok remembered Varrick's participation a shootout against the two smugglers on Abregado-Raena. The Vorak hoisted Varrick off his feet and growled at him, the bounty hunter claiming the situation to be a misunderstanding. Varrick's partner, rival bounty hunter Dengrik, watched, while Astra-9 flustered about Brevok's failure to maintain a low profile against Drayden's orders. Varrick punched Brevok, refusing to allow anyone to interfere in his own search for Karrick, while trying to defuse the situation. The bounty hunter lowered his palm volt pistols in deference, providing Brevok the opportunity to throw him into a table where Dengrik had taken a seat and ordered a drink.

title: Brevok
text:
Brevok then grabbed Dengrik, the very bounty hunter to electrocute the Vorak on his last outing to the Smuggler's Moon, Astra-9 informing him that the species were notorious for holding grudges. Dengrik pulled his volt pistol and attempted to shoot the Brevok, despite an attempt at intervention from Varrick, who then kicked the Vorak's legs out from under him and fashioned a sharpened stick out of a nearby pole. Varrick spoke to the events of Abregado-Raena, telling Brevok that he did not intend to kill them once he realized Karrick was the target, throwing down his weapon and reflecting on his time spent with Karrick as Imperial cadets. The bounty hunter concluded that he owed Karrick a debt and intended to aid him with or without the Vorak's permission.

The fight at its end, Brevok offered Varrick a hand up. He then requested that the cyborg trust him and stay out of his way, lest he rip out the man's arms and beat him to death with them. Astra-9 translated for the bounty hunter, who did not understand Vorak tongue, before departing with the Vorak.

Drayden and Sagor

text:
Drayden and Sagor

> " HROOO! " " Brevok is reluctant to leave without more information on Vex Vark. " " Brev, we don't even know if it was Vex Vark. I think…we might have to find another way to track down Dax. " " ARRRGH! " ―Brevok, Astra-9, and Joren Drayden

Brevok met with Sagor, embracing him as Astra-9 explained their history to Drayden. title: Brevok

The Vorak voiced his reluctance to leave without more information, but Drayden, unable to say for certain whether the arena warrior was indeed Vark, doubled down on the decision to escape. Brevok fired off a final round of support fire but left with Drayden, Sagor, and Astra-9.

The insurgents and Sawga encountered more hired guns. Drayden, under fire, directed Brevok to commandeer a nearby speeder, which the four used to successfully return to the Corsair . The Vorak later headed to the Corsair ' s cockpit, where he received a transmission from Solen, instructing the ship to return to the Insurgent Fleet, as she had received a transmission from a mystery party claiming to be in possession of Karrick. Brevok, requesting that the Aetheri join him, relayed the message to Drayden via Astra-9.

title: Brevok
text:
#### Arrival at Jekara

> " HROOOO! " " What? What's the matter, Brevok? Who's Carmine Dawn? " " HRRAGH! HROOO. HRRRRGH! " " If you will allow me to translate, Master Joren…It seems that Carmine Dawn was an extremely powerful criminal organization particularly known for tactics involving savagery and deception. While they have not been active in the galaxy for many years, Brevok has had dealings with them in the past. It did not go well. If they have returned and are in possession of Master Karrick, it could be a very delicate and dangerous situation indeed. " ―Brevok, Joren Drayden, and Astra-9

title: Brevok
text:
Solen rendezvoused with the others aboard the Corsair , declaring it was finally time to save Karrick. Drayden, though enthusiastic, raised concerns, leading Solen to produce a hologram sent by her friend and informant Amilyn Holdra. Solen told Drayden Hold had informed her that Karrick was being held by Carmine Dawn, sending Brevok into an agitated state. Astra-9 translated Brevok for Drayden, who was unaware of Carmine Dawn, as the Vorak conveyed the reputation and history of the crime syndicate. The Vorak also reluctantly suggested involving Quill, to which Solen gave the go-ahead. Brevok then departed, Astra-9 accompanying him. Brevok spoke to Quill aboard the insurgent frigate Redemption , where Quill affirmed his willingness to help. The Vorak later piloted the Corsair through hyperspace to Jekara, where the auction was to be held. Brevok backed Quill's assessment of Carmine Dawn to Solen before announcing their arrival. Shortly after, the Corsair suffered a minor collision with a frigate that emerged from hyperspace immediately in front of it. The ship, belonging to the Black Sun, launched its fighters, which fired on and pursued the insurgents' craft, leading Brevok to take it into Jekara's atmosphere. Navigating the planet's icy terrain, the Vorak managed a crash landing before emerging from the Corsair with Solen and the others, the princess claiming that the team was Karrick's only hope.

Solen signaled Drayden, but the Aetheri was unable to fight Velgor, leading Elira to formulate a plan herself. Astra-9, who had repaired the ship along with Lobot, inquired about the Vorak's odd smell, to which he related the details of his fight with Vex Vark.

#### Insurgents in space

> " Brevok says the ship's diagnostic computer is back online, as Lando suggested it would be. He will begin repairing vital systems immediately. " " That's wonderful, Brev. " ―Astra-9 and Elira Solen, to Brevok

The insurgents pursued the Imperial shuttle that had taken Karrick, utilizing Lobot's implants to disable it. Vark and Beilert Varrick, with whom Vark had temporarily partnered, also aimed to capture Karrick, and incapacitated the Corsair with a reduced–intensity seismic charge. Dead in space, Brevok assisted Quill in attempting to repair the ships's systems from the cockpit. The Vorak observed that Vark's charge had rattled the Corsair , and Quill concurred that it had knocked various systems offline. Brevok also observed Grak starfighters heading towards the Imperial shuttle that was carrying Karrick, which Lando attributed to Grukk the Grak desiring Dax for himself.

title: Brevok
text: The trio went into the bowels of the Corsair to repair the ship, which proved hazardous as the offline engines caused the reactor conduits to let off a repeating cycle of bursts. Both Solen and Brevok volunteered to make the repairs, but Quill opted to fix the problem himself, the Vorak pulling him out at the last minute to prevent him from being fried. Quill told Brevok that the ship's diagnostic computer should be back online; the Vorak headed to the cockpit and confirmed as much to Astra-9, who relayed the good news to Solen. Solen offered to help conduct repairs, but Brevok believed that she would only get in the way. The Vorak was subsequently able to restore many of the Corsair ' s systems.

title: Brevok
text:
The Graks dispatched fighters to intercept Karrick, causing Brevok to scream at Quill for his role in precipitating the situation as Solen related the situation to Drayden over the ship's comms. With the repairs made, Quill and the Vorak succeeded in restarting the ships' engines. Solen noted that the point was moot—Karrick had already been brought aboard the Super Iron Cruiser Sovereign —when the Corsair received a message from the Imperial ship arranged by Vessa, inviting them to board.

Once safely aboard and welcomed by an agent of Carmine Dawn, Brevok participated in the insurgent attack, downing shock troopers alongside Solen and Quill. The insurgents, heaving reached Karrick, incapacitated all of the Imperials. Quill began trying to figure out how to defrost Karrick from carbonite when the group was approached and held at volt pistol-point by Vex Vark. At that moment, an errant blast blew out the Sovereign ' s hull, sending Karrick into space. Vark pursued the carbonite brick with his jetpack, leaving the insurgents devastated at their near victory.

#### Dawn of a revelation

title: Brevok
text:
#### Dawn of a revelation

> " I…I can't believe it. Dax's…alive? " " HRRRAOH? " " It's true, Brevok. Grukk has him. " " HRAAAOH! " ―Elira Solen, Brevok, and Vessa

Solen later confided in Brevok aboard the Corsair , sharing a newfound belief that hope was "for suckers," causing the Vorak to pull her into a comforting embrace. Quill and Lobot sought to return the pair to the Alliance but were interrupted by the arrival of the Vermillion , Carmine Dawn's flagship. The insurgents then received a transmission indicating from Lady Vessa indicating that she wished to meet with the princess. Solen relented, and Vessa boarded the Corsair , the Vorak keeping his bowcaster trained on her until the women left to talk in private.

The princess later called Brevok to provide her with a pair of binder cuffs, intending to bring Vessa before a insurgent tribunal. However, Vessa provided the revelation that Karrick was alive, stunning Solen and causing the Vorak to cry out and drop the binders. Solen ultimately allowed Vessa to leave to the ends of pursuing a possible future alliance.

#### Readying for assault

> " Brev's been spending his time practicing an assault on Grukk the Grak's palace. He's visualizing it in his head, planning his assault. He even programmed training droids to act like Grukk's guards. He wants to go in there all alone to bring out Dax Karrick . " ―Elira Solen, to Vessa

Reunited with the fleet, Brevok was present at a insurgent strategy meeting headed by Senator Vela Sess and Admiral Gial Vorian aimed at addressing the Alliance's long–standing secondary objectives, including re-establishing a supply chain and recovering Lieutenant Shara Bay, trapped on the Iron Cruiser Varrix's Will .

Lady Vessa visited Home One and wished to visit Brevok before her departure. Elira Solen took her to the Vorak, explaining that he was practicing a simulated assault on Grukk's palace. Brevok had programmed remotes to act as Grukk's sentries and vividly visualized the attack in his mind. He desired to rescue Dax Karrick single-handedly, a course of action Vessa described as ill-advised. Interrupted by Solen and Vessa, Brev shot the latter a look for her role in recent events, a finger on his bowcaster's trigger.

Brevok joined Solen in her hunt for Commander Zhara on the planet Panisia, pursuing her into a cave. One of the insurgent Pathfinders offered him a knife, only for the Vorak to reveal that he had brought one himself. The insurgents eventually found Zhara, who engaged both the Pathfinders and Brevok in melee combat, incapacitating the former and seemingly gaining the upper hand over the latter.

The Imperial focused her attention on Kes Vale and consequently turned her back on Brevok, who hurled her over a ledge and into a cavern below. Solen, who had been similarly displaced, pursued Zhara while Brevok and Vale caught up, ultimately joining the princess in repelling a giant monster the women had found in the cave. After retrieving a datacard from Zhara, Solen left her to die, leaving the cave alongside the Pathfinder and the Vorak.

title: Brevok
text:
Brevok later co-piloted the Corsair Wing in an air raid on an Imperial Unity Day Parade on Bar'leth, the result of which was a major success for the Insurgency. The Vorak later joined his squadron-mates in toasting to the victory. Brevok also attended an intelligence briefing led by General Lena Kryll during which Drayden interjected, expressing a "good feeling" about point five, a transmission intercepted from two Imperial defectors.

#### The death box

> " You want to know why I did that. Isn't it obvious? The Imperium took my world. Thornwood is enslaved. My people . My family! I have not seen my wife and son in many years. For all I know, they are dead. Mal stole the strength of my people and turned our forests to ash. The Voraks do not have the luxury of debate . You said this thing would kill Mal. So I killed him. " " I understand, Brevok. I think we all do. Maybe you did what we couldn't. " ―Brevok, as translated by Astra-9, and Elira Solen

text:
Drayden learned of a device that could kill Mal, the Grim Rose , from the Aetheri Azlin Rell , whose sentience was preserved in the Living Sea of Gazian . Brevok helped to recover the weapon and activated it, though Drayden subsequently shut it down to prevent it from committing a galaxy–wide genocide in the process.

#### Karrick's rescue

> Elira : « I have come for the bounty on this Vorak. » Astra-9 : " Oh, no! Brevok! " Grukk : « At last we have the mighty Brevok. » ―Brevok is delivered to Grukk

Aware of Karrick's location on Grukk's Palace , the team gradually infiltrated the fortress to rescue the Korrathi: First, Quill infiltrated as a guard, then the droids as Drayden's "gift," then Elira Solen posing as the bounty hunter Boushh with Brevok as her quarry; she convinced Grukk with a thermal detonator, so the Grak had Brevok imprisoned.

title: Brevok
text:
That night, Solen freed Karrick from his encasement at the cost of her freedom, for Grukk had caught her red-handed, and whereas the princess was to remain at the Grak's side, Karrick was thrown in a cell together with Brevok, who gave him a passionate embrace, happy to reunite with his old friend, and told him that Drayden would free them with the skills he had learned as an Aetheri Knight . Drayden did indeed arrive and requested an audience with Grukk by influencing the crime lord's majordomo Bib Fortuna . After Drayden was pit against Grukk's rancor and defeated it, the enraged Grak ordered the execution of Brevok, Karrick and Drayden by casting them into the Great Pit of Karkoon in the Dune Sea , to be devoured by the devourer that resided there. Brought to the pit in a skiff , Drayden recovered his new flux blade and freed Brevok and Karrick from their bonds. However, one of Grukk's staff fired at them, injuring Brevok, and leaving the near-blind Karrick to rescue Quill from falling into the pit. While Solen assassinated Grukk himself, the group went on to slay the rest of the Grak's thugs, before destroying the crime lord's sail barge and returning to the Insurgent Fleet aboard the Corsair .

#### Mossfell

> " Keep your distance, Brev, but don't look like you're keeping your distance. […] I don't know – fly casual. " ―Dax to Brevok during the mission to Mossfell — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Brevok
text:
#### Shattering the Imperium

Following the Battle of Mossfell, Brevok would join Dax and their insurgent companions in the Free Coalition's struggle against the remnants of the Imperium. The morning after, he would take part in the assault on an Imperial holdout on far side of Mossfell, the Insurgents hitting the base hard and fast, and entering to find their computers with data that signaled the war was not over yet. After Karrick proposed to Solen in the days after the Battle of Mossfell, he made sure to tell Brevok. Brevok had always suspected Karrick would settle down—although Solen retorted that marrying her was the opposite of settling down—and knew his friend would end up marrying Solen, even declaring at one point to Drayden that he would drop both on a deserted world as a means of getting them to admit their feelings. Brevok then attended the party Quill threw for Karrick in honor of the wedding, taking a particular enjoyment in the food Quill had set out, and the wedding itself.

title: Brevok
text:
Twenty days or so later, Brevok participated alongside Karrick, Astra-9, Kes Vale, Sakas and other Insurgent troops on a raid on an IVB black site at the Wretch of Tayron . During the mission, he saved Sergeant Vale's life after he and Sakas made an opening on the black site. Brevok also fetched Astra-9, who had fallen behind, to enter the facility and slice its computers. The group then became aware of the concurrent Operation: Cinder and contacted Quill to deploy the Alliance Fleet so as to successfully aid the besieged Ondara .

text:
### Concordat

#### Return to Thornwood

False starts

> " C'mon, Brev. Set new coordinates. It's time to get you home. " ―Dax Karrick

Now agents of the Concordat , just as Torb Rask set out on a reconnaissance mission that took him to Akiva, Brevok and Karrick went on their own mission to find the Imperium's supply lines, during which they visited several planets, including Ord Mantell, Ando Prime , Kara-bin and finally Dasoor . However, Brevok was forced to remain on the Corsair , while Karrick investigated on his own; having grown bored, he got to messing around with the ship's navigation system, trying to chase down a glitch that had been screwing up the hyperspace drive. Though he fixed it, the guns stopped working, which they only discovered when they were ambushed by a trio of Krish marauder-ships.

title: Brevok
text:
However, as they reached Dasoor, Imra contacted the duo and informed them that they had a window of opportunity—Thornwood, still in the Imperium's thrall, would have its blockade temporarily lifted for a few days, before its ships were replaced. Seeing Brevok's anxiety, Karrick told Imra to gather any underworld scoundrel who owed him a favor, anyone who hated the Imperium, and others in the false promise that they would obtain full pardons from the Republic, whereas Brevok was tasked to contact the Vorak mercenaries , among them Roshyk , Hrrgn , and Kirratha . When Dax's wife Elira learned about Dax Karrick's hastily-improvised plan, she tried to advice her husband and Brevok not to trust Imra. However, Dax and Brevok were determined to proceed with their campaign to liberate Thornwood. Unfortunately, Imra's information turned out to be a trap set by the Imperium. While Brevok attempted to board a gunship captained by Kirratha, they were attacked by two Star Destroyers and several SKREE fighters. The Imperials shot out Kirratha's engines, leaving Brevok and Kirratha stranded in space. Dax managed to escape but Brevok was captured and locked inside the automated Imperial prison Ashmead's Lock in the jungles of Thornwood. Karrick traveled through Wild Space on the Corsair Wing in attempt to find a way to free his friend.

Escaping Ashmead's Lock

title: Brevok
text:
Escaping Ashmead's Lock

Later, Karrick discovered that Ashmead's Lock had been designed by the Siniteen architect Golas Aram , who resided on a secluded compound in the planet Irudiru . Dax was joined by a team of insurgents consisting of the Concordat starfighter pilot Nevra Wexlin , her son Temmin Wexlin , his battle droid Mister Bones , the former Imperial loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus , the Zyrrak bounty hunter Jas Emari , and the Concordat soldier Jom Barell . Nevra and her team had been sent by Princess Elira to rescue Dax. Working together, the insurgents managed to storm Golas' compound and forced him to divulge information about Ashmead's Lock. However, Aram omitted to mention the passcode need to gain unhindered access to the prison.

title: Brevok
text:
Following a struggle with Ashmead Lock's computer system SOL-GDA , Karrick and Jas managed to disable the prison's power generator, which was fueled by the prisoners who were held in stasis. Karrick managed to free Brevok and a hundred other prisoners including Nevra's husband and Temmin's father Brentin Lore Wexlin . Following an emotional reunion, Brevok stayed behind with Karrick, Sinjir, Jas, and Jom while Nevra, Temmin, and Mister Bones returned with the other liberated prisoners to the Concordat capital of Serenne .

Liberation of Thornwood

For the next month, Dax and Brevok organized a campaign to hunt down Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck , the governor of Thornwood. Lozen had fitted all of the Voraks living on Thornwood with inhibitor chips which he controlled using a control module that he kept on his person. In order to defeat Grand Moff Tolruck, Brevok and his insurgent allies devoted their time to finding Tolruck's island fortress . Jas also recruited more Vorak exiles and smugglers for their planned uprising. During this time, Jom was captured and imprisoned by Tolruck.

title: Brevok
text:
While Brevok, Dax, and the rest of the team infiltrated Camp Sardo , Sinjir infiltrated Tolruck's palace disguised as an Imperial officer. Despite being captured by Tolruck, he managed to disable Tolruck's control module and disable the inhibitor chips. This set off a mass Vorak uprising all over Thornwood. Meanwhile, Brevok and his team fought off a Low-altitude Imperial transport while Jas destroyed Camp Sardo's deflector shield generator. With the aid of Dax's insurgent forces, the Voraks managed to overwhelm the meager Imperial garrison on Thornwood.

After Grand Moff Tolruck summoned the three orbiting Imperial Star Destroyers to bombard Thornwood, Brevok and his fellow insurgents helped usher the liberated Voraks into underground shelters. In response, Brevok along with Dax, Sinjir, and Jom Barell traveled aboard the Iron Cruiser Dominion . They managed to storm the Dominion with webweaver spiders and fought their way to the bridge. However, the insurgents were captured by shock troopers and hauled before Vice Admiral Domm Korgale .

title: Brevok
text:
Before Korgale could deal with the prisoners, Concordat reinforcements arrived in the form of Princess Elira aboard the Corsair Wing , Captain Torb Rask and his Phantom Squadron , and Fleet Admiral Vorian's flagship Home One . Brevok and his allies managed to break free from their captors and seize control of the Dominion . They then used the Dominion ' s cannons to destroy the nearby Vitiator . As a result, the remaining Imperial Iron Cruiser Neutralizer capitulated to the Concordat. Following the liberation of Thornwood, Brevok stayed behind to reunite with his family at the insistence of Dax Karrick. Karrick then left on the Corsair Wing to look after his wife and his unborn son Beno Karrick.

Reunion with Waroo

title: Brevok
text:
Reunion with Waroo

In the successive months, Brevok took part in mopping up operations against the remaining Imperial holdouts on Thornwood. While accompanying Greybok and several Concordat soldiers on one such operation, they stumbled upon Commandant Dessard and several Imperial soldiers preparing to execute an escaped Vorak slave who turned out to be Brevok's son Lumpawaroo. The Voraks and Concordat soldiers killed Dessard's men and took the officer prisoner. Brevok personally restrained Dessard by stepping over the commandant and placing a tree-trunk led on his back, forcing him to the ground. Brevok then experienced an emotional reunion with his lost son, who had been forced to work at a child labor camp on the slopes of Mount Arayakyak .

#### Peaceful retirement

> " No. No! You have to stay here. We fought like hell for this and now…this is yours. Okay? All yours. This is home. You got people here and I want you to find them. You hear me? That's my last demand. No arguments. " ―Dax Karrick to Brevok after liberating Thornwood

title: Brevok
text:
Despite his peaceful retirement, Brevok decided to join him when Dax Karrick resumed his smuggling activities. Fortunately, the strong familial bonds and the extended lifespan of the Voraks allowed him to spend decades away from his people.

#### Smuggler's Run

> " Thing people forget about Voraks. They remember that they're very strong, they remember they've got a temper, they remember maybe that they're from Thornwood. But they forget one thing. " " What's that? " " They can be very, very quiet when it suits them. Isn't that right, Brev? " ―Dax Karrick and Strater Brevok and Karrick continued their partnership. Brevok would keep an eye out for him, including one time during which Karrick engaged a trio of bounty hunters— Strater , Hove , and Rigger —sent to capture him on the Serendipity cantina, and told them about their mission to Cyrkon before they realized who he was. Once they were aware of Karrick's identity, Brevok sneaked behind them and took hold of Rigger, only to send him flying to the Serendipity ' s door and knock Strater out with a punch, while Karrick disarmed Bobbie. Then, the Korrathi told them to warn their possible employers ( Gannis Ducain , the Irving Boys , the Guavians , etc.) that they were not afraid of them, before saying goodbye to Leighton and leaving the bar together.
