Kael was so excited that it was several minutes before he realized that Shira had not been freed as well, and he was dismayed when Shira insisted that Kael go with Vael to a better future without her. Packing his stuff, Drayden bid goodbye to Astra-9, but when it came time to leave, Kael's resolve broke and he ran back to his mother. He promised that he would return and free her. Despite their sorrow at parting, Shira convinced her son to go with the Aetheri.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
As they raced towards the starship that Ondar and Vael had come to Dunemere on, Drayden was suddenly ordered to drop to the ground and complied just as a dark- robed figure, Umbra Lord Vael Vreth , shot overhead on a speeder. The man leaped at Vael, drawing a red-bladed flux blade and attacking the Aetheri as Vael urged Drayden to get aboard the ship and to take off. He rushed aboard, and Ondar took him to the cockpit to tell Vael's apprentice , Orien Kade , what had happened. The pilot Ric Olié followed Kade's instructions to fly towards the fight, and Drayden scrambled into a seat as Kade raced to the landing ramp and helped Vael escape from the dark warrior . Drayden and Kade rushed to help Vael as the ship took off and left Dunemere. When they were convinced Sorin was fine, the Aetheri master introduced Orien to Kael, who was happy to meet another Aetheri.

Before the Aetheri Council

> " He is the Seeded One. You must see it! " ―Sorin Vael pleads to the Council to train Kael — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Before the Aetheri Council

> " He is the Seeded One. You must see it! " ―Sorin Vael pleads to the Council to train Kael — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Later that night, aboard the ship, which Drayden learned was the personal starship of the Queen of the planet Ondara, Drayden struggled to fall asleep in the central chamber, as the ship's temperature was radically different to the constant heat of Dunemere that he was used to. As he huddled in silence, Drayden witnessed Ondar enter the room and watch a recording of a plea for help from the Ondara official Sio Bibble . She then noticed him and gave him her blanket, and the two discussed the Commerce Combine's invasion of Ondara and Ondar's hopes that the Republic's Galactic Senate could resolve the crisis. Drayden gave her a japor ivory wood pendant that he had carved for her so that she would remember him, and Ondar comforted him as he became sad as he remembered his mother.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Ondar accepted Drayden's gift and came to wear the japor snippet as a necklace, which she wore for years to come. She came to view it as a way to represent remembrance and luck. When they finally arrived at the Republic capital of Vantor, Drayden watched from the cockpit in awe as they approached the city-planet, and the ship was greeted when it landed by Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum , Senator Mal of Ondara, and a contingent of Senate Guards. The Queen and her handmaidens—including Ondar—departed with Mal, though they brought Drayden and Mool along with them to Mal's office and left them outside while they discussed the situation. Before he went to the Aetheri Sanctum , Drayden went to the Queen's chambers in search of Ondar, but the Queen promised to pass on his message when the handmaiden was absent. Unbeknownst to Drayden, however, the Queen was in fact Lira.

title: Xarn Velgor

Before Drayden could give his definite answer, at Zho's behest, both student and master responded to a mysterious distress signal from the supposedly dead world of Carnelion IV that specifically called for Aetheri intercession. They began their journey to the coordinates, but their shuttle was damaged due to the planet's atmospheric debris field, and the two had to eject from the doomed vessel, landing below the Celadon Sea . Not too long afterward, they came to be aware of life on the planet as a sky battle raged over them, and Kade returned his flux blade to him so that he could defend himself. As one of the combatant airships began to fall, Drayden and Kade saved its two-person crew by delaying the crash.

They were forced to take cover when a " Closed " airship, which Kade fell; Drayden saved its pilot, Grecker , from falling to his death. But due to the historical feud between their factions, Grecker and Pran tried to murder each other, forcing Drayden and Kade to destroy their weapons and to escort them to safety. To facilitate their journey, they used the intact parts of each of their airships to form a new one in order to fly to their destination. Drayden was taken to one of the Open's fortresses, where he witnessed as Pran used the processors he had repaired to activate some battle droids. text: Drayden's knighthood was soon legitimized by a Knighting Ceremony . Fellow Adept-turned-Knight Iskat Vekkis rationalized to herself that he had proven himself at the Battle of Pyralis and that, if she was ready to be a Knight, so was Drayden. Drayden spent the night after his Knighting Ceremony with Ondar in which he presented her with an Adept braid pendant he had made for her after his Adept braid was cut. Shortly after his knighting ceremony, the Purse World of Cato Geltaria , the headquarters of the Commerce Combine, was rocked by a destructive explosion that was blamed on the Republic. Kade, now an Aetheri Master and an acting Council member, was selected to travel to Cato Geltaria to investigate the explosion. Wanting to clear any Dissident involvement, Varek sent his own agent to Cato Geltaria as well, which was later revealed to be the Dark Adept Kessa Vray .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Shortly after arriving on Cato Geltaria, Drayden and Alibeth found a series of bombs planted in important Geltari landmarks which they later discovered were planted by Ketar Nor to send a message to the Republic. After landing on the Resolute , Vek later noticed Kessith blood in the shuttle, and pursued Vorek, who nevertheless managed to escape in a V-19 starfighter . Drayden and Marr returned to the Aetheri Council to report their failure.

text: During the lengthy campaign on Malastare , Drayden discussed with Mal, who contacted them via hologram, and Koss the effects of the new electro-proton bomb , just as the Dissident Droid Army prepared a new attack—with the Republic expecting to successfully defend the Dugs and secure a treaty for their fuel . Though exceedingly effective, the bomb created a crater, which Koss went to investigate whereas Drayden was to ensure the treaty with Doge Urus , only to be called by Koss to assist him with the scouting. The two soon discovered a gigantic creature whose armored skin was impervious even to flux blades, the Zyll Beast , from which they fled, only to be told by Urus that they wanted it killed, even though it was previously thought to be extinct. With the use of RX-200 Falchion -class assault tanks , the Republic forces put the creature to sleep , convincing the Dugs that it was dead. With the treaty signed and Malastare now a member of the Republic, Mal ordered that the beast be shipped to Vantor for study, despite Koss's objections.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After the Zyll Beast was brought to the Republic capital, Kade and Ondar asked Drayden to speak with Mal about the fate of the creature; reluctantly, he agreed. When both he and Ondar met with the Chancellor, Mal and the Vice Chair Mazan Veldon tried to justify that killing the beast was for the greater good—Ondar objected to their claims, but Drayden chose to stay neutral, instead of opposing either his wife, Ondar, or his friend, Mal. Although Mal claimed that he wished to kill the beast, he in fact wanted to research it as he was intrigued by the durability of the Zyll beast's armor. However, the beast escaped from captivity in Dr. Boll's laboratory and directly targeted the Chancellor himself for his attempts to kill it. Cornered by the beast, Drayden and the others evacuated his office on his executive shuttle , only for the beast to grab it upon take-off. They were freed when Drayden sliced the shuttle in half, causing everyone to fall out of the shuttle, with Drayden saving Ondar from falling from the Senate Building's roof. The Beast was ultimately killed when gunships fired gas at its mouth on Mal's orders.

#### Second Battle of Pyralis

> " I knew they were still alive. I told you not to give up on them. " " It's not that I gave up, Drayden, but unlike you, when the time comes, I am prepared to let my student go. Can you say the same? " ―Kael Drayden and Luminara Undula

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Immediately after routing Dissidents near Dorin , Drayden and Marr were sent to participate in the Second Battle of Pyralis , alongside Kade and Reth-Oss-Van, as the Republic returned to destroy the Pyralian primary droid factory . Intending to make a three-pronged attack against the shield generator, Drayden, Marr, and the 501st Legion set out to attack the Dissident defense lines from the south to reach the rendezvous point—with only Kade's forces arriving at the landing zone, as both Mundi's and Drayden's transports were shot down and forced to make their way to Kade's position by foot. Though they encountered coalition, Drayden's team met up with Mundi's forces. After contacting Yular to deploy a squadron of BTL-B Yarrows to help them, they reunited with Kade and his company, where they planned the assault on the shield generator.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: They then improvised on their plan; leading the charge, Drayden and Marr disabled the enemy cannons with EMP grenades , enabling the AT-TEs to destroy the shield generator; as the gunships arrived, the Geonosians in the area surrendered. Though Mundi and Kade left for medical treatment, the Republic forces continued pushing towards the massive droid foundry, and Drayden and Marr were joined by Luminara Undula and her Adept, Barris Ovva , who met as Drayden and Marr angrily discussed Drayden's lack of trust in Marr's dependability. As Ovva and Marr were sent into the Pyralian catacombs under the factory to plant explosives, Undula realized that Drayden was unable to let go of Marr and put her at risk, rather than distrusting her. Nevertheless, the two Aetheri generals went onto distracting the droid army by marching straight to the factory and engage the enemy.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As Poggle the Lesser had his super tanks deployed, Drayden and Luminara left their men behind and destroyed the bridge, only to learn that their Adepts had not returned yet. Cornered by droids coming from the factory, Drayden was contacted by Marr and she apologized, uncertain that she and Ovva would survive their ordeal, before using a super tank to destroy the factory. Refusing to let his Adept die, Drayden ordered to have them found; Undula, however, told him that he needed to let go of his attachment to her if she were to be dead. Fortunately for them, Drayden was contacted by Marr; after locating them, they rescued the two Adepts.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Sending Marr and Ovva to recover out of the battlefield, Kade and Mundi returned to join in the clean-up of Dissident forces. For her part, Undula left in search of Poggle before he could escape, when a sandstorm broke out. Forced to wait until the storm lifted after her last contact, Drayden and Kade went to Undula's last known location, the Progate Temple . Entering the catacombs below, not only they discovered undead Pyralian warriors , they also encountered the captive Undula, Poggle, and the Pyralian Queen , Karina the Great . Setting up their men to surround the Queen and her brethren, Drayden and Kade tried to negotiate with Karina, for Kade wanted to know how the undead warriors were created. After discovering her use of parasitic brain worms ), they freed Undula, captured Poggle and fled from the Queen, with Vek and Cord burying the Queen in her lair.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: With Poggle in Republic custody, the four Aetheri generals prepared to deliver him to Vantor, while they sent Marr and Ovva on a mission to transport medical supplies from a medical station near Ord Cestus to Drevan Koss on Steelgrove . Unbeknownst to them, one of the troopers, Scythe , was infected with one of the Queen's brain worms and boarded their Pelta -class frigate , the TB-73 , forcing the two Adepts to fend off the infected replicas. When the ship failed to report in as scheduled, Drayden believed there to have been a complication, and was proven right when Marr contacted him to tell him about the situation.

#### Saluk

> " Where there is Kade, you will always find Drayden not far behind. " ―Skarn

Following the capture of Aetheri Master Etha Korrin in the Outer Reach, General Skarn sent a holo-transmission to the Aetheri Council, in which Skarn stated that he did not care about the Aetheri's politics , nor their Republic, concluding that he lived only to see them all die. As Kade decoded Korrin's hand signals that told them of their location at the Saluk system , Drayden, Kade, and Adi Gallia were dispatched on a mission to rescue him. Discreetly, Drayden, Gallia, Vek, and a group of replica troopers would execute a hyperspace jump into the system in an ambassador shuttle that would bring them right alongside Skarn's cruiser.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Once they boarded it, Drayden and Gallia made their way to the stern of the cruiser, where they encountered a T-series tactical droid with a group of BX-series droid commandos . When Kade reported that Skarn had defeated him and escaped, Gallia left them to help Kade flank Skarn and capture him once and for all. Unsuccessful in their endeavor, Drayden picked the two up at the hangar with their shuttle, only to leave for the Resolute , where he waited while Kade conducted a search mission for Skarn on the planet below alongside Cord, Vek, and other troopers.

Leaving Kade to save his "girlfriend," he destroyed the droids and then went to find Kade, who like Velara, hesitated to kill Merrik; Drayden, however, had no such compunctions and impaled Merrik, branding himself a "cold-blooded killer," to retrieve the Senator's detonator before he could destroy the ship. title: Xarn Velgor
text: Leaving Bolt-3 and R8-B7 to scan for life forms, Drayden and Koss entered the bridge to find the survivors executed, with Drayden noticing a Ferrik helmet . Now trapped under the rubble, the wounded Drayden and the unconscious Koss were soon found by Bolt-3, whom Drayden told to call the Temple for help. The Aetheri Master did not agree, until Vayne and Marr showed them a message from Vark and Vossk, with hostages—one of them, Ponds , killed in cold blood by Vossk. Though Koss decided to go, Vayne said that he would take the mission , alongside Marr, since both Koss and Drayden were still recovering from their injuries. As they arrived on Vantor with Boskan and Vark in custody, Drayden was present as Vark apologized for causing so much destruction, but claimed he would never forgive Koss for killing his father, before they were taken away to the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center .

Forewarned by the destruction of Rishi Station and an intercepted transmission between Kessa Vray and General Skarn, Drayden and Kade traveled to Gelvaris to warn Shaak Ti and Prime Minister Lamir of an upcoming Dissident attack , with Vek, Cord, Echo, Fivva, and the rest of the 501st Legion in their company. #### Senate crisis

Supposed to be on a meditative retreat, Drayden spent some time with his wife on her apartment, observing as Ondar anxiously arranged a party for Senator Aang , who held the deciding vote on the Military Oversight Committee . Drayden tried to ease her mind, telling her that the party would work out and that she should relax, when they saw Astra-9 being fuzzy about the arrangements. At Ondar's request, Drayden sent the protocol droid and Bolt-3 to buy the jogan fruit that the latter had forgotten to buy for Aang's favorite dessert, jogan fruitcake . Although they were delayed, Ondar nevertheless hosted the party all the same, with her and Drayden waiting for the two droids to come back—who did so just in time to present the cake to Senator Aang.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Not too long after, Drayden went to the Senate Building to convince Ondar to go away together for two weeks , to a faraway place where no one would recognize them, so that they could actually be husband and wife, instead of Senator and Aetheri. Ondar, however, rejected the idea, for she was preparing an important bill for the Senate. Drayden retorted that the bill seemed more important than their love, but Ondar countered that it was not, just that they both lived to serve the Republic. However, Drayden stated that there was nothing more important than the way he felt about her, and proved it by giving Ondar his flux blade, which, Kade had told him once, was his "life." Though she believed he was teasing her, Drayden was sincere about his feelings, and the two shared a kiss.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
They were soon interrupted by Astra-9 and Senator Solen's voices, prompting Drayden to hide under her desk and Ondar to hide his flux blade in her sleeve. As she went to the lobby to attend a meeting about the Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill , only to be taken hostage along with several other Senators by Cad Vorek and his team. Following her, Drayden saw the situation, when Vorek spotted him and sent his henchmen to capture him, but Drayden avoided them long enough to contact Mal and defeat an IG-86 sentinel droid empty-handed, before being shocked into unconsciousness by Robonino and Ayla Vossk and brought before the Senators. After the bounty hunters planted bombs that would go off if their laser detectors were triggered and left the building, Drayden woke up and Ondar returned his flux blade. He then used it to cut a hole in the floor, dropping all the senators one floor down into safety, just before Vorek triggered the bombs and escaped alongside the now-freed Ziro.

Following the crisis, Drayden went with Ondar to Caamas to board legendary actress Madam Risha Synata 's private ship . However, they were late to see Madam Synata's play about Vael Krist-Ov . After they arrived, Drayden and Ondar met Synata. Drayden agreed to see her museum , despite Ondar's reluctance. Drayden took Ondar to her room. The next day, Drayden and Ondar went to the museum. There, Drayden and Ondar saw a display of Varykino , where they exchanged their vows. Drayden and Ondar came under attack by several robots from the displays. title: Xarn Velgor
text:

With assistance from Bolt-3, Drayden and Ondar reached the theater.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
After arriving late to one of Marr's training sessions, Drayden became frustrated with the simplicity of the exercises. In turn, he told her to meet with him later for an actual training session. Later, Drayden took Marr to an isolated area with Vek and the 501st. He then had the replicas surround Marr and fire stun bolts at her. The sessions continued for hours until Marr told Drayden that the battle droids weren't nearly as good as the replicas. Drayden explained that this was the point and that he wanted her training to be difficult so that she would know how to protect herself. Marr would continue the sessions with Vek and the 501st throughout the war. Sometime later, Drayden was sparring with Marr, teaching her how to fight with two flux blades . She struggled to consciously utilize the other flux blade, but Drayden reassured her. When Master Zho entered to spar with her, Drayden watched as she struggled against Zho, but ultimately learned how to use Jar'Kai more effectively.

#### Unexpected Company

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Sometime later, Drayden was assigned to a mission with Ondar to Cindervale . It took Drayden a lot of work to get the mission with her, but they were both happy to spend some time alone together. That is until, Marr ran up to them, saying that she was encouraged help with the mission by Kade. They all get on a T-6 shuttle, where Drayden charted a shorter course in order to speed up the mission. Marr warned him that the Dissident fleet was spotted on that flight path, and that they shouldn't take it. It was too late, however, and Drayden's ship exited hyperspace in the midst of the fleet. Drayden took control and tried to maneuver around oncoming fire, while Ondar and Marr took control of the laser turrets. Despite their best efforts, stray laser fire hit Ondar's side of the ship. Drayden jumped to protect Ondar, which resulted in them embracing in a hug. Marr was able to take control of the ship and jumped into hyperspace. Upon their arrival on Cindervale, Drayden told her that he was glad she came. Ondar mentioned that her and Drayden made a good team, with Marr returning the compliment.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Trouble with Tomarian

The showman Tomarian later requested Drayden as an Aetheri escort for his Annual Festival of Light Gala . Drayden thought that there would be an actual threat at the event, but in actuality Tomarian had requested him to impress his guests. Drayden was then surprised to see Senator Ondar dressed up for the occasion. They both talked, glad to see each other. Ondar told him to enjoy Tomarian's usual long speech while she went to freshen up. Drayden, along with Tomarian, walked into the theater where the gala was being held. ### Personal and wartime conflicts

#### The Destiny of the Seeded One

> " You are the Seeded One. You have brought balance to this world. Stay on this path and you will do it again… for the galaxy. But beware… your heart… " ―The Father's last words, to Kael Drayden

When the Aetheri Council received a 2,000-year-old Aetheri distress signal , Drayden, along with Kade and Marr, were sent by the High Council to the Chrelythiumn system , where they were supposed to meet up with Captain Vek and an armed cruiser. Though they both made it to the rendezvous point, neither Vek's nor the Aetheri's ship could see each other. In fact, the Aetheri's ship was guided to a mysterious planet, Mournis , where they met by a mysterious figure called the Daughter , who asked Drayden if he was "the one" and who wanted to lead them to the Father , when Drayden was separated from Kade and Marr, and the Daughter.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Drayden tried to follow her, only to reach the monastery , where he met the Father and was given shelter for the night. As he tried to sleep, the figure of his mother, Shira, appeared before him and encouraged him to tell her of his pain and guilt—that he was too late to save her, and that he had failed as an Aetheri and that he had failed her, having tasted only vengeance when he slaughtered so many to avenge her death. But, as he mentioned his wife, who he claimed was "everything" to him, the figure finally revealed itself to be the Son , briefly assuming a monstrous appearance before disappearing.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Shaken by the encounter, he confronted the Father, who told of his family's history, and wondered if he was truly the Seeded One. Though Drayden dismissed the prophecy as a myth, the Father arranged a test to see whether the Aetheri Knight was fit to fulfill his destiny . Ordering his children to kill Marr and Kade, the Father goaded Drayden into choosing between his master and his apprentice, but Drayden instead controlled the two beings, bringing them to their knees. Having proved himself to be the Seeded One, the Father pleaded with him to stay, but Drayden refused, leaving with Marr and Kade on their shuttle .

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
After the Father's death, the three Aetheri were transplanted back to the galaxy to finally rendezvous with Vek. Surprised to learn that, to Vek and the others, they had only been gone for a moment, they returned to the Iron Cruiser. They would later report this encounter to the Council, with Drayden even mentioning that he had spoken with Vael to Zho. Even though Drayden was not entirely convinced, they came to believe it had merely been an illusion of the old mentor. In reality, it had truly been the spirit of Vael.

#### The Citadel

> " I'm not sure what to think of your new ally. " " Well, I think we need people like him. This is a war. If we aren't willing to do what it takes to win, we risk losing everything we try to protect. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden, on Wilhard Varrix

title: Xarn Velgor
text: More than one year and nine months into the war, following the capture of Aetheri Council member Even Piele by the Dissidents, Drayden and Kade were briefed by Master Tor Vayne and sent along with their team—which included Vek, Cord, Echo, and Fivva—to infiltrate the Citadel on Lola Sayu to retrieve Master Piele, who held the information on the Nexus Route . Refusing to let Marr risk her life on such a dangerous mission, Drayden devised a strategy to bypass the lifeform scanners of the prison; the whole team underwent carbon-freezing and were transported to the Citadel by Commander Bolt-3 and his reprogrammed battle droid squadron.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After landing, Drayden was thawed out and he found, to his surprise, that Marr had disobeyed orders and followed him. Forced to take her along, the team made its way to the facilities, leaving the astromech to guard their shuttle. After free-climbing to the entry point through a cliff wall blasted by a strong gale and littered with electro-mines , and after Marr deactivated the ray-shield on the entrance, the team was able to enter, except for Charger , who fell to his death and alerted the prison staff, led by Osi Sobeck , of their presence. Inside, they lost Longshot , but finally made it to Master Piele, whom they freed and who told them they needed to rescue his officers.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Despite the many traps laid through the fortress , the team rescued the officers, when they met the other carrier of the Nexus Route coordinates, Captain Wilhard Varrix . The team was split into two—while Kade's team created a diversion, Drayden would lead the others away. In Varrix's company, Drayden and his team escaped through the cavern system below the prison, when Varrix expressed some skepticism about the Aetheri's plan, to which Drayden told Varrix that he reserved his trust to those who understood gratitude. However, they soon found common ground, for they both believed the Aetheri Code prevented the Order from going far enough to achieve victory in the ongoing war, and Varrix developed a grudging appreciation for Drayden.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
As they made their way out of the fuel line to rendezvous with Bolt-3 and the shuttle, they were attacked by droids and forced to join Kade at their pick-up point, with the shuttle heavily guarded. During the skirmish, Echo tried to defend the shuttle, but its destruction and subsequent explosion seemingly killed him. As they ran into the cave system, Drayden and Kade contacted the Council, telling them they needed to escape, and Vayne immediately departed to pick them up. They contacted the Council again to be informed of the extraction point; as they proceeded to the location, Sobeck sent anoobas after them. The creatures claimed Master Piele's life, who passed his intel on to Marr, and the group took a moment to honor his death. Ultimately, they got to the extraction point on time, and fled on Tor Vayne's rescue shuttle, with Saesee Tiin 's fleet covering them to allow their escape back to Vantor.

#### Battle of Umbara

> " Does my battalion have to do everything? " " You seem to always volunteer. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

During the campaign on Umbara , Drayden and Kade discussed their attack strategy against the Umbaran capital city , which was being defended by Confederate and local militia forces. Together with Vek and Fivva, Drayden prepared to repel enemy reinforcements striking against Kade's joint attack with Aetheri Masters Saesee Tiin and Pong Krell , who would be supporting Kade from the south whereas Drayden and 501st Legion would advance from the north. Amidst heavy fire, Drayden and his battalion made it to the landing site, and then to a ridge which they used as a staging area. As he and Vek awaited the rest of their men, hoping to move out soon and reinforce General Kade's battalion, Dogma reported that all platoons had reported in, and Drayden told him to get some rest. Dogma replied that he was fine, but Vek told him it was a direct order, prompting Dogma to do as he was told. As Vek observed Dogma was "wound tight but loyal," Drayden joked that he reminded him of Vek, who disagreed, saying that was him in the old days.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Shortly after this, the Umbarans ambushed Drayden and his troops, but an airstrike by Master Krell and Odd Ball saved them. After the quick save, Krell approached Drayden with a disconcerting message: the Council had ordered Drayden back to Vantor, effective immediately, as requested by Supreme Chancellor Mal, for reasons unknown. Though reluctant to leave his troops in the midst of battle, Drayden was forced to relinquish command over his troops to Master Krell and make the journey back to Vantor. Despite Krell's efforts to sabotage the Republic effort by tricking the 501st and the 212th battalions into attacking each other, Kade was successful in taking the capital and routing the remaining Umbaran forces, securing all sectors of the planet for the Republic.

#### Mal kidnapped

text:
#### Mal kidnapped

> " Drayden, a powerful Aetheri you are, yet unpredictable and dangerous you can be, to both your friends and enemies. For Orien, on your patience, everything depends. " ―Zho, to Kael Drayden

After the capture of Moralo Eval , rumored to be the mastermind of a plot to kidnap Supreme Chancellor Mal, Drayden, Marr, and Kade were recalled to an emergency meeting by the High Council while they walked through the nightly streets of Vantor. On their way to the Temple, however, a sniper opened fire at them, which prompted the three Aetheri to chase their aggressor. However, the sniper killed Kade before escaping on a speeder, prompting Drayden to return to his master, to find Marr crying and his old master dead, whom he called several times trying to get him to respond. Becoming withdrawn and grim, Drayden would not say a word since then, until after the funeral held to honor Kade, when he went on a self-imposed mission to locate his murderer, Rako Hardeen , at Trueping's . Though Drayden would rather kill him, he arrested Hardeen and ferried him to the Republic Detention Center.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After hearing that Hardeen had escaped from jail, Drayden held a meeting with his friend, Mal, when Koss informed the Chancellor that they would remove the bounty on Hardeen and the two other escapees, Eval and Cad Vorek; a decision did not sit well with Drayden. Mal suggested that the Council perhaps did not trust him to control his feelings, and Drayden felt the Council was doing nothing to catch the murderer of his master—his best friend. Exploiting this to his advantage, Mal told him not to deny his feelings, for they were what made him special, and deliberately sent Drayden and Marr to Grukh . There, two Aetheri harshly interrogated locals for information, which led them to Orondia , the fugitives last known location.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After spotting their quarry as they prepare to leave, Drayden rammed their ship into submission and board it in midflight, but was foiled by Vorek and a subsequent crash-landing of both parties resulting from the chase. Surrounded by smoke, Hardeen left the ship, and Drayden confronted him, ready to kill Hardeen when Vorek interrupted him. Hardeen intervened then and wrestled with Drayden, whispering to Drayden's ear "Kael, don't follow me." As he felt a connection, Drayden passed out, only for Marr to protect him for Vorek's attempts to execute him. As they returned to Vantor, Zho summoned Drayden to his chambers and revealed the truth to him—that Kade was "Rako Hardeen."

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Afterwards, Drayden was briefed along his Adept about the security plans the Council had for the Chancellor during the Festival of Light on Ondara. Drayden, Marr, and Koss would escort the Mal and Mazan Veldon to Serath, where Drayden was greeted by his wife. At the festival itself, the abduction was initially successful with Cad Vorek and Moralo Eval ferrying Mal away, while Drayden and Koss captured Embo and Twazzi ; however, Kade stopped Eval and Vorek, long enough for Koss and Drayden to arrive and take the two into custody.

As he reunited with his old master, he voiced his resentment for the Council's lack of trust in him as well as Kade's decision to hide the truth from him. Wondering how many other lies he had been told by the Council, he set out on his own to bodyguard Mal, who continued to place seeds of doubt in Drayden until they were greeted by Varek. After destroying two of his MagnaGuards, Drayden dueled the Count with ferocity, until Kade arrived to help him rescue the Chancellor, whereas Varek fled.

text:
#### Underra Insurgency

> " I feel responsible for them. " " I know you do, Snips, but remember, purpose must come before feelings. " ―Sela Marr and Kael Drayden

Following a plea made by a insurgent cell on Underra, the Aetheri Council considered how to help them fight the Dissidents. Drayden suggested training the insurgents in subversive combat tactics; though it verged on terrorism, which the Aetheri would not support, the High Council decided to send advisors to the insurgent cell for the upcoming battle . On the Nura -class transport Valkyrie 2929 , Drayden, Marr, Vek, and Kade reached the planet during the night, when they met Steela Vess and were guided to their insurgent secret base, where they met her brother, Torrik . The team trained the insurgents to combat droids, until Dissident probe droids discovered their outpost and attacked, which prompted the cell to enter Iziz .

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
After some successful operations, Drayden, Kade, and Vek decided to return to Vantor and report to the Council, while Marr stayed behind as a liaison to the insurgents, without revealing herself as an Aetheri. They kept in frequent communication with her, to provide guidance, but also to provide help by hiring Hondik Hosha to deliver missile launchers to the Underra insurgents for the final assault. Drayden attended the funeral service for Steela Vess.

#### Losing Satinna, saving Bolt #### Losing Satinna, saving Bolt

Drayden was later present when the Aetheri High Council met up with the chancellor to discuss Vreth's return, during which they decided to leave him alone even though they knew he was still alive. Drayden lent the Twilight to Kade, who used it to travel to Ferrum to rescue Satinna Velara. With all its technical problems, after landing on Ferrum, Kade vowed not to borrow another ship from Drayden. However, as he escaped, the ship was shot down by Ferrik commandos and destroyed, moments before Velara was murdered by Vreth during the Ferrik civil war . Drayden was waiting for Kade when the Aetheri Master returned to the Temple hangar, where Drayden saw through Kade's attempt to hide his sorrow. Kade explained he had lost someone important to him and that he had struggled with his rage, something Drayden knew all too well. Drayden offered to come with him for a report to the Council, which Kade happily agreed to.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Drayden was later present when the Aetheri Council sent Meebur Gascon and a team of Republic droids to steal an encryption module from the Dissidents. Later Drayden participated in the Republic strategy conference on the space station Valor , while on the station he noticed the Renown was going a little too fast. Varrix told Drayden that they are scanning Rhydonium on the ship, Drayden instantly realized it was a bomb, Drayden was later contacted and informed by Gascon of Bolt's sacrifice. However, Drayden refused to believe that his friend was gone. He sent out salvage teams to scour the wreckage, who retrieved Bolt's remains and repaired him. The two reunited, and Kael was happy to have him back.

### Nearing the end

#### Marr's trial

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
### Nearing the end

#### Marr's trial

> " I know you believe in me, Kael, and I'm grateful for that. But this isn't about you. I can't stay here any longer, not now. " " The Aetheri Order is your life. You can't just throw it away like this. Sela, you are making a mistake. " " Maybe, but I have to sort this out on my own, without the Council and without you. " " I understand. More than you realize, I understand wanting to walk away from the Order. " " I know. " ―Sela Marr and Kael Drayden

title: Xarn Velgor
text: During the defense of Cato Geltaria , Drayden and Marr engaged Dissident forces on their Eta-2 Actis -class interceptors , until they received an urgent mission recalling them to the Aetheri Sanctum. Its hangar had been bombed and, as the two had been off-world during the attack, Drayden and Marr were to lead the investigation to uncover the criminal—likely to be an Aetheri. As they entered the Temple's hangar, they discussed the possibilities an Aetheri was behind the attack. Marr doubted an Aetheri could bomb such a sacred location to the Aetheri, and in the process, kill their own colleagues and employees. However, Drayden told Marr to keep an open mind, and he reminded her there were Aetheri that did not agree with their methods, and went rogue, such as Varek and Krell. As a result, everyone who was at the Temple during the bombing were potential suspects, including Aetheri.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As Drayden and Marr walked across the burning hangar, they met Russo-ISC , whom Drayden sent alongside Marr to interview the witnesses, whereas he meditated at the hangar. Unable to discover anything, Drayden met up with Marr and Russo, who told him about their missing suspect, Jackar Bowmani . With this clue, Drayden went to speak with Chief of Security Cin Drallig . As Drayden approached Drallig on the Aetheri Sanctum's steps, he witnessed a crowd of angry protestors, rallying against the Aetheri for their violence during the war. After Drayden showed Drallig the hologram of Bowmani on an imagecaster , Letta Turmond identified Bowmani in the hologram and informed the Aetheri she was Bowmani's wife . Later Drayden and Marr cornered Turmond near her home , and she under pressure admitted to feeding Bowmani nano-droids but would not reveal her motives.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Drayden was present at Zho's eulogy for the six Aetheri who died during the explosion , and later took the opportunity to speak with Varrix. Drayden and his Adept were then summoned to the war room to be briefed about a Dissident attack on Saluk, when Varrix informed them that Turmond had requested to speak with Marr. When she was framed with Turmond's death and imprisoned, he was forbidden to see her, and only returned to track her down on her escape , following Marr into the pipelines.

Alone, they revealed that their trust in each other was absolute, but as Drayden pleaded for her to surrender herself and make her case to the Council, she refused to take the blame for something she had not done and asked Drayden to trust her, just as she jumped onto a passing ship, thus escaping to the Vantor underworld.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As Varrix declared she was being accused of sedition, Zho assigned Drayden and Tor Vayne to search for Marr, with some coalition from Koss—who did not believe Drayden to be emotionally detached to do what had to be done. Nevertheless, when she was captured , Drayden escorted her to the Temple, where he was later summoned to the Chamber of Judgment along with his Adept. He was outraged to learn that the Council had already made their decision and that the meeting was simply a formality, and they proceeded to expel her from the Order. Resentful of the Council, he asked his wife, Ondar, to defend Marr at her trial before leaving to capture Vray himself.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Drayden soon found and interrogated Vray, who admitted she was about to turn in Marr to the authorities, until she realized Marr had been abandoned by Drayden and the Aetheri Order, just like she had been forsaken by Varek. She also said that whoever had attacked Marr had stolen her flux blades and that Marr had contacted Barris Ovva for help. Promising to kill Vray if she lied, Drayden left for the Temple, where he went to Ovva's quarters and questioned her, only to engage her in a duel . After subduing her, Drayden brought Ovva to the Republic military base where Marr was being judged. As the Mirialan Adept confessed, all charges against Marr were lifted.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Back at the Temple, Drayden and the Council apologized to Marr and invited her back into the Order, with Drayden offering her severed Adept braid . However, Marr apologized, leaving him in possession of her braid, and declined the offer. As she left the Temple, Drayden followed her and asked her to reconsider. Marr, however, declared that she felt she could not stay with the Order, due to their lack of trust in her. Despite Drayden's heartfelt protests and his mentioning that he himself had considered leaving the Order before, she chose to walk away. Marr's departure had a deep impact on Drayden, leaving him feeling more alone than ever in bearing the expectations of being the prophesied Seeded One. The circumstances surrounding her departure also served to intensify his frustration with the High Council, as he felt they had betrayed her by not backing her innocence. Without Marr as the counterbalance to his concerns and passions, Drayden's attentions also focused ever more upon Ondar.

#### Gelvaris conspiracy

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Gelvaris conspiracy

> " He's in on it! I don't know to what extent. But I know he orchestrated much of this. He told me in the medical bay! " " He told you? When you tried to assassinate him? You have gone too far, Fivva. The Chancellor isn't capable of what you claim. " " He is! I swear to you, General. You've no idea— " ―Fivva and Kael Drayden, before being interrupted by the Vantor Guard A short time after Marr left the Aetheri Order, Drayden, alongside Aetheri Generals Tiplar and Tiplee , and the 501st were sent to take control of Ringo Vindra 's planet-wide station back from Admiral Trench. Only after seven rotations of stalemated combat, did they manage to push Trench's forces to a breaking point. However, one of Drayden's troopers, Tupp , intentionally killed General Tiplar, forcing Drayden to order his and Tiplee's troops to fall back. He then had Tupp checked out to see if he had been brainwashed by the Dissidents, only to find nothing in him, even as he repeated nonstop "Good soldiers follow orders" as well as apparent amnesia . Though he did not find anything in him, Drayden had Tupp sent to Gelvaris for further examination.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After Tupp's shuttle was destroyed and he was taken prisoner by Trench, Drayden investigated the wreckage. Seeing that Tupp was not among the dead, Drayden decided to infiltrate the Dissident lines. Alongside Vek and Fivva, Drayden reached the Dissidents' hangar wearing an environment suit and saw that Commander Kraken had Tupp aboard his shuttle . Drayden and the others the boarded the shuttle and took out Kraken's crew, including Kraken himself, who refused to reveal why they had abducted Tupp. Drayden then had Tupp transported to Gelvaris with Fivva and Vek as escorts. Following the end of Drayden and the 501st Legion's participation on Ringo Vindra, and the death of Tupp, Drayden and the High Council were informed by Shaak Ti that Fivva attempted to kill the Chancellor. Koss, aware that the Aetheri were not requested to participate in the manhunt, allowed Drayden and Vek to secretly search for the replica. They soon were contacted by Kix , who told them that Fivva wanted to meet the two at a warehouse in Level 1325 . As Kael and Vek entered the warehouse, they dropped their weapons on Fivva' request. After doing so, they were encircled by a ray shield, which prompted Drayden to question Fivva' actions, but he and Vek listened to the fugitive's side of the story. Drayden refused to believe that the Chancellor was involved in this conspiracy about the inhibitor chips , but their conversation was cut short by the arrival of the Vantor Guard . Drayden watched as they gunned Fivva down, dying in Vek's arms.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
He would report the event to Zho, Koss, Ti, and the Chancellor, who was swift to lie to the Aetheri that all had been the product of a parasite from Ringo Vindra, one that had caused the decay of Fivva and Tupp's chips; Mal urged the Aetheri to leave the matter behind, for each day, they grew "closer and closer to victory." From that point onward, Drayden was faced with the fact that Tupp and Fivva, two of his best men, had died under mysterious circumstances, which became another weight on his emotional health.

#### Korvex returns

> " Kael, I understand to a degree what is going on. You've met Satinna. You know I once harbored feelings for her. It's not that we're not allowed to have these feelings. It's natural. " " Senator Ondar and I are simply friends. " " And friends you must remain. As an Aetheri, it is essential you make the right choice, Kael, for the Order. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Upon his wife's mission to Scipio and subsequent reencounter with Rush Korvex, when she was accused of sabotage and her aide Teckla Minnau was killed, Drayden was sent to protect Ondar, but was upset to hear that Korvex was involved. Nevertheless, he agreed to help her, and together, they went to Korvex's residence to assist in exposing the Banking Clan's corruption. As they were about to depart along with Korvex, Drayden defended both Senators from the bounty hunter Embo and his pet anooba, Marrok . The trio were able to escape Embo, thanks to Bolt-3, and make their way to Vantor. Escorted by Zho, they met with Mal and other members of the Aetheri Council, and Senator Bael Solen, during which Drayden's animosity towards Korvex was perceived by Zho.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Before it was too late, he realized his mistake and stopped, only for Captain Typho to enter. Much to his surprise, Korvex lied about the attack. As they carried Korvex to Ondar's bedroom, Drayden tried to apologize to his wife, but she told him to stay away from her. Only when they were alone afterward, she questioned their marriage, too steeped in lies and deception, and decided that they take a break from one another after admitting to not feeling safe around Drayden—who, in turn, admitted to being unable to control himself, even though he did not know why. Korvex was accepted as the new head of the Banking Clan by the Senate, and Drayden confided to the Chancellor of his distrust in Korvex, which Mal shared. Soon, when Korvex apparently joined the Dissidents the day after (which Drayden found strange), and Scipio was occupied by Dissidents, Drayden was then sent to retake Scipio. After landing, Drayden went to Korvex's office and tried to reason with Korvex to make him let go of Ondar. At that very moment, though, a vulture droid crashed into the office, making it unstable and causing Ondar and Korvex to fall, but Drayden grabbed them both, each with one hand. As he could not hold the two, Korvex told Drayden to let go of him, but he would not; Korvex apologized to Ondar and then let go of Drayden, falling to his death. Though Drayden and Ondar reconciled, the Banking Clan came under the control of the Chancellor.

#### Sifas Dyen' secret

> " The creation of the replica army, kept secret from us Sifas Dyen did. How this was done we know not, yet now a new piece of the puzzle we have. Perhaps clarity it will bring us, yes. " ―Zho

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Sifas Dyen' secret

> " The creation of the replica army, kept secret from us Sifas Dyen did. How this was done we know not, yet now a new piece of the puzzle we have. Perhaps clarity it will bring us, yes. " ―Zho

After Aetheri Master Tor Vayne intercepted a distress call from a lost shuttle and discovered Sifas Dyen 's flux blade, its late owner being responsible for the secret creation of the Replica Army. Relaunching the investigation of Sifas Dyen's death, Drayden and Kade were sent to Feldora, where they spoke to the tribal leaders to find out what happened to the late Aetheri Master. Kade was told that the Felucians had cremated his body and that another Aetheri had been with him when he was killed and reported their findings to Master Zho.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The two were then sent to Oba Diah when former Chancellor, Finis Valorum told Zho that Sifas Dyen had been sent to negotiate with the Gruv Syndicate to stop an underground war. Valorum, however, said that there was no other Aetheri sent alongside Syfo-Dyas, but rather his personal aide Silman . On Oba Diah, Kade and Drayden met VOX Gruv , who denied any involvement until Kade noticed that he was wearing the crest of Valorum and Drayden grabbed the necklace and told the Gruv to "stop playing games." VOX finally complied with the Aetheri, and told them that they had been paid by a man called Varek to shoot Sifas Dyen's shuttle down. However, as they feared that anyone who paid for the death of an Aetheri was dangerous, they kept Silman locked away for ten years as insurance.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Once they met Silman, they realized he had gone mad after being locked up for so long, and were unable to learn much from him before Varek arrived to kill him before Drayden and Kade's eyes. After engaging Varek in combat, they learned that the man called Varek was, in fact, the Count. Although Drayden pursued the count after he tried to escape on a Vantor Freighter , Varek escaped aboard his solar sailer , leaving the Aetheri without the chance to learn more about the replica army. Nevertheless having learned the identity of Varek, they informed the Council of their findings, only for them to question why Varek had been behind the creation of the replica army, and what the game of the yet-unidentified Dark Lord of the Umbra was playing.

#### Zho's journey

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Zho's journey

> " Help me to escape. Yes. " " Escape? But you're not in prison. " " No, perhaps, but perhaps I am. Already, all around us, the cage may be. A journey I must make alone. " " The Council will not want you to travel at all, alone even less. " " Disobeying the Council your expertise is. That is why I ask for your help. It is the spontaneity you find so easily which others do not. That is what sets you apart. Now, a walk you will take me on. Come, come. " ―Zho and Kael Drayden

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Upon Zho's brief contact with Sorin Vael, Zho requested that Drayden meet him on the Temple's training grounds to speak about their experience on Mournis, where both he and Kade had spoken to Vael. As Drayden, too, was in disbelief of the idea that an individual could retain its identity after death, Zho left him to rest. Later, when Zho submitted himself for medical examination by Rig Nema, Drayden informed them that Chancellor Mal wanted to hold an emergency meeting with Zho, to which Koss responded, leaving the Grand Master free to undergo a deprivation ritual . Drayden, Mundi, Kade, Vayne, and Nema watched over the old master until Kade interrupted it before it was too late, and Zho claimed to have spoken with the dead.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
With the Council worried for his health, Zho was placed under the surveillance of guards , so the Aetheri Master asked to Drayden to see him. Zho asked Drayden to help him escape, which Drayden did. Accompanying Zho to his fighter , Drayden even lent Bolt-3 to Zho to accompany him on a journey that would take him to Mirefall , a mysterious planet and Moraband , to learn that the Aetheri Order would not win the war, and that there was "another Drayden."

#### An Excuse to Fight #### An Excuse to Fight

After a skirmish against Tofen's Raiders , in which Kade's starfighter malfunctioned, a Republic fleet was attacked by Dissidents. Drayden and Kade were present alongside the young vorak Viiveenn during the attack. They both argued about who should be the one to join the fight and who should be the one to deliver Viiveenn to safety. When a missile that entered the hangar bay exploded near the three, Drayden and Kade were separated, with Kade left with Viiveenn. Drayden used the wreckage that landed in his way as an excuse to join the fight. As another explosive entered the hangar, Kade reluctantly took the vorak into his starship and told her that Drayden did that sort of thing all the time.

#### Mission to Batuu

Alliance with a Chyrr "commander"

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Mission to Batuu

Alliance with a Chyrr "commander"

Drayden was told by Senator Ondar that one of her former handmaidens, Duja , had found something near Batuu that she and Drayden should investigate. Unfortunately, Drayden was unable to join her due to being sent to battle. Drayden allowed her to travel to Batuu by herself. Upon his return to Vantor after the battle, Drayden could find records of Ondar's travels in the Outer Reach. After another battle, Drayden received a message that Ondar's ship was found on Batuu. Drayden, along with Bolt-3 , took his interceptor to Batuu. En route to Batuu, Drayden encountered a freighter . Drayden spoke with the freighter's captain, Chyrr Defense Fleet Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo , known simply as Vorren. Unknown to Drayden, Vorren was actually a Senior Captain . Drayden accepted Vorren's assistance in finding Ondar and Duja.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Drayden found Ondar's ship near Batuu's Black Spire Outpost . There, he stopped a group of smugglers who were angry about the ship being in their landing spot. Drayden fought them until Vorren broke up the fight. Together, they investigated Ondar's ship and learned about Duja's ship, Nomad Four. The two then went to a nearby cantina. After speaking with the bartender, Drayden and Vorren came under attack by four assailants. The two of them were able to kill the assailants. Vorren suspected the assailants were sent to kill Drayden and that there was the fifth nearby. Drayden and Vorren came up with a plan to capture the last assailant. After Drayden took one of the assailant's body, he pretended to suffer engine damage in his interceptor. After landing, Drayden came under attack by an assassin droid but was to destroy it. Vorren was able to capture the assailant and found his freighter, which belonged to the Dissidents.

Mission to Mokivj

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Mission to Mokivj

Drayden and Vorren took out the droids guarding the freighter. Together, they found out the freighter was headed to Cermau . As they returned to Black Spire, they came under attack by several thugs. Vorren was able to use their speeder, to capture the thugs. Drayden and Vorren questioned the cargo inspector Oenti , who reveals that the cantina's bartender, Janott had ties to the Dissidents' Duke Solha . They learned that they were shipping supplies to a droid factory . After learning of Duja's death, Drayden told Vorren about the politics behind the Replica Wars. Drayden and Vorren traveled to Mokivj . There, they discovered that the Dissidents were mining Cortosis and discovered a factory.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Following Drayden's and Vorren's location of the factory, and later their change of clothing, Drayden contacted the duke, to infiltrate the factory and informed him that Captain Boroklif was indisposed, that there was trouble at Black Spire, and that the he and the others were losing. The Serennian was shocked when he heard this news and asked if the Dissident captain and his companions were dead, to which Drayden replied that he did not know as he was not there at the end of the battle. The Aetheri Knight offered the Dissident to bring the cargo he had lost to his factory, Solha accepted and told him he'd open the shield when he was on the coordinates of the courtyard, that he was not stupid and he would not open it until it was truly necessary, just when he was in position to land. Following their arrival, the Aetheri Knight and the Chyrr commander were hailed by the Serennian duke escorted by a pair of B2-series super battle droids and two squads of B1-series battle droids, who inquired their possession of an astromech droid that belonged to the Republic, Bolt-3. In response, the Aetheri explained that he had found the droid and believed it could be worth something if he desired to purchase it.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The Chyrr commander and the Aetheri Knight asked the Serennian what happened to Ondar's former handmaiden, Duja. They also told him how they acquired Boroklif's ship, the Larkrer , that they came to Mokivj because there was a preset hyperspace course on the ship, the Serennian asked who had put in that course, to which they replied they assumed the Dissident captain did. The duke then warned the pair that they did not have anything else to bargain with and that he could have them shot. However, the pair told them there was another preset hyperspace course locked below the current one, which was locked by a two-stage encryption passcode, and that each of them had one half, Drayden then presented his Chyrr companion as "Brix." The Serennian ordered all of his droids to lower their weapons and to escort them while they entered the factory. The lights went off while the group was entering the building, and the Aetheri sliced a droid squad and threw his flux blade to the top of the building so the duke would not be aware that Drayden was in fact, an Aetheri. Then two B2s blocked the courtyard's opening to prevent any escape.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Solha knew that there was an Aetheri loose on the factory, however, he didn't know who Drayden was, he then sent Vorren and Drayden to some improvised prison cells. Calling the Aetheri a thief , the Serennian aimed at Drayden from the corridor in front of his cell with his volt pistol, and said that the Aetheri wanted to be here and that he got here thanks to Drayden, and for that alone he should be shot. He then revealed he was the Duke Solha of the Free System of Sireno, to which the Aetheri Knight replied if he should be impressed, Solha said he should be, and that he would be at some point. One B2-series super battle droid took all of their weapons and communication devices, even taking Vorren's small hold-out volt pistol located in his boot. Solha and the droids left with Bolt, who was dropping oil so Drayden knew where they had taken him. They left the room and locked the cell's doors.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The pair agreed on running a test, which would discover if Drayden's wife had been captured, if she was free or was not on the factory by waiting two hours as Ondar, and if she did not join them on the detention block, they would break out and try to locate her. Vorren asked the Aetheri that if he recognized the ship in the courtyard, telling him it was an ore carrier , which was full of ore , so this was not a staging ground but a manufacturing facility, he also told Drayden where was there more activity and where was there less activity, as Chyrr could see more infrared than humans, and he noticed the heat signatures, and that where they were in was the most active section.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Following the completion of Vorren's and Drayden's test, the Chyrr crafted a cord from the clothing he got from the Larkrer and unlocked their cells from the inside. Meanwhile, the senator had entered the building and was accompanied by a group of locals, consisting of maintenance workers of the factory, Cimy , Huga , and LebJau . They had entered the factory through the service level, which was usually unprotected and only them and the Dissidents knew of. Ondar had promised the group a fortune, which would be given to them by her Uncle Kael if they helped her access the factory. The group later arrived at the detention block, defeated the droid guards and found the Chyrr and Aetheri Knight inside.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After the Chyrr was presented to the newcomers by Drayden, the group created a plan to retrieve Drayden's flux blade, which involved Vorren and the senator going alone to the roof to retrieve the flux blade. The Aetheri was scared of her going alone with the Chyrr, but accepted it. After the Chyrr and the senator left, the Aetheri began to wander across the factory, and found a section of the factory that produced cortosis B2 super battle droids , which was guarded by the duke and his relatives and some droid sentries. The Serennians were protecting themselves with replica trooper armor covered with cortosis, Drayden tried to confuse Solha's droids but he only achieved making the Serennians aware of his presence. Drayden then left the room and began his search for the senator once again.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
In the meantime, Ondar evacuated the workers with LebJau before the factory was destroyed, Vorren joined the senator and the Aetheri Knight who revealed that the ore was cortosis and that it deflected volt pistol bolts and disabled flux blades, thanks to its large energy absorption rate. They learned that the ore was mined in the river next to the factory and strengthened the battle droids' armor making them invulnerable, something that could change the Replica Wars forever. Vorren then agreed to destroy the factory after the Chyrr retrieved the shield generator.

Ondar encountered the duke, who wore replica trooper armor covered with cortosis, who protected him from his husband's flux blade, he then told her that by using the factory he was going to build his name in the Fractio. As he knew Drayden and the senator, he rejected Ondar's ultimatum to surrender and told her that he had no doubts that he'd live and that he'd never surrender.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
In another section of the factory, the Aetheri and Chyrr learned the Dissidents were are also producing replica trooper armor covered with cortosis. The Aetheri thought they were planning to infiltrate the Republic by sending Serennian troopers wearing replica trooper armor to Vantor. After the battle droids protecting the room were defeated by Drayden and Vorren, and the Serennian duke by the senator, knocking him out with her grappling hook, they left the factory and then destroyed the factory. Drayden decided to destroy the mine too, so the Dissidents could not start again on Mokivj, though, Ondar, Vorren, and LebJau asked him not to do it, he ignored their petition, and he destroyed the mine too, which gained him the anger and devastation of the already devastated Mokivj, as it caused a massive explosion expanded by the cortosis.

Aftermath of Mokivj

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Bombing of the Temple

Drayden and Bolt-3 were in the Aetheri Sanctum prior to it being bombed by Dissident captain Rackham Sear . The bomber was foiled by Depa Billaba and Caleb Dume .

#### Ondar's departure

Prior to a mission that Ondar was taking to Clabron , Drayden insisted that he be allowed to assist Ondar, under the impression it was a diplomatic mission to Duro . After assurance from Ondar, Drayden agreed to remain on Vantor, kissing Ondar. He was startled when he realized Ondar's handmaiden, Moteé , had witnessed their display of affection, though Ondar assured Drayden that Moteé understood discretion. Ondar lied to Drayden about her mission because of his close ties to Chancellor Mal.

#### Crystal crisis on Uthara

> " How well would you sleep, knowing that I failed you? " " Not very well, I imagine. Luckily, that isn't true, and never will be. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Crystal crisis on Uthara

> " How well would you sleep, knowing that I failed you? " " Not very well, I imagine. Luckily, that isn't true, and never will be. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

During the last months of the war, Kade and Drayden were sent to Uthara to investigate the mysterious death of Aetheri Master Tu-Anh . Once they landed on Pau City , Inspector Jen June led them to see the corpse at the morgue . After examining the body, they went to the place where she had been found, only to determine she had been hit in the optic nerve with a precision laser dart by a sniper. As they found the sniper's position, from the building's owner, Garri , the two Aetheri learned of the involvement of MagnaGuards and began to suspect the involvement of General Skarn, and had Inspector June analyze some slimy substance they had found—the secretion of an Amani 's skin.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Though Governor Torul Blom asked them to leave Uthara, Kade and Drayden persevered and rented two dactillions to go talk to the leader of an Amani tribe, who revealed that an Amani outcast had entered one of the caves. The two Aetheri entered it to find MagnaGuards. Despite some coalition, they managed to have the droids reveal the involvement of the Sulie and went to see Inspector June once again. Soon after, the two attended the funeral for Tu-Anh. As they reached the Amani settlement they had been looking for, the Amani scattered, leaving Drayden and Kade to follow the tracks of one that appeared to be their leader. During the hunt, Drayden mentioned Marr for the first time since her departure, and Kade asked if he wanted to talk about it, yet Drayden refused. Kade then suggested for them to set up a camp and rest. However, he insisted on the subject, prompting Drayden to tell Kade he missed Marr and to voice his anger at the High Council for turning its back on her. To Drayden's annoyance, Kade stood by the Council's authority, asserting that it had been Marr's decision to leave and that she had allowed her emotions to cloud her judgment, something against the Aetheri way. Then, Kade suggested he rest, but Drayden declined so that he could keep the first watch. Finally, he questioned Kade on what would happen if he had turned out to be a "major disappointment," but Kade wanted to believe it would never happen.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: However, they both fell asleep and were captured by a group of Sugis led by Chong , who brought them before Endente as Kade told Chong of their "intention" to buy weapons. They learned Endente was, in fact, selling a kyber crystal , and Drayden prompted him to show it before they made the deal. Brought to the starship where the crystal was being kept, they escaped from their captors, and Drayden eliminated all the Sulie, except for Endente, who fled. After they discovered the massive kyber crystal inside the ship, the two Aetheri managed to transport the crystal through Uthara's plains until they reached Pau City, where Blom had the two Aetheri surrounded with his men and Skarn's droids. As the kyber crystal was loaded into a shuttle and sent to a ship on orbit , Kade and Drayden stole a freighter to recover the crystal.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Aetheri Master Daren Kelv had been tasked by the Aetheri Council to assassinate Varek with the help of Kessa Vray, but during a mission to Raxun Secundus the Aetheri turned to the umbra side due to Varek's manipulations and Vray's training. Vray staged a rescue mission , which failed and prompted her to contact the Aetheri Council. When she arrived at the Aetheri Sanctum, Drayden and Kade escorted her to the Council Chamber , where despite Drevan Koss's open disapproval, Zho dispatched Drayden and Kade to go with Vray to rescue Vossa above Tarisa . Soon enough, Kade, Drayden, and Vray were on the cockpit of her ship, the Banshee , to infiltrate the Dissident dreadnought from which Vossa, or rather "Admiral Enigma," was issuing orders.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Stealthily, the three boarded the ship and made their way to the bridge, where they found Varek, instead of Vossa. Drayden then engaged in a duel with the Count, distracting him while Kade and Vray discovered a captive Vossa. Though she knew Vossa was consumed by his hatred, they escaped to the Banshee , and Drayden joined with them to escape the enemy ship and return to Vantor. Back in the Aetheri Sanctum, Drayden saw as the Council welcomed Vossa and pardoned Vray. That same night, Drayden reunited with his wife, Ondar, for a moment of respite, during which Drayden told her of the ordeal—after which, Ondar conferred that perhaps Vray's love could be Vossa's way back from the umbra side, leaving Drayden at a loss for words.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### A New Droid Army

After confiscating a Munificent -class star frigate with Squad 326 , Drayden was joined by Grand Master Zho and informed about the mysterious Dissident project, Operation: Titan . Hacking into the frigate 's datacore , they were able to discover that Operation: Titan was being overseen on the planet Enthenium . Together, Zho and Drayden traveled to a Dissident base on Enthenium to uncover more information about the supposed "weapon" that was being developed under Project: Titan. Once they snuck onto the base, Zho climbed through the vents, found information on the "weapons", and confronted Skarn, who was stationed on the base. Meanwhile, Drayden and Squad 326 were battling battle droids as the base went on alert. After Zho came back and aided in the fight, the team escaped before reinforcements arrived. On the frigate once again, Drayden was informed by Zho that on Golatha the weapons being developed were a new army of megadroids four times taller than a human. Drayden quipped that they should have expected the Dissidents to eventually make their droids bigger.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Drayden and Zho then informed the Aetheri High Council via hologram about their planned mission to Golatha . Drayden believed that, because the planet was small, the forces guarding the droid factory would also be small. Zho warned against being overconfident, and suggested being more cautious. Master Koss agreed with Zho and wished them luck, ending the transmission. Drayden was offended by the idea that his plan was overconfident, doing an impression of what Zho had said to mock him. Replica Captain Cesar interrupted their brief argument and informed them that they had arrived. On the planet's surface, Zho and Drayden surveyed the valley where the factory was, but found no above-surface structure. They determined that the factory was fully underground and that an access point must be in the valley. Zho and Drayden, along with Company 326 descended into the valley, and found no droid guards. However, volt pistol fire shot out from the trees, with the replicas unable to stop whatever was firing at them. Zho was able to stop the droid guards firing on them and find the hidden access point, but only after Cesar and rest of the company were all killed.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: They entered the facility alone, with Drayden noting that the size of an attacking army didn't matter anyways. After taking out more droids, Drayden mentioned to Zho that he only had eight thermal detonators, and hoped that would be enough. Upon entering the main area of the factory, they saw a massive assembly line manufacturing hundreds of megadroids. Drayden didn't think they could destroy the whole thing, but Zho pointed out the central column holding up the factory. Drayden asked if he thought taking out the column would take out the whole facility. Zho cheekily responded with an impression of what Drayden had said earlier, with Drayden having to admit that the impression was pretty good. They set the charges and escaped just in time for the factory to explode. However, a sound erupted that wasn't just the factory caving in. A single megadroid shot out from the explosion, and landed right in front of Drayden and Zho. Drayden mentioned that it seems to big, to which Zho replied that size was only a matter of perspective. They try attacking it, but its durasteel coating was stronger than normal, leaving it immune to flux blade attacks. Zho climbed inside the

To his relief, Zho responded to his calls. Drayden had to stop the rotation of the droid so he could attach his ship to it, but the droid was too big and heavy. He tried asking Zho to do it, but since the droid was disabled and the cold vacuum of space weakened Zho, he could not.
