title: Xarn Velgor
text: Vek remained outside on watch while Drayden, holding Vek's helmet, went in and contacted Ondar. Drayden apologized for being away for so long, but, as the two spoke, Orien Kade approached Vek. The Replica Captain knocked on the door to speed up Drayden. Drayden confided that he was worried about his captain, worrying that Vek was letting his personal feelings drive him too much on the mission, although Ondar believed Vek had learned that trait from him. Outside, Vek tried to lie about what Drayden was doing. However, Drayden and her ended their conversation, and both went on their way to Skako, although Kade revealed he knew he had been talking to Ondar by quipping that he hoped Drayden at least greeted Lira for him. In response the Aetheri stopped in his tracks, and although dismayed that his effort to be secretive had been for naught, Drayden kept his composure and only gave his master a knowing glance before walking away.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
As they reached Skako Minor on the Marauder , Drayden was captured by the Poletec on their keeradaks , prompting Vek and the Bad Batch to follow them to the village and rescue the Aetheri General. They apologized and explained the situation, and the chief helped them reach Purkoll , which they infiltrated with some effort. When they reached the antechamber, Foreman Wat Tambra sent a transmission saying they had violated the Artificer Union 's neutrality, and sent droid reinforcements. While Drayden, Hunter, Wrecker , and Crossline destroyed them, Vek and Tech found Echo—alive, but as a cyborg.

Tech managed to unplug Echo, and they escaped to the ventilation system before being vaporized by Tambra's Decimator , after which Wrecker destroyed the Foreman's main computers with explosives. As they escaped, however, they were surrounded by his D1-series aerial battle droids , but thanks to Tech, they rode keeradaks to the Poletec village . There, they convinced the natives to help them against the Artificer Union's forces, including their octuptarra tri-droids , with Drayden effectively destroying two of them.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
The 212th Attack Battalion proceeded to help the 501st while Drayden was approached by Kade who complimented him, which Drayden answered by thanking Kade for helping achieve victory. The two were soon contacted by Admiral Wulric Yular, who informed them of an upcoming transmission going under the code " Fulcrum ," while the two Aetheri thought it might have been Torrik Vess, Yular confirmed otherwise saying it was necessary for the generals to attend the call themselves.

#### The last meeting of a friendship

> " You capture Vreth. I'll take care of Skarn. With any luck, this will all be over soon. " " Master Kade always said there's no such thing as luck. " " Good thing I taught you otherwise. " [Drayden begins to leave] " Kael! Good luck. " ―Kael Drayden and Sela Marr's final words to each other as friends

title: Xarn Velgor
text: At Yular's ship, Drayden and Kade were surprised to see Sela Marr and Bo-Katin Velara were the ones that had made the call. Emotionally shocked to see his former apprentice after several months of being apart, Drayden barely managed to control himself and proceeded to talk to Marr, who remarked the moment was not a reunion as Vreth had been located on Ferrum and they had an opportunity to capture him. Marr hoped Drayden and Kade would be able to join forces with her to confront him. Marr, Velara, and her Ferriks boarded the ship, where they were greeted by Drayden and Kade. The former tried to greet Marr, but his former apprentice turned him down saying they had to act immediately if they wanted to capture Vreth. The group went to discuss the possible attack, but Kade was not willing to help Marr and her allies unless the Aetheri Council gave their permission, causing Drayden to unnoticeably scowl at him. While Kade contacted the Council, Drayden had Marr accompanying him through the complex. Drayden led Marr to a room full of the 501st replica troopers, including Vek, who had painted their helmets as a way to honor her former Commander. Drayden then prepared to give Marr her old flux blades , but before he could do so, the ship's alarm suddenly went off.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Kade rushed in and informed Drayden and Vek that they would be jumping to hyperspace immediately. When Drayden asked if this meant the attack on Ferrum was approved, Kade revealed that they were actually heading for Vantor, where a dire situation was happening: General Skarn had launched a full-scale attack on the capital of the Republic, and the Aetheri Council had lost contact with Shaak Ti, Chancellor Mal's assigned protector. Drayden was visibly uncomfortable about this news, but Kade assured him that their fleet would arrive at Vantor very soon. Marr, however, was angered by her former Masters' decision to abandon Ferrum. Kade pointed out that they were entering a pivotal moment in the Replica Wars, but Marr countered that Kade was playing politics and that the Aetheri Order had lost their way by forgetting that their duty was to help people and not politicians, which was why the people, and Marr herself, had lost faith in them. Drayden heard the argument and weighed in; so as to help Marr in the upcoming siege while also taking part in the mission to rescue the Chancellor, Drayden promoted Vek to Commander so he could lead the a new formation of the 501st that was dubbed the 332nd Division , assigning Marr to assist as an advisor due to her being unable to hold an official military title. When Kade agreed, Marr accepted the proposal. Kade left the room to prepare their troops leaving Drayden and Marr behind. Drayden gave Marr her new flux blades complimenting them as better than before.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Drayden then headed to rescue the Chancellor, believing the defeats of Vreth and Skarn would mark an end to the war. While he was leaving, Marr stopped him by wishing him good luck in his mission. Happy to have been reunited with his apprentice, Drayden smiled and they both parted ways. Unbeknownst to either of them, this would be the last time they ever saw each other as friends.

#### Confrontation on the Invisible Hand

> " Good, Kael, good! [...] Kill him. Kill him now." "I shouldn't…" "Do it. " ―Theron Mal and Kael Drayden, on killing Varek #### Confrontation on the Invisible Hand

> " Good, Kael, good! [...] Kill him. Kill him now." "I shouldn't…" "Do it. " ―Theron Mal and Kael Drayden, on killing Varek

Having been away from Vantor for months due to the Outer Reach Sieges , Drayden and his Master finally returned to the planet after leaving Marr, to lead the rescue of the Chancellor from General Skarn before the cyborg's fleet could flee the besieged Capital . Assisted by a squadron of ARC-170 starfighters led by Replica Commander Odd Ball, the two Aetheri fought their way through a swarm of Vulture and tri-fighter droid starfighters protecting the Invisible Hand , General Skarn's flagship. Drayden and Kade headed for the ship while the replicas distracted the droids, but Kade's ship was damaged and partially disabled by Buzz-droids . Although Kade told Drayden to abandon him and complete the mission, the younger Aetheri refused and cleared his former master's ship of droids before escorting him to the Invisible Hand ' s hangar. After crashing landing, the two Aetheri disposed of the few remaining droids in the hangar while Bolt-3 located the Chancellor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Once they discovered that he was being held at the top of the ship's observation spire, they concluded that they were walking into a trap when Drayden sensed the presence of Count Varek. Not long after they arrived at the top of the spire, the Umbra Lord appeared before them and the two Aetheri engaged him in a duel. Varek managed to gain the upper hand and knocked Kade out, but his taunting, intended to erode Drayden's morale, instead enraged him. Drayden unleashed his fury on the Umbra Lord, brutally overwhelming him and slicing off both of his hands. Taking Varek's flux blade, he crossed both his and the Count's blades at the Count's throat, and Mal urged him to kill his helpless opponent. Drayden initially hesitated, but after the Chancellor's continued insistence, he gave into his hatred of his nemesis and beheaded Varek. He expressed regret afterward, stating it was not the Aetheri way , but the Chancellor assured him that he had been right to kill the Count.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Despite the Chancellor's pleas, he carried Kade on his back to make their escape. However, the elevators leaving the spire had been disabled. With help from Bolt and the attack taking place on the Invisible Hand by a neighboring Republic cruiser, they were able to escape in the elevator shaft until the ship's crew was able to regain control of the ship, restoring its gravity and turning the shaft once more into well. Kade regained consciousness while they were hanging on inside the shaft and together, he and Drayden were able to escape the shaft just as a reactivated elevator was about to crush them. However, their good fortune failed them, and they were trapped by a ray shield and apprehended, along with Bolt, by battle droids. The two Aetheri and the Chancellor were brought before Skarn in the Invisible Hand ' s control room. The cyborg personally taunted them, derisively commenting on Drayden's youth considering his reputation. Drayden retorted with a taunt about the General being shorter than he had expected, which angered the cyborg general.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Looming fatherhood

> " Are you all right? You're trembling. What's going on? " " Something wonderful has happened. Ani, I'm pregnant. " " ...That's... That- That's won- That's wonderful. " " What are we going to do? " " We're not going to worry about anything right now, alright? This is a happy moment. The happiest moment of my life. " ―Lira announces her pregnancy to Kael Following the ordeal, the two escorted the Chancellor to the Senate building, where they separated—while Kade went back to Aetheri Sanctum to report to the Council, Drayden remained with the Senators who had come to greet the returning Chancellor. He briefly spoke with Senator Solen, who expressed hope that Count Varek's death could bring a quick end to the war. Drayden disagreed, saying that as long as General Skarn remained as leader of the Dissident armies, the war would continue. At that moment, he noticed Ondar behind one of the columns, took his leave from the Senator and reunited with his wife for the first time in months. Having been away fighting in the Outer Reach Sieges, Drayden's single focus was reuniting with Ondar. Ondar then revealed to her husband that she was pregnant. Though they were both worried that this might expose their secret, Ondar especially, Drayden was overjoyed and told her not to worry, saying that it was the happiest moment of his life. The couple returned to Ondar's apartment, where they began to make plans for when the baby would be born, deciding that their child would be raised on Ondara, in the Lake Country . Ondar

and told her not to worry, saying that it was the happiest moment of his life. The couple returned to Ondar's apartment, where they began to make plans for when the baby would be born, deciding that their child would be raised on Ondara, in the Lake Country . Ondar also planned to head there before the birth, to prepare the room. However, that same night, Drayden's happiness was marred when he suffered a nightmare of his wife dying in childbirth, similar to the visions he had had of his mother before her death. Although Ondar tried to comfort him that it was only a dream, he was terrified that he would lose her, as he had lost his mother. Ondar tried to convince him that they needed help and suggested they ask Kade for his assistance. Drayden refused, insisting that their baby was a blessing, not a curse. The next day, at the Aetheri Sanctum, he sought Zho's counsel concerning these dreams, but the Grand Master told Drayden that death was a natural part of life, and to let go of all that he was afraid to lose.

#### Tensions of loyalty

> " Is it possible to learn this power? " " Not from an Aetheri. " ―Drayden and Mal discuss the power to stop people from dying

text:
#### Tensions of loyalty

> " Is it possible to learn this power? " " Not from an Aetheri. " ―Drayden and Mal discuss the power to stop people from dying

At the same time, tensions were rising between Chancellor Mal and the Aetheri Council, who were concerned with his increasing power. Matters were made worse when the Senate announced that they planned to grant him more executive powers in order to facilitate the end of the war. When Drayden was informed of this by Kade, he was supportive of the measure, despite the reservations of the Council and Kade's warning to be wary of Mal. He then told him that the Chancellor had requested his presence for unknown reasons, without informing the Council. So Drayden met with Mal at his office, where he told him that he was appointing the young Aetheri to be his personal representative on the Council, a decision that Drayden believed the Aetheri Masters would never accept.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: When informed of this, the Council allowed Drayden to sit on the Council, yet they refused to grant him the position of Master, a decision which greatly angered Drayden. Drayden turned to Kade, who so remained silent. Angered more by this, Drayden reluctantly accepted his position and took his seat on the council. At the end of the meeting, Kade acknowledged to Drayden that his appointment had been accepted so that, on behalf of the Council, he could spy on the Chancellor, which Drayden was reluctant to do. In recent weeks, Ondar and other senators concerned about Mal's expanded powers had also created the Petition of 2,000 in the name of protecting democracy, requesting he return his emergency powers to the Senate and end the war with cease-fire negotiations. Drayden was manipulated by Mal into believing Ondar could have ulterior motives that she was keeping hidden.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: At the Galaxies Opera House in the Uscru District , Drayden joined Mal in his private box while he was watching Squid Lake . During the performance the Chancellor told Drayden that Replica Intelligence had located General Skarn in the Uthara system . He began to stir Drayden's distrust in the Aetheri council, claiming that the Aetheri were planning on taking control of the Republic and betraying him. Drayden felt conflicted — despite the Aetheri's mistrust in the Chancellor, he still felt that Mal was a good man. He confided in the Chancellor that he had lost trust in the Aetheri. Mal correctly guessed that it was because they had sent Drayden to spy on him, and that it made him feel dishonest. Drayden didn't know how to respond. The Chancellor claimed that the Aetheri were only perceived as good because "good is a point of view," stating that the Aetheri and the Umbra were not so different. While Mal's conflation of the two groups played to Drayden's devotion to his Order's ideals and helped set the stage for his conversion to the umbra side, Drayden rebutted by saying that the Umbra were selfish while the Aetheri were selfless. Mal

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Following the attack, he met with Mal, who then sent him to Emberfall to kill the remaining mebers of the Executive Dissident Council . Before his departure he went back home to Ondar and told her much to her disbelief that the Aetheri Order had tried to topple the Republic and that he was about to go to Emberfall. Telling her that he would end the war, they kissed and he left aboard his new green Eta-2 Actis -class light interceptor , which replaced the interceptor he had lost in the Battle of Vantor. On Emberfall, Velgor slaughtered the entire Dissident Council, including Wat Tambra, Poggle the Lesser, and Nutis Gunray, along with their aides, his eyes now yellow and red with rage. Simultaneously, Mal carried out the proclamation of the New Order in an emergency session of the Senate, claiming that the Aetheri Order had committed treason against the Republic, and reorganized the Republic into the first Imperium with himself as its Emperor . During this time, Velgor was followed by Kakan , who believed he was a aetheri. Velgor showed his face, eyes to Kakan and chased after him to ensure there would be no witness. During his chase, Velgor ran into a cloud of Lava fumes . The fumes caused Velgor to see hallucinations his fellow Aetheri such as Koss, Vael, Vayne, Billaba, Zho, and his former apprentice Marr. Velgor was able to push the fumes away from himself and dismissed the hallucinations. Soon, Velgor reported his mission's completion to Mal; on his orders, Velgor sent a shutdown signal to the Confederate navy and army, effectively ending the Replica Wars. With his mission completed, and the Dissidents dead, Velgor looked on from a balcony and shed a tear at the man

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Although Velgor survived, he was horrifically scarred, both physically and mentally, and had damaged lungs due to the hot ash in the air. Shortly afterward, the Emperor—having sensed his apprentice's peril—arrived on Emberfall, where he found the severely wounded Velgor and took him back to Vantor, in a medical capsule . As the Emperor could not afford to lose Velgor, he turned to the Republic's best scientists, among which was Silvar , who, in doing so, gained private access to Velgor's cybernetics. By the Emperor's orders, Velgor was put into a life-sustaining black suit of armor and outfitted with three new robotic limbs by numerous droids skilled in both cybernetic reconstruction and medical surgery. Among the droids working on Velgor was FX-6 , an FX-9 surgical assistant who previously worked on Skarn's armor. After what Mal later called a "long night" of work, he was finally sealed within his new armor. His eyes showed a brief flicker of fear before his mask and helmet locked together and he drew his first breath.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
heart by believing he had killed Ondar and that her death had pushed him to a new future from the pain it provided, Velgor would become the Emperor's loyal enforcer and apprentice. Cut off from his old life and truly believing he had murdered Ondar, Velgor invested entirely in Mal as his only source of refuge and guidance. #### Hunting a kyber crystal

> " No. I refuse. This is all there is . " ―Believing himself irredeemable after everything, Velgor rejects a vision of returning to the light Immediately after his surgery, the Emperor took Velgor to a balcony overlooking the old Aetheri Sanctum. There, he and Velgor watched as the now- Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon directed a ceremonial burning of the flux blades of all the Aetheri who had been killed in the Temple. As they listened to Veldon's speech, the Emperor asked if his apprentice knew how or why Umbra flux blade blades were red in color. Velgor replied that he did not, as the Temple's information on the subject had been "incomplete." The Emperor laughed and contemptuously mused that the Aetheri had been uncomfortable with the information and had buried it as a result. He then explained that kyber crystals felt pain just like any living being, and could be made to bleed after a fashion by pouring rage, pain, and hate into them. He asked Velgor if he understood, to which Velgor replied that he did, stating that he could have given him any of the burning Aetheri flux blades to corrupt, even Zho's. But he had not, as Velgor realized that the crystal of an Umbra's flux blade should be taken directly from an Aetheri by that Umbra.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As the ceremony progressed, the replica troopers attending the vent threw a basket full of various flux blades into the incinerator, including Zho's. The flux blades caught on fire and a moment later, a powerful blast of energy was released into the air as the kyber crystals were destroyed. Afterward, the Emperor brought Velgor to Gattering in the Mid Reach and assigned him the task of hunting down an Aetheri to take a kyber crystal from. The Emperor took his apprentice to a site where he had arranged for a starship to be delivered for Velgor's use, but the ship had been stolen by a group of pirates. Leaving Velgor to reclaim the vessel, the Emperor departed, and Velgor struck out for the planet's nearest settlement on foot. Once there, he eliminated the group of pirates who had stolen the ship and traveled to the Aetheri outpost Brighthome . The station was garrisoned by a group of replica troopers, who noted Velgor's approach and hailed him.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Though he could have provided the security codes necessary to secure the replica troopers assistance, Velgor decided instead to simply kill them. During the fight, Velgor summoned a green-bladed flux blade from the wall to kill most of the replica troopers. After exterminating the garrison, Velgor tasked the droid co-pilot of his ship to search through the station's archives for data on any Aetheri who had taken the Barash vow prior to Directive 66. Velgor's hope was that any Aetheri who had taken the vow, one of complete non-interference in all Aetheri affairs, would have been not only out of harm's way when Directive 66 was issued but would have ignored its occurrence in accordance with the vow. The search identified Aetheri Master Kirak Infil'a , an Aetheri who had been completely dedicated to combat to the exclusion of all else. When a grenade was thrown at him by two surviving replicas, " Ding " and " Kicker ," he managed to contain the explosion, which the replicas believed would make him unable to do anything else as all his concentration was diverted on freezing the explosion.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As he repaired his helmet, having repaired and donned the rest of his suit by then, Velgor was informed of an intruder in the Aetheri Sanctum Archives. He promptly confronted the intruder, who wielded a red flux blade . As the two fought each other, the intruder appeared to take the advantage, but after a time Velgor revealed that he had simply been testing the modifications that he had recently made to his armor, and promptly destroyed the intruder's flux blade. As Velgor went in for the kill, the Emperor arrived and told him that the intruder, titled the Grand Warden , was part of the Warden Order . Velgor was then taken to The Works , where Velgor saw several other members of the Warden Order—the Sixth Warden , the Fifth Warden , the Seventh Warden , the Ninth Warden , and Tenth Warden —training themselves. Velgor was told that most of the Warden Order were Aetheri who converted to the umbra side in the wake of the Order's destruction in order to save themselves.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
As part of their training, he injured the Ninth Warden and removed her eye, severed the Fifth Warden 's hand, and cut off the Sixth Warden 's arm, to which he demanded that the Sixth Warden get back up and fight him. Instead, the Warden shrank away and made his way to the Warden Order medbay, where he encountered the newly anointed Warden Iskat Vekkis and warned her that she would encounter who had harmed him soon enough. Departing from the training pit, Velgor spoke with the Grand Warden about improving the Warden Order' training methods. They began to search for other Aetheri that survived the purge. Velgor saw the Wardens' target list and noticed the Aetheri Archive's Chief Librarian , Jocasta Nura , on it. He asked the Emperor what was so important about her. The Emperor explained that she had knowledge of the Umbra that she and the Aetheri council had kept secret. The Emperor told Velgor to find Nura and bring her to him. Velgor assigned the Grand Warden to search the Archive for information on her.

#### Hunt for Jocasta Nura

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After her hand healed, Vekkis encountered Tualon Veyra , a fellow former Aetheri Knight whom she had once harbored feelings for and whom left for dead during Directive 66 . Veyra was newly recruited into the Warden Order himself and tortured into joining, although Vekkis initially feared that she was seeing things due to an infection in her hand during their reunion. In their subsequent, emotionally-charged training duel, Vekkis pondered if she would warn Veyra about Velgor and, overall, went easy on him, nonetheless understanding that Velgor and their fellow Wardens would not do the same. However, Veyra concluded the duel by stabbing her through one of her hearts, much to her anger—still, the wound made her reconsider those inflicted upon her by Velgor as they appeared instructional compared to how personal the attack Veyra unleashed had been. After recovering from that wound, she finally had a chance to undertake her first operation as a Warden via her mission to the planet Firrhana . During the mission, she discovered that Veyra had tracked his own Aetheri quarry to Firrhana; by that point, Veyra was aware of Velgor and warned her not to disappoint him and cause him to kill her

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Understanding they and their daughter were at risk, they told him about an anonymous bounty with an exorbitant price posted on the Hunter Net . Ramat Cha, a talented slicer , offered to uncover their employer for him in exchange for their daughter's life. When they demanded that he release Chanath first, Velgor refused. However, the Chas refused to work if their daughter was killed, further declaring that they would happily die as well to exist in death with her. Grudgingly impressed, the Dark Lord demanded proof that Ramat could deliver her side of the deal, which she proved by tracking the signal of the bounty back to Vantor. Velgor released Chanath as agreed, at which point the bounty hunters made their daughter swear that she would seek no vengeance against the Dark Lord, a deal Velgor chose to honor. To complete the deal, Ramat provided Velgor with the information he had requested and gave him the source of the bounty on him: the Imperial Executive Building on Vantor, specifically the Emperor's office.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Velgor then killed both Cha parents right in front of their daughter, who was filled with rage. Despite her oath to not hold a grudge, she ignored her promise and spent her life hunting the Dark Lord in revenge. Eventually, as the years passed on, the Umbra Lord himself simply forgot the murders he carried out on Cabarria. Cha, however, never forgot and became a skilled bounty hunter, studying every report she could and speaking to anyone she could find who had witnessed Velgor in battle. She trained herself to counter Velgor's abilities, eventually enlisting a team of fellow hunters as "the Orphans " to help her in her quest. Cha's skills rose to a level that even Mal took notice, becoming a bounty hunter the Emperor could trust all in the name of possibly getting close to Velgor, only to never see him. In effect, Velgor had completely upended Cha's life, only for the crusade her life turned into to not impact Velgor at all.

Cementing his place

title: Xarn Velgor
text: With their business on Cabarria completed, Velgor and the Ninth Warden left the planet and returned to Vantor. Now suspecting that the Emperor had placed the bounty on his head, the Dark Lord planned to confront his Master about his intentions. As the Ninth Warden piloted the ship through hyperspace, Velgor worked on creating a new flux blade. His droid meanwhile investigated the origins of the kill contract placed on him and confirmed that the order could have come from the Emperor's office, with no evidence of slicing to indicate foul play. But, as the ship arrived in orbit over Vantor, the ship's attempt to transmit clearance codes for landing was jammed and the ship itself was marked as being part of a Dissident splinter cell . The Imperial capital's orbital defenses targeted Velgor's ship. Only the Dark Lord's skill as a pilot prevented them from being destroyed, although the ship was damaged and forced to crash land on Vantor. Tired of the repeated attempts on his life, the Dark Lord headed to the former Aetheri Sanctum to confront the Emperor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The Emperor was investigating the hoard of artifacts that Jocasta Nura had collected and stored in the Aetheri Archives when Velgor arrived. The Emperor sensed that his apprentice did not wish to discuss his recent discovery, although he did praise him for having found the Librarian's stash. Velgor informed his master of the events on Cabarria and his investigation into the kill order against him, before directly asking his Master whether he had placed it on his head as part of a test. Noticing Velgor's new flux blade, the Emperor asked to see it, approving of its design. He also chastised his apprentice for believing that he would resort to such methods as placing a bounty on his head if he wanted to have him killed and that he did not "test": he "taught." He also told Velgor that finding the assassins was his task, not theirs. This echoed a previous lesson he had taught Velgor when he had "disciplined" Colonel Barokki: that they must not kill everyone in the galaxy, but that having power meant they could, and that they would never lack for people to destroy.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor returned to his quarters, where he meditated on the past events and his Master's words. Thinking back to all that had happened, he eventually realized the cause of the conspiracy against him was that his sudden elevation had caused concern and fear among the ranks of the Imperial officers, who knew that he had "strength," but not that he shared the Emperor's "power." Despite a lack of proof, Velgor became convinced that Colonel Barokki, who had so suddenly borne his displeasure, must be involved in the conspiracy. The Dark Lord met with the Emperor and shared his conclusions, and requested that he be publicly recognized and allowed to show them the consequences of opposing him. The Emperor asked whether he was sure, and Velgor confirmed it: he would not kill them all unless he had to, but would not allow them to act against him with impunity. The Emperor agreed to Velgor's plan, but forbade him from killing Varrix, as he was essential to his plans.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: stunned and afraid. With his position in the hierarchy established, Velgor did not need to hold an official military rank. Instead, he acted as the de facto Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Military as per his position as the Emperor's right hand man. Velgor would also come to be recognized as part of both the Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military and the Imperial Ruling Council , of which he was considered a ranking member. After his demonstration before the officer corps, Velgor returned to his personal suite and mediated, cracking the window in his anger that positive thoughts still came.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: King Liarch may have had an adviser helping him with his negotiations with the Imperium. Velgor asked if it could be an Aetheri, and the Emperor said it was possible. He told Velgor to take a team to investigate this and claimed the military aspects of the operation would be left to Moff Varrix. Velgor arrived at Mon Calvarra aboard the Zeta -class shuttle Infernum . With him, he took three Wardens, the Sixth Warden, Ninth Warden, and Tenth Warden , and a death squad of Purge Troopers . At this time, the Imperial ambassador Telvar had just finished another meeting with Liarch, and the man was walking to his shuttle when he saw Velgor descend from the ramp of his shuttle. The Ninth Warden struggled to get past the king's Chief of Security , Gial Vorian, and Velgor confronted the Calavane, asking if he had read the writ that the Ninth Warden had given him. Vorian confirmed that he had, but demanded that he knew their business as he had a job to do and so did Velgor. Velgor complied and explained about a possible enemy of the Imperium on Mon Calvarra. As he said that, Telvar's shuttle took off and flew for Varrix's Iron Cruiser, the Sovereign —which was in orbit above Mon Calvarra. However, as Vorian denied the possibility of an enemy of the Imperium being on Mon Calvarra, Telvar's shuttle exploded.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: who was struggling to deal with the grueling conflict on Mon Calvarra. Velgor told Varrix that he was busy, but Varrix knew that and asked him to do something else instead: capture Liarch. Velgor told Varrix that he did not answer to him, but Varrix replied that capturing Liarch was the only way to end the fighting quickly on Mon Calvarra, and he pledged to owe Velgor a favor if he did so. Velgor agreed and told the Wardens to continue the hunt as he left. Velgor arrived at Liarch's Royal Command Bunker and killed his guards. He then disarmed Liarch and contacted Varrix, who told him to take Liarch to a window and send him his exact location. Velgor asked Varrix if he was going to send a shuttle, and the man said not yet. Once Velgor did what he asked, Varrix began a bombardment of Mon Calvarra. Liarch watched in horror but refused to surrender. The two were interrupted by Barr, who had outsmarted and scattered Velgor's team. Barr confronted Velgor and the two dueled . As they fought, Barr revealed that he had assassinated Telvar to send the Calavane into war. Liarch overheard this and realized his mistake in following Barr. He ran to his terminal and sent a message to the Calavane and Quarren forces, ordering them to cease fire. Liarch then contacted Varrix, notifying him of the surrender. Varrix sent a shuttle to pick him up but continued the bombardment.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Velgor and Barr continued fighting, and Barr began laughing. Liarch questioned this, and Barr said that he had completed his plan. Barr prophesied that the Calavane vessels would be at the forefront of a great insurgency decades from then, and decades after that. Velgor told Barr that he was not an Aetheri anymore, and Barr told him that that made two of them, saying that he still beat the Umbra. Velgor then slew him, and the shuttle arrived to pick up Liarch. The king told Velgor that Mon Calvarra would rise again, but Velgor told him that there was no Mon Calvarra, only the Imperium. Some time after the mission, Velgor ordered to imprison and torture the people of Mon Calvarra.

#### Investigation on Pyralis

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Despite the mistrust and even hatred he generated among the officers, Velgor was held in high esteem by the Shock trooper Corps , as he often fought alongside them at the front line rather than remaining in command centers. As the Emperor's enforcer, Velgor retained command of the unit he had commanded during the Replica Wars as Kael Drayden: the 501st Legion. When the Emperor retired the replica troopers, the rank and file of the 501st were composed of recruited shock troopers, some of whom received training from the Dark Lord himself, such as Sergeant Kreel , an undercover agent whom Velgor trained in flux blade combat. Through their missions on Velgor's behalf, the 501st came to be known as "Velgor's Fist." On one occasion, the shock trooper Terex met Velgor, becoming terrified of him while also respecting him. Velgor also garnered strong support from the pilots of the new Imperial Navy .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Meanwhile, Velgor continued on his hunt for surviving Aetheri with his Wardens, constantly putting himself to work to that end. Thanks to their efforts, most surviving Aetheri were successfully located and then cut down as the Imperial Era continued. However, Velgor's successes against the Aetheri left him with few in the galaxy who could offer him a real challenge. While he was willing to kill Wardens for failure, Velgor stopped being a day-to-day danger to the Wardens as each present member of the group had passed his initial test, in which he might remove a Warden's limbs or kill them. If they survived that duel, Velgor was willing to work with the Warden and treated then as a mere servants to his will, although it was more than clear that a fierce punishment awaited those who disappointed him. The Thirteenth Warden, for her part, undertook dozens of operations over her career and continued to work under Velgor, whom she never became truly comfortable with, but she also believed they shared many similarities, including a hatred for the Aetheri and what she saw as the Order's unforgiveable crimes. In her time serving under him, she managed not to disappoint Velgor, something

title: Xarn Velgor
text: career and continued to work under Velgor, whom she never became truly comfortable with, but she also believed they shared many similarities, including a hatred for the Aetheri and what she saw as the Order's unforgiveable crimes. In her time serving under him, she managed not to disappoint Velgor, something she desperately avoided. As much as fighting Aetheri provided Velgor an outlet as he could challenge himself by fighting them, the Thirteenth Warden noticed that most hunts Velgor undertook ended relatively quickly, with Velgor swiftly overpowering and killing his target before moving onto the next one, keeping himself constantly at work. One target sought after by the Wardens and Velgor was Verla , the wayward apprentice of Ferran Barr. On several occasions, Velgor nearly caught Verla, who nonetheless always managed to escape him and the Wardens. One encounter involved Velgor chasing Verla through a rocky environment. Ultimately, the constant chase and her life on the run, which involved abandoning people she became close to or having to deal with the Imperial seekers killing them, became too much for Verla, who decided to abandon her Aetheri path. On one occasion, Velgor stood over the bodies of a number of victims with his flux blade still ignited, an image that embodied his status as an evil monster to beings like Verla.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Dragged off by the creatures, Velgor awoke to find himself and his sergeant confined in the Z'Rakkons' lair. The sergeant, who believed he and Velgor were to be eaten, expressed discontent with such a manner of death, causing Velgor to summon his flux blade and promise vengeance. Velgor freed himself and killed several of the beasts, lecturing them on their mistakes before proceeding to eliminate their queen.

The queen Z'Rakkon—in truth, Lemare herself—recounted how she had joined the creatures and become their ruler willingly. Stabbing Velgor through the chest, Lemare then revealed that she had integrated the Umbra Lord into the Z'Rakkon hive mind. However, Velgor escaped Lemare's snare and, despite her pleas, annihilated her. Lemare explained that she had only tried to bring Velgor peace, a favor Velgor returned by killing her and guiding the Endless Mercy to crash down on to the surface of an astronomical object below. Departing the decimated starship, Velgor remarked that the only peace was death and that the umbra side would always endure.

#### Relics of the Replica Wars

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Relics of the Replica Wars

Around 17 BVE during the early Imperial era, around two years after the skirmish aboard the Tribunal during Directive 66, Velgor traveled to the snowy moon that was home to the crash site of the Vorash -class Iron Cruiser. Investigating the wreckage with a contingent of snowtroopers , Velgor discovered a memorial to the replica company that perished in the crash, as well as a flux blade, partly frozen but still functional, that once belonged to his former apprentice, Sela Marr.

Igniting the flux blades' blue blade, Velgor heard a squawking sound and turned his head to the sky, where he saw a strange bird soaring through the air. Deep down in his heart, he realized his former Adept was alive, but he lacked any concrete proof and did not sense her presence. As such, he assumed to himself that she may have died, thereby closing the painful memories she represented, despite deep down realizing she had to be alive. After gazing at the bird for a moment, Velgor deactivated the flux blade and turned away from the crash site with the blade in hand, his image reflected in an abandoned replica trooper helmet.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Though the squadron commander suggested allowing the Perilous to tractor the transport into one of its hangar bays when it arrived, Velgor assumed (correctly) that the insurgents planned to destroy the transport by detonating the heavy ordnance present in the ship's cargo bays. In order to prevent this eventuality, Velgor crashed his black Eta-2 Actis -class light interceptor into one of its gun bubbles and ejected just before the collision. He then entered the ship through the damaged gun emplacement and proceeded to kill all of the insurgent Velaris on the ship. After eliminating the insurgent leader Pok , Velgor noticed an active comlink on the bridge. Assuming that another insurgent ship was nearby, Velgor had his Vireos fan out in a search pattern, but the insurgent ship escaped detection by shutting down nearly all of its systems and hiding in the rings of a nearby planet. Finding nothing, Velgor had the Perilous collect the transport, and returned to Vantor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: In the Imperial Palace, Velgor reunited with his master. There, he and Mal met with Selvara's Senator Orn Free Taa involving the inconvenience that was the Free Selvara Movement. The movement, though relatively minor, had been conducting raids on Imperial shipping facilities and transports and had seriously impacted the flow of Spice from the planet. As such, Mal believed that the situation warranted his personal attention, and decided that he, Taa, and Velgor would travel to Selvara for a state visit . After informing the Senator of the planned journey and dismissing him, Mal informed his apprentice that Taa almost certainly had a traitor in the midst of his support staff who was feeding the movement classified information on Imperial doings.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Vexana studied the path, suspecting that Baylo was incorrect in his adjustment. Velgor and Vexana discovered that the changed hyperspace route would crash the Defiance into Krestophis' sun , killing all aboard. Velgor ordered Vexana to correct the problem, and without revealing that he knew of Baylo's treachery, Velgor and Baylo went to see the Emperor. The Emperor ordered Baylo to turn over command of the Defiance and take a position at the training center on Korrath . Baylo, however, was loyal to the Republic and considered the Imperium a hostile power. Instead of turning over his command, Baylo offered his resignation from the navy. Velgor then revealed he knew of Baylo's plan to crash the Defiance , and the Emperor congratulated Velgor for handling the "petty problem," annoying him.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Crash landing on Selvara

Shortly thereafter, Velgor and the Emperor reboarded the Perilous and resumed their course to the Selvara system. However, upon their exit from hyperspace, the ship immediately began slamming into spacial mines set up by Chavar Kryll 's insurgents. Hidden amongst these mines were specialized devices designed to drain the ship's shields, which began to buckle under the continual assault. As the shields neared failure, a swarm of several hundred reprogrammed Vulture Droids set upon the Perilous from the system's asteroid belt. Velgor boarded his personal interceptor and took several squadrons of Imperial pilots to destroy the droid fighters and mines, but discovered a short time into the battle that Vulture Droids were each carrying a payload of explosive buzz droids .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Realizing that the Vultures themselves were simply delivery systems meant to unload the buzz droids near or inside the Iron Cruiser, Velgor ordered his squadron to concentrate fire on them, as they presented a far greater threat than the mines. But between the mines and the Vultures, there were simply too many targets for Velgor and his squadrons to handle, and the Perilous was severely damaged. The second wave of Vultures was detected immediately after the first had been destroyed, further compounding the already bleak situation. A message came to Velgor from Captain Lewitt of the Perilous that the ship could sustain virtually no more damage without being destroyed.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Unbeknownst to Velgor, some of the Velari repair teams in fact comprised members of the Free Selvara movement, one of which was a group of saboteurs with orders to plant timed explosives on the hyperrelay core of the Perilous . Shortly after the teams landed, one of the Free Selvara groups engaged in a firefight with Imperial shock troopers. When Velgor learned of this, he ordered all of the Velari repair teams, numbering over 100, to be killed regardless of whether they were aiding the assault and proceeded to Deck 17, where the firefight had been reported. On the way, he killed a group of apparently uninvolved Velaris before proceeding to the hyperrelay chamber. The saboteurs, who were led by Chavar's second in command, Isval , had managed to seal the hatch to the hyperrelay core before any Imperial troops could interrupt them, and Velgor began to use his flux blade to cut it open.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: By the time Velgor finished cutting through the hatch, the saboteurs had already concluded their business and escaped. The main hyperrelay core had been riddled with timed charges, set to detonate if anyone attempted to disarm or remove them. Velgor concluded that the ship was lost, and ordered the captain to evacuate. Velgor contacted Mal, who instructed his apprentice to meet him aboard his shuttle. Before departing, however, Velgor made one last attempt to kill the saboteurs, but they narrowly evaded him and escaped in an Imperial escort boat . Subsequently, Velgor reunited with the Emperor and left on the shuttle, mere minutes before the Iron Cruiser exploded. Shortly thereafter, the Imperial traitor Belka Drayn provided Chavar with the transponder identity of the Emperor's shuttle, and he directed Isval and her group aboard the escort boat to attack it.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Not too long afterward, the Velari insurgents continued their assault on freighters, prompting Velgor and the Emperor to take action and destroy them, before moving away from their fallen shuttle. At night, they stopped to rest, when the Emperor questioned his regret and loyalty, but Velgor showed himself devoted still. They were soon attacked by a lylek horde, forcing them to retreat into a tunnel, unaware that they had entered their nest. They stood their ground against hundreds of lyleks and their significantly threatening queen, and killed them all before exiting the tunnel and finding a young Velari, Drua . When the Emperor tried to kill her, Velgor stopped him, intending to have the girl guide them to her village , where they obtained a communicator to speak with Moff Mors.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
The pair separated when Velgor left Varrix, who met with the Emperor alone. Afterward, Velgor (like Varrix and Veldon) partook in a meeting between the Imperial Ruling Council, and the leaders of Imperium Vigil Bureau and Naval Intelligence Agency in the palace's audience chamber , overseen by the Emperor. He then assigned Varrix and Velgor to a mission on Murkhana to investigate recently discovered Shadowfeed technology and its relationship to the attack on Sentinel Base. The pair traveled to the planet on the Carrion Spike , which Velgor made to carry his meditation chamber .

On Murkhana, however, the Spike was stolen by unknown dissidents , prompting Velgor and Varrix to kill the Sulie crime lord Faazah , and take his Parsec Predator to pursue the stolen ship, hidden by its cloaking systems. Making use of his connection to his meditation chamber, Velgor pinpointed the insurgents' location to the Fial system and later, the Galidraan system , where they engaged the Spike before they jettisoned his meditation chamber and escaped to Lucazec . With the Predator disabled, Velgor and Varrix boarded the Liberator , from which Velgor issued his black Eta-2 interceptor to be transported on the Goliath from Vantor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: On the Goliath , Varrix told Velgor that the insurgency was surely being supported by someone high up in the Imperial Military , and predicted that the insurgents would go to Phindar to refuel the Spike . Subsequently, Velgor led a squadron to attack the stolen corvette in the Phindar system . Though they greatly damaged the ship, it escaped, prompting Varrix and Velgor to calculate its trajectory to Obroa-skai system . Teller transmitted false intelligence that the insurgents were heading to the Obroa-skai system. Hoping to capture the Carrion Spike , Varrix and Velgor deployed substantial Imperial resources including three Interdictor vessels. The prototype Immobilizer 418 cruiser malfunctioned, yanking several ships out of hyperspace and causing a massive accident .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Despite failing to catch the Spike , the Imperials managed to capture the YT-1000 light freighter Reticent , which Teller had sent as a decoy to throw the Imperials off-scent. While Velgor interrogated its Koorivar captain on the Executrix , Varrix accessed Imperial databases and discovered the identities of the insurgents, including its leader Berch Teller . Velgor also interrogated the Reticent ' s Syra Myrthian navigator, who suffered a heart attack. However, Velgor learned from one of his contacts in the Crymorah Syndicate that a lieutenant had negotiated a deal with the Sulie crime lord Faazah for a supply of custom fuel cells . These fuel cells had reached Murkhana shortly before Varrix and Velgor's arrival, thus confirming that Faazah had been colluding with the insurgents.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After a private holo transmission with the Emperor, Velgor told Varrix that Vice Admiral Dodd Rancit was sure the insurgents would attack the Imperial academy at Carida next. Then, Velgor parted ways with Varrix to meet with Rancit, but not before asking for the meaning behind the Carrion Spike ' s name and Varrix told him about his test in Eriadu 's Carrion Plateau . On the Carida system , Velgor boarded the Secutor -class Iron Cruiser Conquest and met Rancit just as the Spike reverted to realspace , astrogating on autopilot. Aware of Rancit's treason, as a co-conspirator of Teller, Velgor had Lieutenant Crest place Rancit aboard an escape pod and had Rancit give himself the command to issue the fire order that destroyed it. Elsewhere, Varrix dealt with the insurgents, ending the insurgency .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The hunt took place on the Outer Reach planet Chandar's Folly , and Varrix immediately began trying to take on the Dark Lord of the Umbra. Knowing of Velgor's brutal abilities, Varrix outfitted the hunters with slugthrowers and flamethrowers to avoid the possibility of Velgor deflecting their shots. On the second day, they cornered Velgor at a copse of Thurian trees , and four hunters engulfed him with their flamethrowers. As Varrix watched Velgor get covered by the flames, he thought he saw fear in his body language. Velgor's possible fear was brief, however, as he targeted the hunters' flamethrowers, incinerating the four hunters. Through the following days, Varrix saw that Velgor was not hard to track, leaving clear signs wherever he went. They learned why as on multiple occasions Velgor ambushed them. On one occasion, Varrix and his hunters were tracking Velgor near a cliff when he revealed himself and killed one of the hunters with his. Two others fired on him but failed to kill him.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Continuing his hunt for surviving Aetheri even as more and more of the Order was destroyed, wiping out many of the individuals whom Velgor could actually find a challenge against, Velgor gathered the Fifth Warden, Tualon Veyra, and the Thirteenth Warden for the latest of his personal missions : Velgor and the Warden Order had successfully tracked down the former Aetheri Master Etha Korrin, whose time on the Aetheri High Council had ended with his removal from the body. After that, Korrin had elected to leave the Aetheri altogether and, as a consequence, escaped the execution of Directive 66. The Imperium had finally tracked Korrin to a largely unknown desert planet , where he had become a priest in the Church of the Ganthic Enlightenment and taken a wife, a fellow Zyrrak named Mira . Ahead of the mission, the Thirteenth Warden felt pleased to be welcomed onto one of Velgor's personal missions and was given a select few details about the mission, such as Velgor's urge to finish what Directive 66 had failed to do by killing Korrin.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor, for his part, had become suspicious of the Thirteenth Warden's loyalty. She had, indeed, become dissatisfied with her life among the Wardens as she felt trapped, feeling as though she had no freedom and was left to perform work for superiors who took all the credit for themselves. She had forced herself to continue her service lest Velgor discover her doubts and invite her into a maiming-filled sparring match. Still, she found solace in a romantic relationship with Veyra, something Velgor had also sensed. While relationships were not strictly disallowed among the Warden Order, Velgor regarded their connection as a weakness and believed the death of Korrin should serve as a warning to both of them. Later, he would claim that he believed that the Thirteenth Warden was building a coalition to usurp control of the Warden Order from himself and the Emperor, using Veyra as her first follower. In truth, however, she simply wanted to retire to her homeworld of Pkori , potentially with Veyra joining her.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Arriving at the Warden Order Headquarters in the Works, Velgor disembarked from the Zeta -class shuttle while telekinetically holding Korrin's child aloft, the Thirteenth Warden, Fifth Warden, and Veyra behind him. Present for their return was the waiting Grand Warden, who welcomed Velgor's return to Vantor and applauded his efforts, and two nursemaids , nanny droids that served the Warden Order as part of Project Harvester. As he disembarked, Velgor informed the Grand Warden that the mission had been a complete success and that the Wardens—whom he referred to as the Grand Warden's subordinates, not his own—had performed their roles well. The Thirteenth Warden found the praise unusual and welcome, yet also demeaning: as she saw things, she was solely responsible for the capture of the child and alone deserved praise for the mission, something she believed Velgor knew. However, Velgor's brief comment had robbed her of individual credit. Such a feeling had plagued her as an Aetheri and made her further doubt her station as a Warden, with Velgor's words sticking with her as the day continued.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As he handed the child off to the nursemaids, Velgor asked the Grand Warden who their next target was, something which made the Warden pause and lead Velgor away. Within the building, Velgor was led to a holographic list of confirmed Aetheri survivors who had hidden themselves away too well to be actively hunted. As such, the death of Korrin ushered in a new phase of the Aetheri Purge: the Grand Warden informed Velgor that Project Harvester would continue but that there were no active hunts for surviving Aetheri, effectively meaning they would have to wait for an Aetheri to reveal themselves or offer a trail. Suddenly, Velgor was faced with a galaxy where there were so few Aetheri left that he had no active targets against whom he could challenge himself. Rather than respond, Velgor silently exited the room and returned to his personal apartment. As time passed, he bathed in a bacta tank, telekinetically modified his life support equipment, walked through Imperial halls, dueled with a training droid, and meditated, in which state he found himself back over the stormy ocean, albeit with calm waves. However, Velgor felt no calm and clenched his fist in silence.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: #### Chasing "rogue" Wardens After feeling that frustration, Velgor decided he had to look elsewhere for a challenge and turned his attention to the Thirteenth Warden, who Velgor knew he would be able to paint as a traitor because of his suspicious about her loyalty and her decision to briefly allow Mira to escape with Korrin's daughter. Velgor made his way into the Warden Order common room, where all the present Wardens had been gathered by the Grand Warden to spend time together. There, the Thirteenth Warden and Veyra were sharing a bottle of dust juice from Korrin's planet to celebrate his death and discussed what would become of Velgor once they had finished off the last of the Aetheri, sliding her eyes towards Velgor in the process. As Veyra mused that Velgor would keep himself busy and find someone new to kill, the Umbra Lord approached their table, catching the Thirteenth Warden's attention as she felt his cold shadow approach them. Meanwhile, the increasingly inebriated Veyra failed to notice his presence. Once he loomed over them both, Velgor announced his presence by silently igniting his flux blade, finally catching Veyra's attention and shocking both them. Likewise, other present Wardens, including the Grand Warden,

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Velgor was then ordered by the Emperor to go to Cindervale to deal with Senator Bael Solen. However, to the surprise of his master, Velgor refused. Having carried out Mal's will for so long, Velgor was content to continue to do so, but he first he demanded a world of his own. Rejecting Mal's offer to give him Dunemere or Ondara, Velgor asked to be given Emberfall, the world where he had been defeated by Kade. The Emperor agreed to his request and would send Colonel Alva Brenne to build a facility for him there. Before leaving for Emberfall, Velgor was then shown the Mask of Vael Mornick , which Mal gave him to help with construction. When Velgor questioned how his master had learned of an Umbra Lord not mentioned in any Umbra nor Aetheri reliquary he had studied, Mal vaguely answered that the mask itself had told him about Mornick.

Return to Emberfall

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Return to Emberfall

> " Perhaps your Lira does await you on Emberfall. Perhaps the umbra side will bring her to you. Go. I think, one way or another, you will learn a great deal. That is good. After all, your power…is my power. " ―Mal to Velgor, before the latter departs for Emberfall Velgor, along with Colonel Brenne and her aide, Lieutenant Roggo , took Velgor's Ondara starship to Emberfall. During the flight, Velgor saw a vision of his younger self with a face that matched his mask. Upon entering the planet's atmosphere, Velgor deactivated the starship's shields and allowed it to burn as they landed. Once on the planet's surface, Velgor commented that the ship looked better burnt. He then told Brenne that he was there to understand a great mystery. While Brenne and Roggo got to work designing Velgor's castle, Velgor returned to the cave where he bled his kyber crystal. As he reached out to the power within the cave's locus, he was presented with a design for the castle from Brenne, which Velgor rejected. However, shortly after leaving, Velgor heard Brenne scream and returned to the starship to find her dead. He also discovered that Roggo had donned Mornick's mask. Velgor attacked Roggo, but stopped upon seeing that he had created a new design for the castle. Removing the mask from Roggo's corpse, Velgor took the mask into the cave and placed it upon the locus. He then asked the mask who he was, to which he replied "I

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Finally, Velgor found himself on a balcony with a vision of Ondar standing before him. Velgor, now in the form of Kael Drayden, told Ondar to come with him. However, Ondar simply told him that Kael Drayden was dead before leaping from the balcony. Velgor screamed in agony as the specter of Ondar was destroyed by a bolt of lightning. He then saw a beacon of blue light in the distance. Within the beacon was a figure who activated a blue flux blade, pushing Velgor back and returning him to his body. After awakening in the castle and retrieving his flux blade, Velgor destroyed the umbra side locus, sealing off the door, because he was unable to restore his wife.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: In 9 BVE , Velgor at last had a chance for his long-awaited rematch with Kade after a Warden known as the Third Warden—who was obsessed with finding Kade because she was in fact the youngling Revai, who wanted to use Kade as bait to get close to Velgor and enact revenge for his slaughter at the Aetheri Sanctum years before —arranged for the kidnapping of Elira Solen to draw Kade to the planet Daiyu . Although he escaped with Solen, the Third Warden told Kade that Drayden had survived his injuries. As Kade grabbled with the information, Velgor awoke in his bacta tank in Fortress Velgor on Emberfall. Assembling his suit, Velgor moved to his throne room and spoke to the Third Warden via hologram, demanding to know where Kade was. Dismissing the apparent death of the Grand Warden, whom Revai had stabbed in her desire to claim credit for Kade's capture herself, Velgor ordered her to prove herself capable, with the position of Grand Warden as her reward should she succeed. In truth, he knew the Third Warden was the youngling Revai and that she intended to betray him, but Velgor kept her alive so long as she

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Kade was visibly distraught and apologized to Kael. Velgor replied that he was not Kade's failure and that Kade did not kill Kael: instead, Velgor replied that he killed Kael and vowed to destroy Kade as well. With that, Kade was left to believe his friend was truly dead before bidding Velgor, whom he simply called "Vael," farewell. As Kade left, Velgor called out to him while trying to rise to his feet, unable to catch Kade before he slipped through his grasp once more. Velgor was left with the belief that he had been but a learner in their latest duel, convincing him to increase his strength to cement his power over Kade for whenever their next encounter came. Velgor's suit was repaired and he returned to Fortress Velgor, where he conferred with the Emperor via hologram, stating that he had dispatched probes along all possible routes and that Kade would not escape him again. The Emperor noticed Velgor's agitation and suggested that Velgor could not move beyond his past. Velgor, seeing the threat hidden in Mal's reply, affirmed that Kade meant nothing to him and that he only served the Emperor.

### Attack on the Archive

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Immediately after the incident, Velgor had it broadcast all over the planet that the insurgents had assassinated Tua in order to discredit them. Velgor then ordered Kallux to lock down the planet's spaceport and publicly announce that any ship attempting to reach orbit would be destroyed. Velgor knew that the lockdown, combined with the populace's mistrust of the insurgents, would essentially guarantee that they would need to steal a ship in order to escape. As such, he provided a tempting target at the local Imperial garrison; a shuttle capable of hyperspace travel. When the insurgents attempted to steal it, Velgor confronted them with a small group of shock troopers. Velgor engaged the insurgents' Aetheri members, Aldric and Virel, while his troops engaged in a small scale firefight with the other insurgents. As his intent was for the insurgents to escape, Velgor lazily toyed with the two Aetheri while their cohorts attempted to launch the shuttle.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Upon discovering Sela's presence aboard the insurgent craft, Velgor's priorities immediately changed. In an unexpected turn of good fortune for the insurgents, Velgor broke off what would have been a killing run at Ember Home in favor of engaging the VCX-100 light freighter . As Velgor peppered the Wisp with volt pistol fire, Brenn and Lena Kryll managed to convince Jun Savren to evacuate Ember Home as Admiral Kassius Konstantine entered the system with three Star Destroyers. The Admiral contacted Velgor in order to receive instructions, and Velgor ordered Konstantine to block the Wisp ' s escape, but not to fire at it, as he wanted the insurgents aboard it alive. Meanwhile, the crew of Ember Home abandoned the crippled command ship and fled the system with the tattered remains of the insurgent fleet. As Velgor closed in on the Wisp , it jumped to hyperspace just as the Destroyers activated their tractor beams , catching Velgor instead of the Wisp .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Following his victory, Velgor boarded Konstantine's Destroyer and contacted the Emperor. He informed his master that he had "broken" the insurgents, but the elder Umbra Lord sensed disquiet in his apprentice's emotions. Velgor then revealed to the Emperor that he had discovered that Marr was alive, and told his master that he believed that she was in league with the insurgents. Pleased by this news, the Emperor declared that she could lead the two Umbra Lords to other Aetheri who survived Directive 66. Velgor immediately postulated that Kade might be amongst them, to which the Emperor concurred; if Kade was still alive. The Emperor urged Velgor to be patient, and instructed him to send another Warden to hunt the insurgents down.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
bird Velgor had seen on the snowy moon outside Marr's crashed Vorash. Virel witnessed the conclusion of Velgor's battle with Marr even as his younger self was locked out of the reliquary chamber. As Velgor swung his flux blade at Marr, Virel reached through the portal and yanked her backward into the temple. As a result, Velgor's strike missed and the temple floor crumbled, sending Velgor plummeting into a pool of light. From Velgor's perspective, a hand had reached from a portal from nowhere to save Marr. Velgor survived the fall and managed to make his way back to the surface, where he was watched by Morai. After Morai guided Marr —who escaped back to her place in time after Mal reached into the World Between Worlds —through the depths of the temple to reach another portal to the World Between Worlds, the convor exited the temple and flew out, with Velgor watching the bird from the surface. Believing Marr dead, Velgor departed Searmark and returned to his duties in the Imperium. Marr's supposed demise marked the end of the Great Aetheri Purge.

#### Continued insurgency

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Later, the captain of the bounty hunter team—Beilert Varrick, the same man he had saved during Varrick's days as an Imperial soldier —amplified a signal near Arvina , disguising it as a Hidden Hand signal. Velgor arrived on an Iron Cruiser in response and it fired on the city below. He then got into his SKREE fighter and chased after Varrick's team. Their sniper, the Insurgent agent Gita , currently disguised as the Dunefolk Raider "Urrr'k", managed to shoot down two of Velgor's support Skrees. This gave the team enough time to escape, leaving Velgor to investigate the damage in the city below. Varrick had planned to leave data banks behind that would reveal the Hidden Hand's secret outposts, allowing him to get the jump on Velgor. However, an informant of Velgor's within the crew —the bounty hunter Dengrik —revealed the bounty hunters' next destination.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor followed them to a Hidden Hand outpost on Heva aboard the Formidable . Upon arriving, an Imperial general informed Velgor that Varrick's ship, the Broken Wing , had been located, and that their informant had gone silent. Velgor abruptly told the general to scramble all fighters, much to the general's confusion. Varrick's crew had begun remotely piloting a fleet of bot-drones towards the Formidable . Velgor got into his SKREE fighter and pursued the drones as well as the Broken Wing . He shredded the drone fleet, but the drones started to pull away. Velgor told his pilots to stay on the leader, as he took out its laser cannons. The drones then formed a large cannon that fired, destroying the Formidable . Despite this, Velgor stayed locked on the Broken Wing , taking out its engines and causing it to crash-land. Velgor landed his SKREE fighter and entered the ship, flux blade drawn. After finding the ship empty, he stood on the roof. Dengrik and fellow hunter Honnah fired on the SKREE fighters near Velgor's ship and destroyed them. Velgor looked in their direction as the bounty hunters took aim.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor brought Varrick on his Iron Cruiser Vengeance along with Dengrik. He gave the bounty hunter his reward and asked abut the Hidden Hand. Dengrik said that he had told Velgor everything he knew, and that Varrick would not tell him anything more. Velgor dismissed him and told him that he knew where to find him, if the Imperium ever required his services again. In the interrogation room, Varrick had been questioned for days, to no avail. Velgor arrived, dismissed interrogation staff and started torturing Varrick for answers until he passed out. Once awake, Varrick escaped his constraints and killed two guards. Exiting out using their armor and weapons, he was greeted by his ship and Velgor. Velgor took him to Chorin and Varrick told him how both he and the Imperium failed to protect Chorin, creating the Hidden Hand. Velgor told him that what remained of his people would be safe. Knowing his history as an Imperial cadet, Velgor welcomed him back to the Imperium.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Undeterred, Velgor searched for any survivors in Lady Corvax's bloodline, which he eventually discovered with the help of Imperial Admiral Gable Karius use an Interdictor vessel to pull a starship named Windfall out of hyperspace above Emberfall and capture the smuggler who was the descendant he had been looking for. Velgor proceeded to demand the smuggler to open a configuration box to confirm their relation to Lady Corvax, and once they succeeded, Velgor left with a reminder that he would need their services later. He communicated with the Black Bishop , who had been his ally in his search for the Aeon Engine, where they discussed about how the Bright Star would give Velgor the incredible powers needed to even resurrect the dead and that with Corvax's descendant in his grasp, the final component needed to achieve his goals was now Velgor's. Dismissing the Bishop once he sensed Lira's soul echo through the Aeon Engine, Velgor let out a wail of fury and sorrow once she quickly disappeared after announcing her pregnancy. Catching up to the smuggler and the ZO-E3 in their attempts to escape, Velgor tossed aside the droid before getting the smuggler to open the lock to the

title: Xarn Velgor
text: their training later and viewed a message left behind by Lady Corvax for one of her descendants, dismissing Lady Corvax's plea to fix her mistake as her never understanding the true extent of that which she had created. Treading down the pathway, the third test for the smuggler came when they came across a large room populated by nests of Lava nymphs , Velgor demanding them to tap into the umbra side and exterminate the vermin. Unimpressed by their difficulties in doing so, Velgor stated their abilities were hardly acceptable and lacking in much regards. but before he could work on the Smuggler more, activating the pedestal with a key caused a large portion of the floor begins to break apart, and despite Velgor's efforts to keep the Smuggler under his watch, lifting up the floor, a darkghast attacked him, forcing him to let go of the Smuggler to fight the creature. Despite the separation, Velgor caught up to the Smuggler just as they had retrieved the Bright Star with a tipoff from the Mole. Seeing that the Smuggler had intended to backstab him, Velgor beat them to the punch, retrieved the Bright Star, and left them and their friends

title: Xarn Velgor
text: the creature. Despite the separation, Velgor caught up to the Smuggler just as they had retrieved the Bright Star with a tipoff from the Mole. Seeing that the Smuggler had intended to backstab him, Velgor beat them to the punch, retrieved the Bright Star, and left them and their friends stranded on the cave after coldly making it clear their betrayal meant nothing as they had outlived their usefulness. Placing the Bright Star on the Aeon Engine, Velgor began the ritual to resurrect Lira, determined to save his wife at the cost of everyone else, willing to even sacrifice other planets if necessary. Lira's face began to emerge with her voice repeating her same words from long ago, indicating that there was the possibility that the ritual could work, but the Smuggler reemerged to stop the ritual, knowing the potential catastrophe that the device could cause. Although surprised by the smuggler's survival, Velgor believed it didn't matter, and engaged his brief apprentice in a duel as he vowed that he would succeed where Lady Corvax had failed. As the smuggler managed to resist Velgor's attacks, the Bright Star's energies coalesced, finally causing a bluish projection of Ondar in full-bodied form to appear, as she began to utter some of the last words that Velgor had heard her tell him long ago. Velgor then paused the duel in its tracks, holding the smuggler in a choke hold, as he realized that their presence was affecting the Aeon Engine. However, it was too late as her projection faded. Realizing the ritual had failed, Velgor became furious, blaming his failure on the

title: Xarn Velgor
text: long ago. Velgor then paused the duel in its tracks, holding the smuggler in a choke hold, as he realized that their presence was affecting the Aeon Engine. However, it was too late as her projection faded. Realizing the ritual had failed, Velgor became furious, blaming his failure on the smuggler, and proceeded to easily overpower him. However, before he could kill his opponent, the Black Bishop intervened, stopping Velgor temporarily and giving the smuggler the opening needed to destroy the Aeon Engine. By the time Velgor was free, he could only beheld the Engine's destruction in horror, and before he could strike down the smuggler, the Engine exploded, sending the two far away from one another.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor found Kade after he had deactivated a grapple beam terminal to allow the Corsair escape the battle station, and the two engaged in one final duel. During the fight, Velgor noted that Kade's age had made him weak. However, Kade told his former apprentice that he would not win because he would become more powerful than Velgor could ever imagine, even if he managed to kill him. As they fought, the two reached Bay 327 just as Kade's companions and the Princess reunited to board the Corsair , only for Kade to see his latest apprentice, Joren Drayden, Velgor's son.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The following day, Velgor returned in his official capacity as the Emperor's envoy to negotiate as if nothing had happened the day before. Grukk welcomed Velgor and claimed that his resources belonged to the Imperium as long as he was paid. Velgor then turned to leave, leaving his shock troopers to tell Grukk what was required, but the Grak invited him to a feast and entertainment in his honor, for he liked to seal his business ventures by watching someone die. Aboard the sail barge Khetanna , Velgor and Grukk watched as the latter's guards killed wild striders for the sport until Grukk's court jester , Salacious B. Crumb , let out a loud cackle. Velgor warned the Grak to not let the Kowakian monkey-lizard do that again in his presence if he valued Crumb's life; Grukk merely laughed and told Velgor he now regarded him as a "good friend." The Grak then inquired whether his bounty hunters were adequately serving his needs; though Velgor berated him for bringing up the private matter, he also told the Grak that their missions were simple enough: to capture an Imperial agent and a boy. Grukk argued that the "boy" had destroyed the

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor left to prepare for the mission and oversee the repairs on the corvette. Oon-ai followed, asking permission to look into Velgor's personal communications to provide information to Targ. Although it annoyed Velgor, as it was the Emperor's command that he serve under Targ, he allowed it and left. He then planted treasonable evidence into a black astromech so as to incriminate Oon-ai during the mission. Soon thereafter, Velgor, Oon-ai, and six shock troopers boarded the corvette and found the pirate base, docking with the station. Greeted by a Velari pirate , whom he killed, Velgor ordered the troopers to secure the core, while his astromech made his way to the command center to plant the false evidence.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Together, they boarded Vexa's ship, the Ark Angel II , where she admitted to being a fan of his. The rogue archaeologist also introduced Velgor to the Triple-Zero protocol personality matrix and estimated it would take hours to unlock the matrix's codes that were restricting it. It took Velgor a few seconds to unlock it, which let Vexa install the personality matrix into a protocol droid's body right away. As the droid introduced himself as 0-0-0 , she imprinted herself and Velgor as his masters, and used him to wake up VT-1 , a blastomech prototype . But as it was hostile towards his new masters, 0-0-0 shut it down before he could do any harm.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor then let her know the reason he had sought her out was to secure his own private resources, ones only she could help him procure. Vexa (who had originally acquired the two droids for the Gotra ) instead gave them to Velgor after realizing Velgor was probably going to be her employer for the foreseeable future. She asked what else he needed, and he answered that he wanted troops of unquestionable loyalty: battle droids. Vexa then suggested that they acquire an unusual droid foundry on Pyralis, one in possession of Queen Karina , who had survived the Replica Wars and the planet's sterilization . As they landed the Ark Angel , and she sent 0-0-0 and VT-1 to map the cave route to the queen so that she and Velgor could follow, Vexa asked Velgor if he had ever been to Pyralis before. Her questioning brought up the memory of his first kiss with Ondar, shortly before the First Battle of Pyralis.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As Zazzik arrived, Velgor confronted the Emperor's agent, Silvar-IV. Velgor demanded that he tell him his name, his commission from the Emperor and the location of his headquarters . As he refused, Velgor assigned 0-0-0 to retrieve all relevant information from him. After an interrogation that resulted in the agent's death, 0-0-0 reported to Velgor that he was Dr. Silvar-IV, that his research base was located in an Outer Reach nebula , and that his commission was to create replacements for Velgor. After learning this, they immediately departed for the base, aboard his J-type 327 Nubian . While Vexa remained on the ship, Velgor and two platoons of droid commandos infiltrated it. Velgor sent a platoon to "the dojo" and had the other one follow him to the barracks . As they killed the soldiers in there, Vexa reported that they had lost the other platoon, prompting Velgor to go to the dojo, where he met the twins Morit and Aiolin Astarte .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor was immediately made to fight the Astarte twins, Tulon Voidgazer , the Calavane Karbin , and a Trandoshan warrior .
