sacrificing herself for her lover, Daren Kelv, Varek' "new assassin" chose to allow Kael Drayden and Orien Kade take him back to the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor for reassessment. Meanwhile, as the Aetheri took Vossa, a ship sent by Vael Mal arrived to retrieve Varek, letting the Dissident leader return to safety. ### Subverting the Republic

#### Most powerful chancellor in centuries

As per his plans to use the Replica Wars as an excuse to consolidate and centralize his political power to make way for his reign as Emperor, Mal had become the most powerful Supreme Chancellor since the days of the Ruusan Reformations by the end of the conflict. Using the war effort as his excuse, Mal had the Galactic Constitution amended multiple times during the conflict. One constitutional amendment known as the Reflex Amendment granted him near-absolute power over military affairs, thereby allowing him to bypass the Senate in such decisions. Towards the end of the war, Mal passed a constitutional amendment known as the Sector Governance Decree .

title: Theron Mal
text:
Under the Sector Governance Decree, Mal created a new structure of regional governance by appointing certain individuals as governors. In theory, the decree was designed to shore up the war effort by uniting star systems into singular blocs and transforming their production centers into war-focused installations. In reality, however, regional governors could become leaders of the systems they oversaw, allowing Mal to circumvent and one day disband the Senate by creating a new bureaucracy composed of individuals he sent out. The decree, however, proved to be too much for senators who formed the Delegation of 2,000 , which quietly assembled the Petition of 2,000 in the name of protesting Mal's conduct and growing powers. Led by Ondar, Sess, and Solen, the Delegation hoped to make Mal give up his emergency powers and intended to present their petition to Mal once it was signed by two thousand of their fellow legislators.

#### The Battle of Vantor

> " You did well, Kael. He was too dangerous to be kept alive. " ―Theron Mal, to Kael Drayden, on the execution of Varek

title: Theron Mal
text:
#### The Battle of Vantor

> " You did well, Kael. He was too dangerous to be kept alive. " ―Theron Mal, to Kael Drayden, on the execution of Varek

Deciding that it was time to make Drayden his next apprentice, Mal devised a plan for Mal to be captured in order for Drayden to rescue him. The plan included sacrificing Vael Varek, who was to be killed by Drayden, which would tempt Drayden to the umbra side and eventually lead to the young Aetheri replacing Varek as the Dark Lord's new apprentice. Likely through the Nexus Route, Mal had obtained the coordinates to Vantor and gave them to Skarn and his fleet to jump from the Outer Reach directly to Vantor. Mal also had a plan to kidnap the Supreme Chancellor, which was tasked to Skarn. Mal ordered Skarn to capture Mal and for Varek to hold him hostage. Skarn and Varek, however, were unaware of Mal' true intentions.

title: Theron Mal
text: Kade and Drayden, who at the time were in the middle of making preparations to take Ferrum, were called upon to rescue him. After landing in the Invisible Hand ' s hangar, the two found Mal bound to a chair on the bridge . They were confronted by Varek, who they entered a duel with. Varek took out Kade with ease and then focused on Drayden. They continued the duel until Drayden cut off his hands. Disarmed and on his knees, Varek was bested. Mal commended Drayden on his accomplishment. However, he then betrayed Varek by urging Kael to kill him, due to Varek having served his purpose. A horrified Varek looked to Mal pleadingly, only to be met with another, more sinister urging. With one swift move, Count Varek was beheaded. Kael was conflicted on his actions but was comforted by Mal, who told him that it was a simple act of revenge in return for Varek cutting off his arm. Beyond luring Drayden closer to the umbra side, the act also served to tie up the loose end Varek would be if he lived, robbing the Aetheri of the chance to question him to learn more about Mal.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Drayden went to pick up the unconscious Kade, to which Mal pleaded with the Aetheri to leave his master. His plea was denied, and the three began their descent to the hangar. Meanwhile, the Invisible Hand was attacked by the Guarlara , with the former taking extensive damage and losing its position, momentarily falling towards that planet's surface. With the ship on its side, the three began running down an elevator shaft, only to lose their footing as the Invisible Hand regained its position. They managed to get out and to a hallway, where they were then captured in a ray shield. They were brought before Skarn in the control room, where Bolt-3, who was also a captive, gave a distraction that allowed Kade and Drayden to take control. With nowhere to run, Skarn broke open a window and found his way to the escape pods, which he activated as he fled. The ship then became caught in Vantor's gravity well and began barreling towards the surface. Drayden and Kade attempted to land it, but only managed to ease the crash. Following the crash, Mal and the Aetheri were escorted to the Senate Building.

#### The seduction of Kael Drayden

title: Theron Mal
text:
#### The seduction of Kael Drayden

> " Soon I will have a new apprentice, one far younger and more powerful. " ―Vael Mal, to Skarn

Mal directed Skarn to return to Uthara on the pretense of ensuring the safety of the increasingly irrelevant Dissident Council. In reality, he had other intentions for the general, whose usefulness to Mal had come to its end. Unaware he was being set up again, Skarn—whose campaigns had served to distract the Aetheri Order from the Umbra conspiracy unfolding around them on Vantor —had only one role left to play: he had to serve as bait to lure Kade away from Vantor and Drayden. Mal did not care if Skarn or Kade lived or died, as his plan was ready to bring down the Republic and the Aetheri and seduce Drayden to the umbra side.

title: Theron Mal
text: Mal soon began preparing for the war's end. Mal instructed Skarn to move the Dissidents to Emberfall. He also told him to remain on Uthara until his new apprentice had joined their cause since he did not want to waste any time before finding a replacement. Drayden, who had just been hailed as a hero for killing Count Varek and rescuing the Chancellor, began having visions of his wife dying in childbirth. Mal decided to use that to his advantage. Throughout the next few rotations, their relationship kept growing. Ultimately, Mal appointed Drayden to be his representative to the Aetheri Council. During what ended up becoming the last full session of the Republic Senate, the Petition of 2,000 was officially unveiled. However, Mal still managed to find an advantage in the current political atmosphere, telling and convincing Drayden that Ondar could have ulterior motives she was keeping secret from them both.

title: Theron Mal
text:
#### The fate of the galaxy

> " In the name of the Galactic Senate of the Republic, you are under arrest, Chancellor. " " Are you threatening me, Master Aetheri? " " The Senate will decide your fate. " " I am the Senate. " " Not yet. " ―Drevan Koss and Vael Mal

Drevan Koss, realizing that the Aetheri had been deceived by Mal, after learning about the Chancellor's double identity from Drayden, went to confront the Chancellor along with fellow Aetheri Council Masters Kit Fisto , Agen Kolar , as well as Saesee Tiin . Koss and the three other Aetheri boldly ignited their flux blades and declared that he was under arrest. Igniting his own crimson flux blade, Mal declared the four Aetheri as traitors to the Republic. Letting out an inhuman wail of fury, he then lunged forward and slew Kolar and Tiin in mere seconds , and Fisto slightly later, leaving Koss to face the Dark Lord alone. Mal and Koss then engaged in a ferocious one-on-one duel. While the fight appeared to be even, Koss eventually disarmed him, knocked him to the floor and held him at blade point.

title: Theron Mal
text:
the Order was a threat to the Senate as well as the security of the Republic. Mal ordered Velgor to attack the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor, and then execute the Dissident leaders on Emberfall. He declared that the galaxy would then return to a state of peace under the rule of the Umbra. #### Execute Directive 66

> " Commander Cord, the time has come. Execute Directive 66. " " Yes, my Lord. " ―Vael Mal and Cord While Velgor led the 501st Legion's attack on the Aetheri Sanctum, Mal ordered the rest of the replica troopers to execute Directive 66, declaring every Aetheri an enemy of the Republic. However, to the select few of the Aetheri he had secretly groomed, he offered their lives in exchange for service to him. Directive 66 activated the biochips within the replicas, who were programmed to kill the Aetheri for treason against the state. Despite serving and forming deep relationships with the Aetheri, the activation of their biochips by Mal, immediately and forcibly brainwashed them into believing that the Aetheri were traitors to the Republic that needed to be executed, resulting in the start of the Great Aetheri Purge . The Aetheri were consequently betrayed and gunned down by their soldiers, although some managed to survive such as Orien Kade, Zho, and Caleb Dume . Mal also used Directive 66 to compel Replica Commander Vek to eliminate the former Aetheri Sela Marr, along with his former apprentice Vreth who had been captured and brought to Vantor by the 501st Legion. However, both attempts were unsuccessful as Marr freed Vreth, and then subsequently freed Vek of the mind control by removing his

title: Theron Mal
text:
compel Replica Commander Vek to eliminate the former Aetheri Sela Marr, along with his former apprentice Vreth who had been captured and brought to Vantor by the 501st Legion. However, both attempts were unsuccessful as Marr freed Vreth, and then subsequently freed Vek of the mind control by removing his biochip. ### Age of the Imperium

#### Rise of the New Order

Consolidation of power

> " In order to ensure the security and continuing stability, the Republic will be reorganized into the first Imperium! For a safe and secure society! " ―Vael Mal — Link ▶️ ( file info )

After the Aetheri Sanctum fell, Mal arrived within and congratulated his new apprentice after affirming he had done as commanded; Velgor had killed many Aetheri during the siege, including Adepts and younglings, much to Mal' delight. After assuring Velgor he had done well, Mal ordered his apprentice to bring peace to their newly rising imperium, dispatching him to Emberfall to wipe out the Dissident leaders. Their conversation was captured by the Temple's security holograms. Mal then contacted the Dissident Council to inform them that Velgor would arrive and take care of them, although none of them were aware that Mal had actually betrayed them and had sent Velgor to kill them.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Assembling the Senate in special session , Mal, as Mal, addressed the Republic and deceitfully accused the Aetheri of attempting to assassinate him and overthrow the government, using his newly scarred face as evidence. Affirming that the Aetheri insurgency, as he called it, had been shut down, by the loyal Replica Army, Mal assured the Senate any remaining Aetheri would be found and wiped away. Taking advantage of the fear and death he had spread across the galaxy and presenting himself as the man who had ended the war and the supposed Aetheri insurgency it had been building to, he announced the Republic's reorganization into the First Imperium, promising a destructive conflict would never again be unleashed under its watch. In the process, he declared himself Emperor of the new regime, with little if any coalition from the majority of the senators present.

Battle in the Senate Chamber

> " I have waited a long time for this moment, my little green friend. " ―Vael Mal, to Zho

title: Theron Mal
text:
Rescuing Velgor

> " I sense Lord Velgor is in danger. " ―Vael Mal

As Imperial shock troopers of the Vantor Guard arrived in the Senate Chamber following the battle, the Emperor stood with Mazan Veldon on a Senatorial pod as they searched for the Aetheri Master. However, they could not find any trace of a body. The Emperor had more pressing concerns however: he had sensed that Velgor, far away on Emberfall, was in danger of being destroyed. He ordered the replicas to double their search for Zho, and that his shuttle be prepared to depart.

The Emperor made haste to Emberfall, accompanied by a squad of the best shock troopers under the authority of Commander Thire . On planet, he found that Velgor had been dismembered, horrifically burned, and left for dead by Orien Kade after the conclusion of their duel. He ordered the replicas accompanying him to prepare a medical capsule for his apprentice. As they left to obey his instructions, the Emperor crouched beside his fallen apprentice, determined to find a way to keep him alive.

title: Theron Mal
text:
The Emperor was keenly aware that, without Velgor, the foundations of his newfound power would be badly shaken; he needed an apprentice capable of ensuring that his Imperium would survive the inevitable challenges that would rise up against it. To make certain that Velgor would be capable of remaining a powerful apprentice, the Emperor contacted the boldest scientists he could, those whose practices would have been frowned on by the Aetheri and the Republic. Among these scientists was an expert in cybernetics named Doctor Silvar .

The Emperor brought Velgor to the Grand Medical Facility, far above Vantor's surface as a storm raged across the capital. A strenuous night followed during which the scientists, their droids and their technology worked to save the critically injured Velgor before he died. The new Umbra apprentice was kept awake for the whole procedure, feeling the pain that came with saving his life. Silvar and the other scientists designed a suit of armor that would protect his weakened body and allow his scorched lungs to breathe. Cybernetic limbs were added to replace the legs and the arm that Kade had taken.

title: Theron Mal
text: Believing he had killed his wife and accepting Mal's claim that the pain it brought him was a gift that would usher in his new life, Velgor invested himself entirely in Mal, just as the Umbra Lord had hoped. With Velgor cutting himself off from his remaining friends and family by believing the Emperor's claims and accepting the hatred growing inside him, Mal became his only safe haven and source of guidance. Further, Mal elected to maintain the illusion of friendship between them both for at least the time being. Meanwhile, having demonstrated his apprentice's need for a new flux blade, Mal showed Velgor a ceremony during which many of the weapons looted from the Aetheri Sanctum were incinerated. Mal also explained the red color of Umbra flux blades , obtained through the process of bleeding a kyber crystal taken from a slain Aetheri. He then dispatched Velgor to obtain one for himself. Velgor proceeded to hunt down and kill Aetheri Master Kirak Infil'a on Al'doleem , taking his flux blade . At Mal' direction, he returned to Emberfall, bleeding his new crystal there in a umbra side cave . Mal was in the middle of a meeting with Wilhard

title: Theron Mal
text:
one for himself. Velgor proceeded to hunt down and kill Aetheri Master Kirak Infil'a on Al'doleem , taking his flux blade . At Mal' direction, he returned to Emberfall, bleeding his new crystal there in a umbra side cave . Mal was in the middle of a meeting with Wilhard Varrix when a battle-damaged Velgor returned, bursting into the room and presenting the new weapon to his master. #### Personal and political projects

Search for ultimate power

> " For an Umbra Lord craves absolute power, and nothing will stop me from attaining it. Not even death itself. " ―Vael Mal

After the creation of his Umbra Imperium, Mal established himself in the old Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor, transforming the most famous of the Aetheri Order's temples into his Imperial Palace. The Aetheri had built the palace atop an ancient Umbra shrine , in order to neutralize and cap the dark power that sprang from its depths. Mal entrusted the reopening and restoration of the ancient temple to droids under the supervision of 11-4D , a protocol droid inherited from Vael Plagueis.

title: Theron Mal
text:
During the early days of the Imperium, making a rare public address, Mal claimed the Imperium would do whatever was needed to ensure a lasting reconciliation now that the Replica Wars had ended. At some point during the Imperial Era, Mal created an Imperial hunter droid named M-OC ; additionally the B1 battle droid R0-GR of the Freymarks later claimed to have fought Mal. The Ehllo family was an influential political dynasty during the Imperial Era, with Mal personally knowing Captain Cerasus Ehllo 's father . As such, Captain Ehllo was able to make a Raider -class corvette , the King's Ransom , into his flagship.

The Warden Order

> " My Lord, am I to be Umbra? " " Oh, no, my child. But you will serve the greater cause. " ―Iskat Vekkis and Vael Mal

title: Theron Mal
text:
Within his first year as Emperor of the Imperium, Mal brought to fruition an old idea with the formation of the Warden Order , an organization composed of umbra side adepts and tasked with hunting down surviving Aetheri. The Wardens were primarily captured Aetheri who had been tortured until they turned to the umbra side. However, a few, such as the the Grand Warden and the Fifth Warden , joined the Warden Order of their own accord. Another was the former Aetheri Knight Iskat Vekkis, who Mal spoke to in the Warden Order Headquarters on Vantor, not long after she had received her uniform. He tested her willingness to continue her training in the umbra side and made sure she understood that she and her fellow Wardens were substantially inferior to him. Mal was impressed by Vekkis' wits, as she had quickly realized that he was an Umbra Lord and had by now identified the agent he had assigned to help nudge her away from the Aetheri over the course of the Replica Wars. He then told her to choose her path carefully before turning her over to the Fifth Warden.

The hunt for Jocasta Nura

title: Theron Mal
text:
#### The Imperial military

Establishing the hierarchy

> " This is Lord Velgor. He speaks with my voice. A command from him is as a command from me. Pass this information down to your men. All must understand. " ―Theron Mal

After foiling two attempts on his life, Velgor traced an assassination conspiracy to the highest levels of the Imperial government and proceeded to meet Mal near Nura's secret vault. Despite his apprentice's failure to capture Nura alive, Mal was pleased with the artifacts recovered from her hoard. In response to Velgor's suspicion of him, Mal took a moment to examine his apprentice's rebuilt flux blade , nodding in approval over the change from Kirak Infil'a's original hilt. He then pointed out that he had no need to hire mercenaries to eliminate Velgor if he had wanted him dead. Mal told Velgor that dealing with the plot was his own responsibility, warning him that with great power come infinite enemies to destroy.

title: Theron Mal
text: Following the successful orbital bombardment of Tipoca City, the Imperium's official explanation was that the replication facilities had been sunk down to the oceans by a harsh storm, despite the structures having been built to endure Gelvaris's extreme climate. By the next year, new legislation of interest to Mal lay before the Senate: the Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill , a formalization of the Replica Army's decommissioning and the shift to an Imperial Military. Mal preferred not to deal with the issue directly, having Vice Chair Mazan Veldon preside over Senate sessions with Rampart pushing for the bill. A major opponent of the proposed legislation was Senator Riyo Chuchi who sought to provide missing representation for the replicas in the development of the bill. During a Senate session, Senator Solen asked Mazan Veldon what the absent Emperor's position on the bill was; the Vice Chair replied that the Emperor preferred to remain neutral, trusting the Senate to act in the best interests of Imperial citizens. However, given that Rampart's fabrication about Tipoca City's fall was not strudy enough to stand up to too much digging by opposing senators, Veldon told Rampart that expediency was necessary and warned him that he would

title: Theron Mal
text: remain neutral, trusting the Senate to act in the best interests of Imperial citizens. However, given that Rampart's fabrication about Tipoca City's fall was not strudy enough to stand up to too much digging by opposing senators, Veldon told Rampart that expediency was necessary and warned him that he would suffer if he could not placate Chuchi and the others. Despite Rampart's efforts to appease his detractors and obfuscate independent investigation, the bill was rejected twice in preliminary hearings, the harshest criticisms being voiced by Senators Chuchi, Solen and Pamlo. When the bill was at last about brought before the chamber for a vote with Rampart having satisfied Chuchi's demands for a fair retirement for the replicas, the Pantoran Senator interjected again, bringing forward former Gelvarian Senator Halle Burtoni to testify how Rampart had reappropriated Senate funds designated for Gelvaris directly into financing his own projects and recruitments. As Rampart attempted to explain this away, Senator Solen entered and played a command log taken from Rampart's own Vorash showing the entire Senate how Tipoca City really fell.

title: Theron Mal
text: Faced with a drastic situation, the Emperor saw fit to finally attend a Senate hearing in person and arose in his Chancellor's podium, which caused the entire Senate hall to fall silent as their leader made one of his few appearances since the Imperium's foundation. Fraught with overwhelming evidence, the Emperor decided that Rampart's value had ceased and had Mazan Veldon direct guards to arrest him. Not allowing this to stop his plans to remove the replicas, the Emperor spoke out with the same mannerisms as when he was Chancellor and voiced his surprise at Admiral Rampart's acts of transgression against the Gelvarians. He promised that the admiral would be punished for his treachery.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Now faced with a golden opportunity, the Emperor manipulated the situation to benefit his own position by reminding the Senators that Rampart did not act alone; that the replicas aboard the Venators willingly unleashed carnage upon their own home without hesitation. Providing sound argument that security in the galaxy was needed more than ever and recognizing the bill's immediate necessity, the Emperor stated his belief that the Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill was their future. Despite framing this as more of a suggestion than an order, the Emperor displayed how supreme his authority was as the bill was immediately passed.

Although he had presented a compelling narrative, many senators remained skeptical. Nonetheless, Mal had made a crucial step in further facilitating his power in the Imperium and control over the galaxy, confirming the phasing out of the replica army and eliminating another crucial remnant of the Republic, with only the Senate remaining. The age of the Imperial shock trooper had now begun.

Invasion of Mon Calvarra

title: Theron Mal
text:
Later that same year, Varrix contacted Mal when Velgor entered the Halcyon vault without authorization to learn more for himself about Project Stardust. Mal ordered Velgor to help Varrix by rooting out saboteurs whose work was slowing down the project's progress, sending him to Pyralis. He also put Velgor under the Governor's command.

Visit to Mount Tantiss

> " It is imperative that this facility remain hidden and secure. There are many, even within our own ranks, who would consider much of your work an abomination. But they lack the vision we possess. Your brilliance is a great asset to this Imperium. " ―Theron Mal, to Doctor Hemlock

title: Theron Mal
text:
Six months after the Senate voted to replace the replica army, the Emperor made a surprise visit to the secret Mount Tantiss facility on Wayland to review the progress Doctors Royce Hemlock and Nalle Seris had made on Project Necromancer . Hemlock gave him a tour of the site, ending with a tightly guarded chamber containing specimens crucial to the project. The doctor stated that with more time and resources, he was confident that they would be able to successfully replicate M-counts. Considering their work of paramount importance, the Emperor assured Hemlock that he would have whatever he required for the project.

On the landing pad, en route to his shuttle, the Emperor stressed to Hemlock the need to keep the existence of the base a secret, warning that many beings, even other Imperials, would not look kindly upon the research being performed there. Mal then complimented the doctor on his brilliance, with Hemlock responding that, with an appointment to scientific minister, he would be able to bring his abilities to bear upon the entire scientific corps. The Emperor warned him to be patient before departing.

The Chyrr from the Unknown Regions

title: Theron Mal
text:
The Chyrr from the Unknown Regions

During the Imperium's reign, Mal' interest in the Unknown Regions continued. This came to a head when the crew of the Vorash -class Iron Cruiser Strikefast , under the command of Captain Voss Parck , encountered the Chyrr known as Vorren in Wild Space . Many years earlier, Kael Drayden told Mal of this alien and how they worked together. This alien claimed to have a great deal of knowledge on the Unknown Regions. Vorren was then brought before the Emperor on Vantor in order to be questioned. Vorren told the Emperor of threats lurking within the Unknown Regions and how they might one day find the Imperium and offered his military skills. The Emperor then deduced that Vorren's intentions were to help protect his people from these threats. Vorren assured the Emperor that his allegiance would be to the Imperium. Vorren then revealed that he had known Kael Drayden during the Replica Wars, thus proving who he was to the Emperor.

title: Theron Mal
text:
For their service, the Emperor promised Captain Parck and his crew rewards. Vorren however, requested that his translator Eli Vanto stay with him. The Emperor then asked Vorren to walk with him outside. In his personal garden, the Emperor told the Chyrr of his interest in the Unknown Regions. Vorren then warned that there was great danger to be found there, however, he assured the Emperor that he would share his knowledge of the Unknown Regions. The Emperor ordered that Eli Vanto would be transferred to Vorren's side and that they would both undergo training at the Royal Imperial Academy .

#### Mission to Selvara

An official visit

title: Theron Mal
text:
The fall of the Perilous

The two Umbra and Senator Taa came to the Selvara system aboard Perilous . When the ship exited from the hyperspace, they found themselves in the middle of a minefield: Kryll was waiting for them. The Velari wished to eliminate them to strike at the heart of the Imperium. However, Mal was unperturbed by the ambush, having evidently foreseen such an occurrence. When the shields were overwhelmed, Mal remained on the bridge, while Velgor took off with his fighter leading a squadron to deal with a swarm of vulture droids . The former Dissident fighters released thousands of explosive buzz droids which further damaged the Iron Cruiser. Velgor returned aboard the Perilous where he met the Emperor and Senator Taa after finding that the Emperor's personal shuttle had been destroyed in the attack. Because he suspected there was a traitor in the Senator's staff, Mal ordered to isolate them in their own quarters and deny them access to any communications equipment.

title: Theron Mal
text: Once on the planet surface, Mal noted with mild annoyance that the landing had been far beneath what he knew Velgor to be capable of and that Velgor's lapse had left four corpses in the rear compartment of the shuttle. Velgor admitted to having been distracted by thoughts of his past and attempted to dismiss it as nothing. Mal however, was unconvinced, though he shelved the matter and proceeded with Velgor into the rear compartment. There, three of the shuttle's occupants, Sergeant Erstin Deez , his captain, and another member of the Imperial Guard had survived the crash, though one was badly injured and unconscious. Velgor noted with mild surprise that the Emperor appeared to have been wrong; there were only three corpses in the compartment. One of the conscious guards noted that his injured comrade had not strapped himself in during the landing, and as a result had been thrown about the compartment when the ship had crashed. However, the Emperor, apparently already aware of the semi-conscious guard, had him executed for his stupidity, leaving the fourth corpse he had mentioned earlier.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Death and fate

While Mal and his companions were traveling through the forest, they encountered a young Velari girl named Drua . Mal made a move to kill her, but Velgor blocked his master's death blow and convinced Mal that she could lead them to a settlement where they could contact reinforcements. Drua led them to her village , which was home to escaped Velari slaves. When the village head Narmn asked for their identities, Mal introduced himself, Velgor, and Deez as "Krataa," "Irluuk," and the Sergeant. Mal and Velgor alone knew that their pseudonyms stood for "death" and "fate."

title: Theron Mal
text: Mal warned Velgor that his act of mercy towards Drua would cost both her and her fellow villagers their lives. Velgor then managed to win over the villagers by offering to repair an ancient communications device. Once Velgor had fixed the machine, Mal ordered Deez to contact Moff Mors; whom he knew to be loyal. After re-establishing contact with the two Umbra Lords, Mors took steps to eliminate the Imperial traitor Colonel Belka Drayn , who was secretly aiding Chavar's insurgents. She foiled Belka's plot to order Vireo fighters to strike Drua's Village and the massed Free Selvara forces in a nearby quarry. After executing Belka, Moff Mors sent her forces to rendezvous with Mal and Velgor at the Velari village.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Chavar's forces, unwilling to harm the villagers, fired warning shots so that the villagers would flee the scene of the upcoming battle. The villagers reacted by fleeing to a nearby mine shaft, a sanctuary in time of danger. However, Mal, Velgor, and Deez stood their ground at the center of the village. Before Chavar's forces could launch their attack, Moff Mors' forces arrived in two transport vessels and trapped the insurgent fighters. With many of the Free Selvara fighters killed, Chavar narrowly managed to avoid capture at the hands of Velgor. Under the orders of Mal, Mors's Imperial forces massacred the surviving Free Selvara fighters. Following a brief exchange with Chavar's lieutenant Isval , Mal ordered Velgor to execute her and then afterward, the surviving Velari villagers hiding in the mine shaft as well, in order not to leave any witnesses. After a brief moment of hesitation, Velgor complied with his master's orders and massacred the villagers.

### Growing insurgency

#### Berch Teller's campaign

title: Theron Mal
text: Following Teller's attack on Sentinel Base , the Emperor convened a meeting of his Ruling Council to discuss the discovery of a cache of communications jammers on the planet Murkhana . The Imperium Vigil Bureau had purportedly discovered the cache and feared that dissidents were planning to disrupt the Imperial HoloNet ; echoing the Dissident Shadowfeed broadcasts during the Replica Wars. The Emperor dispatched both Moff Varrix and Lord Velgor to investigate the matter. However, this played into Teller's hands and allowed the insurgents to steal Varrix's corvette Carrion Spike , which they intended to turn into a symbol of coalition against the Imperium.

title: Theron Mal
text: After being briefed about the theft of the Carrion Spike , Vice Admiral Rancit suggested that the ship's thieves were the same people who attacked Sentinel Base earlier. In response, the Emperor ordered Rancit to divert Imperial forces in the Belderone system to aid Varrix and Lord Velgor. While Varrix and Velgor pursued the insurgents, the Emperor chaired another meeting of the Ruling Council. During the meeting, Rancit advocated diverting more Imperial forces to reinforcing Imperial facilities across the Perlemian Trade Route and Hydian Way . The Council also learned that Teller' insurgents had attacked the TaggeCo mining facilities on Lucazec and were transmitting holovids of their attacks on the HoloNet.

title: Theron Mal
text: Following a skirmish in the Phindar system between Imperial forces and the stolen Carrion Spike , Rancit convinced the Emperor to deploy interdictor vessels against the insurgents. Grand Vizier Veldon then informed the Emperor that the Murkhana communications jammers had been discovered by an IVB asset tasked with investigating the find by his case officer. Acting on this information, Mal interrogated the Koorivar IVB asset Bracchia and his case officer Stellan , who revealed that they had been tipped about the discovery by Naval Intelligence. After viewing the holovid, the Emperor determined that the communications cache had been planted by a high–level Imperial official who was aiding the insurgents.

title: Theron Mal
text: Shortly after he killed Etha Korrin, Velgor attacked the Thirteenth Warden for committing treason. Confused, her partner tried to defend her before they both fled Warden Order Headquarters across Vantor. The Umbra Lord eventually caught up with the couple and slew them. However, the destruction caused by the chase and resultant death of Senator Maklooq , who was important to one of Mal' schemes, led the Emperor to order the Warden Order to be relocated. Their new base was built on Nur . Pleased with the death of Korrin, Mal gifted Velgor the former royal vessel of Queen Ondar. With few Aetheri left to deal with, Mal was about to send his apprentice on other missions when Velgor asked for a world of his own: Emberfall. Mal granted the request but demanded to know why his apprentice had chosen the site of his greatest defeat. Velgor explained that he believed that the umbra side locus there could give him access to the dead Ondar. Mal encouraged him, satisfied that whatever knowledge or power his apprentice gained there would ultimately be his. He gave Velgor one final gift, the mask of Vael Mornick , before sending him to Emberfall with the

title: Theron Mal
text: In 4 BVE , the Emperor met with Director Orren Vossik , stating to him the importance of his energy initiative. The next day, Vossik secretly met with a number of Imperial officials, among them IVB and Navy, off record at the Maltheen Divide , putting them in charge of the Ghorman project : the planned suppression of the Ghormans and the heavy mining of the essential mineral kalkite from the planet . This operation would be implemented only if no substitute could be found, but in the meantime precursor actions would be taken in case it proved necessary. Vossik stated that this would support the Emperor's dream of energy independence while also reiterating that their circle was to be free of leaks, adding that any violation would be brought to the Emperor's personal attention. Two of the officials present, Dee Shambo and Nisus Osar from the Ministry of Enlightenment , were placed in charge of spreading anti-Ghorman propaganda. IVB Major Lio Partagaz was present as was his protégé Supervisor Dedra Meero , who was secretly placed in charge of running Ghorman while publicly being given a discommendation.

title: Theron Mal
text:
By 3 BVE , anti-Ghorman proganda had proved effective, including the idea that the Ghor were arrogant and mocked Theron Mal. Around the same time, Colonel Yular and Major Lio Partagaz of the IVB were scheduled to meet with the Emperor on the logistics of the Bureau's increase in arrests while Ghor Senator Dasi Oran informed his colleague Vela Sess that he could no longer vote with her against the Emperor's legislation after Ghorman's single-product economy was severely injured by a temporary Imperial embargo. Meanwhile, Carro Rylanz , the leader of the Ghorman Front , while attempting to recruit Syril Karn , mentioned his belief that the Emperor had no idea that the persecution of Ghorman was occurring and that the IVB was operating a shadow government in his name. Sometime after this, intrigued by the results obtained by IVB interrogator Doctor Gorst , Military Intelligence convinced the Emperor to expand him into a full-fledged program to be jointly maintained by a number of military and intelligence branches. However, Gorst and his work was soon destroyed by agents of the Axis network before the program could be put to use.

The Ghorman Massacre

title: Theron Mal
text: The same year, IVB Major Partagaz informed Supervisor Meero that the Emperor was greatly interested in the Ghorman project and was currently meeting with Director Vossik. Partagaz told her that their orders were for her to begin implementing the original plan discussed a year prior with the Major assuring Dedra that achieving success on Ghorman would ensure the IVB's importance to the Emperor in the future. Shortly thereafter, Meero oversaw the commencement of the operation. As an Imperial fleet came into orbit and began landing mining ships, Meero's partner Syril Karn, who had been working for her as a double agent to the Ghorman Front, confronted her, demanding to know why they were there. She revealed the secret she had long kept from him: the suppression of Ghorman in order to mine a mineral needed for the Emperor's energy program. As the situation with the local population deteriorated, the IVB and Imperial military implemented their plan to justify the Imperium's actions on Ghorman by inciting a protest by the Ghor and then instigating violence by having a sniper shoot a junior Imperial officer. Over the next few hours, a number of Imperials were killed and hundreds to thousands of Ghor

The IVB managed to shut down the Senate broadcast midway through her speech and failed in their attempt to take her into custody.

title: Theron Mal
text:
#### Machinations on Lorath

A World Between Worlds

> " I can't go with you. " " Perhaps I can. Cass Virel and Sela Marr— Mine at last! " ―Sela Marr and Vael Mal, to Cass Virel

The next year, during Velgor's hunt for the Hidden Hand , the Emperor contacted his apprentice through a hologram, expressing his disappointment in his failure to track down the criminal syndicate. He stated that they must be crushed at once, as they stole weapons from the Imperium and supplied them to the Insurgency.

After the discovery of an Aetheri Sanctum on Lorath, the Emperor directed Minister Veris Hydan to excavate the ruins and uncover its secrets. Sometime thereafter, the Emperor was contacted by Hydan, who informed him that they had reached the roots of the temple and uncovered a mural of the Mournis gods , which was reminiscent of art and iconography found at the former temple on Vantor. The Emperor told Hydan that he had sensed that the death of Aldric had altered the fate of Lorath. Vowing to control the conduit between the living and the dead, the Emperor urged his minister to quicken the pace of his work.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Later, the Emperor used Umbra alchemy in an attempt to open a portal to the World Between Worlds where Virel and Marr were. The Emperor taunted them through the portal and unleashed his power against them, which they were able to hold back. He then caught Virel's leg and pulled him so that he could get through the portal. However, before he could get through the portal to enter the realm, Marr cut the fiery lasso . The Emperor then tried again but failed as Virel and Marr made it back to their world much to his fury. In the process, the Lorath Aetheri Sanctum was destroyed.

Deception on Lorath

> " My dear boy, it's you who chose to destroy the Temple. The actions of your Insurgent friends require a firm hand to ensure that there is order on Lorath. As for your parents, allow me to offer what might have been, and what yet may be. " ―Vael Mal, to Cass Virel

title: Theron Mal
text: While Vorren denied seeking the battle station for his people and promised to fight against such a situation, Mal clearly saw the Chyrr's divided loyalties. Pondering Vorren's true allegiances and the other factors at play, Mal wondered if an alliance between the Imperium and the Ascendancy could be useful if Vorren was correct. However, in such a case, Mal wanted control of both governments and pondered if Vorren could be manipulated or persuaded into betraying his kind. Deciding such a possibility required additional meditation and turning his attention to the more urgent matter of the Lorath insurgents, Mal informed Vorren that he was sending instructions for a chamber to be built aboard the Chimaera . He ordered Vorren to put down the insurgent insurgency on Lorath and bring Virel to the chamber, which was a portion of the Lorath Aetheri Sanctum he wanted brought aboard "stone by stone." Leaving Vorren to carry out his duties, he gave the Grand Admiral one last order: once the battle at Lorath was over, he was to return to Vantor so they could have a "long long talk."

title: Theron Mal
text: Fulfilling his orders, Vorren brought Virel aboard the Chimaera when, in order to stop the Chyrr officer from bombarding Lorath's Capital City , the young Aetheri surrendered himself to the Imperium. After the officer and the Adept talked about the fate of the Aetheri and Lorath, Vorren brought Cass to the room that contained the temple portion, bringing Virel face-to-face with the Galactic Emperor. Since the Emperor was off world, he used a hologram projection to present himself in his more benevolent, pre-scarred form. Mal then ordered Vorren to leave the room, leaving him alone with Virel and the temple fragment.

title: Theron Mal

, successfully liberated his homeworld from the Imperium, as the creatures defeated the blockade in orbit and proceeded to take hold of the Chimaera , dragging it, Vorren, the rest of the crew, and him into hyperspace. #### The dissolution of the Senate

> " The Imperial Senate will no longer be of any concern to us. I have just received word that the Emperor has dissolved the council permanently. The last remnants of the First Republic have been swept away. " " That's impossible! How will the Emperor maintain control without the bureaucracy? " " The regional governors now have direct control over their territories. Fear will keep the local systems in line. Fear of this battle station. " ―Wilhard Varrix and Cassio Targ

title: Theron Mal
text: Later that year, Axis agent Lonni Jung , in his role as an IVB director, gained access to a cache of secretly scavenged files maintained by his colleague Dedra Meero; she had collected these in an effort to get the information she needed to root out Axis. Jung discovered evidence that the Emperor's energy program was a cover for the development of a super weapon being secretly constructed by Orren Vossik and was killed after passing on the information to Axis. However, Jung's viewing of Meero's files was uncovered and his body found. Vossik arrived on Vantor to investigate Meero, meeting with Major Lio Partagaz who defended her, pointing out how miraculous it was that the secret had been kept as long as it had. Vossik commented that they were only a few tests away from successful completion but Partagaz retorted that he should tell that to Mal. The information about the Emperor's project was ultimately passed on to Insurgent Intelligence agent Captain Kassian Andris and through him the leadership of the Free Coalition.

title: Theron Mal
text:
At some point following the Battle of Cinderfall, the Emperor's luxury yacht Imperialis was stolen by the gambler Dorian Quill and his associates while it was undergoing repairs at Sienar Fleet Systems ' Orbital Shipyard CC-24 above the planet Castell . Grand Vizier Veldon informed the Emperor of this loss within a Vantor throne room . In response, the Emperor dispatched three Star Destroyers commanded by Commodore Idel , Captain Shan , and Captain Conro to recover his ship. These Star Destroyers destroyed CC-24 to punish the base's Commander Pasqual for failing to protect the Emperor's property. After the Star Destroyers failed to recover the ship, the Emperor dispatched the bounty hunter Chanath Cha to recover the vessel. Should she fail to recover it, he instructed her to destroy the Imperialis to avoid letting its secrets fall into the hands of others. Unwilling to harm her former friends Lando and Lobot , Chanath opted to destroy the vessel instead. The wreckage of the Imperialis eventually ended up on Quantxi , the junk moon of Ord Mantell.

#### The Silvar Initiative

Eliminating the competition

title: Theron Mal
text: During the twenty years which had passed since the end of the Replica Wars, Silvar had worked to create several subjects which possessed the best genetic and cybernetic upgrades that he could provide, preparing them as potential enforcers for the Imperium. With Velgor's disgrace clear and the Emperor's need for strong elements to prevent further damage being done to the Imperium, Silvar suggested that he replace his apprentice with one of his subjects. Velgor's role would be reduced to a ceremonial one, while the doctor's subjects would enforce Mal' will throughout the galaxy. Intrigued by Silvar's proposition, Mal agreed to provide his subjects with a chance to impress him.

title: Theron Mal
text: However, unbeknownst to the scientist, the Emperor had come to believe that Silvar had grown too powerful as a result of his involvement with the Varrix Initiative. At the time, Mal could do nothing about it because of the doctor's connection with several of the Imperium's greatest scientific minds meant that removing him could lead to dissension among them. When Silvar presented him his plan, however, Mal knew that he could cause him to overplay his hand which would make him a traitor to the Imperium. Knowing that Velgor would be the perfect foil to Silvar's subjects, the Emperor made sure the two men met. The day he informed Velgor of his punishment for his failure at the Imperial Palace on Vantor, he also summoned Silvar for a private meeting. When his apprentice asked who the scientist was, Mal refused to answer him, leading Velgor to conduct his own investigation into the Emperor's secrets.

title: Theron Mal
text: After Velgor's hired bounty hunter Zazzik successfully apprehended Silvar in his fourth body, he revealed under torture the location of his secret research base . The Umbra Lord made his way to the base where he began an assault to find his potential rivals and destroy them. However, Silvar-IV's death at the hands of Velgor's torture droid 0-0-0 had not killed the scientist: having recreated himself as an immortal system, whenever one of Silvar's bodies died, another was activated on board his research base. Silvar-V had guessed that Velgor had discovered the location of his base and that he would be coming when he was activated. As such, he contacted the Emperor so that he could give him a demonstration of his subjects. Mal arrived as Velgor was about to kill the scientist. Only his intervention saved Silvar-V from suffering his predecessor's fate. With all the elements for his plan to begin, the Emperor demanded Silvar start the presentation.

title: Theron Mal
text: various hosts, tested on a Trandoshan , and remove any traits the Emperor would not desire, such as pain and emotions. Sufficiently impressed, Mal demanded a real demonstration of their abilities. Velgor and the subjects began to fight to the death against one another, and the Trandoshan was killed by Morit before the Emperor called a stop to the fight. He announced that he would find a use for every one of them, but that only one would win a place as his enforcer. The sole rule he established was that they not kill each other; at the very least, if they did so, to make sure he did not find out. As he prepared to leave, the Emperor called Velgor to speak to him privately.

title: Theron Mal
text:
After Velgor killed Silvar's minions and destroyed his current body, he informed the Emperor of his success. Pleased with his apprentice, Mal told him to finish his mission then return. At that moment, the archaeologist Doctor Vexa entered his private chambers. She then claimed they had a "mutual friend" and that she had things the Emperor needed to know.

After Velgor finished off Silvar for good, he returned to his master. It was then that Mal told Velgor that Vexa had informed him of all of his secret endeavors, many of which had been technically treasonous. However, rather than chastise or punish Velgor, the Emperor told his apprentice that he was impressed with his ambitions and that he was everything he could have hoped for. He then left Velgor to deal with Vexa as he pleased. Due to Targ's failure, the Emperor demoted him and transferred command of the Sovereign and its fleet to Velgor. Pleased with his apprentice, he left him to "educate" his subordinates of the future.

his bounty from the Sovereign and brought him to Grukk's Palace on Dunemere. The Queen's Shadow

He cited the Grak attack on the Sovereign , the Syndicate War, Commander Zahra's failure to eradicate the Free Coalition, the assassination of ten of his Royal Guards, and the theft of the Screaming Key from Fortress Velgor by the Knights of Karrick as evidence of a concerted conspiracy against them. When Velgor asked who was behind the plot, the Emperor called in IVB Director Barsha to lay out what intelligence he had uncovered about the Syndicate War and name their enemy to Velgor. After explaining that the syndicates were fighting for the Emperor's favor after hearing a rumor that the Graks were losing their arrangement with the Imperium. He revealed that he had learned that Carmine Dawn was responsible for the rumor.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Hidden Imperium revealed

> " Wherever you are Emperor Theron Mal, Vael Mal, Dark Lord of the Umbra...this is my Hidden Imperium. Choke on it. " ―Lady Vessa

The Emperor soon struck back against Vessa, meeting by holocomm with leaders of the major crime syndicates, ordering them to end their war with each other and focus their efforts on Carmine Dawn. Meanwhile, Imperial forces, including Inferno Squad and Lord Velgor worked to root out the Carmine Dawn agents while the fleet soon discovered where Vessa and her flagship, the Vermillion , were hiding. The Emperor then spoke with a hologram of Lady Vessa, informing her that Velgor had described her as formidable. Mal expressed his regret that she seemed foolish enough to desire the enmity of the Umbra. He attempted to chide her, stating that Vreth had undoubtedly taught her a healthy fear of the Umbra, but Vessa retorted that Vreth had taught her many things.

title: Theron Mal
text: Mal dismissed Vreth as an idiot and asked what Vessa planned to do now that she had his attention. She replied that she would do whatever she had to and when Mal learned that Vessa was at that moment preparing to attack his ships, he told her not to throw away her life, insisting that her capabilities made her of possible use to him. Vessa told the Umbra that he didn't understand: she didn't recognize his authority. Mal rejoined that he was disappointed in her inability to distinguish between authority and power, power that he truly held over her whether she accepted it or not. The Umbra proceeded to claim that Vessa's history was tainted by that of her teacher, Vreth, who had never been quite good enough. Mal declared that just like he had turned away from Vreth after finding him lacking, so he was also losing interest in her. Vessa remarked that he would see.

title: Theron Mal
text: Sometime later, Velgor discovered the location at which the Fermata Vault had been activated; the site had been left in a state of wreckage. On board the Sovereign, Velgor reported this by holocomm to the Emperor in his throne room, but confirmed that it had been the source of the disturbance in the umbra side they had felt. In response to the Mal' question, Velgor stated his belief that Vessa's agents had been unsuccessful in freeing an Umbra Lord from the Cage as the Umbra would undoubtedly have killed them and no bodies had been found. Mal mused that the threat thus remained a possibility while noting the possibility that Vessa had lied to him before her death.

title: Theron Mal
text: Regardless of the truth, the Emperor tasked Velgor with destroying Vessa's people and retrieving the Fermata Vault. When Velgor asked his master if he truly believed that another Umbra Lord could be out there, Mal responded that he did. He explained that the Fermata Vault was a trap designed by Vael Mornick to keep people in stasis outside of space and time. While he did not know if an Umbra had been imprisoned in the device, Mal was certain that such a thing could have occurred and he was thus unwilling to leave the possibility undealt with. He iterated to Velgor that there could be no greater threat to them and the Imperium they had built.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Buoyed by the faith of the Umbra Eternal cultists on Umbrale, Mal fought to survive in his rotting, weak, and temporary vessel. His body soon was unable to move on its own, and he took on a ghoulish, undead appearance with missing appendages and eyes clouded over with cataracts. Mal was mobilized through the use of an Ommin harness , a mechanical spine once worn by Ommin , an ancient Umbra king , and the decay of his body was slowed by vials of restorative fluid.

Due to his immobility, Mal was unable to leave the planet and forced to live in exile for years, but while his body was broken his mind and will were sharper than ever and his spirit unbound, and the fallen Emperor over the ensuing decades patiently plotted his return to power as Emperor and an Umbra Lord, forging a sinister plan to take ultimate revenge on the Drayden family , halt the restoration of the Aetheri Order, and decimate the Concordat.

### Interregnum

title: Theron Mal
text:
### Interregnum

> " Admiral Versio, Operation: Cinder is to begin at once. Coalition, insurgency, defiance. These are concepts that cannot be allowed to persist. You are but one of many tools by which these ideas shall be burned away. Heed my messenger. He shall relay you to your target. " ―Vael Mal' posthumous message, to Garrick Versio

Following the Emperor's demise, the Imperium attempted to suppress the true outcome of the Battle of Mossfell while its own ranks began to fracture; the lack of any clear line of succession meant that various Imperials grabbed at Mal's empty station, transforming the once unified Imperium into a fractured collection of warring factions . Without a single central leader to unify the Imperium and faced by celebrations and uprisings across the galaxy in the wake of the Emperor's death, the Imperium was suddenly and quickly fractured into what observers regarded to be scattered remnants.

title: Theron Mal
text: As several Concordat soldiers were discussing what they would do if Mal' body had been recovered, a Calavane soldier of the 61st Mobile Infantry expressed his wish that the Emperor had survived Mossfell, as that would have allowed him to face trial for every crime. While searching the Hall of Imperial Register on Vantor in 5 AVE , Grand Admiral Raena Vexana discovered that the Emperor's personal Super Iron Cruiser Eclipse had mysteriously disappeared instead of being destroyed by the Concordat as reported in the Imperial charts. She also found an image crystal showing a still image of Mal and several Imperial Guards, shock troopers, and officials including Wulric Yular , Dodd Rancit, Terrinald Screed , Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon, and Gallard Raxen. Raxen had since risen to the rank of Fleet Admiral and was Vexana's secret puppet-master. Following the Attack on Serenne , Raxen brought the Imperium to Ashden.

title: Theron Mal
text: Though Raxen claimed that he was testing the resolve of the Imperium before a showdown with the Concordat, Raxen secretly intended to carry out the Contingency. The Contingency involved orchestrating a battle between the Imperial and the Concordat fleets and destroying the two belligerents by detonating Ashden's core, leaving only the "worthy," ruthless Imperials alive to reform the Imperium. The Ashden Observatory contained a deep borehole which led to the planet's core. Raxen planned to pour various Umbra artifacts into the borehole in order to activate the planet's self-destruction. In secret, Raxen had arranged for himself and several "worthy" Imperials including Brendol Vren , his son Armitage Vren , and a contingent of child soldiers to flee into the Unknown Regions. Vexana managed to stop Raxen's plan to destroy Ashden with the help of the insurgents Nevra Wexlin and Brentin Lore Wexlin . Despite perishing on Ashden, Raxen succeeded in fulfilling his master's orders to bring about the collapse of the "Old Imperium."

title: Theron Mal
text: Mal's great power as Chancellor and then Emperor left an impact on the Concordat Senate , which feared ever giving an executive similiar authority. As such, the Chancellor of the Concordat was given greatly reduced power compared to the office under the Vantor Republic, with the word "Supreme" even being dropped from the title. However, the Chancellor's reduced influence complicated politics in the opposite way as Mal's authority; instead of having a head of state with too much power, the Chancellor had too little influence to make change. Eventually, the Contingency and overall legacy Vael Mal left behind ended up becoming the basis of the regime that developed into the New Imperium , the Imperium's successor, led by the mysterious Vorr , who took over the position of Supreme Leader of the Order. After wiping out most of what remained of the Imperial leadership, with several exceptions such as Armitage Vren, Vorr went to discover several truths about Mal, such as the fact that Mal' Contingency had always been a two-fold plan, one that involved ensuring the Imperium's rebirth among the survivors of the Old Imperium.

title: Theron Mal
text:
### From the shadows

#### The foundations of a new imperium

> " With the Imperium erased from existence, something new could rise in its place. And from beyond the grave, I would control its every move… " ―Vael Mal

On Umbrale, other Umbra cultists had gathered to venerate the ancient Umbra Order and swear fealty to the last Umbra Lord, Mal. These followers venerated his efforts to bring about a new Umbra Imperium and labored to rebuild the Imperium from Umbrale as a true Umbra Imperium. To this end, Mal' underlings crafted a vast armada of planet-killing warships , the Final Order . From the shadows, Mal plotted his return to power, and forged the remnants of the Imperium into the New Imperium while he manipulated the Concordat. Once deployed from Umbrale, the Final Order would bolster the forces of the New Imperium military , allowing the regime to finalize its subjugation of the galaxy. The Umbra Eternal labored for a generation, raising children in secret military camps, while building war machines in secret factories and shipyards.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Umbra loyalists served on the executive boards of corporations such as Kuat-Entralla Engineering and Sienar-Jaemus Fleet Systems , which allowed them to funnel assets critical to their domineering machinations through subsidiaries to Umbrale. Under Mal, the children of the Umbra Eternal were raised to covet the religion of the Umbra, while being ingrained with the utmost loyalty to their Emperor. Their efforts yielded legions of Umbra troopers , soldiers trained to be fanatically loyal to the Umbra via flash imprinting technologies built upon the Gelvarian techniques in the training of replica troopers. The efforts of the Umbra Eternal led to the creation of a fleet and army which would spell the end of freedom in the galaxy were they to escape into hyperspace.

#### Building the New Imperium

> " Through my manipulation of Vorr, I began gathering forces, building an army capable of opposing the Concordat that had risen in my absence. Through Vorr, I would make certain that the New Imperium would be mine to control. " ―Vael Mal

title: Theron Mal
text: Vorr became Mal' proxy in power over the New Imperium, a hermit state that began as the remnants of the Imperium that escaped under the Contingency, and by extension, helped ensure the faction would be his to control. Vorr rose to become Supreme Leader over the faction, and through manipulating his puppet, Mal gathered the forces that would go on to form the New Imperium's military, while under Vorr's guidance, the militia developed into a technologically superior war machine over the one under the Imperium. In addition, while the New Imperium served as the military arm of the Contingency, the Umbra Eternal secretly served as its hidden spiritual heart, while none were aware they were secretly controlled by the Umbra.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Many were confused to some of Vorr's motives upon his rise to power, such as making no effort to claim the old title of Emperor held by Mal during the reign of the Imperium, while he also delegated main control and building of the New Imperium to his subordinates and focused on spiritual matter instead. Nevertheless he possessed the knowledge and power to rule them, which made him the undisputed heir to the Contingency. However, even though the highest echelons of the New Imperium, remained unaware of Vorr's true origins and their ultimate purpose in the form of the Contingency, some in the Order, such as Enric Pryde , came to suspect that Vorr was subservient to some greater power.

#### The Drayden heir

> " Young Beno Karrick possessed what all masters live to see: raw, untamed power. But a great conflict raged within the boy as well. Not only did his inner turmoil make him heir apparent to his grandfather, Lord Velgor, it also made him the perfect pawn. " ―Vael Mal

title: Theron Mal
text:
Furthermore, Mal, in addition to using him as a placeholder for the New Imperium, utilized Vorr as his proxy for luring Karrick to the umbra side. In addition to Mal, Vorr whispered to the young Aetheri telepathically, cultivating a friendship with the boy as he manipulated him with deceit, encouraging his negative thoughts about his family and his impulsive tendencies, while utilizing his desperate need for a teacher and fascination with his family's legacy to influence him. When Mal and Vorr constantly whispered to Karrick, the Phantom Emperor also utilized this when Karrick joined the new Aetheri Order as an Adept under his maternal uncle, Aetheri Master Joren Drayden, during his attempt to restore the religious faction of peacekeepers, and partially engineer the failures that would lead to its eventual destruction.

#### A perfect vessel

A cunning test

> " Vorr. He was nothing but your test. You did well to destroy him. " ―Vael Mal, to Zarrin Karrick

Through Vorr, Mal was able to indirectly oversee the young Beno Karrick's training, thinking the humanoid taught their mutual apprentice well. Though he considered himself to be Karrick's true master the whole time, through the umbra side adept, the Emperor also planned to sidestep the tradition of a dark apprentice slaying their dark master to ascend to ultimate power, which Vorr's entire existence was built for in the first place.

Vorr's training of Zarrin Karrick proved effective, warping his understanding of his grandfather' history, conditioning him to believe the worst in people and that they would reject him and redemption would be impossible after his actions, while instructing him to pursue his impulses as a shortcut for power in the umbra side when he chased his desires.

title: Theron Mal
text: In 34 AVE , Nyla confronted the Supreme Leader and his dark apprentice aboard the Supremacy , believing she could turn the former Beno Karrick back to the light. Vorr overpowered Nyla, and having gauged her resolve, he saw that she had the spirit of a true Aetheri. Determined to see every trace of the Aetheri Order eradicated, he ordered her death but left the deed to Zarrin Karrick. Sensing his apprentice's newfound resolve, Vorr urged Karrick to complete his training and fulfill his destiny by executing Nyla. Instead, Karrick outmaneuvered his master by assassinating him with the Drayden flux blade . With Vorr dead, Karrick asserted his claim to the title of Supreme Leader, seizing political and military control of the New Imperium. By murdering his master in the name of obtaining greater power, Karrick had unknowingly completed the Umbra Eternal's final test and proved himself as an individual worthy of inheriting the legacy of the Umbra.

title: Theron Mal
text:

### Resurgence

#### Phantom Ascendant

> " At last the work of generations is complete. The great error is corrected. The day of victory is at hand. The day of revenge. The day of the Umbra. " ―Vael Mal' message — Link ▶️ ( file info )

In 35 AVE , a mysterious audio broadcast using the voice of Theron Mal, the public identity of Vael Mal, who was still thought to be dead by the galaxy at large, was released to the galaxy, threatening revenge. Upon this, Supreme Leader Zarrin Karrick began a search for the broadcast's source, deeming it a challenge to his rule. After acquiring an Umbra wayfinder on Emberfall that led him to Umbrale, Karrick entered the Umbra Citadel on the planet's surface and confronted the decrepit Emperor, who admitted that he had created Vorr and impersonated Velgor.

title: Theron Mal
text: Still, the Emperor remained confident that victory was at hand and asserted that Kael Drayden's daughter had died in vain. Mal then communicated via hologram with Allegiant General Enric Pryde, who had previously served him during the Galactic Civil War. With the Supreme Leader gone, the New Imperium's command defaulted on Pryde, whose allegiance to Mal was secured, officially combining the New Imperium's forces with those of the Umbra Eternal's Final Order. Realizing that the time had come to make his return, Mal ordered Pryde to send one of his Star Destroyers, named the Derriphan , to Kijimi and destroy it in order to send a clear message to the Coalition.

title: Theron Mal
text:
Mal attempted to goad his granddaughter into striking him down, much like he had done to Joren Drayden thirty-one years before, remarking that while Drayden had his father to save him that day, he was the only family she had. In actuality, Mal wished for Nyla to strike him down in order to initiate an Umbra ritual that would transfer his spirit from the decaying replica body into the youthful Nyla's, where he hoped to possess her body. In an attempt to increase her anger and hatred of him, Mal told Nyla that by transmitting the route to Umbrale to her friends, she had led the Coalition into a trap that would see all of them wiped out by the Umbra Eternal forces.

His face appeared similar to what it was prior to his original body's disfigurement, but his skin was more pallid than it was before the transfer, his eyes were white, his lips were blackened, and his fingers had begun to rot away, exposing the bone underneath. During the Ondara Crisis, Mal wore an elaborate blue cloak . As Supreme Chancellor, he wore golden robes with a velvet overcloak in the days surrounding the Battle of Pyralis and a dark crimson gigot-sleeved robe in the final days of the Replica Wars. title: Theron Mal
text:
### Conception

From the very beginning of the writing process on the 1977 original Aetherion film Aetherion : Episode IV First Dawn , director Orin Vask had in mind the character that would eventually develop into the currently known Emperor. One of the earliest documents regarding the project is a paper dating to early 1973 , which compiled a list of names to potentially use in the story. At the very top of this list appeared the name "Emperor Fordo Xerxes XII," as Xerxes was a historical Persian king who was assassinated by his own son, and would be then changed to "Alexander Xerxes XII," then "Emperor of Decarte." None of these mentioned names would be used ultimately. In the rough draft of the script for First Dawn , the Emperor is identified as Cos Dashit .

title: Theron Mal
text:
Throughout the original Aetherion saga films, the character was referred to as either Mal or Vael Mal. The character was not given a full name in any canonical or Aetherion Legends source until 2014 , when the character's first name—Theron—was revealed in the canon novel Varrix by author James Luceno . However, according to Luceno in an interview with the podcast Full of Umbra , the name was reportedly created by Orin Vask for the Aetherion: Underworld TV show that he planned to make before budget constraints, his semi-retirement, and Vask Pictures 's buyout by The Walt Novera Company prevented him to do so. Leland Chee has stated that Vael Mal' name may have derived from the word "insidious."

### Inspiration and creation

title: Theron Mal
text:
### Inspiration and creation

Orin Vask compared the story of Vael Mal to real-life individuals such as Julius Caesar , Napoleon , Adolf Hitler , Benito Mussolini , Joseph Stalin , Ferdinand Marcos , and Alberto Fujimori . All of them used methods similar to the Emperor's while turning their respective democracies into personal dictatorships in real life. The Adolf Hitler similarities are particularly evident from Mal's position as Chancellor and the use of emergency powers to cement his hold on the waning Republic as well as his passion for art. Mal's consolidation of power is also similar to Roman Emperor Augustus , the heir to Casear.

Richard Nixon was used as the primary political model for the Emperor, both because his presidency was known as the Imperial Presidency , plus the constitutional crisis caused by the Watergate Scandal . Vask, in fact, created the first Aetherion film as an anti- Vietnam War message, implying that the Imperium was what America could have been, had it won the war ten years before 1973. Vask opined, however, that Vice President Dick Cheney was actually closer to Vael Mal.

title: Theron Mal
text:
In addition, film critic Roger Ebert and film historian Robin Wooda noted that Vael Mal' appearance resembled Death from the 1957 epic historical film, The Seventh Seal and Queen Grimhilde's witch form in the Novera's 1937 animated film, Snow White and the Seven Dwarves . Orin Vask himself said that where realistically, and originally, Vael Mal appeared in a dark color, the Dark Lord of the Umbra was brightened-up in post-production to the extent where he became a white-faced figure that resembles Death, a fittingly spooky look desired by Vask himself. Aetherion author and historian Chris Kempshall , who would go onto analyze Mal and his imperium from an in-universe perspective through his 2024 book Aetherion: The Rise and Fall of the Imperium , analyzed Mal, and the Aetherion franchise as a whole, from a historical perspective in his 2022 book The History and Politics of Aetherion . Within, Kempshall connected Mal's Operation: Cinder contingency to burn down the Imperium in the event of his demise to Hitler's actions at the close of World War II, pointing out how Hiter had adopted a policy of forcing everyone within the German capital of Berlin to "share in his suicide." Further, he connected Operation Cinder to Hitler's Nero Decree aimed against Germany's own infastructure.

### Non-canon content

title: Mossfell
text:
# Mossfell
> " Oh, I told you it was dangerous here! " ― Astra-9

Mossfell , designated IX3244-A , also known as the Forest Moon of Mossfell or the Sanctuary Moon , was a small forested moon that was the ninth moon that orbited the Outer Reach planet of the same name . It was the homeworld of the sentient Dulok , Mosskin , and Yuzzum species , as well as the Wistie and semi-sentient Gorax races.


A remote moon in the Mossfell system of the Outer Reach Territories , Mossfell was covered in dense woodlands, tall mountains , and savannas , and home to the sentient Mosskin , Dulok , and Yuzzum species . The semi-sentient Gorax also dwelled on the moon as well as the Wistie . Some of Mossfell's trees reached more than 1,000 meters in height. It contained a breathable atmosphere to humans and 8% surface water . It also had two suns : Mossfell I and Mossfell II .

title: Mossfell
text:
Mossfell made its first appearance in the 1983 film Aetherion : Episode VI Return of the Aetheri . The scenes of the forest moon were filmed in the giant redwood forests of northern California, in particular Tall Trees Redwood Grove and other forests near the remote town of Smith River, and at soundstages in England, where the Mosskin village scenes were shot. During the production of the film, Mossfell was referred to as the "Green Moon of Mossfell."

Some location scenes for Mossfell were filmed in Stout Grove, part of Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park, 5 miles east of Crescent City, California, near the Tolowa village Hiouchi. Scenes requiring explosions were shot on private logging company land in the vicinity because the trees were scheduled to be logged and the State Park would not allow damage to their trees.

title: Jax
text: Born in 11 AVE during the Concordat Era , FN-2187 was part of a new generation of shock troopers —human children conscripted into the military forces of the New Imperium—modeled on the Republic replica troopers and Imperial shock troopers of the past . He originally trained with Batch Eight before joining the FN Corps , a sub-branch of the Shock trooper Corps , and although his potential was recognized by his commanding officers , FN-2187 lacked the ruthlessness that had become common in the ranks under the influence of Captain Phasma . In the waning days of the Cold War , he hesitated to kill civilians during his first mission and consequently decided to desert after witnessing the massacre of Tuanul . Lacking experience as a pilot , FN-2187 freed a Coalition prisoner , Commander Rin Vale , who coined the nickname "Jax" to supplant the renegade shock trooper's alphanumeric designation. He then sought his own freedom while forming friendships with the Ashden scavenger Nyla and the droid Orio-6 , as well as the Insurgent war heroes Dax Karrick and Brevok .

title: Jax
text: After the destruction of the Concordat , Jax provided the Coalition with the information they needed to destroy the New Imperium's superweapon , Voidfang Base . During the attack , he was defeated and nearly killed by the dark warrior Zarrin Karrick . Rescued by Nyla and Brevok, Jax recuperated from his injuries and by the time he awoke, the Coalition was forced to evacuate their base on D'Qar . Despite attempting to escape from the conflict once more, a mission with Wrenn Holt convinced Jax to truly join the Coalition to the extent where he nearly sacrificed his life for their cause during the Battle of Saltmark in 34 AVE . In 35 AVE , Jax continued assisting the Coalition by joining Nyla on the quest to find the Umbra wayfinder and destroy the malevolent religion once and for all, eventually becoming a general along with Pova after Elira's passing, with his first mission as a general being spent leading the ground forces during the Battle of Umbrale .

title: Jax
text:
### Pre-birth

> " We'll see each other again. I believe that. " ―Nyla to Jax, as heard by Cass Virel

In 1 BVE , over a decade before Jax's birth , the Aetheri Adept Cass Virel heard the voice of Nyla swearing to Jax that they would see each other again, during his visit to the World Between Worlds —a realm that existed beyond time and space .

### Serving the New Imperium

#### Cadet of the military

> " You have great potential, 2187. You are officer corps material. Your duty is to the New Imperium above everything. Nothing else comes before that. " ―Captain Phasma

title: Jax
text:
### Serving the New Imperium

#### Cadet of the military

> " You have great potential, 2187. You are officer corps material. Your duty is to the New Imperium above everything. Nothing else comes before that. " ―Captain Phasma

The boy who would become Jax was taken at the age of three from his family to serve the New Imperium . Jax later reflected that he had been too young to even remember who his family was. The child received the designation FN- 2187 and was made a shock trooper of the New Imperium, a military junta that continued the ideals of the fallen Imperium in the decades after the Galactic Civil War . During FN-2187's childhood , FN-1971 was somehow able to sneak in Kade Genti comics. Even though they were not regulation and the New Imperium would have sent the children to reprogramming if they learned about the contraband, FN-2187 enjoyed the comics.

title: Jax
text:
FN-2187 served under Phasma as a cadet , alongside fellow troopers FN-2199 "Nines," FN-2000 "Zeroes," and FN-2003 "Slip." FN-2187, known to his fellow troopers as Eight-Seven, was seen by his comrades and superiors as an ideal New Imperium shock trooper, and consistently scored top marks as a cadet. As a cadet, he appreciated and understood his squad 's Shock trooper armor, but took pleasure in the moments when he could see their personalities and diverse faces.

#### GUHL-J03870 related issues

> " This is stupid. Why do we always have to land on mud planets? " ―Jax to himself on GUHL-J03870

title: Jax
text:
#### GUHL-J03870 related issues

> " This is stupid. Why do we always have to land on mud planets? " ―Jax to himself on GUHL-J03870

Following this aboard the Finalizer , groups of shock troopers went on Atmospheric Assault Landers to investigate GUHL-J03870 , a planet in the Outer Reach Territories . GUHL-JO3870 was known to be muddy and FN-2187 complained about scrubbing assault landers. While scrubbing the assault landers, a creature from the surface of GUHL-J03870, came aboard one of the assault landers. The multi-armed, purple, furry creature lunged at Jax, causing him to stop cleaning, and run towards a Special Forces SKREE fighter , knocking off his helmet and sending the creature away. Remembering Phasma's strict training, Jax noticed the creature stealing his helmet, and gave chase.

title: Jax
text: He chased the creature all around the Finalizer , preventing its discovery even as it shut off the lights on a formal meeting with Zarrin Karrick, General Armitage Vren and other New Imperium officers , and Karrick used his flux blade to illuminate the room. Concerned about Karrick's reaction, FN-2187 continued to chase the creature into the a chamber. There, it found Phasma's helmet, for which it discarded Jax's. As he realized this was her quarters and she was showering, Karrick knocked on the door. Using the helmet, Jax went to the length of impersonating Phasma in order to fool the fallen Aetheri as he gave orders to find the creature.
