title: Jax
text:
Later, arriving on GUHL-J03870 with the rest of the New Imperium, Jax thought he finally had a chance to release the creature, but discovered it escaped its box and took control of the AAL. It lifted the transport into the air and drove it straight at Captain Phasma, crashing into the mud and sending Jax out the front ramp. Phasma ordered FN-2187 to eliminate the creature, but Jax, envisioning betraying Phasma and facing the consequences, decided to leave the creature be. Especially considering the larger and more fearsome members of its species closing in on the New Imperium squad from all directions. Lambasting FN-2187 for his lack of helmet, Phasma ordered a retreat from GUHL-JO3870.

#### Kowakian fun-key lizard

> " …to the comical... " ―Astra-9 regarding Jax's misadventure

title: Jax
text:
#### Kowakian fun-key lizard

> " …to the comical... " ―Astra-9 regarding Jax's misadventure

Sometime after, FN-2187 and a group of shock troopers including am officer were deployed to a sunny jungle planet . While patrolling, a yellow and blue Kowakian monkey-lizard got on Eight-Seven's shoulder and pulled off his helmet . This yet-again revealed his face, and made Jax lose grip of his volt pistol , causing the other shock troopers from the squad look at him. The monkey-lizard laughed furiously from the prank he made, while Eight-Seven looked rather uncomfortable. At some point later Astra-9 told this story to some visitors and described it as "comical."

#### Sanitation and insurgency

> " It's more of an infestation. " " That doesn't sound so bad. " " The infestation already ate two people. " ―Captain Bray and Jax regarding an infestation on Voidfang Base

title: Jax
text:
#### Sanitation and insurgency

> " It's more of an infestation. " " That doesn't sound so bad. " " The infestation already ate two people. " ―Captain Bray and Jax regarding an infestation on Voidfang Base

FN-2187 was also once in charge of sanitation duties at Voidfang Base . At one point, he and another trooper were cleaning the Base, and FN-2187 was enjoying himself, being playful with his mop. Suddenly, Zarrin Karrick and Phasma passed by. Confused on what to do, Jax saluted with the mop. Staring down Zarrin Karrick directly, the mop dripped on Jax and Karrick passed by. After a short relief, he was then ordered to help a group of shock troopers clear out a 'blockage' in a tunnel. Joining a cleaning crew of armed Shock troopers and Flametroopers , Jax spoke to a terrified man who described the infestation as full of rage and fury. The group made their way into the tunnel before being halted by a deafening screech, following by the decapitation of one of the troopers. The group engaged the purple tunnel bats , Jax even saving the captain, Bray (shock trooper) by using a flamethrower against the swarming bats.

title: Jax
text:
After questioning the captain's decisions, Jax was criticized for complaining, and punished with an order to trash escort duty, which took three weeks. During trash escort duty, Jax stumbled upon a crack in the tunnel's wall, leading to a chamber full of blue, glowing, flower-like structures. Realizing this wasn't an infestation as was in fact the creature's native home, FN-2187 attempted to convince the captain to save the tunnel bats, to no avail. Hatching a different plan, Jax accompanied the 'trash' to the junk planet Garbage Moon of Maher , where he revealed to the garbage barge pilot, Marialew , that he had smuggled the tunnel bats out of the Base. She decided not to turn him in, saying that compassion was dangerous to a shock trooper, but a little insurgency was good.

#### History with the Supremacy

> " But... but who knows where the breaker room is on an Iron Cruiser? " " I'm the guy that used to mop it. " ―Wrenn Holt and Jax discussing infiltration of the Supremacy

title: Jax
text:
#### History with the Supremacy

> " But... but who knows where the breaker room is on an Iron Cruiser? " " I'm the guy that used to mop it. " ―Wrenn Holt and Jax discussing infiltration of the Supremacy

During the time FN-2187 was stationed aboard the Finalizer , his destroyer occasionally docked with the New Imperium's massive spacefaring capital, the Mega -class Star Dreadnought Supremacy . While aboard the Supremacy after his defection, Jax felt guilty that he was unable to tell the Coalition that the New Imperium possessed a starship with capabilities as deadly as the Supremacy ' s. While serving the New Imperium, FN-2187 was selected a few times for executioner trooper duty, and hoped he would never be ordered to carry out any executions .

#### Mission to the Pressylla system

> " While I am entirely in support of unit cohesion, General, a shock trooper's loyalty must be higher, as you know. It must be to the New Imperium, not to one's comrades. " ―Captain Phasma to General Armitage Vren, regarding FN-2187

title: Jax
text:
#### Mission to the Pressylla system

> " While I am entirely in support of unit cohesion, General, a shock trooper's loyalty must be higher, as you know. It must be to the New Imperium, not to one's comrades. " ―Captain Phasma to General Armitage Vren, regarding FN-2187

During his time as a cadet, Eight-Seven and his fellow troopers underwent a training simulation in which they assaulted a Concordat bunker, with the intention of destroying a heavy repeating volt pistol manned by Republic soldiers. During their advance on the bunker, Slip fell behind—a common occurrence—and Eight-Seven intended to rescue him. Over the objections of Zeroes and Nines, who wanted to complete their objective and felt that rescuing Slip would lead the Republic to take them all out, Eight-Seven ordered them to rescue their fellow soldier. Eight-Seven sent Zeroes and Nines in different directions in order to divide the Republic's attention, while Eight-Seven himself went for Slip and successfully rescued him. Though Zeroes and Nines were pinned down, their diversion gave Eight-Seven a clear path into the Republic bunker, into which he threw a grenade and destroyed the volt pistol before the Republic could react to his attack.

title: Jax
text: The simulation was monitored by Captain Phasma and General Vren. After the training session ended, Phasma spoke to the troopers and told them that their performance was adequate. Each was given a review of their performance, with Eight-Seven being commended on his kill rate and the completion of his objective. She further said that his fellow soldiers should follow his example. The other troopers were dismissed, but Eight-Seven was ordered to stay so Phasma could question why he rescued Slip, as it was not the first time Eight-Seven had to help him. Phasma ordered him to stop, as she said the New Imperium was only as strong as its weakest link. Rather than fixing the problem, Phasma said he was allowing it to persist and weaken the group. Phasma sensed hesitation on his part, but he assured her that he would stop helping Slip.

title: Jax
text:
Following this incident, FN-2187 and his fellow troopers were deployed to a mining colony in an artificial asteroid field known as Pressy's Tumble in the Pressylla system of the Outer Reach Territories. Captain Phasma informed the Shock troopers there that the purpose of their visit was to 'restore order' after Republic agents had allegedly infiltrated the mining operations, sabotaged equipment and created dissent among the miners there. In reality, the miners had staged a strike to protest the harsh working conditions. Upon arrival, Captain Phasma took FN-2187's unit to a room of negotiators. Captain Phasma then gave the order that the troopers execute the negotiators. FN-2187 aimed his rifle at an Abednedo negotiator, yet couldn't bring himself to shoot—Slip attacked the negotiator instead. Upon returning from Pressylla, FN-2187 and his fellow troopers were officially recognized as full-fledged Shock troopers. Captain Phasma decided that FN-2187 ought to be deployed in an upcoming battle on Ashden, thinking that he would understand what it meant to be a Shock trooper and fight back when brought face-to-face with those attacking him back.

#### Massacre on Ashden

title: Jax
text:
### Deserting from the New Imperium

#### FN-2187's new name

> " FN, huh? Jax. I'm gonna call you Jax! That all right? " " Jax... yeah. Jax. I like that!" " ―Rin Vale renames FN-2187

Returning to the Finalizer , Eight-Seven felt significant stress from the mission, taking off his helmet inside an AAL to breathe. Captain Phasma quickly noticed his distress and lack of helmet, and told him to submit his volt pistol to be checked, making sure he fired a shot. Knowing he would be discovered and subjected to reconditioning for not firing on the villagers, and with his faith severely shaken in the New Imperium, he decided to desert. Needing a pilot, 2187 secretly freed the imprisoned Rin Vale, and the two stole a Special Forces SKREE Fighter . FN-2187 manned the guns, killing several of his former comrades in the hangar, and then disabling the Finalizer ' s pulse lances .

title: Jax
text:
During the escape, Vale asked the Shock trooper his name, to which he replied with his number. Not content with calling a man a number, Vale named the trooper Jax, from the FN in his number. Jax liked the name and went on to use it. Vale also told him that the map vital to the Coalition was located in his white and orange BB-series astromech droid , Orio-6 . Jax demanded not to return to Ashden, insisting that they would be killed, but Vale pressed on, revealing to Jax that the map led to Joren Drayden. The SKREE was hit immediately afterward by a missile, sending it spiraling down to a crash landing in the Goazon Badlands .

#### Meeting Nyla and Orio-6

> " I don't know your name. " " Jax. What's yours? " " I'm Nyla. " ―Nyla and Jax

Jax ejected from the SKREE when Vale triggered the ejector seat. Unfortunately, Vale's jacket was caught in the ejector mechanism for the ship, which prevented him from escaping. Left with no choice, Vale piloted the SKREE to a crash landing in the aftermath of which he was thrown clear of the crash and knocked unconscious.

title: Jax
text: Waking up alone in the desert, Jax was shocked and breathing very heavily, before noticing a trail of smoke in the distance. Making his way to the crash, Jax found Pova's jacket, but no other sign of the man, and the fighter sank into the sand. Believing Vale to be dead, Jax discarded his armor as he wandered through the desert, eventually arriving at Nimara Outpost , looking for Orio-6 to carry on Pova's mission. Once at the settlement, he found Orio-6 along with a scavenger named Nyla, after witnessing her and the droid be attacked by a pair of thugs. He attempted to aid them but stopped when the young woman was able to defeat them with her quarterstaff . Soon after, Orio-6 pointed him out to Nyla, identifying Vale's jacket, prompting the woman to chase after him. Jax attempted to outrun her but Nyla caught up to him and smacked him with her quarterstaff. Held under questioning and accused of stealing Vale's jacket, while also being on the receiving end of a couple of electric shocks from Orio-6's arc welder , Jax explained that he and Vale had escaped from the Finalizer , and falsely claimed to be with the Coalition to get them to trust him. The three were immediately targeted by the New Imperium and fled, initially hoping to commandeer a quadjumper , but after the quadjumper was destroyed by orbital fire from New Imperium SKREE fighters, decided to commandeer an old freighter : the Corsair Wing . Jax operated one of the Corsair ' s quad laser cannons while Nyla piloted the ship. Despite the cannon getting stuck in forward

title: Jax
text:
quadjumper , but after the quadjumper was destroyed by orbital fire from New Imperium SKREE fighters, decided to commandeer an old freighter : the Corsair Wing . Jax operated one of the Corsair ' s quad laser cannons while Nyla piloted the ship. Despite the cannon getting stuck in forward position, Jax managed to destroy one of the pursuing fighters after Nyla managed some clever maneuvering. Once in space, the Corsair was in need of major repairs, so Nyla and Jax attempted to fix the aging ship. Jax then confessed to Orio-6 that he wasn't with the Coalition and tried convincing the droid to tell him where the Coalition base was. After some consideration, Orio-6 revealed that the Coalition base was in the Ileenium system . Just after Nyla had completed the repairs, the ship was caught in a grapple beam. Jax initially believed them to be captured by the New Imperium, and thus had Nyla undo her repairs to flood the Corsair with poisonous gas, explaining that shock trooper helmets filter out smoke, not toxins. Putting on breather masks, Jax, along with Nyla and Orio-6, hid in the maintenance duct.

#### Enter Dax Karrick

> " This was a mistake! " " Huge! " ―Jax and Nyla

title: Jax
text:
#### Enter Dax Karrick

> " This was a mistake! " " Huge! " ―Jax and Nyla

Instead of the New Imperium, the Corsair Wing was boarded by the smuggler Dax Karrick and his Vorak co-pilot Brevok , who reclaimed their vessel after it had been stolen from them years earlier. Karrick initially mistook Jax and his companions for thieves and questioned them. Jax and Nyla quickly recognized Dax Karrick as the Insurgency general and the famous smuggler and owner of the Corsair . Having found his stolen ship, Karrick told Brevok to put Jax and his traveling companions in an escape pod and drop them off in the nearest inhabited system. However, Jax and Nyla convinced Karrick and Brev not to do so by explaining that they needed his help to take Orio-6 to the Coalition because the droid had a map that would lead them to Joren Drayden.

title: Jax
text: Unfortunately, Dax's freighter , the Eravana had been boarded by two notorious criminal factions, the Guavian Death Gang and Kanjiklub , whom Karrick was indebted to. Not wanting Nyla and Jax to be involved, Dax placed both of them in the lower corridors of the freighter while he and Brev went to meet with the criminals, with Orio-6 accompanying them. The smuggler tried but failed to convince both parties that he would fix things eventually. The Guavian Death Gang negotiator Bala-Tik recognized the Orio-6 astromech droid from a New Imperium bounty placed on it and demanded that Dax hand over the droid and any stowaways he might have on board. As the scuffle continued, Nyla accidentally released three rathtars that Karrick had been transporting for King Prana while trying to separate the gangs from the smugglers using the blast doors. Jax was briefly captured by one rathtar and dragged off, but Nyla managed to sever the rathtar's tentacles by closing a blast door on it. They successfully escaped the gangs and jumped into hyperspace in the Corsair . Bala-Tik then ordered his men to inform the New Imperium that Dax Karrick and the droid unit had fled aboard the Corsair .

title: Jax
text: Upon entering hyperspace, Jax tended to Brevok's injuries but the Vorak proved a challenging patient to treat. During the journey, Karrick got Orio-6 to display the map that he was carrying. However, the map was incomplete and turned out to be a portion of a much larger map. Jax and Nyla learned from Karrick that Joren Drayden had been trying to restore the Aetheri Order . However, a male apprentice had turned against Drayden and undone his efforts. Drayden had since vanished from the galaxy completely. Karrick believed that Joren had gone to find the legendary First Aetheri Sanctum . Not wanting to deliver Jax, Nyla, and Orio-6 to the Coalition directly, Karrick planned to take them to the planet Takodana where he could find suitable transportation for them.

title: Jax
text: On the trip to Takodana, Jax stayed with Brevok while Nyla worked with Karrick in the cockpit . At some point during the trip, the Corsair Wing suddenly sputtered out of hyperspace. As Nyla ran to Jax and Brevok, Jax asked Nyla what was happening. She explained that there was a potential tracking device somewhere on the ship and conversed with Brevok on where the tracker may be located. Jax asked what Brevok was saying and Nyla clarified that Brevok believed that the tracker could be near the active sensor pulse generator but Jax was confused and apologized for asking. Jax then followed Nyla and Brevok to the generator with the latter discovering the tracker hidden behind a panel. Jax rushed over and removed the tracker, unknowingly beginning a countdown on the tracker's self-destruct mechanism . Nyla quickly exclaimed that the tracker was rigged with an explosive and they had to expunge it through the airlock as Jax asked how much time they had. Brevok suddenly grabbed the tracker out of Jax's hands , running for the airlock as Nyla explained that the tracker had only twenty seconds until detonation. Jax now realized how fast they had to move and

title: Jax
text: to expunge it through the airlock as Jax asked how much time they had. Brevok suddenly grabbed the tracker out of Jax's hands , running for the airlock as Nyla explained that the tracker had only twenty seconds until detonation. Jax now realized how fast they had to move and ran to the cockpit to warn Karrick. As Jax entered the cockpit, Karrick informed him that the hyperrelay was back online but was quickly interrupted by Jax telling him that there was a bomb aboard the ship and he needed to get the hyperrelay ready for a quick jump. Nyla and Brevok managed to remove the tracker and as the Corsair Wing entered hyperspace, the tracking device exploded behind. Shortly after reentering hyperspace, Jax joined Karrick, Nyla, Brevok, and Orio-6 in the cockpit as Nyla turned to everyone and remarked at how great of a team they made.

title: Jax
text:
#### Takodana

> " I'm looking at the eyes of a man who wants to run. " " You don't know the New Imperium like I do. They'll slaughter us. We all need to run. " ―Maz Oru and Jax

After landing on Takodana, Jax and his companions visited the pirate and tavern keeper Maz Oru 's castle , which served as an inn and bar for space. Jax also managed to meet Maz herself, who counseled him to stop running and fight. Jax was then asked to join the Coalition in its struggle against the New Imperium, but Jax initially refused, believing the New Imperium to be too powerful. He then confessed to Nyla his true identity as a shock trooper and stated that he was never going back to the New Imperium. After she declined his offer to join him in escaping the conflict, he wished her well. He planned to leave with pirate Captain Sidon Ithano , who offered him transportation to the Outer Reach Territories in exchange for work.

title: Jax
text:
Shortly later, Maz Oru's castle was attacked by the New Imperium, who had been alerted to the presence of Orio-6 by the spy Bazine Netal . During the ensuing battle, Jax questioned himself having a weapon, but was reminded by Maz that he had one. Jax wielded the flux blade, killing at least one shock trooper and engaging in a duel with FN-2199 , who brandished a Z6 riot control baton . He was unable to defeat Nines, his old friend, who was shot by Dax Karrick wielding Brevok's bowcaster . Jax, Karrick, and Brevok were then captured by New Imperium Shock troopers, but made an escape when the Coalition's Vectors arrived across Nymeve Lake and counterattacked. Jax witnessed Zarrin Karrick carrying off Nyla into his command shuttle and ran to rescue her, but could do little to help as Karrick left the battlefield.

#### Return to Voidfang Base

> " What do we do with her?! " " Is there a garbage chute? Trash compactor?! " "Yeah, there is. " ―Jax and Dax Karrick discuss what to do with Captain Phasma

title: Jax
text:
#### Return to Voidfang Base

> " What do we do with her?! " " Is there a garbage chute? Trash compactor?! " "Yeah, there is. " ―Jax and Dax Karrick discuss what to do with Captain Phasma

In a Coalition transport , Jax traveled with Karrick, Brevok, and Orio-6 to the Coalition base on D'Qar , where he was reunited with Rin Vale, who had survived the crash on Ashden and was surprised to see Jax. Pova remarked that his old jacket fit the former Shock trooper and told him to keep it. Jax also met General Elira Solen who praised him for renouncing the New Imperium and helping Pova escape. Jax then discussed the details of Voidfang Base to Admiral Vorian .

title: Jax
text: Jax was later present during the meeting held to discuss the attack on Voidfang Base– which needed to happen before the battle station recharged its weapon. His knowledge of the superweapon proved invaluable in planning the attack, as he spoke about its thermal oscillator being a weak point. He volunteered to go with Karrick and Brevok on the Corsair to shut down the shield generator on the planet's oscillator, but was secretly more interested in rescuing Nyla. After hyperspace jumping through its shields, and crash-landing on the planet, Jax revealed to Dax and Brev that he used to work on sanitation on Voidfang Base, much to Karrick's annoyance. Jax devised a plan to lower the shield around the planet, which would allow the Coalition pilots to attack the thermal oscillator and destroy the weapon. While sneaking around the secretive facility, Brevok captured Captain Phasma, and the three, including an overly confident Jax, forced her to lower the shield. She warned them that her troops would storm in and kill them all, but Karrick shrugged off her warning, asking Jax if there happened to be any convenient trash compactors in the base and they were able to dump her into one via garbage chute.

title: Jax
text:
Rose was initially enamored with Jax, who she saw as a Coalition hero, but noticed that he had packed a bag and realized he was planning to desert. Rose stunned Jax and placed his body on a cart to try to haul him to the brig. When Jax awoke, he told Rose about Nyla and that the New Imperium could track the fleet through hyperspace . The two then began to devise a plan to shut down the tracker aboard the Supremacy and allow the fleet to jump away, saving both the Coalition and Nyla.

The two presented their plan to Pova, who agreed to sanction it without the knowledge of the fleet's new commander, Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdra . Needing clearance codes to board the Supremacy , they contacted Maz Oru, who directed them instead to the Master Codebreaker , who they would find at the casino in Canto Bight , a city on the planet Cantonica . Jax gave Pova Elira's tracker.

#### Canto Bight

> " Look, this whole place is beautiful. I mean, come on. Why do you hate it so much? " " Look closer. " ―Jax and Rose discussing Canto Bight

title: Jax
text: Jax, along with Rose and Orio-6 departed for Cantonica. As they began their descent near the planet's atmosphere however, they were interrupted by the passing of an unknown floating tentacled alien that emitted electric currents around its body. As it ascended above them, some of the tentacles hit the shuttle, causing a surge of electricity to travel within the ship and temporarily disable Orio-6, who had been helping steer the shuttle. Rose then asked Jax to take over as she busied herself with the task of fixing the droid. Jax voiced his concerns regarding his own piloting abilities, but Rose pointed out that they didn't have much of a choice. As they descended further, Jax then saw and pointed out to Rose that there appeared to be more of the unknown alien creatures. As he did his best to navigate them through the flock, Jax saw one of the creatures quickly appear on an apparent collision course. Jax called out to Orio-6. Luckily for him, Rose was just about done fixing the droid. Orio-6 then resumed control of the ship which allowed them to avoid coming into contact with any of the creatures. As they floated off into safety, Jax

title: Jax
text:
quickly appear on an apparent collision course. Jax called out to Orio-6. Luckily for him, Rose was just about done fixing the droid. Orio-6 then resumed control of the ship which allowed them to avoid coming into contact with any of the creatures. As they floated off into safety, Jax inquired about Orio-6's condition, which the droid replied to by way of extending his built-in torch. Rose and Jax then complimented the droid as well as each other before proceeding to the rest of their mission. They crashed their shuttle on a private beach and entered the casino, despite an Abednedo businessman named Slowen Lo trying to stop them. Jax was amazed by the luxury of the casino, but Rose showed him the animal abuse, child labor, and war profiteering that went on behind the scenes. Rose told Jax that she and her sister came from the Otomok system , which was used as a testing ground by the New Imperium, and that many of the casino's patrons had become wealthy selling weapons to the New Imperium.

Orio-6 located the master codebreaker, but Slowen Lo reported them to the police for parking illegally, and Jax and Rose were arrested and stunned. Jax tried to pick the lock to their cell, yet his actions only succeeded in making another panel slide over the mechanism. Hearing their debate about their plans, their cellmate, DJ , offered to help them break onto the Destroyer, but Jax refused, believing DJ to be a mere pickpocket. DJ then used a manufactured passkey to open the cell door, allowing Jax and Rose to escape as well.

title: Jax
text:
Jax and Rose escaped into the Canto Bight stables, where the stableboy Temiri Blagg helped them escape, riding on the back of one of the casino's fathiers . They initially guided the fathiers towards their shuttle, but the police officers destroyed it. The fathiers rampaged through the casino and town, causing major damage, before losing the police by running through tall underbrush. Rose and Jax were then picked up by Orio-6 and DJ aboard the stolen yacht Libertine .

#### The Supremacy gambit

> " FN-2187. So good to have you back. " ―Phasma "welcomes" Jax upon his capture

DJ demanded Rose's medallion as a deposit. Despite Jax's objections, Rose gave it to him. DJ showed Jax that the yacht's previous owner was an arms dealer who sold weapons to both the New Imperium and Coalition. DJ attempted to convince Jax that the entire galaxy was a machine, and that he should stay away from causes and live free.

title: Jax
text:
DJ partially lowered the Supremacy ' s shields, allowing the Libertine to slip aboard. Jax, Rose, and DJ stole uniforms to disguise themselves as New Imperium officers in order to sneak through the ship and reach the tracker. They also encountered 926 , a shock trooper who recognized Jax, as they had been in the same shock trooper batch together. However, 926 was unaware of Jax's defection, and believing that Jax had been promoted to officer, congratulated him and told him that he didn't think the former shock trooper was captain material.

Jax, Rose, and DJ made it to the tracker, but they were captured by Phasma, who feigned delight at seeing Jax again. However, DJ cut a deal, exchanging information about the Coalition's escape plan he had gleaned from Jax and Rose, which was to use cloaked transports to reach the surface of the mineral planet Saltmark , for payment and his freedom, much to the fury of both Jax and Rose. The New Imperium began to fire on the Coalition transports, destroying most of them.

title: Jax
text:
Phasma ordered Jax and Rose executed, deciding to make them suffer and have them executed via laser ax , but before the executioner troopers could deliver the killing stroke, Holdra used the Raddik to ram the Supremacy at light speed, causing the hangar to erupt in flames, and knocking Jax unconscious. Jax and Rose attempted to reach a Xi -class light shuttle to escape the heavily damaged Supremacy , but they were cut off by Phasma.

#### Duel with Phasma

> " You were always scum." "Insurgent scum. " ―Phasma and Jax #### Duel with Phasma

> " You were always scum." "Insurgent scum. " ―Phasma and Jax

Phasma extended her baton, and Jax picked up a riot control baton, with which he dueled Phasma, but he could not hold out against her for long. Phasma beat him back and eventually knocked him off of his feet and into a pit. However, a rising platform below him saved his life. This allowed him to get behind Phasma and deliver a blow that cracked her helmet and sent her tumbling to unstable footing. Finally seeing his corrupt superior's actual flesh in a solitary eye staring up at him, Jax proudly identified himself to Phasma as a insurgent before her platform gave way, sending her to her demise into the fire below.

After seeing this, Jax noticed Orio-6 and Rose, whp gave Jax a lift to the shuttle with a hotwired AT-ST . As the shuttle took off, Jax remarked that they were going where they belonged, and they turned towards Saltmark to reunite with the Coalition.

#### Battle of Saltmark

title: Jax
text:
After seeing this, Jax noticed Orio-6 and Rose, whp gave Jax a lift to the shuttle with a hotwired AT-ST . As the shuttle took off, Jax remarked that they were going where they belonged, and they turned towards Saltmark to reunite with the Coalition.

#### Battle of Saltmark

> " Why would you do that, huh? I was almost there! Why would you stop me?!" "I saved you, dummy. That's how we're gonna win. Not by fighting what we hate. Saving what we love. " ―Jax and Rose after Rose stopped Jax's suicide run

Pursued by two SKREE fighters, Rose barely managed to pilot the shuttle under the closing bunker door of the abandoned Insurgent outpost where the Coalition was hiding out. The Coalition opened fire on the shuttle, but Jax convinced them to stop.

title: Jax
text:
Pursued by two SKREE fighters, Rose barely managed to pilot the shuttle under the closing bunker door of the abandoned Insurgent outpost where the Coalition was hiding out. The Coalition opened fire on the shuttle, but Jax convinced them to stop.

The Coalition planned to lay low in the bunker until they could send a signal to their allies in the Outer Reach. However, the New Imperium quickly deployed All Terrain MegaCaliber Sixs , AT-ATs , and a weapon Jax recognized as a battering ram cannon to infiltrate the bunker. Jax suggested to Pova that they use the base's complement of speeders to launch an assault against the siege cannon, in order to buy the Coalition time to get the message out. Jax piloted one of the speeders in the battle, and was able to exercise more control over the speeder after dropping his monoski. The New Imperium deployed SKREE fighters which destroyed many of the speeders. However, the timely arrival of Nyla and Brevok in the Corsair Wing drew the fighters away from the Coalition speeders.

title: Jax
text: Jax's speeder drew near the cannon, but Pova called off the attack, realizing that they were too late: the cannon was about to fire, and the cost of life was already too high. Jax disobeyed Pova's orders, and began the route to sacrifice, straight down the barrel of the cannon. But before he could sacrifice himself for the Coalition, Rose crashed her speeder into his, knocking them both out of the line of the cannon's fire and to the salty ground below. Just in front of the New Imperium's line, Jax ran over to an injured Rose, asking why she stopped him. Rose told him that the Coalition would win the war by saving what they love, not by fighting what they hate. Rose then kissed Jax, and collapsed unconscious as the siege cannon fired, destroying the bunker door.

title: Jax
text:
#### Sharing stories on the Corsair

> " Last thing I remember before that was being in a flux blade fight with Zarrin Karrick. " ―Jax while asking Rin Vale about what he missed. > " Last thing I remember before that was being in a flux blade fight with Zarrin Karrick. " ―Jax while asking Rin Vale about what he missed.

During a rare moment of peace onboard the Corsair Wing after departing Saltmark, Pova told an audience of Jax and Nyla the story of what had happened to him since his and Jax's crash on Ashden. Jax listened eagerly, but the trio was interrupted by General Solen, who was pleased that they were getting to know each other. Jax continually checked on Wrenn Holt during this time to make sure she was recovering well from her injuries. During a conversation with Pova about saving her, Jax explained the New Imperium's cruel philosophy on leaving behind those who were injured. Pova then explained to Jax what had happened while he was unconscious during the evacuation of D'Qar, and what happened to Black Squadron following it. Jax reassured Pova on his faith and positive attitude, and the two were subsequently interrupted by Astra-9 with news on the status of Black Squadron in a data transmission that led to Pova and Black Squadron's involvement in the Battle of Grail City .

#### Regroup on Selvara

title: Jax
text:
#### Regroup on Selvara

> " You want me to go with you to an occupied city and pretend to be some crime lord at an underworld auction so we can steal a lis of the New Imperium's top-secret most wanted? A list the New Imperium and a number of unsavory sketchy types would happily kill us for if they knew we had it? " " What? That doesn't sound like fun to you? " " Hell, yes, that sounds like fun. I'll do it! " ―Jax and Pova discussing the Mission to Korrath Soon after, a damaged and decimated Coalition aboard the Corsair Wing found its way to the Selvara Defense Authority base , where Elira's ally Yendor Brethen , a former Insurgent pilot, took them in. During a gathering of Coalition assets on Selvara, Jax proved to be a powerful example to Pacer Agoyo that even those with dubious beginnings can make a choice to be different. After deciding that the Coalition needed more ships and personnel, General Solen looked at a list of New Imperium prisoners also delivered by Maz Oru, and spotted the familiar initials R.C. on the list. Thinking this was former rival and Centrist Concordat Senator Ransolm Kastor , Solen decided to send Pova and a team to Korrath in search of the man, because Kastor was believed to be imprisoned on the shipbuilding world.

title: Jax
text:
Later, Jax and Nyla had a deep discussion onboard the Corsair that Pova interrupted, and asked about Jax's relationship status with both Nyla and Rose, receiving a negative on both. Then, Pova asked Jax to accompany him undercover to a secret auction at the birthday party of Nifera Shu , the wife of a wealthy Korrathi businessman, using an invite given to him by Maz Oru. Jax joyfully accepted, and Pova reminded him of his home and value in the Coalition, and the two went to continue preparing for the mission .

#### Korrathi caper

> " See? He's famous. There're a lot of celebrities here. That's why you recognize him. " " I don't think that's it. " " You're overthinking it. " ―Two shock troopers suspiciously examine Pova and Jax's disguises at the party in Coronet City

title: Jax
text:
#### Korrathi caper

> " See? He's famous. There're a lot of celebrities here. That's why you recognize him. " " I don't think that's it. " " You're overthinking it. " ―Two shock troopers suspiciously examine Pova and Jax's disguises at the party in Coronet City

Arriving in Coronet City, Jax and Pova pretended to be rich Canto Bight businessmen at Shu's birthday and auction, while the second team went to break Kastor out of the Korrathi Command Base . Narrowly avoiding a New Imperium Shock trooper checkpoint with Jax's suggestion that Pova was a celebrity, the two made their way in to give Shu a gift, given to Vale by Suralinda Javos , who also accompanied the team to the party with Charth Brethen .

title: Jax
text: At the party, Jax pointed out to Pova that a large chunk of the guests were New Imperium. This made sense to Vale considering the city's New Imperium occupation, but still surprised him. The two flirtatiously introduced themselves to Nifera and Hasadar Shu , and Pova gave Nifera the gift, a miniature Lylek from Selvara. She had been an entomologist in her youth, so the gift meant a lot to her, earning the two digital passage into the secret holographic auction. Pova began spending the Coalition's credits in the auction, and dispatched Jax to find other bidders, to no avail. Soon, the Coalition was outbid, but screaming started as the New Imperium suddenly raided the party.

title: Jax
text: The celebration quickly turned to chaos, as Jax and Pova scrambled to find Suralinda and Charth amidst the New Imperium's raid. After find the two, the room's lights were shut off, and Nifera, having lost her husband to a Shock trooper's volt pistol fire, ran away. Pova decided to follow her to get the list, sending Jax to escape with the other two. Vale was able to retrieve the list, as he and Nefira dove over the balcony and into the water below. Jax helped the two climb out of the pool, and they made plans to escape Korrath, and Shu revealed her loyalty to the Collective , a techno-activist underground movement.

title: Jax
text:
Pova's team was eventually able to meet up with the second group, who had successfully broken Kastor and several others out of prison. The two groups caught up, and immediately formulated a new plan to gain access to the hangar. Torb Rask and Nevra Wexlin decided to create a distraction, which allowed Jax and the others into the hangar and to the ships, but their distraction generated too much attention from the shock troopers. Rask was shot by volt pistol fire and was unable to continue fighting, but Nevra insisted on staying with him. When they both thought it was the end for them, at the last minute, Pova, in a stolen starfighter, gunned down the remaining shock troopers. With everyone safe, they all made their way back to the Coalition onboard a CR90 corvette .

After the mission, Jax, Pova, and the others gathered with the escaped prisoners in a Collective safehouse on Helmaxa , where Pova gave a rousing speech to the Coalition. Jax congratulated him on the speech, and together with Nyla, the three set off, hopeful, to save the galaxy together.

#### The Horizon Base attempt

title: Jax
text:
#### The Horizon Base attempt

> " Wait-- Hold up. Is that what you think? That we're out here risking our lives so we can be heroes? " ―Jax exclaims at Mezlo's judgement of the Coalition

Soon after at Horizon Base , Jax called Rin Vale to report that there was a larger New Imperium presence on the base than he'd expected. Worried that the New Imperium were after the same objective they were, Vale told Jax that he and his partner Gannis Ducain would have to figure it out, and that the Coalition was counting on them on this mission . Jax and Ducain argued about Ducain stealing the Corsair Wing , as a New Imperium shock trooper stopped them and ordered them to show their identification. In response, Jax shot down several barrels held over the shock troopers, knocking them down and allowing the two to escape.

title: Jax
text: Inside the base, Ducain apologized to Jax, and told him that he joined the Coalition to make himself a better person, considering his past mistakes. But Jax was more worried about fighting the New Imperium, not able to gather necessary allies. While they talked, Jax and Ducain heard a loud noise approaching them, and were suddenly surprised by a candori . The beast picked them up and tried to eat them, while a man emerged and claimed the candori as his, and said it was there to protect him and his fellow Oruans from the New Imperium, which he believed Jax and Ducain to be. Jax tried to tell him that they were Coalition, but the man had heard that the Coalition was destroyed. Jax told the man and his group that he knew what the New Imperium had done to their planet and that now they're alone, just like the Coalition. Hearing this, the man ordered the candori to release the two.

title: Jax
text:
After escaping the base, Jax again asked Mezlo to join the Coalition, but he once again refused telling him that he and his people will fight against the New Imperium on their own, after being made refugees. Back at the Corsair , Mezlo promised to help the Coalition if they ever truly needed it, and Jax promised to do the same. Onboard, Vale was disappointed that the Oruans did not accept the offer, and he believed that the Coalition was still alone. But having learned otherwise, Jax explained that while New Imperium had an army , they did not have honor. Jax believed that the Oruans would fight with them one day , and they would not be alone.

#### Wayward Comet conflict

> " That... that could give the Coalition a fighting chance against the New Imperium! " ―Jax talks to Pova in the Wayward Comet

title: Jax
text:
#### Wayward Comet conflict

> " That... that could give the Coalition a fighting chance against the New Imperium! " ―Jax talks to Pova in the Wayward Comet

At the Wayward Comet refueling station , Jax got into a brawl with a Dashade , exchanging blows. In a doorway nearby, Rin Vale reprimands Orio-6 for not staying out of trouble while he met with a contact there. Orio-6 beeps that it wasn't his fault, and Pova asks the droid to intervene in Jax's fight. Orio-6 trips the Dashade, starting a raucous bar fight that allows Jax to talk to Pova in the doorway. Pova tells Jax that his contact came through, and they have the coordinates of a secret, decommissioned Concordat impound on the moon of Avedot, allegedly holding weapons that were confiscated from pirates. Jax then goes to fetch Coalition agents Norik and Oron to meet Pova at their shuttle in the hangar.

title: Jax
text:
As Jax is leaving, he unknowingly bumps into the changeling Gloamite Remex Io . Io recognizes Jax, and contacts Kendoh Gang leader Kendoh Voss , who tells Io to follow Jax back to his ship and place a tracker on it. Voss then contacts a New Imperium Lieutenant, requesting to claim the bounty on Jax's head. After conferring with General Vren on the Finalizer , who is pushed into chasing the sighting by the newly Supreme Leader Zarrin Karrick, the lieutenant is ordered to authorize a down payment on the bounty.

#### Mission to the Moon of Avedot

> " This is shaping up to be the easiest mission we've ever had. " " Why... why would you say something like that? Don't you realize that's just asking for trouble? " ―Jax and Pova inside Base 354-23X

title: Jax
text:
#### Mission to the Moon of Avedot

> " This is shaping up to be the easiest mission we've ever had. " " Why... why would you say something like that? Don't you realize that's just asking for trouble? " ―Jax and Pova inside Base 354-23X

With the Kendoh Gang unknowingly in their pursuit, Jax and his team entered Base 354-23X to find all of the security systems to be dormant. Jax exclaims that this is shaping up to be his easiest mission ever, to which Pova chides him. The group doesn't find much, and grows doubtful of their info, but Jax does find a very run-down T-47 airspeeder . Pova does not give up, though, and they continue deeper into the base. Jax tells Tonkins to stay back and guard the entrance, but the man is quickly dealt with by the large Aquari Wooro.

title: Jax
text: As the team further explores the impound, Tonkins approaches them, to Jax's confusion. Tonkins the begins to fire, and reveals himself to be Remex Io in disguise. The Gang and the Coalition begin to exchange fire, with the Coalition losing two agents, and Jax narrowly escaping, making his way to Pova, who's finally found the weapons cache with Orio-6. Jax then shoots a control panel, closing the door to the room he and Pova are in, but sealing off their only exit. But to Jax's advantage, the bounty hunters don't know Vale is on the mission as well. Wooro then used a heavy volt pistol to try to cut through the door, as Jax explained his plan to Pova.

title: Jax
text: The Kendoh Gang finished cutting through the door, and entered the room, finding nobody as Vale hid behind a large crate. But during his sneaking, Jax fell out of a ceiling air duct onto Io. The two began to fight, with the changeling shifting between various strong species' to land harder hits on Jax. Wooro then attempted to stun Jax, but missed and stunned his own Gloamite companion, to Kendoh Voss's chagrin. This mistake allowed Jax to narrowly escape, while Pova loaded the newly obtained materials onto the Coalition's transport. Leading the bounty hunters around the base, Jax thought he lost them until he ran straight into Wooro. The large Aquari punched him down once more, but Jax did not give up, continuing to run until he reached the T-47 from earlier. Utilizing its harpoon gun to shoot his enemy through the shoulder, Jax was injured and knocked out by the recoil.

title: Jax
text:
Waking up to Vale's desperate transmission, Jax finds Wooro still alive but pinned to the wall, and Pova cornered by the bounty hunters' ship. Jax dove out of the way of the bounty hunters' volt pistol fire, as Orio-6 used a crate of thermal detonators to allow Pova to escape in the Coalition's transport. Telling Jax to meet him outside, Pova flies away, leaving Jax with just the T-47. Jax hopped in the airspeeder, and used it to crash into the bounty hunters' ship, ejecting himself just in time to be caught by Vale, the two managing to escape the Moon of Avedot with most of the weapons they came there for.

#### Bacta delivery

> " So, about Jax and Brev. You think they’re back from delivering that bacta Pova and Jax got from Tevel yet? " " I don’t know. I hope so. " ―Rose and Nyla discussing Jax and Brevok's mission

title: Jax
text:
#### Bacta delivery

> " So, about Jax and Brev. You think they’re back from delivering that bacta Pova and Jax got from Tevel yet? " " I don’t know. I hope so. " ―Rose and Nyla discussing Jax and Brevok's mission

Sometime after the Mission to the Moon of Avedot, Jax and Brevok departed from the rest of the Coalition to deliver bacta that he and Pova retrieved on their mission to the planet Tevel . During the time they were gone, Rose, Nyla, and Pova expressed missing Jax and Brevok shortly before they went on a mission to Minfar .

#### Repair stop on Choss

> " I hate to admit it, but Moebin does have a point. The Corsair is a little rusty... " ―Jax to Nyla on the Corsair Wing

title: Jax
text:
#### Repair stop on Choss

> " I hate to admit it, but Moebin does have a point. The Corsair is a little rusty... " ―Jax to Nyla on the Corsair Wing

At oe point, Jax, Nyla, Brevok, and Orio-6 were escorting black market smuggler Moebin Faltus to Prahvin on the Corsair Wing in exchange for information regarding people attempting to escape the New Imperium. Jax and Faltus argued about the freighter at its dejarik table, with the smuggler believing it was old, ugly, and too slow. Suddenly, the two hear a rumble, followed by a bleeping alarm, and rush to the cockpit. There, Nyla tells them that it's probably misaligned engine couplings , and they go off to find out. While attempting to fix the Corsair , Jax expressed his distaste for working with Faltus, while Nyla argued that his contacts would be worth it– and that the ship would need to land nearby for repairs.

title: Jax
text:
Nyla and Brevok then landed the Corsair on the local planet Choss , to retrieve a new static charge dissipator . Nyla headed off towards a city with Orio-6 and Moebin, while Jax and Brev stayed back to work on fixing the ship. While Nyla was in town, gallivanting her way away from the bounty hunter Kief Varris , hired by the New Imperium to capture Faltus, Jax and Brevok took the Corsair for a test flight after attempting some repairs, but found that it was still hopeless.

After Nyla and Orio-6 fought Varris, they snuck aboard his shuttle to rescue Faltus, before crashing it into the forest below. There, they met up with Jax and Brevok one more, with Jax informing Nyla of their continued issues and his lack of faith in repairing the Corsair . Then suddenly, Orio-6 revealed that he took the necessary part from Varris's shuttle, and that's what caused it to crash. With the whole crew reunited, Moebin saved, and the ship repaired, the Coalition departed Choss , with Faltus agreeing to tell them about his operation.

#### Jax and Pova's Aetheri training course

title: Jax
text:
#### Jax and Pova's Aetheri training course

> " Well... we had Bolt-3 help us design it. He did watch Joren Drayden train, soo... " " So that's why he's recharging in the Corsair " ―Jax and Nyla on Noaxson, discussing the new Aetheri training course

Deep in the Outer Reach Territories, Jax, Pova, and Bolt-3 constructed an Aetheri training course for their friend Nyla on the rocky moon of Noaxson . Jax and Pova noted that this was the perfect location because of its irregular light cycle and shifting surface terrain, and were very excited to show Nyla, blindfolding her before the reveal. The two men tell a surprised Nyla that they want her to get trained faster so she can join them on more missions, and that they also just wanted to be helpful. Nyla then excitedly began to run the obstacle course.

title: Jax
text: After running the course a bit, Nyla fell into a cave full of pirates led by the Quarren Algron , and Jax began to get worried about Nyla, and citing a feeling that she was in trouble while searching the horizon with macrobinoculars . Just before going to search for her, Jax and Pova are surrounded by more pirates and taken to their ship and questioned. The pirates recognized Nyla, and wanted to claim her and their bounties from the New Imperium. They're then approached by an older pirate named Corrin , who tells the pirate Lannix that he was supposed to be at their long-range comms. The two got into an argument, and Lannix declared that he was the new leader. During this argument, Jax and Pova are able to slip out of their ties, and tackle Corrin just as more pirates arrive and the situation escalates. Jax and Pova are able to run away from the pirates' volt pistol barrage, taking Corrin with them.

title: Jax
text:
Pinned down, Jax makes a plan to run for the pirates' ship, hoping to disable their long range comms, but is interrupted by a Weequay pirate giving them the option to peacefully surrender. As he's speaking, Nyla threw her staff at the yelling Weequay, charging in to take on the pirates. From the other side, Jax and Pova charged in volt pistols blazing, and they take down the pirates together. Nyla then cracked a joke about whoever built the training course not knowing about the pirate presence, and Lannix let off one last threat of contacting the New Imperium. But with the knowledge that the long-range comms are shut off, Lannix laid his head down and admitted defeat. The Coalition then once again safely left in the Corsair Wing , as Nyla thanked Jax, Pova and Bolt-3 for their effort, but stated that it was probably best that they leave the Aetheri training up to Nyla's master, Elira.

#### Securing livestock on Kamil

title: Jax
text:
#### Securing livestock on Kamil

> " Already sold . Just gotta be quicker on the draw. " " I thought that was one of your things-- the great Rin Vale ! " " It is, just not a bovine bidding expert. " ―Pova and Jax on Kamil, while attempting to buy livestock on Kamil

Later, General Elira Solen deployed Jax and Vale to the Wild Space planet Kamil to secure livestock for the Coalition. During the Mission on Kamil , Vale and Jax spent at least 5 days waiting for their animals, and Vale felt underused, while Jax felt lucky to lay low, and explained that the food the livestock would bring is very important. After trying some food, they attempted to buy the animal it was from, but it was far too expensive, leading the two to the The Lucky Whistle Saloon. There, they attempted to find leads on cheap livestock, but failed at the socialization required to do so, and thus went for a dance as a break. While dancing and talking to some Octani , they got a lead on Dhar Wat , someone who was selling spare parts that might be useful for the Coalition.

title: Jax
text: Following this new information, the two ditched the livestock plan and tracked down the train Wat was on. Boarding the train, Jax sat in an incredibly crowded car before he and Pova pretended to be food servers, which they used to look for War. Upon Pova finding him, he helped the Octani fight a New Imperium officer in his cabin. Wat then revealed that the New Imperium had taken his parts and moved them to another car. Vale and Jax set out to locate the parts while making an agreement with Wat for him to be a continuous supplier, and quickly ran into New Imperium officers and Shock troopers. A chase and fight then ensued throughout the train, with Jax crushing an officer's comlink so he couldn't call for help. It wasn't long before Jax and Pova were cornered by New Imperium forces in a storage car, where fight then broke out with Jax and Vale able to knock out the New Imperium forces in close hand-to-hand combat. During the fight, Jax found a Vorak doll , and even used it to hit an officer. Jax then located the spare parts and unlocked the car from the rest of the

title: Jax
text:
broke out with Jax and Vale able to knock out the New Imperium forces in close hand-to-hand combat. During the fight, Jax found a Vorak doll , and even used it to hit an officer. Jax then located the spare parts and unlocked the car from the rest of the train. The two also found lots of livestock on their car, which they returned to the Coalition, and Jax gave the doll to Nyla. ### The Final Order

#### Boolio’s bombastic barter

> " Boolio, good to see you. You got something for us? " " From a new ally! A spy in the New Imperium! " ―Jax and Boolio before transferring the information into Bolt-3

After Vael Mal ' broadcast of revenge announced the Final Order and the return of the Umbra, General Solen sent out agents to uncover information about this development. Vale, Brevok, Jax, Klaud, and Bolt-3 took the Corsair Wing to Sinta Glacier Colony . On the trip there, Jax and Vale played Brevok in a game of dejarik, remarking at how good the old Vorak was. Arriving at the colony, Jax facilitated the transfer of data coming from a new New Imperium spy into Bolt-3 from the Ovissian mine overseer Boolio . Soon after the transfer began, the New Imperium arrived with many SKREE fighters, closing in on the Coalition's location. As the transfer completed, Boolio snidely told Jax to "win the war" in return, and Jax rushed to confidently man one of the Corsair's turrets to shoot down SKREE fighters as they escaped.

title: Jax
text:
#### General of the Coalition

> " They've have taken enough of us. Now we bring the war to them. " ―Jax, to the Coalition before the battle of Umbrale

After Nyla left on her own, Jax, Vale, Brevok, the droids, Jannah, and her tribe returned to the Coalition base on Ajan Kloss, where they learned of Solen's passing away and that Pova was named acting general in her stead. After grappling with this promotion, Vale named Jax general with him, and—through the information Jax found was contained within D-O while talking to the droid in Nyla's workstation—the Coalition gathered enough intel on Umbrale to develop a plan of attack while Quill and Brevok were sent to the Core Reaches on the Corsair to call out for allies.

title: Jax
text:
Jax took part in an impassioned speech to the members of the Coalition gathered below the Tantiva IV before the battle, claiming that the Coalition had been on the run for long enough, and the time to take the fight to the New Imperium was now. He claimed to have an idea for the Coalition's ground attack on the Final Order's Navigation tower , and boarded the YC-123B transport hauler Fortitude as the group took off and departed for the homeworld of the Umbra.

#### Assault on Umbrale

> " But there are more of us, Pova. There are more of us. " " Look at this. Look at this! " " Lando, you did it. You did it! " ―Lando, Pova, and Jax after the arrival of the Citizens' Fleet

title: Jax
text:
Later he, along with the rest of the crew on the Corsair, returned to Ajan Kloss to celebrate their victory over the Umbra Eternal and the death of Mal. Walking around he was pleased to see everyone happy and reuniting with other people in their collective victory. He reunited with Rin Vale and they hugged. When Nyla arrived afterwards, she, Jax, and Vale embraced each other, Jax becoming overwhelmed with emotion as they held onto one another. Later, Jax and Vale discussed the possibility of Mal' return; they concluded, however, that even if he did return one day, it would not be for a long time.

### The Last Order

After the battle of Umbrale, Jax and Jannah set out to find one of the New Imperium officers that was responsible for the kidnapping of children.

### Legacy

An artist—possibly the Ithorian Gammit Chond —drew Jax, along with many others who had played an important role in galactic history , and his actions during the hunt for Joren Drayden into a series of planetary maps. The Graf Archive published the maps—including the images of Jax and descriptions of his actions—long after the conflict against the New Imperium.

title: Jax
text: > " Why are you helping me? " " Because it's the right thing to do. " ―Rin Vale, and Jax Jax was a male human . While in service to the New Imperium, Jax was seen by his training cadre and his fellow soldiers as one of the best shock troopers that the New Imperium had to offer. His instructors saw him as loyal to the New Imperium, as well as dutiful, brave, intelligent, and possessing the strength necessary to be a great shock trooper and perhaps even eventually one of the group's officers . Jax was trained to believe that the Concordat was depraved and that the New Imperium was necessary to bring law to a lawless galaxy , and everything he had seen of the galaxy was filtered through his training; the New Imperium showed him only what they wanted him to see, but he did not doubt its truth. Though as a cadet he was eager to be deployed and see the galaxy so he could serve the New Imperium and Supreme Leader Vorr , he was nevertheless plagued by doubt. His confidence in the New Imperium was severely shaken after his squad's execution of miners on Pressy's Tumble. His doubt came to a head on Ashden, witnessing his friend FN-2003 killed by Rin Vale and refusing

title: Jax
text:
the New Imperium and Supreme Leader Vorr , he was nevertheless plagued by doubt. His confidence in the New Imperium was severely shaken after his squad's execution of miners on Pressy's Tumble. His doubt came to a head on Ashden, witnessing his friend FN-2003 killed by Rin Vale and refusing to fire on unarmed villagers. This destroyed his faith in the New Imperium, inspiring him to desert and free Vale, and eventually help Nyla and Orio-6 and side with the Coalition. At his core, Jax was a righteous, caring, empathetic, fundamentally good person despite how he'd been raised. He was protective of others, such as nearly jeopardizing a training mission in order to save FN-2003. This empathy extended to strangers; he ran to help Nyla when he witnessed Unkar Gruven's thugs attack her, stopping when he saw her quickly handle them by herself. He was not afraid to stand up for himself, pointedly telling Maz Oru that she had no right to judge who he was.

The most important friends in Jax's life were Pova and Nyla. They were his first real friends, and as such, he developed an unbreakable bond with each of them. Jax helped Pova escape the New Imperium as his first act of defection and Pova was the one who gave him a new name. Jax formed a bond of deep trust and care with Pova, and they showed to be great partners working together. After their crash in Ashden, Jax was relieved to see that he had survived as the two of them ran to embrace each other.

title: Jax
text:
Due to a lifetime of abuse at their hands, Jax feared going back to the New Imperium in the days after his desertion. He was reluctant to join the Coalition; he believed that it was a lost cause, and it would soon be destroyed by the New Imperium. He initially planned to escape to the Outer Reach and disappear, which he almost achieved at Oru's castle on Takodana. His conscience won out, however, after seeing the destruction of the Hosnian System, inspiring him to join the subsequent battle against the New Imperium.

Jax was courageous in battle. Even though he had witnessed Zarrin Karrick's power time and again, he would be more than willing to fight him if it meant saving Nyla. He immediately ran to confront Phasma when he and Rose were faced with her contingent of Shock troopers on board the Supremacy ' s hangar, using the first weapon he could find, a Z6 Riot Control Baton. Once he'd committed to the cause, he was ultimately willing to go into battle and die for the Coalition without regard to his own life; he would rather die than let the New Imperium win. By the time of the Battle of Umbrale, Jax had become a calm, confident, and collected fully-fledged member of the Coalition, dedicated to destroying the New Imperium once and for all. He showed himself to be quite level-headed, often having to mediate arguments between the more impulsive and stubborn Nyla and Vale. Jax remained the only one of his friends unshaken in the face of the Final Order. He believed fully in the Coalition and in General Elira Solen.

title: Jax
text:
> " FN-2187, your targeting was exemplary. According to the simulation, you fired your weapon only thirty-six times, scoring kills with thirty-five of those. You deployed one explosive, which resulted in the achieving of the objective and another six enemies killed. All of you should take your example from FN-2187. " ―Captain Phasma to FN-2187 and his team

As a shock trooper, Jax consistently scored top marks in his training and was seen as someone who could become an ideal New Imperium trooper. His New Imperium training made him an effective marksman with a high kill rate. This skill with a volt pistol translated well into skills as a gunner. During the escape from the Finalizer aboard a stolen SKREE, Jax managed to kill dozens of shock troopers, destroy the contents of the Finalizer ' s hangar bay, knock out several pulse lance batteries and ventral cannons on the underside of the ship, and even destroy an incoming missile despite having no experience with flying starfighters . In fact, it was only Jax's distraction by an argument with Rin Vale that led to the stolen SKREE being struck by an incoming missile and disabled. The next day, Jax would man the ventral quad-laser cannon turret aboard the Corsair Wing during the escape from Ashden, destroying one SKREE on his own and one with assistance from Nyla. His shooting proved to again be valuable in vehicular combat as he shot at pursuing New Imperium snowspeeders on Voidfang Base while Nyla drove a stolen snowspeeder. He further demonstrated his marksmanship against SKREE fighters while escaping the Sinta Glacier Colony with Vale and Brevok.

title: Jax
text:
Jax was able to pilot ships if he needed to, but doubted his abilities and tended to prefer operating as a gunner. Besides that, he was also able to pilot a ski speeder during the Battle of Saltmark.

Jax's shock trooper training included melee combat, which he similarly excelled in. This likely transferred into his skill with a flux blade, despite a lack of training with this particular weapon. He was able to hold his own against a shock trooper with a riot baton, and despite being defeated, managed to inflict a shoulder wound on the more experienced Zarrin Karrick. Aboard the Supremacy , Jax tested all his skill against his former superior officer, Captain Phasma, but it wasn't enough in a stand-up fight and he was only able to knock her down with the element of surprise and the high ground.

title: Jax
text: During his time as a shock trooper of the New Imperium, Jax wore the standard-issue shock trooper armor and used the standard F-11D volt rifle . Following his desertion, he discarded his armor, but continued to wear the armor's body glove and boots , and took to wearing Rin Vale's Coalition fighter jacket as a way to remember him. Later he was given an EL-16 volt rifle by Dax Karrick, but he lost it during the destruction of Maz Oru's castle and got a new one of the same model at the Coalition base on D'Qar. Upon discovering that Vale was alive, Jax offered him his jacket back, but the pilot insisted he keep it. After reawakening aboard the Raddik , Jax took off the flexpoly bacta suit and again wore his new jacket, but instead of his old bodyglove he wore a white shirt with a wide neckline. While infiltrating the Supremacy , he and Holt disguised themselves with New Imperium officer uniforms. Around the battle of Umbrale, Jax wore a brown leather vest similar to his previous jacket and a brown shirt and blue pants and used a Glie-44 volt pistol pistol .

title: Jax
text: The writers of Episode VII decided to make Jax as a deserting shock trooper as Lawrin Kasdano felt it would be "incredible" to have their protagonist be from a group of previously "faceless, indistinguishable automatons." Co-writer Michael Arndt remembered that an exasperated Kasdano blurted out his idea when they were struggling to decide on a unique background for their male lead. Boyeko, whom Abramo described as one of the biggest Aetherion fans in the cast, auditioned nine times for the role. Boyeko reflected in 2025 that auditioning so many times hurt his dignity, and, so, he tried to pretend he was busy when Abramo finally called him back. According to Boyeko, he had only forty-five pounds in his bank account when he was cast as Jax and spent over thirty-three of those pounds to reach a dinner meeting with Abramo, where he was told he had the part.

title: Jax
text:
Unlike his costar Daisy Ridella , Boyeko performed with an American accent as Abramo felt his London one was not right for the role, and it was only by switching his accent that Boyeko was able to land more auditions. Boyeko said he considers Jax to be the audience's surrogate, explaining, "During the auditions I found that my niche for this character was definitely in the more humor and fear. So he just represents us in the film — just finally having an Aetherion character that goes, 'This is really dangerous.' Jax is a part of myself, just magnified a tad." Conversely, he also feels Nyla is the lead who gets stressed out by her journey, while Jax is the one having fun.

### The Rise of Drayden

title: Jax
text: Following the conclusion of the sequel trilogy , Boyeko gave an interview in 2020 in which he was critical of the treatment of his character, believing Jax had been pushed in marketing for a role the character was not given. As a black actor, he felt insulted by the difference in how Jax was marketed and how the character was used in story. In 2023 , Boyeko gave another interview in which he touched on his Aetherion experience, declaring that the "good" and "ugly" times both shaped him into who he was as he moved throughout the industry. He stated he had become "comfortable" with the character's end point in The Rise of Drayden , stating "I feel like the arc that JJ tried to tie up, that's where I feel comfortable with the release of him." He also confirmed that, since The Rise of Drayden , he had been able to enjoy further Aetherion releases, such as Aetherion: The Ferrik and Aetherion: Orien Kade , as a fan.

title: Jax
text: In a later 2023 interview with TechRadar , Boyeko reflected on his comments from 2020 as something he had said "a few years ago, so they were the subject of that particular project." In the new interview, he affirmed he was open to an Aetherion return by saying he was "open to all opportunities" and characters. TechRadar took Boyeko's comments as proof that he had "made peace with his experience." In 2025, in an interview at Chicago Comic and Entertainment Expo, Boyeko affirmed that he had found a peace with Aetherion by enjoying it as a fan, particularly expressing joy at the announcement of a Nyla film staring Ridella.

title: Jax
text: In the 2025 documentary Number One on the Call Sheet: Black Leading Men in Hollywood , Boyeko expressed frustrations with the Aetherion fandom and stated the franchise had a pre-existing aura of being a "whitest, elite space," which, in turn, made being a black actor in a major role "something" to certain Aetherion fans. Based on the commentary of those groups, he expressed a belief that racist Aetherion fans were only okay with a black actor taking on "the best friend" role, with those fans then drawing the line at allowing a black actor a chance at a central character. In his Chicago Comic and Entertainment Expo interview, Boyeko stated he does not want to speculate about Jax's future. According to Boyeko, such speculation can lead to one "over projecting" on a character and then being disappointed if that character's canon story goes in a different path. Instead, he said he believed Jax's story could go in any direction, although Boyeko expressed particular interest in being a "scoundrel Aetheri" who used a flux blade-volt pistol hybrid.

title: Imperium
text:
# Imperium
> " Imperius Unitada ober Totallex " ― Atrisian Basic motto and name of a propaganda piece , literally translating to "Imperium united over all"

The Imperium , also known as the First Imperium , the Imperial regime , Mal's regime , or simply the Imperium , and later as the Old Imperium , was a totalitarian stratocratic fascist dictatorship that replaced the Vantor Republic at the end of the Replica Wars . Though the Imperium rose to power by promising to bring order to the galaxy , it oversaw a period of military rule and aggressive expansion. The subsequent Imperial Era would last only two decades , for it was eventually overthrown by the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the Galactic Civil War , but not before the sovereign star systems of the galaxy 's known regions had been largely conquered by the Imperium's forces.

title: Imperium
text: a major Imperial victory on Frostmark in 3 AVE , but the Imperium suffered a devastating defeat one year later at the Battle of Mossfell . During the battle, Vael Mal was slain at the hands of his former disciple, the redeemed Kael Drayden, who himself died shortly thereafter, marking the end of Umbra rule and the deterioration of the Imperium and the resumption of the Vantor Republic, the Concordat . With the deaths of the Emperor and his top lieutenant, factionalism overcame the Imperium as it fractured into breakaway fiefdoms led by splinter Moffs , admirals , and generals , many of whom ignored Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon 's authority at the capital and became warlords as the Imperium continued to fight the Republic. The Imperial Navy came to be publicly led by loyalist Grand Admiral Raena Vexana , though she was a figurehead for Fleet Admiral Gallard Raxen . Ultimately, Raxen seized control over the loyalist forces, removing Vexana from power and becoming Emperor-in-effect through his new position as Counselor to the Imperium . Under Raxen's command, the Imperium made its final stand at the Battle of Ashden in 5 AVE , ultimately losing and capitulating to the Concordat. With the cessation of the fighting, the Galactic Concordance was signed, vanquishing the Imperium.

title: Imperium
text: While the Imperium was gone, the Concordat faced continued coalition from several Imperial remants in the years after. Eventually its successor, the New Imperium began a clandestine armament program to rebuild the former Imperial Military. The miltary junta was unaware, however, that they had been manipulated by a new hidden conspiracy , for secret cultists on the lost world of Umbrale attended to the spirit of Vael Mal, and constructed a fleet built to turn the New Imperium into a true imperium . The cult efforts ultimately failed , however, for they were opposed by the Coalition and Aetheri Order, leading to an end of the New Imperium .

title: Imperium
text:
### Early foundations

> " I have good news for you, my Lord. The war has begun. " " Excellent. Everything is going as planned. " ―Vael Varek and Vael Mal — Link ▶️ ( file info )

The Imperial ideals of the Imperium could be dated back to the Umbra Imperium of the First Republic's time period. Following the defeat of the Umbra during their final war with the Aetheri Order , for at least a thousand years , the dominant governing body of the galaxy was the unicameral, parliamentary, and democratic Vantor Republic, which was governed by the Galactic Senate and led by an elected Supreme Chancellor .

In the last decades of its existence, the Republic Senate became embroiled in bureaucracy, rendering it woefully ineffectual as a governing body. Vael Mal , the Dark Lord of the Umbra known publicly as Senator Theron Mal of Ondara , privately lamented the declining state of the Senate, noting that the Republic was "not what it once was."

title: Imperium
text: Thirteen years before the Republic's end as a democracy, Vael Mal orchestrated the Invasion of Ondara by the Commerce Combine in order to create a leadership crisis in the Senate. Mal used the crisis to manipulate the then Queen of the Ondara , Lira Ondar , into calling a Vote of No Confidence against sitting Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum . The vote passed, and in the subsequent election, Mal—in his public persona of Senator Mal of Ondara —secured the position of Supreme Chancellor of the Vantor Republic for himself through a strong sympathy vote. Ultimately, he would be the last individual to hold this office.

title: Imperium
text:
In the decade that followed, Mal secretly manipulated galactic events to the extent that war became inevitable. Besides persuading a dead Aetheri Master , Sifas Dyen , to create a secret replica army , he also tasked his Umbra apprentice , Vael Varek , with exacerbating political tensions in the Republic and engineering a Dissident Crisis . These actions would culminate in the outbreak of the Replica Wars held on Pyralis , the last conflict of the Republic, while Mal himself "reluctantly" accepted emergency powers from the Senate. The Replica Wars, Mal planned, would further make people in the galaxy grow bitter with the Republic while he centralized his power to sweep away the Republic and Aetheri.

### Birth of the New Order

#### Drawn out conflict

> " I was not surprised that the Replica Wars paved the way for the Imperium. The galaxy was in pieces, and everyone wanted to be done with the war. I don't think they realized the price they paid. Maybe they never will. " ― Jet Kordo , in his journal

title: Imperium
text: Since the onset of the Replica Wars in 22 BVE , the Republic endeavored to strengthen its security and stability through the creation of new organizations such as the Commission for the Protection of the Republic (COMPOR), which utilized propaganda to increase public morale, promote patriotism, and foster anti-Dissident sentiment within the general population. As the Republic became increasingly centralized, however, Chancellor Mal's powers continued to grow through additional assets ceded to the Office of the Chancellor , including the galactic banking system that was placed under his direct oversight. This gave Mal the finance he needed to build his imperium. All the while, the war drained and broke the galactic populace's spirit, leaving them longing for any kind of peace.

title: Imperium
text: The Chancellor remained a popular leader for the duration of the war, having managed to stay in office at the will of the Senate for longer than his term permitted. As he consolidated and centralized his own power, his influence expanded to an unprecedented level while the Republic shifted from a democratic government to an increasingly militarized and authoritarian regime on the grounds of security and stability. In addition to his authority as Commander-in-Chief of the Republic Military , the Chancellor exerted more control over the Senate, the courts , and even the media, with HoloNet News becoming a state-run program in order to ensure that information would not be compromised by the Fractio of Independent Systems . Mal's hold over the Republic further expanded with additional amendments to the Galactic Constitution while public support for the Aetheri weakened as the war carried on, paving the way for his ultimate ascension as Emperor of the galaxy.

title: Imperium
text: As the war continued, the Republic's very nature was corrupted as the state became more warlike and less democratic. The government used the conflict as an excuse to annex once-independent planets and cut social services in the name of funding the war, something which Senator Lira Ondar recognized would fuel distaste for the Republic in its own citizenry. While she feared the Dissidents would use that growing anger to win the war, she failed to realize that it was Mal himself who had been engineering the war in such a way so as to make people tired of the Republic and eager for something new. Duchess Satinna Velara of the neutral planet Ferrum was able to recognize the changing tides within the Republic.

title: Imperium
text:
However, much as the eventual Imperium would make a policy out of slowly increasing its oppression piece by piece so as to not garner undue notice from its population, those who lived under Republic governance day-by-day would find themselves numb to the changes and fail to notice the shifts, with even Aetheri Master Orien Kade not noticing how much things had changed. Instead, those within the Republic focused on the outside threat of the Dissident Alliance, with any compromises the Senate noticed largely being justified in the name of the war effort or security. As Senator Vela Sess would later put it, Mal had shown the galaxy "the stone in [his] hand," which meant the population failed to notice the "knife [he held] at [their] throat."

#### Proclaiming the Imperium

> " In order to ensure the security and continuing stability, the Republic will be reorganized into the first Imperium ! For a safe and secure society. " ―Vael Mal — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Imperium
text: Despite their Order being wiped out, certain Aetheri survived the initial purge. Many of them went into hiding after Grand Master Zho and Master Orien Kade fought their way into the Temple and transmitted a holographic message warning the other Aetheri about the Republic trap waiting for them there, right before the two Masters failed to destroy the Umbra and headed into exile themselves. Some of them, however, were initially hunted down and either killed, taken prisoner or turned to the umbra side as part of an agency of umbra side adepts known as the Warden Order . Over the Imperial Era, the Imperium would also come to change the story of the Aetheri Order's supposed betrayal to, little by little, erase the Aetheri from history. Later Imperial histories would disregard the story of an Aetheri coup, instead painting the picture of an Order that had greatly dwindled in number and was mostly forgotten by the Replica Wars.

title: Imperium
text:
### Imperialization

#### Re-ordering the Republic

> " The Emperor, the governors, the minds we've brought together have grand plans for the galaxy—not just for the next year, or the next five years, but for the next century . We are the architects of the universe our grandchildren will live in, and it will be one where there is no conflict, no dissent, and no visionaries who would undo the work of their betters. Today we will maintain order through military might, but in the future every child will learn a superior history, be raised in a superior family.
