And the concept of defiance will be as antiquated as the spear. You ask me if we would start a war to maintain our grip on power. This is my answer: We already did. While you were obsessed with the Dissident conflict, we were doing battle on another front, capturing the love of the people of this galaxy. The Emperor won. Now we are securing our victory and reaping the spoils, while you seem to believe the fighting never began, let alone ended. " ―Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon, to Senator Vela Sess

title: Imperium
text: Existing government bodies were renamed to reflect the change in authority as civil and military superstructure of the First Republic were overhauled immediately under the personal direction of the Emperor. With vast portions of the galaxy still unconquered, the Grand Army of the Republic became the Imperial Army , while the Republic Navy became the Imperial Navy and the Galactic Senate was rechristened the Imperial Senate . The renowned Senate Plaza , with its name reminding residents of the First Republic, was promptly changed to the Imperial Plaza. Ultimately, the mechanisms created for the Republic during the war were twisted to fit Mal' use, with even the systems built with help from the Aetheri benefiting the new Emperor. All the while, the Emperor and his followers began formulating their century plan for the galaxy and how it would change under Imperial rule.

title: Imperium
text: In addition, the former roundel of the Republic was replaced with the new Imperial crest , adorned on almost everything having to do with Mal' Imperium. With every day that passed, Mal' hold over the galaxy grew tighter. For the next decade and a half, Imperial rule—bolstered by the military created to fight in the Replica Wars—dominated the galaxy and was largely unchallenged. The Imperium soon began to upgrade its military hardware, replacing Vireo and ARC-170 fighters with newer SKREE models five years after the Replica Wars, but Republic-era military equipment continued to be used for a while on distant outposts and locations such as Galidraan Station . The Republic's Phase II replica trooper armor would begin a phase out and be replaced by superior shock trooper armor , whose development had been headed by the Imperial Department of Military Research . In the meantime, the Imperium quietly supported the activity of the 4040s activist group, whose members came to function as something of a paramilitary.

title: Imperium
text: All the while, the average peoples of the Imperium carried on, thinking that their lives would continue happily. On the whole, the population was relieved to see an end to the war and the fear it instilled in their lives. While certain anti-Imperial actions could be punished, with word spreading that some traitors were sent to the spice mines of Cindral , the administration—in that period of early establishment, where its foundations were shaky—only cracked down on major threats to its existence. That created a sense of false security in the population, whose civil liberties were curtailed over the prolonged existence of the Imperium, instead of in one great stroke. Mal relied on populist messaging that appealed to the average citizen, but the Imperium was, in truth, a state designed for the wealthy, who would enjoy comfort and the state's kindness at the expense of those average workers and populations. Indeed, the Imperium made it a point not to push too hard among the residents of the Core Reaches while outer regions, such as the Outer Reach, became valuable sources for exploitation.

title: Imperium
text:
Sess and Solen championed the Imperial Rebirth Act to try and reclaim power for the Senate that had been claimed by Mal, only for Mal to claim that, as Emperor, he had the ability to veto portions of the bill. While Sess disagreed with the claim, she was not yet ready to start a war against the Emperor, who had the love of the galaxy's population and the power to back it up, so found herself forced to accept the defeat. Nonetheless, faced with the revelation that senatorial action would not be enough to curtail Mal, Sess and Solen began a covert partnership with the insurgent leader Torrik Vess of the Partisans ; in this alliance, Vess would stand as the military heart and provide the beginnings of a insurgent army, Sess would build coalitions to oppose Mal as their movement's political heart, and Solen would stand as its ideological heart, bringing together thinkers and reformers who could present a new way forward.

#### Continuing clean-up

title: Imperium
text:
#### Continuing clean-up

> " They want the Imperium to collapse the same way some hoped the Republic would, only this time our enemies aren't rebelling in protest of Senate representation, trade routes, or taxes. They're intent on sowing chaos, on bringing everything down. They have no agenda—political, religious, or any other—beyond a desire to end civilization as we know it. " ― Orren Callan Vossik

Happy for the peace and the end to the fighting the rise of the Imperium brought after the Replica Wars had killed billions, the new government was welcomed by people all throughout a galaxy that was tired of the bloodshed; on the planet Pantora , citizens cheered as replica shock troopers marched past them near an Imperial Informational Station , where a message played announcing personal chain codes and new currency .

title: Imperium
text:
After the Dissident Droid Army was promptly shut down, its navy was dismantled at locations across the galaxy such as the Bilbringi shipyards . However, various droid models and Dissident technology escaped Imperial appropriation and worked their way onto the black market, with many modules taken from Dissident frigates and destroyers, including pieces from Admiral Trench 's warship, the Invincible . Despite Dissident-era technology continuing to be used and appearing in locations such as the Corporate Sector , the Imperium continued to root out remaining holdouts of the Fractio four years after the Replica Wars, while criminal organizations composed of repurposed battle droids such as the Droid Gotra operated in Vantor's underground.

While the Imperium at times came into conflict with parts of the criminal underworld, the Imperium allied itself with major galactic criminal factions, including Carmine Dawn and the Grak Clan . The Graks enjoyed a special relationship with the Imperium that remained in place for decades. Other criminal factions, like Papa Toren's group , the Gruv Syndicate , the Droid Gotra, the Black Sun , the Zerek Besh , all desired to take the Grak Clan's place as the Imperium's formal partner in underworld affairs.

title: Imperium
text:
#### Minor coalition

> " Why should we trust you? " " Because I'm on your side. What the Imperium is doing is wrong. You have to get out of here. " ― Gobi Glie and Howzer

As pirates, smugglers, and ex-Dissidents were routinely imprisoned and destroyed, the Imperium faced little serious coalition to its rule. A rare exception revolved around the Outer Reach world of Selvara , where Moff Delian Mors and Colonel Belka Drayn were fighting an insurgency known as the Free Selvara Movement , led by former Velari Coalition leader Chavar Kryll , who established hidden bases across Selvara and executed raids against the Imperium, including those on its lucrative spice and slave trade in the sector. Composed of freedom fighters who fought with the Vantor Republic and Aetheri Master Drevan Koss during the Replica Wars to free their homeworld from Dissident occupation by Emir Wat Tambra , the newly formed Free Selvara movement would continue its struggle for independence against the Imperium for decades.

title: Imperium
text:
Seeking to make examples of worlds who continued to harbor secessionist tendencies, Moff Wilhard Varrix was assigned to make an example of Antar 4 , a populous moon that had been a part of the Dissident Alliance and involved in a scheme involving Republic Intelligence to train locals into well-armed coalition groups. While COMPNOR initially stifled information regarding the killings, word soon leaked about the operation through inquisitive reporters such as Anora Fair and Hask Taff , while the event was soon penned as the Antar Atrocity , capturing the attention of many Vantori and other citizens from the Core Reaches.

### Age of the Imperium

#### Continued expansion

title: Imperium
text:
### Age of the Imperium

#### Continued expansion

> " There used to be hundreds of settlements up here. Forty thousand Aldhanis all across the highlands. They were here for centuries, but it only took the Imperium a decade to clear them out. " " Killed them? " " No. Drove them south. There's an Enterprize Zone in the Lowlands. Factories, new towns, Imperial housing. Aldhani has the unfortunate quality of being close to nothing and not far away from everything. It's the perfect hub for distribution. If one were trying to take over the galaxy. " ―Vel Sartha and Kassian Andris

title: Imperium
text: In 19 BVE, Imperial forces arrived on the planet Ferrix in the Free Trade sector to bring it under the Imperium's control. On Rix Road , a regiment of replica troopers under an Imperial officer marched pass the gathered masses of civilians as a show of Imperial authority, although local citizen Clem Andris assured his adoptive son Kassian Jeron Andris that the Imperium would pull out soon enough. To Clem, resisting the Imperium was not their fight. However, a small group of protesters emerged from the crowd and began to throw rocks at the soldiers in the name of the Republic and Ferrix in what became known as the Rix Road protest . Believing they would only make things worse for themselves, Clem quickly stepped in to stop the protest, only for the officer to call his troopers to a halt at that moment. Pointing their volt pistols at the protesters and Clem, who was assumed to be part of the demonstration, the protest was shut down. Clem was publicly hung on Rix Road for his supposed treason.

title: Imperium
text: Afterward, Kassian attacked four replica troopers stationed near the gallows in anger. At some point, Andris spent time with anti-Imperial anarchist groups. Ultimately, Kassian would be arrested on charges of attacking an Imperial soldier, insurrection, and destroying Imperial property. After spending time in prison, the sixteen year old Andris was sent to the planet Mimban , which had been an ally to the Republic during the Replica Wars but possessed vital resources, as a cook for the Imperial Army. After six months on Mimban, Andris escaped by deserting the military. He later claimed he had seen active combat. Upon escaping, Andris realized the Imperium had set him and his other conscripts against people who should have been their allies. Although Andris's resolve to fight the Imperium was damaged, the people of Mimban, the Mimbanese , resisted the Imperium's encroachment on their world as the Imperial Era carried on. Andris ultimately returned home to Ferrix, which largely remained out of direct Imperial control and instead was governed by the Preox-Morlana corporate polity on behalf of the central Imperial regime. Despite his hate for the Imperium, Andris's spirit was crushed, and he attempted to eke out a life for himself, his mother

title: Imperium
text:
returned home to Ferrix, which largely remained out of direct Imperial control and instead was governed by the Preox-Morlana corporate polity on behalf of the central Imperial regime. Despite his hate for the Imperium, Andris's spirit was crushed, and he attempted to eke out a life for himself, his mother Maarva , and their droid B2EMO . At some point during its reign, the Imperium undertook an expansion effort known simply as the Imperial expansion . It was during this time that they constructed a military installation on the volcanic world of Nevarro . In 18 BVE, the Imperium arrived on the planet Aldhani due to its tactically useful place in space, liberating the Alkenzi Air Base and creating a dam over the sacred Nasma Klain river that served as a waypoint for weaponry and other supplies, including the quarterly payroll for the overall sector. Beginning an occupation, the Imperium displaced the local population of Dhanis over the course of the next ten years. Forcing the Dhani to the southern Lowlands , the Imperium established an Enterprise Zone of new Imperial housing and offered work in factories . To discourage Dhanis from traveling to the sacred Valley of Caves , the location of the Aldhani dam, to view the revered celestial event known as the " Eye of Aldhani " that happened every three years, the Imperium established an Imperial viewing festival in the Enterprise zone in 15 BVE .

#### Designing the ultimate weapon

title: Imperium
text:
#### Designing the ultimate weapon

> " You look at the history of any sentient species and what do you find but tableaux of violence and slaughter. It's finger painted on the ceilings of caves and engraved into the walls of temples. Dig a hole deep enough on any world and you'll find the skulls and bones of adults and children fractured by crude weapons. All of us were fighting long before we were farming and raising livestock…Violence is hardwired into most of us and there's no eliminating the impulse—not with an army of shock troopers or a fleet of Star Destroyers. That's why we've embarked on a path to a different solution. We have a chance to forge a peace that will endure longer than the Republic was in existence. " ―Orren Callan Vossik

title: Imperium
text: Having inherited the Republic Special Weapons Group , a top secret group headed by Professor Sahali tasked with top secret project and ordered by Mal to construct the deadly battle station from it's predecessor state, the Imperium reformed the Weapons Group into the Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research in which the Ultimate Weapon project was assigned and split into several smaller projects, with Project Celestial Power , a subproject tasked with the development of a superweapon for the battle station, being publicly presented as an initiative to fulfill Theron Mal's dream of sustainable energy independence to transform the Imperial economy and solidify Imperial authority. Lieutenant Commander Orren Callan Vossik , an Imperial officer who had been involved with the failed attempt at the Battle Station's construction, and had held an administrative post at the Institute of Applied Science on Vantor screening scientists for expertise on energy manipulation, materials science, and theoretical physics, was placed in charge of the program. Around this time the the outer rings were completed, with the Emperor performing an inspection shortly after, during which Vossik had the focusing array for what would eventually be the laser dish installed.

title: Imperium
text: In charge of the program, Vossik had the B'ankora relocated from the B'ankor Refuge on Vantor to allow the construction of a new research complex at the site, and seeing potential for the battle station's weapon in the crystallographer Galen Walton Arsa Kyber crystal research, offered the crystallographer a spot in the project, convincing him that the project was tasked with bringing sustainable energy to worlds ravaged by the replica wars, which Galen accepted. As Galen made progress on his research on Kyber crystals, Vossik began attempting to weaponize Galen's research at secret facilities on worlds such as Hypori and Malpaz , all while Galen and his family grew suspicious of Galen's work.

title: Imperium
text:
Despite Project Celestial Power being hit with a major accident when a facility on Malpaz exploded during a weaponization attempt and destroying the planet's capital city , Vossik eventually succeeded in weaponizing Galen's research with the successful test of prototype duel-laser weapon into a set of Black holes known as the Hero Twins . Yet despite the successful test, the project was once again set back when the team tasked with designing the full superlaser questioned their work and realized who's research was being used, forcing Vossik to "relocate" them. Not long after, Galen discovered the Imperial coverup and massacre, which all but confirmed something was wrong. With this information, Galen decided to run away with his family to Lah'mu , making Project Celestial Power stall until Vossik could locate the crystallographer. Grand Moff Varrix used the opportunity to give himself an overseeing position of the Ultimate Weapon Project, often stealing credit for Vossik's work and causing a bitter rivalry between him and Vossik.

#### Spread of the Imperium

title: Imperium
text:
#### Spread of the Imperium

> " For the first time in one thousand generations our sector governors will not be working solely to enrich Vantor and the Core Reaches, but to advance the quality of life in the star systems that make up each sector-keeping the spaceways safe, maintaining open and accessible communications, assuring that tax revenues are properly levied and allocated to improving the infrastructure. The Senate will likewise be made up of beings devoted not to their own enrichment, but to the enrichment of the worlds they represent. " ―An excerpt from the Varrix Doctrine As the Imperium grew, Mal moved closer to his ultimate plan of ruling the entire galaxy and unlocking the secrets of the Umbra Masters who had come before him. With the near extermination of the Aetheri Order and the Imperium swelling in size and strength, the Emperor ultimately planned to possess the powers of the umbra side to reshape reality itself into something of his own creation, and an omnipotent Imperium would allow all the galaxy's inhabitants to be held in his dark embrace. As Emperor, however, he largely disappeared from public life, leaving his public addresses to become more and more rare.

title: Imperium
text: While, in public, the Imperial system of sector governance was designed to improve and uplift life across the whole of the galaxy, the truth of the Imperium and its New Order was that it enforced a form of supposed "natural hierarchy," which uplifted life in the Core Reaches at the expense of those who lived further out across the stars. Planets at the edge of the galaxy suffered under Imperial rule while their resources and wealth were extracted and shipped towards the Core, particularly Vantor, which prospered under Imperial rule. Imperial leadership and their wealthy contemporaries enjoyed luxurious lifestyles. As most planets were ecologically devastated over the Imperial Era, rampant industrialization and mass-production eroded local culture and ecological health. People saw their children drafted into Imperial service, while corrupt governors and magistrates often exploited local populations on worlds such as Jelucan , Devaron and Tangenine . In 18 BVE , the Imperium conquered and occupied the planet Yar Togna , leading to much of its population fleeing as refugees in a mass exodus. At some point, the Mid Reach uprisings were launched by monarchies that refused to obey Mal's will. The revolts ended up as a series of chaotic conflicts that ended in Imperial victory: through the actions of Imperial Starfighter Pilots , the monarchies were forced to submit to the Emperor.

title: Imperium
text: Only a year after its founding, the Imperium had already begun to enforce itself in the Outer Reach. Worlds that did not fall to the Imperium's quick expansion, which installed an oppressive Imperial presence instead of simple bases, became homes to crime lords. In its effort to establish itself in the Outer Reach, in addition to using fear, the Imperium withheld food to make populations endure hunger. While the Imperium turned a blind eye to various abuses, it still maintained a policy of zero corruption and maintained its high standards of conduct, resulting in numerous Imperium Vigil Bureau (IVB) officials actively hunting down corrupt and negligent officials, even resulting in investigations by Lord Velgor himself. Despite this, many citizens were content with the geopolitical situation in the galaxy, believing that strict measures were necessary to maintain order and stability after the destructive Replica Wars. Many also believed that the Imperium, while not the best, was better than anarchy and chaos.

title: Imperium
text: Despite its seemingly endless expansion, such as on Raadan , where Imperial forces arrived to harvest food , which destroyed the quality of the moon's soil and led to a growing oppression. This angered the people of Raadan to the point where they staged an uprising after weeks of planning, with the help of ex- Adept Sela Marr and the forces of Imperial Senator Bael Solen in secret. A major turning point against the Imperium's advance into the Outer Reach occurred in 11 BVE , with Imperial forces commanded by Captain Raena Vexana engaging in a small skirmish in the vital Inner Reach system of Gorse .

title: Imperium
text:
This event saw the meeting of later insurgent Lena Kryll and Aetheri survivor Brenn Aldric , who were confronting efficiency expert Count Denetrius Vidian and his aggressive methods of extracting thorilide —a vital component in the construction of pulse lance batteries and thus essential for the expansion of the Imperial fleet. The Gorse Conflict ultimately ended with the transferring of local thorilide mining operations to Imperial-aligned Baron Lero Danthe , while Kryll and Aldric departed on the heavily modified VCX-100 light freighter Wisp , and would become essential to the eventual formation of the Free Coalition .

Meanwhile, more and more worlds within the Imperium began to realize its true intentions: After various massacres on Thornwood and increasingly brutal tactics, such as the Imperium committing genocide on the Lasat homeworld of Lasan , a growing number of citizens of the galaxy began to insurgent against Imperial dominion. At least nine years after the proclamation of the New Order , the Korrathi Coalition fought the Imperium from its headquarters on the planet Korrath . The Imperium would also end the independence of many galactic, sector and planetary governments in its early conquests.

#### Theft of the Carrion Spike

title: Imperium
text:
#### Theft of the Carrion Spike

> " You hear so many rumors. People are here one day, gone the next. And no one has laid eyes on the Emperor in months. Veldon, Dangor, and the rest of the Ruling Council have taken to dispatching processions of Imperial skylimos to maintain an illusion that the Emperor still moves about in public. You know they commissioned an enormous statue of the Emperor for the Senate—I mean, Imperial Plaza? So far, the thing looks more terrifying than majestic. " " Isn't that the idea, Nils? " ―Admiral Nils Tenant and Moff Wilhard Varrix discuss the Imperialization of Vantor

title: Imperium
text: In 14 BVE , after Mal had spent months on end out of the public eye, members of the Ruling Council, including Mazan Veldon and Ars Dangor, arranged for skylimos to move about Imperial City , creating the illusion of Mal moving amongst the populous. Furthermore, the ongoing Imperialization of the galaxy and even Vantor at that time resulted in, as Admiral Nils Tenant observing, personnel being "here on day, gone the next." Around the time, an enormous statue of the Emperor—which was regarded by Tenant as more terrifying than beautiful—was erected in Imperial Plaza, with Varrix arguing to Tenant that it was supposed to be scary, not majestic.

title: Imperium
text: Meanwhile, various survivors of the Antar Atrocity and other malcontents joined together under the leadership of the former Captain Berch Teller, who organized them into a insurgent cell intent on stalling the development of the Emperor's newest weapon under construction at Pyralis. After stealing the Carrion Spike , an advanced starship based on a prototype stealth corvette used during the Battle of Krestophis during the Replica Wars, the insurgents wreaked havoc across numerous star systems including Lucazec , Galidraan III and Nouane , all while transmitting holovids of their attacks on Imperial HoloNet frequencies, increasing anti-Imperial propaganda across thousands of Mid and Outer Reach star systems before the Imperium was able to shut down the communications grid.

title: Imperium
text: After lengthy fleet redeployments and the discovery of a mole within the Imperial ranks, Varrix, aboard the Imperial -class Iron Cruiser Executrix , disabled the insurgent warship and captured the dissidents after a brief battle and timely arrival of Star Destroyers Compliant and Enforcer . To reward Varrix's skill, the Emperor promoted him to the newly created rank of Grand Moff and gave him command of the Executrix as well as oversight of the Outer Reach Territories, all while the recent attacks on Imperial facilities were made to look like an elaborate plot to root out insurgent cells. The Imperium had effectively dealt with a potentially disastrous situation, rooted out a traitor and kept details regarding the development of its superweapon at Pyralis a mere rumor.

title: Imperium
text:
#### Outer Reach expansion

> " Good news has come to the citizens of Lorath. The Outer Reach planet has been granted the coveted opportunity to participate in the new Imperial Registration Program. " ― Alton Kastle , on the HoloNet News

Around fourteen years into Mal' rule as Emperor, the Imperium had continued its expansion into the Outer Reach. Worlds like Jelucan saw occupation and development, leading to rampant pollution and industrialization to support the Imperial war machine. One such world that was developed was Lorath , which joined the Imperial Registration Program seeking protection and economic opportunities whereby local citizens would find work in the local Sienar Fleet Systems facilities. Ostensibly this was to grow the local economy, but was in fact secretly part of a much larger five-year plan involving numerous Outer Reach worlds that was overseen by the Imperial Outer Reach High Command , a subdivision of Imperial High Command which was in charge of the Outer Reach Territories .

title: Imperium
text:
But the Imperium did not fully control the Outer Reach and often utilized its worlds instead as testing grounds for new biological weapons and as a source of cheap labor. Lorath's industrial importance soon came to the fore for the Imperium as the Emperor planned to further expand Imperial dominion over the Outer Reach Territories and beyond. In order to maximize the worth of newly occupied systems, worlds such as Lorath soon bore witness to Imperial authorities relocating farmers away from their farmlands to mine for Imperial purposes, leading to the development of re-settlement camps such as Tangletown and Lorath re-settlement camp 43 , known by the residents as "Tarkintown" after the Governor of the Outer Reach. The Imperium also limited the HoloNet across the Outer Reach, leading many dissatisfied systems to view the embargo as a part of the conquest of the Outer Systems. This aggressive dislocation of persons and high tax rate eventually led to the development of a small and localized, albeit serious upheaval against the Imperium on Lorath.

Upon landing, Vossik and six members of his guard of death troopers disembarked the shuttle and began traveling towards the homestead, while Galen, in an attempt to buy time for his wife Lyra and his daughter Jessa to escape, left the homestead and began to travel towards Vossik.

Around the same time, the Third Warden secretly arranged for the kidnapping of the adoptive daughter of Cindervale 's senator Bael Prestor Solen , Elira Solen , in an attempt to lure the Aetheri Master Orien Kade out of hiding following her discovery of a connection between Bael and Orien in the Aetheri Archives . As expected, Orien came out of hiding at the personal request of Bael, and traveling to Daiyu , the planet where Bael had tracked the mercenaries two kidnapped Elira to. As Orien travelled the streets of Daiyu, passing a pair of shock troopers while he did so, the Third Warden was confronted by the Grand Warden, accompanied by the Fifth Warden and the Fourth Warden. During the confrontation, the Grand Warden took control of the situation and the hunt for Kade before berating the third warden for kidnapping the daughter of an Imperial senator, despite the Third Warden's argument that the Warden Order had done worse. Additionally, the Grand Warden informed the Third Warden that she would be punished at a later time for stepping out of line. Despite this, the Third Warden once again defied her superiors by placing a bounty on the Orien's head with the intent to use bounty hunters and mercenaries to draw the Aetheri Master out.

title: Imperium

Not long after the confrontation, the Third Warden contacted Velgor, who was at his fortress on Emberfall , of the Aetheri's escape and of the Grand Warden's apparent death. In response, Velgor informed the Third Warden that if Kade was captured, the position of Grand Warden would be hers, but if she failed, she would not live to regret it. Shortly after, the Third Warden met up with the Fifth Warden and the Fourth Warden, instructing them to send out all remaining Probe droids at their disposal. Despite the Fifth Warden questioning the Third Warden's authority in the belief that he was next in line, the Fifth Warden obliged after the Third Warden explained that she had spoken with Velgor and it had been agreed.

Mining on Mapuzo

Having escaped to the planet Mapuzo but unable to find a contact, Orien and Elira convinced a passing Imperial mining transport driver by the name of Freck to take them to the nearest spaceport under the guise of being farmers from Tawl , which the Condluran agreed to. During the journey, Freck revealed himself to be a staunch supporter of the Imperium, before Freck stopped and offered a ride on his truck to a squad of traveling shock troopers , who accepted the ride. During the journey, the shock troopers questioned Orien and Elira over the occuptation and reason for being there, to which the pair lied to about being farmers visiting the homeworld of Elira's mother. Seemingly convinced, the troopers told the pair to report anything suspicious if they saw anything, before then disembarking after arriving near an Imperial facility , which the troops then walked to.

title: Imperium
text: Not long after, Freck stoped his vehicle at an Imperial checkpoint , and suspicious of the pair, reported the pair to the troopers stationed at the checkpoint. As a result, a shock trooper ordered Orien out of the vehicle, which he complied with, before then using a viper probe droid to scan Orien's face, informing the Warden Order of Orien's location and forcing the Aetheri to brandish his volt pistol and destroy the droid. In the resulting firefight, Ferrix and the troopers at the checkpoint fell, before a trio of shock troopers along with an Imperial officer arrived to aid in the firefight. However, Elira, who had made her way to a ship at the town's spaceport, was recaptured by the Imperium and brought to Fortress Warden Order . Infiltrating Fortress Warden Order

After being brought to Fortress Warden Order, Elira was brought to an interrogation cell, where the handcuffed princess told the shock troopers guarding her of her importance, though to little avail. Shortly thereafter, the Third Warden entered the room and told Elira that the Imperium did not tolerate Aetheri sympathizers, before sharing how the Wardens had uncovered the Hidden Path, before asking for Elira's help in finding the remaining members. In response, Elira asked how Kade died, to which the Third Warden stated he had been burned to death, claiming that that members of the Path had abandoned Kade, before offering to let Elira return to her family if she reveals where the Path is. title: Imperium
text: Soon after, Elira was brought to a torture chamber and fastened into a torture harness by a pair of shock troopers, before the Third Warden turned the torture machine on while giving the Princess one last chance to cooperate. During the meeting, Tala claimed that she was a spy for the Imperium in the Path and that the group was operating from Florrine in the Sertar sector , advising the Third Warden to send Imperial forces, but the Third Warden, after questioning how Elira and Kade had escaped an Imperial checkpoint on Mapuzo, ordered Tala to be apprehended. However, as Tala was captured, the fortress's klaxons went off as Kade, having defeated the shock trooper guards in the interrogation room and saved Elira, contacted Tala, distracting the shock troopers guarding her and allowing Tala to break free and defeat them with a volt pistol.

title: Imperium
text:
After working with an engineering officer , Vossik concluded that Gouge mining was required for the extraction of kalkite from Ghorman's crust, a process which was known to stress planet cores and as a result, required the Ghorman people . Through simulations involving Imperium Vigil Bureau Lieutenant Moy , repopulation tactics such as staging a natural disaster or deadly plague to get Ghorman's population to leave on their own accord was gamed out, leaving the complete suppression of the Ghorman people to silence coalition to repopulation and extraction efforts as the best option for the Imperium. As such, Vossik worked with Ministry of Enlightenment to begin the suppression of Ghorman , leading to ministry employees Dee Shambo and Nisus Osar arranging the death of an inspector in the Imperial Navy after months of Ghorman noncompliance with Naval inspections to stir Anti-Ghormanism sentiment in the galaxy's population. However, in the aftermath of the Naval inspector 's death the Imperial Ruling Council , including council members Ars Dangor and Sly Moore , had the Imperium blockade shipping lanes to Ghorman. As a result, the Ghorman people starved until the blockade was lifted on the order of the Imperial Senate once Senator Vela Sess rallied enough support for the Ghormans. Despite the blockade being lifted, Ghorman's senator Dasi Oran was faced with the harsh reality that, —as Ghorman had a single product economy that's export was Ghorman twill — essentials of survival were imported— and as such a similar crackdown could spell doom for his people.

### Combating the growing insurgency

title: Imperium
text:
### Combating the growing insurgency

#### Eye of Aldhani

> " We're treating what happened at Aldhani like a robbery." "What would you call it?" "An announcement. " ―IVB Supervisor Meero and IVB Attendant Heert

By 5 BVE , the Imperium had made plans for the expansion of the Aldhani dam involving the enslavement of many Dhanis , with Engineering officer Colonel Soden Petigar placed in charge of overseeing the next steps. Despite the Imperial-supported viewing event in the Enterprise Zone drawing many Dhanis away from viewing the revered celestial event known as the " Eye of Aldhani " in the the sacred Valley of Caves , the site of the Aldhani dam, some Dhanis persisted in traveling to the valley. For those Dhanis that still decided to make the ten-day trek to the valley of caves, the Imperium's Aldhani Garrison , under the command of commandant Jayhold Beehaz and aware that the Dhanis would refuse, offered transport to the valley from the Lowlands and established Comfort Units along the route, convincing many to abandon the long journey and eventually dwindling the number of pilgrims from five hundred to around sixty.

title: Imperium
text: That same year, Colonel Petigar visited the dam to inspect it for the expansion project, which commandant Beehaz viewed as a way off Aldhani for him and his family . Around that time, Skree/LN space superiority starfighters from Alkenzi Air Base , an airbase located fifty-two klicks from the Aldhani dam, performed patrol flights across Aldhani 's Highlands , with one starfighter passing but not spotting the insurgent freedom fighters Vel Sartha and Kassian Andris . Later, another another Imperial pilot performed a flyby in their SKREE fighter past what they thought was a farm ,  which in reality, was a camp serving as a base of operations for the group of insurgents Andris and Sartha were a part of, which planned to steal the quarterly payroll of Imperial troops in the Cademimu sector stored at the Aldhani dam. During the planning stages of the heist, one of the team's members, Karis Nemik , wrote a maniesto that would later be spread galaxy -wide in which Nemik theorized that the Imperium's need for control was unnatural, its authority was brittle, its oppression was the mask of fear, and as a result, soon enough, the Imperium would be overrun with defiance

On the eve of the Eye of Aldhani, the Imperial officers discussed the Dhani's arrival and the plans for the dam, before the group of Imperial officers went down to the Dhanis to trade a hide with a Dhani chieftain , which the Imperium believed to be a way of "leasing" the land from the Dhanis. Shortly afterward, the insurgent group, with the help of disgruntled Imperial Lieutenant Gorn , infiltrated the Aldhani dam while disguised as Imperial security troopers and took the Imperial command at the dam and Beehaz's family hostage. While being taken hostage, Colonel Petigar attempted to free Beehaz's son , but was ultimately unsuccessful and was instead shot to death. Holding both the Beehaz and his family at gunpoint in separate locations, Beehaz was the forced to open the vault holding the Imperial payroll as the dam's comms shut down, before the insurgent team then had the Imperial staff on the deck load the payroll into the Box freighter parked in the dam.

We know the real shock will be when they discover how ready and eager we are to respond, to be prepared, to be here this morning and know that the only question we need to answer is how tight to close our fist. This is why we plan. This is why we work so hard when we're at peace. This is why we recruit so carefully and demand so much. " ―Wulric Yular

title: Imperium
text: In the immediate aftermath of the Aldhani heist , Imperium Vigil Bureau Major Lio Partagaz ordered that the IVB'S Investigations branch prepare every Star Sector and Planetary Emergency Retaliation plan by the coming midnight. As they prepared the plans, Director of the IVB Wulric Yular met with Theron Mal to discuss how to proceed. In the end, measures of a tax equivalent to five times what was stolen from Aldhani for any Sector found to be harboring insurgents and the permanent revocation of Imperial tolerance for any custom or festival used as a cover for insurgent activity were adopted Imperium-wide. Additionally, two bills were introduced by the Emperor to the Imperial Senate and easily passed— the Imperial Emergency Act , which gave IVB agents the authority to request personnel, data, and material support from the Imperial Military — and the Public Order Resentencing Directive , which saw all criminal sentenced reevaluated, all outstanding fines and levies ordered to be pain in full immediately, and all offenses towards the Imperium, both direct and indirect, to be treated as a class one offense under the Imperial Penal Code . The related information was communicated to the IVB Board by Yular directly the
