Alongside Drayden, Karrick, Brevok, Bolt-3, and Astra-9, Solen led a mission on the Imperial factory world of Cymoon 1 , where they would infiltrate and destroy Weapons Factory Alpha . After capturing a shuttle whose passenger was an emissary of Grukk the Grak sent to negotiate with the Imperium on shipping raw materials from Grak-controlled space to Imperial facilities, Solen and Drayden disguised themselves as bodyguards to escort Karrick (who, they agreed, would pose as the envoy) with Bolt-3 into the factory. Greeted by Overseer Aggadeen , they entered the facility only to reveal themselves as insurgents and incapacitate Aggadeen's shock troopers, with the Overseer revealing the power core's location before Solen knocked him out as well.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Once the four made their way to the central power station, Solen, Karrick, and Bolt-3 rigged the power core. As they awaited Drayden's return, Solen thanked the Korrathi smuggler for taking such a risk for the Alliance yet questioned Karrick about whether he had an ulterior motive for doing so. Their conversation was interrupted by Drayden's arrival with Imperial slaves. Though Solen was unsure of Drayden's decision and determination to have the slaves escape with them, Karrick accepted it and prompted them to escape the facility as soon as possible.

When they were alerted by Brevok of Velgor's arrival, Solen ordered the Vorak to kill the Dark Lord of the Umbra even at the expense of them, blaming him for Cindervale's destruction. However, Velgor sensed danger and protected himself from Brevok's shot, putting the entire moon on alert of their presence. Completely surrounded and having lost contact with Brevok, they came across a hangar , and, though Solen noticed Drayden's absence, she and Karrick procured an All Terrain Armored Transport walker for themselves, just as Drayden engaged Velgor in combat .

title: Elira Solen
text:
Once outside, their walker only received more volt pistol fire; Solen, then, realized the Imperials had stopped the reactor's meltdown, and Velgor caught up with them and destroyed the walker's legs with his flux blade , throwing it off. From the rubble, Solen carried Karrick and led the slaves to safety, when Drayden met with her and told her he would finish their mission. Disobeying Solen's orders, Drayden used his stolen speeder bike to destroy the power core. Soon enough, they made their way to the Corsair Wing and barely escaped with their lives. On the ship, she thanked Drayden for completing the mission, trying to encourage him, but his morale was at rock bottom. Before long, the Corsair rendezvoused with the Insurgent fleet.

#### An estranged wife

> " And here I thought one Karrick was bad. Now I get to listen to two of them. Lucky me. " ―Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### An estranged wife

> " And here I thought one Karrick was bad. Now I get to listen to two of them. Lucky me. " ―Elira Solen

Solen met with the rest of the Alliance High Command and expressed her desire to continue the offensive against the Imperium; however, Vorian and Sess dissuaded Solen from her course of action since they believed she was overtaxing her team. The princess next met with Drayden, who asked her to let him (and Bolt-3) go to Dunemere in search of Kade's home . Later, Karrick inquired about several parts needed to repair his ship, but Solen told him that he needed to work to obtain what he wanted—offering him a mission to be her copilot while they scouted for possible locations for the new Alliance base. Aboard a stolen Vectis -class shuttle , the Invictus , they had a run-in with a pair of SKREE fighters , and Karrick piloted the Invictus to an unnamed planet near the Monsua Nebula .

title: Elira Solen
text: Upon landing, Solen followed Karrick to one of his smuggling dens, where he offered the princess some Korrathi wine to celebrate their survival. Solen, however, misinterpreted his gesture and refused to drink the wine, stormily leaving the den at once. As Karrick followed suit, claiming he would rather seduce a gundark , the Volt Cobra arrived; Sana Starric disembarked and revealed herself to be Karrick's estranged wife, much to Solen's shock. Though Karrick tried to explain, Starric recognized Solen (and the bounty on her head) and had the Invictus destroyed with her ship's voice-activated weaponry. Holding the two at gunpoint, Starric contacted the Iron Cruiser above them to negotiate Solen's bounty, while Karrick tried to convince her to let them go. However, Solen had other plans—pushing Karrick against Starric, taking her by surprise, she drew a concealed EC-17 volt pistol from her clothes to aim it at both "Solos." With the SKREE fighters and SKREE/sa bombers already above them, and Imperial pilots closing in to arrest her, Solen resisted, whereas Karrick confessed he was also an Insurgent (and so, bound to be captured), prompting Starric to take the two to her ship to escape the planet. While in hyperspace , Solen contacted the Alliance, and was informed of Drayden's captivity on Nar Shaddaa . She convinced Starric to transport them to the moon, by agreeing to let her recover her "husband" once they reached the "Smuggler's Moon." Karrick disliked the deal and confronted Solen about it, but she refused to listen to his explanation.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Upon arrival at Nar Shaddaa, they located Astra-9 and Brevok, who had engaged the bounty hunter Dengrik after refusing to reveal Karrick's location. Outgunned by Solen and Karrick, Dengrik was defeated when Brevok threw him off the roof; thus, they carried on with their original objective: to free Drayden from Grukkar the Grak . Solen, Karrick, Brevok, and Starric made their way to Grukkar' palace arena , and realized their volt pistols had been disabled by an EMP charge, Imperials were swarming the place and a beast was wreaking havoc. Separated from Starric, they instead found Bolt-3, who provided them with flux blades; they promptly used the weapons to reach Drayden at the center of the arena. However, instead of reuniting with him, Solen sought Starric and rescued her from under a pile of rubble. Starric then explained she was not Karrick's real wife, and the two women reached an understanding before escaping Nar Shadda.

#### Eneb Ray's infiltration

> " If this fails, we'll have no agents left on Vantor. This is an enormous risk. " " So was Cinderfall. " ―Elira Solen and Eneb Ray

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Eneb Ray's infiltration

> " If this fails, we'll have no agents left on Vantor. This is an enormous risk. " " So was Cinderfall. " ―Elira Solen and Eneb Ray

Sometime after the Battle of Cinderfall, Solen sent insurgent spy Eneb Ray to Vantor to infiltrate the Imperial Senate, pretending to be the senator Tharius Demo. After he uploaded shipping and procurement data for the Core sectors to the insurgency, he contacted Elira via hologram. She gave him the mission to extract Nadea Tural and other insurgent-sympathetic senators from Arrth-Eno Prison Complex and prevent them from being executed. After the conversation ended, Ray made his way to the prison complex on Vantor. After breaking in, Eneb found the prisoners, who informed him that the Emperor would be coming to the complex.

title: Elira Solen
text:
However, Imperial enforcer Karbin arrived with a fleet and destroyed the Amber Wing. Karbin himself went to the encounter of Solen and Velgor and proceeded to duel each other. Solen used the opportunity to escape from their reach into the Aetheri Sanctum and waited to get a clear shot. However, Astra-9 called her through the comlink and informed her that Karrick, Brevok, and Drayden were in trouble. Confronted with their loss, she left Velgor and Karbin to their devices. Instead, Solen located the Corsair Wing and found Karrick, Drayden, the droids, and Brevok cornered by Velgor's ally, Dr. Vexa . As she had implemented a minefield of micro- mines to trap them, Solen snuck up to her and knocked her out with a punch. With Vexa captured, Solen ordered all remaining Insurgent forces to evacuate the planet; then, they boarded the Corsair and escaped.

#### Defending Sunspot Prison

> " I want you to know... I won't give up on you. I'll get you help you need, Eneb. Whether you want it or not. " ―Elira Solen to Eneb Ray

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Defending Sunspot Prison

> " I want you to know... I won't give up on you. I'll get you help you need, Eneb. Whether you want it or not. " ―Elira Solen to Eneb Ray

After weeks of interrogation and four escape attempts, Solen and Starric brought Doctor Vexa to the Sunspot Prison , a Free Coalition penitentiary. Solen, Starric, and the prison's warden debated about how to interrogate the new prisoner. Meanwhile, a team led by former insurgent spy Eneb Ray made their way into the prison, attacking the guards. This was reported to the warden, as well as Elira and Sana.

title: Elira Solen
text: Solen and Starric engaged the invading droid forces, destroying many of them. Elira contacted the control room, wanting to know if they were given an all clear. However, instead of a response from the warden, Eneb Ray responded. He had taken over the control room and was holding the warden hostage. He proceeded to send IG-RM droids to execute prisoners. Solen disabled them, but not before they opened fire. Afterwards, Ray released other prisoners, forcing Solen and Starric to engage them. After fighting many of the prisoners, Elira placed them in a single cell. Ray deactivated the sun shields in that cell, incinerating all the prisoners within it. Ray continued to make threats. Because of this, Solen freed Doctor Vexa, needing her to help retake the prison.

title: Elira Solen
text: Soon after being freed, Vexa began to reprogram one of the enforcer droids while it was attacking Starric. Solen disabled it before it could kill the smuggler. After a brief argument, the three continued to make their way through the cell blocks. Meanwhile, Ray was personally going to cells and killing the inmates, revealing the truth about Theron Mal to one inmate. Vexa, Sana, and Elira finally reached the control room and engaged the droids defending it. The trio, as well as the enforcer droid that Doctor Vexa reprogrammed, managed to retake the control room. Meanwhile, Dax Karrick and Joren Drayden arrived on the base in the Corsair Wing , only to be captured by Ray.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Sana, Vexa, and Elira managed to find Ray with the captured Drayden and Karrick. Ray had wrapped the duo in thermal detonators and threatened to kill them unless Elira shot Doctor Vexa. He then proceeded to reveal his identity, which had been previously hidden. Having thought him dead, Elira was surprised. Solen had Bolt-3 activate an ion pulse, which took out the prison's gravity, as well as the trigger to the thermal detonators. Ray and Solen began fighting in midair. Through the combined efforts of Elira, Vexa, and Sana, Ray was defeated and arrested.

Afterwards, the remaining staff and prisoners were evacuated. However, Doctor Vexa escaped, thanks to the indifference of Solen and Starric. As Ray was escorted in binders, Elira told him that she hadn't given up on him. However, Ray was so broken mentally that he told her that the insurgents had no chance of winning, and that she would eventually wish she had listened to him.

#### Temporary outpost

> " It's absolute chaos in here, Joren. We're still trying to get on our feet here and one of our cargo vessels is still missing . " ―Elira Solen to Joren Drayden

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Temporary outpost

> " It's absolute chaos in here, Joren. We're still trying to get on our feet here and one of our cargo vessels is still missing . " ―Elira Solen to Joren Drayden

Sometime later the Free Coalition established a temporary outpost by the name of LX-Robynsun V on the Outer Reach planet Reamma . The Alliance was still adjusting to the new outpost when a cargo vessel went missing. Elira assigned Drayden to double back and search for it, as it was carrying vital medical supplies and other cargo. However, as Drayden and Bolt-3 prepared the search, the cargo vessel arrived, cancelling the mission.

#### Hijacking of the Harbinger

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Hijacking of the Harbinger

Solen and Drayden attended a meeting with Jan Dodonna, Gial Vorian, and Vela Sess aboard a medical frigate . Vorian reported that the planet of Tureen VII was under siege from the Imperium. The planet had been providing aid to the insurgency secretly, and it was considered time for the Alliance to repay their debts to Tureen VII. The high-ranking members noted that the planet had come under a blockade, with the people of the world starving. After three attempts to break through the Imperial blockade failed, Drayden and Solen came up with the idea to steal an Iron Cruiser to infiltrate the blockade and provide relief to the people of Tureen VII. Although General Dodonna was initially hesitant, due to the large crew needed for operating such a vehicle, Elira asked for as much crew as could be spared. Due to the high rank of Solen and Drayden, they were given permission to go through with this mission.

title: Elira Solen
text: After the meeting, Elira took the Corsair Wing , along with Dax Karrick, Brevok, Sana Starric, Bolt-3, and Astra-9 to attack the Iron Cruiser known as the Harbinger . Joren took the pilots of Red Squadron to also engage in the assault. The Corsair was used to fire proton bombs at an area near the Destroyer's main engine reactor. Red Three , Torb Rask, also fired torpedoes towards the main engine reactor. Although the shots hit their mark, the reactor did not overload. Drayden then flew into the main engine reactor causing it to overload. The Imperial crew of the Iron Cruiser abandoned the ship, giving the crew of the Corsair Wing the opportunity to capture it. The ship flew into the Destroyer's hangar, with the crew of the Corsair attacking the ship from the inside. Meanwhile, Drayden secured the reactor room as the sentients made their way there. As a space battle raged outside, an explosion came from the Harbinger , making the Imperium think it had been destroyed.

title: Elira Solen
text:
A week afterwards, a patrol of two SKREE fighters briefly spotted the stolen Iron Cruiser but were quickly destroyed. Drayden noted that the Imperium may have known their location. However, Solen stated that if the government had known, there would have been more ships sent. At the time, the Destroyer was running on its secondary reactor and had no captain. Karrick and Solen argued about who was to be the captain. Drayden attempted to calm the duo by telling them of the situation at hand, noting that it would most likely be the last flight of the Harbinger .

Days later, a reactor overload was becoming more and more likely. Joren, Bolt-3, and Brevok were attempting to fix the issue as quickly as possible. However, an explosion occurred, and the astromech droid jettisoned the reactor, allowing the Iron Cruiser to go to hyperspace. Dax noted that the group had officially stolen their own Iron Cruiser, with Elira responding that the hard part was yet to come.

title: Elira Solen
text: After the Harbinger got out of hyperspace, the engines died. Brevok attempted to fix the backup reactor trying to get the Destroyer to Tureen VII. Karrick attempted to order the crew to change course to the Monsua Nebula to give the crew more time to fix it. However, Solen ordered the crew to belay that order, knowing that the people of Tureen VII were dying and there was not enough time to stop and make repairs. The duo continued to argue about the merits of their ideas and who should be temporary captain of the ship. Karrick proposed a race to the bridge of the Destroyer to determine who was to be the captain. Although Elira seemed to think that was a bad idea, she kicked Karrick in the shin to give herself a head start.

title: Elira Solen
text: Afterwards, Karrick noted that the Iron Cruiser's hyperrelay, backup reactor, shields, and ion cannons were all malfunctioning in some form, calling the Harbinger "the worst Iron Cruiser in the entire galaxy." Solen wanted to know the status of the ion cannons, asking the Destroyer's maintenance team what the status was. Because the team had gone missing, a group led by Joren and Sana went to check it out. Dax still wanted the Harbinger to stop for repairs, but considering all the options, Elira pressed on. Noting that the situation was ludicrous, Solen told Karrick that she wanted him as the Destroyer's helmsman, calling him "the craziest pilot in the galaxy."

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Escape from Skorii-Lei

> " Insurgency is an idea bigger than any of us, it has to be to inspire. It is alive. Only as strong as its weakest link. What matters is that it survives us, that is grows beyond us. " ―Elira Solen to Pash Davane

During the Galactic Civil War, Solen ended up injured and unconscious on the aquatic planet of Skorii-Lei . The engineer-turned-janitor Pash Davane took in the wounded princess and considered what to do with her. After returning from her area's fish market , Davane was attacked by Elira with her droid Bruce 's arm. Elira threatened Pavane with a deactivated volt pistol to determine why she was there. The janitor revealed that she stitched up some of Solen's wounds, and in turn Elira revealed that she was transporting information vital to the Alliance. Although the two disagreed on ideological grounds, Pavane agreed to help Solen escape through the planet's oceans.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Sometime later, the two had put on wetsuits and prepared to leave when shock trooper's arrived at Pash's house. Pash distracted and knocked out the soldiers and the duo escaped into the city. Hiding in a random house, Elira collapsed from her wounds. There, she and Pash discussed what motivated the former to fight the Imperium despite all the loss she endured. Although ready to give Pash the data tape with vital Alliance information, Davane convinced her to continue into the water. Pursued by security forces underwater, the duo managed to escape and rendezvous with Drayden, Karrick, and Brevok. Elira was able to recover on the Corsair Wing and managed to convince Pash to join the insurgency.

#### The matter of Astra-9's capture

After Astra-9 was captured by SCAR Squadron, Karrick, Drayden, and Elira regrouped with the insurgent fleet and decided not to go after him because he was a droid and SCAR Squadron was too dangerous. However, Bolt-3 rebelled against this and went on a solo mission of his own to rescue his old friend.

#### The Screaming Citadel

title: Elira Solen
text: As the group prepared to depart, Starric informed them of the Queen of Ktath'atn 's yearly meetings with visitors to exchange organic oddities. After realizing what may become of Drayden, the trio began the journey to Ktath'atn in the Corsair Wing . However, upon arriving, they were immediately captured by Vexa's droid associates 0-0-0 and VT-1 . However, the droids spared the insurgents, and they reluctantly gave Karrick permission to pilot Vexa's ship, the Ark Angel II , to Vexa and Drayden's location . When they arrived, the archaeologist and the Adept were fleeing from mutated creatures. Starric attempted to shoot Vexa, but Solen and Drayden prevented her from doing so. Solen threatened Drayden with a court-martial if he disobeyed orders again. She then asked the group which way to go, to which Karrick responded, "Any direction away from them !" The insurgent group held off the Queen's hive and entered a room filled with what Vexa identified as Abersyn symbiotes . Vexa found some blueprints for the Citadel and asked Drayden to follow her. However, the rogue archaeologist led Drayden, and the rest of the insurgents, into a trap for the Queen and her hive. The Queen took mental control of Drayden and Karrick, while Vexa allowed the rest of the group to escape.

title: Elira Solen
text: Solen immediately began formulating a plan to rescue them, asking Vexa's droid associates to assist her. 0-0-0 came up with the idea to transport an Abersyn symbiote in the dome of Drayden's droid S4. Elira reluctantly agreed to his plan. VT-1 used explosive missiles to blow a hole in the room they were in, and the group made their escape. They encountered Bombinax , the Queen's lieutenant, beating Vexa's Vorak associate Zazzik . Solen shot at Bombinax to distract him and "save" Zazzik. The group made their way inside the citadel and sealed the door. 0-0-0 immediately began performing a surgery on Zazzik to transplant the symbiote into his body, much to Elira's chagrin. By the time Bombinax broke through the sealed door, the symbiote had made its way into Zazzik's consciousness and easily dispatched him.

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Surviving in the wild

> " We've got more than enough life left in us to land. I'm taking us down onto this planet. " ―Joren Drayden, to Elira Solen During a mission with Drayden, he had to pilot into a nebula to get away from Skrees hunting them. The nebula disabled the ship, forcing them to crash on an ocean planet . There they had to survive in the wild on an island . Drayden's experience with machinery such as moisture vaporators helped keep them alive. But they had to use the dedlanite from their volt pistols for the moisture vaporators and thus couldn't use their volt pistols for hunting. One night, Solen and Drayden lay on the ground looking up to the sky full of stars. Cindervale was still visible, as the light from the explosion hadn't reached this part of the galaxy. Later, there was an explosion in the ocean, and up to the beach came a native species of the planet. They followed the creatures back into the water and saw that the Imperium were destroying their underwater worlds in search of Solen and Drayden. So, they lit a great fire on the beach to attract the Imperium's attention. Up from the waters came an Ironclad Walker and shoretroopers . Solen and Drayden managed to fight them off and take over their Ironclad Walker. After disabling

title: Elira Solen
text:
their underwater worlds in search of Solen and Drayden. So, they lit a great fire on the beach to attract the Imperium's attention. Up from the waters came an Ironclad Walker and shoretroopers . Solen and Drayden managed to fight them off and take over their Ironclad Walker. After disabling the Ironclad Walker, they repaired the shuttle and returned to the Insurgent Fleet. #### Potential Odona Base

> " You don't owe me anything, Dax. In the Alliance, we don't keep a tally of debts! And we don't blame others when our choices turn out poorly. We make the best of it--together. " ―Elira Solen to Dax Karrick

Sometime later, Dax Karrick led Elira to the remote world of Odona while searching for a new location for a insurgent base. However, as their mission went on, the duo found themselves lost in the caves of the hostile planet, chased by a six-legged creature . Karrick saved the duo by shooting the ceiling of the cave, separating them from the creature. Solen was disappointed by Karrick's lack of knowledge of the planet he purported to know so much about. As the duo bickered in their usual way, a trio of bounty hunters began shooting at them, wanting to collect Karrick's bounty. The duo became separated, with an injured Dax ending up back in the caves while Elira returned to the Corsair Wing . The hunters, led by Frax , a Niktal with a vendetta against Karrick, pursued him into the caves.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Meanwhile, Solen armed herself and searched for Karrick in the caves. After rescuing Karrick, an angry and wounded Frax killed his two partners for wanting to leave Karrick alone. All made their way out to the snowy landscape. Elira decided to seal the other entrance of the cave and in response, Frax shot her, causing her to pass out. Sometime afterwards, Brevok and Alliance soldiers rescued her and Karrick; Frax had frozen to death. As they recovered in a medical frigate, Karrick told Solen that he intended to repay the life debt that he owed her for saving his life on the mission, to which she said that he didn't owe her anything.

#### Return to Horox III

> " This is war . " ―Elira Solen to Joren Drayden, Dax Karrick, and Sana Starric

Solen, Drayden, Karrick, Starric, Astra-9, and Bolt-3 returned to the insurgent outpost on Horox III just to find it all burned down with no survivors. On a wall, "Greetings from SCAR Squadron. Long live the Imperium" in Aurebesh was written.

#### The ashes of Embermoor

title: Elira Solen
text:
Solen, Drayden, Karrick, Starric, Astra-9, and Bolt-3 returned to the insurgent outpost on Horox III just to find it all burned down with no survivors. On a wall, "Greetings from SCAR Squadron. Long live the Imperium" in Aurebesh was written.

#### The ashes of Embermoor

On Embermoor , Solen and the Corsair Wing rescued Drayden and a few Partisans and traveled to Embermoor , where they took shelter. There, Solen discussed with Ubin Des , former member of the Insurgency, about assisting the Partisans in stopping the Imperium from mining the rest of the kyber crystals from Embermoor.

Solen, Drayden, and Karrick were brought before the Tognath named Benthic , once Torrik Vess 's second in command and now the leader of the Partisans. They all had to wear bags over their heads so they wouldn't know where the Partisans' base was located. Solen proposed that the Insurgency would help the Partisans defend Embermoor by giving them supplies. After much hesitation, Benthic stated that they needed the Insurgents' support and agreed.

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Baraan-Fa and Saltmark

During the Imperium's attack on the Insurgent fleet , Solen worked with Sess to find a viable location for a new base. She and Sess agreed on Baraan-Fa and ordered the fleet there. Once there, Solen and Sess continued to search for a new location for their base. Solen suggested Sabanash 's wetlands or the Moon of Ooloponi . She asked Sess for a squadron to see if Saltmark would be suitable for a base. Sess was skeptical about Saltmark's status as a dead planet, but Solen told her that Trusk Berinato assured her and her father that Saltmark's mines would be ideal for the Insurgents. Sess agreed to Solen's request.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Solen took her team, Red Squadron , and the Corsair Wing to Saltmark with equipment. Upon their arrival, Solen met with Berinato and was given a tour of the mines. Following the tour, Solen had a drink with Berinato and told him that it was premature to believe the Insurgents would use the mines as a base. She knew Berinato had dealings with the Imperium and had shock troopers on standby. She tried to convince Berinato to do the right thing, but he refused. Solen, Karrick, and Red Squadron used V-4X-D ski speeders against SCAR squadron. After dealing with SCAR squadron, Organ was confronted by Berinato, who attempted to capture Solen, but she was able to shoot his volt pistol out of his hand. She and the others left Saltmark and some of their equipment. Solen informed Sess of this.

#### Mutiny on Mon Calvarra

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Mutiny on Mon Calvarra

Solen, her team, and Admiral Vorian to Mon Calvarra to meet with Grand Admiral Dors Urtya , Mon Calvarra's regent and commander of its Mercantile Fleet . They landed on an island in a nature preservation zone, but their meeting was interrupted by shock trooper patrol and an Imperial gunship . Despite that, Solen and the others were able to lose the shock troopers and rendezvous at a boat. Solen asked Urtya to give the Alliance their fleet to defeat the Imperium. However, Urtya refused to let the fleet join the Alliance due to the Imperium's continuing occupation of Mon Calvarra .

Solen, her team, and Vorian left Mon Calvarra on the Corsair Wing and went to the Mako-Ta Space Docks . There, Solen contacted Triova and asked her for information on the Imperial prison system to rescue King Liarch . She then prepared a report and attended a meeting of the Insurgent High Council, where she informed them of Urtya's refusal to support the Alliance. However, Solen suggested rescuing King Liarch. Despite concerns from Sess and General Davits Draven , Solen convinced them to agree to her mission.

title: Elira Solen
text: Solen and her team went to the Dex Acquisitions Depot on the planet Meor Ain , which she got inside by posing as a prisoner of Brevok, who was pretending to be a bounty hunter named "Violent Bok." There, they searched for the Gloamite actor Tunga Arpagin . When they entered his cell to free him, Solen was stunned to see him impersonating her father. Knowing it was Arpagin, Solen punched the Gloamite in the face for his trick. They stunned Arpagin and brought him aboard the Corsair Wing , where Solen convinced Arpagin to aid them in their mission by impersonating Moff Tan Hubi , whose bio-signature would allow them access to the prison to free the captive King. Then, Solen explained her plan, which was to attend an opera on Mon Calvarra where Hubi would be attending, where they would kidnap Hubi and have Arpagin double the Moff at the party while they took the real Moff to free Liarch.

title: Elira Solen
text: Solen sent Bolt and Astra-9 in as server droids to give Hubi a drug in his favorite drink, a grabd accelerator . She then watched Drayden, Karrick, and Brevok as they snuck through the ventilation and kidnapped Moff Hubi from the refresher at the Moncaladrome . After Arpagin took the Moff's place, Solen and her team left the Moncaladrome and went to the planet Strokill Prime . Solen, the captive Hubi, and her crew traveled in a submersible to the Imperial base . Avoiding sea monsters, they arrived at the facility and infiltrated it using codes from Triova but found King Liarch imprisoned and on life support. Solen talked with Liarch, regretfully informing him of Raddik' death and pleading him to pledge to them the Mon Calvarra Mercantile Fleet to support the Insurgency. Liarch was eager to help but admitted he could not move because of all the machines he was hooked up to. Drayden hunted down a camera droid where Liarch's message to his people will be recorded. However, Hubi clicked a button on the wall that alerted Imperial forces that the Moff Hubi on Mon Calvarra was an impostor. Shock troopers stormed into the cell, killing Liarch as he finished his message and accidentally killing Moff Hubi. Solen led the crew back to their ship, barely escaping the planet.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Velgor quickly destroyed Willard's flagship Cinderfall's Hope . Triova fled back to her ship and ordered her men to launch, but a insurgent strike team led by Solen and Colonel Bandwin Cor boarded her ship, killing her men. Triova managed to get to an escape pod and told Solen to forgive her, saying she would do anything to ensure that Shu-Torun would not become the next Cindervale before escaping.

Solen watched as ships commanded by Lajaie and Bob Hudsol were destroyed. Eventually, the insurgents found an override to the closed bay doors and Solen again looked on as Drayden led the newly minted Renegade Squadron to combat the enemy. Then, a insurgent technician broke into Triova' files and discovered an override code that would make all their systems operational again. However, the codes were only on the Sovereign . Solen devised a plan, in which she and Draven would lead a squad of Special Forces commandos to the Sovereign , in Triova' shuttle for disguise, to steal the codes and return to the ship.

title: Elira Solen
text: As the group gets clearance to land on the Sovereign , Velgor returns to the ship to meet with Triova. In the hangar, the insurgents killed the Imperial officer who greeted them, but are soon faced by Velgor. The insurgents fled and attempted to access a computer inside, where they obtained the codes while the rearguard was caught by Velgor. Solen led their remaining forces to the hangar to find a ship to escape, but they found only a lone SKREE fighter. Draven then told Solen that he and the special forces would stay behind to let her escape with the codes. She flew back in the stolen SKREE, but Drayden got on her tail and tried to shoot her down. Unable to communicate with them because she did not have a SKREE pilot helmet, Solen demonstrated her loyalties by shooting down another SKREE. Drayden deduced it was a friendly and ordered Renegade Squadron to form up on him and protect the SKREE. They landed on the MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser Republic . Solen alerted the commander of the ship, General Dodonna of the codes she obtained, and their ship escaped the system.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Solen and Drayden were both shocked to hear Dodonna tell them that they could not risk their ship to go back and attempt to rescue their remaining forces. They eventually convinced him to go help, with the Republic serving as a distraction to allow Solen to lead a group of shuttles to rescue forces off the Space Docks. With the losses sustained by the Alliance leadership, Motham contacted Solen to promote her to the rank of general.

#### Saponza's Gang

> " I am Princess Elira Solen of the Free Coalition. I do hope you haven't been fooled by the Imperium's propoganda. Vital medical supplies are being hoarded off-world at a Cartel Den. For this mission, and some others, heroes of the Insurgency will assist you. " ―Princess Elira Solen, recruiting Saponza's forces to aid in a mission to Dandoran

title: Elira Solen
text:
Solen was responsible for recruiting Saponza's Gang to the Alliance. Working with Karrick, Sess, Jennica Pierce , and the criminal underworld, the gang successfully rescued former Senator Johhar Kessen from Imperial custody. They also disrupted Kosh 's contraband smuggling operation, and liberated Dunemere from Imperial control. Following the gang's final victory at Fort Ironhand , Solen sent the gang a congratulatory holo message.

#### Lotho Minor investigation

> " I think I'm ready to give up on this planet now. " ―Elira Solen #### Lotho Minor investigation

> " I think I'm ready to give up on this planet now. " ―Elira Solen

At some point, Elira, Dax, Joren, Brevok, Astra-9 were sent by the Alliance to Restore the Republic to investigate the planet Lotho Minor for a new base. When they arrived, Karrick disparaged the planet and teased Solen, to which she retorted that the Millenium Corsair fit in on the garbage planet. Refusing to give up on the planet and ignoring Karrick's complaints about strategy, they continued investigating until they ran into native droids and a male Kessith named Akar Duel . Duel, wanting to take the Corsair , had the droids pull their volt pistols on Solen and the others. After the droids turned on Duel once they learned from Astra-9 that they could be independent, they boarded the Corsair to leave the planet, Solen concluding that Lotho Minor was not a good location for a insurgent base.

#### Bogara

title: Elira Solen
text:
### End of the Emperor's reign

#### A new base

> " Listen, I know we've all been spread pretty thin, but we've made it through. It's okay to feel tired. It's okay to feel weak. It doesn't erase the hero I see in each and every one of you. While we wait for better days, remember, you're not alone. The day we forget we have each other…is the day we lose. " ―Princess Elira Solen Roughly three years after the Battle of Cinderfall, Solen helped oversee the construction of the Insurgency's recently established Icehold on the ice planet of Frostmark . When Kes Vale and Shara Bey became trapped while carving out an ice tunnel for with an Arrow laser cannon, Solen spoke to them after their rescue by Heroes of Cinderfall Joren Drayden and Brevok, reaffirming their value as fellow Insurgents. Present at the base was also a new insurgent recruit named Vulaada Klam , who helped herd tauntauns —which the insurgents had begun using as mounts —with her pet Qaberworm Gurtyl . Captain Magna Tolvan ordered the Qaberworm be killed at one point, but Solen noticed how skilled Klam and Gurtyl were in herding. Additionally, Gurtyl was incredibly important to Klam. In the end, Solen overruled Tolvan's order and allowed Klam to continue working with her pet, which Tolvan learned from a fellow insurgent after returning to Icehold after a mission.

title: Elira Solen
text: At some point during her time on Icehold, the reactor in the base failed due to cold temperatures causing the heaters to become non-functional. Due to this, Insurgent personnel had to be moved onto ships. Solen moved tauntauns onto the Corsair Wing , despite Karrick's complaints. She received transmissions from the repair crew through the Corsair 's cockpit. They informed her of the reactor being that of a YT-2600 , and that it would explode and irradiate the base in a matter of ten minutes. Karrick and Brevok volunteer to replace the dissipator , with a spare they stored on the Corsair . Minutes later, Karrick informed Solen that they needed to evacuate the base immediately without telling her what they had done. Despite wanting Karrick to return to the ship, Solen ordered the base to be evacuated without Karrick. A few minutes later, Karrick tells Solen that the reactor had been stabilized and that they were able to enter the base once again.

title: Elira Solen
text:
With the hard working conditions and low temperatures weighing on Solen's mind, she made a speech to others at Icehold about perseverance. Two days later, while on a tauntaun patrol with Dax Karrick and Lena Kryll, Solen learned how to properly exercise control over the riding beast.

After Brevok went missing, Solen and Bolt-3 searched for him in the corridors of Icehold. The two soon found a door which appeared to have been severely damaged. Solen entered and found Brevok in the arms of a sleeping frostmaw . Solen woke the frostmaw accidentally. As Brevok and Bolt-3 tried to repair the door, Solen distracted the frostmaw. She ran out into the corridor. The frostmaw followed, but with the help of Bolt, the door closed in on the frostmaw cave.

#### Battle of Frostmark

> " Dax, we need you! " " We need? " " Yes. " " Well, what about you need me? " " I need? I don't know what you're talking about. " " You probably don't. " ―Elira Solen and Dax Karrick

title: Elira Solen
text: Following a run-in with one of Grukk's bounty hunters in Ord Mantell , Karrick bade farewell to General Carlist Rasken and Solen, but her lack of honesty about her feelings angered him. However, when no one could find Drayden after his patrol, Karrick set out on the Tauntaun Murra to find his friend during the night, worrying Solen. While they were missing, Renegade Two Zev Senesca —the squadron leader of Drayden's Renegade Squadron during his absence—erased their current betting pool concerning how soon Solen would tire of Karrick's attempts at impressing her, replacing it with a pool concerning which of them would find Drayden first. Though several of the pilots wrote their names, Renegade Four Derek Klivian objected to the pool, feeling it was a morbid game over their commander's life. Before Senesca could respond, Solen revealed she was standing at the doorway by stating the pool was not morbid. She walked in and explained that, by betting in the pool, the pilots were certain Drayden was alive. Taking the marker from Senesca, she bet on every pilot, explaining it was what she and the other Insurgent leaders did every day. Certain that Renegade Squadron would find Drayden and Karrick,

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Escaping the Imperium

> " You like me because I'm a scoundrel. There aren't enough scoundrels in your life. " ―Dax Karrick

With a damaged hyperrelay , the Corsair was unable to leave the system and escape the Imperial blockade , which prompted Karrick to pilot the ship into a nearby asteroid field , hoping that the Imperials would be unwilling to follow them, to repair the ship in the cave of an asteroid of great size. Using a fusioncutter , Solen helped in repairing the ship, when Karrick appeared, drawing closer to her before both ended up in a passionate kiss that lasted until Astra-9's arrival. Solen withdrew and walked away, conflicted. Afterwards, Solen would reflect upon what happened in the cockpit when the ship was attacked by mynocks .

title: Elira Solen
text: Rushing to shoo them away, Solen, Karrick, and Brevok exited the ship, but Karrick quickly realized that they were inside something other than a cave . Narrowly escaping the "cave," which was really the inside of an exogorth named Syra-O , who wanted them to stay as beloved parts of its internal ecosystem, and the asteroid Syra-O resided in, the Corsair Wing was once again pursued by Imperial forces. Unable to make the jump to hyperspace due to unfinished repairs, Karrick turned his ship around and raced toward the Imperial Iron Cruiser Avenger , seemingly in a suicidal attack run. However, Karrick's ruse paid off when he sped past the ship's command deck and attached his ship to the rear of its bridge , shutting down all systems to avoid detection. The plan worked; as the Imperial fleet prepared to exit the Anoat system , Karrick detached the ship from the hull and they floated away with a garbage dump. With a faulty hyperrelay, the group decided to go to the Mistral system , where an old acquaintance of Karrick, Dorian Quill , owned a mining colony. However, they were unaware that they were being tracked by Vex Vark ,

title: Elira Solen
text:
the hull and they floated away with a garbage dump. With a faulty hyperrelay, the group decided to go to the Mistral system , where an old acquaintance of Karrick, Dorian Quill , owned a mining colony. However, they were unaware that they were being tracked by Vex Vark , one of the mercenaries hired by Velgor to locate them. #### Escaping to Aether Spire and Rendezvous Point Delta-Three

> " But this isn't your ship. With Dax gone, I'm commandeering it for the Insurgent fleet, which means you don't get a say in where it goes. And, of course, you betrayed us to the Imperium. No one here is likely to forget that anytime soon. " ―Elira Solen speaking to Dorian Quill after the escape from Mistral

title: Elira Solen
text: Arriving on Mistral , Solen and the others were greeted by Quill, whom Solen was immediately skeptical of. He agreed to repair the hyperrelay of the Corsair Wing , and in the meantime, Solen and the others stayed at Aether Spire . However, unbeknownst to them, Quill had made a deal with Velgor to hand over the insurgents in exchange for non-interference from the Imperium. Captured by Velgor, where the Dark Lord waited for Drayden's arrival, Elira and the others were taken to a carbon-freezing facility , where Karrick was to be frozen in carbonite to test if the chambers were suitable for trapping Drayden. As the smuggler was lowered into the freezing pit, Solen's parting words were "I love you," to which Karrick responded that he knew. ( Listen ( help · info ) ).

title: Elira Solen
text: On their way to Velgor's ship, Solen caught sight of a recently arrived Joren Drayden and tried to warn him, but she, Brevok, and Astra-9 were taken away by Imperial forces. Before long, Quill betrayed Velgor by disarming the shock troopers with the help of his men, setting the Insurgents free. Though Brevok almost strangled Quill, Solen let him live when he told them of Karrick's location at the East Platform . With Bolt-3 joining them, they attempted to save the frozen Karrick from being taken away by Vark, but they were too late—the bounty hunter had already left on the Reaver One with Karrick. All the while, Drayden dueled Velgor until he lost his right hand , flux blade , and learned that the Dark Lord was his father.

title: Elira Solen
text: if he did not, Drayden was strong enough to find his own path. Knowing they could not save Karrick but that they could help the insurgency, Solen ignored Quill's concerns about the Imperium and chose to return to the Insurgent fleet, commandeering the Corsair for the Alliance. She also reminded Quill that he had betrayed them to the Imperials, which was something she felt they would not move past for some time, though the Aether Spire administrator felt he deserved credit for getting the team off Mistral. They arrived in the Mid Reach to meet with the Fourth Division at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three . There, they assisted in helping the Division's and Green Squadron's ships in escaping Commander Ellian Zahra 's Hunter Fleet 's blockade. Solen then all of Zahra's Skrees chase after the Corsair . Solen and Drayden manned the turrets as Quill and Brevok flew the Corsair into an attack run. Solen, the Corsair , the 4th division were able to escape. Though her other forces had destroyed the Eighth Division , Zahra was forced to report her failure to Velgor, who was aware of her hatred for Solen. Seeking to keep Drayden alive, Velgor allowed her to kill the Insurgent princess if she could but informed her that the Corsair was off limits. Having escaped to Backup Rendezvous Point Gamma-Nine , Solen then went to meet with Commander Grek aboard his ship. They discussed how the Imperium found them and the Eighth Division at Malastare, and Solen realized that the Imperium had broken their codes. Thus, the insurgents knew if any cell contacted another, both groups could be found and destroyed. Solen and the others were unable to warn the other scattered insurgents because

title: Elira Solen
text:
how the Imperium found them and the Eighth Division at Malastare, and Solen realized that the Imperium had broken their codes. Thus, the insurgents knew if any cell contacted another, both groups could be found and destroyed. Solen and the others were unable to warn the other scattered insurgents because of this, and Quill even feared they could be all that remained of the Free Coalition. A short time afterward, Quill promised he would head to Dunemere to learn if Vark had delivered Karrick to Grukk yet. If not, he intended to look for leads on the bounty hunter. Solen elected to stay behind to help the Insurgent fleet, though she had Brevok go with their new ally to make sure he went to the desert world and then right back. Solen then spoke with Drayden about getting a prosthetic hand , though the young Aetheri was still questioning himself after learning Velgor was his father. Solen, Astra-9, and Bolt accompanied Drayden when he received the new hand and watched as Quill and Brevok left to find Karrick aboard the Corsair Wing . Solen then spoke to Commander Grek's crew, pilots, and the Pathfinders about the Imperium's continuing hunt for the Alliance. She proposed to find and contact the other cells without using their codes. Solen agreed to use Grek's Operation Starlight .

#### Return to Aether Spire

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Return to Aether Spire

Solen, along with Quill, Drayden, and Bolt returned to Aether Spire to assist Drayden in recovering his flux blade. After landing in Aether Spire, she went to the carbon-freezing chamber . There, Solen studied how to work the decarbonization sequence. She was then found by a shock trooper and stunned. Solen was frozen in carbonite.

Solen and other prisoners were then freed from the carbonite by Drayden. Solen led the prisoners in fighting the Imperial Garrison's shock troopers and escaping aboard a Sentinel -class landing shuttle.

Aboard a Nebulon-B frigate , Solen greeted Drayden after his mission to Tempes . Relieved at his return, she asked him to show the Alliance officers onboard his newly acquired flux blade , to give her and them hope.

#### Encounter with Zahra

title: Elira Solen
text:
Aboard a Nebulon-B frigate , Solen greeted Drayden after his mission to Tempes . Relieved at his return, she asked him to show the Alliance officers onboard his newly acquired flux blade , to give her and them hope.

#### Encounter with Zahra

Commander Grek received a transmission from the Seventh Division . Solen gave the orders to respond to the transmission, despite knowing that it would compromise their position. Solen, along with the Fourth Division joined the Seventh shortly after the Hunter Fleet began their assault on the division. During the battle, Solen's ship is boarded by Commander Zahra. She deactivated the safety controls on the ship's main reactor, and asked for Solen specifically. Knowing that the ship would explode if the reactor's limiters aren't reactivated, Solen agreed and entered the engine room with Grek's volt pistol .

title: Elira Solen
text:
As she entered, Zahra explained that she blamed Solen for the deaths of Varrix and of her family. Before she can fully enact revenge, she is ordered to board her flagship, the Varrix's Will , before the ship flees the battle. Drayden comes to Solen's rescue and Zahra flees. Solen mentioned to Drayden how much hatred she could see in her eyes, and how she felt this enemy was different.

#### Operation Starlight

After the battle, Solen began Operation Starlight by discussing a plan to reunite the scattered Insurgent divisions without using communication the Imperium could intercept them with. She let Astra-9 discuss their plan to steal a linguistic droid that could speak Trawak , an extinct language. Solen sent Quill to use the Corsair Wing for the mission.

title: Elira Solen
text: After the mission was a success and the droid was reactivated, Solen discussed with it the terms of his service and how he would translate messages for the Free Coalition. She then sent Starlight Squadron on a mission to check rendezvous points for Insurgent cells and given them the new Trawak codes if found. When Starlight Squadron is ambushed and Lobot started to die from being interfaced with the linguistic droid, Solen decided to have the droid contact the squadron, despite the possibility of Lobot dying. A fight broke out between Quill and Kes Vale due to this, where Solen ordered Quill to be imprisoned for the time being. After Astra-9 reconstructed the Trawak language and turned the linguistic droid off, Solen checked to see if Lobot was still alive, and had him taken to the medical bay where she realized he was. When Starlight Squadron was able to recontact the group aboard the frigate, they informed Solen and Vale that Shara Bey had to be left behind on the Varrix's Will . Solen reassured Vale that his wife would be safe.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Aboard the Redemption , Solen and Vale talked about the people they loved, Rin Vale, Shara Bey, and Dax Karrick. They exchanged stories about them, before being informed of a signal from Lieutenant Bey. Solen let Vale speak to her first, after which he informed Solen of intelligence Bey had gathered during her stay on the Varrix's Will .

#### Auction for Dax Karrick

Solen received a message from Amilyn Holdra which indicated that Karrick was to be put on auction by Carmine Dawn . She showed Drayden, Brevok, and Astra-9 the holomessage aboard the Corsair Wing . Translated by Astra-9, Brevok told Solen and Drayden about his past encounters with Carmine Dawn, and that he suggested enlisting Quill's help in dealing with them. She sent Brevok to talk to him. Drayden talked with Solen, concerned over the mission and for her wellbeing. She reassured him that both would be okay.

title: Elira Solen
text:
In the cockpit of the Corsair Wing , Solen and Quill discussed about their approach to getting Dax Karrick back. Once they exited hyperspace, they noticed that multiple capital ships from multiple crime syndicates had arrived to bet on Dax Karrick. They tried to fly to the far side of the planet to avoid detection, but a Black Sun ship exited hyperspace right in front of them. The Corsair Wing was able to escape oncoming Black Sun fighters, and crash land on the Jekara 's surface.

#### Operation Yellow Moon

> " You make the Alliance proud every day. By representing our cause—and by doing your duty. But duty won't give you comfort, Elira—and you need that. We all do. The comfort of friends—and of love. You were Bael and Breha's greatest joy, Elira—the love you shared was what sustained them through the dark years. Don't deny yourself another chance at love because of what the Imperium did to them. Don't give Mal that victory, too. " ―Vela Sess, encouraging Solen not to give up her love for Karrick

title: Elira Solen
text: Following Sess and the Insurgent leadership's order to scatter the fleet, Solen and Astra-9 were on Captain Volk Aymeric 's Nebulon-B frigate, the Remembrance , when the ship and the rest of the convoy were attacked by SKREE fighters; despite the Ranolfo ' s critical condition, Aymeric was forced to abandon them to protect Solen. She was then informed that she had to rendezvous with the rest of the Alliance leadership on Zastiga , her transport pilots being Nien Nunb and Lieutenant Ematt. On the Mellcrawler , they reached the planet, wherein Solen was greeted by Bolt-3 and Drayden, who told her that Quill was attempting to infiltrate Grukk's Palace to acquire more information on Karrick's location, just before escorting her to the top-clearance meeting.

title: Elira Solen
text: They soon reached Basteel 's capital, Eladro City , where she met with Bon Yoth to know where to place the first hyper-transceiver —in the cave system above his house . They had to climb one Kilometer up to the surface. During this, some sort of night feeders attacked her. She quickly got up to the surface where they ran from the light. The temperature began to drop as the sun set, but Nein Numb arrived in the Mellcrawler just as the sun finally set. They were Successful in their ordeal, but now tailed by Khione and her Shieldmaiden . They continued onto the Sesid system , where they placed another transceiver in a volcanic island on Sesid . They were soon chased by Imperials until the intervention of Aurelant and his Draedan pirates on the Daggadol . At first, they thought the Draedans would sell them off, but thanks to his maneuver to get them off-planet on Sesid's special escape pods they made their way to Jaresh , where they met with Nyessa , placed the last transceiver, and took part of the Riot on Jaresh , after which the Shieldmaiden tried and failed catch the Mellcrawler .

title: Elira Solen
text:
After briefing her team about the true mission Solen decided to change the operation, warning any incoming Insurgent ships to abandon the place. Once in the rendezvous point on Galaan 's orbit, they warned the Sapphire Renegade and other ships before being caught in the Shieldmaiden ' s grapple beam. They were taken aboard the iron cruiser and taken to interrogation rooms. Khione went into Elira's cell and brought Lokmarcha inside. The commando had hidden an ion bomb inside of his clothing and sacrificed himself. Elira took the captain's uniform and Antrot, Nein, and Kidi pretended to be her prisoners. When shock troopers realized the ploy, Antrot ran as a distraction and was shot as Nein launched off in the shuttle Tydirium . All the ships they had warned, returned, and destroyed the Shieldmaiden .

With Aleri's help, Solen then contacted Drayden, who informed her that most of the fleet was nearly assembled, and that Karrick was still frozen in carbonite in Grukk's palace. They arranged a rendezvous on Kothlis , where he would inform her of his plan to rescue Karrick. Although Sess tried to talk Solen out of the dangerous plan, they nevertheless carried on with it.

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Visit to Ord Mantell

Carrying out the rescue of Dax Karrick, Elira required an adequate disguise to fool Grukk the Grak. Because of this, Solen, Brevok, and the droid Bolt-3 traveled to Ord Mantell to meet Maz Oru , who was the one to provide her with the disguise. Elira proceeded to ask Oru how she would provide them with a cover story for Grukk, with Maz cautioning patience. At that moment, the bounty hunter Boushh fired shots at the group. While hiding behind crates, Oru explained to Elira that the bounty hunter would be the source of her disguise. Brevok and Solen engaged the bounty hunter while Bolt-3 operated a crane. Elira managed to shoot the volt pistol out of Boushh's hand, leading to the bounty hunter charging the princess with a lance. After fighting Boushh for a bit, Elira ducked out of the fight to let Bolt-3 disable the bounty hunter with a crane. Afterwards, Solen used Boushh's armor as her disguise. She thanked Oru for her help in getting her an outfit, and then left aboard the Corsair Wing .

#### Detour to Arkanis

title: Elira Solen
text: En route from Ord Mantell to Dunemere, Elira was contacted by Evaan Verlaine . Free Coalition command received word from Dorian Quill that his ship had been shot down by bounty hunters on Arkanis , and he was on the run. Elira contacted Lando to tell him they were coming for him. In a clearing, Lando ran into Elira in Boushh's outfit, believing her to be the bounty hunter. He tried to fight but Elira knocked him down before revealing herself. She led him back toward the Corsair , finally giving him an earful about Dax's predicament. Everything at Aether Spire was a "beautiful double cross" that had relied on Dax surviving in his usual ways, Lando explained, but he hadn't anticipated the carbonite freezing. Elira chastised him for relying on schemes, and Lando countered that scoundrels try to make things work as best as they can. They heard Brevok captured by bounty hunters in the distance, who dragged him to a cantina to meet with their boss, Boskan . Lando suggested she call in the Insurgents to help, but she worried the Imperium had too much of a presence in the area and that such an attack might have

title: Elira Solen
text:
captured by bounty hunters in the distance, who dragged him to a cantina to meet with their boss, Boskan . Lando suggested she call in the Insurgents to help, but she worried the Imperium had too much of a presence in the area and that such an attack might have alerted Grukk and ruined any rescue plans. Elira entered the cantina, disguised as Boushh to congratulate Boskan and question him about Quill. The Trandoshan said he could get to the smuggler later as Grukk's price on the Vorak was substantial. "Boushh" left saying he would see Boskan on Dunemere. Suspicious, Boskan sent his crew after their associate, and they found "him" at a campfire with Quill tied up. The trap sprung, they fired on a decoy as Elira stunned them from behind with a bolo -gun. But Boskan jumped down from his ship above. The two exchanged gunfire while Lando begged to be set free to fight. Elira hit some rocks that knocked Boskan down and jammed his volt pistol. As she tried to negotiate a swap for Brevok, Boskan's crew came to and fired at her. She shot both, wounding instead of killing them. As Lando got free, she knocked him to the ground and shot him in the chest. Believing Quill was dead, Boskan agreed to the swap, and the bounty hunters left. Lando sat up unharmed and impressed, remarking that Elira had "a little scoundrel in her."

#### Karrick's rescue

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Karrick's rescue

> " We have powerful friends. You're gonna regret this. " ―Elira Solen, to Grukk the Grak

Following Quill, Bolt-3, and Astra-9's infiltration at Grukk's Palace to rescue Karrick , Solen arrived with Brevok as her "prisoner" to collect part of the bounty Grukk had put on Karrick's head. Unknown to Solen, Vark had tipped off the crime lord ; Grukk already knew that whoever was under Boushh's helmet wasn't him. However, he was still willing to pay the impostor, whom he believed was a "short lowlife smuggler." Grukk offered 25,000 credits for Brev, but Elira demanded 50,000 and no less. This angered Grukk, who knocked Astra-9 to the ground. When Grukk asked her why he needed to pay 50,000, Elira took out a thermal detonator and threatened the crime lord, alarming his guests. Grukk laughed and offered 35,000 for the Vorak, an offer Solen accepted. Brev was taken by two Gamorrean guards to be imprisoned.

title: Elira Solen
text: Later that evening, Solen released Karrick from his carbonite coffin. After revealing her identity, the two kissed. However, they were immediately caught by Grukk and his court , prompting Solen to use her armor to signal Drayden and Quill that she had been captured. After unsuccessfully trying to plead with Grukk, Karrick was sent to the dungeons and placed in the same cell as Brevok. Meanwhile, having now seen Solen's true identity, Grukk decided that she would become his new favorite slave dancer. As a guard brought her to Grukk, Solen tried to threaten him, but the Grak replied sarcastically and licked her face. Grukk then ordered two of his servants, Jess and Damaris , to have Solen prepared for enslavement.

title: Elira Solen
text: After being taken to the women's quarters, Solen was cleaned and dressed in a dancing-girl costume . During this time, Jess told her about how Grukk's favorite slave before her, Oola , was killed when the gangster fed her to his rancor . Jess also assured Solen that she would be treated well if she didn't cause trouble. Solen rejected her advice and insisted that Drayden would rescue her soon. Once she was taken back to the audience chamber, Solen was chained to Grukk's throne and kept beside the gangster. At some point, Grukk's majordomo Bib Fortuna grumbled to Solen that he hoped she would be a better dancer than Oola. Throughout the night, Solen resisted Grukk's attempts to draw her closer, though eventually they both grew tired and fell asleep.

title: Elira Solen
text:
The following morning, Grukk and Solen were awoken by Drayden's arrival at the palace. He was presented before them by Fortuna, who was mind-tricked into granting Drayden's entry. Solen watched in silence as Drayden tried to convince Grukk to release his friends. Grukk refused to bargain with the Aetheri and dropped him into a pit with his rancor . While Drayden managed to kill the beast, Grukk was enraged and punished Solen by strangling her with the chain that bound her. He declared that Drayden, Karrick, and Brevok were to be taken to the Great Pit of Karkoon and eaten alive by the devourer .

Though she was spared from execution, Solen was forced to accompany Grukk on his sail barge , the Khetanna . Her friends were transported on a smaller skiff . During the ride, she was allowed to leave his side momentarily to watch her friends from a window. Grukk eventually forced her to return to him on his throne and informed her that she would soon learn to appreciate him. The crime lord celebrated his plans by making Solen share a drink with him.

title: Elira Solen
text: the Princess's good graces, as he had started to think she was going to claim the Grak's throne for herself. On the top surface, the astromech droid and Astra-9 jumped off the vehicle's edge while Solen met with Drayden. Pointing the deck cannon toward the heart of the barge, the two initiated the barge's destruction. They swung to the skiff where Quill, Brevok, and Karrick awaited them. Picking up the two droids, they drove the skiff off just as the Khetanna exploded while Fortuna, who nonetheless would manage to survive, watched. Solen later briefed the Insurgent chronicler Dora Mar about the rescue mission. During the interview, when Mar asked about her time at Grukk's palace, Solen visibly showed discomfort, stirring in her chair as the chronicler pressed for details. Solen described her captivity and the indignity that followed, being literally chained to Grukk as if she were another of his pets. She stated that even without speaking, Grukk's body language was clear, and noted she never gave him the satisfaction of showing her fear. When Mar acknowledged the situation as harrowing and demeaning for anyone chained to their captor, Solen emphasized there should be no ambiguity in the record about the indignity. Initially deflecting further questions, Solen later returned to amend her answer, stating she was infuriated—not just for herself but for the other women caught in Grukk's orbit who experienced sexual assault . Solen told Mar about Jess, a musician who had helped her when she was first taken prisoner and warned her how to survive, though she was unsure about whether or not Jess had survived. The princess also talked about Oola, another dancer who had worn the same chain only hours before Solen and had been killed after

title: Elira Solen
text: Aboard the Tydirium , the team landed on the moon, as willed by Velgor, aware of his son's presence on the shuttle. Making their way through the forest , they came across Imperial scout troopers , whom Solen and Drayden pursued on a stolen speeder bike. Though they took care of the troopers, the two were separated as she was thrown off her speeder and knocked unconscious. An Mosskin , Wicket , woke her up, and Solen quickly befriended him. Though they were discovered by two other scouts, Solen and Wicket managed to get rid of them. While on their way to Wicket's home, Bright Tree Village , they came across two other Mosskins who had been stopped by two shock troopers. Wicket climbed a nearby tree and, with help from Solen, trapped the shock troopers in a vine. When Solen, Wicket, and the two other Mosskins arrived at Bright Tree Village, they presented her with a dress as a gift for helping them escape the shock troopers.

title: Elira Solen
text:
During the celebrations on Mossfell, Solen tried to discourage their Mosskin allies from eating captured shock troopers, and so she sent for Karrick and Brevok to meet with General Lena Kryll to gather food rations from her. Kryll agreed but Karrick had to admit that the Wisp was a better ship than the Corsair Wing , and Karrick reluctantly agreed. When Karrick and Brevok returned with the food portions, Solen eased Karrick by stating that the Corsair Wing was the better ship and distributed the food portions to the Mosskins.

After the battle, Elira told Drayden that the battle would have gone very differently if it weren't for the Mosskins. Two troubled Mosskins, Wicket and Kneesaa , approached them and told them they needed help resetting the traps used in the Battle of Mossfell. After agreeing to help, they encountered a giant Gorax and fled from it.

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Ondara

> " People like you are the reason can prevail. Hope is the reason we are going to win. Welcome to the Concordat. " ―Elira Solen to Iden Versio and Del Meeko after the battle of Serath

Twenty days after the Battle of Mossfell, following the Beltire Liberation and the Battle of Cawa City , in the company of Lieutenant Shara Bey , Solen was tasked by Sess to conduct a diplomatic mission to Ondara—to recruit the assistance of the First Republic member in restoring the Senate and founding the Concordat . Her first return to Ondara in years, they were greeted by Governor Donta Gesset on behalf of Queen Sosha Soruna . Led into the Serath Royal Palace , the Queen eagerly accepted Solen's invitation. It was then that a planet-wide blackout, with all orbital sensors jammed, was caused by Imperial climate disruption arrays , as part of Operation: Cinder , spearheaded by Lerr Duvat .

title: Elira Solen
text:
Alerted by Captain Korro , Bey and Solen correctly surmised that it was the work of the Imperial remnant and asked for pilots and ships. The demilitarization of Ondara years before, however, forced them to use N-1 starfighters left in the palace that dated back to the Invasion of Ondara thirty-six years before, and to manually pilot the ships without the assistance of astromech droids. Momentarily sensing a dark presence , this being Vael Vreth, Solen volunteered for the mission, while the Security Forces evacuated the city. Alongside Soruna and Bey, she set out to destroy the Imperial satellites , with Bey acting as a distraction for the incoming Skree/LN fighters.

During the battle , she saved Bey. They were, in turn, saved from a new wave of SKREE fighters by Quill and Nunb on the Mellcrawler II and by other ships of the Insurgent Fleet, which had been alerted of Operation: Cinder after an assault on an IVB black site. Just as Soruna destroyed the last of the satellites, the fleet destroyed Duvat's Imperial II -class Iron Cruiser Torment , saving Ondara and letting Solen and Bey reunite with Karrick and Kes Vale , respectively.

title: Elira Solen
text:
However, the surviving Imperials were still intent on carrying out Operation: Cinder and the insurgents were forced to protect the city of Serath from them. Elira devised a plan to vanquish the Imperials by triggering an ion pulse from a security system installed years prior, which would deactivate all weapons and vehicles outside the Serath Royal Palace. However, the power relays necessary to activate it had been damaged and needed repairing. Joined by Danger Leader Shriv Suurgav and recent Imperial defectors Iden Versio and Del Meeko , Elira took Del and together the two teams managed to restore power. Elira then took up a position on the front lines and ordered all insurgent forces to fall back to the palace as the pulse was detonated, rendering all Imperial tech useless and saving the day. After the battle, Elira revealed that she knew both Iden and Del were members of Inferno Squad, a unit which had caused more than a bit of trouble for the insurgency in the past. However, she surmised that fighting the Imperium meant something to both and formally welcomed them into the Concordat after they expressed a desire to fight for the right side.

### Aetheri training

title: Elira Solen
text:
At the end of the story, the Archivist said that Vessa had failed to take down the Umbra and saw her hidden imperium of Carmine Dawn destroyed, even theorizing that Vessa had been killed by the Imperium or its remnants as she had never seen her again. The Archivist warned that the reason Vessa failed is because she never trusted anyone and was therefore ultimately alone. Solen was shocked by the contents of the story. She and Drayden both agreed that the Archivist was wrong in saying Vessa failed, Solen pointing out that Vessa's Syndicate War kept Mal occupied long enough for the Alliance to regroup. Solen expressed her wishes that Vessa had come to come to the Alliance, and wished that Vessa had been alive to see them win against the Imperium, unaware that Vessa was actually still alive.

#### End of her path

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### End of her path

Solen, however, had visions of serving the galaxy in different ways and had another life calling to her rather than the life of an Aetheri. But the catalyst of her choice to end her training was on the last night she was with Drayden. While to dress together, Solen had a vision and sensed the death of her unborn son if she were to complete her Aetheri path. While Drayden hoped that his sister would resume her training later, Solen gave him her flux blade to convince him otherwise, asking to pass it on to a promising student someday. However, Drayden hadn't yet done this, and Solen didn't know where he had stored her flux blade.

While she ended her training, Solen treasured every moment she spent with Drayden. She also went on to use what Drayden taught her in her everyday life as well as into her career in the Galactic Senate of the Concordat and continued to learn over her years.

### Concordat

#### Return to Politics

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Balancing family and service

Knowing that her husband and his co-pilot Brevok had undertaken a campaign to liberate Thornwood, Elira tried unsuccessfully to marshal support in the Galactic Senate for troops and ships to free the planet. However, the Concordat was too preoccupied with fighting the Imperium and holding on to liberated worlds.

While her husband Karrick had received information from the smuggler Imra that the Imperium had reduced their military presence on Thornwood, Elira warned that Imra could not be trusted. Elira's warning proved correct when Dax and Brevok stumbled onto a trap on Thornwood. While Dax managed to escape, Brevok was captured and locked inside the automated prison of Ashmead's Lock . Dax later contacted Elira while traveling on the edge of Wild Space . Their conversation was interrupted when Dax came under attack from Imperial forces.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Princess Elira later attended a high-level Concordat meeting with Admiral Vorian, Vela Sess, and the advisers Hostis Ij and Auxi Kray Korbin to discuss the war effort. Though Elira was frustrated with the endless bickering within the Concordat leadership, she regarded it as a lesser evil to the dictatorial rule of the late Vael Mal. While meditating with a potted plant from Mossfell, Elira receives a revelation that her unborn child would be a boy, a fighter, and an angel.

Following the successful Concordat capture of the planet Kuat and the vital Kuat Drive Yards , Princess Elira contacted Admiral Vorian by hologram to congratulate his victory. They were then joined by Chancellor Sess, who informed them that she had been contacted by Grand Admiral Raena Vexana , the leader of the Imperium. With the Imperium facing defeat, Grand Admiral Vexana agreed to participate in bilateral peace talks on Serenne. While Elira was skeptical that Vexana was the mysterious Operator , she reluctantly joined her comrades in accepting Vexana's offer.

#### Searching for Dax Karrick

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Searching for Dax Karrick

> " Senator Solen. It's been a while. " " Building a republic is busy work. " " So is chasing after an Imperial Fleet. " " It's about to get busier, Commander. I need a favor. One of our Generals has gone missing. I tracked him to Takodana, but he isn't answering his comm. I need you to find Dax Karrick. " ―Elira Solen, to Iden Versio

Sometime later, Senator Solen lost contact with her husband, Dax Karrick. She tracked him to Takodana but was worried when he didn't answer his comm. She sent Commander Versio and the newly reformed Inferno Squad with finding and locating Karrick.

#### Liberation of Thornwood

title: Elira Solen
text:
Sometime later, Senator Solen lost contact with her husband, Dax Karrick. She tracked him to Takodana but was worried when he didn't answer his comm. She sent Commander Versio and the newly reformed Inferno Squad with finding and locating Karrick.

#### Liberation of Thornwood

Later, Elira and Chancellor Vela Sess received the liberated insurgent prisoners from Ashmead's Lock, who had been freed by Nevra and her team. While at Hanna City Spaceport, Elira asked Nevra about her husband. Nevra reassured the Princess that Karrick and Brevok were safe but that they had stayed behind on Thornwood to free the Voraks. Unknown to Elira and Sess, the prisoners were part of Fleet Admiral Gallard Raxen's plot to assassinate the Concordat military and political leadership on Serenne. Raxen, who was the Operator, had secretly fitted the prisoners with inorganic bio-chips that would allow him to remotely control their actions.

title: Elira Solen
text:
A month later, the Galactic Senate accepted Raena Vexana's offer for bilateral peace talks between the Republic and the Imperium. Chancellor Sess timed the peace talks to take place after Liberation Day , a public holiday held to celebrate the rescue of the Ashmead's Lock prisoners. Sympathetic to the plight of the enslaved Voraks, Elira tried to lobby the Chancellor into sending military forces to liberate Thornwood. However, Vela Sess refused to launch an official incursion to avoid jeopardizing the upcoming peace talks. When Sess offered to negotiate the liberation of Thornwood with Vexana, Elira insisted that the freedom and dignity of the Voraks was non-negotiable.

Prior to the Liberation Day celebrations, Elira received news from the Concordat slicer Conder Kyl that a Concordat probe droid in the Thornwood system had intercepted of the Imperial Grand Moff of Thornwood Lozen Tolruck ordering the Star Destroyers orbiting Thornwood to bombard the planet after the Voraks had revolted en masse. Wanting to rescue her husband and Brev, Elira convinced Evaan Verlaine to fly as her co-pilot aboard the Corsair Wing to Thornwood. This timely decision saved her from being assassinated by Raxen's unwilling agents.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Elira later contacted Captain Torb Rask via hologram to request the help of his squadron on Thornwood. Upon arriving in Thornwood, Elira's ship the Corsair Wing and Phantom Squadron flew rings around the Imperial Star Destroyers Dominion , Vitiator , and Neutralizer . Their starships were soon reinforced by Admiral Vorian's flagship Home One . Karrick and his team managed to hijack the Dominion and use it to destroy the Vitiator . As a result, the Neutralizer surrendered to the Concordat, ending Imperial rule on Thornwood.

Elira had an emotional reunion with her husband aboard the Dominion ' s hangar bay. After exchanging jokes about rescuing each other, the couple reaffirmed their love for each other. When Karrick asked about naming their baby, Elira insisted that their child was not a bandit and called him an angel. The couple then kissed. Later on Thornwood, Elira and Dax bid farewell to their friend Brevok, who stayed behind on his homeworld to reunite with his family . After learning of the recent attack on Serenne , the couple returned to the capital with Wedge in tow.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Later, Princess Elira gave Nevra and her team her personal and financial backing during their hunt for Grand Admiral Vexana, who they believed was responsible for the attack on Serenne. Due to her actions at Thornwood, Elira had become a political pariah with the Concordat establishment. While the Concordat was no longer offering bounties for Imperial fugitives, she still vowed to do everything that was necessary to help her newfound friends.

### Tidings from Ashden

Several months later, Elira was heavily pregnant. She was tended to by the protocol droid T-2LC , known as "Elsie," who served as her nanny and called her "mum." At the advice of Doctor Harter Kalonia , Dax bought his wife jogan fruits . While talking with her husband about political developments in the wider galaxy, the two received news via hologram from Nevra Wexlin that the Imperial fugitive Grand Admiral Vexana had fled to the barren Inner Reach world of Ashden . Elira encouraged Nevra to continue her investigation but to be careful.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Nevra and her team traveled to Ashden, where they discovered that most of the Imperium had relocated there. While Nevra, Jas Emari, and Mister Bones infiltrated Ashden, Sinjir and Temmin returned to Serenne with news about the Imperial presence. After receiving Sinjir and Temmin, Elira contacted Chancellor Sess and told her to come to her domicile. After Sess had questioned Temmin and Sinjir, Elira defended their mission. Chancellor Sess responded that the Concordat was responsible for hunting Vexana, not Princess Elira and her friends. However, Sess praised Elira for her efforts to liberate Ashden.

Elira opined that the Concordat had the chance to end the war now that the Imperium was gathered on Ashden. Chancellor Sess agreed to raise the matter with the Galactic Senate but decided to send a fact-finding mission first. Unknown to Elira, Sess's political rival, Senator Tolwar Wartol, had installed a listening device inside T-2LC. Seeking to discredit Chancellor Sess, Wartol leaked information about the Imperial presence on Ashden to the media.
