Later, Elira and Dax allowed Temmin and Sinjir to borrow the Corsair Wing and travel to Ashden. However, Wartol sent guards to stop them from leaving to sow discord among Sess's allies.

title: Elira Solen
text:
### War's end

While watching the morning news with her husband, Elira and Dax saw Senator Wartol informing the media about the Imperial presence on Ashden. After meeting with Sinjir and reassuring him that they had not double-crossed him and Temmin, Elira shared Sinjir's assessment that there was a listening device inside her domicile. Sinjir enlisted the services of his lover Conder, who was a slicer who had previously helped Elira. Conder found a listening device inside T-2LC, and Karrick removed it. Elira and Karrick promptly informed Chancellor Sess, who went to confront Senator Wartol. Elira and her unborn child stayed behind on Serenne while Dax, Sinjir, Temmin, Conder, and Jom Barell undertook an undercover mission on Nakadia , the new capital of the Concordat. The five investigated five senators who had opposed Chancellor Sess's resolution to send Concordat forces to Ashden. They subsequently uncovered a conspiracy by the Black Sun and Red Key crime syndicates to prolong the Galactic Civil War by bribing and coercing the senators. Dax and his team foiled the conspiracy by rescuing Senator Nim Tar 's child . Sinjir then posed as an adviser to the Chancellor and offered them pardons and political favors if they changed their votes. This ploy worked and the Concordat dispatched military forces to Ashden, beginning the final battle of the Galactic Civil War.

title: Elira Solen
text: In the final days of her pregnancy, Elira asked both Dorian Quill and Chancellor Sess to get gifts for the baby, even guilting Sess, who had considered delegating the task to her secretary Auxi , for not picking up the gift herself. However, Sess eventually choosing to comply with Elira's demands would lead to the saving of her life, as Senator Wortal had planted a bomb to go off in Sess's office. Elira ran to the Senate tower, terrified that her mentor was dead. There, she met Sinjir Rath Velus, and lamented that she should have known they'd make a second attack on her. Upon seeing Sess alive and well, Elira ran to her old friend, only stopping to help Sinjir, physically removing a sparking baton from a guard's hand to help him through the crowd. Sess quickly dispersed the situation, explaining that Sinjir was her adviser now and to let him through. The two women embraced each other, thankful that Mon was still alive.

title: Elira Solen
text:
With the Battle of Ashden turning in the Concordat's favor, Chancellor Sess received a peace overture from Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon. Elira along with Chancellor Sess and her new advisers attended the surrender ceremony which took place at the crystal cave north of Hanna City, under an ancient tintolive tree . Elira watched as the Chancellor and Grand Vizier signed the Imperial Instruments of Surrender and the Galactic Concordance , which formally ended the Galactic Civil War and facilitated the Imperium's surrender. During the signing, Elira entered the third hour of her labor. However, she only told Dax after the ceremony. They then rushed off to the birthing chamber at the heart of Hanna City.

### Motherhood

> " I just never should have sent him away. That's when I lost him. That's when I lost you both. " ―Elira Solen to Dax Karrick, on their son, Beno

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Motherhood

> " I just never should have sent him away. That's when I lost him. That's when I lost you both. " ―Elira Solen to Dax Karrick, on their son, Beno

Elira gave birth to her son Beno Karrick on the day the Imperium surrendered to the Concordat. The two were visited by several friends and families. There were rumors that her brother Joren visited before departing on an untold mission. Others claimed that his absence was conspicuous. Stories of Beno's birth circulated within the public sphere. One story claimed that the Princess underwent three entire days of labor. Another tale claimed that it was a fast and painless birth, with Elira merely needing to calm herself and meditate to make the moment as untroubled as a mountain lake. Other stories claimed that her son was born with a full shock of black hair and a full set of teeth.

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Concordat senator

#### The Fenril Consortium

A rising threat

> " How can you be so sure, Mon? Pirros was once a longtime member of the previous Republic. They have a storied" "I am well aware of the history, my friend—but those Pirrosi leaders are long dead. And their successors are not as…eager to negotiate. " ―Elira Solen and Vela Sess before meeting with the Pirrosi delegation on Serenne Around 6 AVE , delegates from Fenril sector world Pirros were on Serenne to negotiate about an upcoming trade summit the Concordat and themselves would be attending soon. Senator Solen and Chancellor Vela Sess discussed their concerns about current generation Pirrosi being much less willing to collaborate than older generations, just before they entered the room Prime Minister Kezrin Almovar and the Prefects were seated in. Councilor Kith Alaytia introduced the delegation, and Almovar expressed her honor to be there, but regretfully informed Solen that she and her planet did not wish to join the Concordat, whom they saw as a desperate bully. Elira responded fiercely, with Sess's support, the two still wanting Pirros and its neighbors to join into their Republic for their mutual benefit. Scared by the Concordat's inability to defend its own supply lines , Almovar refused to join the Concordat and refused to admit them to the important trade summit that was on the horizon. Instead, she introduced the Fenril Consortium , a secretive coalition of planets in the Fenril Sector, and expressed that she finds the Concordat far too weak after the Battle of Ashden and Grand Moff Ubrik Adelvard's chaotic actions – and mocks

title: Elira Solen
text:
that if Joren was leaving, there was a good reason for him to do so. Chancellor Sess then interrupted this to remind Solen that there were more pressing matters at hand, even though Zenathi's story had worried her. Solen was still grappling with the loss of Nechrim's Wake and other trading vessels without even a moment to respond. Concerning Prime Minister Almovar's move to create the Fenril Consortium, and the chaos in their sector, Elira stated that she thinks their enemies are still in the early phases of whatever plan this is. Kaltrais

> " Princess Elira, thank you for coming so quickly." "What kind of friend would I be, President Shoirin, if I didn't? You seemed…distressed. " ―President Shoirin and Elira Solen on Kaltrais

title: Elira Solen
text: After Joren Drayden returned to Serenne from a mission that revealed the plight of the Nagai people, Alaytia called Drayden for help in a nearby docking bay. There, Vela Sess was actively trying to stop Solen from leaving the planet on a diplomatic mission to Kaltrais , a world that was a valued member of the First Republic but had rejected the Concordat's offer to join. Elira insisted that the Pirrosi and their Fenril Consortium wished to disrupt the Concordat's efforts there, and she wouldn't let that happen. Vela Sess, however, was quite concerned with Elira's safety– and said that if the issue was resources, other trade partners could be found. But Elira sensed something more, as she'd spoken to President Tusvein Shoirin to arrange the meeting in-person, and he sounded "off". Suddenly, Drayden and Zenathi arrived to speak to Solen. Joren attempted to sway Elira into staying, but she was adamant about going, as she saw Kaltrais as a great way to demonstrate that the Concordat really cares about the planets that join it. Elira then said she was leaving, and Joren asked to come with, but his stalwart sister declined and boarded the transport with Alaytia, bound for

Elira then said she was leaving, and Joren asked to come with, but his stalwart sister declined and boarded the transport with Alaytia, bound for Kaltrais. On Kaltrais, Solen and Alaytia were welcomed into a chamber with President Shoirin, who shut the doors immediately after starting the coversation. Elira remarked that he seemed distressed, and Shoirin blamed it on a tumultuous galaxy, which Elira segued into a discussion regarding her confusion about Kaltrais refusing to join the Concordat and its supportive community. Disappointed, Shoirin says that this was actually out of his control. Alarmed, and knowing what the President implied, the group is ambushed by the Fenril Consortium affiliated Zantarrk Gang rushing in. The pirates took the two women prisoner. In their cell, Elira devised an escape plan, and told Alaytia to follow along with it. Elira then clutched her throat, and exasperatingly claimed that she couldn't breathe, and Alaytia exclaimed that the princess needed immediate medical care. The door of the cell then slid open, and a Zantarrk shock trooper walked in, examining the situation. Just then, Elira kicked upward, knocking the guard down. After incapacitating the shock trooper, Solen and Alaytia had a volt pistol and made their escape along the same route they were brought in along.

title: Elira Solen
text: Turning to look into a cell, though, Elira saw that President Shoirin was on the ground, captured too. Elira broke into the cell, and helped the President up, asking who'd forced his hand. He says Kezrin Almovar is pressuring him, but that the real leader is a mysterious "Praetor Koyon". They had approached looking to make an alliance, before Shoirin knew of their criminal sensibilities. He revealed that this was all a trap for Joren Drayden, as Zantarrk shock troopers found the group. Concurrently, in orbit above the planet, the Corsair Wing arrived– and was met by a small fleet of Zantarrk vessels, which it engaged. Covering Shoirin as he escaped to give them cover as they escaped the planet, Solen and Alaytia fought the pursuing Zantarrk Gang members on the way to the hangar, where more volt pistol bolts were exchanged. Meanwhile, in a dark office, Shoirin pressed a red button labeled "engage", as the door slid open and the Zantarrk fired on him, killing him and destroying the computer. This shut down Kaltrais's planetary defenses, saving the Corsair , while also firing on the Zantarrk's ships on the surface! Shoirin had died engaging the planetary defense's recalibration, giving

Shoirin had died engaging the planetary defense's recalibration, giving Solen and Alaytia a window to escape, as the fleet in space began to pull back. Just after telling Dax to go home to Beno, Elira and Alaytia received a transmission from the surface– from Reyna Oskure, the secret leader of the Fenril Consortium. Solen asked if Oskure was responsible for the chaos on Kaltrais, which the sorceress denied, saying she was simply assisting the Fenril Consortium against the Concordat. Oksure said that with President Shoirin now dead, Kaltrais was firmly cemented into the Consortium, so the Concordat representatives should be wary. Elira, not backing down, and called their bluff– saying that if the Consortium was really that upset, they wouldn't have called back their ships, and that the Concordat does not scare that easily. As the hologram ended, on Oskure's side, Prime Minister Almovar expressed her disappointment with the sorceress's strategic retreat, and that it was antithetical to the goals of the Consortium. Then, Vela Sess sent the Corsair ' s crew on a mission to Loradil to rescue the Concordat traders.

An assembling fleet

> " Perish the thought, Elira . But we can no longer discount Almovar and the Pirrosi —" " Especially now that we know who they're in league with. " ―Vela Sess and Elira Solen discuss Reyna Oskure on Serenne

title: Elira Solen
text: Back on Serenne, regrouping after Kaltrais, Elira Solen was wary of an "I told you so" from Sess, but Sess dismissed it. They now knew that the Pirrosi, Zantarrk Gang, and Fenril Consortium were in league with Reyna Oskure– whom they mistakenly didn't confirm was dead after the Battle of Ashden. Now, she is close to the Fenril Consortium's leadership, and they directly threaten the Concordat and its virtues. With lots of questions stirring inside her, Sess made it clear that the dream of the Concordat was to start something new and better than what came before, and having it challenged so quickly pained her. As Elira stated that pushing for peace was the only way forward, Kith Alaytia ran into the chamber with news that the Consortium had assembled a fleet, and that fleet was bound for Concordat space. Confirming these details and looking at a hologram of the fleet, Vela Sess realized that war was at their door. Kaltrais had fallen to the Consortium, their diplomatic efforts having failed. But Elira remained strong in advocating for not falling back into the old ways. They dreamt of a softer way, and Elira wanted to make that happen. The two

title: Elira Solen
text: fleet, Vela Sess realized that war was at their door. Kaltrais had fallen to the Consortium, their diplomatic efforts having failed. But Elira remained strong in advocating for not falling back into the old ways. They dreamt of a softer way, and Elira wanted to make that happen. The two women discussed how the situation with Pirros had gone down, and examined their own feelings of rejection and how complicated it made things in this new era. With a fleet heading their way, Sess asked Solen how they should respond, to which the senator said she already had– she had activated agent Bastion, a Concordat operative secretly operating on Kaltrais.

title: Elira Solen
text:
After the Nagai insurgency had finally found its footing on Kaltrais thanks to the Concordat's help and pushed back the Fenril Consortium's fleet, Reyna Oskure assassinated an uncertain Kezrin Almovar. This isolated the Fenril Consortium under the Anzati witch's control, pushing the battle to Nagi as the Nagai intended to free their homeworld, pulling the Consortium's fleet away from targeting the Concordat. Seeing the movement of the Fenril's fleet towards Nagi, Vela Sess ran toward Solen's location, banging on the door. Elira was confused, thinking Bastion had simply done her part successfully. But Sess then revealed to her hat the fleet was now bound for the Nagai homeworld, to Elira's shock.

Nagi

> " We have to bring them home now !" " Elira—your place is here! " ―Elira Solen and Vela Sess on a Concordat landing platform

title: Elira Solen
text: While at the Karrick family apartment with Beno and Astra-9, Solen called Dax Karrick to ask for an update on Bastion, Joren, and Rynn as they were caught in the middle of the Battle of Nagi . But Dax picked up the hologram while he and Varrick were sprinting away from a group of Zantarrk shock troopers blasting them. Stopping to answer the call, Dax told Elira that Oskure had captured Rynn and Jesrit, and that he doesn't know where Joren is but he's not particularly worried about that. As Dax hinted that Venk had been killed as well, an explosion went off behind the two men– prompting an end to the call as Dax asked for some Concordat help and ran off toward Bastion's location. Worried for her husband, for her brother, and for the Concordat, Elira held her son and questioned what Dax had done. Some time later, in a hangar near a CR90 corvette, Solen begged Vela Sess to help her bring them home. Mon told her that her place was there on Serenne, and that the Republic needed her– governing thousands with a word. Elira still wanted to go save her family, but Sess was able

title: Elira Solen
text: in a hangar near a CR90 corvette, Solen begged Vela Sess to help her bring them home. Mon told her that her place was there on Serenne, and that the Republic needed her– governing thousands with a word. Elira still wanted to go save her family, but Sess was able to convince her to stay. Though she wasn't going to go, Elira placed Alaytia in charge of the Republic's response, walking away with Beno and Astra-9. As the battle raged on Nagi, the Fenril Consortium fleet held position in orbit. But the Concordat fleet Solen had sent, led by Alaytia, consisting of a Defender -class cruiser , at least two escort frigates , several corvettes, and many starfighters arrived over Nagi to peacefully ask the pirate vessels to stand down. But Oskure, cornered by Drayden on the surface, detonated the fleet, causing mass chaos And debris raining down. News of this got back to Solen and Sess on Serenne, along with the fact that Bastion had been killed on Nagi. The people of Pirros, acting independently from the tyrannical Oskure, then contacted the two Concordat leaders– begging for their help in stopping Oskure. Elira, always willing to make an ally, and realizing her place as a political leader for the Republic, agreed to help. Sess believed that this was because of Bastion's death, but Solen explained that it was about more than that– she wanted to fight for peace, protecting what they've built. Sess reassured Solen, and the two set off to do good.

title: Elira Solen
text:
While the Concordat's agents fought Oskure's combined Tof , Zantarrk, and traitorous Nagai forces at Nagi, a Concordat transport accompanied by two Vectors landed. and Solen and Sess emerged to announce that the Concordat stood with the Nagai. The fighting ceased upon this proud declaration, the combatants looking at the arriving dignitaries. Jesrit took this opportunity to address the crowd– saying that they now stood on the precipice of true peace, a free Nagi, and freedom from mainpulators, monsters, and their lackeys. Elira denounced the Fenril Consortium as a shadow government run by Oskure, and stated that the Concordat stands with Nagi as a free, independent world they will help rebuild. Jesrit spoke of unity amongst Nagai, united in Garlev's dream, and the enemy Nagai removed their salvaged Imperial trooper helmets, cheering the phrase "in Garlev's name", raising their fists to the sky.

Victory & freedom

> " The Concordat is committed to helping rebuild Nagi—as an independent world, ruled by its own people." "Not as a proxy state—or as a pawn." "As Garlev intended. As I will ensure. " ―Elira Solen, Vela Sess, and Jesrit looking upon the rebuilding of Nagi.

title: Elira Solen
text:
In the city of Siva , the Concordat heroes celebrated and gathered with the Nagai, as they began clearing debris and rebuilding. There, Elira reassured Jesrit that the Concordat was committed to helping the Nagai rebuild their world as a new independent Nagi, which Jesrit said was what Garlev intended. The young Nagai leader thanked Joren and his friends, and Joren clarified that he was just keeping his promise from Gadrilam. Solen told Jesrit she hoped this was the beginning of a strong partnership, and Jesrit told her she hoped for the same, and that she had a lot to learn from Elira in how she unified her people. But Solen told the young woman her own words only nudged along what Jesrit had done. Pulling Solen away from the conversation, Dax had a question for his wife: why had they been apart for so long? Zenathi saw this and all the rest of it, and reflected on the moment of happiness with Joren, who told her that these moments were incredibly important. Nagi was free, after Solen had committed much to the effort.

#### Family life

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Family life

> " Take him in the bedroom, please? We’ll talk about this later. There’s something going on that Mon and I have to attend to. " ―Elira talks to Dax about Beno while she works.

In 7 AVE , Dax, Elira, and Beno were paid a visit by their longtime friend Dorian Quill, who had come to recruit Dax to help him save Aether Spire. Elira gave Dax her blessings as he departed her and Beno to join Quill's crew. Later, Elira helped them by ordering Concordat Captain Krull to allow the group of "Concordat agents" to pass through their blockade and leave Substation Grimdock , and later revealed to them that the pilot they hired, Taka Jamoreesa , was an undercover Concordat bodyguard. Upon Dax's return, Elira was pleased by her husband's vow to spend more time together.

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Assisting Kryll

> " The honorable Senator Solen has become aware of an unfortunate situation and wishes to present this data transcript, which she hopes may resolve the matter. " ―Astra-9 to the court

In 9 AVE , Grand Admiral Vorren of the Imperium planned to return to the galaxy, having previously been taken to Peridea due to the actions of Solen's old ally, Commander Cass Virel. Around this time, Elira's name was included on a list of heroes on the gauntlet of Baylan Skoll , a former Aetheri Knight and an ally to the effort to find Grand Admiral.

title: Elira Solen
text: After being informed of rumors regarding Vorren's return, General Lena Kryll spoke with Vela Sess and other senators, requesting resources to aid in searching for the missing Aetheri and the Grand Admiral, though the request was soon declined. In response, Kryll took a small squadron of Vectors and decided to continue with the search regardless. Solen was soon informed of this, though supported Kryll's actions and decided to cover for her. The Concordat were quick to respond to this however, and Solen soon contacted Captain Carson Teva and told him that she could only cover for them for so long. Teva passed the message down to Kryll, who searched for her friends Ryn Wrenna and Sela Marr. Marr was eventually found and pursued the hunt for Vorren and Virel, whilst Kryll was left to deal with the consequences from the Concordat.

title: Elira Solen
text:
During the prosecution of Kryll by Senator Hamato Xiono for disobeying direct orders, Solen sent Astra-9 to represent her in the trial and defend her friend. Before claiming that Solen had only recently become aware of the situation, the protocol droid presented a data transcript on the senator's behalf to prove that Solen had personally authorized Kryll's reconnaissance mission to Seatos while she was unaware of Xiono's vote against it. Astra-9 also added that Solen was willing to overlook the alleged mistake, with the request that further concerns be addressed directly to her. As Xiono reluctantly claimed to be satisfied, Sess dismissed the case despite knowing that Solen did not authorize the mission beforehand as claimed.

#### Late Concordat Era

An unlikely ally

> " I don't have time for a conversation about galactic politics with someone so profoundly ignorant of their greater implications. " " Nor do I have time to discuss these matters with someone so intolerant of other points of view. " ―Elira and Kastor exchanging views about the Imperium

title: Elira Solen
text:
> " I don't have time for a conversation about galactic politics with someone so profoundly ignorant of their greater implications. " " Nor do I have time to discuss these matters with someone so intolerant of other points of view. " ―Elira and Kastor exchanging views about the Imperium

Twenty-three years after the Battle of Ashden, Solen was still a senator in the Galactic Senate of the Concordat on Hosnian Prime , as part of the Populists , a powerful, yet unofficial, political faction. The Populists believed that individual member planets should retain their full sovereignty, while the Centrists favored a stronger galactic government and a larger military. After Sess, former chancellor , left the office, the tension between the two factions threatened to cripple the Senate.

title: Elira Solen
text:
During this period, Solen attended a dedication ceremony of a new statue of her father, Bael Solen, on Hosnian Prime. At this ceremony, Solen addressed the Senate and attempted to inspire the senators to stop bickering and begin to act. However, her efforts proved unsuccessful, further demonstrating that the Senate was no longer effective. Losing faith that the government could function any longer, Solen resolved to resign as senator at the end of her term.

Following the ceremony, Solen met privately with the Centrist senator Lady Carise Sindian , who informed her that Lord Mellowyn , the Supreme governor of Birren had died without leaving any heirs. Since Mellowyn was a distant kinsman of her adoptive father Bael Solen, Elira was his next in line to inherit the position per the rules of the Elder Houses . While Solen was not interested in matters relating to royalty, Sindian wanted to preserve that tradition. Solen reassured Sindian that she would have her staff investigate the matter immediately.

title: Elira Solen
text: Later during a session of the Senate, Solen was present when Yendor , a Velari emissary from the planet Selvara , appeared before the Senate to ask for help in investigating a Niktal cartel that was threatening his home planet. The cartel was run by a Kajain'sa'Niktal known as Rinnrivin Di , who operated from the planet Bastatha . After Yendor's request was made, the Senate debated whether Yendor's accusations were true and whether the Senate should act upon them. Feeling partially responsible that she was part of the government that allowed this to happen, Senator Solen volunteered to personally investigate Rinnrivin Di's cartel on Bastatha. She was pleased to think that she would see some action again before she retired, until Senator Ransolm Kastor , the junior senator from the Centrist planet Riosa , suggested that the investigation to be bipartisan and volunteered to accompany Solen.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Soon after the session of the Senate ended, Solen went to visit Kastor in his office—contrary to senatorial protocol, where he would be expected to visit her in the morning. Upon her visit, Kastor welcomed Solen into his office, which she discovered to be full of Imperial memorabilia. Disgusted by his infatuation with the Imperium, Solen and Kastor entered a heated debate where Kastor showed his support not for Mal, but the dream of the Imperium, and that he wished that the Imperium had been reformed under better leadership. Solen began to argue that Mal was not the only problem with the Imperium, and that he had only been a child while she was fighting in the war. Solen then left Kastor's office, the two of them agreeing that Astra-9 and the rest of Solen's staff would plan for their trip to Bastatha at another time.

Mission to Bastatha

> " Rinnrivin Di, I presume? " " Princess Elira Solen. I apologize for your unorthodox journey here. However, I thought you unlikely to accept a straightforward invitation " ―Elira's first meeting with Rinnrivin Di

title: Elira Solen
text:
Mission to Bastatha

> " Rinnrivin Di, I presume? " " Princess Elira Solen. I apologize for your unorthodox journey here. However, I thought you unlikely to accept a straightforward invitation " ―Elira's first meeting with Rinnrivin Di

A few days later, Solen and Kastor, along with Elira's chief of staff Greer Sonnel , 16-year-old office intern Korr Sella , Vector pilot Joph Seastriker , and Astra-9, began to prepare their trip to Bastatha. The trip on board Solen's personal ship the Mirrorbright was an awkward one, as Kastor and Solen attempted to avoid each other after their confrontation in Kastor's office earlier. However, by the time they reached the planet, Kastor apologized for being insensitive to Solen's personal experiences in the war, and they agreed to leave the past in the past so that they could do what they came to do.

title: Elira Solen
text: Solen and Kastor remained civil with each other as they exited the Mirrorbright to greet the local authorities, and they were welcomed to Bastatha by Niktal Magistrates Tosta and Xun . The senators and their staff were all welcomed to dinner, and they were taken to a luxurious casino. The group was offered a splendid meal, but Solen insisted on playing her hand in a game of Sabacc . The Niktos believed that she would likely lose some money in the challenging game, but Solen, having learned the game from the best, intended to impress her hosts with her cunning rather than her decorum.

title: Elira Solen
text: While Elira's actions won the favor of her Niktal hosts, Ransolm was uncomfortable with his colleague for fraternizing with what he regarded as "lowlives." During their time at the casino, Elira noticed a party of visitors from the planet Daxam IV . One of the party was an elderly woman who appeared to be watching her while trying to remain unnoticed. After exiting the casino, Solen and Kastor argued about her style of fraternizing with constituents and the alleged "terrorist" activities of the Free Coalition. Later, Elira received news from Greer that a "business delegation" was coming to meet her.

title: Elira Solen
text:
This "business delegation" turned out to be a party of kidnappers sent by Rinnrivin. Without firing shots, Rinnrivin's underlings spirited Solen away on a hoversled for a private audience with Rinnrivin at his underground headquarters . The crime lord attempted to ingratiate himself with the Concordat senator by serving vintage Toniray wine from Cindervale and presenting a holocube of her killing Grukk, an act which had won her the respect of the Niktal species, who called her "Huttslayer." However, Elira rebuffed Rinnrivin's attempts to bribe her into persuading the Concordat to ease its ban on the sale of illegal spice .

Solen's meeting with Rinnrivin was interrupted by Kastor, who had tracked her down using a tracking device he had planted in her cloak. Following a brief scuffle with Rinnrivin's guards, the two senators escaped on a hoversled and alerted the Bastatha authorities. Rinnrivin and his henchmen escaped before the Bastatha security forces could secure his underground lair. However, Elira and her team managed to find information about Rinnrivin's operations including his funnelling of funds to shadow corporations in the Outer Reach. They suspected that Rinnrivin was part of a larger criminal network.

First Senator and the Napkin Bombing

title: Elira Solen
text:
First Senator and the Napkin Bombing

Following their return from Bastatha, Solen and Kastor addressed the Galactic Senate and called for further investigations into Rinnrivin's cartel. Their speeches were greeted by partisan infighting with the Populists accusing Kastor of endangering Elira's life and the Centrists accusing Elira of withholding critical information. Later, Lady Carise took the floor to advocate the creation of " First Senator ," a powerful position that would wield considerable power over the economy and military. While many senators distrusted Lady Carise's motives, Kastor managed to sway the Senate into adopting the motion by pointing to the endemic deadlock in the Concordat. As a result, the Populist attempt to block the motion was defeated.

title: Elira Solen
text: While Solen and her Populist colleagues Tai-Lin Garr and Varish Vicly were dismayed by the results, they decided to change tactics by nominating a Populist for First Senator to prevent a Centrist from holding that position. Since Solen was considered a powerful and charismatic senator, Tai-Lin and Varish convinced her to run for First Senator. Despite her reluctance, Solen agreed to form an exploratory committee to consider the possibility at the urging of her staff including Astra-9, her aide Korrie, and her pilot Sonnel. Elira later contacted her husband, Dax, by hologram to discuss the recent developments. Though Dax expressed disappointment, he understood her devotion to keeping the Concordat in one piece.

title: Elira Solen
text: The following day, Elira met with Lady Carise to conclude their discussion on the Supreme governorship of Birren. During the meeting, Elira revealed that she had been adopted by Bael and Breha Solen. Since Elira and her son Beno had little interest in inheriting the governorship, Elira agreed to support Lady Carise's claim to the title in return for keeping her parentage a secret. While conversing with Lady Carise, Solen admitted that the position of First Senator might not be such a bad idea. In addition, Elira dispatched Greer and the starfighter pilot Seastriker to the watery planet Pamarthe to investigate whether Rinnrivin was hiring pilots from there. Instead, the two Republic pilots learned that Rinnrivin was hiring a shadowy militia group known as the Amaxine warriors , who operated from a base in the Centrist world Daxam IV.

title: Elira Solen
text:
The following day, Elira and Tai-Lin met in the Concordat senatorial complex's banquet hall to discuss her planned nomination for First Senator. There, Elira discovered a hand-scribbled note with the word "RUN." Acting quickly, Elira managed to evacuate the senatorial complex's conference hall moments before a bomb destroyed half of the building. While nobody was killed due to Elira's quick thinking, several senators and staff were wounded by the blast. Elira survived the bombing unscathed apart from some concussion. After receiving treatment for concussion, Elira transmitted a voice message for again to assure him that she was safe.

Missions to Selvara and Harloff Minor

The Populists and Centrists accused each other of staging the bombing for political capital. Despite this bickering, Solen and Kastor resolved to continue their investigation into Rinnrivin's cartel and the Amaxines. After seeing news footage showing an alleged Velari bomber, Elira decided to travel to Selvara to search the planet's archives with Astra-9, Korrie, and Joph for information about Rinnrivin's cartel. Meanwhile, Kastor and Greer would travel to Daxam IV to investigate the Amaxine presence there under the pretext of purchasing an old Imperial artifact from a local dealer.

title: Elira Solen
text: On Selvara, Elira and her entourage were greeted by Emissary Yendor, a veteran of the Galactic Civil War who was familiar with the former insurgent leader. In the Selvara archives, Elira and her team discovered that Rinnrivin had been a lowly spice dealer who had risen to power under unusual circumstances in the past seven years. Elira and Korrie pondered whether Rinnrivin's sudden fortunes were connected to the Centrists. Later, Senator Solen attended a private dinner hosted by Yendor. In her absence, Astra-9, Joph, and Korrie contacted Kastor, who informed them about Rinnrivin's secret satellites above Selvara. Astra-9 sliced into one of the satellites and discovered that Rinnrivin was hiding on the Expansion Region planet of Sibensko . While Elira was annoyed with Joph for acting without consulting her, she was pleased that he had pinned down Rinnrivin's location.

title: Elira Solen
text: After departing Selvara, Elira and her team discovered that Rinnrivin was visiting the upmarket planet of Harloff Minor , which lay near the former galactic capital Vantor. Seeking to question him, Elira delayed her return to Hosnian Prime and took the Mirrorbright to Harloff Minor. Solen and Rinnrivin met at a comfortable restaurant. Rinnrivin denied any role in the "Napkin Bombing" and condemned the incident as a terrorist act. While Elira accepted Rinnrivin's compliment that she would make a worthy candidate for First Senator, she rebuffed his second attempt at bribery and took the opportunity to return her "Huttslayer" holocube on the grounds that she did not need to be reminded of the past. However, Elira had secretly fitted the holocube with a transmitter to keep an eye on Rinnrivin's movements.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Upon returning to Hosnian Prime, Solen learned that her colleague Varish was recovering from her injuries. She also received a hologram recording from her husband, who informed her that he was heading to the fourth stage of the Five Blades race. After listening to news reports of the Populist and Centrist media blaming each other for the Napkin Bombing, Elira chatted with her aide Korrie, who feared the collapse of the Concordat. Addressing Korrie and Joph, she theorized that the current infighting in the Senate could lead to a schism. In private, Elira feared that another war was imminent. After Kastor returned to Hosnian Prime later that night, the Senator briefed her about the Amaxine warriors he had encountered on Daxam IV. Kastor explained that he had gained the trust of the Amaxines and convinced them that he was an Imperial sympathizer. He revealed that the Amaxine warriors had amassed considerable forces and starfighters in preparation for a war. Having determined that the Amaxines and Rinnrivin's cartel were connected, the two decided to investigate whether the Amaxine warriors were responsible for the Napkin Bombing. Rinnrivin also informed her that the Amaxines' main base was located on Sibensko, which was also Rinnrivin's hideout. Elira agreed to steer the official investigation into the Napkin Bombing in the "right direction" while Rinnrivin agreed to investigate whether his fellow Centrists were colluding with the Amaxines.

Secret revealed

title: Elira Solen
text:
Secret revealed

With Elira's approval, Joph and Greer traveled to the seedy space station of Chrome Citadel to arrange a smuggling "cover job" to Sibensko, which had a reputation as a seedy place. Since Elira's nomination as the Populist candidate for First Senator was scheduled to take place within a few weeks, Solen began to prepare for her trip to Sibensko. She discussed her travel plans with Senator Kastor, who advised her that Concordat law prohibited them from using Concordat pilots and ships for illegal work such as traveling to a known criminal hub like Sibensko. Elira invited Kastor to accompany her on this trip to give their mission more credibility in the eyes of the divided Galactic Senate.

title: Elira Solen
text: While Korrie stormed off in outrage at Elira's perceived indiscretion, Astra-9 along with Joph and Greer remained loyal to her. Elira and her remaining team resolved to stop Rinnrivin's cartel and the Amaxine warriors. The following day, Elira marched into Kastor's office and confronted her former friend. Kastor responded that he had been a fool for sharing his most personal and painful life stories with Elira, never guessing that she was Velgor's daughter. When Elira revealed that she had not shared her true parentage with her son, Kastor pointed out that Beno was no longer a child but a man. After destroying one of Kastor's glass display cases and knocking a noodle carton out of a servant droid's hands, Elira stormed out of Kastor's office.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Fortunately for Elira, Tai-Lin Garr spoke in Joren's defense and reiterated that the Concordat did not blame children for the sins of their parents. While accepting the withdrawal of Elira's candidacy, he defended Elira's past record and stressed that she retained his personal friendship and support. The Senate then discussed her request to obtain a brief leave of absence from her duties. After some deliberation, the Senate reluctantly approved her request. Guilt-stricken over his actions, Ransolm did not oppose her request and remained silent throughout the deliberations. Elira and her team then prepared to depart on a junker ship for Sibensko. Despite Greer succumbing to a bloodburn attack, the team proceeded with their mission.

Mission to Sibensko

title: Elira Solen
text:
Mission to Sibensko

For their mission to Sibensko , Elira disguised herself as an indentured servant who wore a heavy robe and veil. Greer and Joph posed as a Ferrik and Ubese bounty hunter respectively, while Astra-9 pretended to be Elira's minder. The Concordat team docked their junker ship in an underwater city in Sibensko's southern axis. Using a tracker, Elira detected that Rinnrivin was somewhere in the underwater city. Upon landing, Elira and team discovered that they were transporting a cargo of detonators to Hosnian Prime. While Greer and Joph loaded the cargo, Elira and Astra-9 headed into the city.

The two accessed a computer terminal in a cantina. Astra-9 downloaded banking records proving that the Amaxine warriors had transferred billions of credits in start-up capital to Rinnrivin Di's cartel over the past seven years. In addition, Astra-9 found that Rinnrivin was linked to nameless sources on Centrist worlds. Elira feared that the Amaxine warriors were planning a major military buildup or that a coalition of Centrist worlds was preparing for war. In addition, Astra-9 uncovered information about a large Centrist base within the underwater city.

title: Elira Solen
text: Elira contacted Joph and informed him about the Amaxine military presence on Sibensko. She decided to send Astra-9 back with his data to rendezvous with the pilots while she went to spy on the Amaxine military base. Since Joph and Greer were scheduled to depart in an hour, Solen planned to stay longer to spy on the Amaxines. Astra-9 reluctantly left to return to the freighter. Before Elira could proceed further, she was cornered by Rinnrivin and two of his bodyguards, who had detected Elira's tracking device on his holocube. Since Elira had accessed classified information regarding his operations, the crime lord intended to kill the intruders.

title: Elira Solen
text: However, Elira shot one of the Niktal henchmen with her volt pistol and then targeted the central strut supporting the hydraulic tunnel above Rinnrivin, crushing the crime lord and his remaining bodyguard to death. Elira then reiterated her orders for Joph and Greer to leave with Astra-9. Unknown to Elira, the Sibensko base served as the Amaxine warriors' headquarters and contained their entire army. Elira then took a lift down to the Amaxine base and discovered that it housed a squadron of starfighters. She then encountered six Amaxine warriors, who attempted to apprehend her. However, Solen fled up a landing platform that took her to the surface of the ocean.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Shortly thereafter, Elira was attacked by a Yarrow and Bulwark starfighter . Before the Amaxine starfighters could finish her off, Dax arrived in a modified racer and shot down the Yarrow. After boarding Dax's racer, the wife and husband shot down the remaining Bulwark fighter, which crashed into the underwater city's ammunition depot. This triggered a massive explosion that wiped out the entire Amaxine base and eliminated the Amaxines and Rinnrivin's cartel as threats to the Concordat. However, the explosion also destroyed much of the hard evidence on the two factions' financial records, which concealed their link to several Centrist senators and the New Imperium.

Warning the Concordat

title: Elira Solen
text: Due to the political fallout resulting from the revelations of her parentage, Elira struggled to obtain a quorum to address the Senate. However, Kastor cast a deciding vote in her favor. Elira related this turn in fortunes to her husband, who was preparing to depart for the hyperspace championship round of the Five Blades which had been postponed due to family commitments. After Dax had left, Elira discussed her plan to address the Senate with her remaining friends Tai-Lin and Varish, who expressed suspicion about Ransolm's motives for voting in her favor. Tai-Lin then informed Elira that he was planning to stand as the Populist nominee for First Senator.

title: Elira Solen
text: The following day, Senator Solen briefed the Galactic Senate about her investigation into Rinnrivin's cartel and the Amaxine warriors. She revealed that Rinnrivin had been funding the Amaxine warriors, who were responsible for the Napkin Bombing. To back her testimony, Solen's chief of staff supplied each senator with an extensive data packet. Elira's testimony evoked finger-blaming between the Populists and Centrists. In addition, Solen submitted visual logs from her Sibensko mission and reported that Amaxine base had been destroyed during the firefight with the Amaxine fighters. When a senator accused her of justifying murder like her father, Elira warned the Senate that her investigation had foiled a conspiracy by the Amaxine warriors to wage war on the Republic. She warned that the Amaxine warriors were not the only threat to the Concordat and urged her colleagues to end their political bickering and not to let their views of her cloud the evidence.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Elira's former friend Senator Kastor then addressed the Senate to support her findings. He vouched for Senator Solen's integrity and then offered visual logs from his trip to Daxam IV, which showed the Amaxines' training facilities and some measure of their military might. He also testified that the Amaxine warriors advocated war and admired the "Old Imperium." Kastor's testimony vindicated Elira's findings and aroused several senators. Due to Kastor's courage and selflessness, Kastor regained Elira's respect. However, Kastor's action earned the ire of Lady Carise, who was covertly working with the New Imperium to undermine the Concordat.

Tying up loose ends

> " The sun is setting on the Concordat. It's time for the Coalition to rise. " ―Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
Tying up loose ends

> " The sun is setting on the Concordat. It's time for the Coalition to rise. " ―Elira Solen

The day after Senator Solen's final address to the Senate, Kastor visited his former friend. The two reconciled with Kastor praising her for her good work in the Sibensko mission. Ransolm then announced his intention to support further investigations into the Amaxines and Rinnrivin's cartel. While Elira did not thank him for supporting her testimony, she praised the junior senator for putting the greater good ahead of his own political faction and ambitions. She told Kastor that he was the kind of politician that the galaxy needed. With Elira's political career at an end, she counselled Kastor to work with other like-minded senators to prevent a war, even if it meant leaving the Centrists. Kastor agreed to do his best to protect the Republic before departing.

title: Elira Solen
text: Ten days following her final speech to the Galactic Senate, Elira accompanied Tai-Lin Garr on his first campaign rally for the position of First Senator. While visiting one of Hosnian Prime's parks, Elira encountered her former aide Korr Sella, who apologized to the Senator for abandoning her. She offered to serve Solen again, a request which Elira accepted. While Tai-Lin was mingling with the crowd, Elira spotted Arliz Hadrassian, the woman she had earlier encountered on Bastatha and witnessed in Ransolm's holos of Daxam IV. Before Elira could react, Hadrassian assassinated Tai-Lin with a volt pistol. Before turning the volt pistol on herself, Hadrassian told the Senator that she was lucky that Hadrassian was thinking strategically.

title: Elira Solen
text: Following Tai-Lin Garr's assassination, the Galactic Senate unanimously declared an official period of mourning. Based on the data from Sibensko, both Populist and Centrist senators believed that Hadrassian was the mastermind behind the Napkin Bombing, Rinnrivin's rise, and the Amaxines. While most senators believed that Hadrassian's suicide ended the danger to the Republic, Elira disagreed and urged the authorities to investigate the source of Hadrassian's money, pointing out that a former Imperial soldier and small-time businesswoman could not bankroll an entire militia. During Tai-Lin Garr's memorial service , she raised the matter. However, her friend Varish was more concerned with mourning Tai-Lin Garr's loss.

title: Elira Solen
text: Two days after Tai-Lin Garr's assassination, Elira heard a news report that her friend Kastor had been arrested for aiding Hadrassian and the Amaxine warriors. After consulting Greer, Solen ascertained that the Centrists had framed Kastor by planting fake footage of him shaking hands with Hadrassian. Before Kastor was deported to face imprisonment, trial, and sentencing on his homeworld Riosa, Elira spoke to him and offered to help her former friend. While Kastor was pessimistic that her help would succeed, he apologized for breaching Elira's trust. In return, Elira apologized for initially assuming that he was an Imperial loyalist. Based on her final conversation with Kastor, Elira determined that the Centrists were behind the recent crisis and were eliminating dissenters among their ranks.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Before resigning as Senator, Elira took the opportunity to settle scores with Lady Carise for revealing her parentage and conspiring against Kastor. Claiming Lady Carise had violated her oath to secrecy as Supreme Governor of Birren, Solen convinced the Elder Houses to strip the Lady of all her royal titles permanently. A smug Elira personally delivered the news to a distraught Carise and chastised the younger woman for her obsession with royalty and privilege. Later that evening, Elira organized a private meeting in the Senatorial complex hangar bay that was attended by several Concordat military personnel including Joph, Greer, Nunb, Ematt, Vorian, Kalonia, Snap Wexlin, and Zari Bangel . With the Galactic Senate too preoccupied with petty squabbles to defend the Concordat, Elira announced the formation of a new paramilitary organization called the Coalition .

### Coalition

#### The new insurgency

> " You are a symbol of the Coalition and an inspiration to all soldiers who follow our cause and do their duty in hard times. " ―PZ-4CO, to Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
Sometime during the Cold War Elira approached and recruited two new Coalition members: Rose and Paige Holt . They were fleeing the genocide on Hays Minor . During the rise of the New Imperium, numerous Velaris feared another occupation of their independent homeworld, Selvara, and so pledged their allegiance to Solen and the Coalition. Meanwhile, New Imperium shock trooper LB-1033 came to develop a series of conspiracy theories about where Solen was born and what her relation to Cindervale was.

#### Prelude to Ashden

> " The problem with a reputation is that it can become a legend. Don't be deceived, Pova. I'm not a legend. " " You're not sitting where I'm sitting, General. " ―Elira Solen and Rin Vale

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Prelude to Ashden

> " The problem with a reputation is that it can become a legend. Don't be deceived, Pova. I'm not a legend. " " You're not sitting where I'm sitting, General. " ―Elira Solen and Rin Vale

As the brewing conflict against the New Imperium advanced, Solen was informed of the Rapier Squadron 's involvement in a dogfight against New Imperium vessels over Suraz 4 , trying to protect the Yissira Zyde , which ultimately was captured by the New Imperium. Interested in any information about the Order, Solen traveled to the squadron's base of operations to meet the squadron's leader , Rin Vale —who had gone to investigate the whereabouts of the NK-Witell -class freighter by himself and had ultimately located it at a New Imperium staging point in OR-Kappa-2722 .

title: Elira Solen
text:
When Vale finished talking about the encounter , Solen noted that he had been very foolish, but his need to do what was right (partly to find adventure) and his piloting skills reminded Solen of her brother, and so, she offered Vale the chance to join the Coalition. He accepted immediately, and in the following months, as he carried out missions for the Coalition, Vale became one of Solen's most-trusted operatives. Eventually because of his skills and determination, Solen recruited him for Operation: Sabre Strike so that he would steal the Hevurion Grace (and its navicomputer data) from its owner, Hevurion senator and New Imperium sympathizer Erudo Ro-Kiintor .

#### Attera Campaign

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Attera Campaign

While on a reconnaissance mission in the Atterra system , the bomber crew of the Cobalt Hammer met Reeve Panzoro and his grandmother Casca Panzoro . They were then brought to D'Qar where they told General Elira about how the New Imperium was destroying their planet. They were members of a local coalition group called Bravo Rising . Reeve told them about the supplies they needed most, and Elira authorized the mission . The campaign would ultimately be successful, but at the loss of 3 MG-100 StarFortress SF-17s bombers.

#### Search for Lor Saan Tarka #### Search for Lor Saan Tarka

After he, Kare Kunna and Iola Aranna completed the mission despite the odds, Solen assigned Astra-9 to see what he could get from the flight computers while she congratulated Vale. Afterwards, as he rested, Solen analyzed the information obtained from the Hevurion Grace . The following morning, she summoned Vale to her office, and asked what he felt about the dilemma, when he remembered the hopelessness of the Imperial Era that his parents had told him about. Thanks to him, she resolved to find her brother and restore hope to the galaxy. Solen then resolved to find Lor Saan Tarka , who Solen believed held a clue to her brother's location.

title: Elira Solen
text: Following Operation: Sabre Strike, General Solen dispatched Rin Vale on a quest to find the explorer Lor Saan Tarka. When Pova assured her that he knew what was at stake, she explained that he had grown up in a galaxy where the Imperium had already been defeated and that he had only learned about the Imperium from others. When Pova recounted his previous encounter with the New Imperium, the two agreed that the faction was not yet as powerful as the Old Imperium. During the briefing, Solen praised Pova for intercepting information from the Hevurion Grace before it could reach Supreme Leader Vorr. She told Pova that they could not allow the New Imperium to find her brother, Joren Drayden, at any cost.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Elira told Pova that Tarka held the key to finding Drayden and that she trusted him to accomplish the quest. For the quest, Elira allowed Pova to select a small squadron consisting of four more pilots and a technician. Elira believed that Pova would not run into trouble due to D'Qar's remote location. When Pova reassured her that he would pick good people, Elira warned him to be careful since she knew that missions could fall apart easily. For the quest, Pova handpicked his fellow Black Squadron pilots Temmin Wexlin, Kun, L'ulo L'ampar , Jessika Pava , and the technician Oddy Muva .

For their first mission , Pova and his comrades traveled to the rocky planet Ovanis where Tarka had visited the Crèche cult years earlier. However, Pova was followed by the New Imperium Security Bureau Agent Terex . With Elira's help, Pova and his comrades bribed their way into Megalox prison on the high-gravity world of Megalox Beta . Pova wanted to question Grukkar, who had encountered Lor Saan Tarka years ago. However, Terex followed them there as well.

title: Elira Solen
text:
After helping Grukkar escape offworld, Pova discussed the information that Grukkar had shared with General Solen. After reading the information on her datapad , Elira opined that the information was legitimate. When Pova asked if he wanted her to take Black Squadron to visit the worlds that Lor Saan Tarka had traveled to, Elira confided that she suspected that a spy had been leaking Black Squadron's movements to the New Imperium.

#### Spy games

Rin Vale later embarked on a solo mission to obtain information about the New Imperium's illegal rearmament efforts in violation of the Galactic Concordance from the Galaxy Beacon journalist Suralinda Javos . Javos wanted to use the story to boost her own career. However, Javos and Pova were ambushed and captured by the New Imperium agent Lieutenant Weel . After escaping Weel, Javos returned with Pova to the Coalition base. General Solen met with Javos, who apologized for exploiting Pova. Experiencing a change of heart, Javos decided to join the Coalition and provide whatever information she had about the New Imperium.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Later, one of the Coalition's droid spies on the Outer Reach world of Kaddak obtained a trove of intelligence about the New Imperium including the location of Vorr. General Solen dispatched her spymaster Astra-9, Pova, and the technician Muva to Kaddak to recover the droid. On Kaddak, they discovered the spy was the BX-series droid commando N1-ZX , who insisted that he could disclose the information once he had been delivered back to the Coalition base. Pova soon realized that this was disinformation planted by Terex to uncover the Coalition base and that Oddy Muva was a spy. Black Squadron and Terex's Ranc Gang proxies were subsequently involved in a battle over a desert planet .

#### Starling in the Unknown Regions

> " When the galaxy is on the line, I have a way of skipping past the formalities of my youth. " ―Elira Solen to Vi Moradi

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Starling in the Unknown Regions

> " When the galaxy is on the line, I have a way of skipping past the formalities of my youth. " ―Elira Solen to Vi Moradi

During the cold war with the New Imperium, Solen Karrick worked with spy Vi Moradi , codenamed Starling, to gain information about the Order's movements throughout the Unknown Regions. After jumping out of hyperspace, Moradi provided vital information to Solen on an encoded comm frequency. The general provided one more set of coordinates for Vi to investigate. However, the New Imperium Iron Cruiser Absolution promptly captured her, but after a lengthy interrogation, Moradi managed to escape with the New Imperium Captain Cardinal .

#### Map to Drayden

> " I saw him. Elira, I saw our son. He was here. " ―Dax Karrick to Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text: Thirty years after the Battle of Mossfell, with the two factions on the brink of war, Lor Saan Tarka finally contacted the Coalition, informing them that he had the map to Joren Drayden and was on the desert world of Ashden. Believing that her brother would solve their crisis, Solen thought the planet was a perfect location, surmising that the New Imperium would be defeated on the same world as the Imperium. Meeting with Vale, she informed the pilot that he was being tasked with retrieving the map, but she also stated he would go without the help of Black Squadron, fearing that four Vector fighters arriving on the planet would spread word of their sensitive mission. Though she believed the mission to Ashden could be their only chance to get an advantage over the New Imperium, their enemy also arrived and attacked the town of Tuanul . Seeing this, Vale gave his astromech droid, Orio-6 , the map fragment. Additionally, the New Imperium attack squadron had been led by none other than Solen's son, who was still using the name "Zarrin Karrick." As he spoke with Tarka, the old explorer told Karrick that he could not deny his heritage

title: Elira Solen
text: her that Tuanul had been wiped out, Tarka had died, and Vale's Vector fighter had been destroyed, which would have likely killed him as well. However, she suspected Orio-6 had survived and told Astra-9 to use the tracking system to locate the spherical droid. Afterwards, she met with her personal envoy, Commander Korr Sella, and sent her to the Senate to try and convince them to act against the New Imperium. Elsewhere, Vale and Orio-6 had indeed survived, with the former having escaped Karrick's command ship, a Resurgent -class Iron Cruiser named the Finalizer , with the help of a treasonous shock trooper, who he gave the name Jax . The two were separated, but Jax met up with Orio-6 and a scavenger named Nyla in Nimara Outpost . They escaped the New Imperium aboard a ship very familiar to Solen, the Corsair Wing itself, leading to them being found by none other than Brevok and Solen's husband, Dax Karrick. Because the two smugglers took the trio to Maz Oru's castle on the planet of Takodana, Astra-9 located Orio-6 within the castle thanks to his droid network. Alerted to the finding, Solen prepared to recover the droid until news reached her that the New Imperium had used its superweapon, Voidfang Base , to destroy the Hosnian system , then-current seat of the Concordat. Vale managed to return to D'Qar aboard the Beloved Bophine but dreaded reporting his failure to Solen. When he met with her, Vale reported what had happened, including that he had escaped imprisonment with the help of a treasonous shock trooper. Solen let Vale talk through his feelings

title: Elira Solen
text: to take Orio-6 back to the Coalition, but that the latter had been abducted by Karrick on Takodana. At some point he also warned her that they would be unable to find her brother with the map Orio-6 had recovered, as Karrick had already seen that it was an incomplete fragment. After traveling back to D'Qar, Vale, now reunited with Jax, brought the former shock trooper to see Solen as she was speaking with several other Coalition members. She complimented him on deserting the New Imperium and saving Vale, but, when he mentioned that Nyla had been taken captive, she revealed that Karrick had told her about the young woman and apologized for what had happened.

title: Elira Solen
text: Desperate for any information about Voidfang Base, which was the very location Nyla had been taken, Solen promised Jax that she would do everything she could to help her, though she noted he first needed to tell them everything he could about the superweapon. Afterwards, Solen conversed with other senior Coalition officers, and using Jax's information about Voidfang, they planned an attack on the superweapon , the location of which they learned by tracking the trajectory of the shots that destroyed the Hosnian system. Solen had tasked Wexlin, Kare Kunna, and Jessika Pava with putting together a reconnaissance run on Voidfang Base. During the flight, as Wexlin's recon pod failed, Kun recalled that Solen had once stated every heist needed luck, telling Wexlin that he was not out of it yet. Shortly afterward, Wexlin would manage to pilot his pod back to her Vector. Elsewhere, at the Coalition base , while Solen and the others waited for Wexlin and Kun to return from the flight, Astra-9 informed her that the map Orio-6 was carrying was only a fragment and that it matched no system on record. Solen thought she had been foolish to think she could find her brother, but

title: Elira Solen
text: while Solen and the others waited for Wexlin and Kun to return from the flight, Astra-9 informed her that the map Orio-6 was carrying was only a fragment and that it matched no system on record. Solen thought she had been foolish to think she could find her brother, but she tried to avoid Karrick after he started speaking to her. Shortly after, however, they finally talked about their son, with Solen expressing that she wanted him back. She told her husband that he could succeed where Drayden had failed, as her brother was only an Aetheri, while he was Karrick's father. Afterward, at a Coalition briefing discussing Wexlin's recon mission, Solen was informed that the New Imperium was charging their superweapon to target their system. Thus, she agreed with Karrick's idea to "blow up" the weapon, prompting the Coalition attack plan to destroy the base's thermal oscillator in Precinct 47 . Karrick also agreed to take Jax to the planet to disable its defensive shields, though he refused to tell Solen how he planned on getting the Corsair onto the base, citing that she would not like the strategy.

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Evacuation of D'Qar

In the wake of the destruction of Voidfang Base, Solen offered condolences to Inferno squad after the loss of its Squad Leader and got the intel about the Dreadnought and then afterwards send Inferno Squad to call for reinforcements. The Coalition was forced to abandon their base on D'Qar, fearing a counterattack from the New Imperium. Solen commanded the Coalition fleet from the cruiser Raddik , while Vale was intended to distract New Imperium forces long enough for the Coalition transports to escape. The escape was interrupted by the arrival of a New Imperium fleet consisting of several Resurgent -class Star Destroyers and one Mandator IV -class Siege Dreadnought , the latter of whose defense systems were neutralized by Vale shortly after the base had been completely evacuated.

title: Elira Solen
text: Though the fleet was able to jump to hyperspace, Vale disobeyed Solen's direct order not to continue with any further attacks on the dreadnought, resulting in casualties that reduced Coalition forces to 400 personnel aboard four ships. Furious at the losses, Solen demoted Vale to Captain, slapping him. Shortly after, the fleet was attacked by a New Imperium armada led by Vorr's ship, the Mega -class Star Dreadnought Supremacy , and Solen realized that they had somehow been tracked through lightspeed. During the attack on the Raddik , the ship's bridge was targeted by a squadron of SKREE fighters led by Zarrin Karrick. Sensing his mother aboard the ship, Karrick hesitated to fire, as Elira also sensed his presence. However, Karrick's escorts took the shot instead, and Elira closed her eyes as the torpedoes obliterated the bridge, killing Vorian and many of the other Coalition leaders and blowing Elira out into the vacuum of space.

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Searching for old allies

After the Coalition's devastating losses of their leadership, Solen decided that the Coalition needed to begin rebuilding by recruiting new leadership. She dispatched Pova and Black Squadron to search for potential allies.

After hearing messages from his teammates of Black Squadron, who went to the planet Ikkrukk to search for more allies and got involved in a fight against New Imperium forces commanded by Colonel Barrut , Vale went to talk with Solen, begging her to let him go to Ikkrukk to save his friends. Elira refused, however, acknowledging that the New Imperium military was immense despite damaging them a little, knowing that every passing moment strengthened their hold on the galaxy, assuring Vale that her decision was perfect and that if she committed another mistake, it would be all over. To convince Vale that she did care for the pilots, Solen assured him that his friends had been crucial for several missions and that they were her friends too in addition to being soldiers, but that they knew the risks.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Upon the discovery that many former insurgents and other potential allies had disappeared without explanation, Solen sent Temmin Wexlin and Kare Kunna to recruit Torb Rask and Nevra Wexlin to join them while she and her allies turned to Selvara for a temporary base. On Selvara, Elira convinced her old friend Yendor, a former insurgent pilot and the head of the Selvara Defense Authority, to temporarily hide them on Selvara. Solen was offered a lavish room within the RDA's headquarters by Yendor's son Charth Brethen , but she declined the offer to be closer to her people.

After more Coalition recruits arrived during the Velari holiday Longest Night , Solen sent a team, including Vale, the Wexleys, and Rask, to Korrath to recover a stolen New Imperium list of potential Coalition sympathizers from the Correllian Collective . While on Korrath, the team liberated a group of prisoners, including Solen's former friend and fellow Concordat Senator Ransolm Kastor. Solen had also tasked a Coalition team under the command of Shriv Suurgav to steal starfighters from the planet of Bracca .

title: Elira Solen
text:
Although the Selvara government did not oppose the Coalition, they did not support their temporary refuge on Selvara. The Selvara Defense Authority was not officially controlled or connected to the government and permitted the Coalition to remain without needing the approval of the planetary government. However, eventually, the New Imperium was tipped off that the Selvara Defense Authority was hiding the Coalition at their secret base. The Authority and remaining Coalition troops planned a defense and retreat of the base. During the retreat, Yendor's daughter, Hahnee Brethen , was killed assisting Solen's escape. Solen told Yendor over comlink about the death of his daughter, as she felt she owed it to him to be the one to tell him. Solen, Nyla, Yendor, and the other Coalition members escaped Selvara, traveling to a location supplied by the Collective. They reunited with the Korrath and Bracca teams, and Solen was able to reunite with Kastor.

#### Mission to Mon Calvarra

> " Instead of just waiting around, I think it's time for me to do something I should have done a while ago. Brev, prepare the Corsair . " ―Elira Solen, after the destruction of Tah'Nuhna

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Mission to Mon Calvarra

> " Instead of just waiting around, I think it's time for me to do something I should have done a while ago. Brev, prepare the Corsair . " ―Elira Solen, after the destruction of Tah'Nuhna

Eventually, the Coalition set up a camp on the garbage planet of Anoat . Elira remained there until she got the news from Lieutenant Connix that the planet of Tah'Nuhna had been destroyed by the New Imperium. After hearing this, the general knew what she had to do. She told Brevok and Rose to prepare the Corsair , which she boarded. She went and picked up Nyla, who'd provoked a fight with a massive Anoatian pit beast , and then she went to Mon Calvarra to see if they would assist her cause. After a brief scuffle there, she met with Admiral Vorian's son Aftab Vorian and visited the Mourning Shrines with him.

#### Meeting on Garel

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Meeting on Garel

Not long after, Elira undertook an undercover mission to Garel alongside Vale, Astra-9, Bolt-3 and Orio-6 to meet with a weapons supplier. Upon landing in the Garel City Spaceport , Astra-9 began to explain their odds of a successful meeting with the weapons supplier as Vale attempted to cut him off, which prompted Elira to explain to Vale that the protocol droid just wanted to assist. After a snarky remark from Vale in response, Elira exited their stolen New Imperium transport with Vale in tow, but not before ordering the droids to remain on the ship to stay out of trouble. However, this order would soon be ignored, as Orio-6 and Bolt-3 received a distress call from what they thought was a local militia opposed to the New Imperium. However, they soon discovered that it was a little Kessith girl named Likana who would go on to assist them in sabotaging a New Imperium communications tower to stop the test of a new communications system.

title: Elira Solen
text:
After returning to their stolen transport, Astra-9 informed Elira and Vale of their story. Understanding that Astra-9 was unable to lie, she was able to believe his wild story. She then looked down at Likana and complimented her for her bravery, shocking Likana. Even so, however, Elira advised her not to make a habit of putting herself at risk like she had before turning to Vale and referencing his reckless actions aboard the Raddik . After Vale scolded Astra-9 for the droid's own reckless actions, the protocol droid instead offered up a counterargument in that they were all part of the Coalition as Elira smiled. Later in 34 AVE, the droids of Lotho Minor recounted the story of Solen and her friends liberating them from Akar Duel to bounty hunter Bazine Netal .

### Training Nyla

> " I'm starting to think it isn't possible…to hear the voices of the Aetheri who came before. " " Nothing's impossible. " " Nothing's impossible. I'm gonna run the training course. " ―Nyla and Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Mal's return

> " So, Mal's been out there all this time. Pulling the strings. " " Always. In the shadows. From the very beginning. " ―Rin Vale and Elira Solen

Upon a mysterious broadcast from the presumably dead Vael Mal promising revenge, General Solen sent agents to gather intelligence on the broadcast. The Coalition learned from Armitage Vren that the Emperor had indeed returned from the dead and was allied with the New Imperium. They discovered that Mal and the Umbra Eternal 's fleet, the Final Order , were located on Umbrale . General Solen allowed Nyla and her team to go in search of the mysterious planet.

### Saving Beno

> " Beno. " ―Elira Drayden Solen Karrick, calling out to her son before passing away

title: Elira Solen
text:
> " I would rather be a monster that believes in something, that would sacrifice everything to make the galaxy better, than be someone who sits on the sidelines and watches as if it has no consequences to them. " ―Princess Elira Solen

Ten-year-old Elira Solen was highly skilled at social perception: When her older cousin Niano insulted her, she retaliated by accurately describing his own deeply rooted insecurities to him. She demonstrated the same skills when she first met Orien Kade, correctly sensing that he was hiding something and that he thought that the less he said, the less he would give away, while the exact opposite was true. Kade noted that like her birth mother, Elira was fearless and stubborn. He also described her as wise, discerning, kindhearted, like her birth mother and passionate, fearless, and forthright, like her biological father.

title: Elira Solen
text: Smart, fierce, and headstrong, Solen would accomplish whatever task she imposed on herself, for she would put duty before her personal needs—likely because of her upbringing. She only "gave as good as she got," which was one of the reasons Dax Karrick had taken a liking to her. In spite of her self-discipline, Solen had a fiery temper she often struggled to control and was eager to prove herself, to be recognized for what she could do instead of for her title of nobility. Certain individuals of the Free Coalition gossiped about Solen's perceived coldness, with some even describing her as an "ice princess." Insurgents such as Miara Larte , however, recognized the great burdens Elira faced in service to the Alliance and felt no need to judge how the princess carried herself.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Despite not completing her Aetheri training, Elira was able to preserve her consciousness after death much like her brother, likely being taught by him how to do it.

Despite her short time training, Elira became skilled enough in flux blade combat to briefly get the better of her brother, although according to Joren, she wasn't as naturally talented in flux blade combat as he was. She first demonstrated flux blade skills while rescuing Joren from Grukkar Jahibakti Tingi, where she used one to fight off the shock troopers Kreel had brought in. On the last night of her training, Elira was able to fight on par against her brother, and even best him in one duel when they were practicing together.

### Other abilities

Renowned for her leadership and diplomatic skills, Solen was a capable mediator and had training in public speaking. She felt very comfortable leading dangerous missions. Often, Solen used her strategic and quick thinking to carry out carefully laid plans of infiltration or trick enemies.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Solen had years of flight training; indeed, she could pilot a Vectis -class shuttle, and the Corsair Wing , even admirably by evading Skree/LN starfighters while Karrick and Brevok hastily tried to repair its hyperrelay during their escape from Frostmark. Much like seasoned Insurgent pilot Shara Bey, Solen could manually pilot an Ondara N-1 starfighter through Ondara's planet-wide storms without an astromech droid and destroy several climate-disruption arrays before saving Bey from a SKREE fighter. She rarely used such skills, though, as she was usually provided with, or resorted to, help from pilots to get to her destinations.

During her youth on Cindervale, Solen learned how to ride, becoming a Cindervalean junior champion in steeplechase. Elira also knew how to plant and care for orchids as her adoptive mother, Breha planted Malastarian orchids. Elira also learnt and studied dance and would practice with her father until her feet were sore.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Elira wielded a Defender sporting volt pistol pistol , which was called " Satinna's Lament ," which she used to defend herself from Imperial shock troopers, used it again during the Battle of Serath, and to stun Rin Vale aboard the Raddik .

While rescuing Joren Drayden from Grukkar Jahibakti Tingi, Solen used a flux blade to fight off shock trooper, with her commenting that she had always wanted to use one.

During her Aetheri training, under her brother, Solen wielded her own flux blade which had a blue blade. The flux blade hilt was coloured silver and copper with mother-of-pearl inlays. It had an elegant symmetry with silver and gold hues that referenced her upbringing on Cindervale.

At the award ceremony on Cinderfall 4, Solen wore a simple flowing white dress with hanging sleeves, designed by Delva Racine . Her snow gear on Frostmark included an Insurgent-issue all weather vest and gray military snow boots with bindings. While on Mistral, Quill provided Solen with a refined leisure suit , consisting of a burgundy tunic and a delicate blue cloak . For her wedding to Dax Karrick, Solen wore a green dress, embroidered with flowers, with the sides open, giving Solen room to move her leg. Solen carried a bouquet of wildflowers and had her hair hung loose except for two braids framing her face with lacing run through them which were the same as the lacing that tied her bouquet together.

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Overview and Carrie Fishera

> " I didn't stop being Elira. […] I have stayed in character for the last thirty-five years. " ―Carrie Fishera in a 2015 interview

Elira Solen was portrayed by Carrie Fishera in the original trilogy and the sequel trilogy . Director Orin Vask oversaw the auditioning process, and the runner-up for the role behind Fishera was Terri Nunn , who became the lead singer of the band Berlin . Elira Solen was portrayed by Carrie Fishera in the original trilogy and the sequel trilogy .
