- Shoto flux blade —A shoto was a short flux blade. Featuring a shortened blade length, shotos were usually used as the secondary weapon in dual-blade combat . Guard shoto —A guard shoto was a flux blade with a hilt perpendicular to the blade that gave a unique way of blocking and attacking. - Lightwhip —A lightwhip had a flexible blade that was several meters long, and could entangle opponents.
- Two-piece flux blade —A single bladed flux blade that can separate into two pieces, with the main body and grip of the hilt in one part and the other bearing the emitter shroud. To use the flux blade, the user merely needed to insert the emitter section into the main body and twist to lock them together.
- Flux blade-volt pistol hybrid —A single bladed flux blade with an attachment that allowed it to fire volt pistol bolts.
- Darksaber —An unique ancient flux blade with a black blade that was flattened and came to a point like a traditional sword, rather than the rounded beam of standard flux blades.
- Sickle-bladed flux blade —A flux blade that produced a sickle-shaped blade.
- Lightfoil --A single handed slim flux blade used by early Makashi practitioners resembling a rapier.
- Contained energy axe —-A variation that resembles a vibro-ax which produces a plasma blade edge.

title: Flux blade
text: There also existed a type of volt pistol known as a flux blade rifle which was designed to be combined with a flux blade. To work, the user would insert a standard flux blade into a slot on top of the rifle. Once loaded, the weapon could fire powerful beams of energy that were highly destructive. Additionally, Aetheri Masters Reth-Oss-Van and Agen Kolar both owned a flux blade that had two different colored kyber crystals, allowing it to change colors from green to blue.

title: Flux blade
text: Korean animator Nelson Shen , who was working for DePatie–Freleng Enterprises at the time, was asked by his manager if he could animate the flux blade in the live action scenes of a film. After Shen accepted the assignment, the live action footage was given to him. He drew the flux blades with a rotoscope, an animation which was superimposed onto the footage of the physical flux blade blade prop. Shen explained to the people from Vask Pictures that since a flux blade is made of light, the sword should look "a little shaky" like a fluorescent tube. He suggested inserting one frame that was much lighter than the others while printing the film on an optical printer, making the light seem to vibrate. Shen also recommended adding a degausser sound on top of the other sounds for the weapon since the sound would be reminiscent of a magnetic field. The whole process took one week, surprising his company. Vask Pictures showed Shen the finished product, having followed his suggestions to use an X-Acto knife to give the flux blade a very sharp look, and to have sound accompany the weapon's movements.

title: Flux blade
text: The flux blade effects during the original trilogy started out in a very complicated manner. During the filming of First Dawn , the blade was made of a three-sided rod covered with reflective material. The rod was then rapidly spun by a compact motor in the hilt, reflecting the lights on set and creating an in-camera glowing effect. However, these props were highly limited; they were cumbersome and fragile, often breaking during fight scenes. Also, the glowing effect was not absolute, as whenever the blade moved out of the light or pointed more directly at the camera the glow disappeared and the actual spinning rod could be seen. In order to partially compensate for this loss of the effect, the blade was rotoscoped and an animated glow was added by tracing onto a blown-up copy of the frame with pen and colored ink, one frame at a time. It was at this phase that blades were given colors, as the props were simple white rods.

title: Flux blade
text:
During the filming of Rise of the Imperium , it was decided creating an in-camera glowing effect was more trouble than it was worth, so the spinning rods were swapped for carbon rods. While these new blades were less cumbersome than before, they were still very fragile and frequently broke. However, they continued to be used for Return of the Aetheri .

When filming began for Veiled Threat , the new flux blade blades were steel and aluminum rods, which were highly durable, but frequently bent and flexed, requiring constant replacement. Despite such a drawback, these rods still saw usage during the filming of Attack of the Replicas , as they had no alternative at the time. However, for the filming of Fury of the Umbra , the blades were replaced by carbon fiber rods laminated with glass and plastic. These new props were highly durable and didn't flex, though they were extremely hard, often causing bruising and leaving scars. While flux blade effects were still done by rotoscoping for the prequels , they were done digitally, rather than by hand.

title: Flux blade
text: In Return of the Aetheri , Joren's newly-constructed flux blade was colored blue during the initial editing of the film, and appears so in both an early movie trailer and the official theatrical posters, but in the final film, it was ultimately colored green in order to better stand out against the blue sky of Dunemere in outdoor scenes and to make it more obvious to the audience that the new flux blade was different from Joren's one in Rise of the Imperium . It also appeared as green in re-release posters. Both green and blue became standard blade colors for Aetheri flux blades in the Aetherion prequel trilogy. In the same regard, red became the standard Umbra flux blade blade. Drevan Koss 's purple flux blade , as first seen in Attack of the Replicas , was a personal request from actor Samuel L. Jackson as a way to make his character stand out among other Aetheri. Jackson's favorite color is purple and he frequently requests the characters he plays to use an item of the color in his movies. In addition, there are yellow, yellow-green, light-blue, black, and white blades. Such blades can visibly see seen in works like The Replica Wars and Insurgents animated series. The yellow flux blade blade made its live-action debut in the final scene of The Rise of Drayden , as the new weapon constructed by Nyla Drayden .

title: Flux blade
text:
Orange blades appear in the video game Aetherion Aetheri: Fallen Order , as did indigo, cyan, and magenta blades. At the direction of Dave Filono , orange-red flux blades appeared in the form of Shen Hadik and Baylan Skoll's flux blade blades in Sela . To Filono, the color signals to the audience that Hadik and Skoll are not characters who fulfill the same narrative role as the Umbra. As established by the novel Master & Apprentice , a flux blade with a kohlen crystal inside also produced an orange blade, but with an intensity that made it mostly useless against anything other than a specialized type of shield which was also powered by a kohlen crystal.

### Choreography

While the usage of flux blades was originally inspired by rapiers featured in the old serials Orin Vask enjoyed, the final choreography in First Dawn looked nothing like fencing. As Aetheri and their Umbra counterparts were heavily inspired by samurai , the fighting styles utilized were based more on kendo . The slower, more strength-oriented moves of kendo used in the Orien/Velgor duel also helped mesh with Vask' concept that it was a battle between what were essentially two old men.

title: Flux blade
text: During production on Attack of the Replicas , Gillard ran sparring matches with stars Evaan Gregan , Christopher Lee , and Hayden Kristano . One practice drill between Gregan and Gillard was captured in a photo later uploaded to Aetherion.com under the name "Spar Wars." It was during some of Gillard's training sessions with the actors that he was approached by animation director Rob Coleman for helping in figuring out Zho's fighting style: in the script Coleman was given, all it said about Zho and Varek's duel was that it would "[defy] description." With Orin Vask only able to tell him that he needed to figure out how it would be done, which Coleman later laughed about, he approached Gillard, with whom he spoke about real-world examples of fighting with small weapons. Additionally, Ahmed Best , best known as the actor behind Greeb Mool , gave Coleman several anime examples for help in figuring out the battle. Ultimately, he figured out Zho's speed and style upon watching a scene in the film Swordsman II .

title: Flux blade
text:
Zho pulling back his cloak to retrieve his flux blade came at Vask's request as it called to mind images of a gunslinger retrieving their pistol. Vask and Coleman were both very happy with the finalized duel between Zho and Varek, with Vask in specific approving of the way Zho jumped around because it was what he wanted. Coleman was nervous such actions would be seen as "too cartoony." When the screening he attended lit up with excitement at Zho's fighting style, Coleman was relieved.

### Aetherion: Visions

In the alternate history of " The Duel " and Ronin: A Visions Novel , Kouru wielded a flux blade parasol —a flux blade that used a flux blade auxiliary to produce multiple blades that sprung up from its sides like a parasol , which could also be used without the parasol auxiliary as a single-bladed flux blade.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### First years on the farm

> " And what of the boy?" " To Dunemere. To his family, send him. " ―Orien Kade and Zho discuss Drayden's future

Joren Drayden spent his youth on the Havel ' moisture farm, where his uncle unsuccessfully tried to discourage his adventurous tendencies, telling him that his father had been "a navigator on a spice freighter " during the Replica Wars. His aunt, Brue, would read him storybooks. One day, when his uncle had business in Port Kess , she took Drayden to Anchorhead to use the HoloNet connections there and show him images of forests , rivers, and oceans .

title: Joren Drayden
text: By the age of three in 16 BVE , Drayden had found pleasure playing with a model spaceship built especially for him. He did not know that Kade had actually built it and that Kade had been leaving several of them at his grandmother, Shira's sandblasted tombstone for his aunt to find. One morning, as Drayden played with his toy, a group of marauders attacked the farm . Orien Kade, who had been watching him from afar, sprang into action, cutting down several Gamorreans before coming to the realization that he was badly outnumbered. Just as he was about to be dealt a possibly killing blow by one of the gang, Drayden threw the toy starfighter he had been playing with, managing to distract the Gamorrean long enough for Kade to separate his feet from his ankles. The battle then raged further, slowly turning in the favor of the defenders which included Owen Havel, who managed to gun down several of the invaders with a volt pistol. Joren cried out after noticing that one of the marauders, a Devaronian , had snuck up behind Havel, ready to knock him out. Kade then threw his flux blade cutting the last marauder

title: Joren Drayden
text:
As Drayden got older, Owen and Brue started homeschooling him so he could stay close and learn the family trade. Despite this, he still kept up with Dunemere's podracing , swoop racing , and sky racing culture through comms stations and local chatter. He dreamed of what it would be like to one day be the pilot of a ship.

In 9 BVE , Kade looked in on Drayden via macrobinoculars around the same time that the Imperium's Wardens came to Dunemere looking for the Aetheri Nari . Drayden was tasked with a chore by Havel but instead disappeared causing Havel and Brue to wonder where he went. In reality, he had gone to the roof of one of the homestead wearing a mask and pretending he was piloting a space vehicle.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Warned of Sevander's coming attack , Owen and Brue hid Joren inside their house and claimed that it was the Tuskens who were coming, but Sevander ultimately fought past the aunt and uncle. With Sevander in pursuit, Joren fled into the desert but was knocked out by a fall. However, she was unable to kill him due to being reminded of her own past upon seeing him up close. With Sevander returning the boy to Owen, Brue, and the suddenly-back Kade, who had drawn on the hope of what Joren and Elira were capable of to triumph over Velgor on a barren moon before returning upon sensing that he was in danger, Joren was ushered back to the homestead by Owen and Brue. The following day, Kade stopped by to meet with Owen, who allowed Kade to finally meet the young Drayden.

#### Taking on Grukk's thugs

> " That right kid? You were trying to steal Grukk's water?" " It's not Grukk's. It belongs to the farmers , I was taking it back. " ―One of Grukk's thugs and Joren Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Saving Uncle Owen

> " Hang on, Uncle Owen! " ―Joren Drayden after rescuing his uncle

A year after the Great Drought, life carried on for Drayden on Dunemere. Alongside Biggs Darklighter and his other friends, Drayden flew his T-16 skyhopper for a joyride through Beggar's Canyon . Despite some daring moves, Drayden ended up crashing the vehicle, leading to his uncle Owen grounding him. Drayden offered to pay for the damage by flying in a race at nearby Anchorhead, but Havel stood his ground. Unbeknownst to both of them, Orien Kade used Duskkins to leave Drayden some skyhopper parts. An angry Owen returned the parts to Kade and told him to leave the family alone.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Some time after grounding Drayden from flying his skyhopper, Havel attempted to rebuild his relationship with his nephew by looking to help him fix it. However, before he could, he was captured by the Vorak bounty hunter Zazzik and tortured. Meanwhile, Drayden was running away from home for not the first time. However, he sensed something was wrong and rushed to his homestead. When he arrived, he found many droids destroyed and his aunt Brue rattled, telling him of the attack. She ordered her nephew to lock himself in the homestead's maintenance bay, where he found his disabled skyhopper. He proceeded to fix it and make his way to Zazzik and Owen. As he flew there, the Vorak was engaged by Orien Kade. During this battle, Owen was thrown off a cliff. Before he could hit the bottom, Drayden, in his skyhopper, managed to catch him and escape. Meanwhile, Kade defeated Zazzik. Afterwards, Drayden was allowed to fly his skyhopper once again.

#### Other adventures

> " Who…who are you? " " Beno Kade. You can call me Beno. I am an old friend of your father. " ―Joren Drayden and Orien "Beno" Kade, after the latter saves the former

title: Joren Drayden
text: Eventually, Drayden became an adventure-seeking youth who demonstrated his father's natural piloting skills, as well as a strong desire to leave Dunemere. At one point in his boyhood, Drayden was climbing in a canyon, but, when he grabbed the top, the rock broke off. Drayden fell into a cave, where he was seen by a group of womp rats and a krayt dragon , although he managed to escape the creatures. When Drayden was 12 years old in 7 BVE , he and his friend, Windy went off on their own through the Dunemere desert and wandered away from the moisture farms riding a dewback . The two encountered a sandstorm during their time outside and both lost consciousness. A krayt dragon was nearby when Drayden woke up, but they were saved by Kade, meeting him once more after two years. Drayden asked him who he was, and Kade revealed that his name was Beno Kade and an old friend of his father. Soon after, Drayden exhausted and with Windy, he returned safely to their homes, carried on a dewback.

title: Joren Drayden
text: As more of Drayden's friends left the planet to follow their dreams, he became increasingly frustrated that his uncle would not allow him to do the same, claiming that he still needed help with the farm. In truth, Owen was trying to prevent Drayden from following in his father's footsteps. In 2 BVE Drayden was helping at his foster parent's moisture farm when Brue called him inside. As Drayden ran back to the house, he was watched in the distance by Orien Kade, who was riding a dewback. Kade had just defeated and killed the former Umbra apprentice Vreth , who had a vendetta against Kade after being bisected at the torso during the Invasion of Ondara thirty years earlier . In his final moments, Vreth asked Kade if he was guarding Drayden. Kade affirmed that he believed Joren was the Seeded One before Vreth passed away.

title: Joren Drayden
text: In 1 BVE , Drayden was working on the family farm by repairing moisture vaporators with one of their WED Treadwell repair droid when he spotted a battle over Dunemere ; unknown to the young man, it was the Insurgent starship Tantiva IV being chased by the Imperial I -class Iron Cruiser Reckoning . Heading to Tosche Station, Drayden swapped stories with his friends, among them a visiting and recently-graduated Darklighter, who was reluctant to believe Drayden's claims about a battle upon looking up with Drayden's macrobinoculars and merely seeing the two craft sitting still in space. Nonetheless, Drayden was then eager to tell his friend of his recent exploits aboard his skyhopper in Beggar's Canyon, which Darklighter was amused by. After warning his friend not to crash the ship, he leaned close to Drayden to tell his old friend a great secret: he intended to defect from the Imperium to join the Free Coalition Starfighter Corps .

title: Joren Drayden
text: Still using their shock trooper guises, Drayden and Karrick convinced Brevok to pose as a prisoner and escorted him to Detention Block AA-23 (where Solen was being held.) They were able to rescue Solen, but their cover was blown and they had to jump into the garbage compactor in order to escape the pursuing Imperial forces. After Joren thrashed and struggled against the hold of the dianoga Omi , the group escaped the compactor and headed back to the Corsair Wing , but not before avoiding more troopers. Though Drayden and Solen were separated from Karrick and Brevok, they were able to reunite with their companions, and the droids, in the hangar bay.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Battle of Cinderfall

> " It'll be like old times, Joren. They'll never stop us. " ―Biggs Darklighter, to Joren Drayden, just before the Battle of Cinderfall

Upon their arrival at the Cinderfall base, they met with Commander Willard and Solen introduced him to Drayden so that he could join the Free Coalition as a pilot . Drayden then separated and met Torb Rask , who oversaw his flight simulation test. Lasting no more than 30 seconds , the more experienced pilot advised Drayden to listen to his explanations, and encouraged him not to give up. In his second try, Drayden used what he had learned from Rask, and managed to surpass the highest score, that of Rask', prompting Willard to accept him without objection. He joined Red Group with the designation of Red Five , which had previously belonged to a cadet named Pedrin Gaul , who had perished during the Battle of Halcyon several days earlier.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Just as the ceremony ended, Drayden told Solen to allow herself some time to grieve for the loss of her family and homeworld. Afterwards, General Jan Dodonna sent him and Rask, the only other survivor of Red Group, in their Vectors to retrieve the wayward princess and bring her to the Great Temple. Her shuttle's pilot, Evaan Verlaine , however, managed to outsmart them and make the jump to hyperspace with course to Ondara , with Bolt-3 accompanying the two women. They would later reunite after she had successfully accomplished her mission . Soon after, Drayden became an officer in the Alliance and was given the rank of Lieutenant and was regularly assigned numerous independent missions.

### Hero of Cinderfall

#### Balnab

> " You're the best smuggler we've got. " " You don't got me! I'm not part of the Insurgency! " ―Drayden and Karrick

title: Joren Drayden
text: Despite his assistance in the fight, Karrick largely divested himself from the Alliance after the Battle of Cinderfall. When Drayden heard that Karrick had camped out on Balnab , he and some members of the Insurgency briefly went there to meet him. Drayden approached Karrick and Brevok on the Corsair Wing , the latter roughing him up when he insulted the ship. Despite Karrick's prodding and boasting of getting his reward money, Drayden insisted that he was not running away from Insurgent life and had just come to see him. He asked Karrick for a favor to deliver a few crates to the Insurgency's surveillance outpost on Calumdarian . Karrick insisted that he was not a part of the Insurgency and did not want to do it, saying he had already done a mission for Solen and saved Drayden's life at Cinderfall. Drayden insisted that it was serious and that lives were at stake as Insurgent pilots started to bring the crates aboard the ship. Drayden pointed out that Karrick was the best smugger they had. While Karrick tried to insist that they did not have him because he was not a part of the Insurgency, Drayden thanked the pilots

title: Joren Drayden
text:
lives were at stake as Insurgent pilots started to bring the crates aboard the ship. Drayden pointed out that Karrick was the best smugger they had. While Karrick tried to insist that they did not have him because he was not a part of the Insurgency, Drayden thanked the pilots for bringing the crates on board as he left. Karrick ended up successfully completing the mission. #### Rion

> " Seriously, Princess. You have nothing to worry about. This is Dax Karrick you're talking to." "To be honest, I think that's why she's worried. " ―Dax Karrick and Joren Drayden, while talking to Elira Solen

Soon after the Battle of Cinderfall, in 0 AVE, Drayden, Karrick, and Brevok were sent on a mission by Princess Solen to negotiate supplies from the planet Rion . Solen put Drayden in charge, which surprised and peeved Karrick.
Once arrived on the planet, Karrick noticed that a big price could have been won by winning a swoop race. Drayden, however, thought that it was better to fulfill the mission without being distracted and risking to loose money.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Karrick decided to participate anyway and, unbeknownst to his friend, took some money with which they should have bought supplies and bought a swoop . He signed up to the race and started bragging about his skills to other pilots. Two pilots, however, understood that Karrick had a big bounty on his head and decided to sabotage the race and hand over the insurgent soldier to the Imperium.
In the meanwhile, Drayden ended the negotiations with Razian , an alien that should have provided the supplies to the Free Coalition, but noticed that half the credits were missing. He understood that Karrick took part to the race, and went to the stadium in which Karrick was racing. In the stands he heard two criminals talking about how they would knock Karrick out: Drayden and Brevok put the two criminals out of action, and Drayden went to help Karrick who was being targeted by his opponents who agreed to eliminate him. Karrick, helped by his friend, was able to win the race, and they could eventually pay Razian for the supplies.

#### The Desert Jewel

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### The Desert Jewel

> " Ever since the Battle of Cinderfall, I feel sometimes that people expect me to top it and wonder why I haven't yet. " ―Joren Drayden

In an errand for Admiral Gial Vorian , Drayden was dispatched to the planet Rodanor in order to open a secret weapon supply line for the Alliance. He was accompanied by Bolt-3 and a pilot named Nakari Kelen , and they flew her ship, the Desert Jewel . During their mission together, they helped a Kupohan ship—which, unknown to them at the time, carried vital intelligence on a Givin cryptographer named Drusil Bephorin —near Llanic . They then continued their journey to Rodanor. Drayden was greeted by Laneet Chekkoo , who guided him to Toopil . During business with Taneetch Soonta , the Rodanori told Drayden about the Aetheri, including a story about Kael during the Replica Wars. From her, Drayden received her uncle's flux blade .

title: Joren Drayden
text: After killing a ghest and getting some treatment for his wounds, Drayden focused on analyzing Huulik's flux blade and trying to learn telekinesis , but a planetwide alert for the Desert Jewel forced him to leave Rodanor immediately and meet up with Vorian and Solen on the Promise . The two assigned him to a mission to rescue Bephorin on Denon , but the need for upgrades for the Jewel prompted him to go on another mission to Fex with Kelen before that. Warned by Solen not to blindly trust Kelen, Drayden set off for Pasher with Kelen and Bolt-3 to receive intel from her father about their destination and the necessary equipment to survive its atmosphere. The two then headed towards Fex. Once they successfully retrieved the Harvester and were rewarded for it, Drayden and Kelen traveled to Rodanor to fix the Desert Jewel .

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Devaron

> " Hyperspace scout. Historian. Farm boy. And yet here you are with an Aetheri laser sword in your hand, like you mean to use it. " ―Sarco Plank

After numerous missions alongside Rask and earning each other's complete trust, Drayden assisted on a mission for Red Squadron above Giju : he helped protect a transport carrying underground insurgent leaders being evacuated from the planet, along with Rask and Commander Arhul Narra . Once the package was clear, they followed the scatter protocol, and Drayden and Bolt-3 set course to Devaron when he had a vision about future events on that same planet. He soon met with Rask and Narra, who sent him, Astra-9 and Bolt-3 on a mission for Chancellor Vela Sess .

title: Joren Drayden
text:
During his stay on the Temple, Drayden heard Kade's voice, from whom he received further instructions. He managed to enter a secret chamber where he and the droids found three training remotes. Using what Kade had taught him on the Corsair , Drayden gradually managed to pass the exercises after a few days, only to find himself surrounded by Imperials with orders to apprehend him and his fugitive starfighter , using Farnay as a hostage. However, Plank unexpectedly appeared and helped Drayden fight the shock troopers with his electrostaff , and observed that Drayden was merely an Adept . Planning to ransack the Temple to pay his debts, Plank then challenged him to a duel, during which he used a grenade to blind him, seeing that Drayden would not be defeated so easily. Prepared to administer the coup de grace, Farnay interrupted him, for which Plank put binders on her; however, it gave Drayden time to stand up and slash Plank's control box, casting him and his electrostaff into a pit leading to the temple's underlevels. Drayden then passed out and Farnay tended his wounds, to whom he swore he would become an Aetheri and rebuild the Order , and return to Eedit one day. With the droids, they left the Temple as Imperial reinforcements arrived afterwards. Drayden eventually kept his promise to Farnay and returned to Devaron accompanied by Astra-9 and Bolt-3. While there Joren also visited the Temple of Eedit once more.

Back in Tikaroo, Drayden reclaimed his now-repaired starfighter from Kivas, and before departing Devaron, he dropped several bombs at the base of the spire to cut off the paths into the jungle, meaning to stop the pikhron hunt.

#### Hradeek

title: Joren Drayden
text: many dead corpses lay, noticing that in the middle of it there was a very old crossguard flux blade . Once he took the weapon, several shock troopers entered in the room and he acknowledged that Bolt had been right to worry. Drayden ignited the flux blade , which unbeknownst to him was one of Vael Atrio 's, and slaughtered all the Imperial troopers. After killing the last one, Drayden was surprised by the unnatural anger that he had felt and told to Bolt-3 that, during the battle, it was like he was watching without being able to stop himself, but that now he was fine.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
a holoprojection of Drayden in the race, a flight that the commentator said no one had "ever seen anything like it", Velgor calling it "most impressive." Velgor watched as one of the engines blew up and left Drayden stuck traveling on foot. He ignited the red-bladed flux blade he had found, but was able to control his anger and, to avoid it to overwhelm him again, destroyed it with his blue-bladed flux blade. He was then rescued by a Vector piloted by Bolt-3, where Velgor had walked outside and watched the fighter leave. #### Searching for a base

Bogara

> " You fought well, insurgent scum. But the Imperium always wins. " ―A shock trooper, moments before defeat

title: Joren Drayden
text:
animal led them to a group of shock troopers who were dealing with animals of the same species, making it clear that the Imperium knew the world. Along with Elira, Joren defeated the shock troopers, who intended to sell the animals on the black market, and then left the planet to continue his mission to verify the planets assigned to him. Lotho Minor

> " I'm not sure there's much to give up on, Elira. Unless we want to make a base out of scrap metal. " ―Joren Drayden to Dax Karrick

At some point Joren, Elira, Dax, Brevok, and Astra-9, were sent by the Alliance to investigate the planet Lotho Minor for a new base, traveling on the Corsair Wing . Drayden did not think there was anything worthwhile on the planet and that it would not lend well to a base, but Karrick warned him to keep a look out on the planet. Hearing strange noises, Drayden activated his flux blade and warned the others. They were then approached by native droids and a Kessith named Akar Duel .

title: Joren Drayden
text:
After Duel announced his plans to take the Corsair for himself with the help of the droids Teetee , Doc and others, Astra-9 ran from the ship calling Drayden's name and informing him that his initial scans had been incorrect and that there was life on Lotho Minor. After seeing that thee protocol droid was acting without asking for permission or wearing a restraining bolt, the droids of the planet turned on duel, allowing Drayden and his friends to escape on the Corsair , and leaving them believing that the planet was not a good location for a new insurgent base.

Kudo

> " That was good thinking, sending the droids out with a cover story. " ―Drayden, to Karrick

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Determined to fight Velgor for killing his father and Kade, he heard his mentor's voice speak to him from beyond, telling him to run, just as he faced the Dark Lord . However, he was no match for Velgor, who quickly seized Drayden's flux blade and was about to kill him, until he realized that Drayden's flux blade had been once his own. Karrick then intervened with an Ironclad Walker , crashing the walker through the factory's walls, giving Drayden and the slaves an opening to escape from the facility.

Seeing so many of the freed slaves die by Imperial fire, Drayden regretted his decision, but continued fighting after stealing a speeder bike . After the Insurgents' walker opened fire against Velgor, Drayden picked his flux blade up from the rubble, rushed to assist his team—whose walker had fallen down due to Velgor—, and provided some cover fire. Determined to destroy the factory, Drayden disobeyed Solen's orders and used his stolen speeder bike to destroy the power core despite Velgor's threat. Afterwards, he managed to board the Corsair Wing , reunite with his team and escape Cymoon 1, yet with his morale at rock bottom.

#### Return to Dunemere

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Return to Dunemere

> " "There's nothing here for me now." That's what I said when I left this place. Let's hope I was wrong . " ―Joren Drayden

Once they returned to the Alliance Fleet , Drayden continued working on his flux blade techniques until Solen came to see him. Drayden told her that he lacked interest in undertaking any more missions, as he did not consider himself an Aetheri but a danger, and that until he could figure out who he was, he could not be around the Alliance; he asked Solen to let him go. Much to her and Karrick's dismay, Drayden (along with Bolt-3) took off in a Vector and set off on a course for Dunemere. Hoping to find some guidance in Kade's hut, Drayden and Bolt made their way across the desert to the abandoned residence, where they found it being pillaged by Dunefolk raiders, who fled in fear upon seeing his activated flux blade.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Inside the hut, Drayden had Bolt scan the ransacked place for anything of value, and the small android came across a box addressed to Drayden. However, before they could find out its contents, one of Vex Vark 's flash grenades incapacitated Bolt-3 and blinded Drayden. Vark proceeded to aim a rifle to his head, but Drayden fought back with his flux blade despite his temporary blindness. Despite his disadvantage and multiple wounds done by Vark, Drayden managed to deflect the bounty hunter's shot at point-blank and Vark tackled him in anger.

Close to death by his own flux blade as he struggled against Vark, Bolt-3 saved him by hurling Kade's box and knocking the hunter out. Still blinded and carrying the box, Drayden had Bolt-3 lead him to his Vector. On his way to an unknown location, he read some of Kade's passages on his journals , including one set during the Great Drought involving him.

#### Showdown on Nar Shaddaa

> " You want to finally be an Aetheri Knight, kid? Here's your chance. Go die like one. " ―Kreel to Joren Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text: and demanded that they cease their attack, while the bartender asked where he acquired an Aetheri's flux blade. He did not answer, instead saying that he was simply on Nar Shaddaa to conduct business and had already stated his purpose for entering the establishment. The bartender guessed that Drayden was seeking entry into the Aetheri Sanctum, meaning he would need to hire someone who could sneak him onto the capital world of the Imperium. The bartender told him that he could do that for the boy, but the price would be the flux blade—a price that Drayden rejected, so the bartender resorted to his previous plan of killing and robbing the boy.

title: Joren Drayden
text: With Drayden having proved himself, Grukkar believed he would make a fine addition to his collection as the last living Aetheri. Grukkar planned to put Drayden into an arena fight that he would bill as the death of the last Aetheri, so the Grak ordered him taken to the arena's gamemaster to be prepared. Bolt-3, knowing that Drayden had been captured, send a distress call to the Alliance Fleet, where it was intercepted by the High Command. Though Chancellor Sess was unwilling to send a team of Insurgents on a suicide mission despite Drayden's importance to the Insurgency, Brevok and Astra-9—who remained with the fleet while Karrick and Solen were on their own mission—volunteered to rescue their captured friend.

title: Joren Drayden
text: The gamemaster—secretly an Imperial shock trooper named Sergeant Kreel —introduced himself to Drayden once the Aetheri was led to the arena, and he stated that it was his job to make sure Drayden was prepared to put on a good show before ultimately dying in the arena. Though Drayden initially refused to fight, Kreel knew he would ultimately do so because he wanted to learn to hone his skills as an Aetheri. The Kreel also told him that the Aetheri Sanctum no longer existed, as it had been converted into the Imperial Palace—so whatever Drayden was hoping to find was gone, as were the other Aetheri temples in the galaxy. He then threw the flux blade to Drayden and removed the binds that the boy's hands were in. While surrounded by MagnaGuards, the Kreel used a flux blade of his own and engaged in a duel to begin preparing him for the arena match. Though the Kreel was not an Aetheri, he was a more-skilled swordsman and quickly bested Drayden. Drayden then engaged multiple MagnaGuards in combat.

title: Joren Drayden
text: The big event soon arrived, and crime lords and other criminal types flocked to watch the death of the last Aetheri. Drayden spoke to Grukkar, who reminded him that no one wanted to watch him win and that everyone had paid to see him die, though the young Aetheri believed he could succeed nonetheless. Grukkar also revealed that scavengers had found Drayden's Vector and the Journal of Beno Kade, which Grukkar intended to add to his collection. The event began once Grukkar left, and Drayden entered into the arena and was introduced as the last of the Aetheri. The announcer claimed that he was a veteran of battles across the galaxy and that he had fought Graks and bounty hunters alike, hyping up the untrained Aetheri hopeful. The announcer then introduced the Aetheri's opponent: Kongo the Disemboweler, a large and fearsome creature from the dolovite mines of Emberfall . Drayden ignited the green-bladed flux blade that was given to him for the show and the fight began. The young Aetheri slashed his blade at the creature, but the opponent's armor was resistant to a flux blade blade and made it difficult for Drayden to combat the creature. He remained confident,

title: Joren Drayden
text: The beast grabbed Drayden as the audience cheered for Kongo to make the kill, and Drayden tried calling out to Kade to ask for miracle. Just as he did so, the beast's shock collar was activated by Kreel, who revealed himself to Grukkar as an Imperial and announced he was taking Drayden into custody. Shock troopers poured into the arena and surrounded Drayden, arresting both him and the Grak. Grukkar had one trick up his sleeve, though, and triggered an electromagnetic pulse that disabled the Imperials' volt pistols. Grukkar, skilled at combat in his own right, began fighting the weaponless shock troopers, while other troops grabbed Drayden. Just then, the young Aetheri saw that Bolt-3, who had infiltrated the palace, recovered his flux blade and threw it into the arena, so Drayden grabbed it and cut the soldiers down. Kongo chased the spectators out of the arena, and Drayden while Kreel confronted Drayden, knocking him to the ground and revealing his true identity as a shock trooper of the 501st Legion tasked with arresting him. Drayden was saved by the timely arrival of Grukkar, who Kreel attacked as Drayden got away.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden regrouped with Karrick, Solen, Brevok, and the droids, all of whom ultimately traveled to Nar Shaddaa to rescue their captive friend. Karrick, Solen, and Brevok each wielded flux blades that Bolt-3 stole from the palace so they were not defenseless in the wake of the EMP blast, leading Drayden to quip that Karrick looked good with a flux blade. Bolt-3 recovered Kade's journal and Drayden wanted to go back to the palace to recover more artifacts, but the arena was flooded with volt pistol-wielding shock troopers so Brevok grabbed the resistant Drayden and brought him out of the arena. The Insurgents returned to the Corsair Wing and escaped from Nar Shaddaa.

#### Vrogas Vas

> " …right now I'm just an Insurgent pilot who needs to help his friends. Learning to be an Aetheri will have to wait. " ―Drayden, to Bolt-3

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden and Velgor both survived the crashes of their starfighters, though they impacted on the surface in different places. The young Aetheri crashed outside of the ruins of the Aetheri Sanctum, from which he witnessed the destruction of Gray Squadron forces sent to attack Velgor—part of a major Insurgent operation to capture the lone Umbra Lord. He put off his search for answers and began to make his way towards the Insurgent forces, determined to help his friends. As he passed through the ruins of the Aetheri Sanctum, he could see yet another Insurgent pilot being killed by the Dark Lord. Unknown to Drayden was that, at the same time, he was being tracked by Velgor's companions—Vexa and the assassin droids VT-1 and 0-0-0 . While the Umbra Lord's followers prepared a plan to capture the boy, Drayden found writings in the ruins that were written with a flux blade, letting him deduce that the ruins were from the Aetheri. A cold feeling passed over him and he could sense the presence of what he thought was Orien Kade and Kael Drayden. He tried to concentrate, but he was interrupted by what he thought was Astra-9's arrival. In reality, it

title: Joren Drayden
text:
letting him deduce that the ruins were from the Aetheri. A cold feeling passed over him and he could sense the presence of what he thought was Orien Kade and Kael Drayden. He tried to concentrate, but he was interrupted by what he thought was Astra-9's arrival. In reality, it was Triple-Zero, painted in gold by Vexa, who placed his metal hand on Drayden and sent an electrical charge through the boy's body, knocking him unconscious. Vexa and Triple-Zero prepared to take Drayden hostage when Bolt-3 stepped in to help. Bee Tee then brought his arsenal to bear on the insurgent's astromech and chased him off. Vexa and Triple-Zero then seized Drayden but were stopped by the smuggler Dax Karrick, who had a sniper rifle aimed at them. Brevok then came in and attacked the protocol droid, ripping his arm off. Drayden then regained consciousness, dispatched Bee Tee, and sliced off Triple-Zero's other arm with his flux blade. Drayden and his allies then retreated when Bee Tee fired his weapons blindly.

Drayden, Karrick, Brevok, and Bolt-3 made their way back to the Corsair Wing. They then lifted off in order to aid princess Elira. They were forced to the ground when their ship was crashed into by the Vorak bounty hunter Black Zazzik. While Karrick and Brevok dealt with the mercenary, Drayden left to head back to the Aetheri ruins.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Learning the ways of the smuggler

> " How else are we gonna replace the money we just lost? " " Heh, don't worry, kid. I know just the thing. It's a big galaxy. And believe me, there's always something somewhere in need of smuggling. " ―Drayden and Karrick

Upon returning to the Insurgent fleet with their new prisoner, Doctor Vexa, Drayden and his friends went their separate ways; Solen, Bolt-3, and Astra-9 went to detain Vexa at an Alliance-controlled space station, Sunspot Prison , with the assistance of Sana Starric , whom Solen hired to transport them to the prison. Meanwhile, Karrick and Drayden were dispatched to buy supplies for the insurgency. Karrick attempted to double the money he was given for supplies by betting on sabacc . However, he was caught cheating, and had to escape with Drayden on the Corsair Wing .

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden and Karrick traveled to Nar Shaddaa where Joren was tasked with finding a customer in need of a ship. He made a deal to haul nerfs to Ibaar for 5,000 credits, which was just enough to replace the credits lost by Karrick. Drayden and Karrick were soon intercepted by SKREE fighters who suspected the Corsair of smuggling illegal livestock. Joren was able to shoot the fighters and he and Karrick made it to Ibaar with the nerfs. While on Ibaar, Drayden blackmailed Karrick into allowing him to fly the Corsair for a few parsecs by threatening to tell Elira about losing the credits in a Sabacc game.

After buying the supplies, Drayden and Karrick received a distress call from Sana and arrived at Sunspot Prison. They were immediately knocked out and taken captive by the masked assailant who was attacking the prison. Neither came to until after the battle had already ended and the attacker had been captured.

#### Temporary outpost

> " I just go word that the cargo vessel just arrived. Looks like the mission was canceled. Hope you didn't go through too much trouble. " ―Joren Drayden to Bolt-3

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Temporary outpost

> " I just go word that the cargo vessel just arrived. Looks like the mission was canceled. Hope you didn't go through too much trouble. " ―Joren Drayden to Bolt-3

Sometime after the assault on Sunspot Prison, the Alliance established a temporary outpost on the Outer Reach planet Reamma . Solen gave Joren a mission to find a missing Alliance cargo vessel. Drayden and Bolt-3 prepared to make the flight to look for them. Before they could do that, however, Solen informed Drayden that the vessel reported in, cancelling the mission.

#### Hijacking the Harbinger

> " Chances are...This is the last voyage of the Harbinger . So let's make it a memorable one. " ―Drayden to Solen and Karrick

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Hijacking the Harbinger

> " Chances are...This is the last voyage of the Harbinger . So let's make it a memorable one. " ―Drayden to Solen and Karrick

Sometime later, Drayden and Solen rendezvoused with insurgent leadership. Admiral Vorian, General Dodonna, and Vela Sess presented them with the task of providing aid to the people of Tureen VII , a planet that had provided aid to the insurgency in the past. A heavily blockaded planet with Imperial bases on both of its moons and swarms of SKREE fighters in orbit, the Alliance could not risk sending the fleet. Joren and Elira proposed stealing an Imperial Iron Cruiser and using it to infiltrate the blockade. Despite some reluctance from Dodonna, Vorian and Sess realized that it was the only choice left.

#### Skorii-Lei Rescue

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Skorii-Lei Rescue

Afer the hijacking of the Harbinger , Elira ended up grievously injured on the planet Skorii-Lei . Cared for by former engineer Pash Davane and carrying vital Alliance information, Solen was pursued by shock troopers and barely managed to escape aboard the Corsair Wing with Drayden, Karrick, and Brevok. Aboard the Corsair , Davane provided Drayden with Elira's data tape, which he noted was a sign of great trust between the two of them. With her place as a friend of the Alliance confirmed, Drayden and his allies returned Davane to her home on Skorii-Lei.

#### Journey to Vagadarr system

> " You remind me of him. But more than that... you remind me of me. You... you're nothing but a frightened child, just like I was. Do you know the only thing I was good at... when I was a child? Walking away. " ―Garro to Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text:
> " You remind me of him. But more than that... you remind me of me. You... you're nothing but a frightened child, just like I was. Do you know the only thing I was good at... when I was a child? Walking away. " ―Garro to Drayden

Despite the escape from the Harbinger , the heroes quickly realized that Astra-9 was captured during the commotion, and Drayden was unable to stop Bolt-3 from commandeering a Vector to rescue the protocol droid on his own. With his own Vector's hyperrelay temporarily disabled, he resumed reading Beno Kade's journal. Identifying a symbol in the journal as a star map , Drayden decided to visit the Vagadarr system after reading of an Aetheri Master who had ventured there in the past and encountered enormous giants made of living stone that gave those in close proximity a power known as Stonepower . Drayden hoped that going there would give him the knowledge he needed to save Bolt-3 and Astra-9.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Sometime later, as the Alliance was setting up a temporary outpost on Horox III , Drayden went to a local bar . Threatened by its denizens for being a human, he was forced to defend himself against them despite his warnings that he would be able to defeat them in a fight. The fight was compounded when Doctor Vexa, who had lied to Sana Starric in order to find Drayden, arrived and sparked the anger of the entire bar after saying Drayden was with her, forcing Drayden, Vexa, and Black Zazzik to fight the entire bar. After the fight, Drayden told Vexa he did not want her following him because he did not want to have anything to do with someone who worked for Velgor, but she caught his attention by saying she knew where to find an Aetheri Master.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Meanwhile, at the Insurgent Outpost on Horox III, Karrick then enlisted Starric' help in communicating with Drayden's temporary R5 astromech droid S4 , who could only speak Binary and thus was not easily able to communicate with Solen. Solen asked the droid for Drayden's whereabouts but the droid responded that he could not tell. Questioning the droid, Starric learned that Drayden did not go by himself but that he went with Doctor Vexa. An unhappy Elira and Karrick wondered why Drayden would go with Vexa, Solen suggesting she kidnapped Drayden while Karrick and Starric suspect she could have reprogrammed the droid to keep a secret.

#### The Screaming Citadel

The Queeen of Ktath'atn

> " I know every sort of creature you can image, Doctor. And many I'm sure you cannot. They have all been paraded through the halls of this citadel. All by people desperate to gain my favor. But never once has anyone brought me an Aetheri " ―The Queen of Ktath'atn to Drayden and Vexa

title: Joren Drayden
text: After arriving on Ktath'atn, Drayden and the others encountered a mob of villagers. Drayden wants to help feed them and Vexa just calls him adorable and has Zazzik scare them off. After making the trek to the the entire party, except for Zazzik were allowed into the citadel. Drayden was curious how Vexa met Zazzik but she just said it was a long story and that she owed him a lot of money. Drayden then asked how Vexa had found him. Noticing he was struggling, Vexa helped Drayden put his Spavat on to meet the Queen, and after finished he insisted that he was more than just a farm boy. While walking toward the main hall, 0-0-0 teased Drayden for stuttering when Vexa commented on her attractiveness but she told the droid only she was allowed to tease him.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
were Abersyn symbiotes that the Queen planned on implanting them with, so after Vexa set off an explosion that knocked them both down they quickly made an attempt to escape while Vexa explained to Drayden what the symbiotes were. Before they could escape, in the Citadel's hallway, they were nearly stopped by many of the Queen's thralls. The Abersyn hive

> " You're not an Aetheri. You just know what an Aetheri knows. That's not enough. Knowing isn't enough. Being an Aetheri is about being . Letting go…feeling…and more than anything…the Aetheri feel free. " ―Drayden, to Eternal Rur After attempting to run, Drayden prepared to use his flux blade to defend them, but Karrick, Solen, and Starric arrived at their location on Vexa's ship, the Ark Angel II , with her droids 0-0-0 and VT-1 in tow. Starric attempted to shoot Vexa, but Drayden blocked the blast with his flux blade, claiming that she was a good person and his friend, he willingly went with her, and he knew what he was doing, despite Solen's attempts to call his decision unwise and threats to court-martial him if he did not follow orders. Meanwhile, the Queen's servants and armed security guards pursued the group, so they escaped into an Abersyn symbiote laboratory, which Drayden decided people needed to know about. There, Drayden and Vexa got into an argument about the merits of the Imperium in which Vexa revealed her mother was killed in the Replica Wars, claimed that regular people preferred the Imperium's peace to war, and insisted that she was not like Karrick as Drayden thought. She attempted to mock him for his upbringing until Drayden revealed everyone on his farm was killed by the Imperium. Vexa led Drayden to a nearby room and sold him out to

title: Joren Drayden
text: people preferred the Imperium's peace to war, and insisted that she was not like Karrick as Drayden thought. She attempted to mock him for his upbringing until Drayden revealed everyone on his farm was killed by the Imperium. Vexa led Drayden to a nearby room and sold him out to the Queen of Ktath'atn, who promptly mesmerized him to capture him. Vexa warned the Queen not to do the same to her too or she would blow up charges she placed in Drayden's pockets. Solen, Karrick, and Starric then saw Drayden get captured, the former calling out to him and later refusing to leave him behind.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden later took part in a mission with Elira, piloting a Taylander shuttle with the princess. With Imperial SKREE Fighters in pursuit, Drayden was forced to fly into a nebula , which disabled the shuttle's systems, forcing them to crash land on an ocean planet . Stranded on the planet for three weeks , Drayden's experience with machinery, such as moisture vaporators helped keep himself and Elira alive. Having to live off of the land, the two grew closer, relating to each other because of their status as orphans. They eventually realized that there was a native species living in the planet's ocean. Not wanting to bring the war to these people, Drayden and Solen set a trap for the Imperial forces that were pursuing them. Joren used the native's resources, as well as his own flux blade, to fend off an Ironclad Walker and shoretroopers . Although close to being defeated, Elira used a flaming arrow to light explosive chemicals and disable the Ironclad Walker . Afterwards, they were able to repair the shuttle and return to the Insurgent Fleet.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Benthic questioned why the Alliance would attempt to mend their relations with the Partisans and return to Embermoor, and Elira revealed that the Imperium had resumed mining Kyber crystals on the planet and that the Alliance hoped to aid the Partisans in fighting against the Imperium. Though wary of Alliance support, Benthic was nonetheless willing to accept some aid. Joren, shaken by the Partisans' extreme methods, was conflicted by agreeing to help them, but specforces operative Ubin Des reassured him that it was the right thing to do. Later in the ruined settlement of Ai-jed , Joren, Chulco, and Ubin contemplated why people would stay on a ruined planet. Shock troopers armed with flamethrowers attempted to incinerate the remaining civilians, but Joren lashed out against them with his flux blade, cutting them all down. Realizing all that was at stake in the Galactic Civil War, Drayden approached Benthic with Dax Karrick and wholeheartedly agreed to assist him in his fight. Their first target was the drill citadel , a mining device from the planet Shu-Torun that the Imperium began using to mine Kyber crystals on Embermoor.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Saltmark

> " I'm just a farmboy from Dunemere. One of many sand-planet farmboys. But one thing was true there, just like it's true here. When someone comes for what's our, they don't try it twice. We work an honest day and long one. We're the good guys. But you wouldn't want to meet us in the dark. Where I come from—when someone pushes you, you push back harder! " ―Drayden to Kreel while dueling him After a mission with a plan made by Karrick went awry, Drayden, who had helped fight in his Vector, escaped to Baraan-Fa with the rest of the Alliance. Solen then put him in charge of a mission to the planet Saltmark to survey its facilities as a base. Drayden, flying there in a GR-75 medium transport , believed the mission was just delivering farm equipment, and was reluctant to go there as he directed those on the mission to land. Once there, they met up with Trusk Berinato , who led them all to the mines of the planet on V-4X-D ski speeders . After receiving new orders from Solen, Joren stated that he found the mission particularly irritating, as it reminded him of his life as a farm boy. Once they arrived, Karrick encouraged him to enjoy the mission since they were not in danger. He told everyone to follow him.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden and his team, which included Rask, began using the farming equipment to make trenches in Saltmark's surface, though he said he would rather do anything else. Green worms then appeared from the ground and Rask and Karrick tried to shoot them, but Drayden realized they would leave you alone if you left them alone. Still being reminded of home, Drayden reluctantly continued an environmental assessment, discovering and rationalizing an underground ecosystem where the worms came from and realizing it was drying up quickly. Following a hunch, Drayden took Rask with him on the ski speeders and they discovered bodies that appeared to have been flash dried. Realizing what happened, Drayden rushed to tell the others. He reached Solen and told her he resented her for sending him on this mission, but she said he reminded him of her and complimented him before giving him a kiss on the cheek. He then finished what he was trying to say and explained that they need to leave because a deadly salt storm was coming in. After Drayden realized Berinato forged environmental reports, Karrick warned that Berinato called SCAR squadron on them.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden got in a ski speeder and attempted to shoot at the incoming troopers, but one shot a canon at his and destroyed it. Kreel then approached him and ignited his flux blade, a determined Drayden lighting his too. The two dueled, Drayden turning Kreel's taunts against him by taking pride in being a farm boy as they were hard working good people who would push you back harder if you pushed them. The worms he saw earlier then tackled Kreel and Drayden cut the shock trooper's flux blade in half. Drayden made his way back to the Corsair and revealed that SCAR squadron lived, but that they needed to get out of the storm or they would die. Later, in orbit on the Corsair , Solen asked how Drayden was and he said that he was the same, living a small life and trying to make a difference. She told him not to change.

#### Mon Calvarra and Mako-Ta

> " I guess you don't need a wingman anymore. " " WEDGE! " " I thought you'd forgotten me! " " No way! Red squadron forever! " ―Wedge Antiles and Drayden reunite

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden joined Solen, Karrick, Vorian and others to meet with Grand Admiral Dors Urtya of the Mon Calvarra Mercantile Fleet at an island preserve on Mon Calvarra with the hope of getting the fleet to join the Insurgency. Drayden was surprised the Imperium cared about nature preservation, but Solen clarified that they wanted to exploit it. After Dax revealed he used to smuggle from there, which upset Drayden, Vorian and Solen began to negotiate as an Imperial LAAT/le patrol gunship approached. Drayden immediately assumed they had been betrayed, but Karrick thought otherwise and advised Drayden not to use his flux blade while he spoke with them. It fired on Urtya's ship, the explosion knocking Drayden down. When Karrick's plan resulted in shock troopers pursuing them, Drayden went with the others through the forest to a boat where Brevok was waiting. On the boat, Solen continued to try an convince Urtya, but he said that he did not want to sacrifice Mon Calvarra, but Drayden shot back, insisting he could not talk to the Princess of Cindervale about sacrifice. They eventually made it back to the Corsair and then to the Mako-Ta Space Docks that the Insurgency was using as a

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Mon Cal Mutiny

> " The King… He couldn't be moved. He was too ill. " […] " But we've got his last words. If this doesn't inspire Mon Calvarra, nothing will. " " It has to be worth it. So many people are counting on us. " ―Drayden and Solen to Astra-9 on King Liarch Once there, Drayden commented that it made sense they would keep Liarch on a water world, though admitted the place looked bleak. After avoiding the planet's security using Hubi's biosignature, they took the ship to the planet and underwater, where they encountered a giant terrifying sea creature. Solen realized that the creature was attracted to their ship because of the light. Karrick was skeptical, but Drayden told him not to question her and informed them he was going to carry out a plan with Brevok's help and to be ready. Donning a full body diving suit while Brevok set up an underwater sled, Drayden shot out far away from the ship after Brevok gave Drayden a hug and he thanked the Vorak. Away from the ship in the expanse of the ocean, Drayden ignited his flux blade, leading the creature away with the light. Brevok then used a water sled and a breath mask to quickly go after Drayden and bring him back to the ship as he turned off his flux blade.

title: Joren Drayden
text: With the creature distracted, they all safely made it to the underwater base, where he commented that hope and luck were working out for them. They then discovered that Liarch was hooked up to a machine that was the only thing keeping him alive, and Karrick said Drayden jinxed them. Drayden attempted to calm an angry Karrick, and Liarch suggested that they could just carry his words to his people instead of having to lead them directly, prompting Drayden to suggest they search for a recording droid there. After bringing back a camera droid, Drayden watched as the King recorded his message, before noticing shock troopers and screaming out to everyone that they had been noticed. The shock troopers shot into the room, killing Liarch, but the group escaped with the recording back to their ship, Drayden defending them with a volt pistol and directing them to get onboard and get to hyperspace quickly. He then pointed out that the Corsair with its touchy hyperrelay would not have been able to pull that off, but Karrick warned him to stop disparaging the ship.

title: Joren Drayden
text: They met back up with Astra-9 in a deserted cove on Mon Calvarra, Drayden revealing to the droid that the king could not be moved but having hope that his message was worth it because people were counting on them. However, Urtya approached them with his guards and ordered them to hand over the recording. As he forcefully took it from Solen, Drayden screamed that Liarch would be ashamed, though Karrick told him to top talking and that they needed to get out of there. However, Urtya decided to show the footage too all of the fleet captains. Back on the Corsair , Drayden heard on an earpiece that the people on the Calavane ships were rebelling because of footage of Liarch. Because of this, however, the Imperial fleet arrived.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Later, on the Corsair , Drayden revealed that they were getting a message from the regent on the planet. The regent apologized for acting without warning and revealed he had called the Insurgent fleet. As the fleet arrived, Drayden and Solen got into gunning positions for the Corsair . Drayden tried to ask her if she remembered what to do, but she had already begun shooting. Seeing SKREE bombers approach, Karrick told Drayden he was going to give him an angle to take them out, and Drayden successfully did. Antilies then commed the Corsair and asked if they were having trouble, but Drayden just expressed his happiness that he was there and promised to buy him a drink after they made it out of their situation. Drayden kept shooting to help protect jetisonned escape pods, and the Corsair escaped to hyperspace after a Calavane ship full of coaxium crashed into the Iron Cruiser and exploded it. Later, Drayden accompanied Solen, Karrick, and Brevok to see Arpagin off on the Cosmatanic Steppes .

#### Renegade Squadron

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Renegade Squadron

> " No time for sentiment, Joren. […] So, flight leader…what's our call sign? " " You know, Wedge, if we're acting like Jessa Arsa, I have to disagree. It is time for sentiment. Renegade Squadron, form up. " ―Torb Rask and Drayden, as the latter forms Renegade Squadron

Later, Drayden participated in a celebration of the commencement of the Insurgent fleet at the Insurgent Base at Mako-Ta, using his Vector to create a display trail of blue light alongside other Vectors creating trails of other colors. After landing back in the hangar bay, Drayden expressed his enthusiasm that amount Insurgents present could definitively defeat the Imperium, though had to assure General Dodonna that he was not being overconfident and was just excited. However, due to a betrayal by Queen Triova of Shu-Torun, the commencement failed and the Imperial Navy arrived, which Drayden saw from a window and suspected was led by Velgor. He prepared to get in his Vector and fight, assuring Bolt that everything would be fine, but the bay doors were sabotaged by Triova and kept them trapped there.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Knowing that they needed to spread the word to the other cruisers that they could launch their fighters but not wanting to split up to land on them, Drayden told Renegade Squadron to form up on him as he made a run past Vorian's ship with his display trail on, ignoring Rask' warnings against it. As Vorian watched, his attention grabbed by the display trail, Drayden flew toward the bay doors on one of the cruisers, which opened. Seeing this, Vorian moved to communicate this so that all of the cruisers could deploy their fighters. Karrick then announced to Drayden that the Corsair was too damaged and so he was flying a Vector.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden pursued a rogue SKREE fighter that had escaped, and that unbeknownst to him was piloted by Solen, who decided to take it while fleeing Velgor and his Iron Cruiser the Sovereign . Sensing something was off and noticing the pilot's skill, Drayden had Bolt try and scan and message it, to no avail. When Organ shot down another SKREE, Drayden realized the pilot was on their side. He ordered Renegade Squadron to form up and protect the SKREE as it came in to land on a cruiser, knowing it needed Insurgent transponders surrounding it for the bay doors to open. This was successful, but Drayden's fighter was shot as he did this and crashed into the bay. Karrick and Solen rushed to make sure he was all right, leaving Drayden shocked Solen had been piloting the SKREE, but all of them were happy things worked out well for them.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Due to the counter-codes Solen had retrieved from the Sovereign , the cruiser escaped to hyperspace, though Drayden wanted to go back and try and rescue more people, pointing out that his chance had worked out before. Dodonna criticized him for this and told him the decision was not his, merely telling Drayden and Solen to prepare for war. After it was decided to attempt a rescue, Karrick returned to Mako-Ta with Renegade Squadron, Drayden telling them he would fly with them again soon, causing Solen to make a comment implying he was neurotic. As Solen told Vela Sess to get the ambassadors to board their ship, he spotted a SKREE fighter coming to them, but it was shot down by Karrick. Soon after, Drayden tried to inform Karrick that they were almost ready to leave, but could not get ahold of him.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Among the mercenaries' possessions, Drayden and the agent discovered a document proving that Searmark Company was preparing to ship supplies somewhere, and its coordinates led Drayden and the agent to an Imperial base on the planet. They subsequently attacked several Imperial bases until they found intelligence pertaining to the Imperium's operation on the planet. Once they located the base from which the Imperials deployed most of their forces on the planet, Drayden assaulted it with the assistance of Princess Solen. The Insurgents razed the base, dealing an important blow to the Imperium's operations on Er'Kit, but they still lacked vital information on what the Imperium's true purpose was on the planet. Drayden gradually discovered Imperial logs detailing how Searmark Company had been hired by the Imperium Vigil Bureau and were tasked with forcibly relocating natives to make room for Project Hidden Eye . This IVB operation was intended to create cybernetic sleeper agents who could be deployed throughout the galaxy and spy on galactic citizens on behalf of the IVB. Upon its discovery, Project Hidden Eye was nearly ready to deploy its first wave of spies.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
To prevent the operation from being carried out, Drayden and the agent led their troops to the base that housed Project Hidden Eye. They fought through its staging area and ultimately took out the installation, ending the Imperial project for good. Drayden thanked the agent for their service and then remained on Er'Kit for a short time, helping the Free Coalition execute additional missions on the desert world.

#### Shu-Torun

> " You asked the Partisans to join you. Do not be surprised when they act like the Partisans. " […] " I…just don't push it. We have all the advantages here. Only we can open doors. We make our way to each of the cores, blow them up and bring the Spike down. " ―Benthic and Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text: Eventually, Solen contacted Drayden and told him they were prepared to perform the slice of the shields around the Spike and told him to get ready to storm it and place bombs. He launched the Corsair and told Benthic and the Partisans to get ready to deploy quickly. Karrick told Drayden to take care of the ship, but Drayden pointed out that the only danger it would be in would be if Karrick and the others did not get the shields down in time. Once he got the word from Solen that he was able, Drayden took the Corsair through the shields and he and the others stormed the base, noticing how weird it was that they had control and the element of surprise. Drayden disarmed all the guards, but the Partisans shot and killed them, which upset him, Drayden warning them not to push their luck. Drayden revealed that they had control of all the doors now and instructed them to stick together so they could blow up the cores, but told Brevok to get back to the ship to stay in contact with Solen.

title: Joren Drayden
text: They eventually took down three of the cores, and Drayden took down the guards at the fourth one with his volt pistol and flux blade while the Partisans gave him cover, before instructing Bolt to set it to explode. Drayden told them they had one more left to destroy and instructed them to make it quick so they could go back to the ship and make contact. After clearing the room of guards at the last core, Benthic tried to get Bolt to ignore Drayden's intructions to set a charge and instead rig the entire Spike to explode and destroy the planet. He told Bolt to stop and told the Partisans it was not just, but they did not listen. Drayden then feigned surrender as Bolt emitted a bunch of gas into the gas, allowing Drayden and the droid to run off out of sight. Fearing the Partisans had gone crazy, Drayden was determined to find a way to stop them.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden eventually reunited with Bolt-3 at his Vector, but Velgor was there too, with his flux blade ignited. Drayden ignited his flux blade too, but before they could duel, the ground beneath them collapsed, forcing Drayden to jump in the Vector as the planet was destroyed. As Drayden flew his starfighter in the aftermath, he discovered that Velgor had survived the event and watched with relief as the Iron Cruiser the man was in jumped to lightspeed before Velgor could hurt him. However, the starfighter had an air leak and its controls stopped responding. Drayden was saved by the insurgents from Sergia, including Calip who had refused to let the others go somewhere safe and insisted they rescue Drayden. Drayden told her that he had known she would come through. Later, on the Insurgent fleet, which was now over the planet Frostmark, Drayden watched as Champion spoke to Rasken and commented he was really good. Solen claimed the reason for this was that he had plans and did not just show up and hope for the best like Karrick, but Drayden decided that was all you needed when you had friends as he watched with a smile as Calip pickpocketed

title: Joren Drayden
text:
commented he was really good. Solen claimed the reason for this was that he had plans and did not just show up and hope for the best like Karrick, but Drayden decided that was all you needed when you had friends as he watched with a smile as Calip pickpocketed someone. #### Valo system

> " Oh I dread to think what would've happened if the Imperium had captured you. " " There was no danger of that, Astra-9—not with Renegade Squadron the case, the best team in the galaxy…every last one! Shortly after, he had a vision of Dax Karrick and Elira Solen suffering at Aether Spire on Mistral . Seeing that Drayden's mind was made up, Kade let him know that if he ended up facing Velgor, he could not interfere on his behalf, and advised him not to give into hatred. Likewise, Zho advised him to mind what he would learned. Drayden promised to do so, and vowed to return to Mirefall one day to finish his training.
