text: After discovering a droid, that unbeknownst to Drayden was Ajax Sigma , an ancient droid revolutionary, he asked it why they killed all the people there. Sigma claimed that it was self defense and that they attacked him outside when he came there to retrieve something, but Drayden did not believe him. The droid clarified that he had followed the people back to their ship and killed them all, which Drayden said did not sound like self-defense. The droid activated electric blades on his arms and disparaged Drayden for being organic and for suggesting that the droid would go with him and answer for his actions. Drayden ignited his flux blade and began to fight Sigma, who used the blades on his arms to defend himself. He was surprised to see an Aetheri, believing them all to be dead, and Drayden assured him they were. After Drayden sliced open the droid's chest and knocked him down, he ordered him to stand down or face destruction. However, the droid just entered a pod that he ejected from the homesteader ship, successfully escaping.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Velgor had a vision of Drayden and Sigma's duel while speaking with the Eye of Webbish Bog , sometime before the events of No-Space and the activation of the Fermata Vault. In the vision, Velgor also saw Drayden holding two kyber crystals, one green and one red.

#### Adventure with Vexa

Kidnapping plot

> " Come on, Joren. Ancient Aetheri artifact of great power? Sealed away by Aetheri Masters? Maybe even something that could give you an edge of a certain Umbra Lord? Tell me you don't want that. " " How far to Sason? " " Now we're talking! " ―Chelli Vexa and Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text: Because he had lost control of his powers just as Drayden had, Velgor recruited Doctor Vexa to help him find a way to control them. While in a shuttle to a location she had in mind, Vexa walked into a room where Velgor was meditating and entered a vision he was having that included Drayden in his Dunemere farm boy clothes. Vexa did not understand why Drayden was there and did not recognize the other individual in the vision, Sable , who was telling Drayden that there was still good in Velgor, which were Drayden's mother's last words. Though his flux blade was still not fixed, Drayden traveled to Numidian Prime with Bolt-3 in search of a temple on the planet. He briefly left Bolt in a temporary camp while he searched for it, but after finding no sign of it and it started to rain he returned to the camp, finding peace in the solitude. He apologized to Bolt for leaving, saying they needed to wait for the rain to taper off, but then noticed the droid was deactivated and laying on the ground. He cried out and ran to the droid, but a node underneath the droid started shooting smoke out, confusing Drayden and knocking him out after he inhaled it. The trap had been set by Doctor Chelli Vexa, who then stood over an unconscious Drayden and greeted him, calling him a "farm boy", and asked how he felt about going on an adventure.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Vexa eventually bound and gagged Drayden and placed him in a crate on her ship the Ark Angel IV . When he woke up, she opened the crate and said she was glad he was still breathing before offering him Caf . She started to get him some as he realized who kidnapped him, telling her he did not want Caf and just wanted to know why she did it and what she had done with Bolt. She explained that she had put a restraining bolt on and turned off Bolt, and Drayden realized that she needed him for something. Vexa then claimed that she was going to actually do him a huge favor. Drayden had managed to slip out of the ropes she had tied him up in, which she noticed at that moment, surprised at how quickly he had done it and wondering if Karrick had taught him as she presented a holorecording. Realizing it was an Aetheri holo, Drayden listened as Aetheri Master Shaak Ti explained to Ciel Venn that a powerful Aetheri artifact called Kythoo's Bell was locked away at the Sason Temple . Vexa told him that she knew how to get there an needed

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden attempted to introduce himself to the Masters, but Vexa quickly realized that they were advanced holograms. This disappointed Drayden, who had briefly believed he was not alone as an Aetheri. As they traversed the temple, illusions started to make the two believe the other was saying things they were not, leading to Drayden lashing out at Vexa for always treating things like a joke and questioning her on why she was not using her electro-tattoos, and Vexa believing Drayden had referenced her and Sana Starric' breakup, though in reality, Drayden had no idea that they had been in a relationship. As the argument reached its peak as Vexa asked him how he broke his flux blade, a creature slammed onto the other side of the crystal wall, terrifying the two, but after Kythoo's bell rang it retreated. After hurriedly leaving to another section of the temple, Drayden began to realize that the entire place was made up of illusions after almost falling into a pit of spikes. He suggested that things felt wrong and they should leave, but Vexa held a gun to his head to stop him and revealed that she was trying to make Drayden more powerful

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Later, back on Numidian Prime, Drayden told Vexa she did not need to trick or bribe him into protecting her from Velgor, insisting he would help because it was the the Aetheri way. Vexa warned against his kindness, but Drayden declared he preferred to take the chance than close himself off from people in need and leave himself all alone. Vexa told him to call her the next time he needed to get into an Aetheri tomb, but Drayden said he would not and took off in his Vector, having taken the emitter with him before Vexa could realize.

#### Krestophis

> " Every time I think I have a handle on being an Aetheri, something happens to kick me back. The ground under my feet just disappears… I'm going to have to face Velgor again, and I am not ready. I don't even have a flux blade I can rely on. " ―Drayden to Solen

title: Joren Drayden
text: While studying his Aetheri text and the yellow kyber crystal from his flux blade on the Home One , Drayden realized that he did not know a lot about kyber crystals except them being in every flux blade as their power source. He explained to Bolt-3 that the text only contained details about the philosophy and spirituality of kyber crystals and an old rite of passage for younglings to find a crystal to make their first flux blade on the planet Ilum, referring to another manual by Professor Huyang for building instructions. He figured that Zho and Kade had never taught him anything about them because he had already had one, but lamented that his had never had a connection with him like they were supposed to due to the almost living nature of the crystals. He ignited his flux blade and said that now that the crystal was cracked it no longer was a useful tool and was unstable. Due to the blade's unsteadiness, Bolt made a concerned beep and Drayden shut it off and apologized. Realizing that he needed a new crystal, Drayden decided that he and Bolt should visit other worlds the text mentioned to find them

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden chose to go to Krestophis, due to the fact that there was not much of a permanent Imperial presence there despite it being an Imperial world and because the text said kyber crystals could regularly be found there. He flew his Vector there with Bolt and landed outside of a small mining town where prospectors sell their finds so he would not get noticed, though did not want to have to walk the way there. Bolt indicated to him that he wanted to know the plan, so Drayden admitted that he did not have one. He explained that Quill had told him there was a black market for crystals on Krestophis because prospectors try to sell them since there was not enough for the Imperium to set up a full-scale mining operation. He told Bolt that he just planned to put the word out and pose as a buyer to see who would speak with him. He admitted that it was not much of a plan but gave Bolt his flux blade to hold onto while he looked around, not wanting to make it obvious he was an Aetheri. He assured Bolt he would be fine and told the

title: Joren Drayden
text: At Cuata's workshop, Drayden explained that he had found his flux blade and that he and his Bolt unit had worked on it. Cuata, concerned at Drayden's lack of knowledge, explained the components and inner workings of a flux blade and told Drayden that a flux blade's wielder should have a strong connection with its crystal, something Drayden admitted he had never felt, not even with his father's flux blade. While Cuata worked on fixing the flux blade, he gave Drayden a red kyber crystal and asked him to pull the umbra side out of it. Gretta, whose people had a history with healing crystals, explained how crystals were turned red by bleeding them with the Umbra side, but could be healed afterward, though the process of doing so could change people and forced them to connect with whoever bled it.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden and Solen returned to the ship very quickly, as they found themselves unable to assist a great amount. They discovered Quill with the Talky droid that contained much of the Alliance's secrets. As Solen and Quill threatened each other, Drayden urged them to focus on healing Lobot. Quill then explained the circumstances that had led him to sell the droid, and thus the Alliance's secrets, to Grukk the Grak, leaving Drayden and Solen shocked– Solen arresting Quill for these crimes.

#### The Umbra and the Drayden

> " Being healed doesn't mean you're weak. Here... I'll show you. " ―Drayden, to Gol

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### The Umbra and the Drayden

> " Being healed doesn't mean you're weak. Here... I'll show you. " ―Drayden, to Gol

In order to learn more about his enemy, the Umbra, Drayden tracked down Gretta in the Outer Reach with the help of Bolt-3 and enlisted her help in once again attempting to purify the Umbra Lord Gol's corrupted kyber crystal. The two were also assisted by Feez , Gretta's aunt. Feez told Drayden that to heal the crystal, he would need to journey into the memories of its corrupter and understand their pain in order to succeed. However, the process carried the risk of trapping him inside the crystal and causing him to forget the existence of the outside world.

title: Joren Drayden
text: After the beating was finished, Gol told Drayden that no one could leave behind their pain, and that it was pain that defined him since his earliest days, looking to an infant crying in a crib in the cell next to Drayden's. Drayden once again offered to help, asking if Gol wanted the pain to stop. Gol replied that pain never stops as it is people's history, he pointed out that Drayden's hand was severed and would always be severed, causing his cybernetic hand to spontaneously disappear. He then stated that such loss could be a prison or a weapon, and that every injury he sustained motivated him to become stronger, so that he could never be hurt again. At this point, he asked for Drayden's name, when Drayden replied, Gol made the same offer to Drayden as when they first met: to combine Drayden's pain with his, creating a better version of the vision. He stated that all Drayden needed to see things his way was more pain.

title: Joren Drayden
text: The two met the pilot in the ship's hangar, and Verlaine remarked that she hoped to fly with Drayden again soon, with which he agreed. Evaan then told the two that the Cindervalean survivor fleet , a flotilla of refugees from Cindervale, had missed their last three check-ins. She was asking for permission to go investigate, which Solen approved– until Drayden insisted that she herself go. Solen refused, but was eventually convinced that it was a military matter as the flotilla was technically considered Alliance reserves. Drayden agreed to go as well, and the three set off, Solen and Drayden in a Taylander shuttle and Verlaine in her Vector.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Deep in space, the group traveled as Verlaine explained that the Cindervalean survivor fleet could be taken out in a single strike, which Drayden remarked was a tough way to live. They then came upon the Thranta , a Cindervalean vessel that was unresponsive to comms and giving the life sign of only one or two people. Drayden and Solen docked with the vessel while Verlaine remained outside to watch their backs. The inside of the Thranta was dark, only lit by emergency lights, which Drayden surmised was because the ship ran out of fuel and was abandoned. He and Solen followed the life sign to a chamber with a bacta tank in its center. Solen immediately recognized the woman as Jora Astane , a preserver of Cindervalean culture who was part of the flotilla. Drayden, however, sensed that Astane was dead, making the presence of a life sign extra confusing. Joren then discovered that the machinery Astane was hooked up to was keeping her blood pumping enough for her neural activity to register on life sign scans, something Elira realized made her bait. Just then, Solen's comms buzzed again with the voice of Verlaine announcing that raiders had dropped

title: Joren Drayden
text: to run and abandon ship in their individual vessels, leaving Joren without an opponent. In a rage, Zahra lunged at Drayden, but the Aetheri easily dodged or blocked her strikes, eventually slicing her blade in half, just as Home One and a squad of Vectors arrived outside. Zahra called Drayden "scum", and ran to her Cumulus-class fighter to escape. Drayden checked on Solen, and told her that he let Zahra go in case she learned from this. Home One contacted Solen asking if they had her authorization to fire on Zahra. Solen said not unless she fired at them, and Zahra subsequently turned around, aiming her vessel at Drayden and Solen. The princess then gave the order to fire, killing Zahra, as Drayden told her that Zahra chose her own fate.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Zastiga

> " Weapons and war don't make you an Aetheri. I know that now. " ―Joren Drayden

After the command of Red Squadron was transferred to Rask following his promotion to squadron leader, which pleased Drayden, he declined to rejoin the squadron and chose to be stationed onboard the Redemption . When he went to Zastiga , he and Bolt-3 were the ones to greet Solen on her arrival to the planet after she and Astra-9 left the Mellcrawler , piloted by its owner Nien Nunb and Lieutenant Caluan Ematt . When the time came for Solen to attend the top clearance meeting with the Insurgent leadership, Drayden and Nunb met with Rask for a discussion of "reconnaissance tactics" about Rask' refusal to pay the Garnethexan a drink. He would later return to escort Solen to her quarters before going to his, and two days later, he saw her off, before catching his own shuttle back to the Redemption .

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Soon afterwards, he would go to Kothlis , where he would learn of Karrick's location—still frozen in carbonite and kept in Grukk the Grak's palace—, and where he would keep himself up-to-date with the status of the Alliance Fleet's assembly. He had already devised a plan to rescue Karrick when Solen contacted him following the successful Operation Yellow Moon , and showed eagerness to join him on his attempts to rescue the Korrathi smuggler.

#### Imperial Refining Platform M36

> " We just took an Imperial refinery without a scratch -- all thanks to Drayden . I heard the stories. But I never saw anyone swing a flux blade up close like that. " ―a Pau'an Insurgent Major about Joren Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text:
As Drayden and the strike team flew away from the platform, they were ambushed by an Imperial Iron Cruiser, which launched several SKREE Fighters in pursuit. As the battle began to rage, Drayden's mind was penetrated by a vision from the Emperor. The vision saw Joren follow a possible series of events wherein he would begrudgingly leave the Insurgent strike team to its fate and crash-land on an unknown planet, losing his Vector in the process. As he journeyed from the wreckage together with Bolt-3, Joren would leave his flux blade and helmet on the ground, symbolizing his complete retreat from the concerns of the war.

Having later broken free of the Emperor's vision, Drayden proceeded to aid the Insurgents in escaping the Imperial ambush, using his flux blade to prevent the major's shuttle from leaving, giving him time to pilot the shuttle and draw the Imperials away from the rest of the Insurgents.

### The last of the Aetheri

#### Karrick's rescue

title: Joren Drayden
text: But to the shock of Grukk and his thugs, Drayden was able to kill the monster by smashed the control panel with the skull - belonging to Bidlo Kwerve - dropping a large metal gate on its neck, upsetting Malakili , the rancor's keeper. Grukk was furious and sentenced all the captured Alliance heroes—including an unfrozen Karrick—to death in the Great Pit of Karkoon to be eaten by the devourer that resided there. Grukk's dancers, including Rystáll Sant and Lyn Me , were ecstatic that Drayden killed the beast and told musician Max Rebo about it, Me believing and fantasizing that he had done it to avenge Oola , another dancer who had been fed to the creature, though dancer Greeata Jendowanian acknowledged that was not true.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden was taken on a skiff to the pit, where Grukk watched on from his sail barge the Khetanna . Before he was walked out onto a plank above the mouth of the devourer, Drayden yelled to Grukk, telling him that he had one last chance to free them and would die if he did not. Drayden nodded to Quill, who was on the skiff, and then saluted to Bolt-3, who was on the Khetanna , before jumping off the plank, grabbing onto it, and using as a springboard to flip back onto the skiff. Drayden then escaped when Bolt-3 shot his flux blade to him, allowing him to take down the guards and free the other prisoners on the skiff . A skirmish ensued in which Drayden protected his friends, including facing and fending off Vex Vark, jumping over and onto the Khetanna , ending the life of several of Grukk's thugs —including Klaatu and Nysad , who shot his cyborg hand during the skirmish— and helping Solen, who had killed the Grak by strangling him, escape the Khetanna by swinging together on a rope back over to the skiff. After destroying the sail barge by pointing one of

title: Joren Drayden
text: of Grukk's thugs —including Klaatu and Nysad , who shot his cyborg hand during the skirmish— and helping Solen, who had killed the Grak by strangling him, escape the Khetanna by swinging together on a rope back over to the skiff. After destroying the sail barge by pointing one of its guns at its deck and activating it before they left it, he and his friends left on the skiff once he made sure they brought Astra-9 and Bolt-3 back with them. Drayden and his entire team then escaped unscathed through a dangerous sandstorm, after which he boarded his Vector with Bolt-3 and parted ways with the others.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Around the same time, Drayden officiated the wedding between his sister and Karrick, speaking about their history together and those they've lost on the way to that moment.

In the days ahead, the Free Coalition began the formation of the Concordat , a successor state to the Vantor Republic. The Imperium, meanwhile, reeled from its defeat and its leadership was in chaos, and the Imperial government claimed that the reports of the Emperor's demise were treasonous propaganda. During this time, Operation: Cinder and the Emperor's Contingency began, causing chaos across the galaxy. On Mossfell, Rynn Zenathi was preparing for the mission to the Anoat sector , and wished Drayden could help– but he declined as he was feeling something was calling him on Pillio . In a long goodbye to Zenathi, Drayden gave her hope and encouraged her to not resign herself to darkness. To keep fighting, for all that they've done so far. Zenathi thanked Drayden and remarked that he was a good teacher, and he reminisced about when the cause was simpler for him. Zenathi told him to follow what was calling him, and this echoed in Joren's mind, bringing a pang of sadness, but also a haunting answer.

#### Call to Pillio

> " If the Imperium is here, then what I sensed is true. There must be something special about this place. " ―Joren Drayden to Bolt-3

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden then followed his calling to Pillio in the Jinata system , and, along with Bolt, took his Vector and set course for the remote aquatic planet. When they arrived , the two came across an Imperial Shuttle making its descent, confirming Drayden's suspicions that the planet held something of importance. He left his faithful Astromech Droid with his ship, and it was not long before the young Aetheri encountered Shock troopers on guard, who attacked him on sight. Drayden made his way through several dozens of troopers and officers, remarking that the Imperium must have been searching the planet. Sensing something unnatural from within a nearby cave, the Aetheri found that native wildlife, Scritters , were attacking the invading imperials. Hearing cries for help, Drayden made his way further into the depths of the planet to find Del Meeko , a member of Imperial Special Forces Unit Inferno Squad , with his arm stuck in the amber of the Scritters. Despite their different allegiances, Drayden used his flux blade to cut through the amber and free the soldier. When Meeko asked why the Aetheri helped him, Drayden simply responded, 'Because you asked'.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden reassured her that their jobs were never going to be easy, but Solen confessed that she'd felt like Mossfell was the end, while now it feels like they've had to start over to fight Adelvard and the rest of the shattered Imperium. Solen called this "a new darkness", but her brother pushed back– Drayden said that even in the darkest of times, if you look close enough, you can find the light. After this reassurance, Joren departed for the Anoat sector to do something about this himself.

#### Anoat sector rescue

> " You're not an Umbra. Just a pretender . Reveal yourself." "Oh Aetheri...how little you truly know...how little you understand—about me, about the Acolytes ...about yourself . " ―Joren Drayden and Reyna Oskure after the Aetheri subdued the Anzati.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Anoat sector rescue

> " You're not an Umbra. Just a pretender . Reveal yourself." "Oh Aetheri...how little you truly know...how little you understand—about me, about the Acolytes ...about yourself . " ―Joren Drayden and Reyna Oskure after the Aetheri subdued the Anzati.

In the Anoat sector, the Concordat's mission had gone south thanks to the newly forged alliance between Moff Adelvard's forces and the Spice Runners of Kijimi . The Concordat agents' freighter Oggrud had been damaged incapacitating the Spice Runners, was captured, and the crew was being held on Adelvard's flagship Scepter . The group, consisting of Rynn Zenathi, Kes Vale, Therisa Alern , and Jarek Yeager was freed by implanted Concordat spy Kith Alaytia , but came into trouble in the form of the hulking Commander Bragh and a cloaked, flux blade -wielding figure. That was, until Joren Drayden boarded the Scepter and fought countless shock troopers to stand down Bragh and the figure.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
The Insurgent trio made their way back towards the Alliance Fleet. During the trip back, Drayden and Bey discussed the latter's future plans for service in the Insurgency, as Drayden knew that Bey was considering leaving the Alliance to reunite with her husband, Pathfinder Sergeant Kes Vale, and their son Pova. Bey was unsure as to whether she wanted to leave the Insurgents behind, but Drayden's guidance helped Bey decide to leave the Alliance. The Aetheri Knight gifted one of the tree fragments to her, as he had only expected to find one, believing that the important relic would be kept safe with Bey and her family. She and Vale planted it outside of their new home on Cinderfall 4.

#### The Lehanis affair

> " The walls are closing in on you, Aetheri—and on your friends. As they struggle to build something, the shadows will—" "You talk too much. But that might help me. " ―Yuan Howzell and Joren Drayden while dueling on Lehanis.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Some time later, Drayden was on the Outer Reach swamp planet Lehanis with Rynn Zenathi, hunting for a compendium belonging to Aetheri Ky Narec . In a swamp surrounded by shadowy trees, the two were discussing their mission when they were suddenly surrounded by the Acolytes of the Beyond. Seeing this threat, Drayden drew his flux blade and Zenathi her volt pistol. The two fought the many Acolytes, all of whom had electrostaffs and surrounded the Concordat's heroes. In the battle, the Acolytes were going for the relic, which Zenathi mockingly called a "rusty sundial" to Joren's chagrin. Then, Adeptis leader Yuan Howzell removed her hood and confronted Drayden personally, saying that they were playing a game, and that the Acolytes had already won. But the fight continued, Drayden realizing that this was all a trap and that they needed to leave. But the Acolytes raged on, Howzell now targeting Zenathi and knocking the artifact on to the ground, injuring the pilot. Drayden then struck Howzell, the two engaging each other in solo combat. As Howzell continued to try to intimidate Drayden, he slashed her once more with his flux blade, pinning her on the ground.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden then asked Howzell what Adelvard was planning next, and she didn't cooperate, telling him that a true Aetheri wouldn't threaten someone. But then Zenathi stepped in, saying that she would be the one doing the threatening, and that Adelvard had tried to kill her twice. While Zenathi aimed her gun at Howzell, her and Drayden saw someone grabbing the artifact from the ground where it laid. Drayden then shot up and the two chased this thief back to their Vector. It was, of course, the dastardly Doctor Chelli Vexa, who was thankful that Drayden had made finding the compendium so easy. Vexa then threw the compendium back to Drayden, who questioned why she'd stolen it. Vexa avoided answering directly, instead saying that she was there to warn Drayden– as a gigantic Klyff'wat emerged from the woods, attacking the three. They all ran from the beast, until Drayden spotted a clearing, igniting his flux blade to hold off the Klyff'wat while his friends made it to the clearing.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Running up a large branch, Drayden slashed the Klyff'wat several times, not wanting to hurt the creature but needing to leave Lehanis as soon as possible. As the beast falls, Joren turns to Vexa, asking what she was there to warn him about. Holding the compendium, Vexa tells Drayden that it took her less than a minute to determine it was fake– and someone wanted to distract Joren from somewhere else he was probably supposed to be. Vexa had come across intel about Adelvard seeking to push outward instead of just focusing on the Anoat sector like he had been. Joren and Rynn breaking for their starfighters, Zenathi stopped Drayden, asking what was wrong. He said he was longing for the simplicity of Rynn's life as a pilot, which caused Zenathi to keep asking. Joren then expressed his regret at not confirming Adelvard's demise on the Scepter , as the Imperial tried to trick the eager Aetheri with an artifact, pulling him away from the conflict at hand.

#### Targeted by Adelvard

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Targeted by Adelvard

> " Back away from him, assassin. You only get one shot to strike at the heart of the Republic—and you missed. " ―Elira Solen standing down Kranor, the bounty hunter sent to kill Joren Drayden on Serenne

right
As Drayden had caused trouble for Moff Adelvard in the Anoat sector, the Imperial warlord placed a bounty on the young Aetheri. After the mission to Lehanis, former Cloud-Rider Weazel brought information about the bounty on Drayden to Adelvard's Spice Runner allies, but Zeva Bliss revealed that she was already aware of Adelvard targeting Drayden. This was a surprise to Bliss's lieutenant Tomasso, who then decided to leak this information to Concordat spy Calder Behrens to protect Drayden. Behrens then recruited bounty hunter Beilert Varrick and Jyala Haydenn to the cause at Hamix Outpost .

title: Joren Drayden
text: Back on Serenne, Drayden had returned to his sister to inform her about what Doctor Vexa had told him: Adelvard wanted them divided, and was working to make that so. But as they were discussing a transmission from Behrens, Vela Sess burst into the room with even more information from the same spy. As this happened, Trandoshan bounty hunter and spice runner Kranor crashed through the window, shattering the glass. Drayden ignited his flux blade and dueled the hulking hunter's vibroblade. As the two fought, Kranor mentioned the recent death of senator Mirim Kess before powerfully slashing and knocking down Drayden. As Kranor raised his volt pistol at his enemy he was shot in the arm by Elira, giving Joren enough time to rise and strike back with his flux blade. As the Drayden twins held their weapons at the disarmed hunter, Joren asked who he worked for. Kranor then dove at and attacked Sess before the pregnant Solen blasted him. Drayden then struck once more, causing the Trandoshan to leap back out the window after telling Joren that the message was that no one is safe, not even him. This attack was followed up by another where Lan-Drus killed

title: Joren Drayden
text:
dove at and attacked Sess before the pregnant Solen blasted him. Drayden then struck once more, causing the Trandoshan to leap back out the window after telling Joren that the message was that no one is safe, not even him. This attack was followed up by another where Lan-Drus killed Calder Behrens, threatening Drayden. #### Striking back

> " There's a madman trying to undercut our goal of establishing this Republic. Do we think by ignoring him he'll go away? You heart what Lando said—They barely got out alive. If we just hope Adelvard disappears, we'll be sorely disappointed sooner than we'd like. " ―Joren Drayden discussing plans on Serenne

title: Joren Drayden
text: Soon after, on the fringes of the Anoat sector, Drayden gathered his forces with Varrick, Haydenn, Preeti, and Zenathi, preparing to get past the Iron Blockade and bring the fight to Adelvard. Varrick had heard about a weak point in the blockade's Imperial sensor network from a smuggler he knows, and they were going to use that to enter in. As Drayden and Varrick spoke, the cyborg hunter described that this was personal for many, as Adelvard had almost crushed an entire Uprising in his sector. The Moff had killed many of his own people in the process, and some of Varrick's friend, so this was personal for him too.

title: Joren Drayden
text: The Concordat's fleet found entering into the Anoat sector easier than they expected, thanks to Varrick's friend's information, and launched an attack on the Scepter , Adelvard's flagship. The vessel appeared half asleep, due to a concurrent mutiny against Adelvard led by Oskure with the help of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. Drayden's forces rapidly engaged the Scepter , led by Joren's Vector, striking hard while the Iron Cruiser's crew was caught unawares. Then, Preeti noticed something launch from the Scepter , but Zenathi dismissed it as debris. A broadcast then went out to Concordat forces: the voice of Reyna Oskure said that Ubrik Adelvard was dead. The Anzati witch was insistent that Drayden's fleet should leave, claiming she was now in control of the Anoat sector and had Imperial reinforcements coming to bolster her forces. Upon hearing this, Quill told Drayden he'd received word from Vorian saying to pull back, but Lando was wary of this choice. Drayden and Zenathi then agreed to do one last spot-check of the area before heading back, as the rest of Drayden's forces there pulled out. Little did they know, though, Moff Adelvard was not killed. The man had left the Scepter in

title: Joren Drayden
text:
back, but Lando was wary of this choice. Drayden and Zenathi then agreed to do one last spot-check of the area before heading back, as the rest of Drayden's forces there pulled out. Little did they know, though, Moff Adelvard was not killed. The man had left the Scepter in an escape pod with a small group of loyalists, surviving to fight another day. #### Galowyss grapple

> " And after what happened in this sector—how close Adelvard came to derailing what we were trying to build... part of me needs to be sure he's gone. Forever. " ―Joren Drayden talking to Rynn Zenathi on Galowyss.

After the fleet left, Varrick left Drayden and Zenathi with a ship to continue searching for Adelvard. After two days, over Galowyss, the Joren and Rynn discussed the blip that was picked up near the Scepter . Zenathi was dismissive, calling it a false alarm, but Drayden was insistent that Adelvard was still around, and wanted to make sure he was dealt with for good. They then landed on the rocky world, where Drayden confessed that he was sensing something there, dark and festering, that was drawing him. Little did they know, a now-caped and tattered Adelvard had set up camp uphill from them– and two of his shock troopers had spotted the Aetheri and pilot. The mad Moff insisted that he was no longer a believer like Drayden, and sent his forces to destroy the Aetheri, demonstrating his rebirth into something new.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Soon after, the shock troopers engaged Drayden and Zenathi, and the two fought fiercely, Joren deflecting countless volt pistol bolts back at the former Imperials. Drayden pointed out that their disorganization was quite strange, as a trooper received a communication saying their ship was leaving. Hearing the trooper give this order, Drayden and Zenathi sprinted after them, coming upon a Vectis -class shuttle being loaded. Adelvard was boarding, as the vessel was sent by another loyalist still on the Scepter . Seeing this, Drayden and Zenathi rushed to the shuttle intent on stopping the warlord, but they just missed it. Adelvard was once again in the air, departing Galowyss with his loyalists. Frustrated, Drayden and Zenathi ran back to their ship. Once onboard, they received a transmission from Solen. She told them that there had been a bombing on Serenne , and that Joren needed to return immediately. He told his sister that Adelvard was still alive, and she added that the bombing was done by the Acolytes of the Beyond, meaning it was Adelvard's doing. The madman, now in command of the Scepter and coalition once more, was seeking revenge. The two then took off, and Zenathi questioned if

title: Joren Drayden
text:
his sister that Adelvard was still alive, and she added that the bombing was done by the Acolytes of the Beyond, meaning it was Adelvard's doing. The madman, now in command of the Scepter and coalition once more, was seeking revenge. The two then took off, and Zenathi questioned if they were even going to make it back to Serenne in time to help with anything. But Drayden reassured her that they could still do good there, as Elira was sure to still be threatened, and more importantly they needed to regroup to fight off Adelvard's now cornered and desperate forces. #### Pieces falling into place

> " "We"? We have to head to Ashden. The battle has started—the Imperium has unleashed everything on us. The Operator wanted us there—it was a trap. Now our friends are stranded. " ―Joren Drayden talking to Rynn Zenathi on Serenne, after the Battle of Ashden had begun.

title: Joren Drayden
text: In a tower on Serenne, Sess, Solen, agent Bastion , and the recently returned Dax Karrick were waiting for Drayden as he and Zenathi entered the room. There was a brief and joyous reunion between the former-Insurgent heroes, before the discussion shifted to Adelvard. Solen then told Drayden about the recent attack and Bastion told him about the Dowutin Adeptis Saycos Hawn that was captured. The agent was concerned with Adelvard's resurgence, and especially how this chaos has frayed his relationships with both the Acolytes and the Spice Runners– and she wished luck to Lando's forces still fighting in the Anoat sector. Solen then interrogated Hawn, and as she left the chamber with news of Adelvard's plan to tip the scales at Ashden, Drayden and the rest received a transmission. It was from the undercover Kith Alaytia, and confirmed what Elira had just heard: Adelvard had his sights set on Ashden, and wanted to tear down both the Concordat and Raxen's Imperial remnant forces alike.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Soon after, the Imperium and Concordat's forces were gathering at Ashden. The Concordat Senate had allowed their fleet to participate thanks to the efforts of Karrick and Sess, and the end of the war was about to begin. From Serenne, Drayden and the rest monitored the situation on Ashden, particularly the consolidation of the Imperial fleet around the Super Iron Cruiser Ravager . Gallard Raxen gave a rallying speech, and the gigantic battle began, Adelvard's forces still in the Anoat sector preparing. Meanwhile, Drayden and Zenathi stood on a landing pad to meet the newly-escaped Alaytia and Kranor, the assassin who had previously targeted Sess. Rynn knew they were coming, and Drayden was confused by this. Drayden was adamant that they needed to be helping out at Ashden, but instead they were meeting on Serenne. Joren wanted to fight Adelvard himself, but Zenathi assured him that there was another way. Kranor then said that Adelvard relied too hard on his alliances, thinking them unbreakable, but Joren wasn't inclined to believe because Kranor was a Spice Runner. But then, Zenathi revealed that she herself was a Spice Runner as well, surprising Drayden. Zenathi told him that she knew how to take down Adelvard's coalition, and that he needed to trust her– which he unequivocally did, the group setting off to even the odds.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
On the planet Sauwecer , the group landed and Drayden learned that the Spice Runner Tomasso was Zenathi's adopted father after her parents were killed by the Imperium. She was raised to become a Spice Runner, but left to join the Insurgency instead. Then, Tomasso himself emerged, confusing Kranor and Alaytia about where the Spice Runners stood in regard to Adelvard. Zenathi then asked her father to pull back the Spice Runners, and Drayden begged the man to help them. Tomasso explained that Zeva Bliss was not blindly allied with Adelvard, and promised he would try to convince her to turn the Spice Runners against him. But he also implied that their turning alone wouldn't defeat Adelvard– he needed their help too.

#### Pirate ally & infiltration

> " Well, 'bout time you showed up, Drayden —the party's getting good. " ―Eleodie Maracavanya while fighting the Adelvard coalition in the Anoat sector.

title: Joren Drayden
text: As the Battle of Ashden raged, Tomasso spoke to Zeva Bliss and guaranteed that the Spice Runners would turn on Adelvard. Then, in the meantime, Drayden and Zenathi arrived in the Anoat sector, where Adelvard's forces were staging for the hyperspace jump to Ashden. There, they came upon pirate ruler Eleodie Maracavanya and zher Super Iron Cruiser Liberty's Misrule , which had arrived to take on Adelvard. Maracavanya greeted Drayden, and his ship was fired upon by Adelvard's vessels until a rogue SKREE fired on his attackers. This was Therisa Alern, still working to free the Anoat sector. With this cover, Zenathi used stolen clearance codes from Alaytia to permit them access to the Scepter . The shuttle haphazardly landed in its hangar as Alern was shot down outside, something that greatly impacted Zenathi. Drayden then reminded her that they needed to calmly take this chance, this incredible opportunity to make Alern's sacrifice mean something more. Drayden and Zenathi were now in place on the Scepter , ready to take down Adelvard, and Maracavanya contacted Joren to let him know that zhe was taking too much damage. After essentially delaying the mad Moff, the pirate regent departed, as Adelvard's fleet

title: Joren Drayden
text:
make Alern's sacrifice mean something more. Drayden and Zenathi were now in place on the Scepter , ready to take down Adelvard, and Maracavanya contacted Joren to let him know that zhe was taking too much damage. After essentially delaying the mad Moff, the pirate regent departed, as Adelvard's fleet prepared to jump to Ashden. #### Aetheri at Ashden

> " Your ship is falling apart, Adelvard. I didn't come to fight you. I came to save you. " ―Drayden speaking to Urbik Adelvard on the bridge of the Scepter during the battle of Ashden

Ashden's orbit was completely filled with vessels, the Imperial fleet making a ring around the Ravager and facing off against the Concordat's Starhawk battleships. As Starhawk Amity was rammed and destroyed by Iron Cruiser Punishment , Adelvard's fleet arrived, Drayden onboard its lead ship. Just when he posed the greatest threat, Adelvard was backstabbed by Reyna Oskure and the Spice Runners at the same time. The Iron Cruiser was falling apart, Zenathi met up with the fleeing Anzati in the Scepter ' s halls, and Drayden made his way toward the bridge. As the once-mighty Ravager fell to Ashden and the Concordat began to emerge victorious, Drayden confronted the mad self-declared Grand Moff Adelvard for the last time.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
live, and his reason, the Imperium, was a lie. As he explained that this would be a shallow victory, he was shot in the chest by Zenathi, who came up behind Drayden. Joren insisted that they should save him, but Zenathi told him that Adelvard had been gone for a long time. Zenathi told Joren that she admired his hope, but it was time for them to go. In the Scepter ' s collapsing docking bay, Drayden and Zenathi ran out to meet the Corsair Wing – Dax Karrick had left Serenne to join the battle and rescue them. The two boarded the old freighter, and remarked that it finally, truly felt like this was over. The Scepter exploded, and with it, Adelvard's dreams of conquest, as the heroes flew off, victorious, into a new era.

text:
### Reconstruction

#### Freedom for the Nagai

Fenril pirate attacks

> " I—I don't know who they are…all I know is that they're pirates…hidden in the shadows…" "Where are they striking next? " ―The Gran merchant being interrogated by Joren Drayden

Around 6 AVE , a group of planets in the Fenril sector known as the Fenril Consortium became fiercely independent , unsatisfied with the Concordat's protection of their trading vessels and unwilling to cooperate with the new democracy. Just outside the Fenril sector, Drayden was flying with a squadron of Vectors to investigate the threat after an incident on a former Imperial space station over Maldran . A dogfight began between the Concordat's fighters and starships accompanied by a modified Imperial Iron Cruiser.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
After losing some fighters, Drayden and fellow pilot Rynn Zenathi flew down to a nearby planet following a crashing pirate vessel. A gray-skinned man emerged with a vibroblade and charged at Joren and Rynn. Drayden fought the man, and knocked him down. Drawing Joren close, the pirate warned the Aetheri about who he's facing, and told him about a collector of Aetheri artifacts on the planet Gadrilam , who has a crown that will help Joren "learn the truth". He then told Joren to brace himself, as he detonated himself to cover his tracks, knocking Joren out. Awakening in a trance-like state, Drayden departed straight for Gadrilam, confusing Zenathi and taking off into hyperspace while telling her that he needed to investigate this alone.

Mission to Gadrilam

> " That pirate shared something before he died. Something I couldn't ignore. " ―Joren Drayden to Bolt-3 upon landing on Gadrilam

title: Joren Drayden
text: On the snowy world of Gadrilam, Joren apologized to Bolt-3 about the promptness and strangeness of his actions as he rushed off towards a village , thinking of what the pilot had told him about: a crown that would reveal the truth, held by Ibo Truddispal. Thinking back to his previous studies, Joren recalled the Crown of Verity , an artifact that, when worn, would cause the user to only be able to speak the absolute truth– but it was thought to be destroyed. In the village, Joren entered into a bar filled with patrons, many of whom were Nagai, just like the pirate. Joren entered and spoke with the bartender , Hossalana , who was dismissive of Joren asking about Truddispal. He was properly answered by the Nagai woman sitting next to him, Jesrit – who spotted that Joren was an Aetheri. Angry, Hossalana screamed that they should leave the bar, as Gallana Venk and her gang entered the establshment, letting Joren know that they'd found his ship, and know he's a Concordat pilot on some kind of mission. Jesrit tried to leave as Joren asked her about Truddispal, which made Venk's men grab him, wondering why Joren was

title: Joren Drayden
text:
is also a Nagai, but Jesrit asserted that Venk is not truly one of them, and is a traitor to the followers of Garlev . Joren then told Jesrit his name, and tells her he wants to help, as it's what Aetheri do. As they arrived at the tunnel, Jesrit told Joren that her people are forced laborers on Gadrilam, and that they need help, if he wants to– and, ever the Aetheri, of course he does. Sent into the tunnel alone by Jesrit, Joren though about how the pilot knew far too much for this to be a normal situation, unlike false artifacts Joren had been fooled by before. Going deeper, Joren overheard Venk and her men speaking about him around an injured Ibo Truddispal, and approached, flux blade lit. Venk tossed down the silver object she was holding– the Crown of Verity. Joren rushed forward and caught it, as Venk spoke ill Garlev's followers, frustrated at how prevalent they are. Venk then fired at Truddispal from point-blank range, killing the Aetheri relic collector. As her and her men left, she introduced Joren to members of the Zantarrk Gang , a group that had been terrorizing surrounding areas recently. Joren cut them down and ran away after one of them revealed that they took out the village, which he found to be true upon emerging from the tunnel's depths and seeing the fiery blaze.

Departing Serenne

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Departing Serenne

> " The Pirrosi and their allies in the Fenril sector have made it clear—they want to disrupt our plans on every front. I refuse to sit back and let that happen. " ―Elira Solen to Vela Sess before departing for Kaltrais. Back on the Concordat's capital, Serenne, Drayden and Zenathi stood amongst a collection of artifacts while pondering the Crown of Verity, and Joren expressed grief about the fate of the old Aetheri Order. Zenathi asked Drayden what the Crown does, which Joren explained is that it allows the wearer to discern truth from lies, while also preventing them from telling lies. He connected this idea to the idea of Aetheri identity, being part of a greater movement than just oneself. Then, his comms buzzed as Kith Alaytia was calling for help in a nearby docking bay. There, Vela Sess was actively trying to stop Elira Solen from leaving the planet on a diplomatic mission to Kaltrais , a world that was a valued member of the First Republic but had rejected the Concordat's offer to join. Elira insisted that the Prime Minister Kezrin Almovar 's Pirrosi forces and their Fenril Consortium allies wished to disrupt the Concordat's efforts there, and she wouldn't let that happen, as the Concordat already had enough trouble with the Consortium completely shuttering its borders to Concordat trade. Elira had a bad feeling about Kaltrais, as she'd spoken to President Tusvein Shoirin to arrange the meeting

title: Joren Drayden
text: Consortium allies wished to disrupt the Concordat's efforts there, and she wouldn't let that happen, as the Concordat already had enough trouble with the Consortium completely shuttering its borders to Concordat trade. Elira had a bad feeling about Kaltrais, as she'd spoken to President Tusvein Shoirin to arrange the meeting in-person, and he sounded "off". Drayden and Zenathi arrived to speak to Elira. Joren attempted to sway Elira into staying, but she was adamant about going, seeing Kaltrais as a great way to demonstrate that the Concordat cares about the planets that join it. Joren begged to accompany Elira, but his stalwart sister declined and boarded the transport with Alaytia, bound for Kaltrais.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Meanwhile, the Corsair Wing was back on Serenne as well, and Drayden and Zenathi met in its cockpit with Dax Karrick and Beilert Varrick, who had just returned from investigating the Zantarrk Gang, and found the Nagai Garlev dead on Aether Spire. Karrick was shocked at Elira departing for Kaltrais, and Varrick told Drayden that Garlev's killer was moving towards Kaltrais as well. Joren then began connecting the dots between the oppressed Nagai, the Zantarrk Gang, and the rising Fenril Consortium. He'd heard Garlev's name on his mission to Gadrilam, and knew that he was a freedom fighter. Joren told his friends about his investigations so far, saying that the Nagai have been part of the groups hitting their supply lines, which led to him discovering the Zantarrk Gang holding Nagai slaves. Karrick said that that sounded correct, and Drayden told him about Jesrit, the Nagai who mentioned Garlev. This confirmed that the Zantarrk were connected to both the supply line hits and Garlev's death, leading Drayden and the rest to depart for the Fenril sector immediately.

Fenril frenzy

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Fenril frenzy

> " Now what's the fun in that?" "Joren... the way this is all shaping up—it's gonna be anything but fun. " ―Joren Drayden and Dax Karrick over Kaltrais On Kaltrais, Elira's meeting with Shoirin had quickly gone awry because of the Zantarrk Gang's presence on the planet, breaking out into a firefight on the rocky world. As Drayden and his allies arrived in the Corsair , they were surrounded by Fenril Consortium vessels. The modified ships fired on the Korrathi freighter, and it took lots of hits– until the antagonistic starships suddenly pulled back because of Shoirin's final act on Kaltrais. The world's defenses fired on grounded ships, and the attack was completely called off. This gave Solen and Alaytia an opening to escape in their shuttle into orbit, where they were contacted by the Consortium's true leader, the devious Reyna Oskure. The Anzati witch had been manipulating the situation from the beginning under the guise of being an "advisor". Drayden and the rest of the Corsair ' s occupants then received a transmission from Chancellor Sess, requesting that they go to the desert world Loradil to investigate a Concordat trading vessel that had been shot down by Fenril affiliated Zantarrk Gang vessels. Joren and the rest heard audio from the crash site– the Concordat traders were in distress and apparently surrounded.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Arriving on the sandy world, Drayden and his allies emerged from the Corsair as he pointed out a crashed Dissident vessel, a Providence -class carrier . There was blood on the ground near an opening into the carrier's insides, and the heroes entered, searching for the merchant crew. Its systems were not fully down, and Zenathi was able to reengage power, bringing lights on and allowing the crew to explore more effectively. But as they continued, a group of B1 battle droids led by a tactical droid stopped them in their path, as even more appeared behind them. Joren ignited his flux blade, and a battle started against the former Dissidents that continued a long-ended war. During the chaos, Zenathi was grabbed by droids and dragged away, and Drayden followed her, as Karrick and Varrick destroyed the tactical droid. While Joren followed Zenathi, the pilot took down her battle droid captors and escaped out into the sand, running towards the wreck of the Nechrim's Wake . Back inside, Drayden reunited with Karrick and Varrick, now fighting a droideka , super battle droid , and several commando droids . The Aetheri made quick work of them all, as the other two

title: Joren Drayden
text: captors and escaped out into the sand, running towards the wreck of the Nechrim's Wake . Back inside, Drayden reunited with Karrick and Varrick, now fighting a droideka , super battle droid , and several commando droids . The Aetheri made quick work of them all, as the other two descended further into the carrier to look for anything that could help the fight. As Drayden joined them, Karrick found a pile of Phase II replica trooper armor, which they equipped, fighting their way outside into a huge field of not only battle droids, but Armored Assault Tanks , concerned about saving Rynn Zenathi and reflecting on the armor's storied history.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Nagai insurgency , who was being transported on the Wake . The man revealed that he was the reason the Zantarrk Gang attacked the convoy, the supplies gained just being a bonus. They aligned themselves with Reyna Oskure and the Fenril Consortium for wealth and power, and are trying to squash the Nagai insurgency while using Nagai slaves as troops. Trying to get to Rynn and the Wake , Joren lept into battle as his father did before him, destroying countless droids, while reminding himself that he must avoid the traps and temptations that got his father. As Karrick ran towards the Corsair , he was knocked down by an onslaught of droids, and as they closed in on him, the entire crew, Drayden, Zenathi, Varrick, Gauvis, Finch, and Marntiv, destroyed the droids and rescued him. Dax immediately suggested they head back to Serenne, but Joren let him know that the Nagai were rising up on Kaltrais , a Concordat agent was present, and it was the Nagai's only chance at freedom. The group, having survived the Dissident onslaught, then left for Kaltrais.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Uprising at Kaltrais

> " ...You're jere...you can help..." "I'm an Aetheri, remember? It's what we do, Jesrit. " ―Jesrit and Joren Drayden, after meeting again during the Nagai insurrection on Kaltrais Soon after, the Corsair Wing arrived over Kaltrais, but didn't receive any communications from the surface– something was wrong. And as the freighter descended further, towards a central city, volt pistol fire could be seen from the sky. As the entire Concordat team exited the Corsair , Joren Drayden ran forward,  shocked to see the Nagai he met on Gadrilam, Jesrit, alive and leading the insurrection in the plaza! Amidst the chaos, and a reunion between Jesrit and Marntiv, Joren called out to Jesrit, and the two fought the pirate troopers together. They took out several as Joren explained that he's an Aetheri, and that means coming back to help. He sadly informed her of Garlev's death, and the two kept fighting the oppressors, many of which were Nagai themselves, enslaved by the Zantarrk or promised reward. They were then interrupted by Karrick and the rest, Dax informing Joren that Rynn Zenathi was not doing okay, and was feeling weak. Meanwhile, Concordat agent Bastion was in place infiltrating the Zantarrk's base of operations, and entered Prime Minister Almovar's chamber, where the regal woman stood surrounded by holograms. Alarmed, Almovar immediately questioned who Bastion was, as Drayden, Zenathi, and Jesrit caught

title: Joren Drayden
text: Rynn Zenathi was not doing okay, and was feeling weak. Meanwhile, Concordat agent Bastion was in place infiltrating the Zantarrk's base of operations, and entered Prime Minister Almovar's chamber, where the regal woman stood surrounded by holograms. Alarmed, Almovar immediately questioned who Bastion was, as Drayden, Zenathi, and Jesrit caught up and entered the room as well. Finally speaking to someone responsible for the continued oppression of the Nagai, Drayden tried to rationalize with the fierce leader, as he and Jesrit told her that her actions were putting countless people–including her own–in danger. Almovar said she was doing everything for her home, but Joren and Rynn reminded her that her will doesn't exactly line up with what the people of Pirros really want. Kaltrais is in shambles, the people of Pirros don't want war, and she's been manipulated by Reyna Oskure. Jesrit was furious at the Prime Minister, seeing Nagai blood on her hands as she'd worked with Gallana Venk and used Nagai slaves. A bit resigned, Almovar then admitted that war was already here, that the Fenril Consortium had permanently allied itself with Oskure and the Zantarrk, and that it was too late to stop it all. Bastion refuted this, and Joren extended a hand of grace to the misguided woman, but Almovar was still concerned about Nagai retribution. At this, Jesrit told her that the Nagai insurgency's two goals were the freedom of the homeworld Nagi , and the deaths of Venk and Oskure, as Joren rebuked her for this retributive anger and hate.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Joren then testified of his experience with the Zantarrk, as they'd built a slave army and killed many, and then spoke of Oskure's Imperial past. Accepting that she had indeed failed her people, Prime Minister Almovar then, finally, declared that she would be withdrawing her fleet, as the Nagai insurrection's explosions outside rocked the building. Almovar dismissed the group and said that she had much to repair and ponder, as Rynn promised that the Concordat would be there to help deal with it. As the group left, quietly, Almovar said her fate was sealed, as a pair of white eyes opened in the shadows behind her, Reyna Oskure killing the Pirrosi leader. Outsiude, while Zenathi grew weaker, Joren Drayden helped her as the group fought their way towards a major hangar. Joren tried asking what was wrong, but Rynn refused to answer. The Nagai were winning, fighting their way onto and stealing ships, as the Zantarrk fell one trooper after the last. Joren and Rynn held the line while more Nagai escaped, until the two were picked up by the Corsair , which departed into space towards Nagi to win this revolution once and for all.

Liberation of Nagi

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Liberation of Nagi

> " We've got to locate Venk and Oskure . If we take them down, the Fenril Consortium will be finished. " " Easier said than done, kid. " ―Joren Drayden and Dax Karrick on the surface of Nagi. As the Corsair and its Nagai allies arrived over Nagi, they were confronted with a Fenril Iron Cruiser and lots of Zantarrk Gang vessels. The Fenril fleet fired on the freighter and other insurgent ships as Dax Karrick performed a spin technique to batter away some fighters, while sending the Corsair down to the surface. The freighter crashed into a crowd of Zantarrk pirates, taking them out as the smoke rose from the vessel. The heroes emerged, and Rynn's condition was worsening while Drayden helped her stand. But then a convoy of Nagai insurgents on landspeeders and speeder bikes appeared, one member saying that it was prophesized that Jesrit would arrive. Jesrit set their goals straight and introduced her new allies to the recently arrived Nagai. The group then decided to split up, Joren, Rynn, Jesrit, and Marntiv going with the Nagai to find medical aid for Zenathi, while Karrick, Varrick, Gauvis, Finch, and Bastion set out to find and eliminate Venk and Oskure as quickly as they could. Drayden and his allies were on a Nagai convoy as Zenathi's illness quickly became all-consuming, as if her life is being drained. Jesrit promised that they wouldn't let Rynn die, as

title: Joren Drayden
text: Varrick, Gauvis, Finch, and Bastion set out to find and eliminate Venk and Oskure as quickly as they could. Drayden and his allies were on a Nagai convoy as Zenathi's illness quickly became all-consuming, as if her life is being drained. Jesrit promised that they wouldn't let Rynn die, as a group of Tof emerged in front of them and blew up their transports. As Drayden woke up, he saw that Marntiv was killed in the blast, and that two of the large men were taking Jesrit and Rynn with them. The Tof departed on speeder bikes while claiming the Nagai insurgency was destined for death– with Drayden left for dead in the barren wastes of Nagi.

title: Joren Drayden
text: On the wastes of Nagi, the final battle for Nagi had begun as Oskure's forces, consisting of Tof soldiers, pirates, and Zantarrk shock troopers faced off with Drayden and his allies. The heroes fought fiercely, as Joren helped Rynn Zenathi to limp away, her condition worsening even more. Drayden wanted to help her, but she begged him to stop Oskure and end the fighting first. While Drayden deflected a sudden barrage of volt pistol fire, Zenathi crawled on the ground to grab the Crown of Verity as Oskure approached her ship to escape. Then, while the battle raged, a Concordat transport accompanied by two Vectors landed– and Vela Sess and Elira Solen emerged to announce that the Concordat stood with the Nagai– the Pirrosi delegation had surrendered. The fighting ceased upon this declaration, the combatants looking at the arriving dignitaries. Jesrit took this opportunity to address the crowd– saying that they now stood on the precipice of true peace, a free Nagi, and freedom from mainpulators, monsters, and their lackeys. Elira denounced the Fenril Consortium as a shadow government run by Oskure, stated that the Concordat stands with Nagi as a free, independent world they will help rebuild, and the

title: Joren Drayden
text: they now stood on the precipice of true peace, a free Nagi, and freedom from mainpulators, monsters, and their lackeys. Elira denounced the Fenril Consortium as a shadow government run by Oskure, stated that the Concordat stands with Nagi as a free, independent world they will help rebuild, and the enemy Nagai removed their salvaged Imperial trooper helmets, cheering the phrase "in Garlev's name", freed. Close by, the heroes cornered the escaping Oskure, Drayden telling her that she had much to answer for, attacking the vampiric witch. Oskure was able to knock Drayden down while her guards were killed, but Zenathi emerged from behind, placing the Crown of Verity this time on her own head.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Rynn's eyes glowed, and she explained that the Crown allows the wearer to not only see the truth, but all that they've left behind. Grabbing Oskure, Zenathi told the ancient Anzati that she'd taken something from her, a piece of her that's helped her destroy so many lives in the Fenril sector. Oskure mocked Zenathi's spice runner background, but the pilot continued, telling Oskure that she'd left something behind inside of her, the sorceress's skin growing more and more decrepit as the rapidly aging woman begged to be left alone. This began to restore Zenathi, who became somewhat mad with power, taunting the dying witch– to Drayden's dismay. He begged her to stop, to not lash out for revenge, and it was Karrick's hand on Zenathi's shoulder that finally stopped her, as he reminded her that she had won, and shouldn't drag herself down with Oskure. The crumpled, old body of Reyna Oskure then fell to the ground, barely clinging to life, as Rynn removed the Crown.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Some time later, Rynn asked Joren if it was really over, to which the Aetheri said that it was, for now– but there was always a potential challenge waiting around the corner. In the city of Siva, the Concordat heroes celebrated and gathered with the Nagai, as they began clearing debris and rebuilding. Jesrit thanked Joren and his friends, and Joren clarified that he was just keeping his promise from Gadrilam. Zenathi saw this moment of reconstruction, celebration, and all the rest of it, and reflected on the moment of happiness with Joren, who told her that these moments were incredibly important. The Aetheri said these moments were what keep one moving through the dark times, even when the fight feels endless: moments of peace and happiness like this give one life.

#### Foundations of an order

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden came to learn about some of the Aetheri Masters that existed before the fall of the Order, such as Nura, Drevan Koss , and Sorin Vael . He became versed in the Synthcells , the Aetheri Code , and the various Aetheri temples that existed, like the one on Lorath . As well as the light, Drayden also learned about the Umbra side. He studied the history of the Umbra, including the creation of Vael Vorek's Rule of Two and events like the Vrak of Searmark. He learned of several Umbra Lords and umbra side warriors: Vael Vorek, Vael Vreth, Vael Varek , and the Aetheri hunters of the Imperium's Warden Order among them. Along with Fortress Velgor , his father's castle on Emberfall, he became familiar with several locations and temples strong with the Umbra side.

Some time after his meeting with Sela Marr, the Nightsister Morgan Elveth recruited former Aetheri Knight of the old Aetheri Order Baylan Skoll , who was aware of the truth behind Drayden's father, to help locate Imperial Grand Admiral Vorren . As Drayden had become prominent during the Galactic Civil War, Skoll became aware of his existence, and kept his name, alongside the names of other Insurgent heroes, listed in a device on his gauntlet during the search for the planet Peridea in a distant galaxy .

#### Recruiting his nephew

> " He's an amazing teacher. Very strong. I've learned so much from him… " ―Beno Karrick, on his uncle

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden desired heavily to preserve the teachings of the Aetheri Order, laboring to pass on the best of what Zho and Orien taught him as Aetheri mentors at his Aetheri Sanctum and to instill the core beliefs they embodied within the next generation. Additionally, Joren understood what Zho experienced with himself on Mirefall as teacher, having the same unique frustrations with his own pupils; a master guiding a young unseasoned student that was convinced they were wasting time on pointless exercises, such as stacking stones. At some point during his time as an Aetheri Master, Drayden would face a group of IG-RM assassin droids alongside his nephew.

#### Encountering the Knights of Karrick

> " Well, hello there. Everything here is ours. We're going to take it…but how we take it is up to you. Your call, friends. " " You're wrong. So, so wrong. This is an Aetheri outpost . Everything in it belongs to the Aetheri Order, which, at the moment, means me. I am the last Aetheri. " ―Karrick and Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text: In 19 AVE , the year his nephew turned fourteen, Drayden, Beno, and Lor Saan Tarka traveled to an Aetheri outpost on Elphrona , a location from the days of the High Republic Era, hoping to find Aetheri artifacts. Joren flew the ship and conversed with Saan Tarka, while Karrick, without his master's knowledge, was communing with Vorr. Drayden was initially skeptical of an Aetheri presence so far from the core, but Saan Tarka assured him that with his expertise he had recognized the description from his contact as an Aetheri Outpost, and explained that the Aetheri's activity was greatly expanded throughout the galaxy during the High Republic Era. Meanwhile, Karrick telepathically communicated with Vorr, expressing that he was tired of missions to find artifacts with Drayden that he would just lock away in the temple and never use. Karrick admitted that Drayden was an amazing teacher, but was frustrated that he never wanted Karrick to use any of the things he had taught him, which Vorr claimed was because Drayden viewed Karrick as a child and had not realized his true capabilities. Drayden then told Karrick that they would possibly find insights into the old Aetheri, and added that

title: Joren Drayden
text: that he never wanted Karrick to use any of the things he had taught him, which Vorr claimed was because Drayden viewed Karrick as a child and had not realized his true capabilities. Drayden then told Karrick that they would possibly find insights into the old Aetheri, and added that they could find interesting weapons, as he knew that Karrick was interested in such subjects, which Saan Tarka affirmed. Drayden told Karrick he was glad he came along, and Karrick said he shared the sentiment. When they landed, Drayden was impressed by the sight of the outpost. He cautioned his apprentice to careful and warned that such a place was likely to be rigged with traps, recalling a time he found a flux blade in a similar place that turned out to be a trap and nearly killed him. Inside, they found a treasure trove that Drayden judged so impressive he thought it may be better than Jocasta Nura's cache, including many Aetheri reliquaries and a flux blade rifle . Drayden was excited by the possibility of learning many new things. As the three perused the outpost, instantly, both Drayden and Karrick felt a cold presence within the structure. They were then confronted by a group of umbra side warriors known as the Knights of Karrick revealed themselves.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Their master, " Karrick ," declared themselves, and claimed ownership of all within the outpost and that they way they took it was up to Drayden. Drayden countered, shooting back that all within the outpost, due it being an Aetheri location, belonged to the Order; all the reliquaries and relics belonged to Joren, for he was the last Aetheri Knight even though he would not be for long. Drayden told the Knights he could sense the umbra side in them and would never let them have the artifacts. When Karrick insulted him, Karrick stepped forward and declared that his master was a legend. Drayden ignited his blade and instructed Saan Tarka to hang back and Karrick to protect Saan Tarka, while handled the threat, assuring Karrick he could do it even thought there were seven of them. Karrick tried to taunt him, but Drayden just taunted him back, angering him and moving him to order the Knights to attack. As Karrick watched on and called out to him, Drayden engaged the knights, not intending to kill any of them, and managed to overpower them quite easily despite their numbers, which he explained as him not being alone because he had

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Much quicker than his other meditations, Drayden found himself in an empty dark void but felt an all-consuming presence within it which he had only thought he had sensed before. Then the vision shifted and he found himself standing on the ancient hidden Umbra world of Umbrale , though he did not know that was what he was seeing. Eventually the vision broke, and Drayden explained to Saan Tarka what he had seen. Saan Tarka wondered if the vision was just a general representation of lingering darkness or an influence from an artifact, but Drayden still believed he was having the vision for a reason. Drayden asked Saan Tarka the reason he had come to Ossus in the first place, and he explained that there was an archaeological dig on the planet Yoturba that he wanted to check out with Drayden, convincing him to leave the temple by saying that it would be good for Karrick to learn responsibilities while he was gone.

I thought that wasn't supposed to happen. Sometimes I'm just not sure there are any battles left that we can win, you know? " " These people are important, and we're going to find them. " ―Drayden consoles Quill on the loss of his daughter and resolves to find the fugitive family Drayden and Quill followed the Goldstone via transmissions aboard the Lady Luck , Drayden telling Drayden about his encounter with the Umbra acolyte on Nightside. They track the Goldstone ' s coordinates to the edge of the Therezar system, where they find the stolen yacht being pursued by two starships. Before the Goldstone jumped into hyperspace, Bolt-3 was able to deduce that the family was fleeing to the Torrenoteer system . Following the trail of the Goldstone , Drayden and Quill land Lady Luck on the desert world of Torrenoteer Minor , the two continuing their search for the family on two Stacker Polaris Stormwolf speeder bikes . While scouting the surrounding area, they discovered that Orrin's associates Bosvarga , Cerensco , and Krastan landed their starship and were also hunting the fugitive family. When the bounty hunters split into two parties, Drayden and Quill also decided to split up in order to track the hunters.

title: Joren Drayden
text: While riding his speeder bike through a ravine system, Drayden was ambushed by the two bounty hunters, also riding speeder bikes. Drayden deflected their volt pistol bolts of using his flux blade, and hit one bolt back at one of the hunters, causing the hunter's speeder bike to crash in a ravine. Drayden chased the second speeder over a lake, once again deflecting the hunter's volt pistol bolts, causing the hunter and his speeder bike to fall in the lake by hitting the bolts back at him. Drayden then approached the Weequay hunter in his wrecked vehicle and attempted to question him, but he fought Drayden instead and subsequently died from being impaled by his speeder bike's steering vane. While examining the hunter's bike, Drayden discovered a message indicating that the hunter's associates believe they have found something "nice and juicy."

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Polaar

> " Yupe Tashu was revealed as the true master of the Acolytes of the Beyond. […] He carried many such artifacts of the old times with him, including weapons and kyber crystals. But most important of all was the mask of Viceroy Exim Panshard. It was to Kiza he bequeathed this most powerful of relics. " " She put it on, and Exim Panshard lived again. " ―Komat and Dorian Quill, on how Kiza became possessed by Umbra lord Exim Panshard Drayden had begun to suspect that the woman he encountered was related to a umbra side cult called the Acolytes of the Beyond that he had fought before. Drayden and Quill used his friend Lina Graf 's ship the Star Herald to travel to the planet Polaar to get information from Komat , a woman who was formerly part of the Acolytes of the Beyond who collected Umbra artifacts like the flux blade of Vael Noctyss . Drayden also believed that she would have the ability to track the Goldstone for them. When Drayden had previously encountered the Acolytes of the Beyond, he had met her and had helped her leave the cult. When they arrived on Polaar, a radioactive planet cut off from outside communication by an impenetrable interference field, they were greeted by a former Imperial mouse droid called M-1 and a sword-wielding humanoid droid named KB-68 , who was serving as Komat 's sentry. Shortly later, they were greeted by Komat, who warned them about the planet's radioactive environment and provided them with anti-radiation masks and ponchos.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Agreeing to help them if they helped her in turn, Komat took them to a wrecked Calavane cruiser that crashed on Polaar during the Galactic Civil War, explaining that with the shields overloaded, the ship's fusion core had melted down, contaminating the planet with distronic radiation that rendered it uninhabitable for most lifeforms. Drayden and Quill help Komat repair her particle capture grid, which she used to harvest radiation that KB-68 sold for supplies in the Pirsen system . In return, Komat revealed that the woman Drayden had encountered was named Kiza , and had once been her friend. She explained that Kiza had worked directly for Yupe Tashu , the leader Acolytes of the Beyond and one of the Emperor's advisors, who had gifted her the Mask of Viceroy Exim Panshard which contained the preserved consciousness of the ancient Umbra lord Exim Panshard and allowed him to take over her when she wore it. Drayden revealed that they believed she was working with Orrin to hunt down a fugitive family in order to obtain a wayfinder. Explaining that two Umbra wayfinders were made as navigational guides to Umbrale, the hidden Umbra world, Komat became determined to help Drayden and

her when she wore it. Drayden revealed that they believed she was working with Orrin to hunt down a fugitive family in order to obtain a wayfinder. Explaining that two Umbra wayfinders were made as navigational guides to Umbrale, the hidden Umbra world, Komat became determined to help Drayden and Quill stop Kiza and keep her from reaching Umbrale. Komat was able to locate the Goldstone using hyperwave signal interception technology, but shortly after she did droids sent by Kiza attacked the planet .
