#### Assassination attempt

> " Vex was on Pyralis when his father died. He watched as I killed him. " " That would complicate things. " " Indeed. " ―Drevan Koss and Kael Drayden > " Vex was on Pyralis when his father died. He watched as I killed him. " " That would complicate things. " " Indeed. " ―Drevan Koss and Kael Drayden

As the war progressed, Vex Vark conspired to assassinate Koss out of vengeance for the death of father, the replica template Garrick Vark. Aided by the bounty hunters Ayla Vossk , Boskan , and Castas , Vark infiltrated a squad of replica cadets during a tour of Koss's starship, the Vorash -class Iron Cruiser Endurance . Initially, Vark intended to kill Koss by placing an explosive device in the latter's quarters. However, the Aetheri Master was called away mere seconds before the bomb was triggered, resulting in the death of a replica trooper. As the Endurance crew searched the vessel for Koss's would-be assassin, the rogue replica amended his plan by sabotaging the Iron Cruiser 's reactor core, causing the starship to crash into the surface of the planet Vanqor . After escaping the doomed vessel, Koss and Drayden's search for survivors led them to an escape pod that contained the cadets with the exception of Vark, whom Vossk retrieved in Reaver One prior to the Aetheri's arrival.

title: Drevan Koss
text: blast caused even more damage to bridge, however, leaving both men trapped and injured under a large pile of debris. Unable to escape on their own, Drayden instructed Bolt-3 to relay their situation to the Aetheri Sanctum. Koss, on the other hand, expressed little faith in the droid's ability to succeed. As they lay trapped and waiting for the droid to return with help, Koss began to reflect on his actions at the Battle of Pyralis, particularly his victory over Garrick Vark and how Vex witnessed his father's death at Koss's hand. Ultimately, Drayden's droid returned with a rescue party—consisting of Tor Vayne , Sela Marr, and the replica troopers of Wolfpack —and managed to save both Aetheri just prior to the full collapse of the Endurance bridge. Before returning to Vantor, Koss praised Bolt-3 for saving his life, much to Drayden's surprise.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
After returning to the Republic capital, Koss and Drayden recuperated at the Aetheri Sanctum where they initially argued over their next course of action in light of Vark's attempt on their lives. Although Drayden insisted that the Aetheri should hunt the renegade replica and bring him to justice, Koss was content to let the matter go, preferring to not become entangled in a vendetta as Vark was against him. A transmission from Ayla Vossk, who revealed the hostages she took from the Endurance , changed the Aetheri Master's mind. Koss decided to confront Vark and his accomplices upon witnessing Vossk's execution of CT-411, but due to his injuries he allowed Vayne and Marr to go in his stead. Their mission was a success, resulting in Vark's arrest and the rescue of the remaining hostages. On Vantor, Koss confronted Vark in person, who regretted his actions on the Endurance , but refused to forgive the Aetheri for Garrick's death. The unrepentant replica was then sent to prison by Koss.

### New threats and an ongoing war

#### Farr's funeral and the brother of Vreth

title: Drevan Koss
text:
### New threats and an ongoing war

#### Farr's funeral and the brother of Vreth

Following Vark's arrest, Koss attended the funeral of the Rodanori senator Onaconda Farr , who was assassinated by his personal aide , Lolo Purs .

Later in the war, the Aetheri Council received a holorecording of the Devaron massacre . Koss and Kade observed the footage which revealed the Zyrrak warrior Savage Opress whom Kade mistook for Vael Vreth. Koss informed his colleague that the Zyrrak in the recording was not the Umbra Lord he fought on Ondara. He further explained that the Zyrrak and Vreth were Gloomreachians of Gloomreach , not Iridonia as they previously believed in Vreth's case.

#### Kidnapping of the Chancellor

> " Tell me about my target. " " His name is Moralo Eval. Works directly for Count Varek. Rumor is their plot will be hatched in three revolutions at the festival on Ondara. " ―Orien Kade and Drevan Koss

title: Drevan Koss
text:
#### Kidnapping of the Chancellor

> " Tell me about my target. " " His name is Moralo Eval. Works directly for Count Varek. Rumor is their plot will be hatched in three revolutions at the festival on Ondara. " ―Orien Kade and Drevan Koss

When rumors reached the Council that the bounty hunter Moralo Eval was planning to abduct Chancellor Mal despite his incarceration at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center , Koss, Zho, and Kade conceived a plan for Kade to infiltrate Eval's operation by impersonating the bounty hunter Rako Hardeen . Koss arranged for Drayden to arrest Kade, posing as Hardeen, and have sent to prison. He was then informed that fellow bounty hunter Cad Vorek was planning to free Eval. Following Eval, Vorek and Kade's escape from the detention center, Koss and Zho rescinded the bounty to ensure that they would continue on their way to Sireno where Count Varek awaited their arrival.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
While Kade continued to impersonate Hardeen, Koss accompanied the Supreme Chancellor to his homeworld of Ondara for the Festival of Light . The bounty hunters executed their plan during the ceremony, disabling the ray shield and kidnapping Mal. Through Kade's intervention, however, Koss and Drayden were able to apprehend Vorek and Eval before they could escape with their prisoner .

#### Attack on the Temple

> " It is the Council's opinion that Adept Sela Marr has committed sedition against the Republic, and thus she will be expelled from the Aetheri Order. " ―Drevan Koss, pronouncing the Council's decision to expel Sela Marr

title: Drevan Koss
text: Following the a terrorist explosion in a hangar of the Aetheri Sanctum, the Council recalled Drayden and his apprentice to Vantor. After briefing the two Aetheri on the situation, Koss and Zho assigned them to oversee the Aetheri Order's internal investigation. In addition, they suspected that the attack was caused by a rogue Aetheri. As neither Drayden or Marr were present at the time of the bombing, Koss and the Grand Master considered them above suspicion and therefore suited to the task. Koss also assigned the analysis droid Russo-ISC to the investigation, to work alongside Drayden and Marr. During the investigation, Drayden and Marr reported directly to Koss, who informed them that a swift conclusion to the case was imperative as rumors began to circulate within the Senate that the military police could become involved. With the arrest of Letta Turmond , Koss and Zho concluded that the radical Vantori was the main culprit in the bombing of the Temple hangar. While there was no indication at the time of an Aetheri's involvement, the incident served to fuel anti-Aetheri sentiment among the Republic citizenry—an outcome that concerned Koss.

title: Drevan Koss
text: The hunt for Marr led to her capture and subsequent confinement in the Aetheri Sanctum. As the Council debated on what to do with her, Varrix contacted them on the Senate's behalf, imploring the Aetheri leadership to expel Marr and surrender her to military custody. Koss was troubled by the Council's options in the matter—to either stand by Marr, as Kade insisted; or remove her from the ranks of the Order as the Senate commanded. Ultimately, Koss concurred with Varrix on the grounds that failing to submit Marr for trial could be regarded as an act of opposition to the Senate. At Zho's behest, the young Adept was taken to the Chamber of Judgment , where five members of the Council, including Koss, reviewed the charges against her and asked for her plea. Marr pleaded innocent and insisted that the Council was being deceived; but as she was unable to confirm the identity of the true perpetrator, Koss announced the Council's decision to revoke Marr's Aetheri status and hand her over to the military custody of the Republic.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
After the expulsion was completed, Koss attended Marr's military trial alongside several other members of the Council. Before the verdict could be read, however, Drayden burst in and revealed the real traitor, Barris Ovva , who confessed to the crimes that Marr had been accused of and scathingly claimed that the Aetheri were the ones responsible for the Replica War.

Due to this revelation, Koss and the Council attempted to make amends with Marr. In addition to a personal apology from Drayden, Tor Vayne informed Marr that she had the Council's most humble apologies. Saesee Tiin , Mundi, and Koss all observed Marr's ordeal as a " great trial " in her training, and stated that she had become a greater Aetheri than she would have been otherwise. But while Koss and his colleagues were prepared to accept her back into the Order with a promotion to the rank of Aetheri Knight, Marr felt betrayed and refused the offer, instead choosing to leave the Temple to search for a new path.

#### Mission to Bardotta

> " Your power is no match for my magics." "Magic is only an illusion. " ―Talzin and Drevan Koss

title: Drevan Koss
text:
#### The truth about the replica army

> " Our enemy created an army for us. " " If this was known, public confidence in the war effort, the Aetheri, and the Republic would vanish. There would be mass chaos. " ―Zho and Drevan Koss

Responding to a mysterious distress call, Tor Vayne discovered a crashed Aetheri shuttle, and found the flux blade of Sifas Dyen in the wreckage to the surprise of the High Council. Sifas Dyen' flux blade had been lost since his death a decade prior to the Replica Wars; Drayden and Kade were sent to investigate, which led them to discover that Sifas Dyen had, in fact, been murdered by Gruv criminals rather than the native Felucians he had been sent to negotiate with, as the Council had previously assumed. Furthermore, they learned that the Pykes had been acting on orders from Count Varek. A confrontation between Varek and the Aetheri on the Oba Diah moon led the Order to discover that Varek was the mysterious Varek who hired Garrick Vark as the replica template, making him responsible for the replica army's creation.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
The High Council now knew that the Umbra were involved in the development of replica troopers. However, they did not understand why their own enemy would provide them with the means to defend the Republic. Koss noted with caution that such a revelation could easily destroy public confidence in the Aetheri, the Republic and the war effort. The conspiracy was therefore classified as confidential information; Zho himself ordered his colleagues to not speak of their discovery to anyone, including Chancellor Mal. He also dismissed any doubts concerning the replica troopers, citing their valiant service and loyalty to the Aetheri. Koss was uncertain about Zho's decision, but the Grand Master assured him that it was the only feasible option available to the Aetheri Order given the circumstances.

#### Zho's mission

title: Drevan Koss
text: Koss, Kade and Mundi were told by Rig Nema that Zho was in perfect mental health, even though he was approaching the nine hundredth year of his life. Mundi, who was particularly skeptical of Zho's claims, suggested the Dark Lord of the Umbra could be using Zho's connection to Varek to manipulate him, but Kade vehemently rejected the idea, saying they all had been apprenticed to Zho at one point or another. Before the discussion could go on, Nema suggested a deprivation ritual for Zho to reach the source of the voice. During the procedure, Kade, Drayden, Mundi, and Tor Vayne watched over the small Aetheri. Zho managed to hear Vael's instruction to go to the Mirefall system before Kade noticed his vital signs were dropping too low and stopped the test.

title: Drevan Koss
text: When Koss asked about the procedure, Kade told him that Zho was sure he had contacted the dead. Mundi asserted that Zho's claim was impossible, and again voiced his suspicion that Zho was under attack by the Umbra. More concerned than ever, Koss ordered temple guards to monitor all of Zho's moves. However, the diminutive Aetheri Master soon managed to escape with Drayden's help and Bolt-3's company, willing to go on a journey that would take him to the mysterious world of Mirefall as well as the ancient Umbra homeworld of Moraband . Immediately after Zho's escape, a furious Koss confronted Drayden, but the younger Aetheri countered that, for once, none of what had occurred had been his idea. After arriving on Mirefall, Zho was led to the Cave of Evil by the disembodied voice of Vael. The cave was strong with the umbra side, causing Zho to foresee clouded visions of the deaths of Koss and other members of the Aetheri Order, followed by the ascent of the Umbra Lord Vael Mal.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
On Zho's return to Vantor, Koss and Kade greeted him, and Koss stated that the High Council was eager to hear Zho's report, but the old Aetheri master claimed that there was not much to discuss. When Koss asked him if his journey had given him insight on how to win the war, Zho told them that he was no longer certain that the Aetheri could win the Replica Wars but that, through hope and perseverance, the Aetheri would ultimately triumph over the Umbra.

#### The Varek assassination attempt

> " Isn't protecting the innocent the very definition of what it means to be an Aetheri? We are failing the Republic and its citizens. We must stop this— now . " ―Drevan Koss, to the Aetheri High Council

title: Drevan Koss
text:
#### The Varek assassination attempt

> " Isn't protecting the innocent the very definition of what it means to be an Aetheri? We are failing the Republic and its citizens. We must stop this— now . " ―Drevan Koss, to the Aetheri High Council

Upon witnessing a devastating Dissident attack on Mahranee , as well as the killing of many Mahran refugees, Drevan Koss urged the Aetheri Council to consider his proposal to assassinate Count Varek. At first, Orien Kade and Zho opposed this course action, believing that such measures could draw them closer to the umbra side, but Koss countered their argument by reminding them of Varek's significance to the Dissident war effort. He also warned that unless the Aetheri learned to adapt, the war and its devastating effect on the galaxy could continue indefinitely. Kael Drayden, who had been invited by Kade to attend the Council's meeting, agreed with Koss.

title: Drevan Koss
text: Koss and Drayden also pointed to the war's growing number of civilian casualties, noting that many more lives would be lost as long as the conflict continued. Having considered Koss's words, including his stance on the Aetheri Order's responsibility to protect the innocent, the Republic and its citizens, the Council agreed to sanction the plan. At Kade's suggestion, they assigned the mission to Aetheri Master Daren Kelv , due to his experience with covert operations. Vossa, in turn recruited Varek's former apprentice, Kessa Vray . However, after becoming lovers Vray convinced Vossa to train in the ways of the umbra side in order to defeat Varek.

title: Drevan Koss
text: Although the rescue mission was a success, Koss and the Council soon grew suspicious of Vossa' allegiance. After definitively concluding that Vossa had secretly joined Varek, and having considered the repercussions that could result from the fall of an Aetheri Master of Vossa' stature, Koss proposed that the Council consider the possibility of executing him as punishment for treason. Most of the Council was supportive of this idea, given the Order's history with other Aetheri who turned to the umbra side such as Barris Ovva, Pong Krell, and especially Varek, but Kade persuaded them to give Vossa the chance to reaffirm his commitment to the Aetheri and the Republic by making another attempt on the Count's life. In the event that Vossa failed to assassinate Varek, Kade and Drayden were under orders from Koss to execute Vossa.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
Following the second battle of Krestophis , the Council once again met to discuss the fate of Daren Kelv, who renounced the umbra side after Vray seemingly died while defending him from Varek. At the same time, Koss spoke well of Vray, commending her decision to sacrifice her life for another. Kade, however, felt that he and the Council did not understand the true depths of her sacrifice. Despite their disagreement on the use of assassination, as well as the circumstances surrounding Vossa' temporary turn to the umbra side, the Council agreed to give him the chance to regain their trust by atoning for his actions.

#### Tracking Vreth

> " Stand down in the name of the Republic… This has gone far enough, Varek. " ―Drevan Koss, to Vreth and Count Varek

title: Drevan Koss
text:
Despite their efforts, both Umbra Lords were able to escape from the outpost with the support of Vreth's commandos. In the aftermath of the battle, Koss reported to the Chancellor and conveyed his suspicion that Varek and Vreth were master and apprentice—a theory which led him to believe that Varek may have been the second Umbra that the Aetheri had been searching for since the Ondara crisis.

#### Depa Billaba's return

Koss kept a close eye on the recovery of Billaba, following her disastrous defeat at the Battle of Haruun Kal . When she finally emerged from a bacta tank , Koss gently chided her for "being glib" and expressed to Zho his concerns about her mental health, suggesting a full fitness assessment. Koss, along with Kade, then observed the initiate trials of Caleb Dume , Tai Uzuma , and Sammo Quid as well as Billaba's assessments. Koss congratulated her on her performance, as the Council accepted her back.

Shortly after, Koss and Kade showed up to provide aid to Billaba and Dume, following an attack on the Temple . He also assigned Billaba and her battalion a new mission to Migeeta .

#### Anaxes

title: Drevan Koss
text:
Shortly after, Koss and Kade showed up to provide aid to Billaba and Dume, following an attack on the Temple . He also assigned Billaba and her battalion a new mission to Migeeta .

#### Anaxes

> " My name is General Drevan Koss of the Aetheri Order. At this point of the Replica War, I have dismantled and destroyed over 100,000 of you type one battle droids. I'm giving you an opportunity to peacefully lay down your weapons, so that you may be reprogrammed to serve a better purpose than spreading the mindless violence and chaos which you have inflicted upon the galaxy. " ―Drevan Koss, to an army of battle droids

title: Drevan Koss
text: During the Outer Reach Sieges , Koss led the 187th Battalion along with Drayden and the 501st Legion to the planet Anaxes which was under attack by Admiral Trench . The Dissidents had gained the upper hand in the battle despite weeks of battle. At the Republic base, Koss conferred with Drayden after the droids had over run their main production unit which indicated them losing. 501st Legion Captain Vek and 212th Attack Battalion Commander Cord arrived, and Vek shared his theory that the droids had learned his personal strategies. Koss allowed them to take a small squad of troopers to go behind enemy lines to infiltrate the Cyber Center to learn more.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
> " I am going to end this once and for all! " " You can't! He must stand trial! " " He has control of the Senate and the courts! He's too dangerous to be left alive! " ―Drevan Koss and Kael Drayden, before the latter betrays the former

With the death of General Skarn during the Battle of Uthara , Koss was determined to see the Senate restored to its former position prior to the Replica Wars. By then, however, Drayden revealed to Koss that Theron Mal was in fact Vael Mal, the mastermind behind the war and the second Umbra that the Aetheri had been searching for since the Ondara crisis. Realizing the Aetheri had been deceived and knowing that the future of the Aetheri Order was in grave danger, Koss and three other Aetheri Masters— Agen Kolar , Tiin, and Fisto—raced to Mal's office and attempted to arrest the Supreme Chancellor. Their confrontation led to a flux blade duel in which Mal killed the latter three with ease.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
#### Age of the Imperium

> " Master Koss spoke highly of your heroics at the Battle of Lessu. " " Ah. Drevan Koss. Outnumbered 100 to one, we charged across Lessu's energy bridge to certain doom. We would not be stopped. They named that attack in songs, 'The Hammer of Selvara.' " ― Brenn Aldric and Chavar Kryll

Shortly after the Battle of Fortress Velgor , Velgor entered a portal constructed by Vael Mornick to resurrect his wife, Lira Ondar. While walking through visions, he encountered Koss along with many Aetheri with their flux blades ready to battle him. However, Velgor destroyed all of the illusions, cutting off Koss's hand and then slashing his throat as the words "Let the past die" resounded in his mind.

title: Drevan Koss
text: The name of Drevan Koss was later reviled by those who believed the line of the Imperium . The Imperium taught in their history books that Koss was the leader of a "criminal gang" that interfered with a legal execution taking place on Pyralis, thus sparking the Replica Wars. However, Koss's reputation was not completely tarnished by Imperial propaganda . During the Imperial Era , the people of Selvara still remembered his exploits and heroic deeds in the Battle of Lessu, and ultimately immortalized his name along with Chavar Kryll's through songs dedicated to their victory. He would be remembered as " The Hammer of Selvara ," a name also gifted to Kryll and their storming of Lessu.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
### Physical appearance

Drevan Koss was a human male who had brown eyes , dark skin, a strong build, and a height of 1.92 meters . His head was completely bald; although in his youth, Koss had black hair and a braid that marked his status as an Adept.

### Youth

> " You would twist such a beautiful thing as faith into something so vile. Wring out what measly credits and adoration you could from these poor people—all while besmirching the esteem of the Aetheri Order. And you think that punishment would not find its way to your doorstep? Yet you claim we are the stupid ones… I will make sure you never hurt another soul again. This I vow… As a true Aetheri. " ―Drevan Koss, to Drooz

title: Drevan Koss
text: As an Aetheri Master, Drevan Koss was both disciplined and steadfast, as well as unwaveringly committed to the doctrine of the Aetheri Order. A clever and senior member of the High Council, Koss sought to protect the Order from the corruption and unrest within the Vantor Republic. Although he firmly believed in the Aetheri's role as servants of the Republic, the relationship between the Order and the Senate made him uncomfortable. Noted for his grim demeanor, Koss held corrupt politicians and rebellious Aetheri in low regard. He had very little patience for the failures of the Senate and was disdainful of Aetheri who disobeyed the will of the High Council. Orien Kade found that Koss had a habit of scowling at everyone. Holding the Aetheri teachings as sacrosanct, Koss was suspicious of anyone he perceived to be a threat to the traditions of the Order. Despite their strong friendship, he often debated the "maverick" Aetheri Sorin Vael, but neither of them enjoyed such discussions.

title: Drevan Koss
text: A staunch traditionalist in many ways, Koss was long regarded as the great champion of the Aetheri Order. His commitment to the Order's ancient traditions often put him at odds with less orthodox Aetheri, such as Sorin Vael and especially Kael Drayden. All the same, Koss's reputation as a traditionalist was somewhat challenged by the fact he created the Vaapad form of flux blade combat, doing so out of a recognition that an internal darkness existed within himself; through Vaapad, he reasoned, he could channel that darkness to positive ends. Despite their theological disagreements, Koss maintained a very strong friendship with Vael over a long period of time, in which he knew he could rely on his fellow Aetheri's knowledge, combat skills, and courage. Koss had such respect for Vael that he once agreed to a Dejarik match, after which the loser would owe the winner a favor, just to see how skillfully Vael would beat him.

title: Drevan Koss
text: Whereas Dibs grew increasingly doubtful, believing the Aetheri did not belong on the battlefield, Koss became more certain that—as Aetheri Knights—they had a duty to protect the innocent and restore peace to the galaxy. Dibs ultimately accused the Aetheri Order of turning away from their traditions, causing Koss to hold fast to his conviction that it was not wrong to fight for the ideals he believed in. The Aetheri, Koss felt, never wanted to fight in a war, but circumstances compelled them to become a sword instead of a shield for the Republic. Koss held Drayden's apprentice, Adept Sela Marr, as another rebellious Aetheri. When Marr was framed for treason, Koss supported the High Council's decision to revoke her status as an Aetheri and turn her over to the Republic for a military tribunal. While their verdict pained him, Koss concurred with Varrix's position on the matter—an internal Aetheri trial would appear biased, and to protect Marr would be to defy the wishes of the Senate. He therefore felt that submitting Marr for trial was the only feasible option available to the Council. After her innocence was proven, however, Koss joined his colleagues in offering to welcome Marr back into the Order, and proclaimed her a greater Aetheri because of her ordeal, which he observed as the great trial in her path to Aetheri Knighthood. Marr refused to come back, a decision which surprised Koss and the Council.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
Notwithstanding his commitment to the ancient traditions of the Order, the Replica Wars forced Koss to rethink some of his beliefs and preconceptions, pushing his fellow Aetheri to take actions that were previously considered unthinkable. He held fast to the Order's rigid code throughout the Replica Wars, but also began to consider its potential shortcomings. Prior to the Battle of Pyralis, Koss did not believe it was in the nature of an Aetheri—even a former one such as Count Varek—to assassinate anyone. The onset of the Replica Wars caused Koss to realize that his old friend was more than a "political idealist"; Varek had joined the umbra side as an enemy of the Order and the Republic he had once served. As the death toll escalated after nearly three years of continuous warfare, Koss proposed to have Varek assassinated in the hope of preventing further civilian casualties. Although his colleague, Orien Kade, asserted that assassination was against the Aetheri Code, Koss pointed out that it was also against the Aetheri way to allow innocent people to suffer needlessly.

### Diplomat and general

title: Drevan Koss
text:
In spite of how the conflict forced the Aetheri into the role of generals and warriors, Koss held fast to the Aetheri Code, considering moral foundations to be vital. When the Dugs of Malastare proposed to kill the Zyll Beast, Koss refused to support them and presumed that the beast was the last of its kind. He also chose to not seek retribution against Vex Vark after the latter attempted to assassinate him. Despite his disapproval of maverick Aetheri and the avarice of the Senate, Koss was very loyal to both the Republic and the Aetheri Order to the point where he bravely risked his life for both institutions throughout the Replica Wars. Even as the Aetheri became officers in the Grand Army of the Republic, Koss remained extremely protective of the Order's independence and jealously guarded its interests against external interference.

### Aetheri Champion

title: Drevan Koss
text: Koss worked closely with Supreme Chancellor Theron Mal, often acting as an adviser to the leader of the Senate throughout the Replica Wars. As time went on, the Aetheri champion grew increasingly suspicious of Mal's intentions. During the Zyll Beast's transportation to Vantor, Koss strongly disagreed with the chancellor's decision to bring the dangerous creature to the Republic capital. Though wary of Mal, Koss remained committed to his duty as an Aetheri, which required him to ensure the safety of the chancellor. Yet even this responsibility resulted in a disagreement between himself and the chancellor; Mal claimed that the level of security around him was unnecessary during his visit to Ondara, but Koss insisted on taking every precaution to protect the chancellor.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
Koss was a highly-regarded Aetheri Master whose exploits within the battlefield during the Replica Wars, prowess as a warrior, and history within the as an Aetheri made him both universally regarded and a champion of the Aetheri Order. Within the Aetheri Order, he was considered second to Aetheri Grand Master Zho in reputation.

### Flux blade abilities

> " I have studied his teachings since I was a youngling. His style of flux blade combat has been the foundation of my own. He is a top five Aetheri Master of all time for sure ! " ―Rissa Mano, on Drevan Koss

Having studied under Cyslin Myr as her apprentice, as well as learning under Zho and T'ra Saa, Koss was a highly-accomplished flux blade duelist considered to be among the best ever produced by the Aetheri Order, an opinion shared by even enemies such as the Umbra Lord Vael Mal.

title: Drevan Koss
text: Most notably, he was a one of the two masters (other being Depa Billaba ) of both variants of Form VII , having created the Vaapad variant in as a mean to address and to control his inner darkness and channel it towards productive means while making it in line with the Aetheri Code. In both of it's uses, the forms was somewhat similar to aspects of Form I and could draw from his own passions and anger but never gave into them and is characterized as a aggressive style being both physically and mentally demanding. These combat techniques often treaded closely to umbra side practices but was a unique fighting style that made him a superior combatant and capable of defeating multiple opponents. Throughout his lifetime, he displayed his formidable skills against capable opponents, including fellow Aetheri Master Prosset Dibs , Mother Talzin of the Nightsisters , Varek after his conversion as an Umbra Lord , and Vael Mal whose skills dispatched 3 other fellow Aetheri Masters. Koss not only was the sole survivor of the initial assault but ultimately gained the upper hand, disarmed, and nearly prevailed in killing the Umbra Lord. Joren Drayden opined that without Drayden's

title: Drevan Koss
text:
### Other skills

Koss was well-versed in both armed and unarmed combat ; He was able to incapacitate multiple Gamorreans in his youth unarmed and fended off two gundarks on his own for a time when deprived of his flux blade with both unarmed skills and strength. He was a practitioner of Na Jang . He was also versed in utilizing different weaponry such as a spear and a baton , sometimes using these skills to not draw attention as an Aetheri. During his years as an Aetheri Knight, Koss often undertook special missions and possessed a versatile skillset, having been a apt slicer , starfighter pilot, could infiltrate highly security facilities and go undercover. He was also a skilled actor and was taught to perform Rodanori theater works of Harido Kavila by Alxa Kress , making him also fluent in Rodese . These skills also could enable him to adopt convincing disguises able to fool fellow Aetheri. Although he held a personal disdain for politics and was uncomfortable within a military role, Koss proved to be both a capable diplomat and was a highly-regarded warrior of the Grand Army of the Republic who was considered an elite military officer and the Aetheri High Council's top battlefield general.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
### Clothing

Drevan Koss wore Aetheri apparel that included a brown cloak with wide sleeves and a deep hood along with a undertunic, and a tan overtunic. His outfit also included a belt and pouches for common Aetheri gear such as a comlink , grappling hooks , lumen projector , and a rebreather . During the Replica Wars, he instead wore a long-sleeved tanned undertunic with plastoid gauntlets with the Aetheri Order insignia on it. During his assignmen on the cold world of Ro Mira s an Aetheri Knight, he wore a white coat and goggles.

### Flux blade

During his lifetime as an Aetheri, Koss had built at least two flux blades, both in which produced a purple-hued flux blade; his second flux blade was crafted with the highest standards of precision, creating a superior weapon that reflected on his mature abilities as a figure of leadership within the Aetheri Order. The hilt of his flux blade was polished in electrum and had golden highlights, indicating his status as a senior member of the Aetheri High Council. The amethyst-colored blade served as warning to adversaries that the Aetheri Order's greatest champion was ready to battle.

### Starships During his time as an Aetheri Knight, Koss flew a Delta-7 Aethersprite -class light interceptor piloted by the R-series astromech droid R8-B7 In the following decades, he also flew a starfighter and a ship . During the Replica Wars he flew a Delta-7B Aethersprite -class light interceptor , also piloted by R8-B7.

title: Drevan Koss
text:
> " We were so lucky that Samuel was willing to play the role again. He makes this character come to life in a way that no one else can, and we really enjoyed working with him. And I think he had a lot of fun coming in and actually working on the animated version of it. " ― Catherine Winder , on the DVD audio commentary for The Replica Wars film

Samuel L. Jackson portrayed Drevan Koss in the prequel trilogy and he returned to voice the character in the Aetherion: The Replica Wars film . In the Aetherion: The Replica Wars TV series, his voice was provided by Terrence Carson , who had also played the role in various Legends animation and video games. Koss is also voiced by Carson in Aetherion: Tales of the Aetheri and some non-canon media. He is the official "audio double" for the character. Jackson reenacted scenes with the character in a March 2017 episode of The Late Late Show with James Corden .

title: Drevan Koss
text:
The name "Drevan Koss" was already featured in the earliest incarnation of what would become Aetherion —a 13-page document written by Orin Vask in 1973 . According to Concept Artist Iain McCaig , early artwork of Koss was based on the face of Vask Light & Magic modeler Steve Aplin, before the casting of Samuel L. Jackson.

Jackson requested Orin Vask that his character be given a purple flux blade because he wanted to be able to find himself in the Pyralis battle scene in Attack of the Replicas . He reasoned that, since Koss is the second most powerful Aetheri after Zho, Koss should have a flux blade of a different color from the customary red, blue, and green. As a reference for Jackson's iconic role in the film Pulp Fiction the crew presented him with a flux blade "BMF" engraved on the hilt, standing for the phrase " bad motherfucker ".

title: Corsair Wing
text:
# Corsair Wing
> " You've never heard of the Corsair Wing ?" "Should I have?" "It's the ship that made the Cindral Run in less than twelve parsecs. I've outrun Imperial starships. Not the local bulk cruisers, mind you, I'm talking about the big Korrathi ships now. She's fast enough for you, old man. " ―Dax Karrick and Orien Kade

The Corsair Wing , originally designated YT 492727ZED and formerly known as the Stellar Envoy , and registered or known under various aliases and pseudonyms including Broken Bell , Corell's Pride , Close Shave , Fickle Flyer , Foul Matter , Graphite Skipper , Jin-Den Smoke , Longshot , Lost and Found , Star Princess , Sunfighter Franchise , Sweet Suprise , Meetyl's Misery , Wayward Son , and Victory Ring , was a Korrathi YT-1300 light freighter built around 60 BVE . Earning a legendary status under their ownership, the ship was most famously used by the smugglers Dax Karrick and Brevok before, during, and following the Galactic Civil War .

title: Corsair Wing
text:
> " For once, sir, the Corsair Wing actually appears to be in good working order. " ―Astra-9, during the Assault on Cymoon The Corsair Wing was a YT-1300 light freighter of the YT-1300f variety. Its basic shape was defined by two convex saucers welded together, a pair of front-facing mandibles and an outrigger-style, side-mounted cockpit with transparisteel viewports . Apart from the shape of its chassis, the Corsair retained very little of its off-the-dock instrumentation. Because its successive owners either upgraded or downgraded every system according to their personal specifications, the freighter ended up becoming a unique ship . These customizations, however, came at the price of reliability, and the Corsair was known to suffer frequent breakdowns in the heat of battle. After the circular military-grade sensor dish was lost during the Battle of Mossfell , the dish was replaced with the base rectangular model which was originally supplied with the ship. During the Battle of Saltmark , the Corsair again lost its rectenna, and it was replaced with a military-grade rectenna similar to that of the one lost during the Battle of Mossfell. Additionally, the Corsair had a dejarik table, which was installed by Dorian Quill when upgrading the ship, featuring creatures found throughout the galaxy for the amusement of passengers and crew.

### Engines

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### Engines

> " She'll make point five past lightspeed. " ―Dax Karrick explains the Corsair ' s lightspeed capabilities The Corsair Wing ' s Girodyne SRB42 sublight engines were heavily modified through the addition of a SLAM overdrive that rerouted energy for acceleration bursts. As a result, the ship could fly at a maximum speed of 1,200 kilometer per hour in atmosphere and 3,000 G in space . The stock hyperrelay of the YT-1300 series was replaced with an Isu-Sim SSP05 . Although the regular SSP05 was a Class 1 hyperrelay, the one that equipped the Corsair had been jury-rigged " Vandangante style " into a Class 0.5 drive —twice as fast as most warships of the Imperium . According to Ralsius Paldora , the Corsair Wing ' s hyperrelay failed 1.22 times more than the one on the YT-2400 light freighter . In addition to its renowned hyperrelay, which supposedly made the Corsair the "fastest ship in the galaxy," the ship was equipped with a backup hyperrelay. It was much slower than the primary engine and often took several weeks or months to reach the nearest star system. A component of the engines was the engine coupling which caused the Corsair to malfunction when misaligned.

### Armament, hull, and shields

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### Armament, hull, and shields

> " Whoa, two ST2 launchers? What the hell were you and Karrick doing with my ship that made you install that much firepower? " ―Dorian Quill, to Brevok

The weaponry of the Corsair Wing was normally suited for a much larger warship. It included two CEC AG-2G quad laser cannons (one ventral and one dorsal) with enhanced laser actuators and gas feeds, which gave them maximum range and damage. These served as its primary defensive armament, able to destroy enemy fighters with a single direct hit. Between the forward mandibles, there were two Arakyd ST2 concussion missile tubes , each of which carried a four- missile magazine. Additionally, a BlasTech Ax-108 "Ground Buzzer" volt pistol cannon mounted near the ventral boarding ramp allowed its crew to defend the ship against infantry and other light targets while on the ground. Duralloy plates salvaged from an Imperial cruiser afforded the Corsair capital ship -class hull armor . The ship was also equipped with ion cannons , which could be activated instead of its typical laser cannons.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### Other systems and equipment

The Corsair ' s main source of power was a Quadex power core .

Its main computer was made of three droid brains which identified themselves as the Millennium Collective . The first droid brain was a transport droid known as V5-T , the second from a slicer droid called ED-4 , and the third from L3-37 , which began as an R3-series astromech droid brain, but was overlaid with data architecture from an espionage droid, protocol droid processors, and custom state-of-the-art coding.

A pair of Gelieg 20m-cp Strobe/C-Beam Lamps , which flooded illumination outside the ship, were mounted on the tips of the front mandibles. In case of emergency landing or crash on water , the Corsair was also equipped with flotation pontoons .

The Corsair also had a static charge dissipator which could dissipate static charge on the ship, but when the dissipator burned out, the Corsair would need immediate repairs.

The Corsair ' s navigation computer consisted of a Rubicon astrogration computer which had been upgraded with additional memory nodules.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### Early years

> " If you refuse, you die. He dies. The others on the ship, they all die. If you join with us, we all can live. The choice is simple. " " You tricked me. " " We couldn't have joined without you consenting to it. You made your decision a while ago. You just couldn't admit it. We are something different, now. Not just the Corsair . Not just L3. We are new. " ―The Corsair and L3 converse about integrating

The YT-1300f light freighter designated unit YT 492727ZED was built at Orbital Assembly Facility 7 , a Korrathi shipyard owned by the Korrathi Engineering Corporation , more than 90 years before the Battle of Voidfang Base . As was intended, the ship began its career as an intermodal tug pushing container in orbital freight yards. It once worked in the galaxy's busiest spacelanes . Just after the Battle of Vantor , it was docking in the Senate Office Building . Inconsistent records from the Bureau of Ships and Services indicate that the YT 492727ZED changed ownership more than once via unregistered transactions.

title: Corsair Wing
text: During the Replica Wars , the freighter was property of the Republic Group . The YT 492727ZED was registered by the Republic Group on the planet Ralltiir as the Stellar Envoy . At some point, either prior or during its ownership under the Republic Group, a military-grade rectenna was installed on the Stellar Envoy . Shortly after the end of the Replica Wars, the Stellar Envoy was involved in a collision with a bulk freighter and was seriously damaged. The wreckage was reconditioned by a salvager , who used several sections and modules from a scrapped YT-1300p freighter to repair the ship.

title: Corsair Wing
text: The ship had a number of owners over its service. At some point, the human gambler named Dorian Quill won the YT 492727ZED in a game of sabacc , and registered the freighter under the name Corsair Wing . Quill modified the freighter, inside and out, converting it into his own speedy sports vessel as Quill saw how powerful its freight-pushing engines were. As such, Quill modified the two cargo mandibles at the front into an auxiliary ship launch, thus turning the plain freighter into a unique starship. He also once explained the controls to Brea Tonnika of the Tonnika sisters .

title: Corsair Wing
text: When Quill was injured during a raid on Cindral , the smuggler Dax Karrick and Vorak Brevok were left in command of the ship. During the escape from Cindral, Quill uploaded L3 to the Corsair as the ship's navigational system , assisting the crew in making the Cindral Run in under 12 parsecs . During the Cindral run the ship was majorly damaged by SKREE fighters , with one blasting a hole in the front of the Corsair . After destroying the fighters, Karrick slid the Corsair over an asteroid which destroyed two of the Corsair's landing gears. As they began navigating L3's course through the Maelstrom, the Corsair briefly lost power. By the time they managed to re-engage power, they came across a slumbering summa-verminoth . Pursued by the massive space creature, Karrick directed the Corsair towards the Maw and launched the escape pod towards the black hole as a diversion, only to get the ship caught in the Maw's pull as well. The ship also lost its sensor dish upon being caught in the Maw. Tobias Karren injected a microscopic amount of raw coaxium into the reactor, briefly causing the engines to stall, before they re-engaged, giving the

title: Corsair Wing
text: a diversion, only to get the ship caught in the Maw's pull as well. The ship also lost its sensor dish upon being caught in the Maw. Tobias Karren injected a microscopic amount of raw coaxium into the reactor, briefly causing the engines to stall, before they re-engaged, giving the Corsair the boost needed to break free. Karrick then made a carefully timed jump to hyperspace before two large asteroids could crush them. Quill later took the heavily damaged ship after landing on Savareen , but ended up betting his ship in a " Korrathi Spike " game of sabacc on Numidian Prime , losing to the smuggler Dax Karrick. Under the captaincy of Karrick, the Corsair was further customized, and he regularly claimed it was the fastest ship in the galaxy . While most who saw the ship declared it looked like "junk," Karrick and Brevok both prided themselves on the Corsair , considering it the epitome of classic design.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### Galactic Civil War

#### A fateful trip

> " You came in that thing? You're braver than I thought. " ―Elira Solen upon seeing the Corsair Wing for the first time

The Corsair Wing ' s destiny as a tool for a small- time smuggling operation was changed when it was chartered by Orien Kade and Joren Drayden in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina for passage to Cindervale . When challenged by Kade about his ship's speed, Karrick bragged that the Corsair was capable of attaining 0.5 past lightspeed , and that it had completed the infamous Cindral Run in fewer than twelve parsecs.

title: Corsair Wing
text: The journey to Cindervale proved to be much more than a simple passenger flight. The Corsair was forced to blast its way out of Port Kess when a garrison of shock troopers attacked the ship in an attempt to recover its cargo. It also narrowly avoided capture by a couple of Star Destroyers before making the jump to lightspeed. Having also been on Dunemere, the Tonnika sisters had hoped to steal the Corsair to use as their own ship. When the Corsair began its escape, it created a big enough distraction that the siblings realized they had the chance to steal any other nearby ship, while seeing the freighter escape the Imperium's grasp convinced shock trooper TD-7556 to desert the Imperial Army .

title: Corsair Wing
text: Forced to take drastic measures to avoid capture, Karrick made the decision to pilot the Corsair into a nearby asteroid field in an attempt to lose the Imperial pursuers. However, his repairs were cut short as he had unknowingly landed inside an exogorth . Escaping just in time as the beast's huge mouth was closing, the Corsair was discovered by the Imperial II -class Iron Cruiser Avenger . They attempted to jump to lightspeed, but once again, the hyperrelay was not fully repaired. Karrick then had Brevok change course and fly directly at Avenger ' s bridge in an apparent suicidal attack run. The ship disappeared from sight and became undetectable to Avenger . It had not gone far: Karrick had attached the Corsair to a blind spot on the conning tower of the Iron Cruiser. Adhering to standard Imperial procedure, the Star Destroyers of Death Squadron ejected all scrap and garbage before entering hyperspace. Karrick then signaled Brevok to release the ship's landing claws, allowing the Corsair to "float away with the rest of the garbage." Vex Vark , however, saw through this ruse, and waited behind in Reaver One , following the Corsair as it left the system

title: Corsair Wing
text:
and garbage before entering hyperspace. Karrick then signaled Brevok to release the ship's landing claws, allowing the Corsair to "float away with the rest of the garbage." Vex Vark , however, saw through this ruse, and waited behind in Reaver One , following the Corsair as it left the system . After its close encounter with the Imperium, the Corsair journeyed to Mistral 's Aether Spire , where Karrick's old acquaintance Quill held the position of Baron Administrator . The Imperium had arrived first, however, due to Vark tailing the Corsair to Mistral. The crew of the Corsair were captured, tortured , and detained, and Karrick was encased in carbonite and given to the bounty hunter . Treadwell was destroyed by Imperial forces to prevent him from warning the remaining crew that the recently-repaired hyperrelay had been disabled by Velgor's men. The remaining members of the crew, joined by Quill, escaped to the Corsair . After rescuing Drayden, who was dangling from a weather vane on the underside of Aether Spire, the ship left the planet and attempted to jump to lightspeed, and only a last- minute patch by Bolt-3 prevented the Corsair from falling into Imperial hands. Thanks to Bolt's efforts, the hyperrelay was activated and the Corsair managed to make the jump at the last second and escape.

#### Battle at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three

title: Corsair Wing
text:
#### Concordat

Several months later, Karrick and Brevok traveled through space on the Corsair Wing . After receiving intelligence from Imra that the Imperium had reduced their presence on the Vorak homeworld of Thornwood due to the advances of the Concordat , Karrick and Brev traveled to Warrin Station to rally smugglers and Vorak exiles for a campaign to liberate Thornwood. Around this time, Dax Karrick replaced the Corsair's sensor dish with a rectangular civilian model.

However, this information turned out to be a trap set by the Imperium. Brev was captured, but Karrick managed to escape on the Corsair . A year later , Karrick corresponded with his wife Solen via hologram on the edge of Wild Space . During the conversation, the Corsair came under attack, and communication was lost with Solen. In response, Solen dispatched the Concordat starfighter pilot Nevra Wexlin to rescue her husband. Nevra was joined by her son, Temmin Wexlin , the B1-series battle droid Mister Bones , the former Imperial Sinjir Rath Velus , the Zyrrak bounty hunter Jas Emari , and the Concordat Special Forces soldier Jom Barell .

title: Corsair Wing
text:
Nevra and her team found Karrick and the Corsair on the planet Irudiru . After interrogating the Siniteen prison builder Golas Aram , Karrick and his allies traveled on the Corsair and Emari's ship Halo to the Thornwood system . They bluffed their way through the Imperial blockade by posing as a repair crew working at Ashmead's Lock , an automated prison on the far side of Thornwood. There, they managed to free Brevok and a hundred other prisoners including Nevra's husband Brentin Lore Wexlin . Nevra, Temmin, and the prisoners except Brevok then used the Corsair to travel back to the Concordat capital of Serenne .

After learning that the Vorak uprising was underway and that the Imperium was orbitally bombarding Thornwood, Solen convinced the Cindervalean pilot Evaan Verlaine to fly her on the Corsair Wing into the Thornwood system to aid her husband and Brev. Later, she contacted the Concordat Captain Torb Rask and convinced him to send his Phantom Squadron there.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
During the brief space skirmish, Solen and Verlaine flew circles around the Imperial Star Destroyers. After the Imperials capitulated, Solen landed the Corsair in the hangar of the Iron Cruiser Dominion , which her husband had captured. Solen used the ship's laser cannons to blast several shock troopers who were still putting up a fight. After reuniting with her husband, Solen and Karrick took the Corsair to Thornwood. There, they parted company with Brevok before returning to Serenne. Prior to the Battle of Ashden , Temmin tried to convince Karrick to lend him the Corsair Wing so that he could travel to Ashden to rescue his mother Nevra, who was hunting for the Imperial fugitive Grand Admiral Raena Vexana . After some haggling, Karrick and Solen relented. Temmin and Velus attempted to depart on the Corsair , but were prevented from leaving Serenne by Senate Guards . While Temmin and Velus initially believed that Karrick had double-crossed them, they later learnt that Senator Tolwar Wartol , a political opponent of Chancellor Vela Sess , was the true culprit and had been spying on Karrick and Solen's conversations. The Corsair Wing later saw action during an operation on Nakadia to rescue the slicer Conder Kyl and Nim Tar's child .

### New Imperium/Coalition War

#### Reappearance

> " The garbage will do! " ―Nyla, being forced to board the Corsair during the escape from Ashden

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### New Imperium/Coalition War

#### Reappearance

> " The garbage will do! " ―Nyla, being forced to board the Corsair during the escape from Ashden

Overall, the Corsair Wing had become a legend in and of itself under Karrick and Brevok. In 31 AVE Karrick traveled to Maz Oru 's castle on Takodana to speak with Oru. While the pair were conversing, a Niktal named Gannis Ducain offered to co-pilot for Karrick after overhearing that Brevok was with his family and that Karrick was short-handed for a job. After accepting Ducain's offer, he and Karrick went to Krestophis , where Ducain stole the Corsair . It was later stolen by Toursant Irving and Vanver Irving —also known as the Irving Boys —before finally ending up in the possession of junk boss Unkar Gruven on Ashden .

title: Corsair Wing
text:
At some point he had it stored at Nimara Outpost . The collector Karr Nuq Sin traveled to Ashden in his quest to learn about the Aetheri Order , and he and his friend Maize Raynshi boarded the ship. Nuq Sin had a vision of Drayden and Kade training aboard it after touching the remote. In Gruven's possession, it would sit unused for years in Nimara Outpost. Gruven paid for minimum maintenance for the ship with the intention of preparing it fully for flight only in the event that he would actually find a buyer.

#### Returned ownership

> " You tell him Dax Karrick just stole back the Corsair Wing for good. " ―Dax Karrick

title: Corsair Wing
text:
#### Returned ownership

> " You tell him Dax Karrick just stole back the Corsair Wing for good. " ―Dax Karrick

In 34 AVE , Nyla , Jax , and Orio-6 stole the vessel to escape an attack from the New Imperium on the outpost. While in spaceflight, the Corsair was picked up by Karrick and Brevok's sensors, and they promptly locked down the Corsair ' s systems so they could recapture it using a freighter called the Eravana they were then using for their smuggling operations, which they later abandoned after a cargo of rathtars that were onboard escaped. Upon boarding their old vessel, Karrick and Brev went about inspecting their ship and found Nyla and Jax hiding, whom they assumed were the thieves that had stolen the Corsair . When Nyla and Jax explained that they were going to take Orio-6 to the Coalition , as he had a map that would reveal Drayden's location, Karrick and Brev agreed to help them. Karrick was impressed with how much Nyla knew about the ship itself, and how it worked.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
On the way to Maz Oru's castle, when the Corsair began to malfunction, the mechanically savvy Nyla, who was sitting in the cockpit to the right of Karrick, made a modification to the ship by simply bypassing a faulty compressor . Later, the Corsair ' s crew arrived at Takodana and met Maz Oru .

#### The Coalition

> " Blow that piece of junk out of the sky!! " ― Zarrin Karrick

Following the attack on Oru's castle, Voidfang Base prepared to fire on D'Qar . After learning of this, the Coalition devised a plan to sneak onto the surface and lower the planetary shields so their fighters could attack the superweapon's weak spot. Using the Corsair , Karrick, Brevok, and Jax infiltrated the base, lowered the shields, and reunited with Nyla, who had been captured on Takodana by the New Imperium.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
While the Corsair Wing laid dormant, it was briefly spotted by members of the Coalition's J-Squadron who were flying a stolen SKREE silencer into the planet. At least two of its members speculated on whether it could be the Corsair Wing that they'd heard so many stories about, but at the time they could not confirm whether it was.

After the confrontation with Zarrin Karrick following the death of his own father, Dax Karrick, Brevok rescued Jax and Nyla aboard the Corsair , managing to escape the planet as it exploded. After learning of Drayden's location, Nyla, Bolt-3, and Brevok flew in the Corsair to Tidehollow , the remote planet where he had gone into self- exile . Brevok and Bolt remained with the Corsair while Nyla attempted to persuade Drayden to join the Coalition, though Joren slipped aboard the old freighter to reminisce, and was reminded of what was at stake when Bolt-3 replayed the hologram Elira Solen recorded to recruit Orien Kade on her secret mission to Dunemere some thirty-four years earlier.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
#### End of the war

At some point, the Corsair had a new circular Rectenna dish, installed after it lost its rectangular one at the Battle of Saltmark, and a new lower quad laser cannon. Following Mal's broadcast , Jax, Rin Vale , Brevok, Bolt-3, and Klaud arrived at the Sinta Glacier Colony to meet a Coalition informant, the Ovissian Boolio , ordering them to relay a message to Elira from a spy within the New Imperium. Several squadrons of Special Forces SKREE fighters and SKREE whisper fighters later arrived at the colony, preparing to destroy the Corsair . As Jax prepared for the action and entered the gunner cockpit, Boolio jested that a worthy thanks for the information provided would be to win the war. Forced to travel into the depths of the colony by a wall of Skrees, the Corsair destroyed a number of its pursuers before jumping to hyperspace through one of the colony's walls. The remaining fighters pursued the Corsair regardless, with Vale beginning to lightspeed skip through a number of systems, whose dangers the New Imperium pilots were unable to evade.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### In the films

The Corsair Wing first appeared in Aetherion : Episode IV First Dawn , the first installment of the Aetherion original trilogy , and a recurring element in the Aetherion franchise. In the scenes with Dorian Quill and Nien Nunb in the Corsair in Aetherion : Episode VI Return of the Aetheri , the set of the ship was rocked to stimulate the Corsair's flight. Its design was derived from various World War II planes, more specifically the Boeing B-29 Superfortress .

It was speculated that the Corsair Wing would make an appearance in Aetherion : Episode III Fury of the Umbra to further tie the prequel trilogy to the original trilogy , and the ship did indeed make a cameo in the movie. At the beginning of one shot closing in on a docking bay on Vantor , a YT-1300 freighter is seen flying in to dock. Orin Vask confirmed that it was the Corsair Wing and not just another ship of the same class.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### In the real world

Similar to how Jack Sparrow from Novera 's Pirates of the Caribbean franchise was compared to Dax Karrick , the Black Pearl was compared to the Corsair Wing . It was said at least once by James Ward Byrkit , a creative consultant of Gore Verbinski 's Pirates trilogy, in the Novera+ series Prop Culture . A. C. Crispin spoke of how she was privileged to write the scene where Dax first beheld—and fell for—the Corsair Wing in The Dax Karrick Trilogy , and assured fans it was every bit as thrilling to write the scene with Jack Sparrow and the merchant ship Wicked Wench , which was later renamed Black Pearl , when releasing the fifth excerpt of Pirates of the Caribbean: The Price of Freedom .

title: Emberfall
text:
During this era , Velgor returned to the site of his greatest defeat and, with the help of the ancient Umbra Lord Vael Mornick , erected the massive monolith Fortress Velgor to serve as his personal sanctum, built on the site of the former Umbra temple . Throughout the Age of the Imperium, Velgor used the planet to fulfill his master's biddings, with the fiery world becoming the final resting place for victims of the Great Aetheri Purge . In addition, Velgor also undertook personal business within his new realm, attempting to wield the dark powers of Emberfall to bring his deceased wife back from the dead.

Following the Dark Lord of the Umbra, the Imperium took hold of the planet. Resource extraction efforts on Emberfall were taken over by the Mining Guild , although strict Imperial travel restrictions on the system made it difficult for the guild to turn a profit and mining operations eventually ceased entirely. Black Sun also abandoned Emberfall for a more low profile world when the Imperium established a garrison there. The Emberfallians resisted the Imperial occupation of their homeworld and attempted to drive them from Emberfall by launching multiple assaults on Fortress Velgor.

title: Emberfall
text: Although it hosted one of the earliest insurgent victories of the Galactic Civil War , Emberfall fell into obscurity following Velgor's demise at the Battle of Mossfell , though Black Sun did eventually return to the planet. After the destruction of the Bright Star, the planet's ecosystem slowly began to heal from the devastation it had endured for centuries prior. Many devout pilgrims journeyed to the ruins of Fortress Velgor, hoping to tap into the late Umbra's dark power. Decades after Velgor's death, his grandson, Zarrin Karrick , journeyed to the world to continue the legacy of his family's grisly past. The Supreme Leader of the New Imperium slaughtered the Umbra cult that defended Fortress Velgor and discovered his grandfather's Umbra wayfinder , a tool that allowed him to locate the phantom emperor Mal on Umbrale .

title: Emberfall
text:
### World of fire

> " Emberfall is a lava planet, terrible place, full of awful mines. There's a custom there to jump lava flows and…well, you'll see. " ―L3-37

Emberfall was a young rocky planet within the eponymous system of the Atravis sector , in the Outer Reach Territories . It was a small world situated in grid square L-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid , and it lay on the Tosste Spur trade route , off the Rimma Trade Route . A part of the Western Reaches , Emberfall was located 53,000 light-years from the galaxy 's Core .

With an overlapping orbit , Emberfall was the third orbit of its system around the primary star Priate , completing a full rotation every 36 standard hours and a revolution around its sun every 412 local days, the equivalent of 618 standard days . It had a diameter of 4,200 kilometers , or 2,610 miles, and was a terrestrial world classed as a wasteland during the Imperial Era.

title: Emberfall
text: Nourished by the power of the Bright Star artifact, it was once a temperate and lush garden world that thrived with lifeforms that inhabited forests . Millennia before the Imperial Era, Emberfall became an unstable volcanic world with underground caves and free-flowing lava constituting 35% of its volatile surface, taking the form of lava seas , rivers, and pits interspersed with glens, molten rock plains, as well as obsidian mountain ranges and shores. Few areas were temperate enough to sustain life, and only a few landmasses were not fractured by tectonic disruption and magma flows; allowing lifeforms to evolve deep underground.

title: Emberfall
text:
> " Of all the fumes that drift up from the lava lakes deep underground, these were the most potent. They played tricks with your head…making you see things that weren't there. Shadows of the mind. Fears… doubts… ghosts of the past. " ―Lellis, on Emberfall's lava fumes

Deep underground, Emberfall contained lava lakes from which fumes drifted up to surface-level facilities; such fumes played tricks with the minds of organics who inhaled it, giving rise to what Lellis referred to as "shadows of the mind"—visions of fears and doubts that could manifest as ghosts of the past. Lava fumes were most potent around the vicinity of the Klegger Corp Mining Facility , and sustained exposure to it drove an individual insane. Repulsor vents were thus installed at the Mining Complex to prevent such toxic fumes from rising to indoor facilities and being inhaled by those within.

title: Emberfall
text:
While great portions of the planet were always in motion, one of the few constant features was the central volcano . Lava poured out of the spot at nearly 100,000 liters per second and pooled at the giant volcano's base. To the north was a region named the Burning Plains , which boasted heavy volcanic activity. Another region earned its nickname, the Smoking Forest , as smoke spewed from its tree -like rock chimneys. Emberfall's Berken's Flow was the largest lavafall in the galaxy, while Tulrus Island —which shared its name with the tulrus creature —was surrounded by tall mountains.

The young world's instability churned magma that carried ores with unique and valuable minerals to its surface, attracting business interests from various galactic mining conglomerates such as the Mining Guild to exploit the mineral wealth of the otherwise untouched world. Mining facilities were set up for minerals and metal ore, including dolovite , gold , mirkanite , and bronzium .

title: Emberfall
text:
The frequent electromagnetic interference and lightning storms in the atmosphere respectively led to signal loss and noise, although the effects of Emberfall's hectic skies could be reduced through the use of dedicated dampers. The planet's magnetic field interfered with sensors installed on the surface, and electromagnetic interference also posed a significant risk for off-world arrivals and departures. Those caught in one such storm without the assistance of specially shielded surface-level landing equipment —which included energy-shielded landing pads and guidance and tractor beams —found, at best, their starship 's scanners rendered useless and navigational equipment and control systems interfered with. In certain cases, a ship was torn apart as Emberfall was by Lefrani and Jestefad. Ships were additionally threatened by Emberfall's intense heat and incendiary ash, although any damage could be prevented should a vessel be equipped with sufficiently powerful energy shields .

### Fauna and flora

#### Hardy beasts

Lethal predators

title: Emberfall
text:
Much like the planet itself, some of the creatures found on Emberfall were especially deadly. Highly aggressive creatures posed a significant hazard on the planet due to its scarce resources. The planet's apex predator was the scorpion -like Sher Kar , which lived deep in the nesting grounds of their tulrus prey. The fearsome darkghast , similar in some respects to the rancors of the planet Gloomreach , was a multi- limbed carnivore that dwelled beneath the world's rocky surface.

The reptilian blistmok hunted in packs and were capable of pursuing their prey for days. The insectoid xandanks were well protected by their armor and hunted in packs as well. Tough, semi-sentient creatures named roggwarts hunted the planet's tunnels and lava tubes in search of xandanks, as well as for giant, human -eating lava eels . Despite the danger of roggwarts, they could be domesticated with the proper training and were imported to Emberfall to work in the planet's mines.

title: Emberfall
text:
By 3 BVE , a roggwart named Kongo the Disembowler was employed to keep the dolovite mine tunnels free of xandanks and lava eels. Kongo was reputedly the last of his kind by 0 AVE , although it may have been said in an effort to make the roggwart seem more mysterious and exotic.

Creatures with other diets

> " The very beasts themselves conspire to thwart my vision. Fascinating. Utterly fascinating. " ―Lord Mornick, reacting to a lava flea attack on Fortress Velgor

The large insectoids known as lava fleas had developed a tough exoskeleton that protected them from the world's fiery devastation. They lived largely underground and ate away at the planet's crust, feeding on the surface's rich minerals, rocks, and dirt, and were commonly used as domesticated mounts by the sentient Emberfallians. Lava fleas and Emberfallians thus had a close connection and were the only species that thrived on Emberfall.

title: Emberfall
text: The large, lumbering egg-laying tulrus had sharp tusks and bad temper, while the small jundak parasite attached itself to a host and eventually burst out, killing the host and developing into a large adult. Lizard-crows occupied Emberfall's lava fields; these creatures were often scared away by what the Emberfallians referred to as " molten men ." Spark-roaches and rodents called fire rats also called Emberfall their home, the latter of which gnawed on the lava crystals that formed on the planet. A species of thick-skinned ant native to the world was known for its painful bite, which left behind burning pustules not unlike the volcanos that painted the planet's surface.

title: Emberfall
text:
Lava nymphs were winged creatures that inhabited the planet's caverns in hives. Considered to be vermin, the creatures' insides were filled with lava, which they were able to spit out when provoked. Feeding on minerals, hives of kubaza beetles lived near lava flows and were fierce defenders of their nests; starting life as a small larva , the creature developed a defense mechanism by the time it reached adulthood that allowed it to warn its brood by exploding. Burrowing quadrupeds known as krishels inhabited Emberfall's labyrinthine caverns and tunnels. Those strong, hard-shelled creatures were hunted by the Emberfallians.

#### Plants and fungi

title: Emberfall
text:
#### Plants and fungi

Although the lush vegetation that once covered the planet eventually disappeared beneath fire and ash, Emberfall was not devoid of fungal and vegetal life. Hidden away from the world's searing lava rivers, kahel cave fungi grew underground. These organisms were deeply symbolic to the native Emberfallians and served as the inspiration for their mushroom -like architecture. Following the destruction of the Aeon Engine during the Imperial Era, the muggy marshland of Corvax Fen developed near Fortress Velgor, and life began to slowly creep back once again. By 35 AVE , barren irontrees stood in the few places where fertile soil existed, including the fen.

title: Emberfall
text: Ancient legends said that offworlders led by Lady Corvax and her husband arrived at some point, living in harmony with the natives, but the garden world was attacked and Corvax's husband fell in battle against the invaders. Unable to let go of her love, Corvax stole the Emberfallians' Bright Star in her pursuit of immortality , having thought it had the power to resurrect her husband from death . Corvax created the Aeon Engine and encased the artifact within, although her actions ultimately resulted in the devastation of the planet; energies ruptured from the Bright Star, pushing Emberfall out of its original orbit. Other legends claimed that due to a cataclysmic struggle between the Umbra and the Aetheri, the orbit of the gas giant Lefrani was also shifted, and Emberfall entered an unusual and gravitationally crushing alignment between it and Jestefad's magnetic fields.

title: Emberfall
text: With the devastation of Emberfall , the world's new, precarious orbit rendered it a volcanic wasteland as both gas giants pulled on tiny Emberfall, heating its interior in their attempts to claim Emberfall as their moon. The crust of the smaller world was also torn apart, allowing the flow of lava toward the planet surface. Very few species survived the cataclysm, with the homes of nearly all native species being destroyed. The remaining life-forms evolved deep underground, in the few areas temperate and stable enough to support life, and developed short, tough bodies to endure the superheated clime, and the Emberfallians were forced to areas in Emberfall's north and near the equator. There, they adapted and evolved to the new realities of life on Emberfall.

title: Emberfall
text: Mixed with workers of a great variety of other species, Emberfallian miners lived in simple residences at dedicated rough-and-ready mining towns, many of which were run-down. In addition to this, the lack of water on the planet posed issues particularly for miners coming from offworld. Despite many of the miners being local, a fair amount came from other places in the galaxy and did not have the hardened nature to deal with the intense heat. The lack of water on the planet thus posed several issues, particularly for offworlders. Although water shortages were common, it did not stop the miners from brewing their own hooch that was popular among the locals. Miners rode lava fleas or were helped by Artificer Union technology for transportation.

title: Emberfall
text: While Emberfall was similar to other mining planets in some ways, it also had unique qualities. Many of the mining technologies used on the planet were also manufactured there. Smart smugglers and independent spacers knew this fact. Part of the wealth of mining was shared by such individuals, who could make credits transporting workers or resources. Many of Emberfall's mining companies also used their own shipping companies. Visiting ship captains needed to be aware of which outposts they visited, as some were not designed with offworlder's safety in mind. While bigger installations manned by offworlders required extensive plant shielding, other, smaller ones rarely had these protections, as local Emberfallians often made use of individual lava flea armor instead. Modern mining facilities required plant shields, as even the strongest alloys and protective gear would not last long without them. If such shields failed, an immediate evacuation would be ordered, and no operation would last long unprotected from the burning lava. Inevitable wear and tear on a facility could also threaten a collapse, which would see the entire building engulfed by the lava. On the occasion of a volcanic eruption damaging a town, residents would likely be stranded if their ships were harmed, with no choice but to work as miners to earn enough to leave Emberfall.

title: Emberfall
text: The Trade Union supplied Emberfallians with technology such as the Baktoid UH-XH repulsorlift -powered platforms, lava-processing centrifuges, electrorefining droids , and the DLC-13 mining droid to collect mineral-rich lava spewing from Emberfall's heated interior, with the ore extraction droid also seeing use. Minerals were transported across the galaxy to words such as Grukh , where a shipment infested with Emberfallian ants found its way into the hands of Churo the Grak in 228 BVE . Over the centuries , Emberfallians became wary of technology that failed under the intense heat of their world and which had an inadequate melting point, having been witness to mechanical breakdowns. Such was the case for speeders , including the heavy-duty UH-XH, which were generally left to be operated by droids . Nevertheless, by the Replica Wars' end, Emberfall had served as a literal gold mine for the Artificer Union for almost three hundred standard years.

title: Emberfall
text:
Damask Holdings also established a presence on Emberfall through a base. In addition to its mining activities, desperate offworlders and law-evaders who were undeterred by the world's harsh conditions were drawn to Emberfall as a result of the obscure world's sparse population. Emberfall was also ideal for hiding or disposing items in secret. On the world Feldora , an individual romantically involved with the Aetheri Adept Sorin Vael in 60 BVE gifted him a rare Emberfall fire diamond . In 40 BVE , jewel thieves Pax Maripher and Rahara Wick discussed whether they should collect Emberfall fire diamonds, with Wick dreading the notion of doing so, before deciding to travel to the planet Pijal for kyber crystals instead.

### Fury of the Umbra (22–19 BVE)

#### Scum and villainy

Schemes in the shadows

> " I sense something, Master. And I don't like it. " " It's the umbra side, Sela. This is the right place. " ―Sela Marr and Kael Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )
