Kade then helped Drayden subdue Marr, until the Father's appearance interrupted them.

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### The Citadel

> " Orien, what took you guys so long? " ―Even Piele, on his rescue

Following the capture of Aetheri Master Even Piele and his imprisonment in the Citadel one year and nine months into the Replica Wars, Kade, Drayden, Commander Cord, Captain Vek, and other troopers were sent to rescue the imprisoned Aetheri. Joined by a rebellious Marr, who joined the mission despite Drayden's orders, Kade and the rest froze themselves in carbonite to prevent the prison's life scanners from detecting them and infiltrated the prison. During their free climbing to the entry point, surrounded by electromines , Marr snuck through a ventilation duct to disable their entrance's ray shield . However one trooper fell, alerting the prison of their presence. Despite this, the team made its way to Piele and freed him.

title: Orien Kade
text:
When the Aetheri Council were looking for a underwater race that close enough to reinforce the Republic's forces fighting on the planet of Mon Calvarra , Kade was the one who suggested that Ondara may be close enough to help.

Kade, along with fellow Aetheri Tiin, Drayden, Drayden's Adept Sela Marr, Adept Barris Ovva, and Pong Krell , was deployed to retake the planet of Umbara . Kade's battalion's mission was to take the capital and met fierce coalition from the Umbaran militia . Kade then contacted Krell and the 501st, to order them to secure an Umbaran airbase that was resupplying the capital.

title: Orien Kade
text:
After his battalion had been pushed away from the capital due to the Umbaran's long-rage missiles, Kade congratulated on his success on taking the airbase and informed him that the capital still receiving supplies, this time from a Dissident supply ship in the atmosphere. He also informed Krell of oncoming, but delayed reinforcements, only for the Besalisk to tell him he would take his battalion to the city regardless of the capital's defenses. Kade's transmission was then jammed by the Umbarans. Despite Krell's efforts to sabotage the Republic effort by tricking the 501st and the 212th battalions into attacking each other, Kade was successful in taking the capital and routing the remaining Umbaran forces, securing all sectors of the planet for the Republic.

#### Zygeran slave crisis

> " If such Aetheri as Drayden and Kade can fall, how many other will follow? Imagine an army of Aetheri in your service. " ―Miraj Scintel, to Count Varek

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Zygeran slave crisis

> " If such Aetheri as Drayden and Kade can fall, how many other will follow? Imagine an army of Aetheri in your service. " ―Miraj Scintel, to Count Varek

Ten rotations after Master Zho's last contact with the Solinai colony of Kiros , Kade, Drayden, Marr, Captain Vek, and Commander Cord landed on the colony, where they found no inhabitants and fought their way through droid contingents on BARC speeders to the governor's tower . Once they had the Dissident headquarters surrounded inside the governor's tower, Cord showed Kade a message from the Dissident commander, Darts D'Nar , asking him to come to the tower to negotiate terms of "surrender." When Drayden became angry at recognizing D'Nar as a Zygeran slaver , Kade told his old apprentice to look for the colonists while he negotiated with D'Nar and explained Drayden's history with slavery to Marr, who assured Kade she would keep an eye on him.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade then went into the tower and interrupted D'Nar's meeting with Varek and Zygeran Prime Minister Atai Molec to negotiate terms of surrender—the Republic's surrender. Kade then turned his comlink on so that Drayden and Sela could hear the fact that the Zygeran had several bombs planted throughout the city. Kade then surrendered, but challenged D'Nar to a duel in the Zygeran way (with no weapons) to distract him while Drayden and Marr disarmed the bombs. Though he received a good beating from D'Nar, Kade successfully beguiled the Zygeran, who set off his last bomb located on his tactical droid and escaped from the Aetheri Master. Unable to pursue him, he told Drayden and Marr of his departure. After Drayden captured D'Nar and his ship, Kade, Drayden, and Marr then contacted the Aetheri Council, informing them of the Zygerrians' abduction of the colonists.

title: Orien Kade
text: Using D'Nar's ship, Kade, along with Drayden, Marr, Captain Vek, and Bolt-3, traveled to Zygera. Upon arrival they formed two teams; Drayden and Marr went to talk to Queen Miraj Scintel disguised as master and slave, respectively, while Kade and Vek, disguised as Zygeran traders, tried to locate the kidnapped colonists from Kiros. The two proceeded to the Royal palace's slave pits where they found the Togrutan Governor of Kiros, Gupat Roshti , weak and broken from his ordeal. With Vek, Kade decided to take him to safety on a brezak , only for Kade to be shot in the shoulder and captured along with Roshti, with Vek safely escaping. Chained to a wall and tortured for information, Kade was recognized as an Aetheri by Prime Minister Atai Molec, and prepared to sell him at that night's auction block.

title: Orien Kade
text: At the auction, Roshti and Kade were the first slaves to be put on offer, and Queen Scintel ordered Drayden to torture Kade with a shock whip before the eyes of the assembled bidders. Once Drayden entered the arena however, he signaled to Bolt-3, who launched Kade's, Drayden's, and Marr's flux blades to their owners, while Vek aided them with a volt pistol. Despite their efforts, however, the whole team was soon captured and separated. While Drayden and Marr were kept in Zygera, Kade, Vek and Roshti were taken to Kadavo , where the rest of the Kiros colonist were kept. There, the Aetheri General was forced into submission by the center's warden, Agruss , who emphasized his point by dropping several Togrutan prisoners to their deaths and threatening to do worse to the others, should Kade ever think of insurgency.

title: Orien Kade
text:
On Kadavo, Kade and Vek were soon forced into working in the mines, where he had a hard time scrounging up any spark of hope for himself or the unfortunate prisoners, since every time he did so, one of the Togrutans was punished in his place in order to heighten his despair. Following the Queen's death at the hands of Varek and her last words telling Drayden where Kade was, Kade was part of a conference with Count Varek in the facility control room. Despite Varek's wish to execute Kade, Drayden arrived to Kadavo with Aetheri reinforcements. During the battle that ensued, Kade and Vek fought in the room, killed Agruss and escaped the facility, while Marr and troopers rescued the Solinai prisoners before the Republic forces destroyed the labor facility.

#### Plot to kidnap the Chancellor

> " How do I look? " " Like a criminal. Should buy you all the credibility you need in prison. " ―Orien Kade and Drevan Koss

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Plot to kidnap the Chancellor

> " How do I look? " " Like a criminal. Should buy you all the credibility you need in prison. " ―Orien Kade and Drevan Koss

Following Moralo Eval 's capture by the Republic and his imprisonment in the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center , Kade became part of a plot with Zho and Drevan Koss to stop Eval's machinations to kidnap Chancellor Mal. To do so, he allowed himself to be shot by a sniper , Rako Hardeen , in front of Drayden and Marr, who then believed him to be dead.

title: Orien Kade
text: When they arrived at Grukh, Kade crashed their ship in order to cover their trail. The trio then proceeded to try to find supplies and a new ship in the town of Bilbousa . Vorek grew even more distrustful of Kade after Kade's kind treatment of Pablo , the owner of the pawnshop that the trio went to. Kade, suspecting betrayal, planted a tracking device on the new ship he bought, so that when Vorek left Kade to be arrested by the local authorities, the Aetheri turned the frequency of the tracking device over to his captors, who shot Vorek and Eval's ship down. Kade, meanwhile, escaped from captivity and purchased another ship, and when Vorek and Eval found him smugly waiting for them, they agreed to make him a partner in their scheme. When the trio reached Orondia , Drayden and Marr caught up with them. During a small confrontation , Kade wrestled with Drayden, whispering "Kael, don't follow me," just before knocking him unconscious and escaping with Vorek and Eval.

title: Orien Kade
text: Eval, Vorek, and Kade then traveled to the planet Sireno to meet with Count Varek, and Vorek and Kade accepted an invitation to participate along with eleven other notorious bounty hunters in a test of skill designed by Eval called the Box . "Hardeen" surpassed Eval's tests, the Phindian grew angrier with him after every test. In the fourth and final test, their shooting skills would be tested, with the bounty hunter's target being a moving spot on the wall. If they missed, they would fall into a floor of flame emitters. After Sixtat failed, Kade stepped in to shoot the target. However, Eval had laid a trap for Kade, as his rifle ran out of shots before he could hit the last moving spot. Eval then removed the platforms in order to kill him, but Vorek, now having respect for Kade and disgusted by Eval's actions, saved him. Varek decided that Eval should not be exempted from the contest and dropped him to the now extinguished floor to fight with Kade. Though the Count wanted him to kill Eval, Kade refrained, disappointing the Umbra Lord, who then chose to put Vorek in charge of the operation to kidnap the

title: Orien Kade
text:
decided that Eval should not be exempted from the contest and dropped him to the now extinguished floor to fight with Kade. Though the Count wanted him to kill Eval, Kade refrained, disappointing the Umbra Lord, who then chose to put Vorek in charge of the operation to kidnap the Chancellor. Within a few hours, the team departed the planet for Ondara. Planning to abduct Mal during Ondara's Festival of Light , the team commandeered a warehouse in Serath and each member of the team was assigned a role, with Kade being given the job of the sniper who would fire stun blasts at the Chancellor. When he was in position, Kade contacted Koss to tell him what he knew of the plan. Later that night, despite Drayden and Koss's efforts during the skirmish , the Chancellor was kidnapped by Vorek and Eval. Kade followed them with Koss and Drayden close behind, and the criminal pair was arrested and the Chancellor recovered when they stopped at the rendezvous point.

However, he agreed on Drayden's doubts about knowing the full truth, and returned to the apartment where he had had his position as a sniper, and discovered an activated comlink in his rifle case. Realizing Varek's hand in it, Kade rushed back to the Royal Palace, where he discovered Drayden dueling with Varek, while Mal was held by a MagnaGuard . After Kade rescued the Chancellor and Varek fled, Mal thanked the Aetheri for their bravery.

#### Vreth's return

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade arrived in a burning village with Vreth awaiting him. Though the Aetheri Master was unsure if Vreth was who he claimed to be, the Gloomreachian proved it by telling him about their shared experience at the Battle of Ondara. The two engaged in a fight and Kade was overpowered at the hands of his old enemy, who had the help of Opress. Kade was then brought aboard the brothers' ship , who intended to have the Aetheri awake so that his death would be as painful as the last ten years of his life had been. However, Kade was rescued by Kessa Vray, who was trying to collect the bounty on Opress' head. After being freed, Kade used one of her flux blades to duel Vreth in the cargo area of their ship. Though he almost gave in to rage, Kade gained the upper hand with the help of Vray and together, they managed to trap Vreth and Opress in the back of the ship, leaving the brothers stranded, but alive, in space.

#### Aiding the Underra insurgents

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Aiding the Underra insurgents

> " Now, to be clear, we are not here to fight your war; rather, to show you how to conduct it in the most efficient and successful way possible. " ―Orien Kade

Kade attended a session of the Aetheri Council when insurgents Torrik Vess and Lux Bontero contacted them with a request for assistance in their struggle against the Dissident forces on Underra , led by King Sanjay Rash . Kade pointed out that at the beginning of the war, Underra made their intentions to join the Dissidents, but Vess said that their true king was silenced by the fake. The Council refused to help, but did consent to send advisers to train and advise them. Kade went there with Drayden, Marr, and Vek.

title: Orien Kade
text:
On Underra, Kade met the insurgents and their charismatic leader Steela Vess – alongside his friends and together, they began to train the insurgents in combat. When the Dissidents discovered their outpost and attacked, Kade and his fellow Aetheri assisted in battle, though cautious not to be in the thick of the battle. When the skirmish concluded, a strategy was devised to get into the capital city of Iziz . Once in there, Kade, Drayden and Vek decided to leave for Vantor to report to the Council, leaving Marr as a liaison to the insurgents. However, they decided to ensure that Marr did not reveal her Aetheri identity, though allowing her to accompany the insurgents on strike. After that, they kept in frequent communication with her. Kade attended the funeral service for Steela after the final battle after she had perished.

#### Younglings in peril

> " For now, be proud. You have survived an ordeal few your age could. Welcome home, young Aetheri. " ―Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Younglings in peril

> " For now, be proud. You have survived an ordeal few your age could. Welcome home, young Aetheri. " ―Orien Kade

While Kade was stationed aboard his flagship, the Iron Cruiser Negotiator , he was contacted by Aetheri initiates aboard the transport Crucible , who informed him that their guardian, Sela Marr, had been kidnapped by Hondik Hosha's pirates. The younglings said they wanted to rescue Marr from the pirates, but Kade told them to stay on the Crucible for their safety. Kade was intending to send Commander Cord to rescue the stranded Aetheri, but his plans were interrupted by an unforeseen attack by General Skarn on his fleet. Skarn's ships quickly gained the upper hand on Kade's, destroying several of his vessels. Upon learning that Skarn had sent a boarding party to board his ship, Kade and the replica forces on the ship stationed themselves in the hangar in order to repel it. Skarn himself accompanied the boarding party, and Kade began dueling with him as the replica troopers and battle droids engaged each other. Soon, however, Kade realized that this was a battle that he could not win, and as he retreated through the passageways of the Iron Cruiser he ordered the crew to abandon ship and initiated the ship's self-destruct sequence . When Skarn arrived on the bridge, he found a hologram recording of Kade. Through it, Kade conceded the victory to Skarn, but informed him that the ship was about to explode. Kade escaped the destruction on an escape pod, as did Skarn, who evacuated Kade's ship on a shuttle just before it exploded.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Soon after, Kade joined Marr, the younglings, who had gone to rescue Marr despite Kade's orders, and members of the pirate gang, including Hosha himself. After Skarn's defeat of Kade, he had attacked the pirates' stronghold, and the Aetheri and pirates had joined forces against Skarn and barely escaped with their lives.

#### D-Squad's mission

Kade was present when the Aetheri Council sent Colonel Meebur Gascon and a team of droids to infiltrate a Dissident dreadnought located deep within Dissident-controlled space, and recover an encryption module , which had been scrambling Dissident communications within the region.

#### Mission to Bray

> " Life on Bray has always been hard, but since the arrival of the dark lord, it has been a living nightmare. " ―A Brayan to Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Mission to Bray

> " Life on Bray has always been hard, but since the arrival of the dark lord, it has been a living nightmare. " ―A Brayan to Orien Kade

Kade, along with Gallia, Cord, and several troops went to Bray in response to a cry for help. Upon their arrival, the inhabitants told Kade about a Dark Lord that was plaguing their village was desecrating the Citadel of Light . Kade was skeptical of the natives' claims until the power went out and came under attack by several mynocks . Kade and Gallia decided to investigate the Citadel. They then discovered that the mynock had affected trooper Peel and transformed into a creature . Kade came under attack by Peel until Cord stunned him and locked him away.

title: Orien Kade
text:
### Nearing the end of the war

#### Fighting Oppress and Vreth

> " I lost someone important to me. And I understand anger in a way I never have. " ―Orien Kade speaks to Kael Drayden after Satinna Velara's death

When the two brothers attacked Cybloc Transfer Station in the Meridian sector , the space station sent out a distress signal , leading Kade and Gallia there to investigate about the two brothers, who were now operating under Vreth's singular vision . The Aetheri learned they were headed to Florrine. There, Kade contacted Hondik Hosha to inquire about the situation, who said that "two horned men" had appeared and threatened to attack his stronghold with pirates who had betrayed him. Kade told him he was unable to help him with his men, but that he could help stop the Umbra .

title: Orien Kade
text:
Following the confrontation, Kade returned to Vantor where he explained to Chancellor Mal about the situation regarding Vreth, but Mal dismissed the Vreth's threat, saying that the Aetheri needed to focus on the Dissident threat, despite Kade's fears of the criminal underworld being a place where Vreth could flourish.

#### Ferrum's fall and losing Satinna Velara

> " I know where you're from. I've been to your village. I know the decision to join the umbra side wasn't yours. The Nightsisters made it for you. " ―Orien Kade

Following Vreth's takeover of Ferrum, Kade was summoned to meet with Zho and Reth-Oss-Van in the communications room. The two showed him a transmission that had been sent by Satinna Velara from Ferrum. In the message, she stated that her government had been overthrown by rogue criminals , only for the transmission to be abruptly cut. Kade noticed the super commandos surrounding his friend, wanting to go to Ferrum to help her. However, he simply chose to tell the Masters that the Grave Watch was most likely responsible for any hostile takeover that took place.

title: Orien Kade
text: Zho and Mundi expressed reluctance to take part in the internal affairs of Ferrum without Senate approval, despite Kade's protests. Kade chose to go to Ferrum anyways, borrowing the Twilight vessel with Drayden's blessing and heading to Sundari. Though Drayden wished to come as well, Kade insisted that one Aetheri would be easier to hide than two. Kade brought the armor of Rako Hardeen, which he had saved from that previous mission, to use in the endeavor. The Master, who despised the way the Twilight flew, was happy to leave it behind once on the planet. Kade proceeded to trick a guard and took his armor . Disguised, he entered the prison complex using a stolen code cylinder, wandering through a maze of cells. When he freed Velara from her cell, she expressed her relief to see him, despite their grim circumstances. Kade admitted that the Senate nor the Council had approved their mission, which could prove to make their escape more difficult. The Aetheri acted as if Satinna was his prisoner, transferring her through a turbolift until being questioned about the prisoner transfer. Kade responded to the query by knocking the asking commando out, hurriedly ushering Satinna onto a speeder to make their escape.

title: Orien Kade
text: In the palace, Vreth, realizing Kade's feelings for Satinna, decided to execute her with Kade watching, hoping that he would feel the same pain Vreth did when he was forced to live in exile after being brutally injured by Kade on Ondara. Vreth again attempted to sway Kade to the umbra side, but the Aetheri Master refused, saying those who oppose it were more powerful than those use the umbra side could ever be. Kade instead talked about the Gloomreachian's own past, recognising that Vreth had his future stolen and was groomed to become the creature of anger and vengeance who stood before him. He hoped that by matching the Umbra's fury with understanding and sympathy he could reach Vreth and both save Satinna's life and turn the Gloomreachian away from the dark path he had been forced on. But Kade's fear for Satinna's life and anger towards Vreth made his words more venomous than the Aetheri intended.

title: Orien Kade
text: Angered by Kade's statements, the commandos forced Kade to his knees. Vreth let Satinna go briefly, but stabbed her with the Darksaber. She ultimately died in Kade's arms saying with her last breath, that she always loved him and always would. Vreth taunted Kade, but Kade replied that only the weak embraced the umbra side. Vreth, then, had his guards escort Kade to a cell where he could "drown in his misery" and "rot." Kade deeply grieved her death, feeling strong anger after it as he envisioned revenge. However, he decided not to act on his emotions and betray what he had worked to become as an Aetheri, and Vreth had him imprisoned again.

title: Orien Kade
text: Satinna's sister Bo-Katin and her renegade Nite Owls team, however, intercepted Kade as he was being transferred to the prison area. Katin freed Kade and gave him his flux blade back, informing the Master that she was there to rescue him. In return, she had him help her find Vreth and kill him. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to them, Vael Mal appeared and engaged Vreth and Opress in a duel, defeating the former and killing the latter. As the conflict escalated, Kade made his way to his ship and was told by Bo-Katin to warn the Republic of what had happened. Kade told her that it would lead to an invasion of Ferrum, but she said that Vreth's death would be worth it, and that they would survive. Kade, before leaving, asked Bo-Katin if Satinna was her sister, and apologized for her loss.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Returning to Vantor, Kade reunited with Drayden, who asked his former master what had happened. Though his words came as a struggle, Kade admitted he had lost "someone important" to him. He also revealed that he understood anger in a new way and that he now knew how difficult it was to not give into the emotion. Drayden held Kade's gaze for sometime before the two left for the Aetheri Council together, as Kade knew he had to report what had happened.

#### Temple bombing crisis

> " Surely we cannot do what Varrix suggests. We need to stand together with Sela. " ―Orien Kade

Following the bombing at the Aetheri Sanctum, Kade took part of the Aetheri Council meeting in which Zho and Koss requested that Drayden and Marr investigate the incident and find the culprit, telling to suspect even their fellow Aetheri. When Marr and Drayden told the Council of their progress―following a clue that led them to Jackar Bowmani , Kade was present again as a hologram. Kade also attended to the funeral for the victims of the bombing.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Later on, Kade was made aware of a Dissident attack on Saluk. To alert his fellow Aetheri in the Aetheri Sanctum's war room, and held a conference where he was suggested for their fleets to move to the Anoat system and move across to Saluk, when he was interrupted by Admiral Varrix, who told the Council that Marr was requested by Letta Turmond .

Following Marr's escape from authorities to prove her innocence, Kade along with the rest of the Aetheri High Council, and Drayden held a emergency meeting with Varrix declaring to them that Marr was now accused of sedition . With Drayden and Tor Vayne doubtful of her guilt, Grand Master Zho sent the two to find her, but Koss attempted to have Drayden left out of the matter, believing having him involved would only making things worse due to his emotional bond with Marr. However, Kade convinced the Council otherwise, stating Drayden knew Marr best and that it would be foolish to take him off the mission.

title: Orien Kade
text: After her capture , Kade listened to Varrix as he informed the Council that the Senate requested for Marr to be expelled from the Aetheri Order and turned over to the Republic military so she could receive more "impartial" judgement. Kade tried to convince his fellow Council members that they should side with Marr, but they all refused to do so, as they feared that protecting Marr would damage their ties with the Senate. Despite his reluctance to hand Marr over to the Republic, Kade took part in Marr's trial in the Chamber of Judgment , where the Council stripped the young Solinai of her rank and status as an Aetheri.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Like other members of the Council, Kade was present during Marr's military trial as presided over by Chancellor Mal and during Barris Ovva's confession, which confirmed Marr's innocence. Along with the Council, Kade agreed that Marr should rejoin the Order and was present when Koss and Zho proclaimed her to be a true Aetheri, worthy of becoming an Aetheri Knight, only for her to refuse readmission. When Drayden ran after Marr, Kade started to follow, but Tor Vayne placed a hand on his shoulder, silently advising him not to. Despite Drayden's attempts to convince her to reconsider, Marr parted with the Aetheri. Following the event, Drayden's regret at her departure soured his mood, which he reflected on to Ondar. Hesitant to lose more people close to him, Drayden was reluctant to leave on his next mission, but eventually went with Kade on an assignment that ended successfully.

#### Gelvarian conspiracy

> " The replica in question is now dead, and the Aetheri still suspect nothing. " ―Count Varek, to Vael Mal

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Korvex returns

> " Kael, I understand to a degree what is going on. You've met Satinna. You know I once harbored feelings for her. It's not that we're not allowed to have these feelings. It's natural. " " Senator Ondar and I are simply friends. " " And friends you must remain. As an Aetheri, it is essential you make the right choice, Kael, for the Order. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden Following Senator Ondar's mission to Scipio where she cooperated with Rush Korvex to expose the InterGalactic Banking Clan and Drayden's continuous demonstrations of animosity towards Korvex, Kade visited Drayden in his quarters to discuss his and Zho's concerns that his judgment regarding Korvex were "clouded" after the event on Cato Geltaria. Kade told Drayden that he could not let his feelings for Ondar get in the way of his judgement. He tried to resonate with his former adept by mentioning how he had similar feelings for Satinna as Kael did for Lira, but Kael was not receptive and Orien left after reiterating that he could not let his feelings get in the way of his decisions. Nevertheless, Drayden was right to distrust Korvex, as his actions not only endangered Senator Ondar's life once again, but also put the Banking Clan under the direct control of Chancellor Mal, thus giving Vael Mal more power in his quest to form a New Order .

#### Sifas Dyen' secret

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Sifas Dyen' secret

> " The creation of the replica army, kept secret from us Sifas Dyen did. How this was done we know not, yet now a new piece of the puzzle we have. Perhaps clarity it will bring us, yes. " ―Zho

After Aetheri Master Tor Vayne intercepted a distress call from a shuttle once thought to have been lost and discovered Sifas Dyen's flux blade, he took of the meeting in which Tor Vayne informed the Aetheri Council of his findings, and Kade reminded them that Sifas Dyen had spearheaded the creation of the Replica Army. Relaunching the investigation of the Aetheri Master's death, Kade and Drayden were sent to Feldora to find out what happened to Sifas Dyen, where they spoke to the tribal leaders. Kade was told that the Felucians had cremated his body and that another Aetheri had been with him when he was killed, and reported their findings to Master Zho.

title: Orien Kade
text: The two were then sent to Oba Diah when former Chancellor, Finis Valorum told Zho that Sifas Dyen had been sent to negotiate with the Gruv Syndicate to stop an underground war. Valorum, however, said that there was no other Aetheri sent alongside Syfo-Dyas, but rather his personal aide Silman . On Oba Diah, Kade and Drayden met VOX Gruv , who denied any involvement until Kade noticed that he was wearing the crest of Valorum and Drayden grabbed the necklace and told the Gruv to "stop playing games." VOX finally complied with the Aetheri, and told them that they had been paid by a man called Varek to shoot Sifas Dyen's shuttle down. However, as they feared that anyone who paid for the death of an Aetheri was dangerous, they kept Silman locked away for ten years as insurance.

title: Orien Kade
text:
However, once they met Silman, they realized he had gone mad after being locked up for so long, and were unable to learn much from him as Varek arrived to kill him before Kade and Drayden's eyes. After engaging Varek in combat, they learned that the man called Varek was, in fact, the Count. After he managed to escape, they informed the Council of their findings, only for them to question why Varek had been behind the creation of the replica army, and what the game of the yet-unidentified Dark Lord of the Umbra was.

#### Zho's journey

> " Yet, open to us, a path remains that unknown to the Umbra is. Through this path, victory we may yet find. Not victory in the Replica Wars but victory for all time. " ―Zho, to Drevan Koss and Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Zho's journey

> " Yet, open to us, a path remains that unknown to the Umbra is. Through this path, victory we may yet find. Not victory in the Replica Wars but victory for all time. " ―Zho, to Drevan Koss and Orien Kade

During a meeting with the High Council, Kade, like the rest of his peers, noticed Grand Master Zho's absent-mindedness following his communion with Kade's late master, Sorin Vael. Later, Koss conferred in private with Kade that he was worried about Zho's turmoil and asked him to keep an eye on the old Aetheri Master. Soon, however, Zho revealed to the Council in full that a voice spoke to him from beyond, prompting Kade and the entire Council to perform a joint meditation with him, but they heard nothing. Though Master Mundi surmised it could be a deception by the Umbra, but Kade dismissed the idea, believing Zho could not be susceptible to such manipulation, but Koss replied that, even as wise and old as he was, Zho was not beyond the corruption of the umbra side.

title: Orien Kade
text: Submitting himself for medical examination, Kade, Koss and Mundi were told by Rig Nema that Zho was in perfect mental health, even if he approached nine hundredth year of life. Though Mundi suggested the Dark Lord of the Umbra could be using Zho's connection to Varek, Kade vehemently rejected the idea, saying they all had been apprenticed to Zho at one point or another. Before the discussion could go on, Nema then suggested a deprivation ritual for Zho to reach Vael's voice. During the procedure, Kade, Drayden, Mundi and Tor Vayne watched over the small Aetheri, Zho managed to hear Vael's instruction to go to the Mirefall system before Kade noticed his vital signs were dropping too low and stopped the test. When asked about the procedure by Koss, Kade told him Zho was sure he had contacted the dead and, like most, he was in disbelief about the whole ordeal, only for Koss to place guards to keep an eye on Zho and the small Aetheri Master to escape with Drayden's help and Bolt-3's company, willing to go on a journey that would take him to Mirefall , a mysterious planet and Moraband .

title: Orien Kade
text:
On Zho's return to Vantor, Kade and Koss greeted him, and Koss asked him if he had gained some insight on how to win the war, but the old Aetheri Master told them that he no longer believed that the Aetheri could win the Replica Wars but that, through hope and perseverance, the Aetheri would ultimately triumph over the Umbra.

#### Crystal crisis on Uthara

> " How well would you sleep, knowing that I failed you? " " Not very well, I imagine. Luckily, that isn't true, and never will be. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade #### Crystal crisis on Uthara

> " How well would you sleep, knowing that I failed you? " " Not very well, I imagine. Luckily, that isn't true, and never will be. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

During the last months of the war, Kade and Drayden were sent to Uthara to investigate the mysterious death of Aetheri Master Tu-Anh . Once they landed on Pau City , they met Inspector Jen June who immediately led them to the morgue where the Aetheri's corpse was located. The two Aetheri examined her body, and later went to the location where she had been found, only to determine she had been hit in the optic nerve with a precision laser dart by a sniper. As they found the sniper's position, they found slime on the floor and interrogated the building's owner, Garri , from whom the two Aetheri learned of the involvement of MagnaGuards. Later, they asked Inspector June to analyze the slimy substance, with her concluding it was the secretion of an Amani 's skin and added that Governor Torul Blom wanted to see them.

title: Orien Kade
text: Though the Governor asked them to leave Uthara, Kade and Drayden persevered and rented two dactillions to go to the city's lower levels and talk to the leader of an Amani tribe there. Told that an Amani outcast had been seen entering a cave not far from there, Kade thanked him, and he and Drayden went to the cave, where they found the MagnaGuards, leading them to suspect of a Dissident conspiracy. Despite some coalition, they managed to get information from the droids that showed them the involvement of the Sulie and went to see Inspector June once again. After she identified the Amani as coming from the plain, Kade contacted the Council to inform them of their findings and later attended together with Drayden, attended the funeral of Tu-Anh .

title: Orien Kade
text: Soon after, they reached the Amani settlement they had been looking for, only for their dactillions to be killed and for the Amani to scatter in every direction during the ensuing confrontation, leaving Drayden and Kade to follow the tracks of one that appeared to be their leader. During the hunt, Drayden mentioned Marr for the first time since her departure, and Kade asked if he wanted to talk about it, yet Drayden refused. Kade then suggested for them to set up a camp and rest. However, he insisted on the subject, prompting Drayden to tell Kade he missed Marr and to voice his anger at the High Council for turning its back on her. In response, Kade asserted that it had been Marr's decision to leave, and that she had allowed her emotions to cloud her judgement, something against the Aetheri way. Then, Kade suggested him to rest, but Drayden declined so that he could keep the first watch. Finally, he questioned Kade on what would happen if he had turned out to be a "major disappointment," but Kade wanted to believe it would never happen.

title: Orien Kade
text: However, they both fell asleep and were captured by a group of Sugis led by Chong , who brought them before Endente as Kade told Chong of their "intention" to buy weapons. However, they learned Endente was, in fact, selling a kyber crystal and Drayden prompted him to show it before they made the deal. The two Aetheri were then brought to the starship where the crystal was being kept and escaped from their captors. Once Drayden took out all the Sulie and recovered their flux blades from Chong, they were unable to capture Endente and discovered the massive kyber crystal inside the ship. Despite being attacked, the two Aetheri managed to transport the crystal through Uthara's plains until they reached Pau City, where Governor Blom showed them his true colors and had the two Aetheri surrounded with his men and Skarn's droids. As the kyber crystal was loaded into a shuttle and sent to ship on orbit, Kade and Drayden took June and Blom as hostages, so that their underlings stopped shooting at them, and stole a freighter to recover the crystal.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Back on Vantor, Kade and Drayden reported to the Council about the outcome of their mission, when Zho told them of the use of kyber crystals on weapons of unimaginable power in ancient times.

#### The dark disciples

> " You were fighting her and chatting at the same time? " " It's... Banter. " " You flirted with her? " " Come now, Vossa, you can't tell me you managed to go undercover in all sorts of shady places without flirting yourself. " ―Daren Kelv and Orien Kade

Upon Mahranee 's fall and the destruction of General Chubor 's refugee -carrier Republic frigate by Varek's decision, Kade participated in council meeting along with Drayden, where it was decided to bring about the Count's assassination, for they had reached the conclusion that all that had transpired in the war had been because of Varek. Though Kade was against the idea, he nevertheless suggested Daren Kelv to be deployed for the mission.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Once Vossa returned to Vantor from his covert mission in Otor's Hub after ending Sheb Valaad 's black market operation, Kade greeted him at the Aetheri Sanctum and accompanied him to the Aetheri Council Chamber . There, Vossa was informed of his mission, and Vray's role in it; Vossa accepted. At the end of the session, Kade went to Vossa' encounter at the dining hall and gave him more details about Vray's character. Afterwards, Kade and Vossa would prearrange to meet at a bar in Level 1313 so that Vossa would keep him appraised of his progress at regular intervals. Vossa' absence in their third and fourth would-be encounters forced Kade to report to the Council.

At one such meeting, Vray was the one to appear at the bar, after her mission to rescue Vossa from Sireno after he had been captured following their failed attempt to kill Varek, she told Kade that they had lost Vossa to Varek and the umbra side; the two sat there, together, for a long time. Kade would later make mention of their encounter to his fellow Aetheri, among them Akar-Deshu .

#### On Vreth's tail

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### On Vreth's tail

> " I sense your turmoil, Orien. " " My last encounter with Vreth didn't go so well. " " He murdered the Duchess Satinna. Someone you cared for deeply. " " My emotions are under control, Master Tiplee. I will not fail you or this mission. " ―Orien Kade

Following the Battle of Ord Mantell , Kade was sent to Ord Mantell to investigate who the Dissident forces had been fighting, alongside Aetheri Masters Tiplee , Drevan Koss and Ciel Venn. Though the Shadow Collective had managed to collect most traces of their presence in the city , Wolffe and his men uncovered a Ferrik helmet outside the town, which led the four Aetheri on the trail of Vreth.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Aware of the Black Sun 's presence on the system, and the location of Vizsla Keep 09 , a Ferrik supply outpost suspected to be Vreth's hideout, Kade and Tiplee led an assault to lock the place down until reinforcements arrived. Tiplee expressed concern that Orien would allow his feelings for Satinna to cloud his judgement when facing Vreth, but he assured her that he would be under control and wouldn't fail the mission. As the two Aetheri tried to reach the command center, Vreth and Count Varek appeared to duel them, with Koss and Venn joining them soon afterwards. Despite their advantage over the Umbra, Tiplee was killed by Varek, and a Ferrik assisted Vreth by setting off an explosion that injured Koss and Venn. The Umbra, then, managed to escape as Vreth told Kade not to worry, as they would be seeing each other again soon; his alliance with Varek leaving the Aetheri perplexed as to what had just happened.

#### Vossa' rescue

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Vossa' rescue

> " Vray is at fault, yes, and of course Varek. But this, Masters...this one is our responsibility. We owe Vossa the chance to choose again, and, with our help, wisely. " ―Orien Kade, to the Council

Upon Akar-Deshu's meeting with Kessa Vray, Kade and Drayden met with them and Kade promised her that she would come to no harm within the Temple, and brought her to the Council chambers. Despite Koss's open disapproval, Zho allowed Kade and Drayden to go with Vray to rescue Vossa. Soon enough, Kade, Drayden, and Vray were on the cockpit of her ship, the Banshee , to infiltrate the Dissident dreadnought where Vossa, or rather "Admiral Enigma," was issuing orders from.

Stealthily, the three made their way to the bridge where Drayden dueled Varek, while Kade and Vray discovered Vossa was still being held captive by the Count. However, Vray saw through his ruse and tried to relieve Vossa from an existence consumed by hatred, but Kade convinced her to escape before taking such an extreme action. Barely escaping on the Banshee , they made their way back to Vantor, and Kade saw as the Council welcomed Vossa and pardoned Vray.

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Redemption of the fallen

> " You misunderstand, Master Koss. All of you. She didn't just save his life. She saved Quilav . And...I believe she may have saved us. " ―Orien Kade, on Kessa Vray

A month later, Kade was sent alongside Drayden, Vossa, and Akar-Deshu in a mission to take over a Dissident supply storage base and redistribute the supplies to worlds in need of them. However, their mission went awry when Vossa, unbeknownst to them, arranged the base's destruction. Later on, Kade and Vossa would be deployed to a listening post on Vanqor, but their second fruitless campaign in a row made Kade suspicious of a leak. He confided his feelings to Zho and Koss, leading them to suspect Vossa was the leak. Kade would later be summoned by Zho to tell him that he had sensed concealed darkness in Vossa' soul, and the Council arranged an emergency session, in which they entertained the option of executing Vossa. Kade, however, protested against the idea, and suggested sending Vossa again to assassinate Varek to test his allegiances.

title: Orien Kade
text: Afterwards, Vossa had Vray tell the Council of the Count and Skarn' presence on Krestophis, and the two set out on their mission aboard the Banshee . Kade and Drayden followed suit and spied on Vossa, who reunited with Varek; they observed as the two dueled, when Vossa gained the upper hand just as he let Varek live as long as he told him about his Master's whereabouts. It was then that Kade and Drayden intervened, taking the pair by surprised, and placed them under arrest. The two soon escaped from the Vigilance , causing the death of Akar-Deshu and the Chagrian Kav Bayons , and boarded the Banshee , but Drayden's quick thinking forced the renegades to crash land on the planet.

title: Orien Kade
text:
The two Aetheri pursued the three injured renegades to a Dissident tower , where they surrounded them. There, Kade and Drayden witnessed what appeared to be Vray' last moments before finding Vossa. They transported Vossa back to Vantor where the fallen Aetheri confessed all his crimes and Kade defended Vray. After being placed under Zho's supervision for some time, Vossa was released to Kade's care so he could take Vray' body back to Gloomreach, where she would be finally reunited with her sisters.

#### Attack on the Aetheri Sanctum

Kade was present when Aetheri Master Depa Billaba came out of a coma, having been in the state for six months. Pleased to see her feeling better, he welcomed her back to her duties. Kade participated in the Initiate Trials at the Temple, as well as in an evaluation of Billaba's mental state, meant to clear her for service. Though she was unsure of her past failures, Kade assured her that success is has never been a prerequisite for service before offering her his council seat. Nevertheless, Kade remained a member of the Council and worked alongside her.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Sometime after Billaba grew interested in making the youngling Caleb Dume her apprentice, Kade gave a lecture in the Aetheri Sanctum central security station for younglings to learn about the Aetheri recall signal, when Dume asked whether the same system could be used to warn Aetheri away. Kade was intrigued by the possibility, and the idea would later prove essential. Kade was later present at the temple when it was attacked by Dissident general Rackham Sear . However, the attack was foiled by Depa Billaba just as he and Koss arrived on the scene.

#### Struggle for Anaxes

> " I hope you at least told Lira I said hello. " ―Orien Kade, to Kael Drayden

title: Orien Kade
text:
While Vek was eager to go, believing ARC trooper Echo was still alive, Drayden reminded his Captain that they had a "thing" to do: Drayden was to contact his secret wife, Senator Ondar. Drayden spoke to her via hologram inside the barracks with Vek keeping watch outside, but Kade approached Vek to ask where Drayden was. Vek attempted to cover for his friend, but Drayden soon exited, and the two began to depart for the Marauder . However, Kade called after Drayden and revealed he knew his former Adept had been speaking with Ondar. After their success, Kade took part on Koss's debriefing on the strategy to take the Dissident assembly complex by air, when Echo posed his plan to be escorted by the Bad Batch into Trench's new comm vault on a dreadnought on the planet's orbit and plug himself to feed the Dissident's strategic movements. Kade took part on the assault and the combined efforts managed to take the complex under their control and, with all other fronts falling to the Republic, Trench initiated a countdown for an explosion that could destroy most of Anaxes. While Koss deactivated the bomb, Kade assisted in the evacuation efforts; with Trench's death at the hands of Drayden and his fleet's destruction, the battle was won. Thanking Captain Vek, Corporal Echo, and the Bad Batch, Kade told the replicas they would receive medals for their actions, but the Bad Batch intended to leave before the ceremony. Additionally, Echo decided to leave with the batch.

#### Battle of Yerbana

> " Yes, Cord. You can join in on the fun as well. " ―Orien Kade, to Commander Cord

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade then gave permission to Cord to lead the 212th Attack Battalion in helping the 501st. Kade approached Drayden complimenting him for his help, to which Drayden thanked him for pretending to be defeated. Kade said he was always glad to help. Then, the two were contacted by Admiral Wulric Yular who informed them of a transmission going under the code "Fulcrum." Drayden guessed it might be Torrik Vess, which worried Kade about the current state of the siege at Underra . Yular denied it was Vess and requested the Generals to attend the call.

#### Locating Vreth

> " I killed Vreth once. Best to capture him. He doesn't seem to stay dead. " ―Orien Kade, to Sela Marr

At Yular's ship, Kade and Drayden entered the room only to witness Sela Marr and Bo-Katin Velara as the ones that had made the call. Kade asked Marr what was the information she had. Marr informed them that that Vreth had been located on Ferrum and they had an opportunity to capture him.

title: Orien Kade
text:
While going to greet Marr and her allies, Drayden, who was still emotionally shocked to see his former apprentice again, claimed that it all made sense, in an attempt to understand Marr's decision to leave the Aetheri Order. Drayden told Kade that if Marr had not left the Order, then Vreth would have never been located. As always, Kade was more reserved about the situation and decided to wait and see how the events were to develop, remaining cautiously optimistic. After a quick greeting, Marr, Velara, and her Ferriks were led by Kade to a private room to discuss Vreth's whereabouts. However, Kade was not willing to help Marr and her allies unless the Aetheri Council gave their permission, saying the Republic could not get involved with Ferrik affairs. Velara explained that there was not time to turn that into a bureaucratic decision, as Vreth could escape before they made an offensive. Velara reminded Kade that the former Umbra Lord killed Satinna and confronted Kade about how could he not want to capture Vreth as Satinna was supposedly important to him. Kade reassured Bo-Katin that he still cared deeply about Satinna, but he could not allow his feelings to cloud his judgment. Kade proceeded to consult the Aetheri Council.

#### Rescue of the Chancellor

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Rescue of the Chancellor

> " So that's it? You're going to abandon Bo-Katin and her people? " " Sela, surely you understand this is pivotal moment in the Replica Wars? The heart of the Republic is under attack! " " I understand that as usual you're playing politics. This is why the people have lost faith in the Aetheri! I had too, until I was reminded of what the Order means to people who truly needed us. " " Right now, people on Vantor need us. " " No. The Chancellor needs you. " " That's not fair. " " I'm not trying to be. " ―Orien Kade and Sela Marr's argument, prior to the Battle of Vantor

title: Orien Kade
text: When Kade contacted the Council, he was informed that General Skarn had attacked the capital of the Republic, and that they lost contact with Shaak Ti, Chancellor Mal's assigned protector. He immediately informed Marr and Drayden of this, at the same time ordering their fleet to travel to Vantor, reassuring Kael who asked after Mal, that they could reach the planet within the hour. This angered Marr, who accused her former masters of choosing to abandon Ferrum. Somewhat shocked by the accusation, Kade urged Marr to understand that they were entering a pivotal moment in the Replica Wars, as the heart of the Republic was under attack. Marr countered that Kade was playing politics, stating that it was proof as to how the Aetheri Order had lost their way by forgetting that their duty was to help people and not politicians.

title: Orien Kade
text: Upon hearing Marr explain why so many had lost faith in the Aetheri, Kade countered that the people of Vantor needed them, but Marr believed that it was really about saving the Chancellor. Kade told Marr to be fair, but Marr retorted that she wasn't trying to play fair. Drayden heard the argument and weighed in. So as to help Marr in the upcoming siege without compromising Ferrum's neutrality and the mission to rescue the Chancellor, Drayden promoted Vek to Commander so he could lead the mission and had Marr assisting him as an advisor. When Kade agreed, Marr accepted the proposal. Instead of allowing his meeting with Marr to end on a sour note, Kade advised Marr to capture Vreth, joking the former Umbra did not seem to stay dead, before leaving the room to prepare the troops, leaving Drayden and Marr behind.

title: Orien Kade
text:
After Drayden and Marr wished each other good luck on their respective missions, Kade and Drayden traveled to Vantor to rescue the Chancellor. The two Aetheri fought their way through a Dissident blockade and managed to board the Invisible Hand , only to find the Chancellor being held prisoner at the top of the ship's observation spire. Not long after they arrived to the room, Count Varek appeared before them and the two Aetheri engaged him in a duel. Though Varek managed to gain the upper hand and knocked Kade out cold, Drayden was able to defeat the Umbra Lord, and subsequently executed him at Mal's urging. He then rescued Kade, carrying him until he woke up when they were hanging in an elevator. As they got out of there and ran through hallway 328, Skarn had them trapped in a ray shield and brought to the Invisible Hand ' s control room. The cyborg General personally taunted them, giving Bolt-3 enough time to free them and for Kade and Drayden to confront Skarn. The General, however, escaped in an escape pod and forced the two Aetheri to pilot the ship and land on Vantor as safely as they could. Following the ordeal, they escorted the Chancellor to the Senate building, where they separated, with Kade going back to Aetheri Sanctum to report to the Council of Varek's demise and what it meant to the Replica Wars.

#### Dividing friendship

> " All of this is unusual, and it's making me feel uneasy. " ―Orien Kade, on Kael's appointment with Mal

title: Orien Kade
text:

> " All of this is unusual, and it's making me feel uneasy. " ―Orien Kade, on Kael's appointment with Mal

Later, Kade attended another meeting, concerning the reports on the Outer Reach Sieges, including Saluk's fall and the move of Daren Kelv' troops to Boz Pity . At the end of the session, he met with Drayden and told him to be careful with Mal, and that Mal had requested his presence for unknown reasons. Soon enough, Kade and the Council were made aware that the Chancellor had Drayden appointed as his Personal Representative on the Aetheri Council; though the Council approved of the appointment, they denied Drayden the rank of Aetheri Master, a decision which greatly angered Drayden, prompting him to question the Council's decision-making. Kade remained silent. After being admonished by Koss, Drayden reluctantly accepted his position and took his seat on the Council. During the same meeting, Kade and Master Mundi discussed the importance of Thornwood, prompting Master Zho to assist the Voraks himself.

title: Orien Kade
text: At the end of the meeting, Kade acknowledged to Drayden that his appointment had been accepted so that, on behalf of the Council, Drayden could spy on the Chancellor, an assignment that Kael refused to partake in because he believed it to be an act of treason. He tried to convince Kael that something out of place had to be happening for Mal to remain in office long after his two legitimate terms had expired and to have accumulated an unnatural amount of executive powers, but still, Kael would have none of it. Later, before Zho's departure to Thornwood, Kade conferred with Koss and Zho of Drayden's reluctant compliance on his task, when he heard of Koss's distrust of the Aetheri Knight and Zho's doubts about the prophecy of the "Seeded One."

title: Orien Kade
text: Following the Chancellor's disclosure of General Skarn' location on Uthara to Drayden, who then passed it onto the Council, Kade was sent to capture the fugitive General. Immediately prior to his voyage to Uthara, Kade contacted Marr and the Ferriks on Ferrum via hologram. With an R4 astromech droid projecting a holomap , Velara told him that the replicas had been extremely effective against Vreth's forces. While communing, Marr mentioned that Vreth had said the name Vael Mal while they confronted one another and Velara asked who he was. Kade admitted that the Aetheri did not know much about him, but told them that he orchestrated the Replica Wars and manipulated both sides of the conflict. He soon informed them about the death of Count Varek during the Battle of Vantor after Marr asked why they would no longer be able to get anymore information from him about Mal. With this, he asked them once again to capture Vreth so that they may finally be able to put an end to the mystery of Mal. After Vek and Velara left, he informed Marr of Drayden's mission to spy on Supreme Chancellor Mal by the Aetheri High Council. After Marr began to ask why they would give him such an assignment, Kade informed her that the Council wished to learn what Mal was truly plotting after remaining in the office of Supreme Chancellor long after his term's conclusion. Marr began to argue with Kade and said that she couldn't imagine Drayden could be happy with the burden the Council had placed upon him. Kade knew this and informed Marr as much, asking her to speak with him after their meeting ended to help him with his burden. Marr began to grow increasingly agitated with the Council after Kade asked this, but Kade revealed that he knew the Council wasn't correct in every one of their decisions and that if Marr communicated with Drayden, it could help them. Before Marr could respond, Vek rushed in and informed the two that there had been an attack and with that, Kade allowed her to leave. them. Before Marr could respond, Vek rushed in and informed the two that there had been an attack and with that, Kade allowed her to leave. With the destruction of R4-P17 and his Aetheri interceptor during the Battle of Vantor, Kade was assigned astromech droid R4-G9 , whom he had previously worked with during the search for Kessa Vray , and a blue Eta-2 Actis -class light interceptor before his search for Skarn. Before Kade's departure to engage Skarn, Drayden apologized to Kade, who told him that he needed patience and that he would soon become a master. The two exchanged goodbyes in what would be their last meeting as friends and allies, a fact neither was aware of, before Kade departed for Uthara.

#### Final clash with Skarn

> " Hello there! " " General Kade! You are a bold one. " ―Orien Kade and General Skarn

title: Orien Kade
text: Orien visits the holding areas where Utapaun wranglers captured native winged and wingless lizards for transportation. He then addressed the Utai varactyl tamers in search of a quick path there that wouldn't interfere with city life. Mounted on the varactyl Boga , Kade made his way to the Dissident holdout and waited for the Dissident Council to depart. He then leaped down from the scaffolding where he had been hidden, just as he had done years before on Pyralis and greeted General Skarn before being surrounded by various types of battle droids. Skarn ordered his MagnaGuards to dispatch Kade, who managed to crush them under a piece of the ceiling without engaging in combat.

title: Orien Kade
text: Orien was able to neutralize Skarn' customary more wide-ranging fighting technique by limiting his movement to the catwalk. Kade maintained the fight close to the cyborg, having grown accustomed to his maneuvers after so many encounters. He kept his cool and aimed wisely for Skarn' vulnerable wrist instead intercepting his blade, severing his hand. It didn't take long for a clawed mechanical hand clattered down onto the deck, along with the flux blade he held. Skarn, furious, launched a wild attack, but he had lost focus. A few seconds later, Kade took another hand and weapon away from him and hands and keep up a solid defense against his unrelenting attacks. The droids watched as their leader continued to lose ground, but before they could help Skarn fight back, a pause occurred. Not long into the duel, the 212th Attack Battalion arrived and engaged Skarn's forces. As the battle intensified, Kade threw Skarn against a wall, knocking his remaining blades out of his hands and forcing him to escape in his wheelbike . Orien had just made the jump to the lower level when Skarn fired it up and tore back into the hanger in an attempt to crush him.

title: Orien Kade
text: Orien and Boga finally caught up with Skarn, he intended to reach his personal starfighter, the Soulless One , stationed at a landing platform distance from the main Dissident base he was aiming for as a backup plan. The tunnels become increasingly packed as they travel deeper into the city. Orien smiles as the General was forced to slow down to avoid a swarm of droids, his mount capable of achieving things that the General's speeder-wheel cannot. He directs it to the tunnel's ceiling, where he will no longer be disturbed by traffic congestion. The Aetheri quickly gains ground on Skarn, while the tunnel in front of him leads to a small landing perform. He accelerates once more, catching up to the general. Orien had just pressed the general when the Dissident leader, able to control his bike and battle, used the electrostaff that he stored on the wheelbike and began attacking him, eventually being pulled onto the vehicle itself along with him. They eventually arrived at a landing platform, Orien snatched the electrostaff and was clutching it as Skarn raised the volt pistol , the Grievance Striker . He knocks the weapon out of Skarn's hand and lands a

He knocks the weapon out of Skarn's hand and lands a few solid blows on the General himself, his first to the chest, the second to the arm, the metal bends, but does not break. Orien knocked Skarn to the ground and plunged the shaft into his abdomen, but the cyborg kicked him away with such speed that the Aetheri cannot.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade informed the replicas that the general was dead but didn't have time to elaborate; victory looked inevitable. The battle of Uthara was one of the Replica Wars' last battles, and with Skarn' death, the conflict that had claimed countless lives seemed to be coming to a conclusion, but the Aetheri did not suspect it was also the beginning of the end.

#### Directive 66

> " My replica troops turned on me. I need help. " ―Orien Kade to Bael Solen Following Koss's and other Council member's duel against Chancellor Mal, revealed to be Vael Mal, and the issue of Directive 66, Kade met up with Commander Cord and ordered him to contact the troops to move to the higher levels of the city. The replica then returned him his flux blade, and Kade proceeded to climb with Boga, just as Cord received a direct message from Mal, ordering him to execute the order. Before Kade went too far, Cord ordered his men to shoot at the Aetheri Master, bringing his fall to the water below. Orien had no time or inclination to comprehend why his own men had turned against him. Hearing Boga's heartfelt tears, he felt a moment of sadness that he couldn't help her. Commander Cord, who was torn, saw Orien Kade as a threat to his operation. He knew from previous experience not to presume an Aetheri was dead until he saw the body. Time and again, Orien, Kael, and Sela, not to mention the other Aetheri he'd seen in action, had beaten seemingly impossible odds to come through. However, unlike many others, he survived and swam towards a cave, fumbling his breather into place, then surfacing,

As the creature dealt with the droids, Orien slipped through. His worst fears confirmed, Orien headed for his escape route and cautiously returned to the location where he had recently battled. He was relieved to find the small, flat-landing form deserted and fled Uthara aboard Skarn's personal starfighter, the Soulless One , running past the smoking remains of his former cyborg rival one final time without even sparing Skarn a fleeting glance. Orien as quickly as he could into space, trusting in the element of surprise to whip past his old flagship and away.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Taking Skarn' starfighter, he left Uthara and made contact with Senator Bael Solen, who had seen the siege of the Aetheri Sanctum firsthand and was trying to locate other surviving Aetheri. Reuniting on the Tantiva III , Kade met with the Senator and Master Zho, who told him of the retreat message telling all Aetheri to return to the Temple, saying that the war was over. Kade then suggested to dismantle the signal, so that others wouldn't fall into the trap, and Zho agreed.

On their way to Vantor, Solen was contacted by Vice Chancellor Veldon, who told him of an emergency session to be held by the Senate. Kade and Zho entered the Aetheri Sanctum and witnessed with their own eyes the massacre that just taken place. During that, Chancellor Mal told the Senate of the Aetheri's "sedition" against the Republic and declared the birth of the Imperium . Ondar's former handmaiden Sable believed Kade died with the rest of the Aetheri during the rise of the Imperium.

### Age of the Imperium

title: Orien Kade
text: Desperate for answers and despite Zho's warning that he would only find pain, Kade checked the security recordings to find that Drayden had led his battalion of replicas to attack the Temple, where he fought the Aetheri & their Younglings and knelt to the newly-proclaimed Emperor , who was proud of his apprentice , now going by a new name—"Velgor." Though Kade was horrified, Zho determined that they had to destroy the Umbra; Kade, however, refused to fight Velgor and requested that he be sent to kill the Emperor instead, but Zho vetoed the idea, claiming that Kade wasn't strong enough to go head-to-head with Mal on his own. Kade expressed that Drayden was like a brother to him and that he did not have the heart to kill him, but Zho explained that the boy he had trained no longer existed and that he needed to be put out of his misery, and told Kade to use his instincts to find Velgor.

title: Orien Kade
text: Unbeknownst to Ondar, Kade stowed away in her star skiff, just as she and Astra-9 departed for the Emberfall system to meet with Velgor, who had already killed the Dissident leaders taking refuge there. Hiding in one of the compartments, Kade emerged from the ship, only for Velgor to think she had betrayed him and brought Kade to kill him, choking her in a paranoid rage. As Kade checked her vital signs, Velgor accused him of turning her against him, but the Aetheri Master stated Kael betrayed her for himself and that his anger & lust for power had already done that, and that he had allowed Mal to twist his mind becoming an Umbra.

title: Orien Kade
text: Unaffected by the Aetheri's "lies" and unafraid of the umbra side, Velgor claimed that he'd brought peace, freedom, justice, and security to "[his] new Imperium," and told Kade, who declared his allegiance was to the Republic and the democracy it represented, that if he was not on his side, then, he was his enemy. Realizing that his former apprentice was already too far gone to be reasoned with, Kade vowed to stop him at all costs, prompting the two to engage in a ferocious duel that caused substantial damage to the facility, just as Zho and Mal dueled in the Senate. Ultimately, Kade and Velgor were hovering over the lava sea, when the Aetheri Master reflected on his failure while Velgor stated that he should have known about the Aetheri's lust for power and domination. Kade tried again in vain to convince Velgor to return to the light again and that Mal was, in fact, an evil mastermind, but Velgor continued to denounced the Aetheri as the true evil.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Velgor's garments then burst into flames from the lava, along with his sliced flesh, severely burning him. Unwilling to help his former friend or murder him in cold blood, Kade left him to his apparent fate and returned to Ondar's ship, where Astra-9 had already brought her back on board. When she asked if Drayden was all right, Kade couldn't respond to that and let her rest as they left the planet. Kade was left with the belief that his former apprentice had died, while thinking of how he's partly to blame for Kael and Padme's relationship ending, unaware of how the Emperor had arrived and saved his life by giving the new Umbra Lord a suit of life-support armor .

#### Birth of the Drayden twins

> GH-7 : " Medically, she is completely healthy. For reasons we can't explain, we are losing her. " Kade : " She's dying? " GH-7 : " We don't know why. She has lost the will to live. We need to operate quickly if we are to save the babies. " Solen : " Babies? " GH-7 : " She's carrying twins. " ―GH-7 medical droid, Orien Kade and Bael Solen

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Hiding on Dunemere

The beginning

> " And what of the boy? " " To Dunemere. To his family, send him. " " I will take the child and watch over him. " ―Orien Kade and Zho discuss the future of Joren Drayden

Kade carried the newborn Joren onboard the late general's starfighter to Nar Shaddaa , where he sold ship for transportation to Dunemere. Upon arriving on Dunemere, Kade purchased an eopie he named Akkani . While the twin suns set, Kade arrived at the Havel moisture farm to leave Joren with his uncle, Owen, and aunt, Brue. When he delivered Joren to them, Kade stood at the door, explaining what had happened and asking for their help. Like Kade, Owen believed his stepbrother had been killed and blamed the Aetheri Master for his fate. Owen agreed to the task of raising Joren, though he told Kade to play no role in his upbringing. Fearing the boy would end up following his father's footsteps, Owen did not want the Aetheri Master to see or train Joren, so he told Kade to stay away and not speak to him, hoping that Joren would learn nothing of his father.

title: Orien Kade
text: After leaving them with Joren, Kade left on an Akkani, heading to his exile. He found a home surrounded by Western Dune Sea . Kade had known immediately after finding this building, which was actually a long since abandoned prospector's hut, that it would serve him well. Nonetheless, he instead set up living quarters in a cave , where he had little outside of a few necessities and keepsakes. To conceal his identity, he would once again use the alias of "Beno Kade," as he had done with Satinna Velara and during the Replica Wars. He also forfeited the use of his flux blade for years. He spent little time in the cities and kept to himself, spending most of his time watching over the young Drayden, who he hoped to eventually train. However, to avoid becoming too recognizable, Kade worked temporary jobs, including that of a farmhand, a barback, a custodian, a mechanic , and a laborer.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Despite having taken the Barash Vow , he struggled to repress his sense of duty as an Aetheri and spent years battling monotony and inactivity. He was haunted by the horrific events of the Replica Wars, with no amount of soothing able to stop his recurring nightmares. Over the course of his exile, he learned much about the noises and sights of Dunemere's wilds, including how to mimic the call of a krayt dragon . While Kade stayed on Dunemere to watch over Joren, the adopted parents of his twin, Elira, told her numerous stories of the Aetheri Master during her youth. Over time, Elira came to cherish the memories of Bael Solen's Replica Wars adventures with Kade, regarding them as exciting and heroic, but she would not learn his name until she was ten. Desperate to remain hidden, Kade buried his flux blade, alongside Kael's blade, in a box in the desert. He also had Sorin Vael's flux blade on-world.

Sins of Drayden

> " Don't destroy yourself to punish the Order for our failures! You're worth so much more than this! " ―What Orien Kade wished he had told Kael Drayden

title: Orien Kade
text:
Protecting Joren Drayden

> " We don't need your protection. We don't need you at all. I could have handled this alone. " ―Owen Havel, to Orien Kade

On one particular morning, Kade was awoken by sensing a young 3-year-old Joren Drayden and his family in danger. He arrived to find a group of bandits attacked the Havel homestead, and he quickly started defending them. After successfully defeating the last of the bandits, he was punched to the ground by Owen for his interference and his influence on Joren getting involved. Out of fear that the boy could become like his father, Owen shouted for Kade to never come back.

Kade came to consider that morning the moment he had failed the young Drayden. Both he and Owen had seen the defiance and bravery in the boy's eyes, yet Kade listened to Owen, staying away instead of training Joren.
