When Bobbajo walked past Krynodd, the Gabdorin hit him and said that he needed to show some respect. Nyla helped the old man capture his creatures who were running away. As thanks she received a few corn-clusters. Realizing that Krynodd would be even worse than Gruven, she decided that she had to rescue him. She returned to her home and took a look at the head of the J9 droid which she had kept so that she could clean it and sell it later for more portions. She then headed out into the night to find Gruven. When out, she heard ripper-raptors in the Kelvin Ravine and decided to go there to see if that was the location of Gruven.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Nyla found Gruven strapped to the ground, surrounded by Zendiat's gang. She then used one of the comlinks she had brought with her to make the sound of a Bloggin . Nyla attacked and managed to beat all except Zendiat. She then attempted to remove the restraints holding Gruven. Instead she got an electric shock. Surrounded by Zendiat's gang, Nyla pulled out the head of the J9 droid, which had been the very droid that had gotten Gruven captured in the first place. Nyla proposed that they let her and Gruven go and she would give them the head. Zendiat then asked why he shouldn't just kill them and take the droid, but Nyla then threw the droid's head up in the sky to show him why. In the meantime, she freed Gruven, but he pushed her away and grabbed the droid's head. Gruven then took Nyla's corn-clusters and threw them on Zendiat's gang so that the ripper-raptors would attack them. As Nyla and Gruven escaped, the scavenger threw the head of the droid back to Zendiat's gang.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: One of the vessels that Nyla scavenged from was the Inflictor , an Imperial -class Iron Cruiser that crashed after its commanding officer, Captain Ciena Ree , scuttled the ship to prevent it from falling into the hands of the Concordat. Nyla climbed throughout the massive vessel and brought parts back to Nimara Outpost, where she cleaned them up and brought them to Gruven. The materials she brought him on this particular day earned her one quarter portion of food, which she brought back to her home. After eating, she heard the noises of an astromech droid and rushed to find that the source of the noise, Orio-6 , had been captured by a Teedo scavenger, also named Teedo . Nyla rescued the tiny droid and learned that it was on a classified mission —it managed to escape the clutches of the New Imperium during an attack on the spiritual village of Tuanul , an attack that Nyla had heard rumors of. Nyla repaired Orio-6's antenna, and pointed the droids towards Nimara Outpost. After some convincing by Orio-6, Nyla allowed the droid to return home with her for one night, before it went on its way the next morning. On

title: Nyla Drayden
text: village of Tuanul , an attack that Nyla had heard rumors of. Nyla repaired Orio-6's antenna, and pointed the droids towards Nimara Outpost. After some convincing by Orio-6, Nyla allowed the droid to return home with her for one night, before it went on its way the next morning. On their way to Nyla's home that evening, Nyla and Orio-6 were attacked by a nightwatcher worm , which was hungry and wanted to eat Orio-6. Nyla saved Orio-6 from the worm, made it safely to Nyla's, and fed the worm a hunk of scrap. She then took Orio-6 to her home in the Hellhound Two , where she mentioned that Teedo might be looking for Orio-6.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
With no other option, Nyla led the two towards an old freighter , which she described as "garbage," that had not flown for years. None other than the Corsair Wing , the ship had fallen into Unkar Gruven's ownership after being stolen from a number of other owners. Nyla took the pilot's seat while Jax manned one of the quad laser cannons . Despite a shaky start, Nyla piloted the ship out of the outpost and, on Jax's suggestion, remained at a low altitude in order to confuse the scanners on the SKREE fighters. She led the fighters on a chase into the Starship Graveyard, where she was able to use the downed war vessels to her advantage. One SKREE fighter crashed after Jax scored a direct hit, while the other followed Nyla into the bowels of a Super Iron Cruiser . The Corsair suffered damage and the turret was locked into one position, so, after flying out of the Super Iron Cruiser, Nyla moved the freighter into position where Jax could fire a direct shot. With the last SKREE fighter destroyed, Nyla flew the ship off of Ashden and into open space.

#### Enlisting Dax Karrick's help

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Suddenly, the ship began to lose power and the two realized that they were caught in a grapple beam . The Corsair was pulled into the cargo bay of a large freighter called the Eravana , which Jax mistook as a New Imperium ship. The trio hid in a compartment beneath the floor and Nyla planned to release the poisonous gas into the ship to kill what she assumed would be shock troopers, but in reality it was two smugglers, and the original owners of the Corsair : the famed Dax Karrick and his First Mate , Brevok . Karrick found the three fugitives in the compartment and Nyla revealed they were the only ones aboard, and that she was the pilot. Karrick asked where they got the ship, and Nyla told him that it belonged to Unkar Gruven, who stole it from the Irving Boys , who stole it from Gannis Ducain —who, as Karrick revealed, stole it from him. It was then that he revealed himself as Dax Karrick. Nyla and Jax realized that meant the ship was the Corsair Wing , the ship that Nyla believed had made the Cindral Run in fourteen parsecs , to which

title: Nyla Drayden
text: from Gannis Ducain —who, as Karrick revealed, stole it from him. It was then that he revealed himself as Dax Karrick. Nyla and Jax realized that meant the ship was the Corsair Wing , the ship that Nyla believed had made the Cindral Run in fourteen parsecs , to which Karrick corrected her saying it was only twelve. The two correctly deduced that Karrick was indeed the famous smuggler who became a General for the Free Coalition during the Galactic Civil War. Karrick inspected the ship and talked to Nyla about the modifications that Gruven had made on it, including a compressor on the ignition line, which they both knew put too much stress on the hyperrelay . Nyla also told him about their mission to bring Orio-6 to the Coalition, a mission that caught Karrick's attention once he realized that the droid carried a map to his old friend and brother-in-law Joren Drayden.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: The Eravana was soon boarded by the both Guavian Death Gang and Kanjiklub , two criminal organizations that Karrick had swindled into loaning him money so he could smuggle rathtars to King Prana . Nyla and Jax hid in the corridors beneath the floors as Karrick unsuccessfully tried to talk his way out of the situation, and his predicament gave Nyla the idea to shut all of the doors between the Korrathi smuggler and the two gangs. She accessed the wrong door controls, however, and accidentally unleashed the monstrous rathtars, which ran loose across the ship. As Nyla and Jax ran from the beasts, one of them grabbed Jax and carried him away. Nyla found a control panel that allowed her to close a door onto the tentacles of the monster, severing the limbs and allowing Jax to escape. They reunited with Karrick at the Corsair Wing and escaped onto the ship. With Brevok injured in the fight against the gangs, Nyla took the co-pilot's chair as Karrick prepared the ship for launch. Though Nyla questioned him on his ensuing plan, Karrick jumped the ship into hyperspace from inside the Eravana , and they successfully escaped. Bala-Tik of the Guavian

title: Nyla Drayden
text: since the device would go undetected there, so they all looked in the room where the generator was. Brev was able to find the tracker beeping behind a panel. Jax immediately grabbed it, much to Nyla and Brev's dismay as the device was rigged to explode. Nyla told Brev to go and throw the explosive out of the airlock . When Nyla told Jax that the bomb would go off in 20 seconds , he ran to inform Dax while Nyla went to see what Brev was doing. Brev threw the bomb out the airlock and Dax jumped into hyperspace shortly thereafter. After they all got back into the cockpit, Karrick thanked Nyla, and she remarked that they made a good team. Dax chuckled at the idea and they continued onto Takodana. As the ship approached Maz's castle, Nyla was taken aback by the lush green world that reminded her of the planets she saw in her dreams as a child, having never known that there was so much green in the entire galaxy. When they landed, the group exited the ship, where Nyla looked out at the stunning vista that stood before her. [ source? ]

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Karrick handed her an NN-14 volt pistol pistol , knowing she would be able to defend herself with it, and asked her what her name was. With the two formally introduced, Karrick said he was considering bringing on a new crew member. Impressed with Nyla's piloting and repair abilities, he said he would consider offering her a job as a second mate aboard the Corsair . Nyla was flattered by the offer and briefly excited by the prospect, but she turned it down because she had to return to Ashden to wait for her family, claiming that she'd already been away for too long already.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Her intention, ultimately, was to commandeer a ship and escape from Voidfang Base, so she made her way towards a hangar where she found SKREE fighters that she could steal. She was approached by several shock troopers before she could get to the fighters, so she climbed down a chasm in the hangar to hide. Careful not to fall to her death, Nyla opened a service hatch, climbed inside, and closed it behind her so she could make her way back through the base. While climbing along the walls of the base, her path came to cross with the members of the Coalition's J-Squadron who were also climbing upon the same walls. She quickly nodded to one of the members but ignored further calls from them as she quickly climbed down away from the group.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Deeper into the base, Nyla found Karrick, Brevok, and Jax (who did not flee to the Outer Reach after all). They had arrived on Voidfang Base in order to rescue her and disable the base's shields so Coalition starfighters could destroy it. Nyla embraced Jax when Brevok said the rescue was his idea, and she thanked him for coming back for her. With the shields already disabled as a result of Jax and Karrick's actions, the group left the base to return to the Corsair Wing , but they saw that the Coalition fighters were being cut to shreds and had been unable to destroy the thermal oscillator , which stored the energy that the weapon drained from stars . The group decided to stay behind to help destroy the oscillator.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: They split up, Nyla and Jax were going to access a terminal to let Karrick and Brev enter the oscillator, while Dax and Brev would fight of troops to get there and plant bombs to destroy the oscillator. Nyla and Jax stole a New Imperium snowspeeder to get to the terminal, but they were pursued by another snowspeeder with a snowtrooper firing upon them. Nyla initially fired upon them, but then Jax suggested they switch places, so then Nyla drove and Jax was able to get a direct shot, eliminating the snowtrooper and allowing the snowspeeder to spin out of control. Nyla and Jax switched places, with Nyla asking if he was sure he didn't want her to fly. Jax reassured her that as long as no one was following them, they be fine. Suddenly three more snowspeeders drove up behind them, Nyla fired on them once again, but was unable to get a clear shot in. Seeing a forest, Nyla directed Jax to drive towards the trees. Jax drove through the forest dodging volt pistol fire, but they were still unable to shake their pursuers. Nyla asked him to switch places with her, to which he obliged. With Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text: unable to get a clear shot in. Seeing a forest, Nyla directed Jax to drive towards the trees. Jax drove through the forest dodging volt pistol fire, but they were still unable to shake their pursuers. Nyla asked him to switch places with her, to which he obliged. With Nyla as pilot, she was able to dodge incoming obstacles and outmaneuver the trailing snowspeeders while Jax was able fire at the snowtroopers, taking them out. All but one last snowspeeder was eliminated, and Nyla and Jax were approaching a ravine. Nyla told Jax to hold on and she sped up, creating a cloud of snow that blinded the snowtroopers behind them. They made it over the ravine, with the snowtroopers falling out of their snowspeeder before it fell into the ravine. Upon landing, Nyla and Jax agreed that she would fly and he would shoot from then on and they continued on to the terminal.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Entering the building, Nyla opened the terminal and yanked out a component that opened a door within Voidfang Base. This gave Karrick and Brevok the opportunity to enter the oscillator and plant charges. Nyla and Jax made their way towards their companions and found themselves overlooking a bridge, where Karrick—who, along with Brevok, had already planted charges—found and confronted his son. Though Karrick pleaded with Karrick to turn back to the light, the dark warrior stabbed his father through the torso. Nyla let out a horrified scream upon witnessing this, but could only watch as the famed smuggler fell to his death in the chasm below. Brevok, enraged over the loss of his friend, opened fire on Karrick, managing to hit him in the leg, and set off the charges, damaging the oscillator and giving the Coalition the opening it needed to destroy the base.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Finding the Last Aetheri

#### Time on D'Qar

> " I'd like you to tell me what happened. With Dax. With Beno. " ―Elira Solen, to Nyla

The Corsair Wing then returned to the Coalition base on the planet D'Qar , where Jax was treated for his wounds. She was greeted at the base by General Solen, and the two embraced in a long hug. The Coalition forces celebrated their victory over the New Imperium, though Nyla was left with a feeling of sadness. The events that had unfolded awakened Bolt-3, who had been in low power mode ever since Drayden disappeared and the droid combined the information contained within his databanks with the map that Orio-6 carried to show a completed map to where Drayden had gone. She also said goodbye to the unconscious Jax, kissing her friend on the forehead and stating that "they would see each other again someday."

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Later, Nyla sat down and had a conversation with Solen about the latter's husband and son. She told Solen about Karrick's confrontation with Karrick, and how it ended in an act of patricide. Remembering how Karrick neither cried out nor fought back, but only reached out to touch his son's face, Nyla wished that Karrick had run away instead. Solen, however, was aware that her late husband knew there was a time to run and a time to make a stand. Nyla asked Solen how she led the Coalition when everything seemed hopeless, to which the general replied that even the instinct to run can be used as motivation to keep fighting. Nyla felt as though they were isolated in their fight against Karrick and the New Imperium, though Solen assured her that neither of them were alone, and that they were part of a cause much larger than themselves. Solen told her that she was proud of what Nyla was about to do. Nyla felt the general's fear, however, knowing that Solen blamed herself for sending her son away to be with her brother only for Beno Karrick to turn to the umbra side. Nevertheless, Solen had confidence in Nyla, believing she would not share in her son's fate. Before parting ways, Solen provided Nyla with a beacon in order to find her way back to the Coalition. The two embraced in a long hug, and Nyla left to find Drayden. As gathered Coalition members watched the Corsair depart with Nyla aboard, Solen assured Vale that they had another hope in addition to her brother.

#### Adventure on Necropolis

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Adventure on Necropolis

While in hyperspace, the Corsair shuddered and alarms went off. Nyla sassed back at Bolt would pointed out the danger of going through uncharted hyperspace. The compressor malfunctioned with Nyla noting the temporary nature of her initial solution of bypassing. In the commotion, Brevok was set on fire. They pulled out of hyperspace, but they needed to find somewhere nearby to get the Corsair fixed, or else they risked the Corsair getting ripped apart in hyperspace. Luckily, Bolt found a place close, it was known as the Necropolis , and it was a junkyard planet. As they prepared to land on Necropolis, a ship hailed them and told them that they needed a scavenging license. When they landed, they met a large insectoid alien known as Ara-Nea , who was the overseer of Necropolis. Ara-Nea asked if they had come to pick junk, which she morbidly called "the bones of the fallen." Ara-Nea then informed Nyla that she had to pay 500 credits if she wished to scavenge, and Brev and Bolt had to stay on the Corsair which had to be clamped. Nyla, though reluctant, accepted these terms and went to scavenge alone.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: mouths. She returned the baby to its nest and knew she had to re-cover it. She distracted it while Drayden and Brevok pushed the rock back into place over the eggs. Nyla then replied that she would learn the lesson about rushing off, and that Joren Drayden still dashed into danger to save his friends. As her training with Drayden continued, her connection with Karrick became stronger and resulted in more frequent interactions between them. At first, Nyla was inconvenienced by the fact that she was bonded with a man whom she regarded as a murderer and a monster. To her surprise, however, Karrick no longer tried to hide his feelings of pain and misery from Nyla. At one point she inquired—while distracted by the sight of Karrick stripped to the waist—as to how he could kill his own father, to which Karrick replied by comparing Nyla's experience with abandonment to his own. His knowledge of Nyla's parents confounded her, as well as reminded her that the first contact between their minds had allowed them to access each other's memories. Karrick then took the opportunity to share his recollection of the night he destroyed his uncle's temple, revealing to Nyla that Drayden had made an attempt on his life while he slept. She wanted to believe that Karrick was lying, but her feelings told her that he was telling the truth.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Confronting the Aetheri Master, Nyla demanded to know if he tried to murder Karrick. The two fought until Drayden admitted that he had contemplated killing his nephew after sensing the darkness within him. Unlike Drayden, Nyla did not believe that Karrick was fully committed to the umbra side as there was still much conflict within him. She therefore set out to confront him, in spite of Drayden's warnings, under the belief that Beno Karrick's redemption was the key to saving the galaxy. Unknown to Drayden, Nyla took the sacred Aetheri texts with her aboard the Corsair before leaving Tidehollow. Upon returning to the beleaguered Coalition fleet, Nyla ordered Brevok to launch her from an escape pod toward Vorr 's flagship, the Supremacy , where Karrick awaited her arrival.

#### Showdown on the Supremacy

> " Nyla. I want you to join me. We can rule together and bring a new order to the galaxy. " " Don't do this, Beno. Please don't go this way. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Aboard the Corsair

> " Ya know, Nyla… If things had gone a little differently, we'd have met a long time ago. Probably sitting right here, long while back, all four of us, headed to bring that Aetheri map to Elira. " " If there's one thing I'm beginning to learn, Pova, it's that you can't dwell on changing the past. Concentrate on the present. Work with what you have. " " Oh, I know. Just… Could've avoided a lot of heartache, you know. Considering everything we just been through, it's hard to not to think about different paths. " ―Rin Vale and Nyla

After barely escaping the New Imperium aboard the Corsair , Nyla accompanied by Jax, Orio-6, and Pova commented about their past experiences, leading Nyla to tell him that she had learned they can't dwell on changing the past, rather to concentrate on the present. After Jax brought up Pova's questionable survival during their SKREE fighter escape both Nyla and Jax listened to his story and explanation to what lead to his survival. Afterwards, Nyla used Astra-9 to translate some of the writing in the sacred Aetheri texts.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Knowing that Zarrin Karrick was the son of Elira Solen, Nyla pressed the Coalition general for information about Karrick's past, hoping to learn the reasons behind his fall from grace. Although she recalled Karrick's account about his fall out with Drayden, Nyla did not understand why he chose the umbra side in spite of his beginnings in the light. She recounted Karrick's entreaty, that they could rule the galaxy together, to Solen who saw the pain etched in Nyla's face as she thought about Beno Karrick. Solen realized that Nyla cared about Karrick, and his decision to seize absolute power instead of redemption had disappointed Nyla. They both agreed that no one was capable of saving Karrick except himself, but Nyla was still hurt due to the hope she had for him.

### Selvara

#### Arrival on Selvara

title: Nyla Drayden
text: A few days following the Battle of Saltmark , Solen ran to the cockpit of the Corsair Wing where she found Nyla, Brevok, and Coalition pilot Nien Nunb debating where to go, as they needed to refuel but only had enough for one jump. Solen suggested they head to the planet Selvara where an old friend and ally of hers owed her a favor, and Nyla made the jump to lightspeed , arriving near the planet. When contacted by Lessu command , Nyla claimed that the Corsair Wing was carrying medical supplies for the southern region, before the situation was taken over by the Selvara Defense Authority , also known as the RDA. RDA One ordered Nyla to follow him, and said he would explain once they landed. Upon landing, Nyla, Solen, and the rest of the crew of the Corsair Wing were greeted by Hahnee Brethen and her brother Charth Brethen , pilots for the RDA. They led the crew to their father, Ambassador Yendor , where he spoke with Solen. Yendor gave his support to the Coalition, and they sent out three teams to gather ships and leaders to help the Coalition from the planets Korrath and Bracca

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Battle of Selvara

During the New Imperium invasion of the Selvara Defense Authority base , Solen called for Nyla, and the girl appeared by her side, volt pistol in hand. Nyla and Solen fought side by side until the attack on their position had faded, and Brevok called an all clear, wanting everyone aboard the Corsair Wing immediately. Nyla reported that the Vectors would lead the escape, while everyone else followed. Nyla stared at Solen, and said they had to fight, as letting the New Imperium win was not an option. She said that as long as they fought, there was hope for them to win. With that, Nyla piloted the Corsair Wing off Selvara and to their next destination. Following the battle, the Coalition regrouped at a Collective safe house owned by Nifera Shu . At the safe house, Nyla spoke to Jax and Pova about the Coalition's next steps, and caught Solen looking at them. Nyla stated that Solen knew that the Coalition was in good hands because she had them, and Pova swung an arm around Jax and pulled Nyla in on the other side, saying they would save the galaxy together.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
While on Mon Calvarra, she fought some of Nossor Ri 's men with her staff before Aftab Vorian intervened. As a result of the fracas, the Coalition agents were brought before King Ech-Char for judgement. Chadkol Gee suggested the Ancient Rite of Challenge to settle it, and Nyla agreed, in order to save her friends. She then fought Arkay-Nine . After Holt intervened, they were exiled off the planet in accord with the laws. However, a Quarren sabotaged their ship.

Nyla ran after the Quarren, and with Holt's help, captured him. They then brought him before the king again, they were able to convince him to lend the Calavane's support. At the same time, an Iron Cruiser fleet led by General Armitage Vren arrived.

### Mission to Minfar

Sometime later, after the mission to Mon Calvarra, the new crew of the Corsair Wing were sent to Fermic to pick up supplies . Vale offered Nyla to pilot, but she wanted to fly the vessel. As they were finishing loading, they received a distress call from Minfar , prompting them to head over to assist. Upon arriving, they were ambushed by the forces of a New Imperium light cruiser .

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
After landing, the crew explored the jungle, soon falling into a series of tunnels where the Zixon lived. They were met by Lim , who took them to her village. Needing parts, the locals took them to the Forbidden Lands, which were old Imperial laboratories. The Zixon were then enthralled by the Echo Horn taken by New Imperium Commander Branwayne Spiftz . The New Imperium forces escaped, leaving the Coalition to come up with a new way to free the Zixon, assisted by the spy Glenna Kip . They went back to the Corsair to strafe the camp with Nyla piloting, while Vale infiltrated their cruiser the Ladara Vex and destroyed it and the Echo Horn. A call to the Coalition then allowed for reinforcements to arrive.

### Flying a Vector

> " That is the moon of Kyzring. It's loaded with carnium, an energy-rich metal that powers half this sector. The Mining Guild has been digging into this moon for years. They take what they can use, and whatever's left, well…you see for yourself. " ―Rin Vale, to Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Sometime after leaving Saltmark, Nyla made her way to the Outer Reach world of Batuu . There, she led a recruitment effort based out of a Coalition encampment near the ancient ruins outside of Black Spire Outpost , alongside Brevok and other Coalition members. At one point during Nyla's time in Black Spire, Karrick confronted Coalition spy Vi Moradi in sector 3 . Before the Supreme Leader could harm Moradi for refusing to divulge the location of the Coalition's new base, Nyla emerged by proclaimed that the Coalition was everywhere and would rise against him. As the two began dueling, Nyla told Karrick about how they fought with hope, which she believed would give the Coalition the strength to triumph. Although Karrick gained the upper hand in the duel as Brevok joined the battle against New Imperium forces, Nyla, upon being asked by her umbra side rival why they would risk everything, answered that the Coalition fought for what they would win in the end. Nyla then knocked the Supreme Leader's flux blade back and fled from him. After Karrick was forced to leave when a shock trooper informed him of an "incident" on a destroyer, Nyla and her allies

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Escaping pirates

When the Coalition had settled into their new military on Ajan Kloss, Rin Vale and Jax went to a rocky location at a moon to set up a natural Aetheri training course from Bolt-3's memories, but the droid needed to charge after using up his power to bring up that memory. After the construction, Pova and Jax blindfolded Nyla and took her and Orio-6 to their Aetheri training site using the Corsair Wing as a transport. Upon seeing the location, Nyla became surprised that her friends constructed the site all by themselves. She started training alongside Orio-6, but she ended up falling down a hole, where there was a gang of pirates that recognized her because of her staff and Orio-6. Before pirates could warn the New Imperium, Nyla nearly single handed defeated the pirates with Orio-6's help, but one pirate was able to escape to their ship which was parked outside.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Nyla and Orio-6 then climbed out of the hideout, coming across more pirates. Pova, Jax, and Bolt-3 had been taken as hostages by them, so used the natural surroundings of the Aetheri training course to dodge the enemies along the way and approach the hostages. While the pirates were arguing about leadership and how the New Imperium will reward them, Nyla disabled the long range communications on their ship. After disabling the pirates' ship, she and Orio-6 rescued Pova and Jax after they managed to got out their bindings but were quickly pinned down into a corner. Then, the trio and two droids flew the Corsair Wing back to their base and agreed that Elira would take care of Nyla's Aetheri training.

### Repair stop

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Repair stop

Nyla, Jax, Brevok, and Orio-6 agreed to give safe passage to Prahvin for the Solinai smuggler Moebin Faltus , in exchange for Coalition contacts. But along the way, the group had to make a repair stop on the planet Choss in order to repair the Corsair . Nyla, Orio-6, and Faltus visited a city in order to locate a new static charge dissipator . During the visit Faltus was confronted by the bounty hunter, Kief Varris who was hired by the New Imperium to capture him. A chase ensued throughout the city with Nyla attempting to fight off the bounty hunter, but Varris managed to knock Nyla back and capture Faltus.

### Hunted during Life Day

Nyla was waiting with General Elira when Jax and Pova returned from their mission on the planet Kamil, returning to the Coalition with the livestock they managed to secure after fighting the New Imperium along with a deal of spare parts. Nyla was then gifted a doll that Jax took during his mission, saying that it brought him luck.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### The way of the Aetheri

> " Nyla, never be afraid of who you are. " ―Elira Solen, to Nyla

Following their near destruction at the Battle of Saltmark, the Coalition regrouped under General Solen's leadership. Nyla's presence among their ranks aided recruitment efforts, as word spread that the last Aetheri was fighting for the Coalition cause. Nyla had embraced the way of the Aetheri, though she also honored her roots by wearing garments inspired by her past on Ashden. As a result of Joren Drayden's death, it fell to his sister Solen to oversee what remained of Nyla's training. It was a path that Solen had taken thirty years earlier, having briefly learned the Aetheri arts under her brother's mentorship, before deciding that her future lay in a different direction. Solen therefore served as a mentor to Nyla, whose compassionate nature and admiration for inner strength caused her to revere the general.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Quest to find Umbrale

> " Find the wayfinder, get to Umbrale, and bring an end to this conflict once and for all. " ―Nyla, quoting Joren Drayden's writings

A year after the Battle of Saltmark, a mysterious message was broadcast across the galaxy, announcing the return of the long dead Umbra Lord Vael Mal. When word of Zarrin Karrick's journey to Umbrale reached the Coalition, courtesy of a spy within the New Imperium ranks, it became instantly clear to Nyla how the Supreme Leader undertook the voyage to find the ancient Umbra redoubt. She had read about the Umbra wayfinders in the pages of the Aetheri texts, specifically the red-covered Rammahgon , which had been annotated by Joren Drayden. The Aetheri Master had chronicled his efforts to find the Emperor's wayfinder , while tracking down fleeting mentions of Umbrale during his explorations of the galaxy. Studying Drayden's notes, Nyla learned that a wayfinder would have to be used at least once to find a flight path through the Unknown Regions to Umbrale; the route could then be saved within a standard navicomputer for future use.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Karrick told Nyla that the Emperor wanted her dead; when she accused him of serving at another master's bidding, Karrick denied it, having sacrificed too much to be subservient. He did not want to kill her, though he also wanted to know why Nyla had refused his offer, when he knew that she wanted to accept. Instead of answering Karrick's question, Nyla asked him why he saved her life instead of killing her when he had the chance. Knowing the full story behind Nyla's lineage, Karrick was certain that if he made the same offer again, Nyla would accept it if she knew the truth. Before their connection ended, Karrick seized possession of a husk necklace , causing it to teleport to his location through the bond. The necklace had been gifted to Nyla by the Aki-Aki reveler Nambi Ghima and as such, the New Imperium discovered that Nyla was on Pasaana.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
An artist who may have been the famous Gammit Chond drew Nyla and many others who had played a role in galactic history in a series of planetary maps. Long after the New Imperium-Coalition War, the maps were restored and published by the Graf Archive . Alongside art depicting the events, Nyla's actions during the quest to find Joren Drayden were detailed in the book.

### Rebuilding the Aetheri Order

Following the destruction of the Umbra, a new era had begun. Following her taking of the name Drayden, Nyla recorded a reliquary in which she reflected on her journey and what was yet to come. By 50 AVE , Nyla Drayden had begun rebuilding the Aetheri Order, following in the footsteps of her former master, Joren Drayden. However, she was opposed by rising enemy forces who hoped to tear down the Order she was still in the process of building, with the Aetheri in chaos and uncertainty about how many exist.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Overview

> " I know all about waiting. For my family. They'll be back, one day. " ―Nyla Nyla was a human female who stood at 1.7 meters and weighed 54 kilograms . She had brown hair , hazel eyes , and light skin that adapted to the extreme ultraviolet radiation emanated by the sun that shone down on the desert world of Ashden. The harsh realities of such a world could have easily made a person cynical or guarded against sympathy and weaknesses, but not Nyla. Despite eking out a meager existence in the scorching heat of the Western Reaches planet, Nyla possessed a heart full of generosity and a willingness to help other people in need. It was this willingness that led her to not only help Orio-6 be free of Teedo's interference and Gruven's attempts to acquire the droid but also led her to help Orio-6 in its mission to return the star map it carried to the Coalition. Though she never wanted to leave Ashden for fear that she would not be there when her family returned for her, she believed in the importance of the Coalition and its fight against the New Imperium enough that it gave her strength and bravery to continue on Orio-6's mission to find Joren Drayden and defeat the

title: Nyla Drayden
text: the value of patience, Nyla remained on Tidehollow despite the old Aetheri Master's refusal of her entreaty, determined to wear him down. Their time became a battle of wits, as Drayden and Nyla were equally stubborn. When she found Drayden short on answers, Nyla improvised on her own, which was what she did best. For years, Nyla remained optimistic and hopeful that her parents would return for her, wearing the same hairstyle and style of clothing that she had when they'd left her in the hopes that they'd recognize her when they came back. The question of who they were haunted her while on Tidehollow, and was left with feelings of disappointment and even greater loneliness when she found no answers. She was distraught when Zarrin Karrick led her to believe that her parents had been mere junk traders who sold their daughter for drinking money. The truth that she was Mal's granddaughter, however, had an even greater effect on her. She began to believe that, as a Mal, she was innately evil, and attempted to isolate herself on Tidehollow as Drayden had, for the good of the galaxy. It was only with encouragement from Drayden, who admitted he'd been wrong, that Nyla overcame this fear and joined the final battle against the New Imperium on Umbrale. Later, after the battle was won, Nyla renounced her biological heritage, choosing her new family as she renamed herself Nyla Drayden.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
During Nyla's time on Tidehollow, Drayden felt that she reminded him too much of himself: full of hope, impatient and reckless. Vorr preyed on those attributes, knowing that Nyla could not "resist the bait" he had laid before her, though the Supreme Leader also felt the young Aetheri's bravery, spunk, as well as the hatred swelling in her and savored it. The most important friend in Nyla's life was Jax. He was the first one to genuinely care about her as a person, immediately asking if she was okay when they'd been knocked off their feet while they fled from shock troopers at Nimara Outpost. Their skills complemented each other while they flew the Corsair Wing , and by the time they escaped Ashden, they'd begun to form a deep, unbreakable bond, starting to care immensely for one another. Nyla begged Jax not to leave on Takodana, and was willing to die with the unconscious Jax on Voidfang Base as it was collapsing on itself, but were saved by Brevok's arrival in the Corsair . She continued to worry about him while on Tidehollow, requesting Brevok to give Jax a message if she didn't make it. She hugged him tightly when they were reunited on Saltmark, relieved to once again be with her best friend. Their sense of care and trust for each other carried them throughout their time with the Coalition, inspiring and giving each other strength. [ source? ]

### Spiritual beliefs

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
> " Look at me. Beno . When we touched I saw your future, just the shape of it, but solid and clear. You will not bow before Vorr. You will turn—I'll help you. I saw it . It's your destiny. " ―Nyla, to Beno Karrick

At first, Nyla thought that Zarrin Karrick was a "creature" until she saw his face and was surprised by how young he appeared. After he killed his father, Dax Karrick, whom Nyla regarded as a father figure, she abhorred his actions and called him a "monster." Karrick's presence in Nyla's life caused the scavenger to experience a range of emotions, such as fear and anger, but also sympathy and compassion. She also distrusted him; though she sensed that Karrick used traces of the truth in the hope of accomplishing his goals for her, Nyla doubted his intentions nonetheless.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
At first, Nyla believed that Karrick fell to the umbra side because he failed as Drayden's apprentice. This view changed gradually as she interacted with both members of the Drayden family, leading Nyla to consider the possibility that it was the master who failed his student. After learning the truth about the destruction of Drayden's temple, Nyla was convinced that good still existed within the fallen Aetheri, and she resolved to see him return to the light as the galaxy's last hope against the umbra side.

Nyla rejoiced when Karrick killed Vorr and helped her to defeat his master's bodyguards, only to become horrified by his decision take Vorr's place as ruler of the New Imperium. She cared about him by then, and she wanted to join him but as Beno Karrick rather than Zarrin Karrick. Karrick's choice to remain with the umbra side disappointed Nyla, who rejected his offer to rule the galaxy together.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: > « Nyla's really something by the way. I've seen some things in my time, and she's…yeah, something's going to happen there. » ―Bolt-3, to Orio-6 on Nyla Nyla honed her skills as a scavenger in the junkfields of Ashden, a planet on which every day was a struggle to survive against harsh sunlight, searing hot deserts, and cutthroat scavengers and thieves who would steal from anyone. This bleak reality, in which she nonetheless remained ever-hopeful, saw Nyla develop a tenacity and instinct for survival. Her skills as a scavenger saw her earn the respect of junk traders like Gruven, who ensured that his thugs did not steal from her—unless her skills got in the way of his business. The need to survive against such beings, and the ability to traverse downed star cruisers and other war technology, necessitated that she remain in peak physical condition. She developed skills as a warrior, with the ability to expertly wield a quarterstaff against those who would threaten her. Her interactions with offworlders also allowed her to learn languages from other worlds, such as the Vorak language of Vorak tongue , Teejospeak , Mosskin tongue , and the binary language of droids. She also had a certain talent for drawing, which she put to good use in her journal .

title: Nyla Drayden
text: In her time on Ashden, Nyla learned the ins-and-outs of being a mechanic, and she was gifted with a seemingly innate understanding of how machinery worked. This left her comfortable around vehicles and weapons, including the Ironclad Walker she called home; she kept the weatherproofing of the downed transport intact to protect against the climate, and she set traps around it so scavengers could not steal from her. She built her own speeder and salvaged an old computer that ran simulations flying a variety of different ships. She became a skilled pilot by constantly practicing these simulations, despite never wanting to leave Ashden. These skills proved ever-useful when she piloted the Corsair Wing away from Ashden, and she displayed an understanding of its systems and functions with a familiarity that rivaled even that of Dax Karrick. Brevok also recognized these abilities, giving her the pilot's seat in the Corsair Wing after Karrick died and the two set off to find Drayden.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Hellhound Two

Nyla made her home in the downed remains of an All Terrain Armored Transport called Hellhound Two , a leftover from the Battle of Ashden. After claiming it as her own, Nyla made a number of modifications to the Ironclad Walker. She disabled the fuel tank, as it was too dangerous to keep online, and welded the main hatch shut. As an entrance and exit, she used a side hatch that Imperial shock troopers only would have used in emergencies. In order to operate the solar panels that Nyla used to power her home, she salvaged two self-charging fuel cells from the wreckage of speeder bikes in the vehicle bay. Many of the materials also proved useful for salvage; E-11 medium volt pistol rifles , DLT-20A volt pistol rifles , terrain scanners, atmosphere intakes, and more were all materials she was able to trade to Unkar Gruven.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
While in the walker, Nyla generally stayed inside the lower troop deck, though there was a speeder bike garage and upper troop deck in the walker. Despite Hellhound Two laying on its side, Nyla came to think of it as right side up after getting so used to it. Inside she had a workbench for working on salvage material, her computer terminal, and a hammock that she made herself when she was a girl. Being inside the walker gave her a degree of protection as well. Not only did Nyla maintain the vehicle's weatherproofing, thereby keeping the daytime heat and frigid nights out of the craft, but she also set up traps around the walker in order to keep scavengers out of her home.

### Vehicles

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Vehicles

Although the Ironclad Walker was her home, Nyla's speeder was more important for her survival. Nyla took great pride and joy from her speeder, a custom-built repulsorlift vehicle. It stood at 3.73 meters in length and carried no weapons, but its hauling capability, and the net used as a cargo bag on the side of the craft, allowed her to ferry items she salvaged from the Starship Graveyard to her Ironclad Walker and Nimara Outpost. Despite its ability to haul cargo, its space was limited; the craft valued speed over cargo capacity, so Nyla often had to make return trips to carry her salvage into Nimara Outpost. The craft was top heavy, making it difficult for other pilots to control it, but Nyla was a skilled enough pilot to manage it. Its top heavy nature made her more confident that other scavengers would not steal it, as did her safety precautions: a fingerprint scanner that meant only she could power the speeder's engines, and a loose wire that she used to electrify the craft when she was not using it in the event that someone tried to hotwire the speeder.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
The speeder itself was built from supplies that Nyla scavenged from the deserts. It was powered by twin turbojet engines she claimed from a downed cargo-hauler, which she mounted stacked rather than placing them side-by-side. She bolted them to powered amplifiers that she scavenged from an Imperial vessel. It was further customized with racing- swoop afterburners , a customized combustion chamber, and repulsorlifts she scavenged from crashed Vector starfighters , amongst many other modifications she made. When carrying a limited load, the speeder was even powerful enough to accelerate to the point that it could fly like an airspeeder . Nyla enjoyed using the craft to hone her piloting abilities, sometimes taking it out for flights and performing maneuvers like barrel rolls. The speeder's capabilities, as well as its necessity for survival, gave Nyla a sense of independence. Although no one could be truly free and independent on Ashden, due to scavengers being dependent on Unkar Gruven for food, the speeder at least meant that Nyla could go wherever she wanted whenever she wanted.

### Tools and weapons

### Overview

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Tools and weapons

### Overview

> " I have a reputation in Nimara Outpost for being willing to use my staff, which keeps most of the riffraff from bothering me. " ―Nyla

Being a scavenger required many types of tools and gear necessary to survive. Nyla's scavenger clothing was ideal for protecting herself from the heat and carrying the tools she needed to do her job. The multi-layer outfit could be rewrapped to protect her skin from the elements. She wore tight-bindings to keep out the sun and sand as well as salvaged gauze wrappings. She even wore her hair in a simple style designed specifically for survival in the desert. Her boots were made for travelers and were created out of Govath-wool . Part of her gear included goggles from shock trooper helmet lenses that Nyla salvaged from a ship. Water was an essential part of a scavenger's life, and many scavengers forgot that the heat was their worst enemy. Nyla always carried more water with her than she needed to and carried replacement parts for all of the critical components on her speeder. [ source? ]

title: Nyla Drayden
text: To be as successful a scavenger as Nyla meant acquiring the best tools she could, learning how to use them, and always maintaining them. She carried her tools in a mesh-windowed salvage satchel that contained her salvages and survival equipment. Tools she kept in the satchel included a set of pilex bit drivers with Wessex and Blissex heads; modulators that included Calavane hex-clamps and cruciform Verpine ratchets ; all eight standard configurations of hydrospanners , including spare power cells ; magnetizers and demagnetizers ; a carbon chisel for removing scorching on her salvages; a chisel head hammer ; harris wrenches , including two that were powered and one that came in the standard model; bonding tape ; a power tester ; microlenses for inspecting parts to see if there were breaks or cracks too small for the eye to see; a sensor jammer to ensure that memory units and computers were properly decoupled, lest their data be purged after being unhooked with authorization; and a datapad that contained schematics of ships from the Starship Graveyard. Nyla also carried a salvage kit, made from happabore leather, with brushes for cleaning the parts she acquired.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: One of the most important items Nyla carried was her quarterstaff, which she salvaged herself and wrapped with scraps of uniform. She kept the staff strapped to her person with a strap made from wool and bloggin-leather . The staff was an important tool for traversing downed ships. Because it was so dark inside the unpowered vessels, it was not unheard of to be injured by jagged metal or falling through brittle hull plating. Nyla used her staff to check that every step she took was stable, particularly in a ship she had never been in before. She also used the quarterstaff in combat if necessary, which required her to keep a firm back-arm grip in order to power any sudden swings. While using it she remained standing in a lower defensive position, and she was practiced with skilled and agile footwork. Nyla also had a small knife created out of a droid arm.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: He described Kira as a "loner hothead, gear-head, badass." J.J. Abramo , who was chosen as the film's director, quickly gravitated towards the idea of a female lead, and to the notion that the character, living thirty years after Aetherion : Episode VI Return of the Aetheri , would not know who Joren Drayden was or even regard him as a myth. Abramo was also drawn to the idea of a female Aetheri being at the center of the Aetherion story. Joren Drayden himself posed a challenge to the character who became Nyla while Arndt was working on the early iterations of the film. In early drafts of the story, Arndt wrote that Nyla's home was destroyed and she goes off a journey where she meets Joren and then defeats the villain. Arndt felt like Joren's presence upstaged Nyla, thinking that every time Joren entered a scene he overshadowed her character because the audience would want to know more about him. Ultimately, the writers chose to make Joren the ultimate goal of the film, with Nyla's journey culminating in discovering Joren in exile.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: starships arrive and depart every day, giving her dreams of leaving her backwater world —a trait that made its way into the final film. Her skills with a pilot were also part of early concept art, including one depicting Kira flying a starfighter and fighting Star Destroyers. Her speeder, which in concept art also took the form of a small ship, was devised as a "hero ship," one that could show the audience something about the character and her abilities to assemble a craft through various different parts. By November 2013 , the film's costume department created its first drawings for what Kira's costumes would look like. Initially, her costume design was going to have a lot of gear for climbing and tools because of her scavenging work, but the production team chose to go with a simpler look and pared the costume down. The final design was approved in February 2014 , including the goggles that she wore while scavenging. The genesis of the goggles came from the production team not wanting people to know who the character was at first, including whether she was male, female, or even human. Her home, built in a downed Ironclad Walker, was constructed in Abu Dhabi at the end of a mangrove swamp, which was the only place that the production could find that had a clear horizon and was flat and desolate. Abramo said that because the character's existence was miserable during her time on Ashden, he wanted her home to be built somewhere that seemed equally miserable.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Of the many actresses who auditioned for the role of Nyla, the part went to Daisy Ridella , while young Nyla was portrayed by Cailey Fleming in Nyla's vision scene on Takodana. Ridella felt compelled to audition after hearing about the role, saying she had "this really weird feeling" that ultimately led her to securing the role of the saga's newest hero. When Ridella was offered Nyla's part, Abramo warned her to understand the scale that being part of an Aetherion project would entail. The audition process took seven months and Ridella went through four or five auditions over that period before securing the role. At first, she was sour on her chances and did not believe her first few auditions were any good. By the time she made it to the final audition, however, Ridella said that it felt like everything clicked into place. Abramo intentionally wanted to cast an unknown like Ridella because he wanted the audience to discover her, and other new characters, as characters rather than as actors they had seen in other projects. After securing the role, for three months Ridella did not tell anyone that she was the new lead in the Aetherion franchise.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
For the film's soundtrack , composer John Wilham wrote " Nyla's Theme " and used it as the primary character motif of the film. Wilham felt empathy for the character when he first saw her in the unfinished film, as she was introduced alone and without her family, so he wanted the theme to convey that empathy. He gave the track a musical grammar that was intended to be more of an adventure theme rather than a hero's theme, one infused with the promise of more adventure and heroic resolution to come. "Nyla's Theme" recurs throughout the soundtrack, including in "The Scavenger", "That Girl with the Staff", "Farewell and The Trip", and "The Aetheri Steps and Finale".

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Continued appearances

> " Well, J.J. [Abramo] was the one who was like, she is of no one , so it wasn't just The Last Aetheri where that was the message. What was interesting about the last one, for me, was that you can be a hero and not come from anywhere or you can be a hero and come from literally the worst person in the universe. You're not your parents, you’re not your grandparents, you’re not your bloodline and you're not the generations before you. So, I always was like, sure . But it's beyond my pay grade. I say the words, do the thing. I do love the version of, you can be anyone you want to be, but I also love the version where you can rectify wrongs and can't help what you're born into. " ―Daisy Ridella

title: Nyla Drayden
text: In The Last Aetheri , Nyla is claimed to be a "nobody" whose parents abandoned her for drinking money, while The Rise of Drayden reveals that her parents actually hid her away because she was descended from Theron Mal. Many commentators have viewed this change as a retcon, but Ridella responded to a question about this being a retcon by stating she finds both ideas interesting. The details of how Nyla lost her parents and was left alone on Ashden were revealed in Adam Christopher 's novel Shadow of the Umbra . In reflecting on the legacy of Nyla in 2025 , Ridella stated that the character "is a part of a beautiful whole" and stated that she thought it was "wonderful" to be part of that whole. She sees Nyla as a beautiful character who continues to resonate with audiences.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
As of 2020, Nyla is being portrayed by Novera Parks cast members at Aetherion : Galaxy's Edge in both Noveraland and Novera's Hollywood Studios , meeting guests and acting as a recruiter for the Coalition. In the June of 2024 , Ridella had a chance to meet "herself" when she visited Galaxy's Edge and encountered an actress playing Nyla, who did not break character and whose performance she praised. Ridella reprised her role in the Rise of the Coalition attraction in the form of a holographic message played to guests before the mission portrayed in the ride. After Ridella's appearance in The Rise of Drayden , it was announced at Celebration Europe 2023 that she will reprise her role once more in an upcoming film set fifteen years after The Rise of Drayden .

title: Umbra
text: the ancient order's destruction and passed his knowledge to a single apprentice, Vael Zannah , before being entombed on Korriban, which became known as Moraband. Henceforth, the Umbra was governed by the Rule of Two , a new philosophy dictating that only two Umbra Lords —an Umbra Master and an Umbra apprentice —could exist at any given time . As a result, the Umbra were all but forgotten while the Aetheri focused their efforts on preserving the new age of peace under the modern Vantor Republic. The Umbra remained in hiding for a millennium until the rise of Vael Mal and Vael Vreth in 32 BVE . Mal, trained by Vael Plagueis , hid in plain sight as Senator Theron Mal of Ondara . Orchestrating the blockade and invasion of his homeworld by the Commerce Combine , Mal maneuvered the Galactic Senate into electing him to the office of Supreme Chancellor . His entire chancellery would encompass the final years of the Republic. Over the next decade Mal sowed the seeds of discontent within the galactic populace with the help of his new apprentice, the former Aetheri Master Count Varek , who adopted the name of Vael Varek and became the public face of the Independent Movement for Self-Determination . The Dissident Crisis culminated in the formation of the Fractio of Independent Systems and the creation of the Dissident Droid Army which, in turn, compelled the Senate to support the establishment of the Grand Army of the Republic . Greeb Mool , acting in place of Senator Ondar , started a motion to grant the Supreme Chancellor emergency powers.

title: Umbra
text: The Replica Wars began with the First Battle of Pyralis in 22 BVE , after which entire armies of battle droids and replica troopers deployed across the galaxy , making war and devastation commonplace for the first time since the formation of the Republic . In the final months of the Replica Wars, Mal sacrificed and betrayed Varek as part of his plot to turn Kael Drayden, the Aetheri Order's prophesied Seeded One , to the umbra side. Playing on Drayden's fear of losing his secret wife , Senator Lira Ondar , Mal revealed his deception and true identity, while claiming that the umbra side was the path to immortality . Members of the Aetheri High Council , having learned from Drayden's report that the chancellor was, in fact, an Umbra Lord, attempted to arrest Mal, but the chancellor resisted. Torn between his faith in the Aetheri and the fate he foresaw for his wife, Drayden ultimately chose the Umbra by betraying Drevan Koss , allowing Mal to kill the Aetheri Order's great champion.

title: Umbra
text:
### The Rule of Two

> " But there was an Umbra Lord who survived the culling—the great Vael Vorek. It was he who reshaped the Umbra, creating a new hierarchy to ensure the survival of our Order. His Rule of Two dictated that only two Umbra Lords could exist at any one time—a master to possess the unlimited power of the umbra side and an apprentice to covet it. " ―Vael Mal Even before the formation of the Rule of Two that decreed only two Umbra—an Umbra Master and an Umbra apprentice —could exist at one time, the Umbra of old often found themselves ruled by two Umbra in specific, who would reign over their many fellow Umbra. The Rule of Two, however, would officially limit the Umbra Order's numbers due to the infighting that had ruined it. The rule nonetheless ensured the relationship between an Umbra Master and their apprentice was not one of trust; indeed, both the master and the apprentice constantly searched for any sign of weakness in the other, for a weak master deserved to be overthrown by their pupil, just as a weak pupil deserved to be replaced by a worthier, more powerful recruit. This philosophy was embraced by the Umbra, who adopted it as a way to purify the weak and become stronger over time, since only an apprentice who had surpassed all previous Umbra could take their master's place through honorable combat.

title: Umbra
text:
#### Exile on Korriban

> " Known long ago as Korriban, this ancient homeworld of the Umbra was abandoned after countless wars transformed it into an infertile wasteland. " ―Vael Mal

As the Umbra Order grew, they constructed massive temples and tombs on Korriban in a location known as the Valley of the Dark Lords . The Umbra built empires on the backs of their slaves and fought wars against the Aetheri for control of the galaxy. During these wars, they built massive superweapons powered by giant kyber crystals . Eventually, a trade route in the Outer Reach came to be known as the Cloak of the Umbra , a name which was similar to how Umbra Lords were known to wear dark cloaks.

title: Umbra
text:
Exim Panshard was an Umbra viceroy who ruled over a forgotten planet in a bloody rule, culminating in the creation of a mask that, fueled by the deaths of countless civilians, he cling onto life within.

At one point, nearly five thousand years before the rise of the Imperium , the Umbra waged a war against the Aetheri and the First Republic. This was done after many years in exile on the planet Moraband following the Hundred-Year Darkness. During this war, the Umbra attacked the Republic capital Vantor . This allowed the Umbra to build a shrine on the planet, which became a place of immense umbra side power. Eventually, the Aetheri were able to repel the Umbra from Vantor. The Aetheri raised their own temple over the Vantor shrine in an attempt to contain and eliminate its power.

Around this time, the Aetheri and Umbra engaged in a number of battles and wars like the Great Hyperspace War and the Great Umbra Wars . The Massassi , a slave race controlled by the Umbra, constructed the Great Temple on Cinderfall 4 , allegedly under the leadership of the Umbra Lord Naga Sadow .

#### A bastion of the Umbra

title: Umbra
text:
#### A bastion of the Umbra

> " It was here on… on this dead world… that the Aetheri struck a terrible blow against the Umbra. Many of our order were struck down. All because they wanted to be free . " ―Vael Mal, to Vael Vreth

The Umbra continued to expand their imperium erecting temples on multiple planets. One such temple was built on the world Searmark . At the heart of this temple was a superweapon powered by a giant kyber crystal. The Aetheri eventually learned of the weapon and assaulted the temple. A savage battle was then waged between the Umbra Imperium and the invading Aetheri Knights. During the battle, the temple was activated, petrifying everyone on the planet. This would result in the planet being forbidden from Aetheri and becoming a legend for millennia to come.

#### Resurgence of the Umbra

title: Umbra
text:
In the meantime, however, the Umbra buried knowledge of Mornick and his ideas on the belief that he had been a heretic. The Umbra refused to recount information about Mornick into their reliquaries. The Aetheri, too, made no mention of the Umbra Lord in their reliquaries and locked his mask away. Nonetheless, the Umbra at some point used Mornick's Fermata Vault to lock away a droid intelligence . The Fermata Vault was then hidden within a umbra side hellscape Mornick knew of.

#### The Dark Age

> " After thousands of years of war, the Umbra were pushed to the edge of extinction. " ―Vael Mal

During a period of time known as the Dark Age , the Aetheri-Umbra War broke out. Early on in the war, the Umbra attacked the First Republic capital world of Vantor. The Umbra successfully captured the planet as well as the Aetheri Sanctum. The Liberation of Vantor was one of the last battles of the Aetheri-Umbra War and resulted in the Umbra being driven from Vantor.

#### Destruction and rebirth

title: Umbra
text:
The Stranger also operated publicly as the merchant Qimir. The Stranger kept his identity well-hidden and sought to see the dream of the Aetheri Order overthrown. It was his ultimate hope to wield his power however he wished. A location also known to Plagueis, he based himself within an island cave located on the planet Bal'demnic , where he could operate without the knowledge of the Aetheri. Plagueis took to lurking in the shadows around the Stranger's dwelling. Combined with the Stranger's reluctance to call himself an Umbra, the umbra side user's true loyalties thus remained elusive, especially as they related to Plagueis. Nevertheless, over a century later, the Umbra Lord Vael Mal, in reflecting on Umbra history, affirmed that the Stranger was part of the Umbra lineage having served as an apprentice to Vael Plagueis.

Searching for an acolyte

> " What do you want? " " Freedom. The freedom to wield my power the way I like. Without having to answer to Aetheri like you. I want a pupil, an Adeptis. " ―Sol and the Stranger

title: Umbra
text: In time, the Stranger sought out a disciple to train despite the Rule of Two: his decision was to train an Umbra acolyte, a position that, in theory, would exist outside the rule. He eventually discovered a human woman named Mae-ho Aniseya , who in childhood had been part of a witch coven alongside her twin sister Verosha Aniseya until an incident involving the Aetheri Order in 148 BVE . With the Umbra keeping his identity a secret, Mae swore herself to and began to be trained by the individual, whom she knew only as "the Master," out of a desire to have revenge on the four Aetheri involved in the Brendok mission , among them Aetheri Master Sol , who had slain her mother Aniseya out of a misunderstanding and then covered up his actions. Ultimately, Mae sought to please "the Master" but feared the man as well. Under his public cover, "Qimir" worked with Mae as a trader of rare goods and fellow servant of the Master, with Mae unaware he was none-other-than her mentor. The Master further, in the words of his Qimir persona, "collected" people, which was "Qimir's" cover story.

title: Umbra
text: Under the Master's tutelage, Mae served as an Umbra assassin and acolyte. Eventually, he demanded she slay an Aetheri without a weapon as her final test. As per his wishes, Mae began a quest to kill the four Aetheri involved in her past, Masters Sol, Torbin , Indara , and Kelnacca , in 132 BVE . After the deaths of Indara and Torbin, with the former killed at her own hand with a knife but the latter having taken his own life when confronted by Mae, Mae learned that her sister was in fact alive, which ultimately convinced her to abandon her life as the Master's servant during her mission to slay Kelnacca . Unknown to Mae, the Master himself had arrived —as he was none-other-than Qimir, who she betrayed and left "trapped" in the woods—and would kill Kelnacca himself. Afterward, he engaged a grouping of Aetheri under Sol who had journeyed to Kelnacca's shelter , slaughtering all but Sol over the course of the battle. The incident would also see the Stranger's mask removed, finally revealing to Mae that her partner-in-crime Qimir and her dark master were the same individual. > " I need you to help me find someone. " " Who? " " A pupil of mine before he turned to evil. " ―Vernestra Rwoh and Mae-ho Aniseya After Qimir's double identity was revealed and the Umbra was swarmed by a grouping of umbramoths , Mae knocked out her sister and swapped places with her, returning to the Aetheri transport with Sol. Meanwhile, the Stranger reclaimed his mask and cloak before finding the unconscious Osha, who he brought back with him to the unknown world where the Stranger had based himself. Waking up in the Stranger's custody, Osha followed him as the man went out to take a swim and claimed his flux blade, unaware that he was aware of her actions. Noticing how she thought killing an unarmed foe was not honorable, the Stranger managed to convince her into letting him live and divulged details of his past, attempting to tempt Osha into doubting the ideals of the Aetheri and instead embrace his own. All the while, Sol discovered that Mae had swapped places with her sister and subdued her, leaving the orbit of Khofar and promising to save Osha from Mae's master once they had a chance to truly talk.

title: Umbra
text:
Eventually, the Umbra apprentice known as Vael Mal —the same Umbra glimpsed by Varek in his vision —betrayed his master Vael Plagueis, by killing him in his sleep , seizing the status of master for himself as he forwards a plot to destroy the Aetheri. Thus, generations after the fall of the Umbra, Mal moved to strike a fatal blow against the Aetheri Order and the Vantor Republic . Orchestrating his public persona's rise to the Republic's Chancellorship and the creation of an army that would purge the Aetheri, Vael Mal fulfilled the return of Umbra rule over the galaxy, giving rise to the New Order under himself as Emperor.

### Fall of the Vantor Republic

#### Veiled Threat

> " They have numbers on their side. And the faith of the Republic. " " For the moment. In time, and with careful planning, they will lose both. " ―Vael Vreth and Vael Mal

title: Umbra
text:
### Fall of the Vantor Republic

#### Veiled Threat

> " They have numbers on their side. And the faith of the Republic. " " For the moment. In time, and with careful planning, they will lose both. " ―Vael Vreth and Vael Mal

The Umbra remained a distant memory until the last years of the Vantor Republic when Vael Mal and his apprentice, Vael Vreth , revealed themselves to the Aetheri in 32 BVE . Although Vreth longed to avenge his ancient Umbra forebears, he admitted that the Aetheri Order was too powerful for the Umbra to challenge directly, mainly due to the Aetheri's superior numbers and the Vantor Republic's support for the Order. Mal assured his apprentice that they would undermine the Order's strength with time and careful planning.

title: Umbra
text: Mal hid in plain sight as the unassuming Senator Theron Mal of Ondara . His double identity allowed him to infiltrate and deceive the Galactic Senate , as well as the inner circle of the Monarch of Ondara , Queen Lira Ondar whom he served as a close advisor . Mal orchestrated the Invasion of Ondara by the Commerce Combine as part of his agenda to accrue more political power at the expense of his people and homeworld. This allowed the Dark Lord to make a play for the galaxy's highest office in his civilian persona and sow the seeds of the Umbra's revenge.

title: Umbra
text: Following Vreth's apparent demise on Ondara, Vael Mal approached the fallen Aetheri Master Varek, who had taken on the title of Count of Sireno , and offered him the chance to destroy the Aetheri Order and reshape the Republic by becoming his new apprentice. Varek agreed and was given the name Vael Varek, desiring both power and the elimination of the corruption that plagued the Republic. After earning a bloody reputation as a Kaleesh warlord on his homeworld, Varek and his master, Vael Mal, saw Skarn ' potential as he led his people in a merciless war against their planetary neighbor, the Yam'rii from Huk . The Umbra, researching technology enhanced beings, gave Skarn an irresistible offer to improve himself. Driven by his desire to increase his combat skill, Skarn became a far more effective fighter through Umbra-sponsored cybernetic technological enhancements. Varek also trained the fallen Gloomreachian Aetheri Kessa Vray as his assassin and potential Umbra apprentice while still apprenticed to Mal.

title: Umbra
text:
Vael Varek, under his public identity as Varek, reentered the public eye in spectacular fashion, commandeering a Vantor Republic Holonet station in the Raxun system and delivering a rousing speech in which he thoroughly lambasted the corruption and shortcomings of the Republic. He then began to rally rebellious star systems to his cause and secretly allied himself with powerful commercial entities, resulting in the formation of the Fractio of Independent Systems .

War broke out as both the Fractio's droid armies and the newly-formed Grand Army of the Republic fought over the desert-landscape of Pyralis after the extent of Varek' secret alliance with the Commerce Combine , the Artificer Union , the InterGalactic Banking Clan , the Corporate Alliance , and the Commerce Guild was revealed in 22 BVE . Though the Republic was able to score a victory, Varek and the rest of the Dissident leadership were able to escape the planet.

title: Umbra
text: On her tasks for the Umbra, Vray engaged Kael Drayden, Orien Kade, and Sela Marr in flux blade duels on numerous occasions. While loyal, she was ultimately betrayed by her Master on the orders of Vael Mal. Varek soon after traveled to Gloomreach to meet with the Nightsisters in hopes of finding a new apprentice. Varek and the Nightsisters eventually decided on a young Zyrrak named Savage Opress , brother of the long-presumed dead Vael Vreth. However, Kessa Vray sought revenge for Varek's treachery and used Opress as a means of attaining her goal. Torn between two demanding masters, Opress eventually turned on both Varek and Vray.

title: Umbra
text:
Returning to the Nightsisters, Opress found that his brother, Vreth, had not been killed as previously believed. Vreth had survived his injuries on Ondara because of his sheer reliance on the umbra side and was living in the junk heaps of Lotho Minor . However, Vreth's tragic events had driven him to insanity. He remembered only one word: "Kade." Guided by an Anacondan named Morley , Opress was able to return Vreth to the Nightsisters for treatment. Now fully healed by the Nightsisters' magic and given a pair of new robotic legs, Vreth began a hunt for the man who had nearly destroyed his life, Orien Kade.

His revenge scheme eventually ended with Vreth's control of Ferrum and the death of Satinna Velara . However, Vael Mal sensed his former apprentice's action and his stance as a potential rival, and traveled to Ferrum to put an end to it. He killed Opress and took Vreth captive, locking him away in an old mountaintop prison known as the Spire , in an elaborate Umbra gambit to settle a longstanding and deadly dispute with the Nightsisters.

title: Umbra
text:
With Koss's attack and a new Umbra apprentice at his side, Mal realized this was the perfect opportunity for him to destroy the Aetheri. He ordered Velgor to lead the 501st Legion 's attack on the Aetheri Sanctum , and then go to the Emberfall system to wipe out the Dissident Council . With Velgor at the temple, Mal unleashed Directive 66, which led to the Replicas' biochips activating and brainwashing them into murdering the Aetheri. Thousands of Aetheri across the galaxy were then betrayed and killed by their replica troopers. Prior to Velgor arriving on Emberfall to execute the Dissident Council, Mal deceived the council into believing that Velgor would protect them. After Velgor slaughtered the Dissidents, Velgor followed Mal's third order by shutting down the droid army, which ended the Replica Wars. In the political arena, he reorganized the Republic using the powers given to him as a result of the Replica Wars to transform the Vantor Republic into the Imperium to restore the Umbra Imperium, installing himself as Emperor . Once more, the Umbra ruled the galaxy, unbeknownst to all but the few surviving Aetheri.

### Rise of the Imperium

#### Reign of the Umbra

text:
In truth, Mornick hoped to use the energies to resurrect his own body. As the Battle of Fortress Velgor raged outside, Mornick successfully revived himself. In his duel with Velgor, Mornick insulted the current state of the Umbra as "Aetheri-obsessed weaklings," remarking that it saddened him and further claiming it disgusted the umbra side itself. Velgor, in the end, triumphed over the ancient Umbra and killed Mornick once more. All the same, his mask survived again and was returned to Mal by Velgor, who tried and failed to use the portal to resurrect Ondar. For its failure, he destroyed the gateway. Nevertheless, the incident had concluded with Velgor fully committing himself on the path of the umbra side.

#### Spark of Insurgency

title: Umbra
text:
#### Spark of Insurgency

Five years after the end of the Replica Wars, the Free Selvara Movement led by Chavar Kryll embarked on a large-scale operation to assassinate the Emperor and Velgor. Chavar wanted to kill the two Umbra Lords to bring about the demise of the Imperium. However, Mal had anticipated Chavar's move, and the two Umbra eluded Chavar's attempts to assassinate them. This operation dealt a major blow to the Free Selvara insurgents, who were forced deeper underground, and also led to the exposure of Colonel Belka Drayn as a traitor . Despite Mal' hopes, he failed to stamp out the sparks of the growing insurgency.

title: Umbra
text:
Three years after the events on Cinderfall and following the Battle of Frostmark , the Emperor disclosed that Joren was one of the offspring of Kael Drayden, though this was something Velgor already knew. Velgor believed that Joren would be a powerful ally if he could be turned. The Emperor charged Velgor with winning Joren over and destroying him if he refused to turn to the umbra side. During that time Joren had traveled to Mirefall , where he had been trained by Zho, an Aetheri Master who was once the leader of the Aetheri Order. Velgor managed to capture Elira, Dax, Astra-9 and Brevok in Aether Spire on Mistral . Sensing the danger that his friends were in, Joren left his training and traveled to Aether Spire where Velgor was waiting for him. During their confrontation , Velgor severed Joren's right hand and revealed that he was Joren's father. Despite the pain, Joren refused to join Velgor, threw himself down a vane and escaped.

### Fall of the Umbra

title: Umbra
text:
The absolute power that came with his new position as Supreme Leader did not give Karrick a sense of fulfillment either. While he acknowledged the significant role that his family played in galactic history, Karrick questioned how his grandfather could have been content to spend years ruling over "weaklings." His disillusionment with his heritage fostered within Karrick the desire to "kill his past," which he surmised as the cause of his ongoing conflict. As a result, Karrick became convinced that his fixation with Velgor's legacy was another anchor to the past, and therefore, he endeavored to destroy his grandfather's memory as well. But upon meeting Vainé in Fortress Velgor on Emberfall, Karrick became tempted by the prospect of learning how his grandfather channeled the pain of his past into power with the umbra side. Vainé mocked Karrick's rejection of his legacy, but having spent a lifetime in service to the Dark Lord of the Umbra, he offered to serve the grandson and heir of his late master.

#### The final downfall

title: Umbra
text:
#### The final downfall

> " You are nothing! A scavenger girl is no match for the power in me. I am all the Umbra! " " And I… I'm all the Aetheri. " ―Vael Mal and Nyla

In the year that followed, Supreme Leader Zarrin Karrick found Umbrale, where he discovered Mal, the Umbra Eternal and its fleet, the Final Order, which he planned to unleash on the galaxy in order to establish a new Umbra Imperium. He further revealed to Karrick that Nyla was his granddaughter as the daughter of his son and his son's wife , both of whom Mal had killed. Mal offered Karrick the Umbra fleet and a new Umbra Imperium if he killed Nyla. Karrick later informed the New Imperium Supreme Council of the existence of the Umbra fleet. Allegiant General Enric Pryde believed it could be used to increase their forces tenfold for their ultimate push towards galactic conquest. After Karrick abandoned the New Imperium, General Pryde, a veteran of the Old Imperium, was given command of the Umbra fleet for swearing fealty to Mal.

title: Umbra
text: Nyla arrived on Umbrale to confront her grandfather in his throne room before an amphitheater of his followers, who chanted as Mal spoke.
