Though being from a temperate planet known for its swamps and forests , Voraks were perfectly comfortable on icy worlds like Ilum and Frostmark , not requiring any additional protective clothing , i.e. gloves or boots .

title: Vorak
text:
> " Big. Covered in fur. Strong. " ― Brue Whitesun Havel describes a Vorak

Voraks were a tall species of furry humanoids from the planet Thornwood , who could grow to a height of nearly three meters . They were covered from head to toe in a thick, shaggy coat of hair with water -shedding properties that notably came in shades of brown, black, gray, and white. The species had two sexes , female and male. The latter grew long beards in adult life. The average male weighed 150 kilograms while the average female weighed 100 kilograms. The Voraks' eye color ranged from blue to brown. Voraks were big eaters, with the average adult requiring 3,500-6,000 calories a day of food . Their diet consisted of wild plants , berries , meat , and spices. They preferred their spices to be hot.

title: Vorak
text:
While Voraks did not like eating blosphi extract , it provided them with enough nutrition to survive. The " Vorak flu " was a sickness that affected Voraks. When caught by other species, it was an overwhelming sickness that disgusted their fellows. The literary collective term for Voraks was a grove of Voraks. Many of their kind were known to understand Galactic Basic but were unable to speak it due to their species' vocal structure.

Voraks had extendable claws which they used for climbing; using them for anything else violated the Vorak honor code . Despite their fearsome appearance and volatile temperament, Voraks were regarded as intelligent, sophisticated, loyal and trusting. When angered, Voraks were known to descend into a berserker rage. Voraks had an average lifespan of 400 standard years , and they appeared not to age over a span of fifty years . Their lifespans dramatically decreased due to the harsh working conditions in the spice mines of Cindral . During their prime growing years, Voraks were often hungry, forcing them to eat whenever they could. One Vorak, Lohgarra , lived healthily for centuries —the only distinction being her white fur.

title: Vorak
text:
### The Replica Wars

> " Go, I will. Good relations with the Voraks, I have. " ―Aetheri Master Zho

Voraks originated on the Mid Reach forest planet of Thornwood. In the ancient past, they invented and crafted weapons that fired poisoned darts and arrows. During the Replica Wars and the reign of King Grakchawwaa , the Voraks remained fiercely loyal to the Vantor Republic and fought alongside them in several star systems . Towards the end of the conflict, Vorak forces also defended their homeworld from a Dissident invasion with the help of Vantor Republic forces led by Aetheri Master Zho , who had good relations with them.

### Age of the Imperium

#### Imperial subjugation

> " Thornwood, l-look, things are really bad down there. The - the Imperium's muscling in on those Voraks big time. " ―Greez Dritus talking about the Imperium's exploitation of Voraks

title: Vorak
text:
### Age of the Imperium

#### Imperial subjugation

> " Thornwood, l-look, things are really bad down there. The - the Imperium's muscling in on those Voraks big time. " ―Greez Dritus talking about the Imperium's exploitation of Voraks

At the end of the Replica Wars, numerous Voraks were slaughtered by the replica troopers they allied with in the ensuing chaos of the anti-Aetheri Directive 66 , and soon after the establishment of the Imperium , their homeworld of Thornwood was blockaded by the Imperium. The Age of the Imperium saw the softening and repeal of anti- slavery laws, which ultimately led to the Imperium classifying the Voraks as non-sentient. The Imperium enslaved the Voraks not because they were a meaningful threat to the Imperium but because their massive, robust physiology allowed them to work long and hard in extreme conditions.

title: Vorak
text:
#### Coalition and resolve

Despite these grave circumstances for their race, the Voraks nonetheless found ways to help others. In the early days of the Imperium, the Outer Reach planet of Lasan , home to the Lasat , was brutally sacked and devastated by the Imperium for daring to question the new regime. Unable to stand by and watch, many Voraks went to Lasan and fought the Imperium with weapons forged from the wroshyr trees of their homeworld, in many cases giving their own lives to save the Lasats. Because of their actions, a few Lasats, including Gara-Zev Orrelios , were able to escape the genocide and survive in the wider galaxy. [ source? ]

title: Vorak
text: In 14 BVE , Voraks who were being held prisoner by the Imperium and forced to work at an Imperial refinery in Thornwood, were freed by the Partisans led by Torrik Vess and the Aetheri Adept Cal Kessara , who joined them during the attack on the refinery. Kessara went to Thornwood in search of Tarfful , a Vorak chieftain he believed might have information that could be useful in his mission to rebuild the Aetheri Order . Kessara left the world while the Partisans searched for Tarfful and returned when he was informed they had found him. Tarfful told Kessara to search the top of the Origin Tree , where he figured out where to go.

title: Vorak
text:
### Joining the Insurgency

> " Would somebody get this big walking carpet out of my way? " ―Princess Elira referring to Brevok — Link ▶️ ( file info )

During the Galactic Civil War , several Voraks, including Brevok and Lohgarra , fought for the Alliance to Restore the Republic and its successor government, the Concordat . One year following the Battle of Mossfell , the Vorak homeworld had become an Imperial remnant known as Imperial territory G5-623 led by Grand Moff Tolruck. Thornwood was later liberated by the Concordat forces . Working with a group of insurgents led by Dax Karrick and Brevok, the former Imperial loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus , used a hyperspace transceiver to neutralize Tolruck's inhibitor chips. This enabled the Voraks to rise up en-masse against the Imperial occupiers and take their well-earned revenge, with Grand Moff Tolruck himself being killed by his personal slave, Cracktooth . The Imperial forces attempted to orbital bombard Thornwood but were defeated by a Concordat fleet led by Elira Solen and Admiral Vorian .

title: Vorak
text:
Vorak and Concordat forces then conducted mopping-up operations against the remaining Imperial holdouts on Thornwood. During one of these skirmishes, Brevok reunited with his son, Lumpawaroo , who had escaped from a slave labor camp run by Commandant Dessard .

### Concordat era

During the Concordat era , Thornwood's forests including the Black Forest grew back. Many Voraks including Brevok and Chief Karasshki lived in villages. About two years after the Battle of Ashden , the rogue Pau'an surgeon Fyzen Gor began kidnapping and killing Vorak younglings to use as spare parts for his droid followers, the Original Dozen . Due to his shadowy appearance, he earned the nickname the "Long Man." Brevok agreed to help Dax Karrick and Dorian Quill retrieve the Phylanx Redux Transmitter in return recovering the limbs of the murdered Voraks for funeral rites.

title: Vorak
text:
> " A Vorak! Rare you are to the Aetheri. Proud, your people must be. " ―Professor Huyang to Gungi

The name for their species was known to translate from Vorak tongue into Galactic Basic Standard literally as "the People of the Trees". Living in a great harmony with the nature of Thornwood, the Voraks placed great value upon the wroshyr trees of their home planet; they considered the mighty trees the true owners of the land, themselves merely coexisting with them, and would consult them before every battle by bowing their heads against their wood to listen to their wisdom.

title: Vorak
text:
Voraks were expert craftsmen who blended off-world technology like volt pistols and flux blades with traditional materials such as wood , precious stones , and metals . Most Voraks carried bowcasters as weaponry, which were handcrafted. Brevok's bowcaster broke Vorak tradition due to its automatic cocking system. Voraks believed that seeing a can-cell brought good luck, and Voraks often kept them as pets. The Vorak people by and large hated Trandoshans , great hunters who turned their talents against the Voraks and hunted them. The highest way a Vorak could compliment someone was to groom them. Voraks were not known to be subtle.

In Vorak society, loyalty and courage were valued as sacrosanct tenets. It was typical for Voraks to value honor and friendship above all else. It was considerably rare to find Voraks with criminal tendencies. When male Voraks turned 12 years old, they would undergo initiation rituals to enter adulthood. Voraks spoke three languages : Vorak tongue , Thykarann , and Xaczik . Vorak tongue had 150 words for "wood" but no word for " artist " because Voraks viewed their carving skills as a survival skill and not a talent.

title: Vorak
text: The first Vorak Elira Solen ever met was a guest at one of Senator Bael Prestor Solen 's state dinners, with the Vorak leaving an impression on the young Elira. Drokkatta was a Vorak who served in the Vantor insurgent cell . The Vorak Greybok played an important role in turning the tide of the Battle on Sevarcos by freeing several rancors , which rampaged the Imperial lines. He later took part in Dax Karrick and Brevok's campaign to liberate Thornwood. While serving as a senator in the Concordat's Galactic Senate , Elira Solen once saw two Vorak commuters in front of her on an automated sidewalk at the Concordat senatorial complex on Hosnian Prime .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
# Vector starfighter
> " Lock S-foils in attack positions. " ―Torb Rask

Vector Starfighters , otherwise referred to as the Vector class , were a type of starfighter marked by their distinctive S-foils that resembled the High Galactic script's character "X" in attack formation. They were heavily armed with four laser cannons on the S-foils and proton torpedo launchers in the fuselage. Vectors were designed for dogfighting and long missions. During the Galactic Civil War , the Free Coalition used Vector models like the T-65B Vector starfighter and T-65C-A2 Vector in many battles, deploying Vectors in engagements such as the Attack on Lorath , the Battle of Cinderfall , the Battle of Mossfell , and the Battle of Ashden .

Approximately thirty years later, a different and upgraded variation of Vector, the T-70 , was used by the Coalition , whereas a more advanced model, the T-85 , was used by the Concordat Defense Fleet .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
### Design and development

The Vector was descended from Vektor Corporation 's Replica Wars –era Fighter , namely the Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter , Replica Z-95 Headhunter , and Z-95 Headhunter . Vektor's engineers strove to build a well-rounded, hyperrelay -equipped snubfighter with no exploitable weakness. The new starfighter was intended to become the backbone of the Imperial Navy , but political forces led to the Imperium deciding to rely on Sienar Fleet Systems ' more affordable SKREE fighter series . The Alliance to Restore the Republic then adopted the Vector design as its own.

In 5 AVE , Vektor-FreiTek Corporation introduced the T-70 model, which incorporated many improvements over the T-65 series. The Vektor engineers, having learned a valuable lesson from the loss of so many Vectors in the trenches at Battle of Cinderfall , equipped the T-70 with a swiveling volt pistol cannon that could be used to fend off attacks from behind. At least one prototype had been constructed prior to the Battle of Ashden . By 34 AVE, the Concordat had retired most of its T-70s in favor of the T-85s, which were even more capable than the already impressive T-70s.

### Operational history

title: Vector starfighter
text:
### Operational history

#### Galactic Civil War

Early battles

The T-65B model was in use as early as 5 BVE . Torrik Vess 's Partisans had several of them in their livery during that period. Vess was among the first insurgent leaders to see how useful the T-65 would be in insurgent operations and had stolen eight via a violent raid on a Vektor warehouse . Dubbed the Cavern Angels for the Partisans' habit of hiding material in caves, these Vectors were used as early as the Partisans' stay on Segra Milo .

The Alliance to Restore the Republic recovered information about the Vector via the rescue of Vektor personnel and operated T-65B Vectors as early as 1 BVE . During the attack on Lorath , at least ten T-65B Vector Fighter alongside BTL-A4 Yarrow assault starfighter/bombers participated in the assault, but all were destroyed by the Imperial defenses. Lena Kryll , Mart Mattin , Secon Daree , C1-10P , and R3-A3 survived being shot down, but many other pilots were killed and their astromechs destroyed.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
A few days after the Battle of Cinderfall , Elira Solen and Evaan Verlaine disobeyed orders from Alliance High Command and departed on mission to rescue the survivors of Cindervale . Drayden and Torb Rask were scrambled to intercept their shuttle, but the insurgents jumped to hyperspace.

After the Assault on Cymoon , Joren Drayden and Bolt-3 flew a Vector to Hradreek in order to obtain credits for the Insurgent war effort. Before long, a four-sided skirmish erupted over possession of Vael Atrio' flux blades , with Bolt rescuing Drayden by bringing him the ship.

Later, Drayden flew a Vector from the Alliance Fleet to Dunemere, accompanied by Bolt-3. There, he revisited Orien Kade 's hut and discovered the deceased Aetheri Master's journal. Disappointed that the journal didn't contain any information on Aetheri training, Drayden set course for Nar Shaddaa .

Vectors would again see large-scale action against the Imperium in the Battle of Vrogas Vas . The battle was a costly defeat for the Alliance, with Blue Squadron completely destroyed and Red Squadron suffering heavy casualties.

Battles continue

Vectors were also deployed to Sunspot Prison in the aftermath of Eneb Ray 's assault.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Vectors also defended from Imperial forces that launched an attack on the Insurgent fleet shortly before the mission to Saltmark .

Vectors again saw large-scale action at the mutiny on Mon Calvarra , a strategic Alliance victory. After the battle, the Mon Calvarra Mercantile Fleet became part of the Alliance Fleet, but the Calavane King Liarch and his Regent Dors Urtya were both killed by Imperial forces.

Later, Vectors defended the Alliance Fleet from an assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks , a major blow for the Insurgency. The attack destroyed more than half of the Insurgent cruisers and 90 percent of its available starfighter forces.

A number of Vectors accompanied the 61st Mobile Infantry company , known to most as "Twilight Company," on the Coyerti campaign in the Mid Reach Retreat . The campaign ended with the destruction of an Imperial biotoxin production facility and an Alliance victory.

From Frostmark to Ashden

title: Vector starfighter
text:
A number of Vectors accompanied the 61st Mobile Infantry company , known to most as "Twilight Company," on the Coyerti campaign in the Mid Reach Retreat . The campaign ended with the destruction of an Imperial biotoxin production facility and an Alliance victory.

From Frostmark to Ashden

In 3 AVE , numerous Vectors served as fighter escorts for the Alliance's GR-75 medium transports during the Battle of Frostmark . The rearguard actions on the surface covering the evacuation proved costly to the Alliance, with many personnel killed. Additionally, the Alliance was forced to leave behind much of their heavy equipment, and the fleet, including its Vectors, scattered throughout the Outer Reach Territories , travelling to separate rendezvous points like Rendezvous Point Delta-Three .

title: Vector starfighter
text: Joren Drayden, however, traveled to the Mirefall system to seek out Zho , the former Grand Master of the Aetheri Order . Due to Mirefall 's thick fog, Drayden crashed his Vector in a swamp. With Drayden away, Torb Rask was promoted to lead Renegade Squadron in his absence, which he rebranded to be "Red Squadron" due to the losses sustained on Frostmark. The following day, Rask led Red Squadron's Vectors against pirates that threatened the security of Rendezvous Point Delta-Three. Meanwhile, Drayden's starfighter sank further until it was almost fully submerged, at which point Drayden attempted to recover it. While he had developed some skill with telekinesis , his self-doubt led to his ultimate inability to lift his waterlogged Vector from the bog, and only with Zho's assistance was the starfighter moved to solid ground. When Drayden left the system, he traveled to Mistral , where he ended up abandoning his Vector when circumstances compelled him to depart in the Corsair Wing .

title: Vector starfighter
text: Upon reaching Rendezvous Point Delta-Three, everyone aboard the Corsair found the Fourth Division besieged by Imperial Commander Ellian Zahra and her Hunter Fleet ; having been appointed to find the Insurgents, Zahra was able to track communications between the Fourth Division and Eighth Division , which was destroyed near Malastare . Zahra personally led the attack against the Fourth, trapping the Vectors and other craft between her fleet and a sun . While one Vector nearly escaped her forces, Zahra personally took control of a cannon to destroy it. However, the arrival of the Corsair eventually led to the Fourth Division successfully escaping to Backup Rendezvous Point Gamma-Nine . Later, Drayden reclaimed his personal Vector during a mission to Aether Spire , and several of the Fourth Division's Vectors and Arrows served together as Starlight Squadron .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Vectors assisted Twilight Company in Operation Ringbreaker , an attempt to divert Imperial forces from Kuat to make the planet more vulnerable to attack. The operation saw numerous engagements with Vectors in combat, including an attack on the dockyards of Najan-Rovi . The campaign scored some notable successes, but it ultimately ended with the Siege of Inyusu Tor and the failure to reach Kuat. Although the Alliance squad was stranded on Garnethex and on the verge of defeat from the outset, an uprising of the Cobalt Laborers' Reformation Front liberated a part of the planet.

In 4 AVE , Corona Squadron engaged Imperial Skrees in a dogfight in the Hudalla system . The small but drawn-out engagement resulted in each side losing a single starfighter, and it set the stage for the Battle of Mossfell .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Seventeen days after the Battle of Mossfell, Vectors took part in the Battle of Cawa City , which expelled Imperial forces from Sterdic IV .

Vectors fought Imperial forces at the Attack on Fondor alongside Arrows and U-wings . The battle ultimately ended with an Insurgent defeat, and the Imperium securing weather control satellites for Operation Cinder.

Joren Drayden flew his Vector to undertake a mission to Pillio , where he encountered Del Meeko .

Vectors also engaged Imperial Skrees in the Battle of Serath , which resulted in the destruction of a series of Imperial weather control satellites and the failure of Operation: Cinder .

By the end of the Battle of Ondara, the Alliance had reorganized itself into the Concordat and continued to operate the Alliance's Fighter. Concordat Vectors saw action at the Battle of Naalol and the Insurgency on Akiva , both victories for the Republic.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
By the end of the Battle of Ondara, the Alliance had reorganized itself into the Concordat and continued to operate the Alliance's Fighter. Concordat Vectors saw action at the Battle of Naalol and the Insurgency on Akiva , both victories for the Republic.

In 5 AVE, the Imperium continued to put up coalition against the Concordat's liberation of the galaxy. Inferno Squad , a former Imperial special forces unit, flew Vectors against their former comrades in a skirmish on Takodana . Later, Inferno Squad would fly Vectors again in a mission to Chinook Station . Vectors accompanied the A/SF-01 Bulwark Fighter of Blade Squadron in the Battle for Kuat Drive Yards , which crippled the Imperium's capability to produce starships and walkers. The twelve Vectors of Phantom Squadron took part in the liberation of Thornwood , which deprived the Imperium of much of its slave labor. Corona Squadron's Vectors fought Imperial forces during the Invasions of Ondara . Shepherd Squadron operated Vectors in the Battle of Fondor Shipyards

title: Vector starfighter
text:
The Galactic Concordance treaty was signed in the middle of the Battle of Ashden, which marked the final surrender of the Imperium. The Imperial ships that hadn't been destroyed in the fighting began jumping into the Unknown Regions , and went on to form the nucleus of the New Imperium Navy .

#### Concordat Era

> " Are those Vectors? " ― Qin

In 28 AVE , the Amaxine warriors operated numerous Vectors alongside Yarrows, Bulwarks, and Imperial Skrees. Although these Fighter were all destroyed in a mission to Sibensko , the Amaxine warrior crisis resulted in the formation of the Coalition. The B-class Vector existed by the time of the Concordat Era and was represented in a model kit owned by a young Karr Nuq Sin .

In 33 AVE , the Concordat T-85 Vectors of Rapier Squadron fought New Imperium Skrees over Suraz 4 . The New Imperium hijacked the Yissira Zyde freighter during the Suraz engagement , prompting Rapier Leader Rin Vale to launch an unsanctioned mission to recover the ship. The resulting skirmish in OR-Kappa-2722 led Vale to trouble with the Concordat authorities, and Vale defected to the Coalition shortly after.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
During the hunt for Lor Saan Tarka , the T-70 Vectors of Black Squadron engaged New Imperium Skrees in a mission to Ovanis . The dogfight ended in a draw, although Black Squadron shot down several Skrees without suffering any casualties.

Later on in 34 AVE , during the mission to Kaddak , Commander Rin Vale stowed his own personal T-70 Vector, Black One , in the cargo compartment of a freighter. After a series of complications required a quick evacuation from the planet, Vale abandoned the freighter and left in Black One .

Five Black Squadron Fighters, including four Vectors, engaged the forces of the New Imperium in a battle over a desert planet . The engagement led to the death of Arrow pilot L'ulo L'ampar .

Black Squadron operated T-70 Vectors in a mission to Spalex .

Black Squadron was also involved in a mission to Cato Geltaria , in which it faced off against Replica Wars–era droid fighter .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Black Squadron operated T-70 Vectors in a mission to Spalex .

Black Squadron was also involved in a mission to Cato Geltaria , in which it faced off against Replica Wars–era droid fighter .

The young Concordat pilot later turned Coalition spy by Rin Vale, Kazuda Xiono , along with his squadron , consisting of Hugh Sion and Mia Gabon , engaged Major Vonreg's Tie in deep space with their T-85 Vectors to provide Rin Vale with critical intelligence about the New Imperium by the Concordat Command's orders. Xiono and Vale flew Vectors on missions together at least twice more in an Investigation of a G-class freighter and a Mission to Station Theta Black .

Zay Versio and Iden Versio both flew Vectors in a mission to Athulla . Later, Shriv Suurgav and Iden flew them to Vardos, where the two fought both New Imperium and Jinata Security forces in the battle of Kestro .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Later, Vale and Orio-6 flew a T-70 to Ashden in order to meet Saan Tarka in the village of Tuanul . Saan Tarka had in his possession the Map to Drayden , which was eagerly sought by both the New Imperium and the Coalition. The New Imperium also tracked down Saan Tarka and launched an attack on Tuanul , killing him and all the villagers. Vale attempted to flee in his Vector, but the ship was damaged and subsequently destroyed.

#### New Imperium-Coalition war

> " That's one hell of a pilot! " ―Jax, on Rin Vale's piloting skills

Within hours, the New Imperium's learned that the droid had escaped to Takodana Castle , and initiated the Battle of Takodana in an attempt to recover Orio-6 and the map. Dax Karrick , Brevok , and Jax were captured, but the Vectors of the Starfighter Corps intervened and forced the New Imperium's ground forces to retreat, allowing the trio to escape.

title: Vector starfighter
text: The Vector series of fighter first appeared in Aetherion : Episode IV First Dawn , during the climactic Battle of Cinderfall. These ships quickly became iconic of the original film, the original trilogy , and the Aetherion franchise as a whole. Vectors reappeared in the other two films of the original trilogy, Aetherion : Episode V Rise of the Imperium and Aetherion : Episode VI Return of the Aetheri . Many Expanded Universe products also featured the Vectors and their crewmembers, including Aetherion: Vector , Aetherion: Vector Alliance , Aetherion: Vector Miniatures Game , and Aetherion: Vector Renegade Squadron . Vask Pictures also created numerous ships that served as in-universe predecessors and successors of the Vector, including the Z-95 Headhunter starfighter, ARC-170 starfighter , and X-83 TwinTail starfighter .

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
# Cinderfall 4
> " Welcome to Cinderfall 4....There are cells gathered here from every corner of the galaxy. " ―Gara-Zev Orrelios

Cinderfall 4 , also known as Cinderfall , was the jungle -covered fourth moon in orbit around the red gas giant Cinderfall Prime . Prior to the Galactic Civil War , Cinderfall was first a secret rendezvous point for members of the Axis Network and later home to the Massassi Group , one of many disparate insurgent cells fighting against the Imperium . Sometime before 2 BVE , the headquarters of the Alliance to Restore the Republic , was established on the moon, becoming fully equipped to wage war by 1 BVE . Following a major battle that took place around Cinderfall, the Alliance went on the run, and eventually relocated its headquarters to Frostmark .

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
### Early history

> " I know that the Massassi have been extinct for millennia. I knew that before I studied history. " ―Chelli Lona Vexa

Five thousand years before the Battle of Cinderfall , the ancient warriors of the Massassi lived on Cinderfall 4 and constructed the Great Temple . The Great Temple was alleged to have been built under the leadership of the Umbra Lord Naga Sadow around 5000 BVE . The Massassi venerated the tyrant as a god and the Temple was raised in Sadow's honor. Archeologists later proposed that the Great Temple may have functioned as a large-scale communications device to contact other Umbra Lords throughout the galaxy . Being enslaved by the Umbra , the Massassi species went extinct millennia before 0 AVE , sometime after finishing their temples.

Sometime before the Battle of Vantor , an archaeological expedition on the moon of Cinderfall 4 uncovered the Great Umbra Wars Bas-Relief in one of the enormous stone temples built by the Massassi.

### Early insurgency

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
### Early insurgency

By the Imperial Era , Cinderfall 4 was only known to scouts and gas prospectors. In 4 BVE , Axis network agents, Kassian Andris and Porko , chose Cinderfall 4 as their rendezvous point for after Andris's mission to Sienar Test Facility 73 . However, a day after Andris left, the remnants of the Maya Pei Brigade arrived at Porko's location, and killed him when he opened fire on them. Andris would later return to the rendezvous point with the stolen SKREE Avenger prototype two days later and was taken prisoner by the Brigade. Soon after, tensions among the Brigade boiled over and splintered into two sub-factions under Bardi and Gerdis , the former holding the SKREE Avenger while the latter holding Andris, the only pilot, hostage. The following night, Bardi and Gerdis resolved to settle their standoff with Five Hands , only to be interrupted and devoured by a Cinderfallian driffle . Andris managed to escape in the chaos and retook the SKREE Avenger and departed the moon, leaving the remaining insurgents stranded.

### Galactic Civil War

title: Zho
text: former Adept Kantam Syra and other Aetheri battle the Nullkin, accompanied by a former Aetheri who fought in the Night of Sorrow named Azlin Rell . As the Nullkin had also weaponized the Nameless, Zho hoped that Rell's knowledge he had accrued about the creatures since the battle would help the Aetheri find a way to fight them. Zho was almost nine hundred years old in the latter days of the Republic. A leading member of the Aetheri High Council, his contemporaries included other legendary Masters, such as Drevan Koss and Reth-Oss-Van . During the Invasion of Ondara , in 32 BVE , the maverick Sorin Vael introduced Kael Drayden to the High Council, believing with absolute certainty that he had discovered the prophesied Seeded One . The Aetheri elders sensed that the boy was full of fear and anger and declined to train him, deeming Drayden too old and emotionally compromised to commit himself to the Aetheri Code . After Vael's death during the liberation of Ondara , the High Council reversed their decision in spite of Zho's continued opposition to Drayden's apprenticeship, having sensed grave danger in his training. At the same time , the Aetheri discovered that their ancient nemesis , the Umbra, had returned after a millennium in hiding. Aware of the Rule of Two , Zho was convinced that at least one more Umbra Lord remained active following Orien Kade 's victory over the Umbra apprentice Vael Vreth .

title: Zho
text: Over the next decade, the galaxy was on the verge of civil war with entire star systems —led by Count Varek , Zho's one-time Adept—threatening to secede from the Republic by 22 BVE . Unable to defend the entire Republic against this betrayal on their own, the Aetheri took command of the newly-formed Grand Army of the Republic , with Zho himself leading an army of replica troopers against the Dissident Droid Army of the Fractio of Independent Systems in the first battle of the Replica Wars, rescuing the Aetheri and Senator from execution. For three years Zho led the Republic military's war effort as an Aetheri General , determined to bring a swift and decisive end to the conflict. During this time he was approached by the spirit of Sorin Vael, who helped Zho learn how to retain his identity as a spirit after death. Zho's efforts against the Dissidents were undermined by Vael Mal , the Dark Lord of the Umbra who conspired to destroy the Aetheri and restore the Umbra to power. After the Great Aetheri Purge commenced in 19 BVE , killing thousands of Aetheri both on Vantor and across the galaxy, Zho confronted the self-declared

title: Zho
text: Years later, Joren Drayden's attempt to reform the Aetheri Order would be foiled when his nephew Beno Karrick turned to the umbra side and destroyed his Aetheri Sanctum . Believing the galaxy was better without him and the Aetheri, Drayden went into exile, just as Zho had. After his student he reluctantly trained, the scavenger Nyla , also abandoned her training, Zho appeared as a ghost to Drayden. Zho taught Drayden to learn from his failures and helped him forgive himself.

title: Zho
text:
Although Zho spoke little of his early days, it was rumored that one of his early instructors was the Hysalrian N'Kata Del Gormo . Zho was paired up with a personal mentor at a younger age than usual. During their time together, Zho's Aetheri Master told him the tale of K'ungfu and Chuang , two great Aetheri of the past. As an Adept , Zho visited multiple planets and during his first years he could have named them all, but in the following centuries, he couldn't remember how many he'd seen and later estimated the number to be in the tens of thousands. Around the age of one hundred, in 796 BVE , Zho was ready to pass on what he had learned. Having attained the rank of Master, he spent the next eight centuries training and tutoring generations of Aetheri. It was estimated that over his lifetime, he trained around twenty thousand Aetheri.

### High Republic Era

#### Early High Republic Era

title: Zho
text: In 382 BVE , after learning of the Battle of Embermoor and the failure of a peace treaty between the warring planets Eiram and E'ronoh there, Zho went to the Republic Executive Building on the galactic capital Vantor to meet with with Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark while they waited for more information from Embermoor . They spoke to Aetheri Master Creighton Sun and Aetheri Knight Aida Forte , who were on the ground on Embermoor and confirmed that the E'roni ambassador was dead and the Eirami had deployed a droid army. They requested to perform an investigation on the Outer Reach Territories planet Dalna of the Path of the Open Hand cult, considering their involvement in the failure of the peace talks, the fact that Aetheri Master Silandra Sho felt a disturbance that made the Aetheri ill at the Path's almshouse , and that Aetheri Knight Gella Nattai believed the Chancellor's criminal son Axel Greylark was working with the Path. Zho admitted that he had sensed a disturbance beyond Embermoor, and emphasized that they need to be careful, reminding them that there was always those who thrived in chaos. After much deliberation, Zho and Chancellor Greylark eventually agreed to a

title: Zho
text: Chancellor's criminal son Axel Greylark was working with the Path. Zho admitted that he had sensed a disturbance beyond Embermoor, and emphasized that they need to be careful, reminding them that there was always those who thrived in chaos. After much deliberation, Zho and Chancellor Greylark eventually agreed to a fact-finding mission accompanied by two of her guards and to send Aetheri Master Char-Ryl-Roy and Adept Enya Keen to Eiram and E'ronoh to try and keep the peace and discover what was causing communications buoys to be down, Zho explaining to them that Werth Plouth , the Path's Herald , was responsible for the riots on Embermoor.

title: Zho
text:
Later, Chancellor Greylark had her guards summon Zho to her to reveal that her son Axel had escaped from prison with the help of the Path and someone named Binnot Ullo . She told Zho that she did not know who Ullo was and did not think Axel had many friends. He assured her that no one, no galaxy, and no republic was perfect, and that she should continue to fight for the greater good like the Aetheri did. She explained that she felt like they have all been moving through a fog that has corrupted everything lately and Zho insisted that Axel still had good in him and that the 'fog' was just corrupting him too. However, the Chancellor resolved to make Axel truly feel the consequences of his actions.

#### Chancellor no more

> " We will go together. Chancellor you may not be anymore. Friend, you still are. " ―Zho to Greylark, on going to Dalna

title: Zho
text:
#### Chancellor no more

> " We will go together. Chancellor you may not be anymore. Friend, you still are. " ―Zho to Greylark, on going to Dalna

Eventually, Greylark received a message from her son on Dalna and immediately called Zho to have him listen to it with her via hologram. After hearing Axel ask for her to go to Dalna to speak with the Path and with him, Zho asked her what she would do, the Chancellor deciding to go to Dalna. She then recorded a message for Axel that included Zho in it, wearing a blank expression, so that he could bear witness to her stepping down as Chancellor. After she sent the message, Zho stayed with her wordlessly for a while, and she appreciated his kindness.

title: Zho
text:
Before Greylark could leave for Dalna, Zho approached her and said that since he had not heard back from Masters Sun or Ela Sutan , who had also been sent to Dalna, that he would go with her because she was still his friend even though she was no longer Chancellor. Zho had an Aetheri Longbeam cruiser follow them with a contingent of Aetheri. While in hyperspace, they received a distress call from Princess Xiri A'lbaran of E'ronoh and Prince Phan-tu Zenn of Eiram. They then received a message from Chancellor Orlen Mollo , who said that the leaders of Eiram and E'ronoh were still not cooperating. Zho volunteered to rescue the heirs due to their proximity to them and left, taking other Aetheri with him.

#### The Night of Sorrow

> " Speak to the Aetheri Council soon, you should. We must explain the happenings on Dalna. All that went wrong. " […] "But we must also speak to all the things that went right. We could not have defeated the Path without the Aetheri. " " And the Aetheri could not have defeated the Path without the help of our Republic allies. " ―Zho and Greylark

title: Zho
text: Eventually, Zho arrived at the battle that was now raging on Dalna between the Path and the Aetheri, which came to be known as the Night of Sorrow . The Path, much of it reorganized into the Path of the Closed Fist , was led by Marda Ro of the Ro family . He was joined by Princess A'lbaran and Prince Zenn, the three announcing that the combined forces of Eiram and E'ronoh were there to fight together with the Aetheri. When Zho arrived on the ground at the Path compound , Aetheri Gella Nattai told him to direct people to go to the cave system as there was potentially many more Path members there. On Dalna, he met Path Little Tromak . Zho eventually came to forget Tromak but always remembered the importance of his visit to Dalna.

title: Zho
text:
Zho met with Kyong Greylark and Chancellor Mollo on a medical frigate above Vantor, the three discussing now only having one Chancellor instead of two and what it means. Zho suggested they speak to the Aetheri Council and tell them everything that went wrong, but Greylark also wanted to focus all the things that went right, including the help of the Republic and the Aetheri. Mollo revealed that the people of Dalna were calling the event the Night of Sorrow. While he imagined the future, Greylark assured Zho that she would meet him on Vantor soon, Zho adding that there was much to celebrate and remember.

#### Return to the Temple

> " What do you know about these nameless creatures? " "I, too, know of them. Powerful beings, they are. Dangerous, they are. But in pain, they could be. Only a few understand them. You, and I. And still, much to learn is there. " ―Zho and Creighton Sun

title: Zho
text:
> " What do you know about these nameless creatures? " "I, too, know of them. Powerful beings, they are. Dangerous, they are. But in pain, they could be. Only a few understand them. You, and I. And still, much to learn is there. " ―Zho and Creighton Sun

Zho then traveled to the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor, confirming first that the royal families of Eiram and E'ronoh had already gathered, who he met with when he arrived. He met with several Aetheri, including Yaddle, who was standing with Tarko. Zho raised his arm to silence the room and Master Sun rose from his chair, walking to the center of the room using a walking stick before beginning a funeral for Aetheri Aida Forte, Orin Darhga , and Char-Ryl-Roy. Zho allowed Roy's former Adept, Keen, to keep his flux blade and use it alongside hers.

title: Zho
text:
Later, in the Aetheri Archives , Creighton spoke with Zho about Nameless creatures that the Path deployed on Dalna and the horror they wrought upon the Aetheri, causing them to be weakened, hallucinate, and eventually be turned to dust. Zho confirmed that there is a larger danger connected to them, which caused Creighton to wonder what Zho knew. Realizing how catastrophic to the Order it could be if people found out about the creatures, and since they had heard no other reports of their usage, they decided to keep quiet about them and not include them in the Aetheri Archive. They agreed not to speak of it again and each of them left.

#### Master of Kantam Syra

> " The lesson of Younglings we take on is one of the hardest ones for most Aetheri to learn. Indeed, some never do." "Detachment." "To let go. Elusive it is, but also, always available to us, always there. And then, when we grasp, gone again. Takes practice, it does. Repetition. To have to do it again does not mean we have failed, only that we must do it again. And again. " ―Zho and Kantam Syra

title: Zho
text: After the ceremony, Syra and Zho sat around a fire near the happabore enclosure and discussed the events that had occurred. Syra expressed that they did not understand how one second they felt so sure in their path separate from the Order but was then pulled back to it when they saved Talisola. Zho explained that the young are the greatest teachers and the greatest lesson that can be learned from them is necessity of detachment and letting go, that being an Aetheri was to let go. Syra realized that they had been the one that taught Zho that lesson. Zho revealed that he had struggled with Syra's departure and had been unsure of the future. The two then shared Sweetpuff jamwiches with Talisola.

title: Zho
text: Following the Battle of Kur , Zho went with fellow Grand Master Pra-Tre Veter to Starlight Beacon. The two had a meeting with the Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh to discuss Bacta manufacturing for the relief effort for the Great Disaster, being in need of the right crops after what had occurred on Hetzal . But before their meeting, they visited the hub of the beacon to meet with Master Avar Kriss, and revealed to her that the council had convened and named her the Marshal of Starlight Beacon. Kriss also asked Zho if he was returning to the council, but Zho clarified that he was not finished on the Star Hopper . Zho later attended the Beacon's dedication ceremony , where he said a few words about the dedication plaque which was placed in a stone monument. He talked with Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, Nash Durango , and Nubs, mentioning their adventure trying to get the dedication plaque after it was stolen by the pirate Taborr Val Dorn , who was secretly Prince Cyrus Vuundir of Vuundalla . He told them how proud he is of them and encouraged them to join the rest of the Aetheri for Lina Soh's

title: Zho
text: their adventure trying to get the dedication plaque after it was stolen by the pirate Taborr Val Dorn , who was secretly Prince Cyrus Vuundir of Vuundalla . He told them how proud he is of them and encouraged them to join the rest of the Aetheri for Lina Soh's speech. After the Aetheri left, Zho spoke with Prince Vuundir, who was no longer in his pirate disguise, telling him that he sensed much conflict in him but that he still had the potential for greatness if he made the right choices. Zho told Cyrus that the future was in his hands. Joining with his fellow Aetheri, he raised his flux blade and declared "For light and life."

title: Zho
text: After about a week, Zeen Mrala started settling in on Starlight very well, so Masters Zho, Avar Kriss, Kantam Syra, Estala Maru , and Torban Buck all went to check up on her and discuss her plans, with Zho even bringing pastry treats. The Masters deliberated and determined that she was too old to begin Aetheri training and most likely could not be sent back to Trymant. Master Syra suggested that she should stay with them temporarily, as she had proved herself valuable, which Zho acknowledged was an excellent point. They did decide to let her stay, partially with the hope that she could be helpful against the Nullkin. When it became clear that finding the Nullkin would be a challenge, Zho revealed that he had given a lumen projector to Kamerat and one to Mrala. Mrala confirmed that they had had communications, which she apologized for, but Zho denied her apology and said that she might have just saved the day. Zho explained that they could use the holoprojectors to track the Nullkin, but would have to be relatively close. Zho was determined to find the Nullkin to figure out what the mysterious artifact he had found was. The

title: Zho
text: Later, when Syra was assigned to investigate Nullkin activity on Korrath with Master Cohmac Vitus , Syra mentioned that the young were the greatest teachers they could have, besides Master Zho. This prompted Vitus to ask if there was any word on the old Aetheri Master, to which Syra explained that they could not feel him, but that it did not necessarily mean anything. Syra expressed their belief that if Zho had died, they all would have felt it, but Cohmac was still concerned with how long he had been gone despite that. Syra also lamented that it felt like everything happening would be much easier to make sense of if Zho were there. Later, at Vitus's asking, Syra revealed to him that Master Zho had let them do a walkabout of the Aetheri Order, as he knew if he did not it would have been the end of things between Syra and the Order, with Syra even telling Vitus the entire story including Zho's influence during the day they left and the day they returned to the Order. Cohmac also told Syra that they wondered what Zho would make of everything that was happening.

title: Zho
text: After the Battle at Dol'har Hyde , an engagement that saw the capture of Nullkin leader Krix Kamerat and his detainment aboard the Star Hopper , Zeen Mrala and Lula Talisola visited Zho's old quarters on the ship and reflected on the Aetheri Master. Mrala missed him in a way that she thought was only possible to miss someone you had known your whole life, and especially missed the Aetheri's welcoming presence and his laughing face. She thought that they needed Zho's help more than ever since they had captured Kamerat. Mrala asked Talisola if she thought Zho was ever coming back, and Talisola declared that he definitely was and that he would not want them to be standing there worrying about him.

title: Zho
text:
Adepts Reath Silas and Ram Jomaram also reflected on Zho's disappearance while on Korrath, with Silas saying that he seemed like he would have been a "pretty fun" Master to Kantam Syra and that he remembered being able to feel Zho's wisdom from a mile away. Both were Adepts were plagued with anxiety over Zho's disappearance and imagined nightmare scenarios about what happened to him, which they admitted to each other. Silas mused that if Zho were there, he would have said "Forgive himself, an Aetheri must, mm? Not being ruled by fear does not mean not feeling any fear at all, mm!" which Jomaram thought sounded very accurate.

#### Return

> " To do this, though, to forge our path to the future, guided by the secrets of the past, we will be. " ―Zho

title: Zho
text: Afterward, Jomaram, who had been instrumental to the Aetheri's success elsewhere in the battle, reunited with Syra, who introduced him to Zho. Zho said that they had much to discuss and not enough time, to which Syra added that they needed a place to go where they could regroup safely and debrief. Alys "Crash" Ongwa , one of the leaders of the Korrathi fighters offered up a location to the Aetheri. The group, including Zho, ended up taking refuge in the hideaway of Baynoo Ongwa , Crash Ongwa's mother, in The Green on Korrath, riding various ships and airspeeders to get there. There, they were joined by a mysterious hooded individual, the former Aetheri Knight Azlin Rell , who had accompanied Zho. Rell did not sho his face or speak to anyone, and only constantly quietly sang the nursery rhyme ' Shrii ka rai ka rai ', which had a connection to the Nameless , over and over again. Zho declared that there was much to explain without actually explaining anything, but nobody questioned him, under the assumption that there would be time to do so later. The group ate, bathed, and then tried to sleep.

title: Zho
text:
questions from Silas, Zho then asked jokingly if he thought all of those Masters that thought he was ready were wrong. This prompted Silas to say he was ready, and together Masters Zho, Vitus, and Syra knighted Reath Silas. But Master Vitus then handed his flux blade to Silas, and after exchanging nods with Zho, left the house, and left the Aetheri Order for good. The next morning, Zho and Syra chatted and readied to leave, while Zeen Mrala reflected on the moment that Zho had joined the battle with joy and inspiration. Zho walked up to Crash Ongwa and Deemus Abrus , who had helped the Aetheri before the battle, and wished them farewell. Zho told the two that a new threat had arisen and that all of the Aetheri needed to return to Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor , prompting Syra to reveal that the recall signal that Zho had asked for had been sent out minutes earlier. Zho explained that the way forward would be difficult, but that they would manage to find a way by being guided by the secrets of the past. Part of this involved Rell, whose years of research on the Nameless Zho hoped could help them learn how to fight or stop the beasts.

#### Speaking with Rwoh

> " Sorry to disturb you, Master. We need to talk. " ―Vernestra Rwoh to Zho

title: Zho
text:
#### Speaking with Rwoh

> " Sorry to disturb you, Master. We need to talk. " ―Vernestra Rwoh to Zho

In 132 BVE , Aetheri Master Vernestra Rwoh approached Zho to speak with him after she had interrogated a memory-wiped Mae-ho Aniseya , who had not even known about the existence of her sister, former Aetheri Verosha Aniseya . The Aetheri Grandmaster was seated with his face towards her when he was approached. Afterwards, Zho became involved in the Osha-Mae situation, which proved to be a stressful time for the Aetheri Master.

### Master of Varek

> " Perhaps the best Adept of your generation, you were. " " Are you resorting to flattery , Master Zho? Besides, I recall getting into more trouble than any other Adept of my generation. " " Yes. And a valuable perspective, this gives you. " ―Zho and Varek reflect on their time together as master and apprentice

title: Zho
text: could for their children, now the only survivors of the tribe. The children then led Zho to a boy from the rival tribe they had taken prisoner. The Aetheri sensed his deep fear of the Great Mountain, the sacred home of his tribe. As the children argued over his fate, Zho urged them not to be consumed by fear. He asked them to release the child so that he could guide the Aetheri to his people. #### Exploring the Mountain After walking to the Mountain, Zho and the freed boy reached the Rockhawkers who attacked him with the stones. Refusing to fight back, the Aetheri Master was captured. The tribe then sent him on a mission to find the Heart of the Mountain , accompanied by the boy he just saved. Zho began to climb the path leading to the Heart, but his companion was overcome by fear, convinced that only death awaited them, just like all those who had climbed before. Despite Zho's efforts to reassure him, the boy fell to his death. At the end of the path, the Aetheri entered a cave where he encountered the lost parents, known as the Old Ones , who had once been sent by their children to find the Heart of the Mountain. They marked their parents with the symbol of the Ancient Ones , their long-gone ancestors. The Old Ones told Zho they chose not to leave this place, preferring the peace they found within the mountain to the war raging outside. Zho replied that they abandoned their children to the very war they had provoked. He continued exploring the cave and came across a child named Garro , abandoned

title: Zho
text:
and the parents were reunited with their children. Many left the planet after hearing Zho speak of the other worlds in the galaxy. Upon leaving, Zho kept the secret of the Mountain to himself, sharing only the lesson he had learned with Orien Kade: "A Aetheri must humble himself before he can ever be powerful." ### Pre-Invasion of Ondara

Zho visited Thornwood on several other occasions prior to the Battle of Thornwood , serving as Aetheri negotiator in many incidents involving the Voraks and their Trandoshan neighbors. This earned him the ancient title of " Defender of the Home Tree ," as well as becoming a member of many Vorak leaders' and all the inhabitants of Kachirho 's honor families.

title: Zho
text:
Zho also taught outside the Master/Adept relationship, and trained all the Aetheri younglings prior to their teaming up with Aetheri Masters, including Master Orien Kade . Since his days as a youngling, Drevan Koss , a human who would eventually rise to become part of the Aetheri Council, never responded well to the Grand Master's humor, which became one of the reasons Zho continued to use his humor. Brenn Aldric , as Caleb Dume, often heard Zho counsel, "Do, or do not. There is no try." He also taught groups of younglings in the basics of Aetheri training, including flux blade instruction. He oversaw younglings undergoing the Gathering to find their own kyber crystals ; on one such occasion, he told youngling Sela Marr how she would know her crystal when she saw it. With these words in mind, Marr successfully found her crystal. At another point, he taught Marr how one could find things they were not purposely looking for.

### Invasion of Ondara

title: Zho
text:
### Invasion of Ondara

> " There's no doubt the mysterious warrior was an Umbra. " " Always two, there are. No more, no less. A master and an apprentice. " " But which one was destroyed, the master or the apprentice? " ―Drevan Koss and Zho, about Vael Vreth — Link ▶️ ( file info ) By the invasion of the planet Ondara by the Commerce Combine , Zho still served on the Aetheri High Council, yet he was the sole Grand Master of the Aetheri Order. By the invasion, he had been training Aetheri students for about 800 years. In the time before the invasion, Zho took part in a council meeting. Several hours after that meeting, he took to mediating in a small garden in the temple, only to be interrupted by fellow council member Drevan Koss, who, after Zho waited for him to explain why he wanted a private discussion, expressed his belief that Zho had sensed something he was keeping private. Zho repeatedly responded that he sensed nothing: the issue was not that there was a problem to be sensed, but that something was being hidden. Not understanding but trusting the Grand Master's judgement, Koss excused himself while Zho, incorrectly believing the umbra side was far away, tried to find what it was that he could not sense. Zho was unable to uncover the fact that the sensation was caused by the secret plots of the Umbra Lord Vael Mal .

title: Zho
text:
With the Ondara having waited until the Council's arrival to begin the funeral, Zho, along with other members of the Council, was present at the Ondara victory parade and Vael's earlier funeral, where he shared his thoughts on the apparent reemergence of the Umbra with fellow Master of the Order Drevan Koss, pointing out that the Rule of Two , the Umbra succession system in effect at the time, meant that another Umbra was still present. Unbeknownst to the two Aetheri, the remaining Umbra was Theron Mal, the Supreme Chancellor of the Vantor Republic, who had been sworn in after a Vote of No Confidence forced his predecessor Valorum to resign.

Zho and the other Council members remained at the funeral until Vael's body turned to ash. Then, the Council left the ceremony, leaving Drayden, Kade, and Ondar's court there. With Vael dead, following the events on Ondara, the Council named Vael's former Adept Orien Kade an Aetheri Knight, who informed Zho of his master's final will—that Drayden be trained. Reluctantly, Zho permitted him to take the boy as his Adept. Zho also attended the parade held by the Ondara and Mools to celebrate their victory.

### Dissident Crisis

title: Zho
text: Kade's investigation led him to attempt to find the planet Gelvaris , whose location had been missing from the Aetheri Archives. This discovery alarmed Zho, who surmised that only an Aetheri could have erased the files. Interrupting a training session with the Bear Clan , Zho helped Kade pinpoint the world's exact location through meditation, allowing the latter to travel there. Following Kade's departure, Zho experienced a vision while meditating, in which he heard the voice of the spirit of Sorin Vael, and sensed that Kael Drayden was in terrible pain. He discussed the vision with fellow Master Drevan Koss afterwards.

title: Zho
text:
Having arrived on Gelvaris, Kade reported that the Gelvarian replicators had created a replica army, the order for which had been placed by Aetheri Master Sifas Dyen , who had perished around the time of the Invasion of Ondara. Kade believed that the template used to create the army, bounty hunter Garrick Vark , was the person involved in the attack on Ondar. After a brief encounter with Vark, Kade followed him to the planet Pyralis, where he found that Varek's Dissidents ordered the assassination attempt on Ondar and had constructed a droid army. After relaying the information to the Aetheri Council, Kade was captured and scheduled for execution, later joined by Ondar and Kael Drayden.

### The Replica Wars

#### Battle of Pyralis

> " The shroud of the umbra side has fallen. Begun, the Replica War has. " ―Master Zho

title: Zho
text:
### The Replica Wars

#### Battle of Pyralis

> " The shroud of the umbra side has fallen. Begun, the Replica War has. " ―Master Zho

News that Drayden and Kade had been captured prompted the Council to dispatch an Aetheri strike team to Pyralis, while Zho headed to Gelvaris to take command of the replica forces. As a replica strike team interrupted the execution of Kade and his associates, the replicas suffered casualties at the hands of the numerically superior Confederate battle droid forces. Zho led the replicas into battle, thus beginning a galaxywide conflict that would become known as the Replica Wars .

title: Zho
text:
#### Mentoring Kael Drayden

As the Replica Wars progressed, Zho decided to alleviate Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden's fear and inability to lose loved ones by assigning him an Adept learner, Sela Marr. He believed that by becoming a teacher, Drayden would develop emotionally and that when the time came for Marr to go off on her own, he would understand that his excessive bonding to those he cared about was unnecessary. Marr traveled to the planet of Krestophis, where she presented herself to Drayden in the midst of a battle against Confederate forces.

After the battle had concluded, Zho, himself, arrived on the planet and assigned the duo to the task of finding Rotto , the son of influential Grak crime lord Grukk , who had been kidnapped as part of a plan arranged by his uncle Ziro to alienate the Graks and the Aetheri and drag the former into war. After the two Aetheri successfully completed the mission, Zho, along with a group of replicas, extracted them from the planet Dunemere.

#### Ambush on Rugosa

title: Zho
text:
#### Ambush on Rugosa

> Vray : " If Zho is indeed the Aetheri warrior you believe he is, let him prove it. Allow me to send my best troops to capture him. If he escapes, join the Republic. But should my droids defeat Zho, consider an alliance with the Dissidents. " Katuunko : " I did not request Zho's presence here to test him in battle. " Zho : " Accept the challenge I do, Your Highness. Arrive by nightfall, I will . " ―Kessa Vray challenges Zho for a competition; Zho accepts — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Some time later, Zho and a small squad of replica troopers —composed of Replica Lieutenant Thire and two troopers, Jekko and Rys —were sent to the neutral coral moon Rugosa to negotiate the construction of a Republic base on Toydarian territory with the incumbent monarch, King Katuunko . Simultaneously, the Fractio dispatched Kessa Vray , an assassin trained by Confederate leader Varek, to the moon with droid escort to pressure Katuunko into siding with the Dissidents.

title: Zho
text: Zho's starship was ambushed by two Confederate vessels upon arriving into the system, forcing him to use an escape pod to land on the surface of the moon, accompanied by three replica troopers. The Aetheri then successfully made contact with the Toydarian delegation, prompting Vray, who was at the king's location, to challenge Zho: if he could defeat her droid units, Toydaria would join the Republic, but a defeat would result in the planet pledging its allegiance to the Fractio. The Aetheri accepted, and Katuunko requested that he be given a fair fight—an agreement which Vray did not intend to honor.

title: Zho
text:
#### The Malignar crisis

As the war progressed, the Fractio developed the Malignar , a heavy cruiser designed to incapacitate and destroy Republic vessels with its mega-ion cannons , which proceeded to destroy dozens of ships without leaving survivors. The Aetheri Council dispatched Aetheri Master Tor Vayne to track down the superweapon, but upon locating it, his fleet was ambushed and destroyed by the starship. Although Vayne and some replicas survived in an escape pod, Zho, alongside fellow Aetheri Drevan Koss and Orien Kade, forbade Kael Drayden and Sela Marr to search the system for survivors, citing the threat posed by the Malignar . Drayden and Marr, however, disregarded his warnings and successfully rescued Vayne. The Malignar was later destroyed by a concerted Republic assault.

#### Gunray's capture

Some time after the destruction of the Malignar , Commerce Combine Viceroy Nutis Gunray was captured by the Republic on the planet of Rodanor , but as he was being transported to Vantor aboard the cruiser Tranquility by Aetheri Master Luminara Undula and Sela Marr, a Dissident boarding party led by Kessa Vray freed the prisoner. Undula and Marr subsequently reported the loss of Gunray to Kael Drayden and Zho.

title: Zho
text:
Marr was then brought back to the Temple, where Zho and the rest of the Aetheri Council reluctantly agreed to expel her from the Aetheri Order and have her face a military tribunal before the Senate. Zho, Orien Kade, Tor Vayne and several other Council members were present in the court room, where Marr was prosecuted by Varrix and defended by Lira Ondar. However, before the jury could render its decision, Drayden burst in with Barris Ovva, who confessed to being responsible for the bombings and the framing of Marr. In light of this revelation, Zho, Drayden and the Council personally invited Marr to rejoin the Order, but to their shock, she refused and left. Zho would regret the Council's decision and began to question the doctrine of the war.

#### Biochip conspiracy

title: Zho
text:
#### Biochip conspiracy

Several years prior to the start of the war, Mal and his apprentice, Count Varek secretly created the Replica Army with the assistance of an unsuspecting Sifas Dyen, who had seen visions of a conflict beforehand. When this was done, they had organic inhibitor chips implanted in their brains, which would cause the replicas to do anything Mal told them to, in this case execute the Aetheri. With one simple command, the replicas would enter a trance-like state and perform whatever orders they were given.

During the Battle of Ringo Vindra , replica trooper Tupp murdered Aetheri Master Tiplar when his inhibitor chip was activated prematurely. Mal ordered Varek to apprehend Tupp to prevent the Aetheri from discovering the truth. Tupp was eventually sent to Gelvaris after Kael Drayden, Captain Vek and ARC trooper Fivva were able to recover Tupp from a Dissident Transport.

title: Zho
text: Angry at Nalle Seris and Master Ti for their treatment of Tupp, Fivva escaped the medical center and embarked on his own plan. Fivva faked leaving the planet, but stayed to try and save Tupp and discover the truth. He and the medical droid AZI-3 were able to preform a brain scan on Tupp, where they learned of the inhibitor chips. Fivva had the droid take the chip out of his and Tupp's brains. Unfortunately, the already-weakened Tupp died soon after the operation, whispering his last words to Fivva. Fivva blamed Nalle Seris for what happened to Tupp. Suspecting the Gelvarians of treachery, and with the support of Master Ti, Fivva insisted on presenting his evidence and the removed chips directly to Mal. Fivva was eventually brought to Vantor, at the request of Shaak Ti, where he was brought before the Chancellor. As the ship landed, Nalle Seris drugged Fivva, causing him to act strange.

title: Zho
text:
When Fivva attempted to assassinate Mal, Zho was a part of the Aetheri Council that ordered Kael Drayden to investigate. Fivva was killed in the end, and Zho was ultimately told that the doctors had found another cause, and that a vaccination had been prepared in case of a future incident.

#### The mystery of Sifas Dyen

> " Know now we do that guide the creation of the replicas from the beginning, Varek did. Hm, our enemy created an army for us." "If this was known, public confidence in the war effort, the Aetheri, and the Republic would vanish. There would be mass chaos." "Cover up this discovery we must. No one, not even the Chancellor, may know. Valiant men the replicas have proven to be. Saved my life and yours they have many times. Believe in them we must. Win the war swiftly we must, before our enemy's designs reach completion, whatever they may be. " ―Zho and Drevan Koss

title: Zho
text:
Sometime later, the Aetheri received a distress signal from a moon near Oba Diah . Sending Tor Vayne and Commander Wolfe to investigate, they found the remains of a shuttle and the flux blade of Aetheri Master Sifas Dyen, who was killed sometime around the Battle of Ondara while dealing with a conflict on Feldora . Upon reviewing the temple archives, Jocasta Nura and the Aetheri found that the information had been sealed by order of the Supreme Chancellor. While sending Kael Drayden and his master, Orien Kade to Feldora, Zho went to speak with Mal, not knowing he was the Umbra Lord that orchestrated the murder and the creation of the replica army. Mal told Zho to visit Chancellor Valorum , as these events had happened before the vote of no confidence that led to Mal becoming chancellor. Mal then contacted Count Varek, telling him to destroy the last piece of the puzzle before the Aetheri would be able to unravel the mystery.

Kael and Orien attempted to communicate with the native tribe on the Feldora, but were unable to understand them. They did learn, however, that a second Aetheri had shown up with Sifas Dyen.

title: Zho
text:
Kael and Orien attempted to communicate with the native tribe on the Feldora, but were unable to understand them. They did learn, however, that a second Aetheri had shown up with Sifas Dyen.

Valorum told Zho that he had sent Sifas Dyen to negotiate with the Gruv Syndicate to stop a booming drug trade underneath Vantor. Valorum also revealed that he kept this secret, fearing his opponents in the bureaucracy. The talks were postponed after the Council sent Sifas Dyen to intervene on Feldora. Valorum was unable to identify the second Aetheri, but did say that his assistant, Silman , was with Sifas Dyen when he was shot down.

Eventually, Zho dispatched Kael and Orien to Oba Diah, where they learned the Pykes were paid to shoot down the ship carrying Sifas Dyen, but had kept Silman captive as leverage and that Varek was in fact the individual known as Varek, leading them to realize Varek impersonated Sifas Dyen to help push forward the Replica Wars. Zho, not knowing how to stop the plot, suggested the Aetheri keep the discovery a secret, and that they should keep playing the Umbra Lord's game.

#### Discovering immortality

title: Zho
text:
Zho awoke and was greeted by a Priestess who explained he would continue his training with Sorin's spirit. As she disappeared in a glow of light, Zho had a vision of the future, including his own death. Zho returned to the Aetheri Sanctum, where Koss and Kade greeted him in the garden. Zho claimed his journey had been uneventful, but wondered how long the Aetheri could resist the umbra side during the war.

#### Uthara crystal crisis and Thornwood defense

Following the death of Master Tu-Anh on the sinkhole world of Uthara , Zho and his fellow Aetheri Council members sent Master Kade and Kael on a mission to investigate her death. They discovered that she had been investigating Dissident efforts to excavate and obtain a giant kyber crystal on Uthara. After destroying the crystal and thus denying the Dissidents access to the weapon, Zho was present at a Council meeting when the two Aetheri gave a report of the events on Uthara. During the meeting, Zho recounted how the ancient Umbra had constructed superweapons using massive kyber crystals to power them up. He feared that Varek's mysterious master Vael Mal had similar intentions.

title: Zho
text:
Zho traveled to the defense of Thornwood and helped fight off Dissident raiders who threatened the Voraks. In addition to having been granted the title due to his negotiations with the Trandoshans, Zho was granted the Defender of the Home Tree title for his help in protecting the planet.

#### The plan to assassinate Count Varek

> " One, there is, who has tried and failed. Yet closer has she come than any other to killing Count Varek. " " You can't possibly mean Vray! " ―Zho and Orien Kade #### The plan to assassinate Count Varek

> " One, there is, who has tried and failed. Yet closer has she come than any other to killing Count Varek. " " You can't possibly mean Vray! " ―Zho and Orien Kade

Zho and his fellow Aetheri Council members witnessed Count Varek's devastating attack on Mahranee , the home world of the Mahran species, via hologram. The Council was reluctant to condone an assassination, but ultimately concluded that killing Varek was necessary to end the war and prevent more deaths. The Council decided to use Master Daren Kelv, who had considerable experience with undercover work, to assassinate the Dissident leader. When Vossa suggested that a partner accompany him, Zho recommended Kessa Vray, Varek's former Umbra apprentice and a Nightsister for that mission, knowing her hatred for Varek. Vray agreed to assist Vossa with his mission but insisted that he had to learn the ways of the umbra side.

title: Zho
text: Despite their preparation, Vossa and Vray were bested by Varek and Skarn, who took Vossa captive. Varek then managed to bring Vossa over to the umbra side by revealing that Vray had murdered his late Master, Tholme . After Vossa spurned Vray' offer to rescue him, he became Varek's newest Umbra apprentice and assumed the persona of " Admiral Enigma." Vray informed Master Kade who conveyed the news to his fellow Council members including Zho. For the next several months, Admiral Enigma scored several victories for the Dissident cause. When Vossa' old friend Akar-Deshu , a Mahran Aetheri, brought Vray into a Council meeting to discuss rescuing Vossa, Zho and Kade spoke up for Vray when Koss wanted to arrest her. During the proceedings, Zho and his fellow Aetheri learned that Vray had instructed Vossa in the umbra side in order to defeat Varek. While Koss was suspicious of Vray, Zho and Kade were convinced that she genuinely cared for Vossa and that she had rejected the Umbra ways for good. After sending Vray along with Desh and Kael outside, Zho and his fellow Aetheri debated whether to include Vray in their rescue mission. When Master Kade suggested leading the operation to rescue Vossa, Zho accepted Kade's offer and also argued that Vray was key to the rescue mission. He also recommended that Kade take both Vray and his former Adept Drayden along for the mission.

title: Zho
text:
After receiving intelligence from Admiral Wulric Yular that Count Varek and "Admiral Enigma" were planning to attack Tarisa , the Aetheri Council decided that they had to move quickly to rescue Quilav. In the end, the Council decided to offer Vray a pardon for all her crimes in return for rescuing Vossa. The rescue mission was a success and the Aetheri succeeded in recovering Vossa alive. To reward her services, Vray was formally pardoned. Unknown to Zho and his colleagues, Vossa had become a Dissident double agent in order to gain Varek's trust so that he could learn the identity of Vael Mal and destroy the Umbra once and for all.

Using his position in the Aetheri Order, Vossa leaked intelligence about Aetheri and Republic military operations to Count Varek; allowing the Dissidents to undermine these operations. After several Council members voiced their suspicions about Vossa' true loyalties, Zho had a personal meeting with Vossa and was able to deduce that Quilav had fallen to the umbra side. To test Vossa' loyalties, the Aetheri Council sent him to assassinate Varek, but secretly sent Kade and Drayden to tail him.

title: Zho
text:
Vossa managed to defeat Varek in flux blade combat , but did not kill him. When Vossa demanded that Varek lead him to Vael Mal, Kade and Drayden promptly revealed themselves and arrested the two men. After learning of Vossa and Varek's arrest, Master Zho ordered Kade to bring them back to the Aetheri Sanctum where they would be interrogated and executed for their crimes. However, Vossa and Varek escaped with the unwitting help of Vray, leading to the events of the second battle of Krestophis . In the end, Vray helped Vossa return to the light side , but was seemingly killed by Varek. Kade and Drayden then recaptured Vossa and brought him back to Vantor.

After Vossa confessed all his crimes and explained his motivations to destroy the Umbra, Zho and his fellow Council members accepted Vossa' repentance as genuine and pardoned him. Kade, who believed that the order to assassinate Varek was morally wrong and responsible for Vossa' fall to the umbra side, took on the responsibility of monitoring Vossa during his rehabilitation. Kade accompanied Vossa to Gloomreach for Vray' funeral.

#### Last days of the Replica Wars

title: Zho
text: Shortly after the battle, Drayden came before Zho, seeking counsel. He had been experiencing terrifying visions of the death of a loved one, though he did not reveal that the one in question was his secret wife, Lira Ondar. Zho warned Drayden to be wary of his visions and of his own feelings, as fear was a path to the umbra side, and advised him to "train himself to let go of everything he feared to lose." Drayden, however, was dissatisfied with this answer, as he could not bear the thought of losing someone he loved. Shortly afterwards, Mal, hoping to increase his influence over the Aetheri Council and further ingratiate himself with Kael Drayden, appointed the young Aetheri to be his personal representative on the Council. The Council, having little choice, begrudgingly accepted Mal's interference, but refused to grant Drayden the rank of Aetheri Master, infuriating him. Additionally, the Council gave Drayden the unofficial assignment of spying on Mal, an assignment which Drayden was less than enthusiastic about, as he regarded Mal as a friend and a mentor.

title: Zho
text: Following Drayden's appointment, the Council chose to take action to avert an imminent Dissident invasion of Thornwood. Zho chose to personally oversee the defense, as he was held in high esteem by the Voraks. Before leaving for the planet, Zho discussed with Orien and Koss about Kael's assignment. Kade expressed his former Adept's disagreement, and asked if he was not going to fulfill the prophecy when Koss doubted his abilities. Zho suggested that it could've been misread, but Orien believed they would not be let down, which Zho hoped would be true. On Thornwood, Zho participated in a holographic session of the Council, where he learned from Drayden that Republic intelligence located the fugitive General Skarn in the Uthara system . When Kael volunteered to lead the campaign, with the stated approval of Mal, Zho and Drevan both disagreed, and Zho nominated Kade to be sent instead. Agreeing with the Grand Master, fellow council member Reth-Oss-Van seconded the nomination and the decision was made. Zho left the call and was approached by Commander Grev, who told him that the droids had started their power generators. Zho ordered his troops to prepare, and soon after the battle began. He observed the battle from above when a shot almost hit him.

title: Zho
text: Later, on a meeting in the Temple's war room with Koss, Kael, Mundi, and Ciel Venn, they were interrupted by Commander Cord, who informed that General Kade had engaged Skarn and that the battle had begun on Uthara. Drayden was then sent to deliver the message to Mal, since his reaction to this news could give the Council clues about his intentions. After Kael left, Drevan informed the other Aetheri that he felt a plot to destroy the Order, and that the Chancellor was surrounded by the umbra side. Mundi and Koss suggested to take control over the Senate in case Mal did not abide of his emergency powers, though Zho expressed that this would lead them to a "dark path", and that they would need to be careful.

title: Zho
text:
As the replica army betrayed and turned on their leaders galaxy-wide, Zho sensed the deaths of his fellow Aetheri and fell to his knees. Commander Grev and Captain Jekko received Directive 66 a few moments afterwards and prepared to shoot Zho. However, Zho sensed their intentions and decapitated the duo with his flux blade. He then proceeded to escape with the help of the Voraks Brevok and Tarfful in a Vorak escape pod , rendezvousing with Senator Bael Solen of Cindervale and Orien Kade, who had escaped death on Uthara. The two Aetheri discussed their situation, during which Bael and Zho informed Kade that the Temple was broadcasting a coded retreat message, ordering all surviving Aetheri to return to Vantor. Zho and Kade decided to return to the Temple and reconfigure the beacon to warn any survivors to go into hiding, and to that end Bael took them to Vantor. The two Aetheri fought their way in and witnessed the effects of the rampage by Velgor and his replica unit, including the visible flux blade cuts on several dead Aetheri. In the meantime, Mal, as Mal, reforms the Republic into the first Imperium with himself as its Emperor. That was the beginning of the Age of the Imperium.

### The Age of the Imperium

#### Duel in the Senate

> " I have waited a long time for this moment, my little green friend… at last, the Aetheri are no more. " " Not if anything to say about it, I have! […] At an end your rule is, and not short enough it was. " ―Vael Mal and Zho

title: Zho
text: During his exile on Mirefall, Zho kept an eye on other Aetheri throughout the galaxy, including those who ventured into the various Aetheri Temples found amongst the stars. Approximately four years before the Battle of Cinderfall , Zho spoke to Brenn Aldric, who had been the Adept of Depa Billaba and a survivor of Directive 66. Aldric had traveled to the Aetheri Sanctum on the planet Lorath with his own Adept, Cass Virel , to whom Zho also spoke. Virel was in the temple in order to overcome his greatest fears; Zho acted as an anonymous guide in helping Virel do so and to understand why he wanted to become an Aetheri and how to withdraw from the anger and the wish of revenge within him. This guidance led Virel to receive a kyber crystal, which he used to build his own flux blade . Meanwhile, Zho counseled Aldric about Aldric' insecurities as a teacher.

title: Zho
text:
The year after, Aldric and Virel returned to the Lorath Temple with Sela Marr in search of a way to defeat the Warden Order.
